0.e: If the perfect Guru had indicated to them with the information about His whereabouts and location. (In stead of looking outside, they could have attained His convergence from within their own hearts.)(383)

0.e: But the world would not know about this fact without a perfect Guru. (384)

0.e: When the True Master is nearer than even your main artery,

0.e: O ignorant and amateur person! Then why are you roaming around jungles and wilderness. (385)

0.e: When someone familair and well conversant with this path becomes your guide,

0.e: You will be able to achieve solitude within the company of noble persons. (386)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਿਲ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਚਿਰਾ ਆਕਿਲ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: Whatever worldly possessions they have,

0.e: They are willing to relinquish them in one instalment instantly. (387)

0.g: ਮਰਦਿ ਆਰਿਫ਼ ਫ਼ਾਰਿਗ਼ ਅਜ਼ ਚੁਨੋ ਚਿਰਾ-ਸਤ ।

0.e: For this reason, they follow completely the perfectly enlightened persons. (388)

0.e: Perfect saints can transform you also into perfect saints;

0.e: And, they can fulfill all your desires and wishes. (389)

0.g: ਕੁਫ਼ਰ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਿਲ ਸ਼ੁਦਨ ।
0.e: The truth in it is that you should adopt the path leading towards the Lord,

0.e: So that you, too, can shine like the brilliance of the sun. (390)

0.e: And, the perfect and complete Guru like a true friend assists you in this process. (391)

0.e: Then, you will discover all types of material and non-material wealth and treasures inside you. (392)

0.e: And, helps in achieving the eternal divine wealth. (394)

0.e: Persons from both the worlds obey his (the Guru's) command spontaneously,

0.e: And, both the worlds are willing to lay their lives for him. (395)

0.g: ਰੂਜ਼ੋ ਸ਼ਬ ਦਰ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਬਾਸ਼ੰਦ ਸ਼ਾਦ ।
0.e: The real gratitude for Akaalpurakh is the (achievement of) true divine knowledge,

0.e: When, by abiding the All-powerful in his heart, recognized His Entity,

0.e: Take it that he achieved the treasure of eternal life. (397)

0.e: The splendor of Akaalpurakh radiates in your home-like-heart in such a way,

0.e: And, it is His command that speaks from your tongue. (401)

0.e: This body of yours is radiant because of the splendor of Akaalpurakh,

0.e: This entire world is shining with His refulgence. (402)

0.e: That it, too, can adopt noble virtues because of its fondness for Him. (408)

0.e: And provided succor to the heart-broken. (418)

0.e: Because it is him (Him) who can bestow tranquility to the mind and the soul. (419)

0.e: So that you could get the correct direction from His street to the path of Truth. (420)

0.e: Then, you can be the master of this heart without any (ritual) problems. (421)

0.e: The Akaalpurakh does not divulge His mysteries to him. (422)

0.e: When the complete and perfect true Guru becomes your guide and mentor,

Every morning and evening, my heart and soul,

Pehlee Paatshaahee (Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji)
The first Sikh Guru, Guur Nanak Dev Ji, was the one who glistened the true and all-powerful refulgence of the Almighty and to highlight the significance of knowledge of complete faith in Him.
He was the one who elevated the flag of eternal spirituality and eliminated the darkness of ignorance of divine enlightenment and who took upon his own shoulders the responsibility of propagating the message of Akaalpurakh.
Beginning from the earliest time to the present world, everyone considers himself to be the dust at his door;
The highest-ranked, the Lord, Himself sings his praises; and his disciple-student is the divine lineage of Waaheguru Himself.
Every fourth and sixth angel is unable to describe Guru's eclat in their expressions; and his radiance filled flag is flying over both the worlds.
Examples of his command are the brilliant rays emanating from the Provident and when compared to him, millions of suns and moons get drowned in the oceans of darkness.
His words, messages and orders are the supreme for the people of the world and his recommendations rank absolutely first in both the worlds.
His true titles are the guide for both the worlds; and his true disposition is the compassion for the sinful.
The gods in the court of Waaheguru consider it a privilege to kiss the dust of his lotus feet and the angles of the higher court are slaves and servitors of this mentor.
Both the ens (N's) in his name depict nurturer, nourisher ans neighborly (boons, support and benefactions); the middle A represents the Akaalpurakh, and the last K represents the Ultimate great prophet.
His mendicancy raises the bar of detachment from the worldly distractions to the highest level and his generosity and benevolence prevails all over both the worlds. (12)
Waaheguru is the Truth,
Waaheguru is Omnipresent
His name is Nanak, the emperor and his religion is the truth,
And that, there has not been another prophet like him who emanated in this world. (13)
His mendicancy (by precept and practice) lifts the head of saintly living to lofty heights,
And, in his view, everyone should be prepared to venture his life for the principles of truth and noble deeds. (14)
Whether special person of high status or ordinary people, whether angels or
Whether onlookers of the heavenly court, all of them are desirous-petitioners of the dust of his lotus feet. (15)
When God Himself is showering praises on him, what can I add to that?
In fact, how should I travel on the path of approbations? (16)
Millions from the world of souls, the angels, are his devotees,
And, millions of people from this world are also his disciples. (17)
Gods of the metaphysical world are all willing to sacrifice themselves for him,
And, even all the angels of the spiritual world are also prepared to follow suit. (18)
People of this world are all his creations as angels,

Through his benefaction, the all-powerful Waaheguru, he said (22)

Fourth Guru, Guru Ram Das Ji
The rank of the fourth Guru, Guru Ram Das Ji, is higher than the ranks of the four holy sects of angels.
Those who have been accepted in the Divine Court are ever ready to perform service for him.
Every unfortunate, ignoble, debased, sordid and mean person, who has sought refuge at his door, he, due to the greatness of the blessings of the fourth Guru, gets enthroned on the seat of honor and eclat.
Any sinner and immoral person who had meditated on his Naam, take it, that he was able to shake off the filth and the dirt of his crimes and sins far away from the ends of his body.
The ever-gifted 'Ray' in his name is the soul of every body;
the first 'Alif' in his name is better and higher than every other name;
the 'Meem' that is the model of the benevolence and kindness from head to toe is the favorite of the Omnipotent;
the  'Daal' including 'Alif' in his name is always attuned to the Naam of Waaheguru.
The last 'Seen' is the one to bestow honor and eclat on every handicapped and the destitute and is adequate to be of help and support in both the worlds. (68)

And, pearls-like messages and words  (metaphors and expressions) from the four Vedaas and six Shaastraas emerge from his utterances. (71)
Akaalpurakh has selected him as one of His specially close favorites,
And, has elevated him to even a higher position than His personal sacred souls. (72)
Everyone prostrates before him with a truthful and clear conscience,

Fifth Guru, Guru Arjan Dev Ji
The fifth Guru, the burnisher of the flames of the previous four Gurus of heavenly glow, was the fifth successor to the divine seat of Guru Nanak.
He was the withholder of the truth and the disseminator of the brilliance of Akaalpurakh, a teacher of high status with spiritual ostentation because of his own greatness and his rank was a way higher than the five sacred sections of the society.
He was the favorite of the heavenly shrine and a beloved of the extraordinary divine court.
He was one with God and vice versa.
Our tongue is incapable to describe his virtues and kudos. 
Persons of distinction are the dust of his path, and the heavenly angels are under his auspicious patronage.
The letter 'Alif' in the word Arjan that implies to weave the whole world into one link and is the proponent of the unity of Waaheguru, is the supporter and helper to every hopeless, cursed and disdained person. 
The 'Ray' in his name is the friend of every tired, languid and exhausted individual.
The heavenly aromatic 'Jeem' blesses freshness to the faithful and the companion of largess, 'Noon', patronizes the devoted believers. (74)
Guru Arjan is the personification of bestowals and praises,
And, is the searcher of the reality of the glory of Akaalpurakh. (75)
His entire body is the glimpse and reflection of the kindness and benevolence of Akaalpurakh,
And, is the propagator of the eternal virtues. (76)
What to speak of just two worlds, he had millions of followers,
All of them are drinking gulps of divine nectar of his kindness. (77)
Verses full of divine thought comes down out of him,
And, faith and trust-revealing essays, full of spiritual enlightenment, are also from him. (78)
Divine thought and conversation get the glitter and shine from him,
And, the divine beauty also gets its freshness and bloom from him.(79)
The Sixth Guru, Guru Har Gobind Ji
The personality of sixth Guru, Guru Har Gobind Ji, was spreading holy glitters and represented the form and the shape of scared lights.
The penetrating glow of the beams of his blessings was providing day light to the world, and the radiance of his laudation was the one that would remove the darkness for those living in utter ignorance.
His sword would annihilate the tyrannical enemies and his arrows could easily break open the stones.
His chaste miracles were as clear and bright as the clear day; and his lofty court was more lustrous than every high and holy sky. 
He was the gaiety of the congregations where discourses of imparting the spiritual education were held and where the magnificence of the five torches that adorn the world was highlighted.  
The first 'Hay' of his name was the bestower of the divine teachings of Waaheguru's Naam and was the guide for both the worlds.
The compassionate 'Ray' of his name was the pupil and darling of everyone's eye;
the Farsi 'Kaaf' (Gaaf) represented a pearl of divine affection and amity and the first 'Vaayo' was the rose providing freshness.
The eternal-life-granting 'Bay' was the beam of immortal truth; the meaningful 'Noon' was the God-given boon of ever-lasting Gurbaanee.
The last 'Daal' in his name was conversant with the knowledge of the secret and open mysteries (of Nature) and the Guru was able to foresee clearly all the invisible and supernatural mysteries. (80)

The seventh Guru, Guru (Kartaa) Har Rai Ji, was larger than the seven foreign countries, specially, Great Britain and nine skies.
Millions of people from all the seven directions and nine boundaries are standing in attention at his gate and the holy angels and gods are his obedient servitors.
He is the one who can break the noose of death; the chest of dreadful Yamraaj bursts open (with envy) when he listens to his laudation.
He occupies the immortal throne and is the favorite in the court of ever-bestowing-eternal Akaalpurakh.
Granter of blessings and boons, the Akaalpurakh Himself, is desirous of him and his strength is overpowering over His powerful Nature.

The 'Hay' along with 'Ray' can defeat the armed and weapon-wearing influential angels of the skies.
The 'Ray' along with 'Alif' can tame even the strong lions, and his last 'Yeh' is supporter of every common and special person. (86)

The Eighth Guru, Guru Har Kishen Ji
The eighth Guru, Guru Har Kishen Ji, was the crown of the 'accepted' and  the 'chaste' believers of Waaheguru and the honorific master of those who have merged into Him. 
His extraordinary miracle is world-famous and  the radiance of his personality lights up the 'truth'.
The special and near-ones are willing to sacrifice themselves for him and the chaste constantly bow at his door.
His numerous followers and those who have an appreciation of real virtues are the elite of the three worlds and the six directions, and there are countless persons who pick up bits and scraps from the refectory and pool of Guru's qualities.
The jewel-studded 'Hay' in his name is capable to defeat and bring down even the world-conquering and strong giants.
The truth-telling 'Ray' deserves to be seated respectfully with the status of a president on the eternal throne.
The Arabic 'Kaaf' in his name can open the doors of generosity and benevolence,
and the glorious 'Sheen' with its pomp and show can tame and overpower even the tiger-like strong monsters.
The last 'Noon' in his name brings and enhances freshness and aroma in life and is the closest friend of the God-given boons. (92)

In spite of the fact that he was the master of divine power, he still would always acquiesce and bow before the will and command of Waaheguru and was the mysterious instrument for the godly glory and majestic grandeur.
His personality was such that he had the capability of putting those who were his chaste and loyal followers to a severe test and to invigorate those devotees who follow an impartial methodology.
The travelers on the grand divine path and the inhabitants of the next world were existent due to his personality that was totally dependent on truth and was a close companion of the highest spiritual power.
He was the crown of the specialy selected devotees and the coronet of the proponents of God's adherents with truthful virtues.

0.g: ਗ਼ੈਰ ਯਾਦਸ਼ ਈਂ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਾ ਸ਼ਾਦ ਨੀਸਤ ।੨੫੭।
0.e: He is more sacred than every sacred word,

0.g: ਸ਼ਾਦੀਇ ਦਾਇਮ ਬਵਦ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।
0.e: And, he is more elevated than all the four types of mineral resources and six types of manifestations. (30)

0.g: ਐ ਜ਼ਹੇ ਦੌਲਤ ਕਿ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਰਾਹਨੁਮਾ ।੨੫੮।
0.e: His command is obeyed in all the six directions,

0.g: ਗਰ ਚਿ ਹੱਕ ਦਰ ਜੁਮਲਾਇ ਦਿਲਹਾ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: And, the entire kingdom is illuminated because of him. (31)

0.g: ਲੇਕ ਆਰਿਫ਼ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਈਮਾਂ ਬਵਦ ।੨੫੯।
0.e: The beat of His kettle-drum resonates in both the worlds,

0.g: ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਆਰਿਫ਼ ਕਾਬਲਿ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਹਸਤ ।
0.e: And, His godliness is the glory of the world. (32)

0.g: ਮਰਦਿ ਆਰਿਫ ਵਾਕਿਫ਼ਿ ਅਸਰਾਰ ਹਸਤ ।੨੬੦।
0.e: His elevated prominence illuminates both the worlds,

0.g: ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਹੱਕ ਰਾ ਦੂਸਤ ਦਾਰ ।
0.e: And, it burns down the enemies. (33)

0.g: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਹਮ ਗਰਦੀ ਜ਼ਿ ਯਮਨਸ਼ ਰੁਸਤਗਾਰ ।੨੬੧।
0.e: From the fish in the netherworld to the highest eternal limits,

0.g: ਹਰ ਚਿਹ ਹਸਤ ਅਜ਼ ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਈਸ਼ਾਂ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: The whole world follows his sacred Naam with their heart and soul. (34)

0.g: ਜ਼ਾਂ ਕਿ ਜਿਸਮੋ ਜਾ ਸਰਾਪਾ ਜਾਂ ਬਵਦ ।੨੬੨।
0.e: Kings and gods remember and worship Him in their meditation,

0.g: ਮੁਰਦੁਮਾਨਿ ਦੀਦਾ ਰੋਸ਼ਨ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ।
0.e: And, His belief and faith are much more fortunate and sublime than every other religion. (35)

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਜਿਸਮਮ ਜੁਮਲਾ ਗੁਲਸ਼ਨ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ।੨੬੩।
0.e: How about millions of Kaisers, emperors of Germany and millions of Mongolian kings

0.g: ਐ ਜ਼ਹੇ ਸਹੁਬਤ ਕਿ ਖ਼ਾਕ ਅਕਸੀਰ ਕਰਦ ।
0.e: How about innumerable Nausheervaans and countless emperors of Iran (36)

0.g: ਨਾਕਸੇ ਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤਦਬੀਰ ਕਰਦ ।੨੬੪।
0.e: Whether we talk abouit Egyptian kings or Chinese rulers of high rank,

0.g: ਗੋਹਰੋ ਲਾਲੋ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਪੇਸ਼ਿ ਸ਼ਾਂ ।
0.e: They all are the dust of his lotus feet (dust of the path on which he treads) (37)

0.g: ਹਰ ਦਮੇ ਕੂ ਬਿਗੁਜ਼ਰਦ ਦਰ ਯਾਦਿ ਆਂ ।੨੬੫।
0.e: All these people adore his feet and are his servitors and sleves,

0.g: ਈਂ ਜਵਾਹਰ-ਹਾ ਹਮਾ ਫ਼ਾਨੀ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: And, all of them are the followers of his divine commands. (38)

0.g: ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਬਰ ਬੰਦਾ ਅਰਜ਼ਾਨੀ ਬਵਦ ।੨੬੬।
0.e: Whether it be the Sultaan of Iran, or Khan of Khutan

0.g: ਰਸਮਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਦਾਨੀ ਕਿ ਚੀਸਤ ।
0.e: Whether it be the Daaraa of Tooraan, or the king of Yemen (39)

0.g: ਫ਼ਾਰਿਗ਼ ਅੰਦ ਅਜ਼ ਕੈਦਹਾਇ ਮਰਜੋ ਜ਼ੀਸਤ ।੨੬੭।
0.e: Whether it be the Tsar of Russia, or the ruler of India

0.g: ਯੱਕ ਨਫ਼ਸ ਬੇ ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਨਭਗੁਜ਼ਾਸ਼ਤੰਦ ।
0.e: Whether it be the officials of the South or those fortunate Raos (40)

0.g: ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਆਲਮ ਬਰ ਨਹੁ ਤਬਕ ਅਫਰਾਸ਼ਤੰਦ ।੨੬੮।
0.e: All the chiefs and the kings from the east to the west

0.g: ਖ਼ੈਰਖ਼ਾਹਿ ਜੁਲਗੀ ਪੈਦਾਇਸ਼ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: Are obeying his sacred command even at the cost of their lives. (41)

0.g: ਜ਼ੇਬ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿ ਈਂ ਹਮਾ ਆਰਾਇਸ਼ ਅੰਦ ।੨੬੯।
0.e: Thousands of emperors of olden Iran and tzars of Russsia

0.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਹੱਕ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਹੱਕ ਰਾ ਜ਼ੇਵਰ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: Are standing by, with their folded hands like slaves, ready to serve him. (42)

0.g: ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਸ਼ਾਂ ਅਜ਼ ਨੂਰਿ ਹੱਕ ਪੁਰ ਗੌਹਰ ਅਸਤ ।੨੭੦।
0.e: Thousands like Rustam and Saam, father of Rustam

0.g: ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਸ਼ਾਂ ਤਾਅਲੀਮਿ ਉਮਰਿ ਜਾਵਿਦਾਂ ।
0.e: And thousands of Asfand Yaars, the son of Gustapus who was blinded by Rustam with his arrow and then killed, are his slaves. (43)

0.g: ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਦਾਰੰਦ ਦਾਇਮ ਬਰ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਂ ।੨੭੧।
0.e: Thousands of rivers like Jamnaa and Gangaa

0.g: ਹਰ ਚਿਹ ਮੀਗੋਇੰਦ ਅਰਸ਼ਾਦਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।
0.e: Bow their heads respectfully on his lotus feet. (44)

0.g: ਬਰ ਨਮੀ ਆਰੰਦ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਅਜ਼ ਹੱਕ ਨਫ਼ਸ ।੨੭੨।
0.e: Whether (we talk of) gods like Indar or Brahmaa

0.g: ਈਂ ਹਮਾ ਮੁਸ਼ਤਾਕਿ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ-ਸਤ ।
0.e: Whether (we talk about) gods like Raam or Krishen (45)

0.g: ਬੋਸਤਾਨਿ ਦਹਿਰ ਗੁਲਜ਼ਾਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ-ਸਤ ।੨੭੩।
0.e: All of them are unable and inadequate to describe his eclats,

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿ ਬਾ-ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਹੱਕ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਆਸ਼ਨਾ ।
0.e: And, All of them are the seekers of his blessings and bestowals. (46)

0.g: ਸਾਇਆਇ ਊ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਅਜ਼ ਬਾਲਿ ਹੁਮਾ ।੨੭੪।
0.e: His fame is being celebrated on the beat of a drum in all islands and directions,

0.g: ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਯਾਅਨੀ ਜ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਬਿਗ਼ੁਜ਼ਸ਼ਤਨ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: And, his name is being honored in every country and region. (47)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ਿਆਲਿ ਗ਼ੈਰਿ ਹੱਕ ਵਾਰੁਸਤਨ ਅਸਤ ।੨੭੫।
0.e: His tales are talked about and discussed in every universe and cosmic region,

0.g: ਰਸਤਗੀ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ਤਨ ਵਾਰਸਤਗੀ-ਸਤ ।
0.e: And, all the connoisseurs of truth delightfully accept and follow his command. (48)

0.g: ਬਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਇ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ਤਨ ਦਿਲ-ਬਸਤਗੀ-ਸਤ ।੨੭੬।
0.e: Everyone from the nethgerworld to the seventh sky are the followers of his orders,

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਸ ਕੂ ਬਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਦਿਲ ਬਸਤਾ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: And, everyone from the moon to the fish deep below the earth are his servitors and slaves. (49)

0.g: ਊ ਜ਼ ਚਰਖ਼ਿ ਨਹੁ ਤਬਕ ਬਰ-ਜਸਤਾ ਅਸਤ ।੨੭੭।
0.e: His blessings and bestowals are infinite,

0.g: ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਦਿਲ-ਬਸਤਗਾਨਿ ਬਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।
0.e: And, His miracles and antics are divine and celestial. (50)

0.g: ਕੈ ਮੁਯੱਸਰ ਆਇਦਤ ਈਂ ਕੀਮੀਆ ।੨੭੮।
0.e: All the tongues are dumbstruck in praising him,

0.g: ਦੀਨੋ ਦੁਨਿਆ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਹੈਰਾਂ ਮਾਂਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: Neither any one can describe his eclat to any limits nor has enough courage to do so. (51)

0.g: ਬਸ ਜ਼ ਹੈਰਾਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਸ਼ਾਂ ਮਾਂਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।੨੭੯।
0.e: By nature, he is generous, and comeliness is in his character,

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿਹ ਰਾ ਈਂ ਆਰਜ਼ੂਏ ਪਾਕ ਹਸਤ ।
0.e: He is known for his generosities, and is remembered for his unlimited gifts. (52)

0.g: ਮੁਰਸ਼ਦਿ ਊ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਅਦਰਾਕ ਹਸਤ ।੨੮੦।
0.e: He is desirous of condoning the sins of the populace,

0.g: ਵਾਸਿਲਾਨਿ-ਹੱਕ ਤੁਰਾ ਵਾਸਿਲ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।
0.e: and he is the guarantor of the entire creations. (53)

0.g: ਦੌਲਤਿ ਜਾਵੀਦ ਰਾ ਹਾਸਿਲ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੮੧।
0.e: He is the redeemer of the people and he is the deposit in trust for all of them;

0.g: ਦੌਲਤਿ ਜਾਵੀਦ ਪੇਸ਼ਿ ਆਰਿਫ਼ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: Even the darkest clouds become shining with his touch. (54)

0.g: ਈਂ ਸਖ਼ੁਨ ਮਸ਼ਹੂਰ ਬਸ ਮੁਤਆਰਿਫ਼ ਅਸਤ ।੨੮੨।
0.e: He is the treasure of bestowals and a great collection of blessings,

0.g: ਆਰਿਫ਼ਾਨੋ ਕਾਮਿਲਾਨੋ ਵਾਸਿਲਾਂ ।
0.e: He is the abundance of beneficence and ultimate in generosity. (55)

0.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਊ ਦਾਰਦ ਦਾਇਮ ਬਰ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਂ ।੨੮੩।
0.e: He unfurls and waves the flag of wisdom and justice,

0.g: ਬੰਦਗੀਇ ਸ਼ਾਂ ਬਵਦ ਜ਼ਿਕਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।
0.e: He further glistens the eyes of trust. (56)

0.g: ਦੌਲਤਿ ਜਾਵੀਦ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਹੱਕ-ਨੁਮਾ ।੨੮੪।
0.e: He is the one with lofty palaces and tall mansions,

0.g: ਚੂੰ ਨੁਮਾਇਦ ਦੌਲਤਿ ਜਾਵੀਦ ਰੂ ।
0.e: He is generous in his character and habits, and gentle and suave in his facial features. (57)

0.g: ਤੂ ਜ਼ ਹੱਕ ਬਾਸ਼ੀ ਵਾ ਹੱਕ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਜ਼ ਤੂ ।੨੮੫।
0.e: Sacred is His court, and higher is His title,

0.g: ਬਰ ਦਿਲਤ ਗਰ ਪਰਤਵੇ ਹੱਕ ਬਰਫ਼ਗੰਦ ।
0.e: Thousands of moons and suns are begging at His door. (58)

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਰਿ ਹਿਜਰਤ ਰਾ ਜ਼ ਪਾਇ ਦਿਲ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੮੬।
0.e: His ranks are higher and He is a great refuge,

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਰਿ ਹਿਜਰ ਅਜ਼ ਪਾਇ ਦਿਲ ਚੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ।
0.e: He is the Knower of all the good and the bad secrets. (59)

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਨਾਇ ਦਿਲ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਮਾਮੂਰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ।੨੮੭।
0.e: He sanctifies different regions and is the donor of benedictions,

0.g: ਹਮਚੂ ਕਤਰਾ ਕੂ ਬਦਰਿਆ ਦਰ ਫ਼ਤਾਦ ।
0.e: He elevates the status and is the embodiment of compassion. (60)

0.g: ਐਨ ਦਰਿਆ ਗਸ਼ਤੋ ਵਸਲਸ਼ ਦਸਤਦਾਦ ।੨੮੮।
0.e: He is great in His nobility and is most appreciated for His characteristics,

0.g: ਕਤਰਾ ਚੂੰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਬਦਰਿਆ ਆਸ਼ਨਾ ।
0.e: He is respected for His customs and habits, and is praiseworthy for His form and shape. (61)

0.g: ਬਾਅਦ ਅਜ਼ਾਂ ਤਫ਼ਰੀਕ ਨਤਵਾਂ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਜ਼ ਜਾ ।੨੮੯।
0.e: His elegance and radiance is the circumference of the Divine grandeur,

0.g: ਕਤਰਾ ਚੂੰ ਜਾਨਿਬਿ ਦਰਿਆ ਸ਼ਤਾਫ਼ਤ ।
0.e: His glory and pomp is eternal and his eclat indestructible. (62)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਰਹਿ ਤਫ਼ਰੀਕ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਰਾ ਕਤਰਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤ ।੨੯੦।
0.e: He is beautiful because of his noble qualities, and is perfect in his virtues,

0.g: ਕਤਰਾ ਰਾ ਈਂ ਦੌਲਤਿ ਚੂੰ ਦਸਤਦਾਦ ।
0.e: He is condoner of the sins and is the supporter of and advocates the cause of the world. (63)

0.g: ਕਤਰਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਅੰਦਰ ਹਕੀਕਤ ਬਾ-ਮੁਰਾਦ ।੨੯੧।
0.e: He is generous by nature and is the master of blessings and generosity,

0.g: ਗੁਫ਼ਤ ਮਨ ਯੱਕ ਕਤਰਾ ਆਬੀ ਬੂਦਾ ਅਮ ।
0.e: All angels prostrate before him. (64)

0.g: ਪੈਹਨਿ ਦਰਿਆ ਰਾ ਚੁਨਾਂ ਪੈਮੂਦਾ ਅਮ ।੨੯੨।
0.e: He is the All-powerful master of the earth, the skies and the cosmos,

0.g: ਗਰ ਮਰਾ ਦਰ ਬਾਜ਼ ਰਾਹਿ ਲੁਤਫ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ।
0.e: He provides illumination in the darkest porches of the world. (65)

0.g: ਵਾਸਿਲ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਕਰਦ ਅਜ਼ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਬੇਸ਼ ।੨੯੩।
0.e: He is, in fact, is the light of maturity and courtesy,

0.g: ਹਮਚੂ ਮੌਜ ਅਜ਼ ਪੈਹਨਿ ਦਰਿਆ ਰੂ ਨਮੂਦ ।
0.e: He is the master of status and praises. (66)

0.g: ਮੌਜ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਵਾ ਕਰਦ ਦਰਿਆ ਰਾ ਸਜੂਦ ।੨੯੪।
0.e: He is the prophet of virtues and blessings,

0.g: ਹਮ ਚੁਨਾਂ ਹਰ ਬੰਦਾ ਕੁ ਵਾਸਿਲ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: He is the embodiment of boons and bestowals. (67)

0.g: ਦਰ ਤਰੀਕਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਬਸ ਕਾਮਿਲ ਅਸਤ ।੨੯੫।
0.e: He is the 'abundance' of generosities and wisdom,

0.g: ਮੌਜੌ ਦਰਿਆ ਗਰ ਚਿ ਦਰ ਮਾਅਨੀ ਯਕੇਸਤ ।
0.e: He is the 'collection' of accomplished and perfect persons. (68)

0.g: ਲੇਕ ਅੰਦਰ ਈਨੋ ਆਂ ਫ਼ਰਕੇ ਬਸੇਸਤ ।੨੯੬।
0.e: He is the manifestation and perfect jeweler of the offers and gifts.

0.g: ਮਨ ਯਕੇ ਮੌਜਮ ਤੂ ਬਹਿਰਿ ਬੇਕਰਾਂ ।
0.e: He recognizes and accedes to the helplessness of the lowly and meek.(69)

0.g: ਫ਼ਰਕ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ਮੀਨੋ ਆਸਮਾਂ ।੨੯੭।
0.e: He is the pride of the elderly and kings and chief of the amiable and the suave.

0.g: ਮਨ ਨੀਅੱਮ ਈਂ ਜੁਮਲਾ ਅਜ਼ ਅਲਤਾਫ਼ਿ ਤੂ ।
0.e: He is the abundance of blessings and representative of the competent, dexterous and the intelligent. (70)

0.g: ਮਨ ਯੱਕ ਮੌਜਮ ਜ਼ ਤਬਆਇ ਸਾਫ਼ਿ ਤੂ ।੨੯੮।
0.e: The world has gained beauty, splendor and glory from his radiance,

0.g: ਬਾ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਸੁਹਬਤੇ ਮੀ ਬਾਇਦਤ ।
0.e: The world and its people have profited a great deal from his blessings. (71)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਹੁਮਾ ਅੱਵਲ ਹਮੀਂ ਮੀ ਬਾਇਦਤ ।੨੯੯।
0.e: He has two diamonds in his hand that are brilliant like the Sun,

0.g: ਕਾਦਰਿ ਮੁਤਲਿਕ ਬਕੁਦਰਤ ਜ਼ਾਹਿਰ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: One of them represents beneficence and the other disaster and wrath. (72)

0.g: ਦਰਮਿਆਨਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਕਾਦਰ ਅਸਤ ।੩੦੦।
0.e: Due to the first (diamond), this world becomes a demonstration of truth,

0.g: ਕਾਦਰੋ ਕੁਦਰਤ ਬਹਮ ਆਮੇਖ਼ਤੰਦ ।
0.e: And, second is capable to dispel all darkness and tyranny. (73)

0.g: ਆਂ ਮਤਾਇ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਹੱਕ ਰਾ ਰੇਖ਼ਤੰਦ ।੩੦੧।
0.e: He has dispelled all the darkness and cruelty from this world,

0.g: ਪਸ ਤੁਰਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਇਦ ਐ ਯਾਰਿ ਅਜ਼ੀਜ਼ ।
0.e: And, it is because of him that the whole world is filled with aroma and ecstacy. (74)

0.g: ਹੱਕ ਕੁਦਾਮ ਵਾ ਤੂ ਕੁਦਾਮੀ ਕੁਨ ਤਮੀਜ਼ ।੩੦੨।
0.e: His face is lit with the Devine eclat,

0.g: ਗਰ ਤੂ ਵਾਸਿਲ ਗਸ਼ਤਾਈ ਦਰ ਜ਼ਾਤਿ ਊ ।

0.g: ਈਂ ਤਿਲਾ ਮਾਅਲੂਮ ਅਜ਼ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।੪੮੩।
0.e: And, this gold is realized only through the memory of Akaalpurakh. (483)

0.g: ਆਂ ਤਿਲਾ ਫ਼ਾਨੀ ਵਾ ਸਦ ਮੌਜ਼ਿ ਬਲਾ ।
0.e: This materialistic gold is destructible and is the root cause and whirlpool of  numerous problems and conflicts,

0.g: ਈਂ ਤਿਲਾ ਬਾਕੀ ਚੂ ਜ਼ਾਤਿ ਕਿਬਰੀਆ ।੪੮੪।
0.e: The gold of meditation, however, like the Entity of Omnipresent and True Waaheguru is permanent. (484)

0.g: ਦੌਲਤ ਅੰਦਰ ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਪਾਇ ਮੁਕਬਲਾਂ ।
0.e: The (true) wealth is in the dust of the feet of the noble and accepted souls,

0.g: ਦੌਲਤੇ ਕਾਂ ਰਾ ਨਮੀ ਆਯਦ ਜ਼ਿਆਂ ।੪੮੫।
0.e: It is such a true wealth that it is above and beyond any damage or loss. (485)

0.g: ਆਕਬਤ ਦੀਦੀ ਖ਼ਿਜ਼ਾਂ ਆਵੁਰਦ ਬਹਾਰ ।
0.e: You must have noticed that every spring brings in the autumn,

0.g: ਵਰਨਾ ਦਰ ਦੁਨਿਆ ਹਮਾ ਫ਼ਸਲਿ ਬਹਾਰ ।੪੮੬।
0.e: Although the spring keeps coming into this world again and again. (486)

0.g: ਈਂ ਬਹਾਰਿ ਤਾਜ਼ਾ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਤਾ ਅਬਦ ।
0.e: However, this meditational form of spring remains fresh and new till the doomsday,

0.g: ਯਾ ਇਲਾਹੀ ਦੂਰ ਦਾਰ ਅਜ਼ ਂਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਬਦ ।੪੮੭।
0.e: O Akaalpurakh! Kindly keep the influence of the evil eye far away from this spring . (487)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿ ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਪਾਇ ਸ਼ਾਂ ਰਾ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤ ।
0.e: Anyone who happens to obtain the collyrium of the dust of the feet of the holy persons,

0.g: ਬਰ ਰੁਖ਼ਸ਼ ਤਹਿਕੀਕ ਨੂਰਿ ਮਿਹਰ ਤਾਫ਼ਤ ।੪੮੮।
0.e: Rest assured that his face will shine like the brilliance and radiance of the divine sun. (488)

0.g: ਆਰਿਫ਼ਿ ਅੱਲਾਹ ਦਰ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: Even though spiritually enlightened person lives in this world,

0.g: ਦਰ ਹਕੀਕਤ ਤਾਲਿਬਿ ਮੌਲਾ ਬਵਦ ।੪੮੯।
0.e: He, in fact, is always a seeker-devotee of the Waaheguru. (489)

0.g: ਜ਼ਿਕਰਿ ਮੌਲਾ ਦਮ ਬ-ਦਮ ਦਰ ਜਾਨਿ ਊ ।
0.e: He meditates and describes His virtues every breath of his life,

0.g: ਆਇਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਦਰ ਸ਼ਾਨਿ ਊ ।੪੯੦।
0.e: And, he recites verses of His Naam every moment in His honor. (490)

0.g: ਹਰ ਨਫ਼ਸ ਦਾਰੰਦ ਦਿਲ ਰਾ ਸੂਇ ਹੱਕ ।
0.e: They keep directing their hearts and concentrating towards thoughts about Him,

0.g: ਸ਼ੁਦ ਮੁਅੱਤਰ ਮਗ਼ਜ਼ਿ ਸ਼ਾਂ ਅਜ਼ ਬੂਇ ਹੱਕ ।੪੯੧।
0.e: They make their intellect fragrant with the aroma of the memory of Akaalpurakhb in every breath. (491)

0.g: ਹਰ ਦਮੇ ਕੂ ਬਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਵਾਸਿਲ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: He always concentrates and is united with the Almighty at all times,

0.g: ਹਾਸਿਲਿ ਈਂ ਉਮਰ ਰਾ ਹਾਸਿਲ ਬਵਦ ।੪੯੨।
0.e: And, he has been able to achieve the real fruits of this life. (492)

0.g: ਹਾਸਿਲਿ ਈਂ ਉਮਰ ਪੇਸ਼ਿ ਮੁਰਸ਼ਿਦ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: The real fruits of this life lies with the Guru,

0.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਹੱਕ ਚੂੰ ਬਰ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨਸ਼ ਵਾਰਿਦ ਅਸਤ ।੪੯੩।
0.e: And, silent repetition and meditation of His Naam is always on his tongue and the lips. (493)

0.g: ਮੁਰਸ਼ਦਿ ਕਾਮਿਲ ਬਵਦ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਹੱਕ ।
0.e: The true Guru is the apparent glimpse of Akaalpurakh,

0.g: ਕਜ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨਿਸ਼ ਬਿਸ਼ਨਵੀ ਅਸਰਾਰਿ ਹੱਕ ।੪੯੪।
0.e: Therefore, you should listen to His mysteries from his tongue. (494)

0.g: ਸੂਰਤਿ ਹੱਕ ਮੁਰਸ਼ਦਿ ਕਾਮਿਲ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: A true Guru is indeed a perfect personification of the image of God,

0.g: ਨਕਸ਼ਿ ਊ ਦਾਇਮ ਦਰੂਨਿ ਦਿਲ ਬਵਦ ।੪੯੫।
0.e: And, the image of Akaalpurakh always abides in his heart. (495)

0.g: ਨਕਸ਼ਿ ਊ ਦਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਕਸ ਜਾ ਕੁਨਦ ।
0.e: When His image resides permanently in someone's heart,

0.g: ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਹੱਕ ਅੰਦਰ ਦਿਲਸ਼ ਮਾਵਾ ਕੁਨਦ ।੪੯੬।
0.e: Then, just one word of Akaalpurakh settles down in the depths of his heart. (496)

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਸਤਮ ਤਰਤੀਬਿ ਈਂ ਦੁੱਰ ਦਾਨਾ ਰਾ ।
0.e: I have threaded these grains of pearls into a necklace,

0.g: ਕਿ ਆਸ਼ਨਾ ਸਾਜ਼ਦ ਦਿਲਿ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਰਾ ।੪੯੭।
0.e: So that this arrangement may make the ignorant hearts aware of the secrets of Waaheguru. (497)

0.g: ਆਬਿ ਹੈਵਾਂ ਪੁਰ ਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਚੂ ਜਾਮਿ ਊ ।
0.e: (This compilation) Like a cup is filled to the brim with the divine elixir,

0.g: ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਨਾਮਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਜ਼ਾਂ ਨਾਮਿ ਊ ।੪੯੮।
0.e: That is why, it has been given the name 'Zindagee Naamaa'. (498)

0.g: ਕਜ਼ ਤਕੱਲੁਮ ਬੂਇ ਇਰਫ਼ਾਂ ਆਇਦਸ਼ ।
0.e: From his speeches emerges the fragrance of divine knowledge,

0.g: ਵਜ਼ ਦਿਲਿ ਆਲਮ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਬਿਕੁਸ਼ਾਇਦਸ਼ ।੪੯੯।
0.e: With it, the knot (mysteries and suspicions) of the heart of the world is untangled. (499)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿ ਖ਼ਾਨਦ ਅਜ਼ ਰਹਿ ਲੁਤਫ਼ੋ ਕਰਮ ।
0.e: Whosoever recites this with the grace and compassion of Waaheguru,

0.g: ਗਰਦਦਸ਼ ਦਰ ਰਾਹਿ ਇਰਫ਼ਾਂ ਮੁਹਤਰਿਮ ।੫੦੦।
0.e: He receives laurels among the enlightened persons. (500)

0.g: ਹਸਤ ਜ਼ਿਕਰਿ ਆਰਿਫ਼ਾਨਿ ਪਾਕ ਰਾ ।
0.e: This volume contains description and delineation of sacred and divine men;

0.g: ਆਂ ਕਿ ਊ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਕੁਨਦ ਇਦਰਾਕ ਰਾ ।੫੦੧।
0.e: This description lightens up the intelligence and the wisdom. (501)

0.g: ਨੀਸਤ ਦਰ ਵੈ ਮੁੰਦਰਜ ਐ ਬਾ-ਖ਼ਬਰ ।
0.e: O informed person! In this volume,

0.g: ਗ਼ੈਰ ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਦਿਗਰ ।੫੦੨।
0.e: there is no other word or expression except the words or expressions of remembrance and meditation of  Akaalpuralkh. (502)

0.g: ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਸਰਮਾਯਾ-ਇ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਦਿਲੀਸਤ ।
0.e: Remembrance of Waaheguru is the treasure of the enlightened minds,

0.g: ਗ਼ੈਰ ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਹਮਾ ਬੇ-ਹਾਸਲੀਅਤ ।੫੦੩।
0.e: Everything else other than the meditation of Waaheguru is (absolutely) useless. (503)

0.g: ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਦੀਗਰ ਨੀਸਤ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਅਜ਼ ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ।
0.e: Do not read or even look at any word or expression except the ones about meditation of the Omnipotent,

0.g: ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਹਾਂ ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਹਾਂ ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ।੫੦੪।
0.e: Remembrance of God, yes remembrance of God, and only remembrance of God. (504)

0.g: ਯਾ ਇਲਾਹੀ ਹਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਪਜ਼ਮੁਰਦਾ ਰਾ ।
0.e: O Akaalpurakh! Kindly make every withered and disheartened mind green and confident again,

0.g: ਸਬਜ਼ ਕੁਨ ਹਰ ਖ਼ਾਤਿਰਿ ਅਫ਼ਸੁਰਦਾ ਰਾ ।੫੦੫।
0.e: And, refresh and rejuvenate every wilted and languishing mind. (505)

0.g: ਯਾ ਇਲਾਹੀ ਯਾਵਰੀ ਕੁਨ ਬੰਦਾ ਰਾ ।
0.e: O Waaheguru! Kindly help this person, yours truly,

0.g: ਸੁਰਖ਼ੁਰੂ ਕੁਨ ਹਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਸ਼ਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਰਾ ।੫੦੬।
0.e: And, make every ashamed and timid person successful and triumphant. (506)

0.g: ਦਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਗੋਯਾ ਹਵਾਇ ਸ਼ੌਕ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ।
0.e: O Akaalpurakh! (Kindly) bless the heart of Goyaa with the yearning of love (for You),

0.g: ਬਰ ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨਸ਼ ਜ਼ੱਰਾ-ਇ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ੌਕ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ।੫੦੭।
0.e: And, bestow upon the tongue of Goyaa just one particle of the fondness for Your love. (507)

0.g: ਤਾਂ ਨ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਵਿਰਦਿ ਆਂ ਜੁਜ਼ ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ।
0.e: So that he would not meditate or remember anyone other than the Lord,

0.g: ਤਾਂ ਨ ਖ਼ਾਨਦ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਹੱਕ ਦੀਗਰ ਸਬੱਕ ।੫੦੮।
0.e: And, so that he would not learn or recite any other lesson except that of the love and devotion for Waaheguru. (508)

0.g: ਤਾ ਨ ਗੀਰਦ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਨਾਮਿ ਜ਼ਿਕਰਿ ਹੱਕ ।
0.e: So that he would not speak any other word except the meditation and remembrance of Akaalpurakh,

0.g: ਤਾ ਨ ਗੋਇਦ ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਅਜ਼ ਫ਼ਿਕਰਿ ਹੱਕ ।੫੦੯।
0.e: So that he would not recite or read any other word or expression except that the one(s) on the concentration of spiritual thought. (509)

0.g: ਦੀਦਾ ਅਜ਼ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ-ਹੱਕ ਪੁਰ-ਨੂਰ ਕੁਨ ।
0.e: (O Akaalpurakh!) Kindly make my eyes refulgent with glow by blessing  me with a glimpse of the Almighty,

0.g: ਗ਼ੈਰ ਹੱਕ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ਾਤਰਿ ਦਿਲਿ ਦੂਰ ਕੁਨ ।੫੧੦।
0.e: Kindly remove everything from my heart except the entity of God. (510)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਪਗ ਜਿਉ; ਕੋਝਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਕਛੋਟਾ ।
0.e: The truth adorns the head like a turban but the falsehood is like a loincloth which remains in an untidy place.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਸਾਰਦੂਲੁ; ਕੂੜੁ ਜਿਵੈ ਹੀਣਾ ਹਰਣੋਟਾ ।
0.e: The truth is a potent lion and the falsehood is like an abased deer.

0.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜੀਐ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕਿ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ।
0.e: Transactions of truth bring gains whereas the trading in falsehood brings nothing but loss.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਦਮੜਾ ਖੋਟਾ ।
0.e: Truth being pure earns applause but the falsehood like a counter coin does not get circulated.

0.g: ਤਾਰੇ ਲਖ ਅਮਾਵਸੈ; ਘੇਰਿ ਅਨੇਰਿ ਚਨਾਇਣੁ ਹੋਟਾ ।
0.e: In the no-moon night, millions of stars remain there (in the sky) but the scarcity of light persists and pitch darkness prevails.

0.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਇਕੁ ਚੜ੍ਹੰਦਿਆ; ਹੋਇ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਪਵੈ ਫਲਫੋਟਾ ।
0.e: With the rise of the sun the darkness dispells in all the eight directions.

0.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਸਚੁ, ਜਿਉਂ ਵਟੁ ਘੜੋਟਾ ।੭।
0.e: The relationship between the false hood and the truth is similar to the relation of the pitcher and the stone.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਦੰਮਲੁ ਵਜੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਧਿਰੀ; ਖਾਇ ਤਮਾਚੇ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਜੜਿਆ ।
0.e: Two-faced drum roped all around is beaten from both the sides.

0.g: ਵਜਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਰਬਾਬ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕੰਨ ਮਰੋੜੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫੜਿਆ ।
0.e: Musical measures are played on rebeck but time and again its pegs are twisted.

0.g: ਖਾਨ ਮਜੀਰੇ ਟਕਰਾਂ; ਸਿਰਿ ਤਨ ਭੰਨਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਧੜਿਆ ।
0.e: Cymbals being paired strike each other and smash their heads and bodies.

0.g: ਖਾਲੀ ਵਜੈ ਵੰਝੁਲੀ; ਦੇ ਸੂਲਾਕ ਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੜਿਆ ।
0.e: The flute when empty from inside definitely chimes but when any other object enters into it (i.e. when duality enters it) an iron rod is pushed in it to clear it (it is put to trouble).

0.g: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਲਸੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ; ਭੰਨਾ ਘੜਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਘੜਿਆ ।
0.e: The golden vessel is got repaired but broken mud-pitcher is not formed again.

0.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ, ਸੜਾਣੈ ਸੜਿਆ ।੧੩।
0.e: Engrossed in duality the individual putrefies and is scorched for ever.

0.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: All competent God Himself is the efficient as well as material cause of all but He does everything according to the will of the holy congregation.

0.g: ਭਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The stores of that bestower are full but he gives according to the wishes of the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: That transcendental Brahm, by being the Guru, enrapts the holy congregation into the Word, sabad.

0.g: ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰੇ ਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: His glimpse can not be had by performing of yajna, offering sweets, yoga, concentration, ritualistic worship and ablutions.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਇ ਪੈਨ੍ਹੈ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Fellows in the holy congregation maintain father-son relationship with the Guru,

0.g: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤਿਆ; ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: and whatever he gives to eat and put on, they eat and wear.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ, ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ।੨।
0.e: God remains detached in maya.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਆਪਿ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਲਾ; ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ।
0.e: One's good mind finds everybody good in the world. A gentleman beholds everyone as gentle.

0.g: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ; ਸਭ ਕੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੇ ਲੇਖੈ ।
0.e: If one is bad himself, for him the whole world is bad and all is bad on his account. Lord Krsna helped

0.g: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਪਾਂਡਵਾ; ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Pindays because they had in them profuse sense of devotion and morality.

0.g: ਵੈਰ ਭਾਉ ਚਿਤਿ ਕੈਰਵਾਂ; ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Kaurays had enmity in their heart and they always calculated the dark side of things.

0.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਰਵੰਨਿਆ; ਭਾਲਣ ਗਏ ਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਰੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Two princes went out to find a good and a wicked person but their views were different.

0.g: ਬੁਰਾਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੁਧਿਸਟਰੈ; ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਭੇਖੈ ।
0.e: None was bad for Yudhisthar and Duryodhan did not find any good person.

0.g: ਕਰਵੈ ਹੋਇ, ਸੁ ਟੋਟੀ ਰੇਖੈ ।੪।
0.e: Whatever (sweet or bitter) is there in the pot is known when it comes out through the spout.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨਿ ਸਰਦ ਸਸਿ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਹੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਜਾਨੇ ਬਰ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਊਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The light of full moon is considered cool and comforting by the whole world. But to me (suffering the pangs of separation of the beloved) it is like a burning wood.

0.g: ਅਗਨ ਅਗਨ ਤਨ ਮਧਯ ਚਿਨਗਾਰੀ ਛਾਡੈ; ਬਿਰਹ ਉਸਾਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਫੰਨਗ ਕੀ ਫੂਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: This pain of separation is causing countless fiery sparks in the body. The sighs of separation are like hissing sound of a cobra,

0.g: ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਖਾਨ ਫੂਟ ਟੂਟ ਜਾਤ; ਛਾਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਬਰਜਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੋਇ ਟੂਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Thus fire of separation is so strong that even stones break into pieces when they touch it. Despite much effort my chest is breaking into pieces. (I can't bear the pain of separation anymore).

0.g: ਪੀਯ ਕੇ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨ ਭਏ; ਜਨਮ ਲਜਾਯੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਚਿਤ ਚੂਕ ਹੈ ।੫੭੩।
0.e: Separation of the beloved Lord has made both living life and death burdensome. I must have made a blunder in abiding by the vows and promises of love that I had made that is sullying my human birth. (The life is going to waste).  (573)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: With the touch of philosopher's stone the eight metals become one metal and people call it gold.

0.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ; ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
0.e: That beautiful metal becomes gold and the jewellers also prove it to be gold.

0.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸੀਐ; ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਕੁਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Stone does not become philosopher's stone even after getting touched by it because the pride of family and hardness remains present in it (in fact the philosopher's stone is also but a stone).

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਟੀਐ; ਤੜਭੜ ਡੁਬੈ ਭਾਰ ਭੁਲਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Thrown in water, the stone full of pride of its weight sinks at once.

0.g: ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ; ਰਹੈ ਨਿਕੋਰੁ ਘੜੈ ਭੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Hard-hearted stone never gets wet and from inside remains as dry as it was earlier. It only learns how to break pitchers.

0.g: ਅਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੁਟਿ ਜਾਇ; ਅਹਰਣਿ ਘਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: It cracks when put in fire and becomes brittle when hammered on anvil.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੈ ।
0.e: Such person's also even after listening to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation do not keep to their heart the importance of the teachings.

0.g: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੁ, ਨ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Showing fake affection, none can forcibly prove to be truthful.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਬਹੁਤੀਂ ਘਰੀਂ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ; ਜਿਉ ਰਹੰਦਾ ਭੁਖਾ ।
0.e: A guest of many houses remains hungry.

0.g: ਸਾਂਝਾ ਬਬੁ ਨ ਰੋਈਐ; ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਨ ਚੁਖਾ ।
0.e: On the loss of common father of many, scant are the weeping and mental anxieties.

0.g: ਬਹਲੀ ਡੂਮੀ ਢਢਿ ਜਿਉ; ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਧੁਖਾ ।
0.e: When many drummers strike a drum, no one is pleased with the discordant voices.

0.g: ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਕਾਉਂ ਨ ਸੋਹਈ; ਕਿਉਂ ਮਾਣੈ ਸੁਖਾ ।
0.e: How could a crow wandering from forest to forest be happy and honourable.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਵੇਸੁਆ; ਤਨਿ ਵੇਦਨਿ ਦੁਖਾ ।
0.e: As a prostitute's body suffers from having many lovers,

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਨਿ ਹੋਰਨਾ; ਬਰਨੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾ ।੧੯।
0.e: Those who worship others than the Guru are unhappy in their apostasy.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਤਿਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Even a fraction of pleasure fruit of gurmukhs in the form of joy of love is imperceptible and beyond all accounts.

0.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Many are the creatures in the eighty-four lacs of species.

0.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ ।
0.e: They all have variegated colour of their trichomes.

0.g: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸਿਰ; ਮੁਹੁ ਲਖ ਸਰੇਖੈ ।
0.e: If to their single hair millions of heads and mouths were joined;

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੀਭੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੇਖੈ ।
0.e: If such million of mouths could speak through their millions of tongues;

0.g: ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਇਕੀਹ ਵੀਹ; ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ ।੧੩।
0.e: If myriad times more the world were created, even then it cannot equal the one moment (of the delight of love).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਅਸੁਰ ਭਭੀਖਣੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ; ਬਿਦਰੁ ਸੁ ਵਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ।
0.e: Saint Vibhisaa a demon, and Vidur son of maid servant came in the shelter of the Lord. Dhanni is known as a jai

0.g: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਸਧਨਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕਸਾਈ ।
0.e: And Sadhana was an out caste butcher. Saint Kabir was a weaver

0.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੁਲਾਹੜਾ; ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਂਬਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ।
0.e: And Namdev a calicoprinter who sang the praises of the Lord. Ravidas was a cobbler and saint Sairt belonged to (the so-called ) low barber caste.

0.g: ਕੁਲਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਸੈਣੁ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਈ ।
0.e: Female crow takes care of the fledgelings of nightingale but they ultimately meet their own family.

0.g: ਕੋਇਲ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਾਵਣੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: Though Yagoda nurtured Krsna, yet he came to be known as the lotus (son) ) of the family of Vasudev.

0.g: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਜਸੋਧਾ ਪਾਲਿਆ; ਵਾਸਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਕਵਲ ਸਦਾਈ ।
0.e: As the pot of any type containing ghee is not said to be bad,

0.g: ਘਿਅ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ; ਭਗਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ।
0.e: Likewise, the saints also have no high or low caste whatsoever.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ।੫।
0.e: They all remain in the shelter of the lotus feet of the true Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਵਸਦੀ ਛਡਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਜਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Owl does not have any thoughtful understanding and leaving habitats lives in deserted places.

0.g: ਇਲਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਨ ਪੜ੍ਹੈ; ਚੂਹੇ ਖਾਇ ਉਡੇ ਦੇਹਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Kite cannot be taught texts and eating rats keeps on flying the whole day.

0.g: ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਂਸ ਨੋ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Even being in the garden of sandal wood, the egotist bamboo does not get fragrant.

0.g: ਸੰਖੁ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੀਣਾ ਦੇਹ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ ।
0.e: As the conch remains empty though liviing in sea, the person devoid of the wisdom of Guru (gurmati) is spoiling his body.

0.g: ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਅਨਾੜੀ ।
0.e: The cotton-silk tree does not bear fruit howsoever much that colourless may brag of its greatness.

0.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਫਕੜਿ, ਪਵੈ ਰਿਹਾੜੀ ।੪।
0.e: Only fools quarrls over trivialities.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: The Guru preaches to the Sikh to be pure in conduct.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਮੇਲੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਅਵੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: He (gurmukh) joining the congregation remains absorbed in the Word.

0.g: ਫੁਲੀ ਤਿਲੀ ਫੁਲੇਲੁ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਲੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: In the company of flowers the sesame oil also becomes scented.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਨਕ ਨਕੇਲ; ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: Nose – string of God’s Will remains in the nose of the Sikh of the Guru i.e. he always keeps himself ready to be subservient to the Lord.

0.g: ਨਾਵਣ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲ; ਵਸਣ ਸੁਦੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: Taking bath in the ambrosial hours he remains enrapt in the region of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਵੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: Remembering Guru in his heart he becomes one with Him.

0.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਭੇਲੁ; ਸਾਧ ਸਰੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: He having the fear of the Lord and a loving devotion, is known as the sadhu of high stature.

0.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਲ ਨਵੇਲ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: The fast colour of the Lord goes on compounding on a gurmukh.

0.g: ਖੈਰ ਦਲਾਲੁ ਦਲੇਲ; ਸੇਵ ਸਹੇਸਿਆ ।੯।
0.e: The gurmukh only remains with the supreme Lord who is the giver of supreme delight and fearlessness.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Manmukh, the mind-orientated, leaving away the true Guru Lord becomes slave of man.

0.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਲਾਮ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Becoming errand boy of man he goes daily to salute him.

0.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ; ਹੋਇ ਹਜੂਰੀ ਖੜਾ ਰਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: All the twenty four hours (eight pahars) with folded hands he stands before his master.

0.g: ਨੀਦ ਨ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਸੁ; ਸੂਲੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਡਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Sleep, hunger and pleasure he does not have and remains so scared as if he has been sacrificed.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਧੁਪ ਛਾਉ; ਸਿਰ ਉਤੈ ਝਲਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Throughout rains, cold, sunlight, shade, he undergoes myriad sufferings.

0.g: ਆਤਸਬਾਜੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ; ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਾਇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: In the battlefield (of life) this same person, considering sparks of iron as fireworks gets mortally wounded.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ, ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵੰਦਾ ।੪।
0.e: Without the (shelter of) perfect Guru, he wanders through the species.

0.g: ਗੰਨਾ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ; ਰਸੁ ਦੇ ਦਰਹਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Crushed by the crushing machine sugarcane gives juice instantly.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁੜੁ ਭੇਲੀਆਂ; ਕੋ ਸਕਰ ਵਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Some prepare lumps of jaggery and brown sugar out of it.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਖੰਡ ਸਵਾਰਦਾ; ਮਖਣ ਮਸਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Some prepare refined sugar and some adding in it sweet drops make special jaggery.

0.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਕਲੀਕੰਦ; ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ਢਾਲਾ ।
0.e: It is moulded into lump sugar and variegated sweets.

0.g: ਖਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰਿ; ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ।
0.e: The poor and the wealthy both eat it with pleasure.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ।੧੨।
0.e: God (similar to sugarcane juice) permeates through all; for gurmukhs He is the essence of all the pleasures.

0.g: ਲਹੁੜਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਮਿਆ; ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Small sesame seeds sprouted and it remained lowly and got itself not mentioned anywhere.

0.g: ਫੁਲਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ; ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: When it came to the company of flowers, it earlier being devoid of fragrance now become fragrant.

0.g: ਕੋਲੂ ਪਾਇ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ; ਹੋਇ ਫੁਲੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: When alongwith flowers it was crushed in crusher, it became perfume oil.

0.g: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਪਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: God, the purifier of the impure ones, enacted such a wondrous feat that that fragrant oil gave pleasure to the king when messaged on his head.

0.g: ਦੀਵੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਲਾਇਆ; ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: When it was burnt in the lamp it came to be known as kuldipak, the lamp of the dynasty generally lit to complete the last rites of man.

0.g: ਕਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਵਿਅਹੁ; ਅਖੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From lamp becoming collyrium it merged in the eyes.

0.g: ਬਾਲਾ ਹੋਇ, ਨ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇਆ ।੯।
0.e: It became great but never allowed itself to be called so.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਭਲਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ; ਸਹੈ ਅਵਟਣੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ ।
0.e: The nature of madder is gentle; it bears the heat but dyes others in fast colour.

0.g: ਗੰਨਾ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ; ਟਟਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਮਿਠਾਸੁ ਵਧਾਏ ।
0.e: Sugarcane is first crushed in crusher and then put on fire in a cauldron where it further increases its sweetness when baking soda is put into it.

0.g: ਤੁੰਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਜੀਐ; ਕਉੜਤਣ ਦੀ ਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ।
0.e: Colocynth even if irrigated with nectar, does not shed its bitterness.

0.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ; ਭਲਾ ਨ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਏ ।
0.e: A noble person does not adopt demerits in his heart and does good to the evil doer.

0.g: ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਉਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੈ; ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮੰਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: But the evil doer does not adopt virutues in his heart, and does evil to the benevolent.

0.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ, ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ।੧੫।
0.e: One reaps what one sows.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਹਰਣ ਭਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Beyond pleasures and sorrows he is creator, sustainer and destroyer.

0.g: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਰਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: He is away from enjoyments, repulsions, forms and even being amidst festivities, he remains detached and stabilized.

0.g: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ; ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Unapproable through discussions, he is beyond the powers of intellect, speech; wisdom and praise.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ; ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Accepting Guru,(Arjan Dev) as God and God as Guru, Hargobind (the Guru)remains ever elated.

0.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜ ਮਿਲੈ; ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Being full of wonder he is absorbed in the supreme :Wonder and thus being awe inspired he remains immersed in supreme rapture , rapture.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ; ਖੰਡੇਧਾਰ ਕਾਰ ਨਿਬਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Moving on the way of gurmukhs is like treading on the edge of sword.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ, ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ ।੨੧।
0.e: Accepting the teachings of the Guru, the disciple adopts them in his life.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਦਸਤਗੀਰ ਹੁਇ ਪੰਜ ਪੀਰ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਅਤੋਲਾ ।
0.e: The first five Gurus held the hands of the people and the sixth Guru Hargobind is incomparable God-Guru.

0.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਅਡੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He is the king of spirituality as well as temporality and is in fact irremovable emperor of all the kings.

0.g: ਪੰਜ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਿ; ਹੋਇ ਮਸਤਾਨ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Assimilating the unbearable knowledge of the earlier five cups (Gurus) in the inner core of his mind he re,mains merry and wise mediator for humanity.

0.g: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ; ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਕੋਲੋ ਕੋਲਾ ।
0.e: In spite of the six philosophies spread around, he reaching the turiyä (highest stage of meditation) has attained the supreme reality.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਣੁ ਛਿਅ ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀਆਂ; ਇਕਸੁ ਦਰਸਣੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He has strung all the six philosophies and their sects in the strung of one philosophy.

0.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ; ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਵਿਰੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He has churned the essence of the lives of celebate ascetics, the followers of truth, contented people, the siddhs and naths (yogis) and the (so called) incarnations of God.

0.g: ਗਿਆਰਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ।
0.e: All the eleven Rudrs remain in the ocean but those (divers) who seek life in death get the invaluable jewels.

0.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਸੋਲਾਂ ਮੇਲ ਕਰਿ; ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਹਿੰਡੋਲਾ ।
0.e: All the twelve zodiac sings of sun, sixteen phases of moon and numerous constellations have provided a beautiful swing for him.

0.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ, ਬਾਲਾ ਭੋਲਾ ।੩।
0.e: This Guru is omniscient yet he possesses a childlike innocence.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਰੋਵੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਨੇਰੁ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Losing the jewel (in the form of the name of the Lord) the creature (on his birth) wails and weeps in utter darkness of maya and infatuation.

0.g: ਓਹੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He cries because of his own suffering but the whole family sings merrily.

0.g: ਸਭਨਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆਂ; ਰੁਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The heart of all is full of happiness and musical sound of drums is heard all around.

0.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਦਕੁ ਸੋਹਲੇ; ਦੇਨਿ ਅਸੀਸਾਂ ਬਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Singing songs of happiness maternal and paternal families bless the beloved child.

0.g: ਚੁਖਹੁਂ ਬਿੰਦਕ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ; ਬਿੰਦਹੁਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਰਬਤ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: From a small drop it increased and now that drop looks like a mountain.

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ; ਅਰਥੁ ਸੁਗਰਥ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Having grown up, he has with pride forgotten the truth, contentment, compassion, dharma and higher values.

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਧਰੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He started living among desires, anger, oppositions, greed, infatuation, treachery and pride,

0.g: ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਲ, ਫਾਥਾ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ।੭।
0.e: And thus the poor fellow got entangled in the larg web of maya..

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਪਿਕੰਬਰ ਅਉਲੀਏ; ਗਉਸ ਕੁਤਬ ਵਲੀਉਲਹ ਜਾਣੇ ।
0.e: In this religion (Islam) the pirs, prophets, aulias, gauns, qutbs and waliullah are well known.

0.g: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਿਵੇਸ ਵਖਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Millions of sheikhs , mashaiks (practitioners) and dervishes are described in it.

0.g: ਸੁਹਦੇ ਲਖ ਸਹੀਦ ਹੋਇ; ਲਖ ਅਬਦਾਲ ਮਲੰਗ ਮਿਲਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Millions of mean people, martyrs, faquirs and carefree persons are there.

0.g: ਸਿੰਧੀ ਰੁਕਨ ਕਲੰਦਰਾਂ; ਲਖ ਉਲਮਾਉ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਉਲਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Millions of sindhi rukhans, ulmas and maulanas (all religious denominations) are available in it.

0.g: ਸਰੈ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ; ਤਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਰਾਹ ਸਿਞਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Many are there who give exposition to the Muslim code of conduct (shariat) and many go on debating on the basis of tariqat, the methods of spiritual purification.

0.g: ਮਾਰਫਤੀ ਮਾਰੂਫ ਲਖ; ਹਕ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Myriad people have become famous by reaching the last stage of knowledge, the marfati and many in His divine Will have merged into the haqiqat, the truth.

0.g: ਬੁਜਰਕਵਾਰ, ਹਜਾਰ ਮੁਹਾਣੇ ।੮।
0.e: Thousands of elderly people were born and got perished.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਜਹਬ ਵਰਨ; ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The dealings of the four sects (of Muslims), four vamas (of Hindus) and the six schools of philosophy are current in the world.

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਵਿਚ ਵਣਜ ਕਰਿ; ਚਉਦਹ ਹਟ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In all the shops of fourteen worlds, that great banker (the Lord God) is doing business in the form of Siva and Sakti, the all pervading cosmic law.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਟੀਐ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The true merchandise is available in the Guru's shop, the holy congregation, wherein praises and glory of the Lord are sung.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸਦਾ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Knowledge, meditation, remembrance, loving devotion and the fear of the Lord are always propounded and discussed there.

0.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਰਤਨ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs, who are steadfast in remembering the name of Lord, ablution and charity, make bargains of jewels (virtues) there.

0.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The true Guru is benevolent and in his abode of truth, the formless Lord resides.

0.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਕੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Practising all the fourteen skills, the gurmukhs have identified love towards the truth as the fruit of all delights.

0.g: ਸਚਹੁਂ ਓਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਹੁ; ਉਪਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Everything is below truth but, for the gurmukhs truthful conduct is higher than the truth.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਤਰੈ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: As the fragrance of sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant, the whole world gets across through the teachings of the Guru.

0.g: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅ, ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੁਸੀਆਰਾ ।੬।
0.e: Drinking the nectar of the Guru's teaching, the Jiv becomes awake and alert.

0.g: ਸੋਵਤ ਪੈ ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖੀਓ ਚਾਹੇ; ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If someone desires to see the happenings of a dream in reality, it is not possible. Similarly the divine radiance of the celestial light generated due to Naam Simran cannot be described.

0.g: ਸੁਰਾਪਾਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਜਿਉ; ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਨਭੈ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As a drunkard feels satisfied and happy drinking liquor and he alone knows about it, similarly the continuous flow of the elixir of Naam generates divine awareness that is indescribable.

0.g: ਬਾਲਕ ਪੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਚਾਹੈ; ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਰੁਨ ਝੁਨ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a child is unable to explain the notes of music in various modes, similarly a Guru-conscious person who listens to the unstruck music cannot describe its sweetness and melody.

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੈ; ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨ ਗੋਤ ਹੈ ।੧੭੨।
0.e: The melody of unstruck music and continuous fall of elixir as a result is beyond description. One who has the process going in his mind, experiences it. Just as the trees which are fragranced by a Sandalwood are not regarded different than the Sandalwood

0.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: After wandering in many species of life, I have been able to get a chance of living a family life as a human being. When will I get this body of five elements again?

0.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨੰਮ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਹੁਇ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਭੋਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When will I get this invaluable birth as human being again? A birth when I shall be able to enjoy the relishments of sight, taste, hearing etc.

0.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ; ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: This is an opportunity of uniting into the knowledge, contemplation, meditation and enjoying the loving elixir-like Naam that the True Guru has blessed me with.

0.g: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਚਾਖ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਅਲੋਗ ਹੈ ।੨੪੩।
0.e: An obedient Sikh of the True Guru endeavours to make this birth a success by living his worldly life and yet remaining aloof. He relishes and repeatedly drink deep the elixir-like Naam that the True Guru has blessed him with and thus he becomes emancipate

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ; ਸਹੈ ਅਵਟਣ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ ।
0.e: The nature of truth is like madder which itself bears the heat of boiling but makes the dye fast.

0.e: The nature of falsehood is like that of jute whose skin is peeled off and then twisting it, its ropes are prepared.

0.g: ਚੰਨਣ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਸਾਏ ।
0.e: Sandal being benevolent makes all the trees, be they with or without fruits, fragrant.

0.g: ਵਡਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਵਾਂਸੁ ਹੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਗਵਾਂਢੁ ਜਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Bamboo being full of evil, bums in its own ego and at the out break of fire, bums its other neighbourly trees also.

0.g: ਜਾਣ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ; ਖਾਧੈ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਾਏ ।
0.e: The nectar makes the dead alive and deadly poison kills the living.

0.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜਹੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਏ ।
0.e: Truth is accepted in the court of the Lord, but, the falshood is punished in the same court.

0.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ, ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ।੨੦।੩੦। ਤੀਹ ।
0.e: One reaps what one sows.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ।
0.e: Those gurmukhs who have gone into the shelter of the holy congretation have attained the pleasure fruit.

0.g: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਏ ।
0.e: These devotees are Dhruv, Prahalad, Ambaris, Bali, Janak, Jaidev, Valmilci et al.

0.g: ਜਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜਗਿ; ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਏ ।
0.e: They have gone across through the holy congregation. Bent, Trilochan, Namdev, Dhanna,

0.g: ਬੇਣੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ; ਧੰਨਾ ਸਧਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾਏ ।
0.e: Sadhana have also been called saints. Kabir is accepted as bhagat, the devotee, and Ravidas,

0.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਜਨ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ ।
0.e: Vidur et al. have also been loved by the Lord. Whether born in high or the low caste,

0.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: The gurmukh who has adopted the lotus feet in his heart,

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਏ ।੧੫।
0.e: Decimating his ego has come to be known (as devotee).

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾਬਧੂ ਬੁਧਿਵੰਤ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ; ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਚੇਤਨ ਰਹੈ ਅਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as an intelligent daughter-in-law of a good family deals with everybody attentively, consciously and decently in her in-laws house;

0.g: ਸਸੁਰ ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਸਕਲ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ; ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Realizing that this is her husband's family, takes care of food and all other needs of her father-in-law, brothers-in-law and other members of the family diligently and respectfully;

0.g: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰਜਨ ਸੈ ਲਜਾਵਾਨ; ਸਿਹਿਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਤਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: She talks with all elders of the family respectfully, politely and abashedly. Similarly a devoted disciple of the True Guru is adept in observing respect towards all human beings.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ।੩੯੫।
0.e: But within himself, he remains focused on the divine sight of the God-like True Guru. (According to Bhai Gurdas Ji, practicing on the Guru's words and meditating on Lord's name given by the True Guru is contemplation on the vision of True Guru).  (395)

0.e: And, Guru Har Rai is commanding all the nine skies. (90)

0.e: On the other hand, He is the friend and support of the helpless and the destitute, (91)

0.e: The apostates get ',the shells only because their cultivation and labour is defective.

0.e: She is like the musical pipe which lures the deer, or lamp which burns the moth.

0.e: Due to the sinful activities her face in both the worlds remains pale because she behaves like a boat of stone which drowns its passengers.

0.e: Mouth, eyes, nose, ears, hands, teeth, hair etc. were bestowed upon it.

0.e: Man was given sight, speech, power of listening and consciousness of merging in the Word. For his ears, eyes, tongue and skin, the form, joy, smell etc. were created.

0.e: When grown up, he (man) leaving aside the creator Lord becomes engrossed with His creation.

0.e: He is free of all desires of taste, not dependent on the grace of gods and goddesses, transcendental of form, independent of all support, free of vices and doubts, fearless and stable of mind.

0.e: The ignorant one who tries to be clever or feigns indifference is expelled by the minister from the court.

0.e: In speaking and writing like this minister, loyal devoted disciples, have been created by the Guru.

0.e: The affection between a king and his minister is such as if the same one life current is moving in two bodies.

0.e: This relationship is also like the relation of the sword in the sheath; the two may be separate, yet they are one ( i.e. sword in sheath is yet called sword only).

0.e: Likewise is the relation of gurmukhs with the Guru; they are subsumed in each other in such a manner as is the juice and the sugarcane.

0.e: In the human birth, one is influenced by good or bad company. Thus the teachings of Guru instills virtues whereas bad company fills a person with base wisdom.

0.e: In the company of true people, one attains a position of a devotee, an analytical person, liberated alive and possessor of divine knowledge.

0.e: The attention of a Ruddy sheldrake and of Allectoris graeca is always towards Sun and Moon respectively. One loves only that in whom one's mind gets engrossed.

0.g: ਮੀਨ ਅਉ ਪਤੰਗ ਜਲ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ; ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਟੇਵ ਓਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੈ ਜੀ ।
0.e: In the context of love, fish loves water while a moth is mad over the flame of fire. Their habit of loving cannot be stopped and they live through their love till their last breath.

0.g: ਮਾਨਸਰ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਬਗੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ; ਉਤਮ ਅਉ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਸਮਤਾ ਹੈ ਜੀ ।
0.e: In the context of love, a swan is associated with Mansarover while an egret is found in ponds and puddles. There cannot be any equality in the love of high and low.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਭੇਦ; ਸਮਸਰ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਰਤਾ ਹੈ ਜੀ ।੪੯੨।
0.e: Similarly, there is much difference in the love of the Sikhs of the Guru and followers of gods and goddesses. True Guru is like ocean full of divine virtues whereas gods and goddesses are like rivers and brooks. Ocean and streams can never be alike.  (492

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਰੂਪੈ ਕਾਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ, ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Friendship of beauty and lust is known all over the world.

0.e: And this is very practical that hunger and taste are complementry.

0.g: ਘੁਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਚਲਿ ਲਬਿ ਮਾਲਿ, ਇਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Greed and wealth also mix up with each other and remain deluded.

0.g: ਊਘੈ ਸਉੜਿ ਪਲੰਘ ਜਿਉ, ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ।
0.e: For a dozing person, even a small cot is a pleasure to pass the night.

0.g: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੀਅਨਿ, ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ।
0.e: In the dream, one enjoys every colour of events.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਓਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ।੫।
0.e: Likewise, indescribable is the story of the love of the Sikh and the Guru

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਵਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਵਨੀ ਸਹੇਤ; ਸਕਲ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਏਕ ਬਾਂਝ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a king loves many queens who all bear him a son, but there may be one who is barren, who cannot bear any issue.

0.g: ਸੀਚਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਫਲ ਸਕਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ; ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸਲਿਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as irrigating the trees help them bear fruits but the cotton silk tree remains fruitless. It does not accept the influence of water.

0.g: ਦਾਦਰ ਕਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ; ਉਤਮ ਅਉ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a frog and a lotus flower live in one pond but lotus is supreme since it faces Sun and frog is low since it remains engrossed in mud.
