0.g: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਆਖੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਾਲੈ ।
0.e: The teachings of the Guru are subtler even than the hair itself; the Sikh should always follow them.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਲੰਘੈ, ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: The Sikhs of the Guru go across the world-ocean by virtue of their cup full of love.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨
ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਣਾ ।
0.e: One should remain in the will of the Lord by becoming an obedient servant.

0.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ; ਸਭਨਾ ਆਵਟਣ ਹੈ ਸਹਣਾ ।
0.e: All are in His will and all have to bear the heat of the divine order.

0.g: ਦਿਲੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Man should make his heart a river and let the water of humility flow into it.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣਿ ਬਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Leaving the worldly activities one should sit on the throne of holy congregation.

0.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਅਨਭਉ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Merging consciousness in the Word, one should get the ornament of fearlessness prepared.

0.g: ਸਿਦਕ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਬਤਾ; ਸਾਕਰੁ ਸੁਕਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਣਾ ਲਹਣਾ ।
0.e: One should remain true in faith and contentment; the transaction of thankfulness should be kept to continue and one should remain away from worldly give and take.

0.g: ਨੀਰਿ ਨ ਡੁਬਣੁ, ਅਗਿ ਨ ਦਹਣਾ ।੨੨।
0.e: Such a person neither drowns in water (of maya) nor gets burnt in the fire (of desire).

0.g: ਗੋਤਮਿ ਤਪੇ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਰਿਗਿ ਵੇਦ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ ।
0.e: Speculating seriously, seer Gotama has put forth the story of the Rgveda.

0.g: ਨਿਆਇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਕੌ ਮਥਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਭਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਜਣਾਈ ।
0.e: After churning the thoughts, in the Nyaya school, God has been defined as the efficient cause of all the causes.

0.g: ਸਭ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰਿ ਬਾਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲੇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ।
0.e: Everything is under His control and in His order, no order whatsoever of anybody else is accepted.

0.g: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪਿ ਨਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ।
0.e: He is in the beginning and at the end of this creation yet in this Shastra he is shown as separate from this creation.

0.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ।
0.e: No one has seen or known this creator, and rather people have remained indulged in the expansive delusions of prakriti (nature).

0.g: ਸੋਹੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਛਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਪੜਦਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ।
0.e: Not realising that soham parbrahm, the jiv is mistaken in understanding Him as a man (full of fallacies).

0.g: ਰਿਗਿ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਹੁ; ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ।
0.e: The Rgveda exhorts the knowledgeable people that supreme Lord is everything and none else can be compared with Him.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨਾ, ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ।੯।
0.e: Without true Guru this understanding cannot be attained.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਾਂਗੇ ਤੇਲੀਐ; ਪੰਡਿਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖੈ ।
0.e: A discussion between Gangu, the oilman and a pandit was being witnessed by one and all.

0.g: ਖੜੀ ਕਰੈ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੁਲੀ; ਗਾਂਗਾ ਦੁਇ ਵੇਖਾਲੈ ਰੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Showing one finger to Gang/ the pandit indicated that the Lord is one. But Gangu thought that he wanted to extract his (Ganges) one eye and hence he showed two fingers indicating that he will bring out both of his (pandit's) eyes.

0.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਉਚਾਇ ਪੰਜਾਂਗੁਲਾ; ਗਾਂਗਾ ਮੁਠਿ ਹਲਾਇ ਅਲੇਖੈ ।
0.e: But the pandit thought that Gangu is hinting at the two dimensions of Lord - nirgun (beyond all virtues) and sagun, (with all virtues).

0.g: ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ; ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਭੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Pandit now raised five fingers to show that His two forms are due to the five elements, but, considering the pandit as indicating that with five fingers he would scratch the face of Gangu,

0.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਅੰਗ ਦੁਇ; ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਸਰੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Gangs brandished his fist showing that he would kill him by the stroke of his fist. Now pandit felt that he was being made to understand that unity of five elements was the cause of the creation.

0.g: ਅਖੀਂ ਦੋਵੈਂ ਭੰਨਸਾਂ; ਮੁਕੀ ਲਾਇ ਹਲਾਇ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Mistakingly the pandit accepted his defeat and fell at his opponent's feet and left the place. In fact the fool had meant that he would bring out his eyes and attack with a tight fist but this was interpreted differently by the pandit.

0.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ, ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: Thus because of his specific thinking even the pandit was also proved a fool.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਚਾਰੇ ਚਕ ਨਿਵਾਇਓਨੁ; ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਣਤਾ ।
0.e: He has conquered all the four directions and the Sikh devotees come to him in countless number.

0.g: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ; ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣੀ ਬਣਤਾ ।
0.e: The free kitchen (latigar) wherein the word of the Guru is served runs unabated there and this is the perfect creation(arrangement) of the perfect Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਤਾ ।
0.e: Under the canopy of the Lord, the gurmukhs attain the supreme state bestowed by the perfect Lord.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸਤਾ ।
0.e: In the holy congregation, the. Word Brahm, which is beyond the Vedas and the Ketebas , is attained by gurmukhs.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜਨਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤਾ ।
0.e: The Guru has created myriad Janak-like devotees who remain detached amidst maya.

0.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਬਿਗਤਾ ।
0.e: The mystery of the power of His creation cannot be known and ineffable is the story of that unmanifest (Lord) .

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਸਹਜ ਜੁਗਤਾ ।੨੦।
0.e: The gurmukhs receive their pleasure fruit without any effort.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ; ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਪੂਰਾ ।
0.e: The life patron of Puranas, is the perfect Supreme Soul.

0.g: ਪੋਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ; ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਨ ਊਰਾ ।
0.e: Har, the Sustaining Lord, is not deficient in protection.

0.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ; ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਾ ।
0.e: Hail! Manifested is the Supreme Being in the countenance of gallant Guru Gobind Singh,

0.g: ਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਰੂਪ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੂਰਾ ।
0.e: Who is spectacular, and with his marvels, profusely he is Satguru, the True Lord.

0.g: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਜੀਅ ਜਪਿ; ਸਚੁ ਸਚੀ ਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Remember day and night, the virtues of Har who, at the times honest, endows truth.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੧੪।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੮
ਵਾਸ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਬਾਵਨ ਬੋਹਾਏ ।
0.e: Bamboo does not become fragrant but by the wash of Gum's feet, this also becomes possible.

0.g: ਕਚਹੁ ਕੰਚਨ ਨ ਥੀਐ; ਕਚਹੁਂ ਕੰਚਨ ਪਾਰਸ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Glass does not become gold but with the impact of philosopher's stone in the form of Guru, glass also transforms into gold.

0.g: ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਅਫਲੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਭ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: Silk-cotton tree is supposed to be fruitless but that too (by the grace of Guru) becomes fruitful and gives all sorts of fruits.

0.g: ਕਾਉਂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਉਜਲੇ; ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਧਉਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਏ ।
0.e: However, manmukhs like crows never change into white from black even if their black hair become white i.e. they never leave their nature even in old age.

0.g: ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ; ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਏ ।
0.e: But (by the grace of the Gum) the crow changes into swan and picks up invaluable pearls to eat.

0.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁਂ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਾਏ ।
0.e: The holy congregation transforming beasts and ghosts into gods, causes them to realize the word of the Guru.

0.g: ਤਿਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਤੀਆ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਏ ।
0.e: Those wicked ones who are engrossed in the sense of duality have not known the glory of the Guru.

0.g: ਅੰਨਾ ਆਗੂ, ਸਾਥੁ ਮੁਹਾਏ ।੨੮।
0.e: If the leader is blind, his companions are bound to be robbed of their belongings.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When a Sikh joins in the holy congregation and become engrossed in the divine word, the ecstasy of the spiritual waves felt by him is like the waves of the ocean.

0.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਿ ਆਹਿ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤਿ; ਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਹਰਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The ocean-like Lord is beyond our reach and its depth is unfathomable. One who stays engrossed in Naam Simran and adulations of the Lord is able to realise the jewel-like treasure of the Almighty.

0.g: ਹੰਸ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਕ ਚਾਹਕ ਸੰਤ; ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪਹਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The true disciple and seeker of the Lord remains a trader for the jewel-like traits of the Lord's name and he is never affected by the time of the day or night, watch, auspiciousness of the time and other rites and rituals.

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਰਖਾ ਜਿਉ ਗਵਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ; ਹੋਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਉ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰ ਹੈ ।੭੬।
0.e: As the Swati raindrop becomes a precious pearl when it falls on a clam in the deep sea, similarly when a Sikh experiences the divine unstruck music in the tenth opening (Dasam Duar) as a result of Naam Simran, he becomes God from the form of a human being

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਕੈ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਤਿ; ਪਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਨ ਅਥਾਹ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As the imperishable God is beyond beginning though He is the beginning of all; as He is beyond end since He is the end of all; as He is beyond the farthest conceivable extent as He is unfathomable, so is the praise of the True Guru just like that of Lord.

0.g: ਮਿਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਅਰ ਸੰਖ ਕੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਪੁਨਿ; ਲੇਖ ਕੈ ਅਲੇਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੌਲ ਕੈ ਤੌਲਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As the imperishable God is beyond measurement, beyond counting, beyond perception, beyond· weighing; so is the praise of a True Guru.

0.g: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੰਤ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨ ਮੋਲ ਕੈ ਮੁਲਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As the Almighty is limitless, inaccessible, beyond the perception of senses and evaluation, so is the praise of the True Guru.

0.g: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ; ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਡਾਈ ਹੈ ।੭੧।
0.e: As God Almighty is absolutely marvellous, astonishing and very strange, so is the praise of True Guru. (71)

0.g: ਸੋਭਿਤ ਸਰਦ ਨਿਸਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਸਿ; ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Note: Abandon bashfulness and enjoy the love of the beloved husband at the time of meeting Him. It is a wintry night and the Moon is spreading its light all around. A friend of the holy congregation urges to obtain Guru's sermons in order to enjoy .

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਇ ਹੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿਧਾਨ; ਮਿਲੀਐ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ਕੈ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ।
0.e: And when the clement Lord in His complete blessings comes and rests on your bed-like heart, then meet Him without any reservations and inhibitions.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ; ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਭਿਲਾਖੀਐ ।
0.e: May the frolicsome mind remain longing for the fragrant dust of the lotus feet of the Lord.

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਲਜਾਇ, ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਦਮ ਦੈ; ਪਲਕ ਅਮੋਲ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਸਾਖੀਐ ।੩੪੮।
0.e: Guru-conscious persons testify that any seeker bride who remains shy and bashful at the time of meeting with husband Lord, loses that rare opportunity. She is then unable to obtain the invaluable moment even after spending countless money. (348)

0.g: ਉਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ; ਦਸਵਾਂ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Guru Gobind Singh manifested as the tenth incarnation.

0.g: ਜਿਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ; ਜਪਿਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He inspired the meditation upon the imperceptible, timeless and flawless Creator.

0.g: ਨਿਜ ਪੰਥ ਚਲਾਇਓ ਖਾਲਸਾ; ਧਰਿ ਤੇਜ ਕਰਾਰਾ ।
0.e: And initiated the Khalsa Panth, the Religious Path of Righteousness, and bequeathed scintillating splendour.

0.g: ਸਿਰ ਕੇਸ ਧਾਰਿ ਗਹਿ ਖੜਗ ਕੋ; ਸਭ ਦੁਸਟ ਪਛਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Head high with full tresses, and the sword in hand, (the Panth) eliminated the adversaries,

0.g: ਸੀਲ ਜਤ ਕੀ ਕਛ ਪਹਰਿ; ਪਕੜੋ ਹਥਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Wearing the breaches, the symbol of chastity, raised the arms,

0.g: ਸਚ ਫਤੇ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ; ਜੀਤਿਓ ਰਣ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Roaring the war-cries of Victory to the Guru, prevailed in the immense battlefields,

0.g: ਸਭ ਦੈਤ ਅਰਿਨਿ ਕੋ ਘੇਰ ਕਰਿ; ਕੀਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Rounded up all the devilish foes and annihilated them.

0.g: ਤਬ ਸਹਿਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਪ ਅਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: And then docilely manifested the appraisal of great Guru in the world.

0.g: ਇਉਂ ਉਪਜੇ ਸਿੰਘ ਭੁਜੰਗੀਏ; ਨੀਲ ਅੰਬਰ ਧਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Thus descended the young Singhs, the lions, like the rain showers from the blue sky,

0.g: ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਛੈ ਕੀਏ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Who eliminated all the Turk (ruling Muslim) enemies and promoted the God's Name.

0.g: ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਠਹਿਰਿਓ; ਭਾਗੇ ਸਿਰਦਾਰਾ ।
0.e: None dared to face them, and all the chieftains took to their heels.

0.g: ਜਹ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਾਹ ਅਮੀਰੜੇ; ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਛਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The kings, sovereigns and emirates, all of them were decimated.

0.g: ਫਿਰ ਸੁਨ ਕਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਧਮਕ ਕਉ; ਕਾਂਪੈ ਗਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: With high pitched drum-beats (of victory), even the mountains shuddered.

0.g: ਤਬ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਲਚਲ ਭਈ; ਛਾਡੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The upheaval ruffled the earth and people forsook their domiciles.

0.g: ਇਉਂ ਐਸੇ ਦੁੰਦ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਹਿ; ਖਪਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In such a conflict and distress, the world was absorbed.

0.g: ਤਿਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ; ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: And there was none else than the True Guru who could eradicate the fright.

0.g: ਗਹਿ ਐਸੇ ਖੜਗ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ; ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਝੇਲਾ ।
0.e: He (the True Guru), beholding the sword, displayed the feats bearable to none.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੧੫।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੁ ਪੂਜੈ ਦੇਵਤੇ; ਧੰਨਾ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: A brahman would worship gods (in the form of stone idols) where Dhanna used to graze his cow.

0.g: ਧੰਨੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ; ਪੂਛੈ ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ।
0.e: On seeing his worship, Dhanna asked the brahman what he was doing.

0.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ; ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: “Service to the Thakur (God) gives the desired fruit,” replied the brahman.

0.g: ਧੰਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਜੋਦੜੀ; ਮੈ ਭਿ ਦੇਹ ਇਕ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Dhanna requested, “O brahman, if you agree kindly give one to me.”

0.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਲਪੇਟਿ ਕਰਿ; ਦੇ ਧੰਨੈ ਨੋ ਗੈਲ ਛੁਡਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The brahman rolled a stone, gave it to Dhanna and thus got rid of him.

0.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੋ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਾਲਿ ਕੈ; ਛਾਹਿ ਰੋਟੀ ਲੈ ਭੋਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Dhanna bathed the Thakur and offered him bread and buttermilk.

0.g: ਹਥਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਮਿਨਤਿ ਕਰੈ; ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ।
0.e: With folded hands and falling at the feet of the stone he begged for his service to be accepted.

0.g: ਹਉ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਨ ਜੁਠਾਲਸਾਂ; ਤੂ ਰੁਠਾ, ਮੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Dhanna said, “I will also not eat because how can I be happy if you are annoyed.”

0.g: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਇ; ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ਛਾਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: (Seeing his true and loving devotion) God was forced to appear and eat his bread and buttermilk.

0.g: ਭੋਲਾ ਭਾਉ, ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ।੧੩।
0.e: In fact, innocence like that of Dhanna makes the sight of the Lord available.

0.g: ਰਹਿ-ਰਸਾਨਿ ਰਾਹਿ ਹੱਕ ਆਮਦ ਅਦਬ ।
0.e:
Goyaa says, "I cannot attain nor understand my reality as to who I am,
Alas ! I have simply wasted all my life's assets.” (8) (4)
Goyaa says, "If someone ever happens to pass through the street of the Beloved,

0.g: ਹਮ ਬਦਿਲ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਵ ਹਮ ਬਲਬ ।੫।੧।
0.e: He would then never go for a stroll (which will be beneath the above pleasure) even in the heavenly garden.” (8) (5)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕੁਜਾ ਦੀਦੇਮ ਅਨਵਾਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।
0.e: The moon is abashed when compared to your (beautiful) face,

0.g: ਬਸਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਣ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਜਜ਼ਬ ।੫।੨।
0.e: In fact, even the world's sun is also mortified before your radiance, O Guru! its glow and light is subservient to yours. (9) (1)

0.g: ਚਸ਼ਮਿ-ਮਾ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਅਜ਼ ਜਮਾਲਸ਼ ਵਾ ਨਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ।
0.e:
Goyaa: "My eyes have never recognized anyone other than the Akaalpurakh.
Blessed are the eyes which can possibly see the Almighty.” (9) (2)
I do not brag about my meditation or sanctimony,
But if I am ever guilty of this sin, the Waaheguru is all-Forgiving.” (9) (3)
Where can we find another one,
When there is so much of noise and ado about the Only One." (9) (4)

0.g: ਜ਼ਾਣ ਕਿ ਜੁਮਲਾ ਖ਼ਲਕ ਰਾ ਦੀਦੇਮ ਰੱਬ ।੫।੩।
0.e: No word, other than the Naam of the Waaheguru ever comes to the lips of Goyaa,

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਕਦਮਸ਼ ਰੌਸ਼ਨੀਇ ਜਿਲ ਕੁਨਦ ।
0.e: because of His divine attribute being All-forgiving. (9) (5)

0.g: ਗ਼ਰ ਤੁਰਾਬਾ ਸਾਲਿਕਾਂ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ਨਸਬ ।੫।੪।
0.e: In (the chamber of my heart) our gathering, no sermon or discourse other than that about Akaalpurakh is delivered,

0.g: ਕੀਸਤ ਗੋਯਾ ਕੁ ਮਰਾਦਿ ਦਿਲ ਨ ਯਾਫ਼ਤ ।
0.e: Come in and join this congregation. There is no stranger here (in the secrecy of this rendezous). (10) (1)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਸੇ ਬਾ ਨਫਸਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਜਜ਼ਬ ।੫।੫।
0.e: Without worrying about others' personalities, try to understand your own;

0.g: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਅਰੁ ਅਧਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ; ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੁਰੋ ਤਉ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as no category of society, high, middle or low class considers their son bad or evil,

0.g: ਸਭ ਕੋਊ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤ ਕਉ; ਆਪਨੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਅਨਰਾਗਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as everyone do business in order to earn profit, but they all consider their own profession to be the best and therefore love it,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਇਸਟੈ ਚਾਹਤ ਸਭੈ; ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਰੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Similarly everyone respect and love their own deity and in their life-time, are ever ready and conscious of worshipping him,

0.g: ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਸਮਰਥ ਭਏ ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਾਨੈ; ਇਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅੰਤਿਕਾਲਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ।੫੫੨।
0.e: Just as a son when grown up understands the art of business and trading and acquires proficiency, similarly on receiving initiation from the True Guru, a devoted disciple learns that the knowledge, ambrosial name blessed by the True Guru is capable of lib

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: The true Guru (God) is the true emperor and the holy congregation is true throne which is most delightful.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਸਚੁ; ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਪਾਰਸ ਮੇਲਾ ।
0.e: The true Word is such a true mint where different castes in the from of metals meet the Guru, the philosopher's stone, and become gold (gurmukhs).

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ; ਸਚ ਮਹਲ ਨਵਹਾਣ ਨਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੋ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ ।
0.e: There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.

0.g: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ; ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone.

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ ।
ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਗਤਿ; ਸਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs remain detached among many hopes and they always play the game of truth.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ, ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ।੨੦।
0.e: Such gurmukhs become Guru and the Guru becomes their disciple.

0.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਨਾਰ ਸਾਜੈ ਜਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੁਤ ਨ ਖਿਲਾਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A woman may adore herself with very attractive embellishments but without surrendering to her husband, cannot enjoy the pleasure of playing with her son.

0.g: ਸਿੰਚੀਐ ਸਲਿਲ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਮੂਲ; ਫਲ ਨ ਬਸੰਤ ਬਿਨ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If a tree is watered day and night, it can not bloom with flowers in any other season than spring.

0.g: ਸਾਵਨ ਸਮੈ ਕਿਸਾਨ ਖੇਤ ਜੋਤ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਵੈ; ਬਰਖਾ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਤ ਨਾਜ ਨਿਪਜਾਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If a farmer ploughs his field and sows seed in it even in the month of Sawan, then without rain the seed cannot sprout.

0.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੇਖ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਭੂਮ; ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਰਿ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਦੀਪ ਨ ਜਗਾਇ ਹੈ ।੬੩੫।
0.e: Similarly, a man may dress himself in any number of disguises and wander the world over. Even then he cannot acquire the radiance of knowledge without the initiation of the True Guru and receiving His precept.  (635)

0.g: ਬਿਆਹ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਗਾਈਅਤਿ ਗੀਤ; ਏਕੈ ਹੁਇ ਲਭਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਨਿ ਕਾਨਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as in celebration of marriage, songs are sung both in the bride and bridegroom's house, the bridegroom's side stands to gain through dowry and arrival of the bride whereas the bride's family loses in wealth and their daughter.

0.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਤਾਨ; ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਜੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪਰਾਜੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as drums are beaten by both sides before commencement of battle, one wins and the other loses ultimately.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਕੂਲਿ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਮੈ ਭਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਚਲੈ
0.e: Just as a boat sets out fully loaded with passengers from both banks of a river,

0.g: ਕੋਊ ਮਾਝਿਧਾਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ
0.e: one sails across while the other may sink half way.

0.g: ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ; ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਪਦਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ।੩੮੨।
0.e: Similarly, by virtue of their good deeds, the obedient Sikhs of the Guru achieve high status in society while those who indulge in vices are easily recognised by their bad deeds.  (382)

0.g: ਕਉਡਾ ਪੈਸਾ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਸੁਨਈਆ ਕੋ ਬਨਜ ਕਰੈ; ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਕਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as one starts dealing in shells in the beginning, then in money, gold coins and then becomes evaluator of diamonds and precious stones. He is then called a jeweller.

0.g: ਜਉਹਰੀ ਕਹਾਇ ਪੁਨ ਕਉਡਾ ਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਕਰੈ; ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਮੈ ਪਤਸਿਟਾ ਘਟਾਵਈ ।
0.e: But after becoming famous as a jeweller, one starts dealing in shells, he loses his respect among the elite people.

0.g: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ; ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਊਚ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Similarly, if a follower of some god comes into the service of True Guru, he acquires high status in this and the world beyond.

0.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ; ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਪੂਤ ਹੁਇ ਹਸਾਵਈ ।੪੭੯।
0.e: But if someone leaves the service of the True Guru, and becomes a follower of some other god, then he wastes away his human life and he is laughed at by others being known as a bad son.  (479)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੭
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ; ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣ ਭਉਜਲ ਸੈਂਸਾਰੇ ।
0.e: This world is a game of oblong dice and the creatures go on moving in and out of the world-ocean.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋੜਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs join the association of the holy men and from there the perfect Guru (God) takes them across.

0.g: ਲਗਿ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਪੁਗਿ ਜਾਇ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ।
0.e: He who devotes his self to the Guru, becomes acceptable and the Guru dispels away his five evil propensities.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ; ਆਪਹੁਂ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: The gurmukh remains in a state of spiritual calm and he never thinks ill of anybody.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਚਲੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Attuning consciousness with the Word, the gurmukhs alertly move with firm feet on the path of the Guru.

0.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ; ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: Those Sikhs, dear to the Lord Guru, behave in accordance with morality, religious scriptures and the wisdom of the Guru.

0.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ, ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ।੨੭।
0.e: Through the means of the Guru, they stabilize in their own self.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਛੀ ਫਲ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਰੋਪੈ; ਨਿਹਫਲ ਰਹੈ ਬਿਰਖੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a gardener plants saplings of many trees for obtaining fruits, but one which does not bear any fruit becomes useless.

0.g: ਸੰਤਤਿ ਨਮਿਤਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਵਾਹ ਕਰੈ; ਸੰਤਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਛਾਜਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a king marries many women for obtaining a heir of his kingdom, but the queen who does not bear him a child is not liked by anyone in the family.

0.g: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਦਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਧਾ ਚਟਸਾਰ ਜੋਰੈ; ਬਿਦਿਆ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਲ ਨਾਮ ਉਪਰਾਜਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a teacher opens a school but the child who remains illiterate is called lazy and foolish.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਨਮਿਤਿ; ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਨਮ ਕਉ ਲਾਜਿ ਹੈ ।੪੧੫।
0.e: Similarly, True Guru holds a congregation of his disciples in order to impart them with supreme form of knowledge (Naam). But he who remains bereft of Guru's teachings, is worthy of condemnation and is a blotch on the human birth.  (415)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਐ ਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗਿ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਿਹੂੰਨ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as without eyes a face cannot be seen and without ears, no musical note can be heard.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਉਚਰੈ ਬਚਨ ਅਰ; ਨਾਸਕਾ ਬਿਹੂੰਨ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਨ ਲੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as without tongue, no word can be spoken and without nose no fragrance can be smelled.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਕਿਰਤ ਕ੍ਰਮ; ਚਰਨ ਬਿਹੂੰਨ ਭਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਕਤ ਕੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as without hands no accomplishable work can be done and without feet no place can be reached.

0.g: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਨ ਧਰੈ ਦੇਹ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ।੫੩੩।
0.e: Just as without food and clothes a body cannot be kept healthy; similarly without the teachings and divine words obtainable from the True Guru, the wondrous elixir of Lord's love cannot be relished.  (533)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Gumukhs get pleasure in the company of saints. They remain indifferent to maya though they live in it.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਹੈ; ਸੂਰਜ ਧ︀ਯਾਨੁ ਅਗਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ।
0.e: As a lotus, which remains in water and yet keep its gaze fixed towards the sun, gurmukhs always keep their consciousness attuned to the Lord.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸਪੀਂ ਵੇੜਿਆ; ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ।
0.e: The sandalwood remains entwined by snakes but still it spreads cool and peace-producing fragrance all around.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs living in the world, through the company of the saints keeping the consciousness attuned to the Word, move around in equipoise.

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਣਿ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ।
0.e: They conquering the technique of yoga and bhog (enjoyment) become liberated in life, undecievable and indestructible.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ।
0.e: As the transcendetal Brahm is the perfect Brahm , the same way the Guru who is indifferent to hopes and desires is also nothing but God.

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ, ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ।੨੧।੧੫। ਪੰਦ੍ਰਾਂ ।
0.e: (Through the Guru) that ineffable story and unmenifest light of the Lord becomes known (to the world).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਕਟਣੁ ਚਟਣੁ ਕੁਤਿਆਂ; ਕੁਤੈ ਹਲਕ ਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੂਗਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The dog, only bites and licks but if it goes mad, one's mind becomes scared of it.

0.g: ਠੰਢਾ ਤਤਾ ਕੋਇਲਾ; ਕਾਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Coal whether cold or hot makes the hand black or burns it.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਚੂੰਧਰ ਸਪ ਦੀ; ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਕੋੜ੍ਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Mole caught by snake makes it blind or leper.

0.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਰਸਉਲੀ ਦੇਹ ਵਿਚਿ; ਵਢੀ ਪੀੜ ਰਖੀ ਸਰਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Tumor in the body when operated upon gives pain and if it is kept untouched it is a cause for embarrassment.

0.g: ਵੰਸਿ ਕਪੂਤੁ ਕੁਲਛਣਾ; ਛਡੈ ਬਣੈ ਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: A wicked son can neither be repudiated nor he can adjust in the family.

0.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ; ਪਰਹਰਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਵਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Therefore, the stupid should not be loved and while enmity towards him should be avoided, detachment towards him should be maintained.

0.g: ਦੁਹੀਂ ਪਵਾੜੀਂ, ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ।੯।
0.e: Otherwise, both the ways, suffering is bound to occur.

0.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਕਰਬੈ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ।
0.e: The significance of bathing at places of pilgrimage is that body becomes clean and free of all desires and attractions.

0.g: ਦਰਪਨ ਦੀਪ ਕਰ ਗਹੇ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ; ਪੇਖਤ ਚਿਹਨ ਮਗ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਮਾਰੀਐ ।
0.e: Holding of mirror in the hand shows one the shape of features and body structure. Carrying a lamp in hand makes one aware of the path one walks on.

0.g: ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ; ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਬੂੰਦ ਸੀਪ ਗਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੀਐ ।
0.e: The union of husband and wife is like swati drop falling in an oyster that develops into a pearl. The wife becomes pregnant and she takes care of her pearl-like child in her womb.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀਐ ।੩੭੭।
0.e: Similarly, a disciple taking refuge of the True Guru and getting initiation from him is that the Sikh of the Guru adopts the teachings of the True Guru in his heart and lives his life accordingly.  (377)

0.g: ਪਵਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ; ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The basis of the world is air (the mixture of gases) and Sabad (Word) is the Guru of all knowledge from which flow further all thoughts, music and attendant sounds.

0.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ; ਉਤਪਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Mother and father are the creative forces in the form of earth and water.

0.g: ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ; ਵਰਤੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Night and day are the nurses who nurse for the creatures and this way the whole system goes on operating.

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ; ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: With the combination of Siva (the consciousness) and Sakti (the inert nature) this whole world comes into being.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਘਟਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: That transcendental perfect Lord is permeating through all as the same moon in the sky is visualised in all the pitchers of water.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਾ ।੧੯।
0.e: That Lord beyond all the sustenances is the sustenance for the gurmukhs and He alone operates through all.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਸੂਦ ਸਦਾਇਏ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਕਾਇਥ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Many are Sud and many are kaith, the bookkeepers.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਬਾਣੀਏ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਭਾਭੜਿਆਂ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: Many are traders and many more Jain goldsmiths.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਜਟ ਹੋਇ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਛੀਂਬੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ।
0.e: In this world millions are Jats and millions are calico printers.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਠਾਠੇਰਿਆ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲੋਹਾਰ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Many are coppersmiths and many are considered ironsmiths.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਤੇਲੀ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਹਲਵਾਈ ਬਾਜਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Many are oilmen and many confectioners are available in the market.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਪੰਖੀਏ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਨਾਈ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Many are messengers, many barbers and many more businessmen.

0.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਗੋਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ ।੧੨।
0.e: In fact, in all the four varnas, there are many castes and sub castes.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਪੀਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਟੇਰ ਹੇਰੇ ਬੂੰਦ; ਵੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a rain-bird longing for a Swati drop keep wailing making sound of  ' Peeu, Peeu' similarly a faithful wife fulfills her wifely duties remembering her husband,

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਪੇਖਿ ਜ੍ਵਾਰਾ ਜਰੈ; ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a love-lorn moth burns itself on the flame of an oil lamp, so does a woman faithful in love lives her duties and religion (She sacrifices herself over her husband).

0.g: ਜਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨ ਮਰ ਜਾਤ ਤਾਤ; ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਪੁ ਹਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a fish die immediately when brought out of water, so does a woman separated from her husband die of pangs becoming weak in his memory day by day.

0.g: ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ; ਕਰਨੀ ਕੈ ਐਸੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਰ ਹੈ ।੬੪੫।
0.e: A separated faithful, loving and devoted wife who lives her life according to her religion is perhaps one in a billion.  (645)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਵਡਾ ਗੜੁ; ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜਿਵੇਹੀ ਖਾਈ ।
0.e: Golden Lanka was a grand fort and the ocean around it was like a vast moat.

0.g: ਲਖ ਪੁਤੁ, ਪੋਤੇ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ; ਕੁੰਭਕਰਣੁ ਮਹਿਰਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਈ ।
0.e: Ravan had one lac sons, one and a quarter lac grand sons and brothers like Kumbhkaran and Mahiravari.

0.g: ਪਵਣੁ ਬੁਹਾਰੀ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਤਿ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਭਰੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆਈ ।
0.e: Air would broom his palaces whereas Indr through rains carried water for him.

0.g: ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਸੋਈਆ; ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਰਾਗ ਦੀਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Fire was his cook and the sun and the moon his lamp burners.

0.g: ਬਹੁ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਦਲ; ਦੇਸ ਨ ਵੇਸ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: His huge army of horses, elephants, chariots and infantry comprising many khuhants (akeauhauts, one aksauhani is known as a mixed force of 21870 elephants, 21870 chariots, 65610 horse and 109350 foot soldiers) was such whose power and grandeur cannot be e

0.g: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ; ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਰਹਂਦੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ।
0.e: He (Ravan) had served Mahadev (Siva) and due to this all the gods and demons were under his shelter.

0.g: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਲੈ, ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ।੧੯।
0.e: But evil intellect and actions earned him infamy.

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ; ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਜਨੇਊ ਜਤ ਹੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Except the name of the stable and firm Lord, no other deed is righteous. Except for the prayer and worship of Master Lord, worship of gods/goddesses is futile. No piety is beyond the truth and wearing of sacred thread without morality is futile.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਭਾਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Without obtaining initiation from a True Guru, no knowledge is worthwhile. No contemplation is useful except that of the True Guru. No worship is worth anything if not performed love, nor any view point expressed can invite respect.

0.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Without patience and contentment, peace cannot reside. No true peace and comfort is achievable without acquiring a state of equipoise. Similarly no love can be stable without the union of the word and mind (consciousness).

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ।੨੧੫।
0.e: Without deliberation on His name, one cannot establish faith in the heart and without the holy congregation of divine and saintly persons, engrossment in Lord's name is not possible. (215)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਤੇਰਹ ਤਾਲ ਅਊਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੁਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Thirteen beats of music are incomplete but gurmukh with his accomplishment of the rythm (of household life) attains delight.

0.g: ਤੇਰਹ ਰਤਨ ਅਕਾਰਥੇ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Thirteen jewels are also futile for the Gurmukh who gets the jewel of teaching of the Guru.

0.g: ਤੇਰਹ ਪਦ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪਿਤਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The ritualistic people have overawed the people in their thirteen types of rituals.

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਜਗ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਪੀਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Myriad burnt offerings (yajna) cannot be equated with nectar of the feet of gurmukh.

0.g: ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਲਖ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਣਾ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Even one grain of gurmukh;s is equal to millions of yajnas, offerings and edibles.

0.g: ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: And by making their fellow disciples of the Guru content, the Gurmukhs remain happy.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ, ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ ।੧੩।
0.e: God is undeceivable but He is dodged by the devotees.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Guru is replica of the perfect Braham who is unmanifest and indestructible.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ; ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Word of Guru (and not his body) s transcendent Brahm who resides in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ।
0.e: The company of the sadhus is the abode of truth where opportunity for loving devotion is created.

0.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Here all the four varnas are preached to and the wisdom of the Guru (Gurmat) brought before the people.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਰਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Only here touching the feet and by becoming dust of the feet, gurmukhs become followers of the way of discipline.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਗਤਿ; ਹੋਇ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ।੧।
0.e: Becoming neutral amidst hopes, the individuals through the holy congregation go beyond maya.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਵੈਦਿ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ਊਠਣੀ; ਲੈ ਸਿਲ ਵਟਾ ਕਚਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ।
0.e: A physician in order to cure a female camel, of a melon stuck in its throat, crushed the melon in its throat by hitting out side the neck with his pestle and mortar.

0.g: ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਵੈਦਗੀ; ਮਾਰੀ ਬੁਢੀ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਰੰਨਾ ।
0.e: His servant (who was watching) thought he had mastered the art and killed an old ill woman by the same process, causing general lamentation among women.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਫਲ; ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As a tree yields countless fruits, so is the gathering of many disciples (Gursikhs) of the True Guru.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ; ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Focusing mind on the holy form of True Guru who is the immanent manifestation of Lord, his percepts in the shape of word, its contemplation and understanding of the Transcendental form of God is in reality the contemplation of immanent Lord.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਾਧ; ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਧਾਰ ਹੈ ।੫੫।
0.e: By assembling in the holy congregation at the appointed place and meditating on Lord's name with total concentration and loving worship, can one sail through the worldly ocean. (55)

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੰਗਤੇ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਵੈਦ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਰੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Many are doners, many beggars and many the physicians and the diseased ones.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Many being in the state of spiritual calmness are associated (with the beloved one) and many get ting separated are undergoing the pangs of separation.

0.e: Many are dying of starvation whereas many are kinds who are enjoying their kingdoms.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਸੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Many are singing happily and many are weeping and wailing.

0.g: ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ; ਕਿਤੜੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੜੀ ਹੋਗੀ ।
0.e: The world is transitory; it has been created many times and still would be created again and again.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਸਚਿਆਰ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦਗਾਬਾਜ ਦਰੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Many are leading truthful life and many are cheats and liars.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ, ਕੋ ਜੋਗੀਸਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ।੧੭।
0.e: Any rare one is the true yogi and a yogi of the highest order.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Sikh who remains in service of his Guru, whose mind is engrossed in his teachings, who practices remembering Lord; his intellect becomes sharp and high. That enlightens his mind and soul with the light of Guru's knowledge.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਦਿਬਿ ਜੋਤਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: With Guru's word residing in the memory, seeing and treating all alike, he experiences the divine refulgence in his soul. By attachment of his mind in the divine word, he becomes a practitioner of Fearless Lord's Naam Simran.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਮਪਦ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By this union a Guru-conscious person achieves emancipation, the supreme spiritual state. He then rests in a state of perpetual comfort and peace and lives in a state of blissful equipoise.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।੬੨।
0.e: And by imbibing the divine word in his memory, Guru conscious person lives in the love of the Lord. He relishes the divine elixir forever. An astonishing devotion for the Lord develops in his mind then. (62)

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਿਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਤ ਆਵਤ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਤਿ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ।
0.e: How can the mysteries of the eternal Lord be brought into mind? He cannot be described. How can He be explained through words?

0.g: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਿਧੌ ਪਾਈਅਤਿ ਪਾਰ ਕੈਸੇ; ਦਰਸੁ ਅਦਰਸੁ ਕੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: How can we reach the beyond end of the infinite Lord? How can the invisible Lord be shown?

0.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਧੌ ਕੈਸੇ; ਨਿਰਲੰਬੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਵਲੰਬ ਠਹਿਰਾਈਐ ।
0.e: The Lord who is beyond the reach of the senses and perception, how can the Lord who cannot be caught be held and known? The Lord Master needs no support. Who can be assigned as His support?

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੈ; ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਜਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ।੨੫੩।
0.e: Only the Guru-conscious seeker experiences the infinite Lord who himself goes through that state and who is completely immersed in the True Guru blessed elixir-like words of the Guru. Such a Guru-conscious person feels free of his body bondages. He merges

0.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: From the shop of holy congregation, through the Word, the merchandise of God’s name is procured.

0.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਟਿ; ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: How to praise Him? The measuring criteria of the perfect Lord are perfect.

0.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ; ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: The warehouse of the True King is never deficient.

0.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖਟਿ; ਅਖੁਟੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: Cultivating the True Guru, those who earn through Him get merged into His inexhaustible Being.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਟਿ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: The company of the saints is manifestly great; one should always be in and with it.

0.g: ਚਾਵਲਿ ਇਕਤੇ ਸਟਿ; ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: Husk in the form of maya should be separated from the rice of life

0.g: ਜਮ ਦੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਕਟਿ; ਦਾਦਿ ਇਲਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: with strokes of discipline during this very life.

0.g: ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਘਟਿ; ਢੇਰੀ ਢਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: All the five evil propensities, should be decimated.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿਹਟਿ; ਸੁ ਖੇਤਿ ਉਮਾਹੀਐ ।੬।
0.e: As the water of well keeps the fields green, the field of the consciousness should be kept verdant (with the help of shabad).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ, ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ।
0.e: As the lamp is lit from the flame of another lamp;

0.e: As sandal's fragrance makes the whole vegetation fragrant

0.g: ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ, ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਣੀ ਚਾਲਿਆ ।
0.e: As the water mixing with water acquires the status of trivevi(the confluence of three rivers - Gatiga; Yamuna and Sarasvati);

0.e: As air after meeting the vital air becomes unstruck melody;

0.g: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ, ਪਰੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ।
0.e: As a diamond being perforated by another diamond gets stringed into a necklace;

0.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ, ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਾਲਿਆ ।
0.e: A stone by becoming the philosopher's stone performs its feat and

0.g: ਅਨਲ ਪੰਖਿ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ, ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲਿਆ ।
0.e: As an anil bird getting birth in the sky promotes the work of its father;

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖਾਲਿਆ ।੮।
0.e: Likewise the Guru making the Sikh meet the Lord establishes him in the equipoise.

0.g: ਤੀਜੀ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹੀ ।
0.e: Third Guru Guru Amar Das Ji. The Third Guru, Guru Amar Das Ji, was the noursiher-upholder of truth, emperor of regions and expansive ocean of bestowals and largess. The strong and powerful angel of death was subservient to him, and the chief of gods of maintaining the accounts of each and every person was under his supervision. The glow of the garb of the flame of truth, and the blossoming of the closed buds is their joy and happiness. The first letter of his holy name, 'Alif', bestows elation and serenity to every strayed person. The first letter of his holy name, 'Alif', bestows elation and serenity to every strayed person. The sacred 'Meem", blesses the ear of every grieved and afflicted person with the savor of poetry. The fortunate 'Ray' of his name is the glory and grace of his divine face and the well-intentioned 'Daal' is the support of every helpless. The second 'Alif' of his name provides protection and refuge to every sinner and the last 'Seen' is the image of the Almighty Waaheguru.

0.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਆਂ ਗਰਾਮੀ ਨਜ਼ਾਦ ।
0.e: Gueu Amar Das was from a great family lineage,

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਅਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲਿ ਹੱਕ ਹਸਤੀਅਸ਼ ਰਾ ਮੁਆਦ ।੬੪।
0.e: Whose personality received the wherewithal  (to complete the task) from the compassion and benignity of Akaalpurakh. (64)

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਵਸਫ਼ੋ ਸਨਾਇ ਹਮਾ ਬਰਤਰੀਂ ।
0.e: He is uperior than all in terms of laudation and admiration,

0.g: ਬ-ਸਦਰਿ ਹਕੀਕਤ ਮੁਰੱਬਅ ਨਸ਼ੀਂ ।੬੫।
0.e: He is sitting cross-legged on the seat of the truthful Akaalpurakh. (65)

0.g: ਜਹਾਂ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਨੂਰਿ ਅਰਸ਼ਾਦਿ ਊ ।
0.e: This world is glittering with the radiance of his message,

0.g: ਜ਼ਮੀਨੋ ਜ਼ਮਾਂ ਗੁਲਸ਼ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਦਾਦਿ ਊ ।੬੬।
0.e: And, this earth and the world have transformed into a beautiful garden due to his fairness. (66)

0.g: ਦੋ ਆਲਮ ਗੁਲਾਮਸ਼ ਚਿਹ ਹਜ਼ਦਹਿ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ।
0.e: What to talk about eighty thousand population, in fact, both the worlds are his slaves and servitors.

0.g: ਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲੋ ਕਰਾਮਸ਼ ਫਜ਼ੂੰ ਅਜ਼ ਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ।੬੭।
0.e: His praises and extols are innumerable and beyond any count. (67)

0.g: ਕਰਤ ਨ ਇਛਾ ਕਛੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ; ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Due to his childlike wisdom and unawareness of all sorts, a child is innocent, He desires nothing, nor does he harbour any hostility or friendship with anyone;

0.g: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਲੈ; ਬੋਲੈ ਮੁਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤ ਕਉ ।
0.e: His mother out of love keeps wandering behind him with food and clothing and utters elixir-like loving words for her son;

0.g: ਬਾਲਕੈ ਅਸੀਸ ਦੈਨਹਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗਾਰਿ ਦੈਨਹਾਰੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਡਾਰੀ ਸੇਤ ਕਉ ।
0.e: The mother loves her friends who keep showering blessings on her son but one who abuses him or say ill words for him destroys her peace of mind and creates duality.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਅਨੰਦਮਈ; ਜੈਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਕਉ ।੩੯੩।
0.e: Like the innocent child, the obedient Sikh of the Guru maintains impartiality. He treats all alike and by virtue of the relishing of the Naam Ras blessed by the True Guru, stays in a state of bliss. Whatever way is he recognised and known by the worldly p

0.g: ਅਵਘਟਿ ਉਤਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਜਪਤ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Crossing the difficult discipline of the Yogi; a Guru-oriented person bathes himself in the mystical tenth door of the spiritual realm. He dwells in the elixir-like Naam and becomes practitioner of fearless Lord.

0.g: ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅਕਾਸ ਬਾਸ; ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He experiences a continuous flow of the celestial nectar in the mystical tenth opening. He experiences light divine and continuous playing of celestial unstruck melody.

0.g: ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ; ਅਧਯਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A Guru-oriented person settles in self and gets absorbed in the Lord God. By virtue of his spiritual knowledge all the miraculous powers now become his slaves.

0.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ; ਸਲਿਲ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ।੨੪੮।
0.e: One, who, in this life has learnt the means of reaching the Lord is liberated while still alive. He remains unaffected by worldly matters (maya), like a lotus flower that lives in water and is not affected by it. (248)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਹੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: About the day and month of the creation, the Creator has told nothing to anybody.

0.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਣੁ; ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Formless One who resided in His own self did not make anybody see His imperceptible form.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਆਪੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Himself He created all and Himself He (for the weal of creatures) established His name in their hearts.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ; ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਹੋਂਦਾ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: I bow before that primal Lord, who is there in the present, who will remain in the future and who was in the beginning as well.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He is beyond beginning, beyond end and is infinite; but He never makes Himself noticed.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ, ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।੭।
0.e: He created the world and Himself subsumes it in His self.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਾ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਚੈ; ਛੁਅਤ ਅਪਾਵਨ ਛਿਨਕ ਛੋਤ ਲਾਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a woman cooks many dishes in a kitchen but a small act of unholiness makes the food contaminated or sullied.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਸਾਜਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਕੈ; ਪੁਹਪਵੰਤੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਤਿਆਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a woman embellishes her body and enjoys the union with her husband, but if her menstruation is due, the husband refrains from sharing bed with her.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਭਧਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਤ; ਮਲ ਮੈ ਗਰਭ ਛੇਦ ਖੇਦ ਨਿਹਭਾਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a woman makes every effort for the safety of her pregnancy, but if her menstruation re-starts, there is every fear of miscarriage. She then feels distressed and is called unfortunate.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮ ਜਨਮ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਕੀਜੈ; ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਤੂਲ ਮੈ ਬਜਾਗ ਹੈ ।੬੩੭।
0.e: Similarly, one should maintain disciplined life and piety of actions. But, if even a small sin is committed, it is like a dreadful fire in a bail of cotton. (One small wrong act destroys all the goodness that had been earned.)  (637)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਮੰਨੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਨਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Who accepts the order (will) of Lord makes the whole world accept His order (Hukam).

0.g: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ, ਗੁਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The order of the Guru is that the will of the Lord be accepted positively.

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਿ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Drinking the cup of loving devotion, they visualise the invisible (Lord).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇ, ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Gurmukhs even having seen (realised) do not go on divulging this mystery.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs delete ego from the self and never allow themselves to be noticed.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ, ਬੀਜ ਫਲਾਇਆ ।੧੩।
0.e: The Guru-orientated ones acquire the fruit of happiness and spread its seeds all around.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: Repudiating pride and ego a gurmukh should be humble.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਭਰਮ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ।
0.e: With the light of knowledge in his mind he should dispel darkness of ignorance and delusions.

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਢਹਿ ਪਵੈ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: He should fall on the feet (of Lord) in humility because only the humble are honoured in the court of the Lord.

0.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਂਵਦਾ; ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Master also loves that man who loves the will of the master.

0.g: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੈ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਵੈ ।
0.e: One who accepts the will of God is accepted by one understands that he is a guest in this world;

0.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ; ਦਾਵਾ ਛਡਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਾ ਦਾਵੈ ।
0.e: That is why foregoing all claims, he lives without making any claim for himself.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ, ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ।੧੩।
0.e: Being in the holy congregation, he acts in consonance with the commands of the Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਪਿਰਥੀ ਮਲੁ ਤੁਲਸਾ ਭਲਾ; ਮਲਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Pirathi Mal, Tulasa and Malhan were devoted to the service of the Guru.

0.g: ਰਾਮੂ ਦੀਪਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣੁ; ਨਾਗਉਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Ramu, Dipa, Ugarsain, Nagori would concentraye opon the world of the Guru.

0.g: ਮੋਹਣੁ ਰਾਮੂ ਮਹਤਿਆ; ਅਮਰੂ ਗੋਪੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Mohan, Ramu, the Mehta, Amaru and Gopi had erased their sense of ego.

0.g: ਸਾਹਾਰੂ ਗੰਗੂ ਭਲੇ; ਭਾਗੂ ਭਗਤੁ, ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੀ ।
0.e: To Saharu and Gangu of Bhalla caste and to Bhagu, the devotee, the devotion of the Lord was very dear.

0.g: ਖਾਨੁ ਛੁਰਾ ਤਾਰੂ ਤਰੇ; ਵੇਗਾ ਪਾਸੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Khanu, Chhura, Taru, had swum (the world ocean).

0.g: ਉਗਰੂ ਨੰਦੂ ਸੂਦਨਾ; ਪੂਰੋ ਝਟਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ।
ਮਲੀਆ ਸਾਹਾਰੂ ਭਲੇ; ਛੀਂਬੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਗਹ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Many Courtiers of the Gurus court such as Mallia, Saharu, Bhallas and calico-printers have happened.

0.g: ਪਾਂਧਾ ਬੂਲਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਇਣੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Pandha and Bula are known as the singer and the writer of the hymns of the Guru.

0.g: ਡਲੇ ਵਾਸੀ, ਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ।੧੬।
0.e: Grand was the assemblage of Dalla inhabitants.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਇਕਤੁ ਨੁਕਤੈ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ; ਮਹਰਮੁ ਮੁਜਰਮੁ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਆਰੀ ।
0.e: In Persian language only a point makes ‘mahram’ the confidant, a mujarim, the offender.

0.g: ਮਸਤਾਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਸਲਤੀ; ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs remain exhilarated in the holy congregation and they do not like to go to other assemblies.

0.g: ਗਲ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ; ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਰੀ ।
0.e: In the will of the Lord they serve vigorously and try not to make it public.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਵਡੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Such gurmukhs attain the fruit of happiness and giving up the pride of body, and becoming bodiless they become serious thinkers.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ।
0.e: The word of the Guru is their idol and the holy congregation is the seat of the formless Lord.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਹਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Bowing before the primeval Purusa, in the ambrosial hours they chew the Word (gurbani).

0.g: ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਪਾਰੀ ।
0.e: To have knowledge of the dynamism of that unmanifest Lord is a very deep experience, and to say something of that ineffable Lord is a Herculean task.

0.g: ਸਹਨਿ ਅਵੱਟਣੁ, ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ।੨।
0.e: Only Gurmukhs suffer while doing good to others.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ; ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: Trilochan awoke early daily just to have sight of Namdev,

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਇ ਜਣੇ; ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Together they would concentrate on the Lord and Namdev would tell him the grand stories of God.

0.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: (Trilochan asked Namdev) “kindly pray for me so that if the Lord accepts, I may also have a glimpse of His blessed vision.”

0.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿਓਸੁ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Namdev asked Thakur, the Lord, as to how Trilochan could have sight of the Lord ?

0.g: ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬੋਲਿਆ; ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨੋ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The Lord God smiled and explained to Naamdev;

0.g: ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਭੇਟੁ ਸੋ; ਤੁਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਮੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: “No offerings are needed by me. Out of my delight only, I would make Trilochan to have sight of me.

0.g: ਹਉ ਅਧੀਨੁ ਹਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਦੇ; ਪਹੁੰਚਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਾਂ ਭਗਤੀ ਦਾਵੈ ।
0.e: I am under the total control of the devotees and their loving claims I can never reject; rather I myself also cannot understand them.

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ, ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ।੧੨।
0.e: Their loving devotion, in fact, becomes mediator and makes them meet me.”

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ, ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs have learnt the technique of life in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ, ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: They have consciously enjoyed the delight of the spring season of life.

0.g: ਸਾਵਣ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ, ਨੀਰੁ ਨੀਵਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: They are elated like the water of rainy season (Savan) but still they (gurmukhs) have made water of hopes and desires go down and downward.

0.g: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲੁ ਸੁ ਢੰਗ, ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Meeting with such persons is wonderfully delightful.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ, ਦਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: They way of gurmukhs is devoid of mire and is accepted in the court of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਅਭੰਗੁ, ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣਿਆ ।੯।
0.e: A meeting through the wisdom of the Guru is obstruction free, true and delightful.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਅਥਾਹ ਕਰਿ; ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Variegated forms of agricultural products, medicines,clothings and foods have been created on earth.

0.g: ਮਹੀਅਲ ਖੇਤੀ ਅਉਖਧੀ; ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Variegated forms of agricultural products, medicines,clothings and foods have been created on earth.

0.g: ਤਰੁਵਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਫੁਲ ਫਲ; ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ ਮੂਲ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Shady trees, flowers, fruits, branches, leaves, roots exist there.

0.g: ਪਰਬਤ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ; ਲਾਲੁ ਜਵਾਹਰੁ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In the mountains are eight metals, rubies, jewels, philosopher's stone and mercury.

0.g: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਲਖ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Among the eighty four Lacs of species of life, large families meet only to part i.e. they take birth and die.

0.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ; ਭਵਜਲ ਪੂਰ ਭਰਾਇ ਹਜਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In the cycle of transmigration the herds of creatures in this world -ocean come and go in thousands..

0.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ; ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ।੫।
0.e: Only through the human body one can get across.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਅਠੈ ਸਿਧੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਫਲਾਈ ।
0.e: Accomplishing eight siddhis (powers) the gurmukh has attained the fruit of adept trance (siddh samadhi).

0.g: ਅਸਟ ਕੁਲੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ; ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੇਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: The practices by the eight ancestoral family houses of Sesanag could not understand His mystery.

0.g: ਮਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਠ ਪੈਸੇਰੀਆ; ਪੰਜੂ ਅਠੇ ਚਾਲੀਹ ਭਾਈ ।
0.e: One maund (old Indian weighing unit) consists of eight panseris (about five kilograms), and five multiplied by eight is equal to forty.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਰਖਾ ਅਠ ਖੰਭੀਆ; ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ।
0.e: The spinning wheel having eight spokes keeps its consciousness concentrated in a single thread.

0.g: ਅਠ ਪਹਿਰ ਅਸਟਾਂਗੁ ਜੋਗੁ; ਚਾਵਲ ਰਤੀ ਮਾਸਾ ਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Eight watches, eight limbed yoga, chaval (rice), ratti, rais, masa (all old Indian measuring units of time and weight) have among themselves the relationship of eight i.e. eight rais = one chaval, eight chavals = one ratti and eight rattis = one masa.

0.g: ਅਠ ਕਾਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਵਸ ਕਰਿ; ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Controlling the mind comprising eight inclinations, the gurmukh has made it homogenous as the eight metals after mixing become one metal.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।੮।
0.e: Great is the glory of the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਭ; ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਨ ਫੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In discussions he ( Guru Nanak Dev) worsted the siddhs maths and the incarnations of gods.

0.g: ਬਾਬਰ ਕੇ ਬਾਬੇ ਮਿਲੇ; ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਸਭ ਨਬਾਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Men of Babur came to Baba Nanak and the latter made them bow in humility.

0.g: ਪਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਛਡਿ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak met the emperors as well and becoming detached from the enjoyments and renunciation he performed a wonderful feat.

0.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Self reliant king of the spiritual and the temporal world (Guru Nanak) moved around in the world.

0.g: ਕਾਦਰ ਹੋਇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ; ਏਹ ਭਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The nature enacted a masquerade that he becoming creator created (a new way life- Sikhism).

0.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਦਾ; ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He makes many meet, separates others and further reunites the ones separated long back.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੨੧।
0.e: In the holy congregation, he arranges the glimpse of the invisible Lord.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ; ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a wife describes her union with her husband to her friends who feel pleased hearing the details;

0.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੁਇ; ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: She fantasizes her union and goes into a state of ecstasy thinking about it. She expresses the beauty of the moment in her silence;

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਰੁਦਨ ਸੈ; ਗੁਰਜਨ ਮੁਦਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: On completion of her pregnancy and at the time of giving birth to the child, she cries in labour pain and her whimper pleases the elderly ladies of the house who express their love for her;

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜਾਸੁ; ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਮੋਨਿ ਸਬਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ।੪੧੪।
0.e: Similarly, a devoted Guru-conscious slave of the True Guru, whose heart is kindled with love of the Lord by virtue of his loving meditation and contemplation on Lord's name, speaks in a state of renunciation from the world. Although he observes silence mo

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩੧
ਸੁਹੰਢੈ ਮਾਈਆ ਲੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ।
0.e: In village Suhanda is Bhai maia of lamb caste who sings the holy hymns in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਚੂਹੜ ਚਉਝੜੁ ਲਖਣਊ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Chuhar of Chaujhar caste from Lucknow is gurmukh who remembers Lord day and night.

0.g: ਸਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਪਿਰਾਗ ਵਿਚ; ਭਾਈ ਭਾਨਾ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Bhai Bhana of Prayag is a close Sikh who earns his livelihood.

0.g: ਜਟੂ ਤਪਾ ਸੁ ਜੌਨਪੁਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Jattu and Tappa, the residents of Jaunpur have served in accordance with Gurmat with stable mind.

0.g: ਪਟਣੈ ਸਭਰਵਾਲ ਹੈ; ਨਵਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਸੁਧ ਪਰਾਣੀ ।
0.e: In Patna Bhai naval and among Sabhaervals Nihala is a pious person.

0.g: ਜੈਤਾ ਸੇਠ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ।
0.e: One wealthy person is known by the name of Jaita who likes nothing except the service of the Guru.

0.g: ਰੋਜੇ ਵਰਤ ਨਮਾਜ ਕਰਿ; ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ।
0.e: They observe rozas, vrats (fasts), namaz and prostration (Muslim and Hindu way of worship).

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ।੯।
0.e: They all are not equal to even one trichome of a Gum's Sikh who has effaced his sense of ego.

0.g: ਦਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਰ ਦਾ; ਹੋਇ ਧੂੜਿ, ਧੂੜੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੱਸੈ ।
0.e: The seed of promegranate merges into dust by becoming dust.

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ; ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ਫਲ ਵਿਗੱਸੈ ।
0.e: The same becoming green is adorned by flowers of deep red colour.

0.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਹਸ ਫੁਲ; ਫੁਲ ਫਲ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕ ਸਰੱਸੈ ।
0.e: On tree, thousands of fruits grow, each fruit being more delicious than another.

0.g: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਦਾਣੇ ਲਖ ਹੋਇ; ਫਲ ਫਲ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੱਸੈ ।
0.e: In each fruit reside thousands of seeds produced by one seed.

0.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰੱਸੈ ।
0.e: As there is no dearth of fruit on that tree so the gurmukh is never at loss to realize the delights of the fruits of nectar.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਲੱਯਨਿ ਤੋੜਿ ਫਲਿ; ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰ ਫਲੀਐ ਹੱਸੈ ।
0.e: With the plucking of the fruit the tree again and again, bursting into laughter bears more fruits.

0.g: ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ, ਗੁਰ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੱਸੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Thus the great Guru teaches the way of humility.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾ; ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਣੁ ਨਾਈ ।
0.e: Hearing of glory of Kabir, Sain also turned to be a disciple.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਰੈ; ਭਲਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: In the night he would immerse in loving devotion and in the morning he would serve at the door of the king.

0.g: ਆਏ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ; ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ।
0.e: On one night some sadhus came to him and the whole night was spent in singing the Lord's praises

0.g: ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ।
0.e: Sain could not leave company of the saints and consequently did not perform the king’s service the following morning.

0.g: ਸੈਣ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਆਇਆ ਰਾਣੈ ਨੋ ਰੀਝਾਈ ।
0.e: God himself took the form of Sain. He served the king in such a way that the king was overjoyed.

0.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਨੋ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਿ; ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਰਮਾਈ ।
0.e: Bidding fairwell to the saints, Sain hesitantly arrived at the palace of the king.

0.g: ਰਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਹੁੰ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ; ਗਲਹੁੰ ਕਵਾਇ ਖੋਲਿ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਾਈ ।
0.e: The king From a distance the king called him nearby. He took off his own robes and offered them to Bhagat Sain.

0.g: ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਹਉਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਜੁ; ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ ।
0.e: ‘You have overpowered me’, said the king and his words were heard by one and all.

0.g: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰੈ, ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।੧੬।
0.e: God himself manifests the grandeur of the devotee.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ; ਇਕਸ ਪਿਛੈ ਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ।
0.e: In satyug, the whole country suffered due to the evil deeds of even one individual.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ; ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਲਾ ।
0.e: In tretayug, the evil committed by one, made the whole city suffer and in dvapar the whole family underwent the pains.

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ; ਵਰਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਉ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Simple is the justice of kaliyug; here only he reaps who sows.

0.g: ਫਲੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗੀਂ; ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਫਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲਾ ।
0.e: In other three yugs, the fruit of the action was earned and accumulated but in kaliyug, one gets the fruit of dharma immediately.

0.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ; ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲ ਵਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Somethin* happens only after doing something in the kaliyug but even the thought of dharma gives the happy fruit in it.

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰਿ; ਬੀਜਨਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ।
0.e: The gurmukhs, contemplating on the wisdom of Guru and the loving devotion, sow the seed in earth, the true abode of truth.

0.g: ਸਫਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ, ਪੂਰਣ ਘਾਲਾ ।੭।
0.e: They succeed in their practice and objective.

0.g: ਤੋ ਸੋ ਨ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਨ ਮੋ ਸਰਿ; ਤੋ ਸੋ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ਨ ਮੋ ਸੋ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ।
0.e: O  True Guru! there is no Master like You. But there is no one as dependent as I am. There is no one as great a donor as You and there is no beggar as needy as me.

0.g: ਮੋ ਸੋ ਨ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੋ ਸਰਿ; ਮੋ ਸੋ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਤੋ ਸੋ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ।
0.e: No one is as miserable as I am but none is as clement as You. No one is as ignorant as I am but there is no one as knowledgeable as You.

0.g: ਮੋ ਸੋ ਨ ਪਤਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਤੋ ਸਰਿ; ਮੋ ਸੋ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਨ ਤੋ ਸੋ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ।
0.e: There is no one who has fallen so low in his deeds and actions as I am. But there is no one else who can purify anyone as much as you. There is no one as sinful as I am and none who can do good as much as you can.

0.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਤੂ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਗਰ; ਜਾਤ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਓਟ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ।੫੨੮।
0.e: I am full of faults and demerits but You are an ocean of virtues. You are my refuge on my way to hell.  (528)

0.g: ਕਵਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤ; ਕਵਨ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: By the use of which collyrium in the eyes can one see the beloved Lord? What ear-rings can help hear his sound?

0.g: ਕਵਨ ਤੰਮੋਲ ਕਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਰਸੈ; ਕੌਨ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਕਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: Which betel leaf when chewed can help the tongue repeat the supreme praise of the beloved Lord? What bangles should be worn in the hands to greet and salute Him?

0.g: ਕਵਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਹਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਅਤ; ਕੌਨ ਅੰਗੀਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਦੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: What flower garland can make Him reside in the heart? What bodice should be worn to embrace Him with hands?

0.g: ਕਉਨ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਪੇਟ ਲੀਜੈ; ਕਵਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ।੬੨੬।
0.e: What dress and diamond can be worn to entice Him? With what method can the union of the beloved be relished? The crux of the whole thing is that all embellishments are worthless. Relishing His love can only unite one with Him.  (626)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਚਪਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ; ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Just as one cannot see full image of Sun or Moon in unstable and wavy water.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮਲੀਨ ਦਰਪਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਦਨ ਸਰੂਪ ਉਰਬਸ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Just as one cannot see the complete beauty of the face of Urvashi the divine fairy in a dirty mirror.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨ ਦੀਪ ਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਕੋ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤੁ; ਭਵਨ ਭਇਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਤਸ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Just as without the light of a lamp, one cannot even see a thing lying close by. A house in darkness looks scary and frightening beside fear of intrusion of thieves.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਰਮ ਅਧਮ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਮਨੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੋ ।੪੯੬।
0.e: So is the mind entangled in the darkness of mammon (maya). An ignorant mind cannot enjoy the unique bliss of the contemplation of True Guru and meditation on Lord's name.  (496)

0.g: ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਗੁਨ ਹੀਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀਨ; ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਭਾਗ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਬਾਵਰੀ ।
0.e: I the sentient seeker am without attractive looks, do not belong to high caste as deemed of Sikhs of the Guru, without the virtues of Naam, empty of Guru's knowledge, without any praiseworthy traits, unlucky because of vices, bereft of the service of Guru

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਹੀਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨ; ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਹੀਨ ਸੂਧੇ ਹਸਤ ਨ ਪਾਵ ਰੀ ।
0.e: I am bereft of the kind looks and glimpse of the True Guru, without meditation, weak of power and wisdom, of warped hands and feet because of not doing service of the Guru.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਹੀਨ ਰੀਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਭਾਇ ਭੈ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਹੀਨ; ਚਿਤ ਹੀਨ ਬਿਤ ਹੀਨ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਰੀ ।
0.e: I am vacuous of my beloved's love, unaware of Guru's teachings, hollow of devotion, unstable of mind, poor of the wealth of meditation and even lacking in calmness of nature.

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨਾਧੀਨ ਪਰਾਚੀਨ ਲਗਿ; ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੁਇ ਰਾਵਰੀ ।੨੨੦।
0.e: I am inferior from every aspect of life. I don't become humble in order to please my beloved. With all these shortcomings, O my True Guru! How can I acquire the refuge of your holy feet. (220)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਲਖ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਲਖ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ; ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਲਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ।
0.e: Millions are slanderers, millions are apostates and millions of wicked persons are untrue to their salt.

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਧੋਹੀ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਿ; ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀ ।
0.e: Unfaithful, ungrateful, thieves, vagabonds and millions of other infamous persons are there.

0.g: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਗਾਈਂ ਵੰਸ ਘਾਤ; ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਅਸਾਮੀ ।
0.e: Thousands are there who are slayers of Brahmin, cow, and their own family.

0.g: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪ ਲਖ; ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਦਨਾਮੀ ।
0.e: Millions of liars, prevaricators of the Guru, guilty and ill-reputed ones are there.

0.g: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਲਖ; ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰ ਖੁਆਰ ਖੁਨਾਮੀ ।
0.e: Many a criminal, fallen, full of demerits and phoney people are there.

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਿਬਾਸੀ ਦਗਾਬਾਜ; ਲਖ ਸੈਤਾਨ ਸਲਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਮੀ ।
0.e: Millions are there of variegated guises, cheats and friendly to Satan, exchanging greetings with them.

0.g: ਤੂੰ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਾ; ਹਉ ਕਪਟੀ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਿਜਾਮੀ ।
0.e: O God, you all know how I am denying (after having your gifts). I am a cheat and O Lord, you are omniscient.

0.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ, ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ।੨੧।੧੭। ਸਤਾਰਾਂ ।
0.e: O Master, you are uplifter of the fallen ones and your always keep your reputation.

0.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਅਨਰਸ ਬਸਿ, ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ; ਜਉ ਲਉ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ, ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ।
0.e: So long a human being remains absorbed in worldly attractions and pleasures, he cannot know love. So long his attention is focused on something else, he cannot realize self.

0.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ, ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ; ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ, ਨ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਿਸੇਖੀਐ ।
0.e: (Renouncing Lord) as long as one is busy acquiring knowledge of mundane worldly things, he remains bereft of spiritual wisdom. As long as one remains involved in worldly pleasures one cannot hear the unstruck celestial music of divine word.

0.g: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ, ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਤਿ; ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਲਖਾਵੈ, ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅਲਖ ਨ ਲੇਖੀਐ ।
0.e: As long as one remains proud and arrogant, one cannot realise self. Till such time True Guru does not initiate a person with the boon of Lord's name and propitiate the Lord, one cannot realise the 'formless God'.

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ, ਏਕ ਏਕ ਭੇਖੀਐ ।੧੨।
0.e: The knowledge of Almighty lies in the consecrating words of the True Guru that leads one to reality of His name and form. By uniting his mind with His name, the Lord who prevails in various forms gets revealed. (12)

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੋਧੁ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਬੋਧੁ ਅਬੋਧੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: In kalijug one finds intellectualism incarnate, but discriminating between knowledge and ignorance is nowhere.

0.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਰਜਈ; ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ, ਜੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Nobody interdicts anybody and everyone is behaving according in his whims.

0.g: ਕਿਸੇ ਪੁਜਾਈ ਸਿਲਾ ਸੁੰਨਿ; ਕੋਈ ਗੋਰੀ ਮੜ੍ਹੀ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Someone instructs for the worship of the inert rocks and someone guides people to worship cemetries.

0.g: ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ; ਕਲਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਹੁ ਵਾਦਿ ਵਧਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Due to the tantra mantra and such hyprocricies, the tensions anger and quarrels have been increased.

0.g: ਆਪੋ ਧਾਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਨਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਚਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: In the rat-race for selfish ends, different religions have been promulgated.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਪੂਜੇ ਚੰਦੁ, ਸੂਰੁ; ਕੋਈ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Someone is woshipping moons, someone sun and someone worshipping earth and sky.

0.g: ਪਉਣੁ, ਪਾਣੀ, ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ; ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜ ਕੋਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Someone is propitiating air, water, fire and yama the god of death.

0.g: ਫੋਕਟਿ ਧਰਮੀ, ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: These all are religious hypocrities and are tossing in delusions.

0.g: ਚੂੰ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੋ ਹਫ਼ਤਾ ਰੂ ਨਮਾਈ ਚਿ ਸ਼ਵਦ ।
0.e: Both the moon and the sun keep circling around His (God/Guru) abode night and day,

0.g: ਇਮਸ਼ਬ ਮਹਿ ਮਨ ਅਗਰ ਬਿਆਈ ਚਿ ਸ਼ਵਦ ।੨੫।੧।
0.e: It is His blessing that He has bestowed them the capability of providing light to both the worlds. (41) (3)

0.g: ਈਣ ਜੁਮਲਾਇ ਜਹਾਣ ਆਸੀਰਿ ਜ਼ੁਲਫ਼ਤ ਗਸ਼ਤਾ ।
0.e: Wherever I see, I find His comeliness and splendor all over.

0.g: ਯੱਕ ਲਹਿਜ਼ਾ ਅਗਰ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਈ ਚਿ ਸ਼ਵਦ ।੨੫।੨।
0.e: The whole world is anxious and daft because of His curly lock of hair. (41) (4)

0.e: Second Guru, Guru Angad Dev Ji. The second Guru, Guru Angad Dev Ji, became the first supplicating disciple of Guru Nanak Sahib. Then he transformed himself into a mentor worth supplicating to. The light emitted from the flame of his strong faith in truth and belief, due to his disposition and personality, was far greater than that of the day. Both he and his mentor, Guru Nanak, had, in fact, one soul but outwardly were two torches to glisten the minds and the hearts of the people. Intrinsically, they were one but overtly were two sparks that could singe everything but the truth. The second Guru was the wealth and treasure and the leader of the special persons of the court of the Akaalpurakh. He became the anchor for the people who were acceptable in the divine court. He was a selected member of the heavenly court of the majestic and awe-inspiring Waaheguru and had received high praises from Him. The first letter of his name, 'Aliph', is the one that encompasses the virtues and blessings of high and low, rich and poor, and the king and the mendicant. The aroma of the truth-filled letter 'Noon' in his name bestows and cares for the high rulers and the low like menials. The next letter in his name 'Gaaf' represents the traveler of the path to the eternal congregation and for the world to stay in the highest spirits.
