0.g: ਤਨਕ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਜਗਦੀਸਹਿ ਦਏ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ; ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਚਤਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਥਾਹ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Sudama offered a handful of rice to Krishna Ji, with utmost love and in return, he attained the four aims of life as well as many other treasure-houses of His blessings.

0.g: ਦੁਖਤ ਗਜਿੰਦ ਅਰਬਿੰਦ ਗਹਿ ਭੇਟ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਜੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਪਾਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਹ ਜੀ ।
0.e: A distressed elephant caught by an octopus, plucked a lotus flower in desperation and offered it to the Lord in humble supplication. He (elephant) was freed from the clutches of the octopus.

0.g: ਕਹਾਂ ਕੋਊ ਕਰੈ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਸਬੈ ਸੁਖ ਤਾਹਿ ਜੀ ।੪੩੫।
0.e: What can one do with his own efforts ? Nothing tangible can be achieved by one's own efforts. All this is His blessing. One whose hard work and devotion is accepted by the Lord, gets all peace and comforts from Him.  (435)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਦੀਵਾਲੀ ਦੀ ਰਾਤਿ, ਦੀਵੇ ਬਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
0.e: Lamps are lighted in the night of divali festival;

0.g: ਤਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ, ਅੰਬਰਿ ਭਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
0.e: Stars of different variety appear in the sky;

0.g: ਫੁਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ, ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
0.e: In the gardens the flowers are there which are selectively plucked;

0.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਾਤਿ, ਨੈਣ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
0.e: The pilgrims going to pilgrimage centres are also seen.

0.g: ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਝਾਤਿ, ਵਸਾਇ ਉਚਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।
0.e: The imaginary habitats have been seen coming into being and vanishing.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਾਤਿ, ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੀਅਨਿ ।੬।
0.e: All these are momentary, but the gurmukhs with the help of the Word nourish the gift of the pleasure fruit.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਦਾ; ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: As water flows downwards and takes with it whosoever meets it (and makes it also humble),

0.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਰੰਗਾਂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ; ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: All the dyes mix up in water and it becomes one with every colour;

0.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਂਵਦਾ; ਉਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Erasing ego it does altruistic deeds;

0.g: ਕਾਠੁ ਨ ਡੋਬੈ ਪਾਲਿ ਕੈ; ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਹੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: It does not sink the wood, it rather makes the iron swim with it;

0.g: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੀਹ ਸੁਕਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਰਸ ਕਸ ਉਪਜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: It makes for prosperity when it rains in rainy season.

0.g: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਇ; ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ।੨੦।
0.e: Likewise, the holy saints getting dead in life i.e. removing their ego, making their coming to the world fruitful.

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੰਮਿ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Seeing the well adored God-like True Guru with one's eyes, the devoted Sikh of the True Guru acquires the divine knowledge. By the focusing of mind in the vision of Lord Guru, one is freed from watching the worldly merriments.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਪਰੈ; ਜਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਅਲਖ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਨਾਸ ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When the sound of Naam Simran enters the ears, the ability of concentration of a Guru's disciple turns away from other sounds and modes. The fragrance of the Guru's words that is so supernatural, the nostrils become free of all other smells.

0.g: ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਸ; ਕਰ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਪਰਸਨ ਕਰਾਜੀਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The tongue of practitioner of meditation becomes engrossed in the pleasure of Naam Simran and it becomes bereft of all other worldly tastes. The hands when able to touch and feel the untouchable Lord are freed from the impressions of touching worldly thin

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਗਵਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਗਵਨ ਚਰਨ ਗੰਮਿ; ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ।੨੭੯।
0.e: The feet of a Guru-oriented person tread towards the path of the True Guru. They give up travelling or going in other directions. For him his lone desire of meeting the beloved Lord is unique and marvellous. (279)

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਪ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ; ਆਪਨ ਰਚਿਓ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Omniscient and Omnipotent God Himself has created His own form and has named Himself as (Guru) Nanak.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਹਾਇਉ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਕਾਰ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: The second name that He called Himself is Gobind. The transcendental Lord took the immanent form to appear as the first Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਦ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਲਾਧਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Lord Himself is the precept of Vedas and He Himself knows all the secrets that lie therein. Lord Himself has created this wonderful act and is manifesting in many forms and bodies

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਏਕਮੇਕ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਬਰ ਉਚਾਰ ਕੈ ।੫੪।
0.e: Like waft and woof of a cloth, both Guru and Gobind (God) are not different to each other. (54)

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਤੀਰਥ ਮੰਝਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਬਗੁਲਾ ਅਪਤੀਣਾ ।
0.e: Crane though living at a pilgrimage centre remains without faith.

0.g: ਲਵੈ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਵਰਸਦੈ; ਜਲ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਪੀਣਾ ।
0.e: The rain-bird goes on crying during rain but dries not know how to drink water.

0.g: ਵਾਂਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਪਰਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ।
0.e: Bamboo may be engrossed in sandalwood but cannot take its fragrance.

0.g: ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਕਰਮਾ ਦਾ ਹੀਣਾ ।
0.e: So unfortunate is owl that it never beholds sun.

0.g: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਦੇ; ਵਤੈ ਓਡੀਣਾ ।
0.e: Though musk remains in the el of deer, yet it goes on running around in search of it.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲੈ ਮੀਣਾ ।੧।
0.e: The true Guru is true emperor and the faces of the dissemblers are blackened.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰ ਨਿਰਬੈਰ ਭਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those who abide by Guru's teachings with faith and sincerity are without rancour. They carry no enmity for anyone because they have realised His presence in everybody.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਦ ਨਿਰਭੇਦ ਭਏ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧ ਖੇਦ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those who practice the teachings of the Guru are free from discriminatory temperament. All are alike for them. The sense of dualism and attitude of condemnation of others disappear from their mind.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਇਸ ਪਰਮਹੰਸ; ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਗੰਧ ਠਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those crow-like dross-filled persons who adopt Guru's wisdom as truth are able to shed all the dross and become clean and pious. A miniscule of spiritual knowledge help them spread the fragrance of the Lord like Sandalwood.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਏ; ਆਸਾ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਉਰ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ।੨੬।
0.e: Those who abide by the teachings of the Guru destroy all their doubts of rites and rituals. They become unattached with worldly desires and imbibe the intellect of the Guru in their hearts. (26)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨
ਲਖ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਨ ਅਪੜਿ ਸਕੈ ।
0.e: Millions of meditational postures and concentrations cannot equal the form of the gurmukh.

0.g: ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਕਰ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਡਾਰੀ ਥਕੈ ।
0.e: Millions got tired with learning and elaborations and with flights of consciousness to reach the divine Word.

0.g: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਲਖ; ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਦਰਿ ਧਕੈ ।
0.e: Millions of people using their intellect and powers talk of discerning wisdom but they fall and stagger, and, at the door of the Lord they get jolts and blows.

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਲਖ; ਸਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਹਕੈ ।
0.e: Millions of yogis, pleasure seekers and recluses cannot bear the passions and fragrance of the three qualities of nature (sattv, rajas and tamas).

0.g: ਲਖ ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੋਇ; ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਕੈ ।
0.e: Millions of wonderstruck people have got tired of the unmanifest nature of the unmanifest Lord.

0.g: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਲਖ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਮਿ ਸਹਕੈ ।
0.e: Millions are awe-struck, with the ineffable story of that wondrous Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦੈ, ਅਖਿ ਫਰਕੈ ।੨੨।੨੮। ਅਠਾਈ ।
0.e: They all are equal to the delight of one moment of the life of a Sikh of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਪਾਣੀ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉਂ; ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ।
0.e: As is the case with water and stone, things are good or bad according to their nature.

0.g: ਵੈਰ ਨ ਟਿਕਦਾ ਭਲੇ ਚਿਤਿ; ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬੁਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ।
0.e: A noble heart carries no enmity, and love does not abide in an evil heart.

0.g: ਭਲਾ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਦਾ; ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਵੈਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਾਏ ।
0.e: The noble one never forgets good done to him whereas the evil doer does not forget enmity.

0.g: ਆਸ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦੁਹਾਂ ਦੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਖਾਏ ।
0.e: Both fmd in the end their desires unfulfilled because the evil still wants to commit evil and the noble wants to go on spreading benevolence.

0.g: ਭਲਿਅਹੁਂ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਬੁਰਿਅਹੁਂ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਏ ।
0.e: The noble cannot commit evil but the noble should not expect nobility in an evil person.

0.g: ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ; ਸਈ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਏ ।
0.e: This is the essence of the wisdom of hundreds of people and accordingly I have explained the thoughts in vogue around.

0.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ, ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਮਾਏ ।੧੬।
0.e: Benevolence may (at times) be repaid in the form of evil.

0.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ; ਸਹਜ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੋਦ ਕਉਤਕ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: The eyes of a Sikh of the Guru are seeing the adornment of the every limb, colour and form of the True Guru. The bliss of the spiritual knowledge and its wondrous effect is evident.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਜਸ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲ ਗੁਨ; ਸੁਨ ਸੁਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: The ears of a Gursikh have become relishers of the virtues of the True Guru having heard them perpetually, and they are reaching the messages of His wondrous deeds to his consciousness.

0.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕੈ; ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: The tongue of a Gursikh is uttering the words blessed by the True Guru. Its music is sounding in the tenth door and the pleasure so generated is reaching his consciousness in the form of prayer and the fragrance of Naam Simran is also being conveyed by th

0.g: ਸਰਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਾਨੋ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ; ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ।੬੨੦।
0.e: Just as many rivers fall in the sea and yet its thirst is never satiated. So is the love of his dear beloved in the heart of Gursikh where multi-waves of Naam are propagating yet its loving thirst is never satiated.  (620)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਵਾਉ ਵਿਚਿ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠੰਦੇ ।
0.e: In the one word of the Lord lacs of rivers (of life) flow and lacs of waves come up in them.

0.g: ਇਕਸ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਵਿਚਿ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: In His one wave again, lacs of rivers (of life) flow.

0.g: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ; ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: In each river, in the form of incarnations, lacs of jivs assuming many forms are roaming about.

0.g: ਮਛ ਕਛ ਮਰਿਜੀਵੜੇ; ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਲਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Incarnations in the form of fish and tortoise dive into it but they cannot fathom its depth, i.e. they cannot know the limits of that supreme reality.

0.g: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਨ ਲਹਨਿ ਤਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: That sustainer Lord is beyond all limits; none can know the bounds of his waves.

0.g: ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: That true Guru is the excellent purus and the disciples of the Guru bear the unbearable, through the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat).

0.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ, ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ।੧੫।
0.e: Rare are the people who undertake such devotional worship.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੂਨੋ ਖਾਂਡ ਸ੍ਵੇਤ ਏਕਸੇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ; ਪਾਈਐ ਤੌ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਚਾਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as both sugar and flour being white look alike, but can only be identified when tasted (one is sweet, the other insipid).

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੀਤ ਬਰਨ ਹੀ ਹੇਮ ਅਰ ਪੀਤਰ ਹ੍ਵੈ; ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਹਤ ਪਾਰਖਦ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਰਾਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as brass and gold bear the same colour, but when both are placed before an examiner, the value .of gold is known.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੋਨੋ ਖਗ ਸ︀ਯਾਮ ਤਨ; ਬੂਝੀਐ ਅਸੁਭ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਸੁ ਭਾਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as both a crow and a cuckoo is black in colour, but they can be distinguished by their voice. (One is sweet to the ears while the other is noisy and irritating).

0.e: In the holy congregation the state of equipoise is actually identified and known.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਿਮਰ ਸਿਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੋਇ; ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a wife recalls her experience of pleasure with her husband and feels happy, becomes quiet and chuckles in her mind exhuming prettiness;

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਰੋਦਤ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਜਨ ਮੁਦਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as on completion of her pregnancy, she goes into labour and cries due to pain but the elders of the house feel happy seeing the child and they shower love on him time and again;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਵਤੀ ਮਾਨ ਤ︀ਯਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਅਮਾਨ ਹੋਇ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਇ ਚੁਪ ਹੁਲਸਤ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as an honoured pretty woman sheds her pride and arrogance and becomes humble, and on receipt of her husband's love when united with him becomes quiet and smiles within.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਜਾਸ; ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ।੬੦੫।
0.e: Similarly, an obedient disciple of True Guru who experiences light divine as a result of his loving, perpetual meditation on Naam blessed by the Guru, he earns much respect and praise whether he speaks in a detached mood or goes silent in ecstasy.  (605)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ, ਸਭ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ।
0.e: The concentration except on Guru is all duality.

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ, ਫਿਕਾ ਆਲਾਉ ।
0.e: The knowledge except theknowledge of the Guru-word is a cry in vain.

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾਂ ਪੂਜਣਾ, ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਸੁਆਉ ।
0.e: Worship except the Guru feet is all false and selfishness.

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੁ ਮੰਨਣਾ, ਊਰਾ ਪਰਥਾਉ ।
0.e: Except the acceptance of the teaching of the Guru, all other means are incomplete.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੈ, ਸਭੁ ਕਚਾ ਚਾਉ ।
0.e: Except the meeting in the holy congregation, all other assemblages are fragile.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਦਾਉ ।੧੭।
0.e: The Sikhs loving their Guru, know well to win the game (of life).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਉਪਰਿ ਹੰਸ ਸੁਵੰਸ ਵਸੰਦੇ ।
0.e: It is said that on Manasarovar (lake) resides swans of the highest breed.

0.g: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ; ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਹੰਸ ਅਮੋਲ ਚੁਗੰਦੇ ।
0.e: In the Manasarovar are pearls and rubies and there invaluable jewels are picked up by swans to eat.

0.g: ਖੀਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਰਵਾਰਦੇ; ਲਹਰੀਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਤਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: These swans separate water from milk and go on floating on the waves.

0.g: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ; ਹੋਰਤੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Leaving Manasarovar, they go nowhere to sit or reside.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੋੁਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the congregation of holy persons wherein gurmukhs in the form of superior swans adorn the place.

0.g: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ; ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: With single-minded devotion they concentrate upon the Lord and do not go astray to any other thought.

0.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖੰਦੇ ।੮।
0.e: Merging their consciousness into the Word they behold that imperceptible Lord.

0.g: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ; ਲੋਨੇ ਹੈ ਨ ਲੋਇਨ ਜੋ ਲਾਲਨ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਐ ।
0.e: My looks are not attractive. Then how can I remember and conceive the beautiful? Lord the fulfiller of desires Lord? My eyes are not good looking; then how can I see the glimpse of that beloved Lord?

0.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨਉ ਕੈਸੇ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਬਚਨ ਮਧੋਕੀਐ ।
0.e: My tongue is not ambrosial. Then how can I make an effective request to my beloved? I do not have such power of hearing that I can enjoy the honey-like words of my beloved Lord?

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਰ ਮਾਲ ਕਰਉ; ਮਸਤਕ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪਗ ਧੋਕੀਐ ।
0.e: I am weak and imperfect in every part of my body. Then how can I make a superior rosary of remembrance of my Lord's name? I have no I can bank upon to wash the feet of my beloved.

0.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਹੁਚ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਸੇਵ; ਨਾਹਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਸਮੋਕੀਐ ।੬੪੦।
0.e: I do not have the temperament of service in my heart; so I cannot reach for the service of my beloved. Nor do I have that devotion through which I can become one with the greatness of the dear Lord. (The greatness of the Lord may reside in me.)  (640)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਦਿ ਰਹਤ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਬਿਖੈ; ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਮਰਮੁ ਕਿਧਉ ਕਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as wine remains in a bottle day and night but that bottle/ pot does not know its characteristics.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇਲੀ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਬਾਂਟਿ ਦੀਜੀਅਤ ਸਭਾ; ਪਾਵਤ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as in a party, wine is distributed in cups, but that cup does not know its (wine) secret nor thinks about it.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਿਨਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਬੇਚਤ ਕਲਾਲ ਬੈਠੇ; ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ਦਰਬ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a wine merchant sells wine all the time during the day but his greed of wealth does not know the significance of its intoxication.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕੇ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੈ; ਬਿਰਲੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਦੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।੫੩੦।
0.e: Similarly many write Gur Shabad and Gurbani, sing and read it but. a rare person among them harbours loving desire of relishing and acquiring the divine elixir from it.  (530)

0.g: ਘਣਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ; ਨੀਵੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਾਸਹੁ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: A lovely drop of cloud falls from the sky and mitigating its ego goes into the mouth of a shell in sea.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵੇਖਿ; ਸਿਪੈ ਦੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The shell, at once, closing its mouth dives down and hides itself in the underworld.

0.g: ਲੈਦੋ ਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਿਪੁ; ਚੁੰਭੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤਾਲਿ ਲੁਕਾਵੈ ।
ਫੜਿ ਕਢੈ ਮਰੁਜੀਵੜਾ; ਪਰ ਕਾਰਜ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਫੜਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The diver catches hold of it and it also allows itself to be caught for the sale of altruistic sense.

0.g: ਪਰਵਸਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨੋ; ਪਰ ਹਥਿ ਪਥਰ ਦੰਦ ਭਨਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Controlled by the sense of benevolence it gets itself broken on stone.

0.g: ਭੁਲਿ ਅਭੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਦੇ; ਮੋਤੀ ਦਾਨ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Knowing well or unknowingly it bestows a free gift and never repents.

0.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ, ਕੋਈ ਵਰੁਸਾਵੈ ।੧੫।
0.e: Any rare one gets such a blest life.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਫਲ; ਅਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a tree is born out of fruit and fruit grows on the tree this act is wonderous and cannot be explained.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਵਨ ਮੈ ਬਾਵਨ ਹੈ ਬਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ; ਬਿਸਮ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as fragrance is in sandalwood and sandalwood is in fragrance, no one can know secret of this astonishing display.

0.g: ਕਾਸ ਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਕਾਸ ਜੈਸੇ; ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਯ ਮਯ ਕੌਤਕ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as fire exists in wood and wood is fire. This play is no less amazing.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੈ; ਨਿਗੁਨ ਸਗੁਨ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਧ︀ਯਾਨ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਜੀ ।੬੦੮।
0.e: Similarly, the True Guru has word (Naam) and True Guru resides in it. The True Guru alone explains us the focusing of mind on the absolute and transcendental form of divine knowledge.  (608)

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ; ਕੋ ਪਾਧਾ, ਕੋ ਵੈਦੁ ਸਦਾਏ ।
0.e: Someone is called pandit, someone astrologer, someone priest and some physician.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਉ ਕੋ; ਕੋ ਮਹਤਾ, ਚਉਧਰੀ ਅਖਾਏ ।
0.e: Someone is called the king, satrap, headman and chaudhary.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਬਜਾਜੁ, ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕੋ; ਕੋ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਜੜਾਉ ਜੜਾਏ ।
0.e: Someone is draper, someone is called goldsmith and someone a jeweller.

0.g: ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ਪਰਚੂਨੀਆ; ਕੋਈ ਦਲਾਲੀ ਕਿਰਸਿ ਕਮਾਏ ।
0.e: Someone is earning through being druggist, retailer and an agent.

0.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤ ਸਹੰਸ ਲਖ; ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਗਣਾਏ ।
0.e: (So called) Low born are millions whose names explain their professions.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ ।
0.e: The Sikh of the Guru, being in the holy congregation, while living in joys remains indifferent to desires.

0.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ, ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ।੫।
0.e: He by merging his consciousness in the Word (sabad) beholds the Supreme Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਭਾਉ, ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ; ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਅਗੈ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹਾ ।
0.e: They are not scared of anybody who have cherished the love of the Lord and those who are devoid of the fear of Lord remain scared in the court of Lord.

0.g: ਅਗਿ ਤਤੀ ਜਲ ਸੀਅਲਾ; ਨਿਵ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਤਾਹਾ ।
0.e: Since it keeps its head high, the fire is hot and because the water flows downwards, it is cold.

0.g: ਭਰਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਖਾਲੀ ਤਰੈ; ਵਜਿ ਨ ਵਜੈ ਘੜੈ ਜਿਵਾਹਾ ।
0.e: The filled up pitcher drowns and makes no sound and the empty one not only goes on swimming, it rather makes the noise also (likewise is the egotist and the egoless one, the latter absorbing in loving devotion gets liberated and the former goes on tossing

0.g: ਅੰਬ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਿ ਝੁਕਿ ਲਹੈ; ਦੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਰੰਡੁ ਨ ਨਿਵੈ ਤਲਾਹਾ ।
0.e: Being full of fruits, the mango tree bends down in humility but the castor tree being full of bitter fruits never bows in humility.

0.g: ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਧਾਵਦਾ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਫਲ ਖਾਹਾ ।
0.e: The mind-bird keeps flying and according to its nature picks up the fruits.

0.g: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ; ਹਉਲਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਹਾ ।
0.e: On the scale of justice, the light and the heavy are weighed (and good and bad are differentiated).

0.g: ਜਿਣਿ ਹਾਰੈ, ਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਣੈ; ਪੈਰਾ ਉਤੇ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਾਹਾ ।
0.e: He who looks to be winning here loses in the court of the Lord and likewise the loser here wins there.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ, ਜਗ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਾ ।੯।
0.e: All bow at his feet. The individual first falls at the feet (of Guru) and then he makes all to fall at his feet.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ, ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਚੇਲਾ ।
0.e: One should accept the word of the Guru as the Guru, and by becoming gurmukh one makes his consciousness the disciple of the Word.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਲਾ ।
0.e: When one becomes attached to the abode of truth in the form of holy congregation, he through loving devotion meets the Lord.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਕੂੰਜ ਕਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸ ਨਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: In the art of knowledge, meditation and rememberance, the Siberian crane, tortoise and swan respectively are adept ones (in gurmukh all these three qualities are found).

0.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁਂ ਫਲ, ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: As from tree the fruit and from fruit (seed) again the tree is grown i.e. (tree and fruit are the same), so is the simple philosophy that the Guru and the Sikh are the same.

0.g: ਵੀਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ; ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਖੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Word of the Guru is present in the world but beyond this is the ekankar (ikis) occupied in His invisible game (of creation and destruction).

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸ ਵਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Bowing before that primeval Lord that power of the Word in His hukam merges into Him.

0.g: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ।੨੦।੭।
0.e: Ambrosial hours are the correct time for His praise.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਾ; ਲਖ ਅਗਰ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Myriads of sandals and fragrant sticks may be mixed;

0.g: ਲਖ ਕਪੂਰ ਕਥੂਰੀਆ; ਅੰਬਰ ਮਹਿਕੰਦੇ ।
0.e: With myriads camphor’s and musk’s the sky may be made full of fragrance;

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਗਉੜੇ ਮੇਦ ਮਿਲਿ; ਕੇਸਰ ਚਮਕੰਦੇ ।
0.e: If myriads of saffron are mixed with yellow pigment of cow;

0.g: ਸਭ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਲਾਇ ਕੈ; ਅਰਗਜਾ ਕਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: And of all these fragrances an incense stick is prepared;

0.g: ਲਖ ਅਰਗਜੇ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਫੁਲ; ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀ ਸੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Then myriads of such sticks may be mixed with the fragrance of flowers and scents,

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਵਾਸੂ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ ।੭।
0.e: Even then all these cannot withstand the fragrance of the elixir of love of the gurmukh.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਮਲਿਆਗਰ ਪਵਨ ਕਤ ਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a sandalwood tree cannot impart its fragrance to others without breeze and without the air of malay mountain, how can the atmosphere become fragranced,

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਦ ਅਵਖਦ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਿ ਹੋਤ; ਅਵਖਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਦ ਰੋਗਹਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a physician know the merit of every herb or medicine and without medicine, no physician can cure an ailing person,

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ, ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ।੧੭।
0.e: The true Guru alone chisels one and all.

0.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਸਮਸਰ ਨਾਂਹਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਰ ।
0.e: Many other beautiful forms may be there but none can reach near the effulgent form of the beloved True Guru nor millions of elixir-like items can reach the sweet words of the True Guru.

0.g: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਪਰ; ਵਾਰ ਡਾਰਉ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਮੁਕਤ ਮੰਦਹਾਸੁ ਪਰ ।
0.e: I sacrifice all four desires of life over a look of grace of my True Guru. I can sacrifice myriad salvations over a sweet smile of my True Guru. (Dharam, arth, Kaam and mokh are paltry over the smile and look of grace of the True Guru).

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਅਨੰਤ ਕੋਟ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕੈ; ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨ ਤੁਲ ਧਰ ।
0.e: Comforts of millions of heavens cannot match even a momentary meeting with True Guru and comforts on total meeting with Him are beyond the capacity of oceans.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਸਰ ਕਛੂ ਪੂਜੈ ਨਾਹਿ; ਤਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਸਰਬਸ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਕਰ ।੬੪੬।
0.e: No one can reach the glory and loving elixir of the True Guru. I sacrifice my body, mind and wealth unto Him.  (646)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਜੇ ਖੁਥੀ ਬਿੰਡਾ ਬਹੈ; ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਜਾਜੁ ।
0.e: A cricket sitting on the heap of cloth does not become a draper.

0.g: ਕੁਤੇ ਦੇ ਗਲ ਵਾਸਣੀ; ਨ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਸਾਜੁ ।
0.e: If a money belt is tied around the neck of a dog, it does not become a gold merchant.

0.g: ਰਤਨਮਣੀ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਂਦਰੈ; ਜਉਹਰੀ ਨਹਿ ਕਾਜੁ ।
0.e: Tying of rubies and jewels around the neck of monkey does not make it behave like a jeweller.

0.g: ਗਦਹੁੰ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਦੀਐ; ਨਹਿੰ ਗਾਂਧੀ ਗਾਜੁ ।
0.e: Laden with sandalwood, the donkey cannot be called a perfumer.

0.g: ਜੇ ਮਖੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਕੜੀ; ਕਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਾਜੁ ।
0.e: If per chance a fly goes into the mouth of a spider, the latter does not become a hawk.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾਵਾਂ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ; ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਾ ਪਾਜੁ ।੧੭।
0.e: The truth is always true and the falsehood always fake

0.g: ਮਾਨਨ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਾਨ ਬਦੋ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਿਆਨ; ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹ︀ਯੋ ਮਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਔਸੁਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਕੋ ।
0.e: O my egoistic friend! Don't be proud, I do not consider much wisdom in this pride. Listen to me and regard this human birth as the most auspicious and invaluable time of meeting with the Lord. Make this opportunity a success by taking the initiation of Na

0.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਕੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਪ︀ਯਾਰੀ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਆਈ ਬਾਰੀ; ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਸੰਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਹਠ ਨੀਚ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Dear Lord has numerous beloved wives whose hearts are pierced with His ambrosial Naam. After wandering in many species, you have now got the turn to meet with the Lord through this human birth. Why don't you give up your arrogant obduracy and unite with y

0.g: ਰਜਨੀ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਗਾਤ; ਖੇਲਹੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਖ ਬੀਚ ਕੋ ।
0.e: This night-like human life is passing away. The youth, body and all its adornments will be left behind. Then why don't you enjoy and relish the loving elixir of your dear husband? And why are you wasting your night-like life in the false pleasures of maya

0.g: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਥ ਬਹੁਰਿਯੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਥ; ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਡੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਚ ਕੋ ।੬੬੦।
0.e: And if you fail to achieve union with your master Lord in this human birth, you will not get another opportunity. You will have to spend the remainder life in the separation of the Lord. The separation is far more painful than death.  (660)

0.g: ਕਾਰਤਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪਮਾਲਕਾ ਰਜਨੀ ਸਮੈ; ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਹੀ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as on festival of Diwali, that falls in the Indian month of Kartik, many earthen lamps are lit at night, and their light go off after a short period;

0.g: ਬਰਖਾ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਕੌ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ; ਤਾਸ ਨਾਮ ਪਲਕ ਮੈ ਨ ਤਉ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as bubbles appear on water when rain-drops on it, and very soon these bubbles explode and disappear from the surface;

0.g: ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ; ਝਾਈ ਸੀ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਉਪਜਿ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a thirsty deer is disillusioned of the presence of water, the hot shimmering sand (mirage) that disappears in time then he reaches that spot;

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖ ਚਪਲ ਛਲ; ਛਲੈ ਛੈਲ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ।੩੧੧।
0.e: So is the love of Maya that keeps changing its master like the shadow of a tree. But the Naam practitioner devotee of the Guru who remains engrossed in the holy feet of the True, he is able to control the attractive and trickster maya with ease. (311)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਕਰਿ; ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Siva and Sakti i.e. the supreme element in the form of consciousness and prakrti, the matter containing dynamic power in it were joined to create the world, and sun and moon were made its lamps.

0.g: ਰਾਤੀ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਦੇ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Shining stars in the night give the look of lamps lit in each house.

0.g: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਦਿਹਿ; ਤਾਰੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਰੂਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In day time with the rise of one great sun , the stars in the form of lamps go into hiding.

0.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਵਾਉ ਵਿਚਿ; ਤੋਲਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: His one vibration (vak) contains millions of rivers (of life) and His matchless grandeurs cannot be measured.

0.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਜਿਸਿ; ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The benevolent sustainer Lord has also manifested His form as Oankar.

0.g: ਅਬਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: His dynamism is latent, unapproachable and His story is ineffable.

0.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ, ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।੨।
0.e: The basis of talk about the Lord is simply hearsay (and not the first hand experience).

0.g: ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ; ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Serving and worshipping of gods and goddesses viz-a-viz the True Guru is like the difference between night and day.

0.g: ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ; ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁਕਰ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: In the darkness of night (ignorance), there is much radiance of stars (gods) but with the appearance of True Guru's radiance of knowledge (with the rise of the Sun during the day) God, the Only One becomes conspicuous and obvious.

0.g: ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਮੈ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੇਤੁ; ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਸਮੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: The vice and evil-doers are enamored by the evil and vicious acts, but by the knowledge of the True Guru, the devoted Sikhs contemplate on the Lord's name at ambrosial hour by becoming one with Him.

0.g: ਰੈਨ ਸੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਠਗ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੀਤ; ਰਾਜੁਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ।੪੮੭।
0.e: At night when the time for sleep comes, the evil designs of treacherous, deceitful and vicious people prevail. But with the daybreak at ambrosial hour (radiance of knowledge by the True Guru) the righteousness and justice of the Lord prevails. (The divine

0.g: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਸੈਪੁਰਸ; ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: Millions of wisemen through their skills cannot attain the (supreme) fruit of delight.

0.g: ਸਹਸ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਘੜਾਈਆਂ; ਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਸਹਸ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Millions of skillful persons with their skills and thousands of clever persons with their cleverness cannot attain Him.

0.g: ਲਖ ਹਕੀਮ ਲਖ ਹਿਕਮਤੀ; ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ਵਡੇ ਦੁਨਿਆਈ ।
0.e: Lacs of physicians, lacs of ingenious persons and other worldly wise people;

0.g: ਲਖ ਸਾਹ ਪਤਿਸਾਹ ਲਖ; ਲਖ ਵਜੀਰ ਨ ਮਸਲਤ ਕਾਈ ।
0.e: Lacs of kings, emperors and of their minister in lacs are there but no suggestion of anybody is of any use.

0.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ; ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Celebates, truthful and contented ones, siddhs, naths, none could lay his hand upon Him.

0.g: ਚਾਰ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰ ਮਜਹਬਾਂ; ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਹਿਂ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ।
0.e: None, including four varnas, four sects and six philoso­phies could behold that imperceptible Lord's fruit of delight.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ; ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।੧੮।
0.e: Great is the glory of the fruit of delight of the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਮ ਨੀਚ ਲਖ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਸਦਾਏ ।
0.e: Millions are low, medium and high but gurmukh calls himself low of the lowly.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ।
0.e: He becoming dust of the feet and guru’s disciple erases his ego.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਏ ।
0.e: Going with love and respect to the holy congregation, he serves there.

0.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ; ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਏ ।
0.e: He speaks mildly, behaves humbly and even by giving something to somebody wishes good of others.

0.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: Absorbing consciousness into the Word that humble person receives honour in the court of the Lord.

0.g: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Considering death as the last truth and becoming unknown to cunningness he remains indifferent to hopes and desires.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ।੨੪।੮। ਅਠਿ ।
0.e: The imperceptible fruit of delight is seen and received only by Gurmukh.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਅੰਗਹੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਗੰਗਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak created him ( Guru Angad) from his limbs as the waves are produced by Ganges out of itself.

0.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Embodied with deep and sublime attributes he (Angad) was known by gurmukhs as the form of the (imperceptible) supreme soul (paramatman).

0.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਣਿਹਾਰੁ; ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He himself is bestower of pleasures and pains but remains always without any blot.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ, ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ; ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The love between the Guru and the disciple was such that the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.

0.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ, ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤਹੁ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਉ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ।
0.e: It happened in the same manner as tree creates fruit and from fruit is created tree, or as father becomes happy over son and son feels happy in obeying the orders of father.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: His consiconsness merged into word and the perfect transcendental Brahm made him see the imperceptible (Lord).

0.g: ਬਾਬਾਣੇ, ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਆਇਆ ।੫।
0.e: Now Guru Angad got established as ( the extended form of) Baba Nanak.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਖੁਸਬੋਇਦਾਰ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਰੰਗਰੇਜ ਰੰਗੋਲੀ ।
0.e: Many are perfume sellers and many dyers who use colors to make many designs (rangolis).

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਮੇਵੇਦਾਰ ਹਨਿ; ਹੁਡਕ ਹੁਡਕੀਏ ਲੋਲਣਿ ਲੋਲੀ ।
0.e: Many are servants working on contract and many are frolicsome prostitutes.

0.g: ਖਿਜਮਤਿਗਾਰ ਖਵਾਸ ਲਖ; ਗੋਲੰਦਾਜ ਤੋਪਕੀ ਤੋਲੀ ।
0.e: Many are personal maidservants, bomb-throwers, cannoners and many are carriers of war material.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਤਹਵੀਲਦਾਰ; ਮੁਸਰਫਦਾਰ ਦਰੋਗੇ ਓਲੀ ।
0.e: Many are revenue officers, superintending officers, policemen and estimators.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ; ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੀ ।
0.e: Many are farmers who weigh and take care of the agricultural crop and its allied works.

0.g: ਮੁਸਤੌਫੀ ਬੂਤਾਤ ਲਖ; ਮੀਰਸਾਮੇ ਬਖਸੀ ਲੈ ਕੋਲੀ ।
0.e: Millions are accountants, home secretaries, oath officers, finance ministers and tribal people who prepare bows and arrows.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਹੋਇ; ਕਰਨਿ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਮੁਲਕ ਢੰਢੋਲੀ ।
0.e: Many becoming custodians of property administer the country.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ, ਮੋਲ ਅਮੋਲੀ ।੨੧।
0.e: Many are there who have the accounts of invaluable jewels etc. and deposit them properly.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਵਰਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ; ਕਰਿ ਖੁਦੀ ਖਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: All the vamas (castes) do not love one another and quarrel among themselves in ego;

0.g: ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੀਂਹ ਦੁਇ; ਬਲਵੰਤਿ ਬੁਕੰਦੇ ।
0.e: If there are two lions in a jungle they roar mightily at each other.

0.g: ਹਾਥੀ ਹਥਿਆਈ ਕਰਨਿ; ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਹੁਇ ਅੜੀ ਅੜੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They all are like those intoxicated elephants which stubbornly fight each other.

0.g: ਰਾਜ ਭੂਪ ਰਾਜੇ ਵਡੇ; ਮਲ ਦੇਸ ਲੜੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The mighty kings capture large territories and fight with each other.

0.g: ਮੁਲਕ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਦੁਇ; ਜਾਇ ਜੰਗ ਜੁੜੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Two emperors in a country will go at war with each another.

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਲਖ; ਮਲ ਮਲ ਘੁਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Guided and controlled by ego lacs of wrestlers wrestle with one another.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਨੀ; ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੰਦੇ ।੬।
0.e: But ego cannot touch the Sikhs of the Guru residing in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੇ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The praise of the lotus feet of Satguru Ii is comprehension. It is indeed wonderful. Salutations time and again.

0.g: ਕੋਮਲ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਅਉ ਸੀਤਲ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ; ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨ ਸਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: They are tender than the tenderness of the whole world. They are indeed comfortably cool. No other fragrance matches them.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ; ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰਸ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The disciple, who lives ever in attendance of the holy feet of the True Satguru Ii and has worked hard on meditation of Lord's name, has relished the supernatural elixir of Naam Simran.

0.g: ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਬਕਤ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ।੮੦।
0.e: The beauty of Satguru's lotus feet is exemplary. The desire and faculty of mind tires describing it. Their praise indescribable. This wonder of wonders is astonishing. (80)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਜਿਉ ਹਾਥੀ ਦਾ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਵੈ ।
0.e: As the elephant washes its body and coming out of water, it throws mud over it;

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਊਠੈ ਦਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ; ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਣਕ ਜਵਾਹਾਂ ਖਾਵੈ ।
0.e: As the camel avoiding wheat eats low variety of corn named java-s;

0.g: ਕਮਲੇ ਦਾ ਕਛੋਟੜਾ; ਕਦੇ ਲਕ ਕਦੇ ਸੀਸਿ ਵਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The loin cloth of mad man is sometimes worn by him around his waiste and sometimes on his head;

0.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਟੁੰਡੇ ਹਥੜਾ; ਸੋ ਚੁਤੀਂ ਸੋ ਵਾਤਿ ਵਤਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The hand of a cripple sometime goes to his buttocks and the same one sometimes to his mouth when yawning;

0.g: ਸੰਨ੍ਹੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਲੁਹਾਰ ਦੀ; ਖਿਣੁ ਜਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਿਨ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Blacksmith's pincers are sometimes put in fire and the next moment in water;

0.g: ਮਖੀ ਬਾਣੁ ਕੁਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਲੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Evil is the nature of fly, it prefers foul smell to fragrance;

0.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਦਾ, ਕਿਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ।੧੦।
0.e: Likewise, the fool gets nothing.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਛਾਣਨੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਉਠ ਉਠਾਲੇ ।
0.e: With the sound of the seive it is vain to cause the camel to get up.

0.g: ਤਾੜੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਰਾਇੰਦਾ; ਮੈਂਗਲ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Frightening the elephant with the clappings of the hands is as futile

0.g: ਬਾਸਕਿ ਨਾਗੈ ਸਾਮ੍ਹਣਾ; ਜਿਉਂ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲੇ ।
0.e: As burning of the lamp before a Väsuki cobra (in the hope that it will run away).

0.g: ਸੀਹੁੰ ਸਰਜੈ ਸਹਾ ਜਿਉਂ; ਅਖੀਂ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ।
0.e: If rabbit looking into the eyes wishes to frighten the lion (it is nothing but a deathwish).

0.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਨਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Small water conduit pipes can not be equal to the ocean.

0.g: ਅਣਹੋਂਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਂਦੇ; ਬੇਮੁਖ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ।੨੦।
0.e: Like ghost, the apostate being nothing goes on expressing his ego.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਲ ਤੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਨਤ ਕਈ ਕੋਸ ਚਲ︀ਯੋ; ਨੈਨ ਉਘਰਤ ਵਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ਹੀ ਠਿਕਾਨੋ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a blind folded bullock of an oilman keeps going around the extractor and he thinks he has travelled many miles, but when his blindfold is removed, sees himself standing at the same place.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਟਤ ਆਂਧਰੋ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਚਿੰਤ; ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਛੁਰੋ ਟਟੇਰੋ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੋ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a blind person keeps twisting a rope without care when at the same time, the calf is eating it. But when he feels for the work done by him so far, repents to know that much of it has been eaten away;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲੌ ਧਾਵੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ; ਆਵਤ ਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੋ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a deer keeps running towards a mirage, but the absence of water does not satiate his thirst and he feels distressed wandering.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਸ੍ਵਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਬਿਹਾਯ ਗਈ; ਪਹੁੰਚ ਨ ਸਕ︀ਯੋ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਹਾਂ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਨੋ ਹੈ ।੫੭੮।
0.e: Similarly, wandering in the country and beyond, I have spent my life in a dream. I have not been able to reach where I had to go. (I have failed to re-unite myself with God).  (578)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The transecental Brahm is the perfect Brahm and that very formless (Lord) has created all the forms of universe.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He is ummanifest, unfathomable and imperceptible for intellect, but Guru, the icon of beauty, has made me behold the Lord.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In holy congregation, the abode of the truth, He emerges as tender towards devotees and deludes even those who never get deluded.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੁਇ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Guru alone unites all the four varnas to make them one and further makes them bow before the Lord.

0.g: ਧਿਆਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ; ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: At the base of all ascetic disciplines is the philosophy of the Guru in which all the six philosophies (of Indian tradition) get subsumed.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।੧੮।
0.e: He himself is everything but never makes Himself noticed by anyone.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਧ ਸਮੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ; ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤਯਾਗਿ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a brave warrior goes to the battlefield wearing his armour and his weapons, renouncing all his love and attachments.

0.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁਝਾਊ ਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ; ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਭਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Listening to the inspiring music of battle songs he blooms like flower and feels happy and proud seeing the army spread like dark clouds in the sky.

0.g: ਕਰਤ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਕਾਮ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੂਝ ਮਰੈ; ਕੈ ਤਉ ਰਨ ਜੀਤ ਬੀਤੀ ਕਹਤ ਜੁ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Serving his master the king, he is performing his duties and is killed or else if alive, returns to narrate all the happenings of the battlefield.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਮਤ ਭੇਟਤ ਜਗਤ ਪਤਿ; ਮੋਨਿ ਔ ਸਬਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ।੬੧੭।
0.e: Similarly, a traveller of the path of devotion and worship becomes consciously one with the master of the world. He either becomes totally silent or singing His praises and paeans, remains in a state of ecstasy.  (617)

0.g: ਯਾਹੀ ਮਸਤਕ ਪੇਖ ਰੀਝਤ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ; ਹਾਥ ਆਪਨੈ ਬਨਾਇ ਤਿਲਕ ਦਿਖਾਵਤੇ ।
0.e: My beloved master used to feel pleased seeing my forehead. Adoring it, he used to put mark of consecration on it and ask me to see it.

0.g: ਯਾਹੀ ਮਸਤਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਸਤ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਹਿ ਮਾਨਨ ਮਨਾਵਤੇ ।
0.e: My beloved then used to keep her soft hands on my forehead and with loving stories used to please me-the arrogant one.

0.g: ਯਾਹੀ ਮਸਤਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗਤੀ ਹੀ; ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਹੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਲਗਾਵਤੇ ।
0.e: I used to run away saying No! No! and chasing me, he used to hug me very lovingly resting my forehead on his chest.

0.g: ਸੋਈ ਮਸਤਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੁਨ ਰੋਇ ਉਠੌਂ; ਸ੍ਵਪਨੇ ਹੂ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਹਿ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਵਤੇ ।੫੭੬।
0.e: But now on separation, I lament and cry with the same forehead, but my beloved master does not even appear in my dreams.  (576)

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Understanding the deep philosophy and his precept is highly unfathomable matter that is beyond comprehension. Like the imperishable Lord, it is beyond and infinite and worthy of salutation time and again.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ; ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਠਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By concentrating mind in his philosophy and attaching the mind in Naam Simran, one realises the omnipresent Lord in the entire expanse created by Him.

0.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੁਸਮਾਵਲੀ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ; ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਗਮਿਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: One Transcendental Lord is appearing in countless immanent forms. Like the fragrance of a flower bed, He, the inaccessible can be realised and felt.

0.g: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ।੮੧।
0.e: The precept and philosophy of the True Guru is utmost admirable. It is most astonishing and beyond description. He is beyond understanding and stranger than the strangest. (81)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਗਾਂਈ ਘਰਿ ਗੋਸਾਂਈਆਂ; ਮਾਧਾਣੁ ਘੜਾਏ ।
0.e: The cow herds are there in the house of the master, the foolish person continues getting the churning sticks made for his own home.

0.g: ਘੋੜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਉਦਾਗਰਾਂ; ਚਾਬਕ ਮੁਲਿ ਆਏ ।
0.e: The horses are with the merchants and the foolish person roams around purchasing the whips.

0.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਏ ਭਾਜਵਾੜ; ਘਰਿ ਗਾਹੁ ਘਤਾਏ ।
0.e: Foolish person creates stampede at his home only by seeing the harvest of others around the threshing floor.

0.g: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹਟਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਦੇ; ਸੁਨਿਆਰ ਸਦਾਏ ।
0.e: The gold is with the gold merchant but the foolish calls for the goldsmith at his own home for preparing the jewellery.

0.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਾਫਾਏ ।
0.e: He has no place at home, but goes on boasting outside.

0.g: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਬਦਲ ਚਾਲ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜੋ ਆਲਾਏ ।੧੧।
0.e: The apostate is unstable like the speedy cloud and goes on telling lies.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਸਚ ਦਾ; ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Gurmukh longs for the glimpse of truth and the truth is abtained only by providentially meeting an adopter of the truth.

0.g: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Living in the family, the gurmukh like a dutiful householder enjoys all materials and like kings tastes all delights.

0.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੁਇ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੀਸਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ।
0.e: He remains detached amidst all hopes and, knowing the technique of yoga, is known as the king of yogis.

0.g: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ।
0.e: He always bestows and begs nothing. Neither he dies nor he suffers the pangs of the separation from the Lord.

0.g: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਹੈ; ਵਾਇ ਪਿਤ ਕਫੁ ਰੋਗ ਅਰੋਗੀ ।
0.e: He is not troubled by pains and maladies and he remains free from the diseases of air, cough and heat.

0.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ; ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਅਪਦਾ ਸੋਗੀ ।
0.e: He accepts sufferings and joys alike; wisdom of the Guru is his wealth and he is uninfluenced by joy and sorrows.

0.g: ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹੀ, ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ।੧੬।
0.e: Being embodied he is yet beyond the body and while living in the world he is beyond the world.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨ ਸਵਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Creating the jiva (self) He made his body and gave good shape to his mouth, nose, eyes and ears.

0.g: ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ।
0.e: Gracefully He bestowed hands and feet, ears and consciousness for listening to the Word and eye for beholding goodness.

0.g: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸੰਜਾਰੇ ।
0.e: For earning of the livelihood and other works, he infused life into body.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਸਦੇ; ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ।
0.e: He bestowed various techniques of assimilation of music, colours, smells and fragrances.

0.g: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ; ਟੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: For clothing and eating He gave wisdom, power, devotion, and discriminatory wisdom and thought process.

0.g: ਦਾਨੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: The mysteries of that Bestower cannot be understood; that loving Donor keeps with Him myriad's of virtues.

0.g: ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ, ਅਸੰਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ।੩।
0.e: Beyond all accounts, He is infinite and unfathomable.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾਂ; ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ।
0.e: Attaining spiritual discipline through the six seasons, gurmukh assimilates even the six philosophies.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ।
0.e: He conquers the six tastes (sour, sweet, astringent, bitter, tart and saltish) of the tongue and alongwith six musical measures and their consorts surrenders with full devotions.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਚਿਰਜੀਵੀ ਛਿਅ ਜਤੀ; ਚੱਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਛਿਅ ਸਾਧਿ ਜੁਗਤੀ ।
0.e: He understands and accomplishes the ways of life of six immortal ones, six yatis (ascetics) and six yogic chakras.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਛਿਅ ਕਰਮ ਜਿਣਿ; ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੀ ।
0.e: Conquering the six codes of conduct and the six philosophies, he cultivates friendship with the six gurus (teachers of these philosophies).

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਛਿਅ ਛਕ ਛਤੀ ਪਵਣ ਪਰਤੀ ।
0.e: He turns his face from the five external organs plus one internal organ, the mind, and their attendant thirty six kinds of hypocrisies.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰੱਤੀ ।੬।

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਲਖ ਮੁਲੀਅਨਿ ਕਖੈ ।੧੩।
0.e: The love between the Guru and the Sikh makes the latter valuable like a blade of grass made worthy of million (coins)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ; ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: O man, you have not remembered the creator and have accepted the created as your creator.

0.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਪੁਤੁ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Getting engrossed in wife or husband you have further created relationships of son, grandson, father and grandfather.

0.g: ਧੀਆ ਭੈਣਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ; ਤੁਸਨਿ ਰੁਸਨਿ ਸਾਕ ਬਬਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Daughters and sisters proudly become happy or annoyed and such is the case of all relatives.

0.g: ਸਾਹੁਰ ਪੀਹਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੇ; ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ ।
0.e: All other relation's such as the house of father-in-law, one's mother's house, the house of the maternal uncles and other relations of the family are disdainful.

0.g: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪੰਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
0.e: If conduct and thoughts are civilised, one gets honour before the high ups of the society.

0.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਾਥੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ।
0.e: However, at the end, when caught up in the web of death, no companion takes notice of the person.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ, ਜਾਇ ਜਮਾਣੈ ।੭।
0.e: Bereft of the grace of the perfect Guru, all persons become scared of death.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਘਣੇ; ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Recitations, austerities, persistences, many renunciaitions explanations on Vedas and all the fourteen skills are known in the world.

0.g: ਸੇਖਨਾਗ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕਾਂ; ਲੋਮਸ ਅੰਤੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Even Sesanag, Sanaks, and rishi Lomas do not know the mystery of that infinite.

0.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ; ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਥ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Celebates, follower of truth, contented ones, siddhs, naths(yogis) all becoming master­less are wandering in delusions.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕੰਬਰ ਅਉਲੀਏ; ਬੁਜਰਕਵਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਹੈਰਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Searching Him all the pars, prophets, auliyas and thousands of old men are wonderstruck (because they could not know Him).

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ; ਲਖ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਵਿਡਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Yogas (austerties), bhogs (joys), lacs of ailments, sufferings and sepa­rations, all are illusions.

0.g: ਦਸ ਨਾਉਂ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀਆਂ; ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Ten sects of sannyasis are wandering in delusions.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਗਦੇ; ਹੋਰ ਸਭੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੁ ਲੁਕਾਣੇ ।
0.e: Disciple yogis of the Guru always remain alert whereas others have hidden themselves in the jungles, i.e. they are unconcerned with the problems of the world.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ।੧੩।
0.e: Joining the holy congregation, the Sikhs of the Guru eulogize the glory of the name of the Lord.

0.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਜੈਸੇ; ਉਦਤ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਭਾਨ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਸੈ ।
0.e: Just as the beat of the drum is heard on all four sides (its sound cannot be hidden) and when the supreme celestial body-sun rises, its light cannot be concealed;

0.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਸੈ ਦਾਵਾ ਭਏ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਘਟਕਾ ਮੈ ਸਿੰਧ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਿਪੈ ਨ ਛਿਪਾਏ ਸੈ ।
0.e: Just as the whole world knows that light emanates from a lamp, and the ocean cannot be contained in a small earthenware pitcher;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਚਕਵੈ ਨ ਛਾਨੋ ਰਹਤ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਸੈ; ਦੇਸ ਮੈ ਦੁਹਾਈ ਫੇਰੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸੈ ।
0.e: Just as an emperor sitting on the throne of his mighty empire cannot remain hidden; he is known among the subjects of his kingdom and that glory and fame is hard to destroy;

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ; ਗੁਪਤੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਉਪਜਾਏ ਸੈ ।੪੧੧।
0.e: Similarly, the Guru-oriented Sikh whose heart is enlightened by the love of the Lord and His meditation, cannot remain hidden. His silence gives him away.  (411)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਕੰਚਨੈ ਪਾਰੋ ਪਰਸਤ ਸੋਖ ਲੇਤ; ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਡਾਰੇ ਪੁਨ ਪਾਰੋ ਉਡ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as mercury touching gold conceals its real colour but when put in a crucible regains its luster, while the mercury evaporates.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਲਗ ਅੰਬਰ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੋਤ; ਸਾਬਨ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as clothes become dirty with filth and dust but when washed with soap and water become clean again.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਬਿਖ ਬ︀ਯਾਪਤ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਗ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਸੁ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as snake-bite spreads poison in the whole body but with recitation of Garur jaap (a Mantra) all ill effects are destroyed.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਮੋਹਤ ਮਗਨ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੂਲ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ ਹੈ ।੫੫੭।
0.e: Similarly by listening to True Guru's word and meditating on it, all the effects of worldly vices and attachment are eliminated. (All the influence of worldly things (Maya) ends.)  (557)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: Transcendental Brahm is the perfect Brahm; He is the primal cosmic spirit (purakh) and the true Guru.

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਹੋਇ; ਵੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: Yogis became awestruck in meditation for He does not care for knowledge of the Vedas.

0.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ; ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਭਵਦੇ ਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Adoring the gods and goddesses, people go on roaming (in different lives) in water on earth and in the sky.

0.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਘਣੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਈ ।
0.e: They perform many burnt offerings, oblations and ascetic disciplines and still weep while performing the so-called ritualistic activities (because their sufferings are not removed).

0.g: ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਧਾਂਵਦਾ; ਅਠੁ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਗੋਈ ।
0.e: Ever-running mind does not come under control and the mind has spoiled all the eight divisions of life (four varnas and four ashrams).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਣੈ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: The gurmukhs after conquering the mind have won the whole world and losing their ego, they have seen themselves in one and all.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਈ ।੧੭।
0.e: The gurmukhs have prepared the garland of virtues in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਕਿਉ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Quaffing the elixir of love giving fruits of delight, how could a gurmukh explain that ineffable joy?

0.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ; ਓਹੁ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Much is said and listened to but the people remain ignorant of its real taste.

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਕਥਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: In the Vedas and Puranas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa have told enough about the delight of love.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕਤੇਬਾਂ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਦੀਨ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: One can see the four scriptures of semitic religion in this context.

0.g: ਸੇਖਨਾਗੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸਾਂਗੀਤ ਸੁਹਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Sesanag also remembers it and all musical measures also are busy in adorning it.

0.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੁਣਿ; ਹੋਏ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: One becomes full of wonder after listening to the myriads of unstruck melodies,

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ; ਪੀਲਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ।੪।
0.e: But the tale of that elixir, love, is ineffable which one fortunately drinks in the will of the Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਨਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Accepting Guru and God as one, the gurmukh has erased the sense of duality.

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਲਿ ਢਹਾਇ ਕੈ; ਤਾਲ ਨਦੀ ਦਾ ਨੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Knocking down the wall of ego, the gurmukh has united the pond (self) with the river (Brahm).

0.g: ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਦੁਹ ਵਲੀ; ਇਕ ਦੂ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Undoubtedly the river remains contained within its two banks neither one knowing the other.

0.g: ਰੁਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਤੈ ਫਲਹੁ ਰੁਖੁ; ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From tree the fruit and from fruit the e are born and in fact both are one though they have different names.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਝ ਹੈ; ਸੁਝੈ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The sun is one in all the six seasons; knowing this, one does not think of different suns.

0.g: ਰਾਤੀਂ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਦੇ; ਦਿਹ ਚੜਿਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਆਖੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।
0.e: At night the stars twinkle but with the break of day under whose command they hide themselves? (they automatically go and likewise with light of knowledge the darkness of ignorance is dispelled of its own).

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।੧੪।
0.e: The holy congregation, the gurmukhs adore the Lord with single-minded devotion.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਅੰਗ ਰਚਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਖੋੜਿ; ਤੇਈ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਰਚਤ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਗਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a lady of a noble house adorns herself with sixteen types of embellishments and even a harlot does the same;

0.g: ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਮੈ ਭਤਾਰ ਏਕ; ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਤਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੈ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਭਚਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: The lady of the noble house enjoys the bed of one person her husband, whereas a harlot shares her bed with many persons;

0.g: ਕੁਲਾਬਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸੁਜਮ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ; ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਪਰਸਤ ਅਪਜਸ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: For her love of her husband, the lady of the noble house is praised, admired and is free of any calumny whereas a prostitute earns notoriety for her blemishes and offering herself to others.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ; ਸੋਈ ਦੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਹੁਇ ਦਹਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਜੀ ।੩੮੪।
0.e: Similarly the mammon (maya) becomes good for obedient Sikhs of the Guru who use it for good of others according to the teachings of the Guru. But the same mammon becomes troublesome to the worldly people and causes them distress and sufferings.  (384)

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The unique servant of the True Guru keeps the wandering mind under control by taking the refuge of the Guru and practicing meditation on the consecrated words of the Guru. His mind becomes stable and he rests in the comfort of his self (soul).

0.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਿਟੀ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He loses the desire for a long life and fear of death disappears. He becomes free of all worldly bonds while still alive. The teachings and wisdom of the Guru takes over his mind.

0.g: ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਮਾਨੈ; ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He discards and destroys his self-assertion and accepts the dispensation of the Almighty as fair and just. He serves all living beings and thus becomes a slave of the slaves.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਮਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।੨੮੧।
0.e: By practicing the words of Guru, he acquires the divine knowledge and contemplation. And thus he is assured that the perfect God Lord pervades in all. (281)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਕੋਟੀਂ ਸਾਦੀਂ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਜੰਗਲ ਭੂਪਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Many are engrossed in myriad of tastes, and many are the kings of the forests.

0.g: ਥਲੀਂ ਵਰੋਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਪਰਬਤ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Many are the places, whirlwinds, mountains and the ghosts.

0.g: ਨਦੀਆਂ ਨਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਸਰਵਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Many are the rivers, streams and the deep tanks.

0.g: ਅੰਬਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ।
0.e: The sky has many a star and in the nether world innumerable are the serpents.

0.g: ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ; ਭਵਜਲ ਭਰਨਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Many are wandering confused in the labyrinth of world.

0.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਸਭਿ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ।੧੮।
0.e: Without one true Guru all else are perplexities.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ; ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਹੁਇ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a fish swims through towards upstream swiftly, so does a disciple of Guru engrossed in the Guru's word crosses the confluence of all the three veins (Irha, Pingla and Sukhmana) with the methodology of reverse breathing/air.

0.g: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਰਸ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਧੁ ਅਪੀਉ ਪੀਐ ਗੁਹਜੁ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Becoming fearless in the strange devotion and love, engrossed in the practice of Naam Simran and reaching there through strangely mysterious ways, one drinks deep the loving eternal nectar.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਉਨਮਨੀ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਸਹਜ ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ।
0.e: By plentiful practicing of meditation on Guru's teachings, the mind starts listening to the unstruck melody. As a result, it changes its stance and becomes God-oriented. Then one relishes the continuous flow of the divine nectar that is produced as a resu

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ; ਦਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਭਵਨ ਕੈ ।੨੯੧।
0.e: By crossing the confluence of three nerves, one enjoys the bliss of meeting the Lord. The mystical door there is the unique place of enjoying peace, union, relishment and pleasure. (291)

0.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ; ਖੋਏ ਹੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When a disciple meets his Guru and he works hard and toil himself on his precepts, he gets rid of base intellect and divine intelligence is revealed to him. He sheds his ignorance and acquires His knowledge.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਮਰਨ ਕੈ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪਰਵਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the glimpse of the True Guru and focusing his mind, he weans away his attention from worldly pleasures and concentrates the divine word in his consciousness and closes his mind from all other attractions.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੋੁਇ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਤ ਹੁਇ; ਜੋਤੀ ਮੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੁਰ ਤਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: In His love, leaving all worldly pleasures, getting absorbed in His Naam, he keeps on remembering Him all the time.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ਈਸ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਹੀਯੇ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ।੩੪।
0.e: Believe it for Sure that by meeting with Guru, a Guru conscious person becomes one with Lord and all his life depends on Naam Simran-an exclusive support of the Lord. (34)

0.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦਰਸ ਕਮਲ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਹਿਤ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Both lotus and Nymphea lotus crave for a sight of The Sun and The Moon respectively. Because of their meeting and separating frequently, their love is besmirched.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ; ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰੋਗ ਰਹਤ ਅਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A Guru-conscious person is ever engrossed in the elixir-like relishment of True Guru's feet after freeing himself from the influence of three traits of maya (mammon). His love is blemishless.

0.g: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ; ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੈ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Such a God-oriented person stays free from the worldly affairs and remains engrossed in the mystical tenth door because of the unstruck music melody that keeps playing ere.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਜੋਗੀ ਹੈ ।੨੬੭।
0.e: The wondrous state and glory of such a Guru-oriented person is beyond explanation and description. Guru-oriented person remains absorbed in the Lord who is imperceptible, beyond worldly pleasures, yet who is a yogi and a relisher (Bhogi) as well. (267)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ; ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਵਲ ਫੁਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: It is a pond full of pure and fine water wherein the lotuses blossom.

0.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਤਿ; ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੋਇ ਮਹਕੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Lotuses are of beautiful form and they make the environment fragrant.

0.g: ਭਵਰਾਂ ਵਾਸਾ ਵੰਝ ਵਣਿ; ਖੋਜਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Black bees live in bamboo forest but they somehow search and get the lotus.

0.g: ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਤਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ; ਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: With the sunrise, they come attracted from far and wide and meet the lotus.

0.e: With the sunrise, the lotuses of the pond also turn their faces toward the sun.

0.g: ਡਡੂ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਕਵਲ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਨ ਮਾਣਿ ਸਕੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Frond lives in the nearby mire close to the lotus but not understanding the real delight it cannot enjoy like lotus.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Those unfortunate persons who listening to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation do not adopt them.

0.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੰਦੇ ।੨।
0.e: They are most unfortunate in life like the frogs.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਰਾਤਿ, ਸਰਾਈਂ ਵਸਿਆ ।
0.e: A wayfarer, on the way halted in an inn.

0.e: Then moved forward on the told path.

0.e: He neither got envious with anyone nor did he get infatuated by any.

0.e: He neither asked the caste (identity) of any dying person nor he felt any delight witnessing the marriage ceremonies etc.

0.e: He happily accepted gifts of the Lord and never remained hungry or thirsty.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਵਾਤਿ, ਕਵਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ।੫।
0.e: The lotus face of the gurmukh always remains in blossom due to continuous remembrance of the Lord.

0.e: Many are kettledrum and drum-beaters and many play on clarinets.

0.e: Many are prostitutes, bards and singers of qauwali, a particular type of song sung usually in-group in particular modes mostly by Muslims.

0.e: Many are mimics, acrobats and million are jesters.

0.e: Many are torchbearers who light the torches.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਕੋਰਚੀ; ਆਮਲੁ ਪੋਸ ਸਿਲਹ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ।
0.e: Many are the keepers of army store and many are officers who wear comfortable suit of armor.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਆਬਦਾਰ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਬਾਵਰਚੀ ਨਾਨਵਾਈ ।
0.e: Many are water carriers and cooks who cook nans, a kind of round, flat bread.

0.g: ਤੰਬੋਲੀ, ਤੋਸਕਚੀ ਸੁਹਾਈ ।੨੦।
0.e: Betel sellers and incharge of store room for precious articles of their own glory.

0.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਪੈ ਆਵਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਿ; ਦੀਪ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਪਰੀਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A moth approaches a light out of love but the attitude of a lamp is to the contrary. It singes him to death.

0.e: Fulfilling his desire for love, a black bee approaches a lotus flower. But as the Sun sets, the lotus flower closes its petals and snuffs out life from the black bee.

0.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਗਤਿ; ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਗਹਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: It is the character of fish to stay in water but when a fisherman or angler catches it with the help of a net or a hook, and throws it out of the water, the water does not help it in anyway.

0.g: ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਟਰੈ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ।੩੧੮।
0.e: Despite being one-sided, the painful love of moth, black bee and fish is full of faith and trust. Every lover dies for its beloved but doesn't give up loving. Contrary to this one-sided love, the love of Guru and his Sikh is two-sided. True Guru loves His

ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਧਨਾ; ਹਠ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕਰਣੇ ।
0.e: Actions such as recitations, austerities, continence, devotion, perseverence, control over senses, etc. are performed.

0.e: For spirituality, fasts, observances, pilgrimages are undertaken.

0.e: One gets inclined towards temples for the worship of gods and goddesses.

0.e: Besides burnt offerings and charities of many kinds, Vedic hymns are chanted.

0.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਵਿਚਿ; ਬਹੁ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੇ ।
0.e: Getting stuck in such religious, ritualistic illusions, fear and doubt only leads to transmigration.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਣੇ ।੧੨।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation meeting which the ardous world-ocean is crossed.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਧ੍ਰੂ ਹਸਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ, ਪਿਉ ਕੁਛੜਿ ਲੀਤਾ ।
0.e: Boy Dhru came smiling to his house (palace) and his father full of love put him into his lap.

0.g: ਬਾਹਹੁ ਪਕੜਿ ਉਠਾਲਿਆ; ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੇਈ ਕੀਤਾ ।
0.e: Seeing this, the stepmother got angry and catching hold of his arm pushed him out of the lap of the father (the king).

0.g: ਡੁਡਹੁਲਿਕਾ ਮਾਂ ਪੁਛੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਾਵਾਣੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸੁਰੀਤਾ ।
0.e: Tearful with fear he asked his mother whether she was a queen or a maidservant?

0.g: ਸਾਵਾਣੀ ਹਾਂ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹੀਤਾ ।
0.e: O son! (said she) I was born queen but I did not remember God and did not undertake acts of devotion (and this is the reason of yours and mine plight).

0.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਦਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਸਤ੍ਰੂ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ ।
0.e: With that effort can the kingdom be had (asked Dhru) and how can enemies turn friends?

0.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਜਿਦੂ ਹੋਈਐ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ।
0.e: The Lord should be worshipped and thus the sinners also become sacred ones (said the mother).

0.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਰਣਿ ਤਪੁ; ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਤੀਤਾ ।
0.e: Listening to this and getting totally detached in his mind Dhru went out (to the jungle) to undertake rigorous discipline.

0.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ।
0.e: On the way, sage Narad taught him the technique of devotion and Dhru quaffed the nectar from the ocean of the Name of the Lord.

0.g: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਦਿਆ; ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਾ ।
0.e: (After some time) King (Uttanpad) called him back and asked him (Dhru) to rule forever.

0.g: ਹਾਰਿ ਚਲੇ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਤਾ ।੧।
0.e: The gurmukhs who seem to be losing i.e. who turn their faces from the evil propensities, conquer the world.

ਸੋਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ; ਲਖ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Lacs of mounds of gold and rupees and lacs of filled up store houses;

0.e: Invaluable pearls, rubies and diamonds;

0.e: Lacs of kingdoms, countries and thousands of paraganas (districts);

0.e: Riddhis, siddhis (miraculous powers), renunciations, enjoyments, ornaments. embellishments;

0.e: Kantdhenus, the wishfulfilling cows, lacs of wishfulfilling trees (parijats) and fabulous gems;

0.e: All the four ideals of life (dhrma, arth, Kam and moks);

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੋਹ ਨ ਹੰਘਨੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰਾ ।੪।
0.e: And lacs of attractive fruits and other temptations cannot even touch that Sikh of the Guru who has got liberated in the holy congregation.

ਵਾਟੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਮਾਰਦਾ; ਬੈਠਾ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਵਟਵਾੜਾ ।
0.e: Valmeel was a highwayman Valmiki who would rob and kill travellers passing by.

0.e: Then he began serving the true Guru, Now his mind became diffident about his work.

0.e: His mind still urged to kill people but his hands would not obey.

0.e: The true Guru made his mind tranquil and all the volition of mind came to an end.

0.e: He unfolded all the evils of mind before the Guru and said, ‘O Lord, this is a profession for me.’

0.e: The Guru asked him to enquire at home as to which family members would be co-partner him of his evil deeds at death.

0.e: But although his family were always ready to be sacrifice unto him, none of them were ready to accept responsibility.

0.e: Becoming gurmukh, one becomes capable of jumping across mountains of sins.

0.e: Moth loves burning lamp and fish goes on swimming in water for love of It.

0.g: ਮਿਰਗੁ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ; ਭਵਰ ਕਵਲਿ ਵਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: For deer the musical sound is the source of delight, and the black bee being in love for lotus gets enveloped in it.

0.g: ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ; ਦੇਖਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The redlegged patridge (chakor) loves the moon and concentrates upon it.

0.g: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸੰਜੋਗ ਬਣੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Female ruddy sheldrake (chakavi) loves the sun and only on sunrise it meets and mates with its patner.

0.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ; ਮਾਂ ਪੁਤੁ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Woman loves her husband and it is love that the mother brings forth the son.

0.e: Beholding Him operative in all, the gurmukh feels contented.

0.e: The Lord spreading His one vibration, created all the universes.

0.e: Having created lacs and crores of universes He subsumes them in His each trichome.

0.e: That Murdri; killer of Mur demon, the transcendent Brahm is the perfect Guru Brahm.

0.e: Holy congregation is the abode of truth wherein resides the word of the formless One.

0.e: Bestowing loving delight on the gurmukhs, this holy congregation wipes out their ego.

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਕਾਜ ਲਾਗ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਸੇਵਕ ਜੈਸੇ; ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਿਰਖ ਸਨੇਹ ਉਪਜਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Just as a worker serves the king whole-heartedly and the king feels happy to see him.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੂਤ ਚੋਚਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਮਾਨ; ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਢਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Just as a son shows his childish pranks to his father, seeing and hearing these father pampers and cuddles him.

0.e: Just as a wife serves the food fondly that she had prepared so lovingly in the kitchen, her husband eats it with pleasure and that pleases her immensely.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ; ਗਾਵੈ ਰੀਝ ਗਾਯਨ ਸਹਜ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ।੫੬੬।
0.e: Similarly, the devoted followers of the Guru hear the divine words of the Guru with rapt attention. Then the singer of these hymns also sing with deep emotion and love that helps both the listeners and the singers absorb their mind in the essence of Guru'

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦

0.e: Meeting and mating of mother and father makes the mother pregnant who becoming hopeful keeps the child in her womb.

0.e: She enjoys edibles and unedibles without any inhibition and moves carefully with measured steps on the earth.

0.g: ਪੇਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਸ ਮਾਹ ਰਖਿ; ਪੀੜਾ ਖਾਇ ਜਣੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: She gives birth to her dear son after bearing the pain of carrying him in her womb for ten months.

0.e: Having delivered, the mother nourishes the child and herself remains moderate in eating and drinking.

0.e: Having ministered the customary first food, and milk, she stares at him with deep love.

0.g: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਪੋਖਿਆ; ਭਦਣਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਨਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: She thinks about his food, clothes, tonsure, betrothal, education etc.

0.g: ਪਾਂਧੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ; ਖਟਿ ਲੁਟਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: Throwing handful of coins over his head and giving him a proper bath she sends him to the pundit for education.

0.g: ਉਰਿਣਤ ਹੋਇ, ਭਾਰੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ ।੧੦।
0.e: This way she clears the debt (of her motherhood).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਰੁਖਹੁ ਘਰ ਛਾਵਾਇ; ਥੰਮ੍ਹ ਥਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From tree are made houses and pillars.

0.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ; ਬੇੜ ਘੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: A tree getting sawed helps to make boat.

0.g: ਲੋਹੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੜਾਇ; ਪੂਰ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Then adding iron (nails) to it, it gets people float on water.

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਹਰੀ ਦਰੀਆਇ; ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In spite of the myriads of waves of river, it takes people across.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ; ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Likewise, the Sikhs of the Guru, in love and fear of the Lord, practise the Word.

0.g: ਇਕਸ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਾਇ; ਲਖ ਛੁਡਾਇਆ ।੯।
0.e: They make people follow the one Lord and get them liberated from the bondages of transmigration.

0.g: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਹਿਜਾਸਨ ਜਉ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਸਮੈ; ਗੁਰਜਨ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When a wife proceeds to enjoy the union of her husband in his bed at night, no talk of any noble, elderly or holy person appeals to her.

0.g: ਹਿਮ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਿਤ ਮੁਦਤਿ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਚਿਤਿ; ਇਕ ਟਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਰਤ ਨ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As the moon rises, the ruddy sheldrake is immensely pleased and gazing at it with concentration of mind, is unaware of his own body even.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੈ; ਬਿਸਮ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a bumble bee is so engrossed in the sweet smelling nectar of the flower, that it gets trapped in the box-like lotus flower when the Sun sets.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਖ; ਦਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੁਸਕਾਤਿ ਹੈ ।੪੩੩।

0.e: Just as peacocks and rain-birds make pleasing sounds seeing the dark clouds in the sky and hearing their thunder.

0.e: Just as mango and many other trees bloom during spring season, when cuckoos become ecstatic and make very sweet sounds sitting on these trees.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਫੁਲਤ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਵਿਖੈ; ਮਧੁਪ ਗੁੰਜਾਰਤ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਜਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Just as lotus flowers bloom in a pond attracting bumble bees who come flying making pleasant sound.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਪੇਖ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸਾਵਧਾਨਹ ਗਾਇਨ ਗਾਵੈ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ।੫੬੭।
0.e: Similarly, seeing the listeners sitting in singular mind, the singers sing the divine hymns in deep devotion and attention that creates an atmosphere of loving tranquility absorbing both the singers and the listeners in divine state of ecstasy.  (567)

0.e: Truth in the form of gurmukh ever remains detached and the falsehood has no impact on it.

0.e: Sandal wood tree is surrounded by snakes but neither the poison affects it nor its fragrance is lessened.

0.e: Amid the stones resides the philosopher's stone but even meeting the eight metals it does not get spoiled.

0.e: Polluted water mixing into the Ganges cannot pollute it.

0.e: Seas are never burnt by fire and air cannot shake mountains.

0.g: ਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਣਿ ਜਾਇ; ਵਾਹੇਂਦੜੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ।
0.e: The arrow can never touch the sky and the shooter repents afterwards.

0.e: The falshood ultimately is false.

0.e: Where does a man reach while asleep? How does he eat when hungry? When thirst flares up, how does it satisfy it ? And where does the water consumed creates calmness?

0.e: What is the nature of lust, anger, greed, attachment and pride? Similarly reality of truth, contentment, kindness and righteousness cannot be known.  (623)

0.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ।
0.e: Sorath:

0.e: This mystery of the beginning and end is beyond comprehension. Lord is beyond, away and infinite.

0.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ।
0.e: Dohra:

0.e: Guru Ram Das caused the meeting of Guru and Sikh in the same wondrous way of fruit and tree.

0.g: ਅੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਆਦ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ।੨।੬।
0.e: That perspective is infinite and no one can understand it. It is beyond, away and still away out of the reach of mortals.

0.g: ਛੰਦ ।
0.e: Channt:

0.e: Just as the sound of musical instruments melds with the words (of song/hymns), similarly Guru Ram Das and Guru Arjan became indistinguishable.

0.g: ਸਲਿਲਹਿ ਸਲਿਲ ਸਮਾਇ ਨਾਦ ਸਰਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਨਿ ।
0.e: Just as the river water becomes inseparable from the water of the ocean, Guru Arjan became one with Guru Amar Das by engrossing himself in his precepts and following them obediently.

0.g: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਹੋਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ।
0.e: Just as son of a king becomes king, similarly Guru Arjan born as son to Guru Ram Das became an enlightened soul by singing the eulogies of Lord-a boon blessed to him by Satguru.

0.e: By the grace of Guru Ram Das, Arjan Dev succeeded him as Guru Arjan Dev.

0.g: ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਰੋਗੁ ਦੁਖਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ; ਕਹਤ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਪਥਿਕਨ ਪੈ ਉਸਾਸ ਤੇ ।
0.e: The to pangs of separation and disunion from her beloved husband, a distressed wife heaves big sighs and sends messages to her beloved husband through the wayfarers.

0.e: My beloved! Look how a lovelorn pigeon, a species of devious origin, impatiently flies down from high sky to his mate.

0.g: ਤੁਮ ਤੋ ਚਤੁਰਦਸ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੇ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ; ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਨ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਰਿਪ ਰਿਪ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਤੇ ।
0.e: My beloved! You are a store-house of all the knowledge; why don't you rid your woman from the pangs of separation?

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ; ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਦਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤੇ ।੨੦੭।

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧

0.e: The true Guru is true emperor who has founded the abode of truth in the form of the congregation of the saints.

0.e: The Sikhs living there being taught by the Guru, lose their ego and never make themselves noticed.

0.e: The Sikhs of the Guru get themselves called sadhus only after accomplishing all sorts of discipline.

0.e: They preach to all the four varnas and themselves remain indifferent in the midst of maya.

0.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: They explain clearly that everything is below truth i.e. the truth is highest and only this mantra should be recited with deep integrity.

0.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ; ਮੰਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Everything is subsumed in the divine order and whosoever bows his head before His order, merges in the truth.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੧।
0.e: The consciousness attuned to the Word makes man competent to behold the invisible Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ; ਛਿਣ ਭੰਗਰੁ ਛਲ ਦੇਹੀ ਛਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Though human birth is a rare gift, yet this body being made of clay is momentary.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਲਾ; ਉਡੈ ਨ ਪਉਣੁ ਖੁਲੇ ਨਉਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Made from ovum and semen, this airtight body has nine doors.

0.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੀਅਨਿ; ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿੰ ਉਦਰੁ ਮਝਾਰਾ ।
0.e: That Lord saves this body even in the hellish fire of the mother's womb.

0.g: ਕਰੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਗਰਭ ਵਿਚਿ; ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: During pregnancy the creature hangs upside down in the mother's womb and continuously meditates.

0.g: ਦਸੀ ਮਹੀਨੀਂ ਜੰਮਿਆਂ; ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਰੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: After ten months the ftv takes birth when because of that meditation it is liberated from that pool of fire.

0.g: ਜੰਮਦੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Right from the time of birth he gets engrossed in maya and now that protector Lord is not beheld by him.

0.g: ਸਾਹੋਂ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ, ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ।੬।
0.e: Jiv the travelling trader thus gets separated from the Lord, the great banker.

0.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਇ ਜਨਮ ਜੀਤਿਓ; ਚਰਨ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਰਗ ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ।
0.e: A human life is usefully spent when one leads it as an obedient Sikh of the True Guru and wins all its benefits. The feet are successful if they tread the path defined by the Guru.

0.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾ ਵਲੋਕਨ ਕੈ; ਮਸਤਕ ਸਫਲ ਰਜ ਪਦ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ।
0.e: The eyes are successful if they accept the omnipresence of the Lord and see Him everywhere. The forehead is successful if it touches the dust of the path tread by Satguru.

0.g: ਹਸਤ ਸਫਲ ਨਮ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਲਿਖੇ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ।
0.e: The hands are successful if they are raised in the salutation of Satguru and to write his utterances/compositions. The ears become successful by listening to the glory, adulations of the Lord and words of the Guru.

0.g: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਕੈ ।੯੧।
0.e: The congregation of holy and true souls attended by a Sikh is useful as it helps in uniting with the Lord. Thus abiding by the tradition of Naam Simran, he becomes aware of all the three worlds and the three periods. (91)

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ; ਕਾਲ ਮੈ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ।
0.e: A Guru-conscious person enjoys the benefits of all the nine treasures in the company of holy men. Despite living in the wheel of time, he remains protected from its wrath. He destroys the poison of the time like snake.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ; ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਭਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ।
0.e: He drinks deep the elixir of the Lord's name sitting in the dust of the feet of holy men. He becomes bereft of caste pride and is able to remove all differences of high and low from his mind.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ; ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਕੀ ਤਾਰੀਐ ।
0.e: In the company of holy men and enjoying the treasure of elixir like Naam, he remains engrossed in his self and attached consciously in a state of equipoise.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਤ ਪਰਮਪਦ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਆਰੀਐ ।੧੨੭।
0.e: Relishing the elixir like Naam of the Lord in the company of the holy men, he attains the supreme state. The path of Guru-conscious people is beyond description. It is imperishable and celestial. (127)

0.g: ਜਾਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਲਤਾਨ ਦੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਿਪੁਰੇ ਨੋ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: After the journey of Multan, Baba Nanak again turned towards Kartarpur.

0.g: ਚੜ੍ਹੇ ਸਵਾਈ ਦਿਹਿ ਦਿਹੀ; ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।
0.e: His impact increased by leaps and bounds and he made people of kaliyug remember Nam.

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੰਗਣਾ; ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Desiring anything except the Nam of the Lord, is invitation to multiplying sufferings.

0.g: ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In the world, he established the authority (of his doctrines) and started a religion, devoid of any impurity (niramal panth).

0.g: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਲਹਿਣਾ ਜੀਂਵਦੇ; ਗੁਰਿਆਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: During his life time he waved the canopy of Guru seat on the head of Lahina(Guru Angad) and merged his own light into him.

0.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਕੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਵਟਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak now transformed himself.

0.g: ਲਖਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਕਈ; ਆਚਰਜੇ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: This mystery is incomprehensible for anybody that awe-inspiring (Nanak) accomplished a wonderful task.

0.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟਿ; ਸਰੂਪੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।੪੫।
0.e: He converted (his body) into a new form.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ਪਰੀਤ ਹੈ, ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Red-legged partridge (chakor) loves moon and hence stares at it without even losing its glance.

0.e: Lotus loves water and shows the water its blossomed face.

0.e: Rain birds and peacocks also shriek when they see the clouds.

0.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ, ਮਾਂ ਪੁਤ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Wife loves her husband and mother takes care of the son.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਓਹੁ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ।੪।
0.e: Similarly the Sikh loves Guru and this love accompanies him to the end.
