0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਦ ਸੌਰਭ ਕਮਲ ਓਰ ਧਾਇ ਜਾਇ; ਮਧੁਪ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਉਚਾਰਹੀ ।
0.e: Just as attracted by the fragrance, a bunch of bumble bees invade lotus flowers resoundingly.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਜਾ ਮੈ; ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੀ ।੬੦੬।
0.e: Similarly, an obedient Sikh who is accepted (by the Guru) and in whose mind the words and knowledge of the True Guru the supreme treasure, gets lodged, that Sikh's feet are bowed at by the whole world.  (606)

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ; ਧਿਆਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: That the true Guru is the truth incarnate and is the basis of meditation is well known (to gurmukh).

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Satnam, Karta Purakh is accepted as the basic formula, the muli mantr, by gurmukh.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸੁ; ਪੂਜਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: He accepting the sweet sap of the lotus feet as fundamental, quaffs the joy of love for the supreme.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੈ ।
0.e: He enters into the immersion of word-consciousness through the Guru and the holy congregation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਭਾਣੈ ।
0.e: The way of the gurmukh is beyond the ken of mind and speech and he in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru and his own steadfast will, treads on it.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁਂ ਬਾਹਰੀ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ, ਕਉਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Who can describe the importance of the parable (of gurmukh) because it is beyond the Vedas and the Katebas, (the four holy books of semitic religion).

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ, ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ।੧੯।
0.e: This way can be identified only by crossing the limits and anxieties about the high and low of the world.

0.g: ਖਗਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪਰਾਕ੍ਰਮੀ ਪਰਮਹੰਸ; ਚਾਤੁਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Mind is like a large Garud (a bird that according to Hindu mythology is the transport of Lord Vishnu) that has very sharp flight, is very powerful, shrewd, clever, well aware of happenings in all four directions and is brisk like electricity.

0.g: ਭੁਜਬਲੀ ਅਸਟ ਭੁਜਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਲੀਸ ਕਰ; ਏਕ ਸਉ ਅਰ ਸਾਠਿ ਪਾਉ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਾਚਲ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Like a maund, the mind is also powerful with eight arms (eight arms of maund-each of 5 seers) 40 hands (each hand is one seer of a maund). Thus it has 160 feet (each feet of a maund is of one pao). Its gait is very sharp and not likely to stop anywhere.

0.g: ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸੁਪਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਹਿਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ਏਕ ਪਲ ਹੈ ।
0.e: This mind awake or asleep, day or night keeps wandering in all ten directions all the time. It visits all the three worlds in no time.

0.g: ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਅਛਤ ਉਡਤ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ; ਪੁਰ ਪੁਰ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਰ ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ ਹੈ ।੨੩੦।
0.e: A bird in a cage cannot fly, but mind though in cage of the body flies to places where no one can reach. It has reach to the cities, mountains, jungles, in the water and even the deserts. (230)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ, ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Spending this life fruitfully gurmukh goes to the other world.

0.g: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ, ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿਆ ।
0.e: There in the true court (of lord) he gets his true place.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ, ਚਾਉ ਅਲਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Repast of gurmukh is love and his delight is devoid of flirtatiousness.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤੁ, ਨ ਹਲੈ ਹਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Gurmukh has a tranquil heart and remains steadfast even in ups and downs.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਉ, ਭਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਭਲਿਆ ।
0.e: He speaks truth and good of the good.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦੇ ਜਾਨਿ, ਆਵਨਿ ਘਲਿਆ ।੧੪।
0.e: Only gurmukhs are called to the court of the Lord and they come to the world only when the Lord sends them.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਲਸਣੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਲੁਕੈ; ਬਹਿ ਖਾਜੈ ਕੂਣੈ ।
0.e: The smell of garlic cannot be concealed even if it is eaten in a remote corner.

0.g: ਕਾਲਾ ਕੰਬਲੁ ਉਜਲਾ; ਕਿਉਂ ਹੋਇ ਸਬੂਣੈ ।
0.e: No soap how so much applied, can turn the black blanket into white.

0.g: ਡੇਮੂ ਖਖਰ ਜੋ ਛੁਹੈ; ਦਿਸੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸੂਣੈ ।
0.e: Whosoever will touch the hive of poisonous wasps will find his face swollen.

0.g: ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਲਾਵਣੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੂਣੈ ।
0.e: The cooked vegetable devoid of salt is absolutely useless.

0.g: ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵਿਹੂਣੈ ।
0.e: Without the knowledge of the true Guru, the backbiter has neglected the name of the Lord.

0.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ; ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਝੂਣੈ ।੩।
0.e: He gets happiness neither here nor there and always laments and repents.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ, ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ਈਸ; ਇਤ ਤੇ ਉਲੰਘਿ, ਉਤ ਜਾਇ ਠਹਰਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Meeting with Guru, a Sikh receives the Lord's word to meditate upon and by his untiring and resolute efforts become one with Him. He frees himself from the worldly matters and lives in harmony in the realm of the Lord.

0.g: ਚਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੂਦ, ਪੇਖੈ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ; ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ, ਓੁਨਮਨੀ ਸੁਧ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: He shuts his eyes from mundane worldly attractions and lives in the spiritual wisdom that helps him feel His presence in everything.

0.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਕੋਚਤ ਹੀ, ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੋਲਿ; ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਪਰੈ, ਅਨਹਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Weaning his thoughts away from the worldly attractions, his doors of ignorance are opened; he is distracted from all sources of worldly pleasures and he gets engrossed in listening to celestial songs and music.

0.g: ਬਚਨ ਬਿਸਰਜਤ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੁਇ; ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ, ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਵਈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Renouncing the worldly matters and shedding all attachment with worldly pleasures, he drinks deep the elixir that flows continuously in his (Dasam Duar) the celestial door of the body. (11)

0.g: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਨਿ ਸਾਲਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਾ; ਗੀਤਾ ਭਾਗਵਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਏਕਾਕੀ ਕਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: If someone is a worshipper of Vishnu, is brahmin by caste, worships (stone) and listens to the recitation of Geeta and Bhagwat in a secluded place;

0.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਦੇਵ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੂਛਿ; ਕਰਤ ਗਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਸੋਧਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Have the auspicious time and date worked out by learned brahmins before proceeding on religious places or visiting the temples of gods and goddesses located on banks of rivers;

0.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਗਰਧਬ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਗਨੁ ਕੈ; ਸੰਕਾ ਉਪਰਾਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੀ ।
0.e: But when he sets out of the house and faces a dog or a donkey, he regards it inauspicious and a doubt arises in his mind forcing him to return home.

0.g: ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ; ਦੁਬਧਾ ਅਛਿਤ ਨ ਪਰੰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੀ ।੪੪੭।
0.e: Despite belonging to a Guru like a faithful wife, if a person does not acknowledge the support of his Guru firmly and wanders at the door of one god or the other, he cannot reach the supreme state of Oneness with God having been caught in duality.  (447)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸਨ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਇ ਮਲੀਨ; ਸਲਿਲ ਸਾਬੁਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as clothes become soiled by their touching the body but are washed clean with water and soap

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਿਵਾਲ ਕੈ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਜਲੁ; ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਛੋਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the water in a pond is covered with thin film of algae and dropped leaves, but by brushing aside the film with hand, clean drinkable water appears.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ; ਹੋਤ ਉਜੀਆਰੋ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਕੇ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the night is dark even with the twinkling of stars but with the rising Sun-light spreads all over.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਤਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ।੩੧੨।
0.e: So does the love of maya sully the mind. But by the teachings of True Guru and His contemplation, it becomes radiant. (312)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਕਿਕਰ ਕੰਡੇ ਧਰੇਕ ਫਲ; ਫਲੀਂ ਨ ਫਲਿਆ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਦੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Thorns grow on acacia and flowers and fruits on china-berry but they all are useless.

0.g: ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਹਾਂ ਫੁਲ; ਦਾਖ ਨਾ ਗੁਛਾ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Both have colourful fruits but they cannot be mistaken for the bunch of grapes.

0.g: ਚਿਤਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਅਰਿੰਡ ਫਲੁ; ਥੋਥੀ ਥੋਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Fruit of castor is also beautiful and piebald but what can one expect from vacuos cactus?

0.g: ਰਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਮੁਲੁ ਅਢੁ; ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਿਮਲ ਛਾਂਵ ਜਿਵੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Its red fruit is worthless just like the useless shade of silk-cotton tree.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਨਲੀਏਰ ਕਠੋਰ ਫਲੁ; ਮੁਹੁ ਭੰਨੇ ਦੇ ਗਰੀ ਤਿਵੇਹੀ ।
0.e: The hard coconut yields its kernel only after its mouth is smashed. Mulberries are of white and black variety and their tastes are also different.

0.g: ਸੂਤੁ ਕਪੂਤੁ ਸੁਪੂਤੁ ਦੂਤ; ਕਾਲੇ ਧਉਲੇ ਤੂਤ ਇਵੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Similarly, the worthy and the unworthy sons are obedient and rebellious respectively, i.e. one provides happiness whereas the other one gives suffering.

0.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ, ਕੁਦਾਉ ਧਰੇਹੀ ।੨੧।
0.e: Duality is always a bad policy of life.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਿਹਾਰੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The true Creator as the Truth is pervading one and all.

0.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ, ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਛਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Out of Truth He created air and (in the form of vital air) is residing in all

0.g: ਪਵਣਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਜਿ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From air was created water which always remains humble i.e. it. always moves down wards.

0.g: ਤੁਲਹਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਣਾਇ, ਨੀਰ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Earth as a raft is made to float on water.

0.g: ਨੀਰਹੁ ਉਪਜੀ ਅਗਿ, ਵਣਖੰਡੁ ਛਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From water emerged fire which spread throughout the whole vegetation.

0.g: ਅਗੀ ਹੋਦੀ ਬਿਰਖੁ, ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: By virtue of this very fire (heat) the trees became. full of fruits

0.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ, ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In this way, air, water and fire were integrated under the order of that primaeval Lord

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ, ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।੪।
0.e: And thus was this game of creation arranged.

0.g: ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂਐ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਫਲੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮੈ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: To everyone, his/her son looks beautiful. But one whom others praise is certainly beautiful.

0.g: ਆਪਨੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਬੁਰੋ ਲਾਗਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਰਿਦੈ; ਜਾਇ ਜਗੁ ਭਲੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: No one dislikes his profession, but one should trade only those commodities which are praised by others.

0.g: ਆਪਨੇ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਸਭੈ; ਉਤਮੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਅਵਗਾਹੀਐ ।
0.e: Everyone follows rites and traditions of one's family, but all deeds which are as per scriptures and according to social traditions are considered supreme.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਬ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਹੀਐ ।੫੫੩।
0.e: Everyone says that no salvation can be achieved without a Guru, but one requires such a capable True Guru who can guide a person to salvation through His advice while living a householder's life, in a society and enjoying all material comforts.  (553)

0.g: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਰ ਗੰਗ ਜਾਇ ਬਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਾਗ ਨਾਇ; ਤੈਸਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਏਕ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਵਾਏ ਕਾ ।
0.e: Providing bathing facility to a Sikh and helping him bathe is an act that is equal to five visits to a place of pilgrimage to river Ganges and an equal number to Prayag.

0.g: ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਪਿਲਾਇ ਪਾਨੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰ ਕੁਰਖੇਤ; ਅਸ੍ਵਮੇਧ ਜਗ ਫਲ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜਿਵਾਏ ਕਾ ।
0.e: If a Sikh is served water with love and devotion, then it is an act equal to visiting Kurukshetra. And if a Sikh of the Guru is served meal with love and devotion one is rewarded with blessing obtainable from an Aswmedh Yag.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਉਸਾਰ ਦੀਨੇ; ਤੈਸਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਇਕ ਸਬਦ ਸਿਖਾਏ ਕਾ ।
0.e: Just as a hundred temples raised in gold are given away in charity, its reward is equal to teaching one hymn of Gurbani to a Guru's Sikh.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਾਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੀਆ ਕਾਹੂ; ਤੈਸਾ ਫਲ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਚਾਪ ਪਗ ਸੁਆਏ ਕਾ ।੬੭੩।
0.e: The gain of pressing the feet of a tired Guru's Sikh and putting him to sleep is equal to seeing a noble and godly person a score of times.  (673)

0.g: ਦੇਖਬੇ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਇਬੇ ਕਉ; ਕੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: I neither have enlightened eyes to have a glimpse of my unique, radiant and dear lover nor have I the power to show His glimpse to anyone. Then how can one see or even show a glimpse of the lover?

0.g: ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਬੇ ਕਉ; ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ।
0.e: I do not have the wisdom to describe the virtues of my beloved who is treasure-house of goodness. Nor do I have ears to listen to his adulations. Then how should we listen and recite the panegyrics of the fountain of merits and excellence?

0.g: ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਨ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ।
0.e: The mind neither inhabits the teachings of the True Guru nor does it engross itself in the sermons of Guru. The mind does not achieve stability in the words of Guru. Then how can one get engrossed in higher spiritual state?

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ; ਕੈਸੇ ਬਹੁਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਈਐ ।੨੦੬।
0.e: My whole body is aching. I, the meek and devoid of respect, has neither beauty nor high caste. Then how can I become and be known as the most favourite love of my Master Lord? (206)

0.g: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਨ ਸਕੇ; ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Supreme, absolute, true Lord whom Sidhs, Yogis and Naths could not bring in their perception, who could not be known by Brahma and other deities despite contemplation of Vedas;

0.g: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਪਾਏ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Lord who could not be realised by Shiva and four sons of Brahma, nor by Indra and other such deities who resorted myriad yags and penances;

0.g: ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਸੇਖਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਸੰਖ ਜਾਨੀ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਰਜ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਕ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Whom Shesh Naag with his thousand tongues could not comprehend and speak out all names of the Lord; bewildered by His magnificence, even the celibate sage Narad gave up the search out of frustration,

0.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਇਓ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।੨੧।
0.e: About the infinitude of which Lord, Vishnu in spite of manifesting in so many incarnations, could know nothing. Satguru manifests Him in the heart of his obedient devotee. (21)

0.g: ਚੀਟੀ ਕੈ ਉਦਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਹਸਤੀ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈਸੇ; ਅਤੁਲ ਪਹਾਰ ਭਾਰ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀਨ ਉਠਾਵਈ ।
0.e: As an elephant cannot be contained in the stomach of an ant, as a small flying insect cannot lift the weight of a mountain,

0.g: ਮਾਛਰ ਕੈ ਡੰਗ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਹੈ ਬਸਿਤ ਨਾਗੁ; ਮਕਰੀ ਨ ਚੀਤੈ ਜੀਤੈ ਸਰਿ ਨ ਪੂਜਾਵਈ ।
0.e: As a mosquito sting cannot kill the king of snakes, a spider can neither win a tiger nor match with it,

0.g: ਤਮਚਰ ਉਡਤ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ਆਕਾਸ ਬਾਸ; ਮੂਸਾ ਤਉ ਨ ਪੈਰਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: As an owl cannot fly and reach the sky, nor can a rat swim across the ocean and reach the far side,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਵਈ ।੭੫।
0.e: So are the ethics of love of our beloved Lord difficult and beyond for us to understand. It is a very serious subject. As a drop of water merges with the water of the ocean, so does a devoted Sikh of the Guru becomes one with his beloved Lord. (75)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪੈ ਆਪਣਾ; ਕਿਉ ਸਿਝੈ ਚੇਲਾ ।
0.e: If the disciple does not know (tell) about his guru, how could he get liberated.

0.g: ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ; ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Bound in chains, he is forced to walk alone on the way of the Yama, death.

0.g: ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈਂ ਨਰਕ ਵਿਚਿ; ਉਹੁ ਖਰਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: In dilemma he stands and suffers hell.

0.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਉਦਿਆਂ; ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Though he transmigrates in the eighty four lac species of life yet he does not meet the Lord.

0.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿਉ ਜੂਏ ਖੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Like the playing of gamble, he loses the invaluable stake of life in this game.

0.g: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਨੈ; ਉਹੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਵੇਲਾ ।੨।
0.e: At the end (of life) he has jitters and lamentations but the time gone never returns.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ; ਸਹਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Fear (of God) and love (for mankind) being diffused in the holy congregation the sense of non-attachment always prevails.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਉ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By nature, the Gurmukhs remian alert i.e. their consciousness remains attuned to Sabad, the Word.

0.g: ਮਧਰ ਬਚਨ ਅਲਾਉ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: They speak sweet words and they have already expelled ego from their selves.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਥਾਉ; ਸਦਾ ਅਨੁਰਾਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Conducting themselves according to the wisdom of the Guru they always remain imbued in love (of the Lord).

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਸਾਉ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: They feeling fortunate quaff the cup of love (of the Lord).

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਉ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Realising the light of the Supreme in their mind they become competent to light the lamp of divine knowledge.

0.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਉ; ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਅਦਾਗੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Due to the wisdom obtained from Guru they have unlimited enthusiasm and they remain untouched by maya and the dirt of the evil propensities.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜਾਉ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਹੈ ।੧੩।
0.e: In the context of worldliness, they always conduct themselves in a superior position i.e. if the world is twenty, they are twenty one.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਕਰਿ; ਖੇਤ ਬੀਜਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Farmers even having done their farming donot attain the fruit of spiritual Leasure.

0.g: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ; ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The traders engaged in profitable trading donot remain stablized theirselves.

0.g: ਚਾਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸੁਲਹ ਕਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The servants go on doing their jobs but not eschewing ego Alley donot meet the Lord.

0.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆਂ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਬ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: People, despite their virtues and charities and .even performing many duties donot remain stablized.

0.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਪਰਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Becoming rulers And subjects, people undertake many quarrels but donot go across the world wean.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Sikhs of the Guru, adopt teachings of the Guru, and joining the holy congregation attain that supreme Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਲਦੇ, ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬੰਦੇ ।੨੦।
0.e: Only rare ones behave in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru, the Gurmati.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜ ਦੁਇ ਝਾਗੜੂ; ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਚਉਤੈ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Truth and falsehood had a tiff and quarrelling they came to the dias of justice.

0.g: ਅਗੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਆਇ; ਆਪ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਝਗੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Dispenser of the true justice made them to debate their points there.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ; ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The wise mediators concluded that the truth is true and the falsehood Her.

0.g: ਸਚਿ ਜਿਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The truth triumphed and the falsehood lost and being labeled untrue, was paraded in the whole city.

0.g: ਸਚਿਆਰੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜਿਆਰੈ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The truthfull was applauded but the untrue incurred opprobrium.

0.g: ਸਚ ਲਹਣਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਣਾ; ਖਤੁ ਸਤਾਗਲੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: This was written on a piece of paper that the truth is creditory and the falsehood debtor.

0.g: ਆਪ ਠਗਾਇ ਨ ਠਗੀਐ; ਠਗਣਹਾਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਠਗਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He who allows himself to be cheated is never deceived and he who cheats others gets himself cheated.

0.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ, ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਣ ਆਇਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: Any rare one is a buyer of truth.

0.g: ਦਿਲਿ ਮਨ ਦਰ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕਿ ਯਾਰ ਬਿਸੋਖ਼ਤ ।
0.e: Like Goyaa, those with wounds of your love and captivated by your devotion,

0.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਹਿਰਿਆਣ ਨਿਗਾਰ ਬਿਸੋਖ਼ਤ ।੧੪।੧।
0.e: Always tune up their voices into melodies with your fragrance. (22) (8)

0.g: ਆਣ ਚੁਨਾਣ ਸੋਖ਼ਤਮ ਅਜ਼ਾਣ ਆਤਿਸ਼ ।
0.e: O Guru, my good friend! Radiance of your eyes cannot be matched by the light of the day.

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿ ਬਿਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਚੂੰ ਚਨਾਰ ਬਸੋਖ਼ਤ ।੧੪।੨।
0.e: Even the sun in the sky is no match to the refulgence of your face. (23) (1)

0.g: ਮਨ ਨ ਤਿਨਹਾ ਬਿਸੋਖ਼ਤਮ ਅਜ਼ ਇਸ਼ਕ ।
0.e: To capture the heart of the beloved hunter of the death,

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਆਲਮ ਅਜ਼ੀਣ ਸ਼ਰਾਰ ਬਿਸੋਖ਼ਤ ।੧੪।੩।
0.e: There is no better snare like the noose of your ravishing lock of hair. (23) (2)

0.g: ਸੋਖਤਮ ਦਰ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕਿ ਆਤਿਸ਼ਿ ਯਾਰ ।
0.e: This priceless life that we have been bestowed with should be considered as blessed,

0.g: ਹਮ ਚੁਨੀੰਣ ਕੀਮੀਆ ਬਕਾਰ ਬਿਸੋਖ਼ਤ ।੧੪।੪।
0.e: Because, we have not yet seen a morning (youth) that did not have an evening (old age). (23) (3)

0.g: ਆਫਰੀਣ ਬਾਦ ਬਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਗੋਯਾ ।
0.e: O Guru, heart of hearts! How long can I keep consoling my mind?

0.g: ਕਿ ਬ-ਉਮੀਦ ਰੂਇ ਯਾਰ ਬਿਸੋਖ਼ਤ ।੧੪।੫।
0.e:
The fact is that I do not get any succor or comfort without getting a glimpse of your handsome face." (23) (4)
The gem-showering eye, O Goyaa, has become deep as an ocean,
The mind is not consoled without your comforting glimpse. (23) (5)
O Guru! Until your life-extending red lips do not utter some expression,
The cure for our pains and agonies cannot be produced." (24) (1)

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਪਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੈ; ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ।
0.e: Having been born in this world, the gurmukh becoming innocent and ignorant ducts himself in the fear of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ।
0.e: Adopting the teaching of the Guru becomes the Sikh of the Guru and sustaining himself in the loving devotion, e leads a pure and intelligent life.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੈ ਸਮਝਿ; ਮਾਣਿ ਮਹਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: After listening to and understanding it, e accepts the teachings of the Guru and even earning the glories continues be humble.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਪੂਜਦਾ; ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ ।
0.e: In accordance with the teachings of the Guru, he worships the e Sikhs and touching their feet and, following their virtus path, he becomes avourite of all.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Guru's instruction is never forgotten by the Sikh and he having learnt the way of considering himself as a passing guest, spends his life (purposefully) here.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ; ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The Sikh of the Guru speaks sweetly and accept humility as the proper way of life.

0.g: ਘਾਲਿ ਖਾਇ, ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿ ਖਾਣਾ ।੧।
0.e: The Gurmukh, guru-oriented person earns is livelihood by hard labour and shares his victuals with other Sikhs of the um.

0.g: ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਲੀ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਸਾਖਾ; ਰਚਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The vegetation is seen in many forms like trees, creepers, fruit, flowers, roots and branches. This beautiful creation of the Lord unfolds itself in many forms of wonderful artistic skills.

0.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫਲ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ; ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫੂਲ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: These trees and creepers bear fruits of different tastes and flavour, flowers of myriad shape and colour. All of them spread various types of fragrance.

0.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਮੂਲ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਾਖਾ; ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਗਨ ਅਚਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The trunks of the trees and creepers, their branches and leaves are of many kind and each leaves a different effect.

0.g: ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜੈਸੇ; ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ।੪੯।
0.e: As the latent fire in all these types of vegetation is the same, so do the God-loving persons find One Lord dwelling in the hearts of all the living beings in this world. (49)

0.g: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਬਲ; ਤੈ ਜੁ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਕੀਏ ਕਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: O friend! that Transcendent one who cannot be deceived by anyone. He is unbreakable who with His power has subdued the whole world, With what elixir have you been able to enamor Him?

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਧ︀ਯਾਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਤੇਰੋ ਧ︀ਯਾਨ ਧਾਰੈ ਆਲੀ ਕਵਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: O friend! He who has not even been realised by Sanak, Sananadan and those who have contemplated on Brahma, what embellishments and adornments have attracted Him to you?

0.g: ਨਿਗਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੇਖ ਜੰਪਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ; ਤੇਰੋ ਜਸ ਗਾਵਤ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: O friend! the Lord whose praise is being said in different words by Vedas and Sheshnag, what merits have made Him sing your praise?

0.g: ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਜਾਹਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਨ ਖੋਜ ਪਾਵੈ; ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਪਿਆਰ ਕੈ ।੬੪੭।
0.e: God who has not been realised by gods, man and Naths who have laboured untiringly, what type of love has made Him search you?  (647)

0.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਿਮਾਂਡ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜਾਸੁ; ਮਾਨਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Supreme Lord, whose each hair support millions of cosmos has incarnated as Satguru in human form.

0.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ; ਸ੍ਰੀਮੁਖ ਸਬਦ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨੁ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Omniprotector Lord who has many forms, appearing as Guru has given sermon to his disciples in person.

0.g: ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਜਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ; ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਲਡਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The God for whose propitiation yags are performed, food and offerings are made, the same Lord takes the form of Guru now coddling his Sikhs by distributing food and to his disciples.

0.g: ਨਿਗਮ ਸੇਖਾਦਿ ਕਬਤ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਰਿ; ਪੂਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ।੩੫।
0.e: The supreme Creator, whom Shesh Nag and others have calling by innumerable names, now manifests as Guru showing Himself to His devotees (The Sikhs). (35)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੂਛੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਮਝਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a blind person asks another blind person about the features and beauty of a person, how can he tell him, when he cannot see anything?

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਪੂਛੈ ਬਹਰੋ ਜਉ ਬਹਰਾ ਪੈ; ਸਮਝੈ ਨ ਆਪ ਤਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਮਝਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a deaf wishes to know about the tune and rhythm of a song from another person who is also deaf, then what can one who himself is deaf explain to the other deaf?

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਪਹਿ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪੂਛੇ ਚਾਹੇ; ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਵਈ ।
0.e: If a dumb wants to learn something from another dumb, what can anyone who himself is unable to speak, explain to the other dumb?

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਜੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਅਨਿਥਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤ ਆਨ ਪੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ।੪੭੪।
0.e: Similarly it is foolishness to seek spiritual knowledge from other gods and goddesses leaving the True Guru who is perfect manifestation of the Lord. No one else can impart this wisdom or knowledge.  (474)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ; ਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਵਣਾ ।
0.e: In the congregation of the Sikhs of the Guru, the people of all the varnas assemble.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੁ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: The way of the gurmukhs is difficult and its mystery cannot be understood.

0.g: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਇਖ; ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Even the sweet juice of sugarcane cannot be compared with the delight of kirtan, the melodious recitation of hymns.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਭਿਖ; ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਪਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Here, the seeker gets all the four ideals of life i.e., dharma, arth, kam and moks.

0.g: ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਲਿਖ; ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Those who have cultivated the Word, have merged in the Lord and have liberated themselves from all the accounts.

0.g: ਸੁਝਨਿ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ; ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਾ ।੨।
0.e: They see through all the ages and yet do not put themselves above others.

0.g: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਹੁ; ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੇ ।
0.e: Fire lits the lamp and light scatters in the darkness.

0.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਵਿਚਹੁੰ ਮਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਕੰਮ ਆਇ ਲਿਖੇਰੇ ।
0.e: The ink obtained from the lamp is used by the writer.

0.g: ਕਜਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਸੰਗਿ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ ।
0.e: From that lamp women get collyrium. Therefore by living in the company of good persons one engages himself in good deeds.

0.g: ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖੈ; ਦਫਤਰ ਅਗਲੇਰੇ ।
0.e: With the same ink are written eulogies of the Lord and the clerk writes accounts in his office.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਫੇਰੇ ।੮।
0.e: Only gurmukh realises this fact, that the Lord pervades all around.

0.g: ਰਬੂਦ ਮਕਦਮਿ ਵਸਲਸ਼ ਜ਼ਿ ਮਨ ਇਨਾਨਿ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕ ।
0.e: Even though he, being a lowly person, becomes wise and sagacious. (183)

0.g: ਦਿਹੇਮ ਤਾ ਬਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਰਹਾ ਦਾਸਤਾਨਿ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕ ।੪੯।੧।
0.e: When the enthusiasm of devotion for God becomes your supporter,

0.g: ਨ ਬੂਦ ਗ਼ੈਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਰ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਚਸ਼ਮੇ ਅਬਰੂਏਮ ।
0.e: Then even a particle of dust desires to emulate (and becomes) a bright sun. (184)

0.g: ਨ ਯਾਫ਼ਤੇਮ ਦਰਾਣ ਜਾ ਦਿਗਰ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਿ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕ ।੪੯।੨।
0.e: When they talk, they shower (words of) the nectar of Truth,

0.g: ਹਨੂਜ਼ ਹਿਜਰ ਨਿਆਲੂਦਾ ਬੂਦ ਵਸਲਿ ਤੁਰਾ ।
0.e: With their glimpse, the eyes become more bright and soothed. (185)

0.g: ਸ਼ਨੀਦਾਇਮ ਸੁਖ਼ਨਿ ਵਸਲ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ਬਾਨਿ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕ ।੪੯।੩।
0.e: They keep meditating on the Naam of Waaheguru day and night;

0.g: ਚੁਨਾਣ ਜ਼ਿ ਹਿਜਰਤ ਆਤਿਸ਼ ਫ਼ਿਤਾਦਾ ਦਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਨ ।
0.e: Even in the worldly guise, living in this world, they become perfect human beings. (186)

0.g: ਕਿ ਬਰਕਿ ਨਾਲਾਇ ਮਨ ਸੋਖ਼ਤ ਖ਼ਾਨਿਮਾਨਿ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕ ।੪੯।੪।
0.e: With everything around them, they are independent and are immune to the effects of these material distractions;

0.g: ਚਿ ਕਰਦਾ-ਸਤ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕਿ ਤੂ ਬਰ ਸਰਿ ਗੋਯਾ ।
0.e: They are always satisfied and pleased under the Will of Akaalpurakh. (187)

0.g: ਕਿ ਦਰ ਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ਨਿਆਇਦ ਮਰਾ ਬਿਆਨਿ ਫ਼ਿਰਾਕ ।੪੯।੫।
0.e: Even they are dressed in worldly clothes, their tradition and practice is religious.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
ਬਾਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਭਲੇ ਕੀ ।
ਸੋਰਠਾ ।
0.e: Sorath:

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸ ਓਨਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ।
0.e: My Supplication to Ad(i) Purakh (Primordial Lord), salutation the holy feet of the True Guru (who is the embodiment of the Lord)

0.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਾ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਸਿ ।੧।੧।
0.e: Like the moon, who though one, resides everywhere and in everyone and yet remains one.

0.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ।
0.e: Dohra:

0.g: ਓਨਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ।
0.e: Salutation in the holy feet of Satguru, the embodiment of glorious Waheguru who is the Primeval Lord.

0.g: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਸਿ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਾ ਪਰਵੇਸ ।੨।੧।
0.e: He is like the moon, Who though one is present everywhere and yet remains one.

0.g: ਛੰਦ ।
0.e: Channt:

0.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਾ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਸੇਸ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: Waheguru (Lord) who is all-pervading and whose extent cannot be defined even by Sheshnag (a mythological serpent with thousand heads),

0.g: ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਹਿ ਨੇਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਜਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Whose praises Ved, Bhats and aIl others have been singing since eons and yet say-not this, not even this.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਹੁਤੇ ਹੁਤ ਹੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਹੋਨਮ ।
0.e: Who was there in the beginning, in between era and will remain in future,

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸ ਚਰਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਨਮ ।੩।੧।
0.e: My supplication to Him through the holy feet of the True Guru in which He is totally effulgent. (1)

0.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਵਾਹੜੇ; ਗੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੰਗੋਦਕ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: Rivers and small streams joining Ganges become the sacred river (Ganges).

0.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: With the touch of the philosopher's stone (paras) all the mixed light metals are transformed into gold.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਕਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਗੋਈ ।
0.e: The vegetation whether fruit producing or fruitless becomes sandal by assimilating into it the fragrance of sandal.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ; ਸੁਝੈ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: In the six seasons and twelve months nothing except sun is there.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ; ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਭਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Four varnas, six Schools of philosophy and twelve sects of the yogis are there in this world.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਈ ।
0.e: But by treading the path of Gurmukhs all the dubieties of the above sects vanish.

0.g: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ, ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਓਈ ।੯।
0.e: They (Gurmukhs) now with stable mind adore the One (Lord).

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਰ ਸਚੁ; ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ ।
0.e: True is the Lord and True HisGurbani, the Celestial Word.

0.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ; ਸੁਖ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Infused in the True, celestial delight is gained.

0.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ।
0.e: They who endeavour for the True recognition, relish the bliss.

0.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੈ ਘਾਣੀ ।
0.e: The egocentric are condemned to the hell, and their bodies are crushed by the oil-press.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: The Gurmukh's birth brings contentment while the egotistic wander in duality.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੫।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਰਸਹੁਂ; ਕੰਚਨ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਹੋਰੀ ।
0.e: Gold is made by the (touch of the) philosopher's stone but gold itself cannot produce gold.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹੁਂ; ਓਦੂੰ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਰੋਰੀ ।
0.e: Sandal tree makes other tree fragrant but the latter cannot further make other trees fragrant.

0.g: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਬੀਜਿਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਫਲ ਭੋਰੀ ।
0.e: Sown seed sprouts only after it rains but adopting the teachings of the Guru, one attain fruit instantly.

0.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਦਿਹੁ ਆਥਵੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਧੁਰ ਧੋਰੀ ।
0.e: The sun sets at the fall of night but the perfect Guru is there all the time.

0.g: ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪਰਬਤ ਨਾ ਚੜ੍ਹੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਠ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਨ ਸਹੋਰੀ ।
0.e: As a ship cannot mount the mountain forcibly similarly, forced control over the senses is not liked by the true Guru.

0.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਨੋ ਭੁੰਚਾਲ ਡਰ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚੋਰੀ ।
0.e: The earth may be scared of a quake and it becomes restive in its place but the Gurmat, Guru's tenets are steadfast and unconcealed.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਬੋਰੀ ।੪।
0.e: The true Guru, in fact, is a bag full of jewels.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਫਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ; ਲਾਗਤ ਜਿਤੇਕੁ ਪਰਪਕ ਨ ਸਕਲ ਹੈ ।
0.e: All the flowers that blossom on a tree do not yield fruit. And whatever number of fruits appear, do not ripe to be eaten ultimately.

0.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮਤ ਜੀਅਤ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਤੇਤੇ; ਜੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ, ਤੇਤੇ ਕੁਲ ਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੈਂ ।
0.e: All sons born do not survive to live but all those who live do not bring name and fame to their family.

0.g: ਦਲ ਮਿਲ ਜਾਤ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੁਭਟ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਤੇ; ਜੇਤਕ ਸੁਭਟ ਜੂਝ ਮਰਤ ਨ ਥਲ ਹੈਂ ।
0.e: All those who join the army are not valiant soldiers. And those who are brave warriors do not die fighting in the battlefield.

0.g: ਆਰਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ; ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਅਚਲ ਹੈਂ ।੩੬੮।
0.e: A glass embedded in a finger ring cracks when brought near fire but a genuine stone is unaffected. Similarly like a genuine stone, everyone is known as a Sikh but a few emerge genuine when put through traits. (368)

0.g: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਹੋਈ ਉਡੀਣੀ ।
0.e: The earth is the most humble which eschewing ego is firm and steady.

0.g: ਧੀਰਜੁ, ਧਰਮੁ, ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ; ਪੈਰਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੀ ।
0.e: Deeply rooted in fortitude, dharma and contentment it remains tranquil under feet.

0.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਦੇ ਚਰਣ ਛੁਹਿ; ਆਢੀਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਖੀਣੀ ।
0.e: Touching the holy feet of the saints, it earlier being worth half a penny now becomes worth lacs.

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ; ਛਹਬਰ ਛਲਕ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੀਣੀ ।
0.e: In the rain of love the earth gets satiated with delight.

0.g: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਐ; ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਇ ਪਤੀਣੀ ।
0.e: Only the humble get adorned with glory and the earth, quaffing the cup of the love of the Lord gets satiated.

0.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਲੁਣੈ; ਸਭ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਣੀ ।
0.e: Amongst variegated flora, sweet and bitter tastes, and colours on earth, one reaps whatever one sows.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ, ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੈ ਮਸਕੀਣੀ ।੨।
0.e: Gurmukhs (in their humility like the earth) get fruit of delight.

0.g: ਹੇ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੰਥ ਦੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਜੀਓ ।
0.e: O Immortal Being, eternal helper of Thy Panth, benevolent Lord,

0.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਨਕਾਣਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿਆਂ ਗੁਰਧਾਮਾਂ ਦੇ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਥ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਖੁਲ੍ਹੇ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਦਾ ਦਾਨ ਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ ਜੀ ਨੂੰ ਬਖਸ਼ੋ ।
0.e: Bestow on the Khalsa the beneficence of unobstructed visit to the free management of Nankana Sahib and other shrines and places of the Guru from which the Panth have been separated.

0.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ, ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ; ਸੀਚਤ ਸਰਬ ਰਸ, ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Tongue that enjoys many forms of sweet and savoury foods, drinks and is relisher of all the tastes is called gustation. Eyes see good and bad, beautiful and ugly and is therefore known as vision power.

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ; ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਅਮਿਤ ਬਡਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Ears for their ability to hear all sorts of sounds, melodies etc. are called hearing power. With the use of all these faculties, one obtains knowledge of various things, focuses one's mind in meaningful thoughts and earns worldly respect.

0.g: ਸਕਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਅਉ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ; ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The skin brings awareness of things through touch. Enjoyment of music and songs, intellect, strength, speech and dependence on discrimination is the boon of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ; ਬੋਲਤ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ, ਸੁੰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ।੧੩।
0.e: But all these senses of knowledge are useful if a person obtains the boon of Guru's wisdom, dwells his mind in the name of the Immortal Lord and sings the sweet paeans of me Lord's name. Such tune and melody of His name is bestower of bliss and happiness.

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕਾਮ ਕਟਕ ਹੁਇ ਕਾਮਾਰਥੀ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੀ ਵੰਤ ਆਹਿ ਜੀ ।
0.e: If countless means of inciting lust in a consecrated and practitioner of meditation on Lord's name befall upon a Sikh of the Guru, he is also invaded by unlimited means that can put him in rage;

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਲੋਭੀ ਹੁਇ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੈ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ਜੀ ।
0.e: If he is visited by millions and millions of allurements of greed and attachments to entangle him;

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੁਇ; ਰੂਪ ਰਿਪ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਬਲ ਛਲ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Millions and millions of such temptations are visited upon him like enemies that would make him proud, enticing him with wealth, luxuries and physical power;

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੇ ਰੋਮਹਿ ਨ ਚਾਂਪ ਸਕੈ; ਜਾਂ ਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਜੀ ।੩੫੯।
0.e: These evil forces cannot even harm a hair of the body of these Sikhs of the Guru who are blessed with the weapons and armour of the knowledge and consecration of True Guru. (In other words, no amount of temptations and worldly allurements can influence th

0.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਖ, ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਅਨੰਤ; ਅਨਿਤ ਮਨੰਤਰ ਲਉ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ।
0.e: If every hair of the body is blessed with millions of mouths and each mouth has numerous tongues, even then the glorious state of the person who relishes Lord's name with them cannot be described over the eons.

0.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਭਾਰ ਡਾਰ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ; ਤੋਲੀਐ ਜਉ ਬਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਤੋਲ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ।
0.e: If we weigh the load of millions of universes with the spiritual bliss time and again, the great comfort and peace cannot be measured.

0.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਉ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ; ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਮੋਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: All the worldly treasures, seas full of pearls and numerous pleasures of heaven are virtually nothing compared to the glory and grandeur of reciting His name.

0.g: ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਗਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਭਉਨ ਮਨ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਈ ।੪੩੦।
0.e: The fortunate devout who is blessed with the consecration of Naam by the True Guru, how high a spiritual state can his mind get absorbed in? No one is capable of expressing and describing this condition.  (430)

0.g: ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਈਐ ।
0.e: The mind wanders like a bumble bee in all four directions. But by coming into the refuge of True Guru and by the blessings of Naam Simran, he merges into peace and comfort of equipoise.

0.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ; ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਤਸ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Once the calming, scented, delicate and very beautiful elixir-like holy dust of the feet of True Guru is received, the mind does not wander in any direction.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ; ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਰੁਨਝੁਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ।
0.e: On account of his association with the holy feet of the True Guru, by remaining in a state of divine will and tranquil state of meditation and ever enjoying a glimpse of the light effulgent, he remains engrossed in the melodious unstruck celestial music.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ; ਆਪਾ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਰਮਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ।੨੨੨।
0.e: Believe it! An obedient Sikh of the True Guru becomes aware of the One Lord who is beyond all limits. And thus he reaches the supreme spiritual state. (222)

0.g: ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਰਗਾਮੀ; ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਮੀਪ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰਤ ਅਭਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Once someone boards a ship, he is confident of sailing across the sea. But many unfortunates die even when the ship is near about.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧ ਸੋ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੋਹਿ; ਦੁਰੰਤਰ ਤਰ ਗੰਧ ਮਾਰੁਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Fragrance less trees acquire fragrance when they grow near Sandalwood trees. But those trees which are located far away do not receive fragrant breeze of Sandalwood as it cannot reach them.

0.g: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਾਰਿ ਗਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਹੋਤ; ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕ ਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: To enjoy the pleasure of nocturnal bed, a faithful wife clings to her husband. But one whose husband is away don't even feel like lighting a lamp in her home.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਪਲ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।੭੯।
0.e: Similarly a Guru-conscious, slave disciple who holds the True Guru close receives the celestial comfort by abiding by the counsel, sermon and loving by remembering His name every second that the clement True Guru has so kindly blessed him with. One who do

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਲਖ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ; ਉਕਤਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Plenty of practical arts, spiritual wisdom, wise sayings and skills are extent (upto day).

0.g: ਲਖ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਲਖ; ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ।
0.e: Lacs of powers, discretions, discourses and physical services are known.

0.g: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਖ; ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਘੜਾਈ ।
0.e: Plenty of cleverness, consciousness and knowledge of skills are available.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਹੰਸ; ਲਖ ਪਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।
0.e: Similarly knowledges, meditations, remembrances and eulogies are there in thousands.

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਣਾ; ਦਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Having all this and behaving in arrogant manner, one does not get place at the door of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ।੧੫।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of gurmukh's coming in the shelter of Guru is unapproachable.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ।
0.e: That sustainer Lord ought to be praised who has created the multicoloured creation.

0.g: ਰਾਜਿਕੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿਦਾ; ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਮੰਗੀ ।
0.e: He is bestower of livelihood to everyone and giver of charity unasked for.

0.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਚੰਗੀ ।
0.e: None resembles anyone and the jiva (creative) is good or bad according to the ratio of perplexity in him.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ ।
0.e: Being transcendent, He is detached from every thing and being perfect Brahm. He is always with everybody.

0.g: ਵਰਨਾਂ ਚਿਹਨਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ ।
0.e: He is beyond caste and symbols etc. but side by side He pervades one and all.

0.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ, ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਗੀ ।੧੦।
0.e: He is in air, water and fire i.e. He is the power of these elements.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਵਡੇ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।
0.e: How vast could He be said? The grandeur of the Great is great.

0.g: ਵਡੀ ਹੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖ ਸੁਣਾਈ ।
0.e: I relate what I have heard that He is said to be the greatest of the great.

0.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ।
0.e: Crores of universes reside in His trichome.

0.g: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਜਿਸੁ; ਤੋਲਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈ ।
0.e: None could be compared with Him Who created and spread everything with one bang.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: He is beyond all the statements of the Vedas and the Katebas. His ineffable story is beyond all descriptions.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ, ਕਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ।੨।
0.e: How could His unmanifest dynamism by seen and understood?

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ; ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸਾਹੈ ।
0.e: The love between the disciples and the Guru is the same as is there between a trader and a banker.

0.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਹੈ; ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੈ ।
0.e: The merchandise of the name of the Lord is available only at one ship (of the Guru) and the whole world purchases there-from only.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਵੇਚੈ ਕਉਡੀਆ; ਕੋ ਦਮ ਉਗਾਹੈ ।
0.e: Some of the worldly shopkeepers are selling trash whereas others are collecting money.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਰੁਪਯੇ ਵਿਕਣੈ; ਸੁਨਈਏ ਕੋ ਡਾਹੈ ।
0.e: Some are storing the gold coins after spending rupees;

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਰਤਨ ਵਣੰਜਦਾ; ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ ।
0.e: And there are some that are dealing in jewels of the eulogisation of the Lord.

0.g: ਵਣਜਿ ਸੁਪਤਾ ਸਾਹ ਨਾਲਿ; ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੈ ।੨੦।
0.e: Any rare honourable banker having full faith in the Lord maintains this trade.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਕਤ ਜੀ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਾਤੈ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਭਏ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Without tasting the elixir of Naam, an insipid tongue speaks much trash. On the contrary, by indulging in repeated utterance of His name, a devotee becomes sweet of tongue and pleasant of disposition.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੈ ਮਦੋਨ; ਅੰਤਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By drinking the elixir-like Naam, a devotee remains in a state of exhilaration. He starts seeing inward and depends not on anyone else.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ; ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The devoted traveller on the path of Naam stays in a state of equipoise and remains absorbed in the celestial melody of divine words music. He hears no other sound in his ears.

0.g: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਅਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ।੬੫।
0.e: And in this blissful state, he is free of body and still alive. He is free from all worldly things and is emancipated while still living. He becomes capable of knowing the happenings of the three worlds and of the three periods. (65)

0.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੀਚੁੰਗਲੀ; ਪੈਧੀ ਛਾਪਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।
0.e: The smallest finger is respected and adorned by making it wear the ring.

0.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਘਨਹਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਿਪ ਸਮਾਈ ।
0.e: The drop from the cloud is small but the same but getting into the mouth of shell becomes pearl.

0.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਬੂਟੀ ਕੇਸਰੈ; ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: The plant of saffron (Messua ferria) is small one but the same adorns the forehead in the form of consecratory mark.

0.g: ਲਹੁੜੀ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਥਰੀ; ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰਵਾਈ ।
0.e: The philosopher’s stone is small but transforms alloy of eighty metals into gold.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਣਿ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ; ਦੇਖੈ ਲੁਕਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਲੋਕ ਲੁਕਾਈ ।
0.e: In the head of small snake remains the jewel which people behold in wonder.

0.g: ਜਾਣਿ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪਾਰਿਅਹੁ; ਰਤੀ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਲਾਈ ।
0.e: From mercury is prepared elixir which is invaluable.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਈ ।੪।
0.e: Those who eschew ego never allow themselves to be noticed.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By engrossing the mind in the divine word, a Guru-conscious seeker is able to arrest his wandering mind. That stabilises his memory in the meditation of Naam raising him to a higher spiritual state.

0.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ; ਪਰਮੁਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The sea and the waves are one and the same. Similarly by becoming one with the Lord, the spiritual waves experienced are astonishing and gloriously unique. Guru-conscious people are only capable of understanding and experiencing the spiritual state.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਰਤਨ ਧਨ; ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Guru-conscious person obtains the invaluable jewel like treasure of Naam by the precepts of Guru. And once he obtains it, he remains engrossed in the practicing of Naam Simran.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ; ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸੋ ਏਕਾ ਮੇਕ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ।੬੧।
0.e: By the harmonious union of Guru and Sikh (disciple) the Sikh attaches his mind in the divine word that enables his self to become one with the Supreme soul. Thus he is able to recognise what he truly is. (61)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Ahalya was wife of Gautam. But when she set eyes Indhar, the king of gods, lust overpowered her.

0.g: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਲੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਪਛੋਤਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He entered their house, got curse of being with thousands of pudendums and repented.

0.g: ਸੁੰਞਾ ਹੋਆ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੁ; ਲੁਕਿਆ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The Indralok (abode of Indr) became desolate and getting ashamed of himself he hid in a pond.

0.g: ਸਹਸ ਭਗਹੁ ਲੋਇਣ ਸਹਸ; ਲੈਂਦੋਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਿਧਾਣਾ ।
0.e: On revocation of the curse when all those holes became eyes, only then he returned to his habitat.

0.g: ਸਤੀ ਸਤਹੁ ਟਲਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਹੋਇ; ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Ahalya who could not remain steadfast in her chastity became stone and remained lying on the river bank

0.g: ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਚਰਣਿ ਛੁਹੰਦਿਆ; ਚਲੀ ਸੁਰਗ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਣੇ ਬਿਬਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Touching the (holy) feet of Ram she was lifted to the heavens.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਲਿਆਈਅਹੁ; ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Because of His benevolence He is mother-like to the devotees and being forgiver of the sinners He is called redeemer of the fallen ones.

0.g: ਗੁਣ ਨੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ; ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Doing good is returned by good gestures always, but he who does good to the evil is known as virtuous.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ, ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ।੧੮।
0.e: How can I explain the greatness of that unmanifest (Lord).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ; ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By practicing the teachings of Guru with mind, words and action, the devoted Sikh in attendance keeps every limb of his body in the memory of blissful Omnipresent Lord all the time.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਮਦੋਨ; ਰਸਨਾ ਥਕਤ ਭਈ ਕਹਿਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He remains in a state of trance by drinking the loving elixir of Naam: He relishes not any other pleasure of life anymore.

0.g: ਜਗਮਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ; ਲੋਚਨ ਚਕਤ ਭਏ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The wonderful elixir that has caused him to live such a celestial state of trance is indescribable.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਲੈ ਬਿਲੈ ਬਿਲਾਏ ਹੈ ।੫੨।
0.e: The radiance of love for Naam Simran exists in him a strange form that surprises all the beholders. (52)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਦੋ; ਪਰਮਾਤਮੁ ਦੇਖੈ ।
0.e: He who beholds the true Guru has beholden the Lord.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣ ਹੋਇ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Putting his consciousness into the Word he concentrates upon his self.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ; ਹੋਇ ਚੰਦਨ ਭੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Enjoying the fragrance of the lotus feet of the Guru he transforms himself into sandal.

0.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ; ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Tasting the nectar of the lotus feet he goes into a special wondrous state (of super consciousness).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ; ਵਿਚਿ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Now in consonance with the Gurmat, the wisdom of the Guru, he stabilizing the mind goes beyond the boundaries of forms and figures.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਜਾਇ; ਹੋਇ ਅਲਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ ।੧੦।
0.e: Reaching the holy congregation, the abode of truth, he himself becomes like that imperceptible and ineffable Lord

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਜ; ਲੁਭਤ ਹੁਇ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਲਪਟਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The mind of a devoted Sikh is ever entangled in the sweet smelling dust of the lotus feet of the Lord like a bumble bee. (He is ever engrossed in practicing meditation on Lord's name).

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹੁਇ; ਅਤਿ ਉਨਮਤਿ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He is ever longing to relish the Naam-elixir day and night. In its bliss and ecstasy, he ignores all other worldly awarenesses, allurements and knowledge.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਨੇਹ ਗੇਹ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਰੂਪ; ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਬੂੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਸੀਪ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Such a devoted Sikh's mind then lovingly resides in the holy feet of the Lord. He is free of all body desires. Like the Swati drop of rain falling on an oyster, he also is enclosed in the box of Lord's holy feet.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਟਾਛ ਕਰਿ; ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਹੁਇ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਠਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।੪੨੯।
0.e: Engrossed in the refuge of ocean of peace-The True Guru, and by His grace, he too becomes an invaluable and an unique pearl like the pearl of the oyster.  (429)

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੈ; ਦਯਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇ ਅਰਥੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: How great are the truth, contentment, compassion, dharma, the meaning (of a concept) and its further elaboration?

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: How much is the expansion of lust, anger, greed and infatuation?

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Visitors are of many kind and how many are forms and their hues?

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਥਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: How great is the consciousness and how much is the extension of Word?

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: How many are the founts of flavor and what is the working of various fragrances?

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਦ ਨਾਦ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Nothing can be told about the edible delights and inedible.

0.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ।੩।
0.e: His expanse is infinite and beyond description.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ; ਭਿਦੈ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: True Guru has eternal form. His teachings are also for ever. He is never ridden with duality. He is free of the three traits of mammon (Tamas, Rajas and Saty).

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਨ ਸਰਬਮਈ; ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਕਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Complete God Lord who is one and yet present in everyone, who is friend of everyone, manifests His form in True Guru, (Satguru).

0.g: ਨਿਰਬੈਰ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਨਿਰਲੰਭ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚੀਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: God-like True Guru is free of all animosity. He is beyond the influence of maya (mammon). He requires nobody's support, nor takes anyone's refuge. He is formless, beyond the grip of five vices and is ever stable of mind.

0.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ; ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਨਿਰਭੇਦ ਅਛਲ ਅਜੀਤ ਹੈ ।੧੫੦।
0.e: God-like True Guru is free of dross. He cannot be evaluated. He is beyond the smudge of maya (mammon). He is free of all bodily needs like food and sleep etc; He has no attachment with anyone and is free of all differences. He tricks no one, nor can be tr

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਚਲ ਅਚਲ ਭਏ; ਮਹਾ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those frolicsome persons who toil on the name of the Lord with devotion and love become peaceful and tranquil. Those who are filled with dross become neat and clean.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੈ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਭਏ; ਕਾਲ ਸੈ ਅਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਅਮਰ ਪਦ ਦੀਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those who practiced the consecration of True Guru saved themselves from the repeated births in the life of various species and achieved immortality.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਨ; ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਨੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਚੀਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those who toil on the Naam Simran of the Lord with full devotion and love, become humble by renouncing ego and crossing all hurdles merge into Him.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨ ਭਏ; ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਕੈ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈ ।੨੪।
0.e: They are free from caste, creed, race and colour-based social inequalities and becoming fearless merge with the Fearless Lord. (24)

0.g: ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਪਨ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Creation of the wonderful play of the creator's creation is amazing and astonishing. He alone resides in all in several shapes and forms.

0.g: ਉਤ ਤੇ ਲਿਖਤ ਇਤ ਪਢਤ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ; ਇਤਹੂ ਤੇ ਲਿਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਤਰ ਪਠਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a letter is written by somebody who sends it to someone in another city, it is read there and after understanding it sends back a reply.

0.g: ਉਤ ਤੇ ਸਬਦ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਇਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਕੈ ਉਤ ਸਮਝਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a singer sings a song in a mode and tune that pleases someone who understands it and educate others about it.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਖ︀ਯ︀ਯਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ।੨੭੫।
0.e: Just as a jewel evaluator inspects a jewel, learns about its characteristics and educate others about it, so would a Guru oriented Sikh who has become one with True Guru by virtue of His teachings and words, he alone can brief and educate others about the

0.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਯੋ ਰੂਪ ਮੁਨਿਵਰ ਕੋ ॥
0.e: By the command of [A]kal Purakh [the Khalsa] took the form of the most exalted of sages, with matted hair from the top of its head to the smallest nail of its toe.

0.g: ਜਟਾ ਜੂਟ ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਕਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤ ਸੂਰ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਰੂਪ ਨਰਵਰ ਕੋ ॥
0.e: By keeping company with the divine it achieved true purity, acquiring the noblest of forms which is that of the truly devoted (bhagat rup).

0.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਪਦ ਦਾਤ ਧੁਰ ਪਾਯੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜ ਭੁੰਚਤ ਗਿਰਵਰ ਕੋ ॥
0.e: Dharam-raj bestowed on it the rank of ruler supreme, setting its place far above all that others can reach.

0.g: ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਯੰਤੰ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਰਪੁਰਿ ਕੋ ॥੩੬੬॥
0.e: From heaven he established its [paramount] rule, from the furthest shore to the uttermost limit. 366

0.g: ਪੰਥ ਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ ਭਯੋ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਿਆ ਕਰ ਉਦਤ ਭਏ ॥
0.e: By his command the Lord created that Panth which is the Khalsa.

0.g: ਮਿਟੀ ਦ੍ਵੈਤ ਸੁ ਜਗਤ ਉਪਾਧਿਨ ਅਸੁਰ ਮਲੇਛਨ ਮੂਲ ਗਏ ॥
0.e: The earth was cleansed of refuse, both demons and malechhs.

0.g: ਧਰਮ ਪੰਥ ਖ਼ਾਲਸ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਭਯੋ ਸਤ ਸ੍ਵਰੂਪ ਮੁਨ ਰੂਪ ਜਏ ॥
0.e: The sacred and pure Panth multiplied, walking in the way of truth and piety.

0.g: ਕਛ ਕੇਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੁਦਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਾ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਭਏ ॥੩੬੭॥
0.e: Kachh, kirpan, and kes — these three signs made followers of the Guru the servants [also] of God (ram das). 367

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ; ਕਰੁਨਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Focusing mind on the form of True Guru, one is enlightened with celestial vision of knowledge. By the grace of True Guru, the human form acquires Godly refulgence making its coming to this world a success.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Concentrating the mind on the divine word, the rock strong doors of ignorance become ajar. The acquisition of knowledge then blesses one with the treasure of Lord's name.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ; ਹਸਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The touching and feeling of the dust of True Guru's feet enlivens the fragrance of Lord's name in the mind. Involving the hands in His prayer and service, one is blessed with true and real spiritual knowledge.

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਇ ਭਏ; ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: Thus every hair of a person becomes glorious and he merges with the light divine. All his vices and desires end and his mind dwells in the love of Lord's feet. (18)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਲਾਸ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਗਬੇਲ ਮੇਲ ਭਏ; ਪਹੁਚਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਪਤ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a meritless leaf of Butea frondosa when enjoins a betel leaf can reach the hands of the king and this is known the world over.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਨੀਲ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਿਖੈ; ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as blue colour is regarded dirty amongst all the colours, but a dress of that colour when enjoins a diamond is considered flawless and unadulterated.

0.g: ਸਾਲਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਮੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਖ; ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a conch is high by impious, being the skeleton of a sea worm, but its sounding at the time of worship of idols, distribution of consecrated offerings and holding of yoga is considered supreme and sacred.

Goyaa says, "Kindly come out of the clouds and show me Your full-moon-like face. (5)
This body of yours is like a cloud under which is hidden the Sun (God),
Remember to engage yourself in the divine devotion because this is the only purpose (fruit) of this life. (6)
Whosoever has become cognizant of the mysteries of Waaheguru,
He has no other purpose except to remember Him every moment of his life. (7)
What is the truth?  It is the memory of the Almighty that is the stark truth;
In fact, how can a fistful of dirt or dust, the human body, appreciate His real value? (8)
If you have the good fortune to have the company and association of the noble persons,
Then my friend! You would have attained eternal wealth. (9)
This (God given) wealth is meant to be used in the service of  His creations, the people;
Every beggar and emperor is willing to sacrifice himself for it, the true wealth. (10)
O brother! You should acquire the traits of those who constantly remember  the Beneficent;
And, you should circle around the (street) locality they reside in again and again (so that you may get an opportunity to be blessed with their company.) (11)
If anyone keeps going around the streets of these noble souls,
He would have attained the light and radiance of the sun and the moon in both the worlds. (12)
(We must realize) that meditation is an eternal treasure;
Therefore, we should engage ourselves in meditation, worship and prayers before the Almighty. (13)
The entire kingdom (of the world) is encompassed in the remembrance of (the Naam of) Waaheguru;
And, it is only His realm extending from the moon to the sun. (14)
Anyone who is oblivious and unmindful of (the existence of) Akaalpurakh, consider him as an idiot;
No matter whether he is a beggar or the emperor king. (15)
The love of God is the loftiest of all the traits for us,
And His shadow (on our heads) is like a tiara on our heads. (16)
Devotion for Akaalpurakh is considered as Aremembrance of Him",

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਬਿਸਵਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਹੰਸਾਵਈ ।
0.e: For the acquisition of Naam-like elixir from the True Guru if a disciple does not meet the True Guru with complete faith like the rain-bird yearning for the Swati drop, then he has no faith for the True Guru in his mind nor can he be His devoted follower.

0.g: ਸਤਿਰੂਪ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਸਿਖ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ।੫੫੧।
0.e: A devoted disciple of the True Guru engrosses his mind in the divine word, practices it and swims in the loving lap of the True Guru as a fish swims in water merrily and contented.  (551)

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Listening to the teachings of the Guru, the Sikh becomes wise internally though apparently he looks a simpleton.

0.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਹੋਇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He with full care keeps his consciousness attuned to the Word and listens to nothing except the words of Guru.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਖੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He beholds the true Guru and without the company of the saints feels himself blind and deaf.

0.g: ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ; ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਚੁਪਿ ਚਬੋਲਾ ।
0.e: The Guru's word he receives is Vahiguru, the wondrous Lord, and remains silently immersed in delight.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ; ਚਰਣਿ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਝੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He bows on the feet and becoming (humble) like dust goes on quaffing the nectar of the feet (of the Lord).

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ ।
0.e: He remains involved like black bee in the lotus feet (of the Guru) and thus living in this world ocean remains unsmeared (by its water and dust).

0.g: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਸਚਾਵਾ ਚੋਲਾ ।੧੭।
0.e: His is life of a liberated one during the life on earth i.e. he is a jivanmukt'.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜਾਣੋਈ ।
0.e: The glimpse of the Guru is the basis of meditation because Guru is Brahm and this fact is known to a rare one.

0.g: ਪੂਜ ਮੂਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣ; ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: The feet of true Guru, the root of all delights, should be worshipped and only then the delight would be atttained.

0.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਚਨ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਰਾਧੈ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: The instructions of the true Guru is the basic formula (mantra) whose adoration with single minded devotion is undertaken by rare one.

0.g: ਮੋਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ; ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: The basis of liberation is the grace of the Guru and one attains liberation in life in the holy congregation alone.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Making oneself noticed none can attain the Lord and even shedding the ego any rare one meets Him.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: He who annihilates his ego, in fact, is the Lord Himself; he knowns everyone as his form and all accept him as their form.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ, ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਈ ।੬।
0.e: This way that individual in the form of Guru becomes disciple and the disciple is turned to be Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦ, ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Lacs of spiritualists and their disciples assemble.

0.g: ਸੁਹਦੇ ਲਖ ਸਹੀਦ, ਜਾਰਤ ਲਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Myriads of beggers ave pilgrimages at the martyries.

0.g: ਲਖ ਰੋਜੇ ਲਖ ਈਦ, ਨਿਵਾਜ ਕਰਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions of people observe fasts (roza) and offer namaz (prayer) of id.

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਫਤ ਸੁਨੀਦ, ਮਨ ਪਰਚਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Many entice their minds by being busy in questioning and answering.

0.g: ਹੁਜਰੇ ਕੁਲਫ ਕਲੀਦ, ਜੁਹਦ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Many are engaged in preparing the key of evotion for opening the lock of mind's temple.

0.g: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਹੀ ।੧੩।
0.e: But those Who by becoming dervish at the door of Lord have become acceptable, never show their individuality.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ; ਸੁਤਰ ਮੁਰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੰਮ ਨ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: The evil person who is double-talker is always unhappy and is useless like an ostrich.

0.g: ਉਡਣਿ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਲਦੀਐ; ਪੁਰਸੁਸ ਹੋਈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ।
0.e: An ostrich can neither fly nor can be laden, but it strutts ostentatiously.

0.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਦੰਦ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਹੋਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਖਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The elephant has one set of teeth for display and another for eating.

0.g: ਬਕਰੀਆਂ ਨੋ ਚਾਰ ਥਣੁ; ਦੁਇ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਵੈ ਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Goats have four teats, two on their necks and two attached to their udders.

0.g: ਇਕਨੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਵਦਾ; ਇਕ ਠਗਾਊ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The latter contain milk, the former deceive those who expect milk from them.

0.g: ਮੋਰਾਂ ਅਖੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ; ਉਇ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਓਨੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: Peacocks have four eyes through which they behold but others know nothing about them.

0.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ, ਕੁਦਾਉ ਹਰਾਵੈ ।੧੨।
0.e: So turning one's attention to two masters (religions) leads to disastrous failure.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਲਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਦਾਤਾਰ, ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਦੇਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions are the generous persons who beg and bestow upon others.

0.g: ਅਉਤਰਿ ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ, ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions are incarnations (of gods) who having born have performed many acts

0.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ, ਖੇਵਟ ਖੇਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Many boatmen have rowed but none could know the extent and end of the world ocean.

0.g: ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਭੇਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ।
0.e: The thinkers also could know nothing about His mystery.

0.g: ਕਰਤੂਤੀ ਆਚਾਰਿ, ਕਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਵਹੀ ।
0.e: The thinkers also could know nothing about His mystery.

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਜੇਵਣਹਾਰ, ਜੇਵਣ ਜੇਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions are eating and feeding others and

0.g: ਲਖ ਦਰਗਹ ਦਰਬਾਰ, ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹੀ ।੧੦।
0.e: Millions are there who are serving the transcendental Lord and also in the courts of worldly kings.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠ ਕਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੇ ਸਰੁ ਨ੍ਹਾਵੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The gurmukh getting up in arobrosial hours of the early morning takes bath in the sacred tank.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਕੈ ਬਚਨ ਉਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Reciting the holy hymns of the Guru, he moves towards gurudvara, the central place for Sikh.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਣੰਦਾ ।
0.e: There, joining the holy congregation,he lovingly listens to Gurbant, the holy hymns of the Guru.

0.g: ਸੰਕਾ ਮਨਹੁਂ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Effacing all doubt from his mind he serves the Sikhs of the Guru.

0.g: ਕਿਰਤ ਵਿਰਤ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੀ; ਲੈ ਪਰਸਾਦ ਆਣਿ ਵਰਤੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Then by righteous means he earns his livelihood and he distributes the hard-earned meal among the needy ones.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ; ਪਿਛੋਂ ਬਚਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਖਵੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Offering first, to the Sikhs of Guru, the remainder he himself eats.

0.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: In this dark age, illumined by such feelings, the disciple becomes Guru and the Guru disciple.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ, ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ ।੧੧।
0.e: The gurmukhs tread on such a highway (of religious life).

0.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮ ਲੋਸਟ ਕਨਿਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: For a devoted Sikh of the Guru, a lump of earth and gold are equal in value. Thus, praise and slander for him are the same.

0.g: ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਰਿਦੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: For that devoted Sikh, both fragrance and foul smell means nothing. So he treats both friend and foe alike.

0.g: ਰਸਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਕਰ ਸਪਰਸ ਜਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: For him the taste of poison is not different from that of nectar. He feels the touch of water and fire alike.

0.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗੁ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀਐ ।੧੦੪।
0.e: He treats comforts and distresses alike. These two emotions do not influence him. By the benign and magnificence of a True Guru, who has blessed him with Naam, he achieves emancipation while living a house-holder's life. (104)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਉਪੰਨਾ ।
0.e: Nature of sugarcane is wondrous: it takes birth head down.

0.g: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਖਲ ਉਖਲਿ ਕੈ; ਟੋਟੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੰਨਣਿ ਭੰਨਾ ।
0.e: First its skin is eeled off and it is cut into pieces.

0.g: ਕੋਲੂ ਪਾਇ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ; ਰਸ ਟਟਰਿ ਕਸ ਇੰਨਣ ਵੰਨਾ ।
0.e: Then it is crushed in cane crusher; its nice is boiled in a cauldren and the bagasse is burnt as fuel.

0.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਖਾਏ ਅਵਟਣੁ ਜਗ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨਾ ।
0.e: It remains ontented in joys and sufferings alike and after getting boiled is called est in the world.

0.g: ਗੁੜੁ ਸਕਰੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਿਸਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਬੰਨਾ ।
0.e: Attaining the pleasure fruit, like gurmukh, it becomes he base of jaggery, sugar and crystal sugar.

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ; ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਥੀਵਣੁ ਗੰਨਾ ।
0.e: Death after quaffing the cup f love is similar to the life of sugarcane which after getting crushed becomes live.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲ, ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤੰਨਾ ।੧੨।
0.e: Sayings of gurmukhs are invaluable like jewels.

0.g: ਨੌਵੀਂ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹੀ ।
0.e: The Nineth Guru, Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji. The nineth Guru, Guru Teg Bahadur Ji, with a new agenda was the chief of the heads of protectors of the truth. He was the ornate of the honored and proud throne of the Lord of both the worlds. In spite of the fact that he was the master of divine power, he still would always acquiesce and bow before the will and command of Waaheguru and was the mysterious instrument for the godly glory and majestic grandeur. His personality was such that he had the capability of putting those who were his chaste and loyal followers to a severe test and to invigorate those devotees who follow an impartial methodology. The travelers on the grand divine path and the inhabitants of the next world were existent due to his personality that was totally dependent on truth and was a close companion of the highest spiritual power. He was the crown of the specialy selected devotees and the coronet of the proponents of God's adherents with truthful virtues. The blessed 'Tay' in his name was a believer in living under His will and command. The Farsi 'Yay' was the indicative of complete faith; the blessed Farsi 'Kaaf" ('Gaggaa') was representing his god-blessed personality as an embodiment of humility from head to his feet; The 'Bay' along with 'Hay' was the adornment of the social and cultural party in education and teaching. The truth-compiled 'Alif' was the embellishment of the truth; the infinitely formed 'Daal' in his name was the just and fair ruler of both the worlds. The last 'Ray' understood and appreciated the divine mysteries and was the rightful foundation of the highest truth.

0.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਗ਼ ਬਹਾਦਰ ਆਂ ਸਰਾਪਾ ਅਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲ ।
0.e: Guru Teg Bahadur was the storehouse of elevated moralities and virtues,

0.g: ਜ਼ੀਨਤ-ਆਰਾਇ ਮਹਿਫ਼ਲਿ ਜਾਹੋ ਜਲਾਲ ।੯੯।
0.e: And, he was instrumental to enhance the gaiety and pomp and show of the divine parties. (99)

0.g: ਅਨਵਾਰਿ ਹੱਕ ਅਜ਼ ਵਜੂਦਿ ਪਾਕਿਸ਼ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ।
0.e: The rays of truth derive their brightness from his sacred torso,

0.g: ਹਰ ਦੋ ਆਲਮ ਜ਼ਿ ਫ਼ੈਜ਼ਿ ਫ਼ਜ਼ਲਸ਼ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ।੧੦੦।
0.e: And, both the worlds are bright because of his grace and blessings. (100)

0.g: ਹੱਕ ਅਜ਼ ਹਮਾ ਬਰ-ਗ਼ੁਜ਼ੀਦਗਾਂ ਬਰਗੁਜ਼ੀਦਸ਼ ।
0.e: Akaalpurakh chose him fro among His selected elite,

0.g: ਤਸਲੀਮੋ ਰਿਜ਼ਾ ਰਾ ਨਿਕੋ ਸੰਜੀਦਸ਼ ।੧੦੧।
0.e: And, he considered accepting His will as the loftiest bevahior. (101)

0.g: ਬਰ ਹਰ ਮੁਕਬਲ ਕਬੂਲਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਅਰਜ਼ੂਦਸ਼ ।
0.e: His status and rank is far higher than those selected accepted ones,

0.g: ਮਸਜੂਦੁਲ ਆਲਮੀਂ ਜ਼ਿ ਫ਼ਜ਼ਲਿ ਖ਼ੁੱਦ ਫ਼ਰਮੂਦਸ਼ ।੧੦੨।
0.e: And, with His own benevolence, He made him worshippable in both the worlds. (102)

0.g: ਦਸਤਿ ਹਮਾ-ਗਾਂ ਬਜ਼ੈਲਿ ਅਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲਿ ਊ ।
0.e: Everyone's hand is trying to grab the corner of his beneficent robe,

0.g: ਬਰ ਸਰਿ ਅਨਵਾਰਿ ਇਲਮਿ ਹੱਕ ਕਾਲਿ ਊ ।੧੦੩।
0.e: And, his message of truth is far more elevated than the glow of divine enlightenment. (103)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਭਵਨ ਉਜੀਆਰੋ ਹੋਤ; ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਦਿਖਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a house is lit up when a lamp is lighted in it, it makes everything visible clearly;

0.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਬਾਛਤ ਸਿਧਿ; ਆਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ।
