0.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਉ, ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।੧।
0.e: As someone sows, so he reaps.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੩
ਮਿਹਰ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਆਸਕੀ; ਇਸਕੁ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Kindness, affection, passionate love and smell do not remain concealed even if they are hidden and of their own get manifested.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant and never makes it self noticed (but still people come to know that).

0.g: ਨਦੀਆਂ ਨਾਲੇ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ; ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Rivers and streams meet the Ganges and silently become pure without any announcement.

0.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ; ਅਣੀ ਕਣੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The diamond is cut by the diamond and the cutter diamond looks as if it has adopted the other diamond in its heart (likewise the Guru also cutting the mind of disciple gives place to him in his own heart).

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਇ; ਪਾਰਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The disciple of the Guru becomes such a sadhu in the holy congregation as if someone becomes philosopher's stone after touching the philosopher's stone.

0.g: ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: With the steadfast teaching of the Guru, the mind of the Sikh becomes peaceful and God also becoming affectionate towards the devotee gets deluded.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੨੩।੧੮। ਅਠਾਰਾਂ ।
0.e: Getting a sight of the imperceptible Lord is the pleasure-fruit for the gurmukhs.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰਿ; ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Narayan, the lord of the destitutes, assuming forms has established mastery over all.

0.g: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He is the formless king of all men and kings who created various forms.

0.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: As is creator of all the causes He is true to His reputation.

0.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ; ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Gods and goddesses also could not know the extent of that Lord, the imperceptible and beyond all mysteries.

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The ture Guru Nanak Dev inspired people to remember the true name of the Lord whose form is truth.

0.g: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਕਰਤਾਰਪੁਰੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Founding dharamsala, the place for dharma, at Kartarpur, it was inhabited by the holy congregartion as the abode

0.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ, ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।੧।
0.e: Word Wahiguru was imparted (by Guru Nanak) to the people.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖੁ ਹੈ; ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Away from attachment and jealousies he has adopted rajyoga (The supreme yoga).

0.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਵਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਣਾ; ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: None can know the mystery of his mind, speech and actions.

0.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੈਆ ਦਾਨਿ; ਦੇਵਸਥਲੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He is bestower ( unattached) enjoyer, and he has created holy congregation which is equal to the abode of gods.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He remains absorbed in innate poise; the master of unfathomable intellect, and being the true Guru he sets every one's disordered life in order.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਜੁਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: From the flame of Guru Amar Das the flame of Guru Ram Das has been lighted. I salute him.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Becoming disciple of Gum and merging consciousness into, word he has quaffed the eternally flowing current of the unstruck melody.

0.g: ਤਖਤੁ ਬਖਤੁ, ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ।੧੪।
0.e: Sitting on the throne of Guru, he has become manifest in the world

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਡਤ ਸੈ ਜੋਈ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ; ਬੂਡਿ ਗਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਪਛਤਾਇਓ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Blessed are those who are saved from a capsizing boat. If drowned, there would be nothing but repentance.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਆਗਿ ਜੋਈ ਬਚੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ; ਜਰਿ ਬੁਝੇ ਪਾਛੇ ਕਛੁ ਬਸੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: All those who escape from a burning house are blessed people. Nothing can be done if one is burnt into ashes.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੋਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਜੋਈ ਰਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ; ਸੋਇ ਗਏ ਰੀਤੋ ਘਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਉਠਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As one wakes up when the thief is committing theft, whatever is left behind by him is bonus and blessing. Otherwise one would find the house empty in the morning.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵੈ; ਪਾਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਾਤਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ।੬੯।
0.e: Similarly if a wayward person comes to the refuge of Guru even at the near end of his life, he can achieve a state of emancipation. Otherwise he would fall in the hands of angels of death and keep wailing. (69)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੭
ਮਛੀ ਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਵਾਂਗਿ; ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Gursikh is like the family of fish who whether dead or alive never forgets water.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਪਤੰਗ ਦਾ; ਦੀਪਕ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਹੋਰ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Similarly to the moth family nothing but the flame of lamp is visible.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਵਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ; ਭਵਰ ਕਵਲ ਕੁਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ।
0.e: As the water and the lotus love each other and the tales are told of the love between the black bee and the lotus;

0.g: ਬੂੰਦ ਬਬੀਹੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਨਾਦ; ਕੋਇਲ ਜਿਉ ਫਲ ਅੰਬਿ ਲੁਭਾਣੀ ।
0.e: As the rain bird with the rain-drop of svati nakstr, deer with music and the nightingale with mango fruit is attached;

0.g: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ; ਓਹੁ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਰਤਨਾ ਖਾਣੀ ।
0.e: For swans the Manasarovar is the mine of jewels;

0.g: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰੈ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Female reddy sheldrake loves sun; Indian red legged partidge' s love with moon is praised;

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਜਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Like wise, the Sikh of the Guru being the progeny of the swan of high order (paramhans) accepts the true Guru as the tank of equipoise

0.g: ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ।੨੭।
0.e: And like a waterfowl goes to face the world ocean ( and goes across unwet).

0.g: ਬਾਬੇ ਡਿਠੀ ਪਿਰਥਮੀ; ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡਿ ਜਿਥੈ ਤਕਿ ਆਹੀ ।
0.e: Baba Nanak visualized all the expansive nine divisions of the earth.

0.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਚੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਪਰਿ; ਸਿਧਿ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਹੀ ।
0.e: Then he climbed up to the Sumer mountain where he came across a group of siddhs.

0.g: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧਿ ਗੋਰਖਾਦਿ; ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਣਤੀ ਵਰਤਾਈ ।
0.e: The mind of the eighty four siddhs and Gorakh filled with surprise and doubts.

0.g: ਸਿਧਿ ਪੁਛਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਲਿਆ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਤੁਹਿ ਏਥੇ ਲਿਆਈ ।
0.e: Siddhas asked (Guru Nanak), (O young boy! Which power brought you here?)

0.g: ਹਉ ਜਪਿਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak replied that for coming to this place (I have remembered the Lord with loving devotion and meditated upon Him deeply.)

0.g: ਆਖਨਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਲਿਆ; ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ ।
0.e: Siddhs said, (O young man, tell us your name).

0.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਖੇ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Baba replied, (O respected Nath! This Nanak has attained this position through rememberance of the name of the Lord).

0.g: ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹਾਇ, ਊਚ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ।੨੮।
0.e: By calling himself lowly, one attains the high position.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਛਲਿ ਅਛਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Assuming the form of Vaman (short statured brahmin) and remaining unsuccessful in beguiling king Bali

0.g: ਕਰੌਂ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤਿ ਮੰਗਿ; ਪਿਛੋਂ ਦੇ ਵਡ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He Himself got beguiled. Having asked for two and a half steps of land, Vaman, afterwards enlarged His body.

0.g: ਦੁਇ ਕਰੁਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਿੰਨਿ ਲੋਅ; ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਗਰੁ ਮਿਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In two steps He measured all the three worlds and in a half step He measured the body of king Bali.

0.g: ਸੁਰਗਹੁ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ; ਰਾਜੁ ਪਤਾਲ ਲੋਕ ਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Accepting the kingdom of netherworld better than heavens Bali started ruling it.

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਦਰਵਾਨ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Now the Lord, in whom subsume Brahma, Visnu and Mahen, becoming lover of His devotees, served as a door keeper of king Bali

0.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਲਖ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਨਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਜ ਇਛ ਇਛਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Many sacred incarnations like Vaman also have the wish of having the dust of the feet of holy congregation.

0.g: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।੬।
0.e: They also contemplate the feet of the Guru in the company of holy ones.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਉਧਰੀ ਪੂਤਨਾ; ਵਿਹੁ ਪੀਆਲਣੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ ।
0.e: If even Pfitana (female demon) got liberated that does not mean that poisoning some one is a good act.

0.g: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਉਧਰੀ ਆਖੀਐ; ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲਈਐ ਪੰਗਾ ।
0.e: Gariika (a prostitute) was liberated but one should not enter other's house and invite trouble.

0.g: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ; ਮਾਰੈ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ।
0.e: Since Valmlici got blest, one should not adopt the way of highway robbery.

0.g: ਫੰਧਕਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਫਾਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਫੜੀਐ ਟੰਗਾ ।
0.e: One bird catcher is also said to be liberated, but we should not catch hold of the leg of others by using snares.

0.g: ਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਉਧਰਿਆ; ਜੀਆ ਘਾਇ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ਭੰਗਾ ।
0.e: If Sadhana, the butcher got across (the world ocean), we should not put ourselves to harm by killing others.

0.g: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ; ਸੁਇਨਾ ਲੋਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ।
0.e: Ship takes across both iron and gold but still their forms and colours are not the same.

0.g: ਇਤੁ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ, ਰਹਣੁ ਕੁਢੰਗਾ ।੯।
0.e: In fact, living on such hopes is a bad life style.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ; ਵੁਠੈ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾ ।
0.e: In the month of Savan, the whole forest becomes green but akk, a wild plant of sandy region ( Calatropis procera) and javah (a prickly plant used in medicine) go dry.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਬਬੀਹੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ; ਸਿਪ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਉਮਾਹਾ ।
0.e: Getting rain drops in the savanti nakstr (a special formation of stars in the sky) the rain bird (Paphia) gets satisfied and if the same drop falls in the mouth of a shell, it is transformed into a pearl.

0.g: ਕਦਲੀ ਵਣਹੁ ਕਪੂਰ ਹੋਇ; ਕਲਰਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਾਹਾ ।
0.e: In the banana fields, the same drop becomes camphor but on alkaline earth and lotus hat drop has no impact.

0.g: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਹੋਇ; ਧਾਤ ਸੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਦੁਰਾਹਾ ।
0.e: That drop, if it goes into the mouth of a snake, becomes deadly poison. Therefore, a thing given to a genuine and undeserving person has different effects.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਉਭੈ ਸਾਹਾ ।
0.e: Likewise, those who are engrossed in the worldly delusions do not get peace even though they listen to the word of the Guru in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਦਰਾਹੀ ਬਦਰਾਹਾ ।
0.e: The gurmukh attains the pleasure fruit of the love of the Lord, but manmukh, the mind orientated one, goes on following the evil path.

0.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਟੋਟਾ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਲਾਹਾ ।੪।
0.e: Manmukh always suffers loss whereas the Gurmukh earns profit.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਸਤਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਇਕੁ ਫੇੜੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Satyuga is said to be best but in it one committed sin and the whole country suffered.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ; ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਿਧੁੰਸੁ ਕੁਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: In treta, one did the wrong act and the whole city would suffer. In Duapar, sinful act of one person made the whole family suffer.

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ; ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ ।
0.e: The justice of Kaliyuga is true because in it only he reaps who sows the evil seeds.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Brahm is the perfect Sabdabrahm and that disciple who merges his consciousness in the Sabdabrahm is in fact Guru and the true Guru (God).

0.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Sabdabrahm, the Guru is attained in the holy congregation by remembering the name of the Lord in the ambrosial hours.

0.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ; ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: A mild spoken, humble and giver through his hands moves in equipoise and remains happy.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ, ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ।੧੬।
0.e: Ever new love of devotion to the Lord keeps the gurmukhs happy.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਵਣਖੰਡ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਉਜਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Being near the vegetation, it keeps its head down and remains engrossed in meditation.

0.g: ਪਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲਾਇ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਤਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Getting attached to the moving breeze it spreads the superfine fragrance.

0.g: ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਉਲਾਸ ਉਘਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Whether with fruit or without fruit, all the trees are made fragrant by sandal tree.

0.g: ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਸਮਦਰਸ ਹੋਇ; ਕਰੇ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾੜੀ ।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the company of holy persons, which purifies the impure ones even in one day (sitting).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹਾੜੀ ।
0.e: It fills the evil persons with virtues and in its fold the people of fragile character become strong and firm.

0.g: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ; ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਉਪਰਿ ਵਾੜੀ ।
0.e: Neither water can drown nor fire can burn such people i.e. they go across the World Ocean and the flames of desires cannot reach them.

0.g: ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਡੋਬੈ, ਅਗਿ ਨ ਸਾੜੀ ।੬।
0.e: Neither water can drown nor fire can burn such people i.e. they go across the World Ocean and the flames of desires cannot reach them.

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਉ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ; ਸਰਬ ਦਰਸ ਏਕ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: An obedient disciple of the Guru who has focused his vision in the glimpse of the True Guru, he observes the impermeable Lord everywhere and every place. He makes others see Him too. He regards and understands that all philosophies are present in His sigh

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੋਈ; ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦ ਏਕ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: When a Guru-oriented person acquires the teachings of the True Guru, his mind gets absorbed in the practicing of Lord's Naam Simran. He then speaks and hears the words of the True Guru deep in his soul. He regards all singing modes engrossed in the melody

0.g: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਤਗਿ ਸਰਬਗਿ ਸੋਈ; ਕਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਤੂਤਿ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: In this state of immersion in the elixir of Naam, a Guru oriented slave recognises the cause of all causes, the knower of all deeds and capable of knowing all; who is the doer of all the deeds-the Doer and Creator,

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੀਐ ।੩੦੧।
0.e: And thus a Guru-conscious person becomes aware of One God through the knowledge blessed by the True Guru and perpetual contemplation of Him, Such a person leans on none else for support except One All-pervading Lord, (301)

0.g: ਕੌਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਰੀਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਕਵਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਜਗ ਮੋਹਨ ਬਿਮੋਹੀਐ ।
0.e: Singing what virtues of the treasure-house of merits can we please Him? With what pleasant actions can we enamor the bewitcher of the world?

0.g: ਕੌਨ ਸੁਖ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਣ ਗਹੌਂ; ਭੂਖਨ ਕਵਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ।
0.e: What comfort can be offered to the sea of comforts that would provide us His refuge? With what embellishments can we captivate the mind of the Lord who fulfils all desires?

0.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੇ ਨਾਯਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਯਕਾ ਹ੍ਵੈ; ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤ੍ਰਜਾਮੀ ਕੌਨ ਉਕਤ ਕੈ ਬੋਹੀਐ ।
0.e: How can one become the wife of the Lord-Master of millions of Universes? With what means and methods can the knower of inner things be apprised of the anguish of the mind?

0.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਬਸੁ; ਕੈਸੇ ਬਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਗ ਸੋਹੀਐ ।੬੦੨।
0.e: The Lord who has the mind, body, wealth and the world in His control, involvement in whose praise one becomes adorable; how can such a Lord be brought in one's favour?  (602)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਸਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs accept the will of that Lord as truth and they love His will.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Bowing at the feet of the true Guru, they shed their sense of ego.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਚਾਇ, ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਾ ।
0.e: As disciples, they please the Guru and the heart of the Gum becomes happy.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ, ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: The gurmukh realises the imperceptible Lord spontaneously.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਿਲ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ, ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: The Sikh of Guru has no greed at all and he earns his livelihood by the labour of his hands.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ, ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Merging his consciousness into the word he obeys the commands of the Lord.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲੰਘਾਇ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ।
0.e: Crossing beyond the worldly illusions he abides in his own real self.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ।੧੧।
0.e: This way, the gurmukhs having attained the pleasure fruit absorb themselves in equipoise.

0.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ; ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Guru's word is the air, the Guru and wondrous lord has recited Word the Guru.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਨਿਵਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The father of man is water which by flowing downwards teaches humility.

0.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਤ ਮਹਤੁ ਕਰਿ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The earth being tolerant like mother is the mother and is the further base of all the creatures.

0.g: ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ; ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜਗਤ੍ਰੁ ਖਿਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The day and night are the nurses who keep the people of child-wisdom busy in the plays of the world.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The life of Gurmukh is meaningful because he in the holy congregation has lost his egotism.

0.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He becoming liberated in life behaves in the 'world with the skill to come out of the cycle of transrnigration.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ; ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ, ਮੋਖ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The mother of the gurmukhs is the wisdom of the Guru and father, the contentment through whom they attain deliverance.

0.g: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਭਿਰਾਵ ਦੁਇ; ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਪੁਤ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Forbearance and the sense of duty are their brothers, and meditation, austetities, continence the sons.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ, ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ; ਪੁਰਖਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Guru and the disciple are diffused into one another in equanirnity and they both are the extension of the perfect supreme Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੫।
0.e: Raving realized the supreme pleasure they have made others also realize the same.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩੦
ਬੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ; ਮੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਡਿਠੇ ।
0.e: Seeing the face of an apostate like me, the apostates beome more deep -rooted apostates.

0.g: ਬਜਰ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਬਜਰ ਪਾਪ; ਮੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਇਠੇ ।
0.e: The worst sins have become my beloved ideals.

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਠਾਂ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ; ਆਪਹੁਂ ਬੁਰੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਸਿਠੇ ।
0.e: Considering them apostates I taunted them (though I am worse than them).

0.g: ਲਿਖ ਨ ਸਕਨਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤਿ; ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਮਾਵਨਿ ਚਿਠੇ ।
0.e: The story of my sins cannot be written even by Yama's scribes because the record of my sins would fill the seven seas.

0.g: ਚਿਠੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੁਮਾਰ ਲਿਖਿ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਇਕ ਦੂੰ ਇਕ ਦੁਧਿਠੇ ।
0.e: My stories would get multiplied further into lacs each one doubly shameful than the other.

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਗ ਹੁਰੇਹਿਆਂ; ਹੁਇ ਮਸਕਰਾ ਸਭਾ ਸਭਿ ਠਿਠੇ ।
0.e: So much I have mimed others so often that all buffoons feel ashamed before me.

0.g: ਮੈਥਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ, ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਰਿਠੇ ।੩੦।
0.e: None is worse than me in the whole creation.

0.g: ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ਘਰ; ਬਿਛਰੈ ਤੁਰਤ ਬਟਵਾਰੋ ਮਾਰ ਡਾਰ ਹੈਂ ।
0.e: Just as a man travelling in the company of others reaches home safely but one who gets separated, is robbed by dacoits and killed.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਰ ਦੀਏ ਖੇਤ ਛੁਵਤ ਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਰ; ਛੇਡੀ ਭਏ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਖੇਤਹਿ ਉਜਾਰ ਹੈਂ ।
0.e: Just as a fenced field cannot be touched by humans and animals but an unfenced field is destroyed by passers-by and animals.

0.g: ਪਿੰਜਰਾ ਮੈ ਸੂਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੇਤ ਹੇਤੁ; ਨਿਕਸਤਿ ਖਿਨ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a parrot shouts Ram Ram when in a cage but as soon as it gets out of cage, it is pounced upon by a cat and is eaten away.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ; ਬਿਚਰਤ ਪੰਚੋ ਦੂਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਰਿਹਾਰ ਹੈਂ ।੫੮੨।
0.e: Similarly, the mind of a human being acquires higher spiritual state when it unites with God-like True Guru. But when separated from the True Guru, it wanders about and is destroyed (spiritually) by the five vices-lust, anger, avarice, attachment and prid

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ।
0.e: The gurmukhs subdue the four life-mines (egg, foetus, sweat, vegetation) and the four speeches (para, posyanti, madhyama, vaikhari~.

0.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Four are directions, four the yugas (ages), four varnas and four are the Vedas.

0.g: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਮੋਖੁ ਜਿਣਿ; ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Conquering dharma, artha, kama, moksa and crossing three stagges of rajas, sattva and tamas they enter into the fourth stage turiya, the stage of supreme bliss.

0.g: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਉਲੰਘਿ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵੀਰ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਣੀ ।
0.e: They control Sanak, Sanandan Sanatan, Sanatkumar, the four ashramas and the four warriors (in the field of charity, dharma, compassion and warfare).

0.g: ਚਉਪੜਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਉਸਾਰ ਮਾਰਿ; ਜੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਰਞਾਣੀ ।
0.e: As in chaupar (a game like blackgamman played with an oblong dice) one is victorious by winning all the four sides, and a twosome is not killed,

0.g: ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਇਕੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ।
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ, ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ।੪।
0.e: So the gurmukh also makes pair with the One Lord and becomes undefeatable.

0.g: ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The Oankar Lord, with one resonance created the forms.

0.g: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ; ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸੁ ਧਰੇ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Air, water, fire, sky and earth He sustained (in his order) without any support.

0.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਅਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Millions of universe exist in his each trichome.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He the transcendental Brahm is the complete (within and without), inaccessible, imperceptible incomprehensible and infinite.

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He remains in the control of loving devotion and by becoming kind to the devotees, He creates.

0.g: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੂਖਮੋ; ਤਿਦੂੰ ਹੋਇ ਵਡ ਬਿਰਖ ਵਿਥਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He is the subtle seed that takes form of the large tree of creation.

0.g: ਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੀਉ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ; ਇਕ ਦੂੰ ਬੀਅਹੁ ਲਖ ਹਜਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The fruits contain seeds and then from one seed millions of fruits are created.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: The sweet fruit of Gurmukhs is the love of Lord and the Sikhs of Guru love the true Guru.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In the holy congregation, the abode of truth, the supreme formless Lord resides.

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ।੪।
0.e: The Gurmukhs get liberated through loving devotion.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a faithful wife does not like to look at another man and being sincere and faithful always supports her husband in her mind.

0.g: ਸਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਾਹੂ; ਆਸ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗੁਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a rain-bird does not want water from a lake river or sea, but keeps on wailing for Swati drop from the clouds.

0.e: Pehlee Paatshaahee (Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji). The first Sikh Guru, Guru Nanak Dev Ji, was the one who glistened the true and all-powerful refulgence of the Almighty and to highlight the significance of knowledge of complete faith in Him. He was the one who elevated the flag of eternal spirituality and eliminated the darkness of ignorance of divine enlightenment and who took upon his own shoulders the responsibility of propagating the message of Akaalpurakh. Beginning from the earliest time to the present world, everyone considers himself to be the dust at his door; The highest-ranked, the Lord, Himself sings his praises; and his disciple-student is the divine lineage of Waaheguru Himself. Every fourth and sixth angel is unable to describe Guru's eclat in their expressions; and his radiance filled flag is flying over both the worlds. Examples of his command are the brilliant rays emanating from the Provident and when compared to him, millions of suns and moons get drowned in the oceans of darkness. His words, messages and orders are the supreme for the people of the world and his recommendations rank absolutely first in both the worlds. His true titles are the guide for both the worlds; and his true disposition is the compassion for the sinful. The gods in the court of Waaheguru consider it a privilege to kiss the dust of his lotus feet and the angles of the higher court are slaves and servitors of this mentor. Both the N's in his name depict nurturer, nourisher ans neighborly (boons, support and benefactions); the middle A represents the Akaalpurakh, and the last K represents the Ultimate great prophet. His mendicancy raises the bar of detachment from the worldly distractions to the highest level and his generosity and benevolence prevails all over both the worlds.

0.g: ਬਲ ਛਲਿਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਾਲਦਾ; ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਸਿਧਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Though duped (by Visnu), King Bali observed truth and went to the netherworld.

0.g: ਕਰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਿ; ਅੰਤੁ ਪਛੋਤਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Karn would also give gold in charity but he had to repent ultimately (because god Indr demanded his armour ana earrings of him which he readily gave and lost his powers).

0.g: ਸਤਿਵਾਦੀ ਹੁਇ ਧਰਮਪੁਤੁ; ਕੂੜ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The truthful Yudhisthar, son of Yama, for his one lie had to go to hell.

0.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Many celebates, truthful and contented people have flourished but they all were proud of their conduct.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ।੮।
0.e: Such a humble one is the Sikh of the Guru that all these are not equal to his one trichome.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੇਖੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: An obedient Sikh of the Guru sees the Lord pervading everywhere. By his utterances and expressions, he shows His presence to others as well.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕੈ; ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Guru's obedient slave hears the melodious sound of the complete God with his own ears by his very sweetly spoken words. He makes supplications which have marvellous sweetness in them.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ; ਪ੍ਰੇਸ ਰਸ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗਮਾਗਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Guru-conscious person always relishes the elixir of Lord's name even if he is lured by the combined attractions of his sense of smell and taste. The wondrous elixir obtained as a result of his love for the Lord is far more fragrant than the Sandalwood.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ।੧੫੨।
0.e: Guru-oriented person considers the True Guru as a form of all-pervading Lord God. He makes his salutations and supplications to him again and again. (152)

0.g: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਅਧਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਭਏ; ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If we have fallen from your favour due to our evil and unrighteous deeds, then 0 Lord! You have made known that You bless the sinners with Your grace and make them good and pious.

0.g: ਜਉ ਭਏ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨ ਪਰਚੀਨ ਲਗਿ; ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If we are suffering due to our ill deeds and sins of the previous births, then 0 Lord! You have made it conspicuous that You dispel the sufferings of the poor and destitudes.

0.g: ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਅਰਕ ਸੁਤ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਭਏ; ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਜਗਤ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If we are in the grip of the angels of death and become deserving of a life in hell because of our bad and evil deeds, then 0 Lord ! The whole world is singing Your paeans that You are the liberator of all from the vagaries of hell.

0.g: ਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਭ ਕੋਊ ਕਰੈ, ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਅਵਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਤੋਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਹੈ ।੫੦੪।
0.e: O store house of clemency! One. who does good to others begets good in returns. But doing good to low and evil doers like us behoves only You. (You alone can bless and forgive the sins and evil deeds of all).  (504)

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧ ਮਿਲੇ; ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The union of Guru and Sikh leads the Sikh to focus his mind on the divine word. The irha, pingla and Sukhmana enter the tenth door of the Sikh making him realise himself and granting him spiritual peace.

0.g: ਓੁਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੈਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ; ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Practicing Naam Simran, the frolicsome mind becomes peaceful and crossing all hurdles gets engrossed in the realm of peace and tranquillity-the Dasam Duar. They are not to bear the torments of yogic practices.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਪਦ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਕੈ; ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਮਿਅ ਚੁਆੲੈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A practitioner of Naam detaches himself from the three pronged influence of mammon i.e. the worldly attractions and reach the stage of absolute.

0.g: ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਅਨੰਦਮਈ; ਕਦਲੀ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਛਾਏ ਹੈ ।੨੮।
0.e: Just as Chakvi (Sun bird) seeing sun, Chakor (moon bird) seeing moon, rain bird and peacock seeing clouds get into wondrous stage of bliss, similarly a ·Gunnukh (Guru conscious person) who practices Naam Simran keeps progressing like a lotus flower in the

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਮਹੁਰਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਰੁਠੀ ਨੋ ਤੁਠੀ ।
0.e: The foolish would say the poison sweet and the angry person a happy one.

0.e: To burnt he would say the cooled one: the 'gone' for him is 'come' and the 'come' one for him is eloped one i.e. if something sets in the eye, the eye is said to be soaring and if a widow settles in someone's house by marrying him, she is said to have elo

0.g: ਅਹਮਕੁ ਭੋਲਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਸਭ ਗਲਿ ਅਪੁਠੀ ।
0.e: To moron he would say simple, and his all talks will be contrary to normal.

0.g: ਉਜੜੁ ਤ੍ਰਟੀ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖਨਿ ਵੁਠੀ ।
0.e: To the ruining person, the foolish would say that he is leaving everything of his own sweet will.

0.g: ਚੋਰੈ ਸੰਦੀ ਮਾਉਂ ਜਿਉਂ; ਲੁਕਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਮੁਠੀ ।੧੪।
0.e: Such people are like the mother of a thief who weeps hiding in a corner (lest she is detected and possibility of catching hold of her son increases).

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਸੁਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ; ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: He who performs all deeds according to his family traditions, behaves well and kindly is known as an ideal person in the family.

0.g: ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ; ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਬਨਉਟਾ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: He who is honest of all his dealings, alone is considered guileless and sincere before his master, the rich merchant.

0.g: ਸੁਆਮ ਕਾਮ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ, ਮਾਨਤ ਨਰੇਸ ਆਨ; ਸੋਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਕਾਰਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: He who acknowledges the authority of his king and performs his master's tasks with care and devotion is always recognised as the ideal servant of the master (king).

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਰਿਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਖ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।੩੮੦।
0.e: Similarly, an obedient Sikh of the Guru who lodges the teachings of True Guru in his mind and engrosses his consciousness in the divine word is known the world over.  (380)

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The granter of knowledge and contemplation of ever stable form and name (Lord) is True Guru. A Guru-conscious person listens to the teachings of the True Guru and practices His words in his deeds and actions.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ; ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By virtue of glimpse and contemplation of the True Guru, a Guru-oriented person treats all uniformly. And as such he is Lord-conscious person and because of the knowledge of the words of Guru, he is Lord aware person.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਿਦੈ; ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By practicing the teachings of the True Guru completely and with patience, the light effulgent appears within him. He is filled with the love of the Lord and he acquires higher state of spiritual being.

0.g: ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ; ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਨੀ ਹੈ ।੧੩੮।
0.e: By the grace of the meditation of Naam of the Lord carried out by the blessings of the True Guru, he stays in most ecstatic, strange and blissful state all the time. (138)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ; ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਭਾਈ ।
0.e: Ineffable is the taste of the joy of love, which is the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: It’s this shore and the yonder one are beyond limits none can reach it.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਨਾਹਿ; ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਵਡਾਈ ।
0.e: Its beginning and end are unfathomable and its grandeur is most eminent.

0.g: ਹਾਥ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਥਾਹ ਦੀ; ਅਸਗਾਹ ਸਮਾਈ ।
0.e: It is so much that many of the oceans immerse in it yet its depth remains unknown.

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਬੂੰਦ ਇਕ; ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Who could evaluate even one drop of such a cup of love.

0.g: ਅਗਮਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ; ਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ।੧੨।
0.e: It is inaccessible and its knowledge is unfathomable, but the Guru can make one realise this imperceptible cup of love.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਹੀ ਤਿਲ ਬੋਏ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੂਟੁ ਬਾਧੈ; ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮੈ ।
0.e: A sesame seed is Sown that mixes with earth to become a plant. One seed gives several seeds and spreads in the world in many forms.

0.g: ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਚਬਾਇ ਕੋਊ ਖਾਲ ਕਾਢੈ ਰੇਵਰੀ ਕੈ; ਕੋਊ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਲਵਾ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਰ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Some munch them (sesame seeds), some coat sugar balls with them (Rewari) while others mix them with jaggery syrup and make cake/biscuit like eatables.

0.g: ਕੋਊ ਉਖਲੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਤਿਲਕੁਟ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਊ; ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀਰਿ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Some grind them and mix them with milk paste to make a form of sweet-meat, some squeeze them to extract oil and use it for burning lamp and lighting up their homes.

0.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਹਤ ਆਵੈ; ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਤ ਆਵਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਮੈ ।੨੭੩।
0.e: When multiplicity of one sesame seed of the creator cannot be explained, how can the unknowable, formless Lord be known? (273)

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: By becoming humble only, Dhru could behold the Lord.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: God, affectionate to the devotees, also embraced him and egoless Dhruv attained the highest glory.

0.g: ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In this mortal world he was granted liberation and then a stable place in the sky was given him.

0.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜਿ; ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Moon, sun and all the thirty three crores of angels circumambulate and revolve around him.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ; ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: His magnificence has been clearly described in the Vedas and Puranas.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The story of that unmanifest Lord is extremely mystical, indescribable and beyond all thoughts.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੨੧।੪। ਚਾਰਿ ।
0.e: Only gurmukhs can have a glimpse of Him.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਵਾਹੜੇ; ਗੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੰਗ ਹੁਵੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Rivers and streams become Ganges after meeting the latter.

0.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵਦੇ; ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The cheats undertake to go at sixty-eight pilgrimage centres and serve gods and goddesses.

0.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They, from people during their discussions over good and knowledge, listen to the name of the Lord, the saviour of the fallen ones;

0.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਨੀਰਿ ਨ੍ਹਵਾਲੀਅਨਿ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਣੰਦੇ ।
0.e: But, it is like the elephant who is bathed in water but coming out of it spreads dusts all round.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The cheats listen to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation but do not adopt them in the mind.

0.g: ਤੁੰਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਜੀਐ; ਬੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਫਲ ਨ ਫਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Even if irrigated by nectar, the seeds of colocynth never become sweet,

0.g: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ, ਨ ਸੇਹ ਪੁਜੰਦੇ ।੯।
0.e: The cheating lovers never follow the straight path i.e. they do not follow the way of truth.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਹਰਿਚੰਦੁਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ; ਕਰਦੇ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ।
0.e: How can mirage in desert quench the thirst?

0.g: ਥਲ ਵਿਚ ਤਪਨਿ ਭਠੀਆ; ਕਿਉ ਲਹੈ ਪਿਆਸਾ ।
0.e: People, in dreams enjoy by becoming kings (but in the morning they possess nothing).

0.g: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ; ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ।
0.e: How can one hope that the shade of a tree would remain stationary?

0.g: ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਥਿਰੁ; ਪੁਜੈ ਕਿਉ ਆਸਾ ।
0.e: All this is a fake show like that of an acrobat's.

0.g: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਦੀ ਖੇਡ ਜਿਉ; ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ।
0.e: One who keeps association with dissemblers,

0.g: ਰਲੈ ਜੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਣਿਆ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ।੭।
0.e: Ultimately goes (from this world) disapponited.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਖਣਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਿਖਣ ਬਜਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Learning of the Sikh way of life is as tough as the thunderbolt and only the Sikhs of the Guru learn it.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਲਿਖਣਾ; ਲੇਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Writing about the Sikh-life is also beyond all accounts; none can write.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਤੋਲਣਾ; ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲੈ ਤੁਲਧਾਰਾ ।
0.e: No scale can weigh the Sikh way of life.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਦੇਖਣਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਾ ।
0.e: The glimpse of the Sikh life can be had only in the holy congregation and the Gurdvara, the door of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਚਖਣਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Pondering upon the word of Guru in the holy congregation is like tasting of the Sikh way of life.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਮਝਣਾ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Understanding of the Sikh life is like kindling the flame of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।੭।
0.e: The pleasure-fruit of the Gurmukhs is the love of the dear Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਆਏ ।
0.e: In the holy congregation, the disciples of the Guru come in the shelter of the holy feet of the Guru.

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ; ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: The nectar like sight of the Guru has blest one and all and due to his divine look, the Guru has put them all at the holy feet (shelter) i.e. they all have been made humble.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਲਕ; ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਦਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ ।
0.e: The Sikhs applied the dust of the feet to their forehead and now their account of delusive actions has been erased.

0.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਆਚਮਨੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਏ ।
0.e: After drinking the nectar of feet, their maladies of ego and duality have been cured.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ।
0.e: Falling at the feet, becoming the dust of feet and adopting the way of liberated ones in life they have established themselves in equipoise.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਵਰ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਦ ਮਕਰੰਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ।
0.e: Now having become the black bees of the lotus feet, they are enjoying the nectar of pleasure and delight.

0.g: ਪੂਜ ਮੂਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣ; ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: The base of worship with them are the lotus feet of the true Guru and they do not allow duality to come near them now.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਏ ।੧੯।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is the shelter of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਲੀਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ; ਜਿਉ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ।
0.e: As, a coach on the highway goes through the beaten tracks,

0.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੁ ।
0.e: In the holy congregation one goes on abiding with the divine ordinance (hukam) and will of the Lord.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਧਨ ਸੋਘਾ ਰਖਦਾ; ਘਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ।
0.e: As, the wise person keeps money intact at home

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਨ ਛਡਈ; ਸਾਇਰੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ।
0.e: And the deep ocean leaves not its general nature;

0.g: ਲਤਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਲਤਾੜੀਐ; ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਘਾਹੁ ।
0.e: As the grass is trampled under the feet,

0.g: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਹੈ ਮਾਨਸਰੁ; ਹੰਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਵਾਹੁ ।
0.e: Like this (earth) inn is the Manasarovar and the disciples of the Guru are swans

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ; ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਖਾਹੁ ।੧੪।
0.e: Who in the form of kirtan, singing of the holy hymns, eat the pearls of the Word of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸਹਸ ਫਲ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The head (root) of the tree remains downwards and there for it is laden with flowers and fruit.

0.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਸਿਰੁ ਨੀਵਾਂ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਚਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The water is known as pure because it flows downward.

0.g: ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨੀਵੇਂ ਚਰਣ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੀਸੁ ਪਵੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The head is higher and the feet lower but even then the head bows on the feet of the gurmukh.

0.g: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਨੀਵੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੈ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The lowest is the earth which bears the burden of the whole world and of the wealth in it.

0.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਧੰਨੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: That land and that place is blest where the Guru, the Sikh and ..he holymen put their feet.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ; ਸੰਤ ਵੇਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਿ ਸੁਣੰਦਾ ।
0.e: That the dust of the feet of the saints is the highest is told even by the Vedas.

0.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ, ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਲਹੰਦਾ ।੧੫।
0.e: Any fortunate one attains the dust of the feet.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਚੰਨਣੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਦੇ; ਚੰਨਣੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਬਾਏ ।
0.e: Giving fragrance to all trees, the sandalwood tree makes them fragrant.

0.g: ਖਹਦੇ ਵਾਂਸਹੁਂ ਅਗਿ ਧੁਖਿ; ਆਪਿ ਜਲੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਜਲਾਏ ।
0.e: By the friction of the bamboos (on the other hand) the bamboo itself gets burnt and burns the whole family (of bamboos).

0.g: ਮੁਲਹ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੰਖੇਰੂਆ; ਫਾਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਫਹਾਏ ।
0.e: Twithering quail not only gets caught but also makes the whole family ensnared.

0.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਬਤਹੁ; ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਏ ।
0.e: The eight metals found in the mountains are converted into gold by the philosopher's stone.

0.g: ਗਣਿਕਾ ਵਾੜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਹੋਵਨਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ।
0.e: The people going to the prostitutes earn sins besides contagious diseases.

0.g: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਆਵਨਿ ਵੈਦ ਘਰ; ਦਾਰੂ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ ।
0.e: The sufferers from a disease come to the physician and he giving medicine cures them.

0.g: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ, ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਏ ।੧੪।
0.e: Because of the nature of the company kept, one becomes good or bad.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ।
0.e: The true Guru is the transcendent perfect Brahm and resides in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ; ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ ।
0.e: By absorbing the consciousness in the Word He is adored, and cherishing love, devotion and His awe He spontaneously blooms in the heart.

0.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਸੋਗੁ ਹੋਇ; ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭੋਗੁ ਵਿਣਸੈ ।
0.e: He never dies nor becomes sorrowful. He always goes on bestowing, and his bounties are never exhausted.

0.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਸੈ ।
0.e: People say that the Guru has passed away but the holy congregation smilingly accepts Him as indestructible.

0.g: ਛੇਵੀਂ ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ ਕੋ ਦਸੈ ।
0.e: Guru (Hargobind) is the sixth generation of Gurus but who can tell about the generations of the Sikhs.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉਂ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਸਨੋ; ਸਚ ਖੰਡ ਸਤਿਸੰਗੁ ਸਰਸੈ ।
0.e: The concepts of true name, true glimpse, and the true abode get their explanation only in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੈ ।
0.e: The cup of love is quaffed in the holy congregation and there only the touch of the philosopher's stone (Lord), loving to devotees is received.

0.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਹੋਇ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਸੈ ।
0.e: In the holy congregation, the formless one assumes form and there only the unborn, timeless

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ, ਕਸੌਟੀ ਕਸੈ ।੧੨।
0.e: Being is eulogized. The truth only prevails there and everyone is tested on the touchstone of truth there.

0.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਫਨ ਪੈ ਧਰਨ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ; ਤਾਂਹਿ ਗਿਰਧਰ ਕਹੈ ਕਉਨ ਬਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: God created Sheshnag who is believed to be supporting the Earth on one of his thousand heads, and he is called Dharnidhar, and if his creator is called by the name of Girdhar (lifter of Goverdhan mountain-Krishan) what sort of praise is his?

0.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਨਾਥ; ਤਾਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਜਨਾਥ ਕਹੇ ਕੌਨ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The creator who has created a crazy (Shiv Ji) and is called Vishwanath (master of the Universe), if his creator is called Brijnath (master of Braj region-Sri Krishan) then what is so praiseworthy about him?

0.g: ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰ ਓਂਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰੇ ਜਿਨ; ਤਾਹਿ ਨੰਦ ਨੰਦ ਕਹੈ ਕਉਨ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The creator who has created this entire expanse, if that creator is called son of Nand-Krishan Ji, then what is so great about him?

0.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤ ਅਗ︀ਯਾਨ ਅੰਧ; ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੋਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ।੬੭੧।
0.e: (So by such type of worship) ignorant and blind of knowledge consider Lord's worship being performed, but instead, they are slandering Him. Remaining silent is far better than this type of worship.  (671)

0.g: ਸਿਆਮ ਵੇਦ ਕਉ ਸੋਧਿ ਕਰਿ; ਮਥਿ ਵੇਦਾਂਤੁ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Vyas (Badarayan) recited Vedanta (sutras) after churning and researching the thought frame of the Samaveda.

0.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He put up before the self (atman) as identical to indescribable Brahm.

0.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਿਆਵਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He in invisible and the jiv wanders hither and thither in its delusions of self conceit.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਪੁਜਾਇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: By establishing the self as the Brahm he is in fact established one's own self as worthy of worship and therefore remained unknown to the mysteries of loving devotion.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਵੇਦਿ ਮਥਿ; ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਤਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Churning of the Vedas could not obtain peace for him and he started scorching one and all in the heat of is ego.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਡੰਡ ਨ ਉਤਰੇ; ਜਮ ਡੰਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਰੂਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The rod of maya always hung over his head and he suffered extremely because of the constant fear of the Yama, the god of death.

0.g: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਮਥਿ ਭਾਗਵਤ, ਗੁਨਿ ਗੀਤ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Having obtained knowledge from Narad, he recited Bhagvat and thus eulogised God.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਰਨੀ, ਨਹਿਂ ਕੋਇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।੧੧।
0.e: Without surrender before the Guru none could get across (the world ocean).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਲਖ; ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ।
0.e: Millions of variegated creatures of unparallel beauty are there in this world.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਲਖ; ਸੰਗੀਤ ਅਭੰਗੀ ।
0.e: Likewise millions of vibrations, dialogues and their constant music is there.

0.g: ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਲਖ; ਅਰਗਜੇ ਅਦੰਗੀ ।
0.e: Mixing many scents millions of pure essences are prepared.

0.g: ਛਤੀਹ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ; ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਢੰਗੀ ।
0.e: Similarly in cook houses thirtysix types of delicious dishes are there.

0.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਗਹਣਿਆਂ; ਸੋਹਹਿਂ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ ।
0.e: The fully grown up women are there decorated with silken robes and ornaments.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ; ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ ।੧੪।
0.e: But association with the gurmukhs is a pleasure fruit which is unapproachable.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਕੁਹੈ ਕਸਾਈ ਬਕਰੀ; ਲਾਇ ਲੂਣ ਸੀਖ ਮਾਸੁ ਪਰੋਆ ।
0.e: The butcher slaughters goat and its meats is salted and strung on a skewer.

0.g: ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਕੁਹੀਂਦੀ; ਖਾਧੇ ਅਕਿ ਹਾਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ।
0.e: Laughingly, the goat says while being killed that I have come to this condition only for grazing leaves of akk plant.

0.g: ਮਾਸ ਖਾਨਿ ਗਲਿ ਛੁਰੀ ਦੇ; ਹਾਲੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਅਲੋਆ ।
0.e: But what will be the plight of those who cutting the throat with knife eat flesh (of animal).

0.g: ਜੀਭੈ ਹੰਦਾ ਫੇੜਿਆ; ਖਉ ਦੰਦਾਂ ਮੁਹੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਵਿਗੋਆ ।
0.e: The perverted taste of the tongue is harmful for the teeth and damages the mouth.

0.g: ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰਿ; ਹੋਇ ਦੁਜੀਭਾ ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਭੋਆ ।
0.e: The enjoyer of other's wealth, body and slander becomes a poisonous amphisbaena.

0.g: ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰੁਮੰਤ ਸਪੁ; ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਸੋਆ ।
0.e: This snake is controlled by the mantra of the Guru but manmukh, devoid of Guru, never listens to the glory of such mantra.

0.g: ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ, ਅਗੈ ਟੋਆ ।੨੧।
0.e: While moving ahead, he never beholds the pit before him.

0.g: ਰੁਬਾਈਆਣ ।
0.e: It is them who bless all these creations and natural beauties with grace and elegance. (269)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਸ ਜ਼ਿ ਸ਼ੌਕਿ ਤੂ ਕਦਮ ਅਜ਼ ਸਰ ਸਾਖ਼ਤ ।
0.e: The Naam of Waaheguru is an ornament for His noble and saintly devotees,

0.g: ਬਰ ਨਹੁ ਤਬਕ ਚਰਖ਼ਿ ਅਲਮ ਸਰ ਅਫ਼ਰਾਖ਼ਤ ।
0.e: And, the eye of these nobilities is always full of pearls and gems because of the refulgent glow of the Almighty. (270)

0.g: ਸ਼ੁਦ ਆਮਦਨਸ਼ ਮੁਬਾਰਿਕ ਰਫ਼ਤਨ ਹਮ ।
0.e: Their words are a lessons for a permanent life,

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਆਣ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਰਾਹਿ ਹੱਕ ਰਾ ਬਿਸ਼ਨਾਖ਼ਤ ।੧।
0.e: And, the memory of Akaalpurakh abides on their lips/tongue for ever. (271)

0.g: ਕੂਰ ਅਸਤ ਹਰ ਆਣ ਦੀਦਾ ਕਿ ਹੱਕ ਰਾ ਨਭਸ਼ਨਾਖ਼ਤ ।
0.e: Their utterances have the status of the words of Divine,

0.g: ਈਣ ਉਮਰਿ ਗਿਰਾਣ ਮਾਯਾ ਬ-ਗ਼ਫ਼ਲਤ ਦਰਬਾਖ਼ਤ ।
0.e: And, not even one breath of theirs is spent without remembering Him. (272)

0.g: ਊ ਗਿਰੀਆਣ ਕੁਨਾਣ ਆਮਦ ਬ-ਹਸਰਤ ਮੁਰਦ ।
0.e: All these saintly persons are really seekers of a Divine glimpse,

0.g: ਅਫ਼ਸੋਸ ਦਰੀਣ ਆਮਦ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਕਾਰੇ ਨਭਸਾਖ਼ਤ ।੨।
0.e: And, this delightful worldly spread is, in fact, a heavenly flower bed. (273)

0.g: ਈਣ ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਤੂ ਖ਼ਾਨਾ ਦਾਰਿ ਜਾਨਾਨਸਤ ।
0.e: Whosoever developed a friendship with the devotees of Waaheguru,

0.g: ਈਣ ਤਖ਼ਤਿ ਵਜੂਦਿ ਮਸਨਦਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਸਤ ।
0.e: Take it that his shadow (on them) will be many times more blessed than the shadow of the feathers of  the Humaa bird (It is said that a shadow of Humaa bird can bestow the kingdom of the world). (274)

0.g: ਹਰ ਬੂਅਲਹਵਸੇ ਬਸੂਇ ਊ ਰਾਹ ਨ ਬੁਰਦ ।
0.e: We should take it that getting absorbed in Waaheguru's meditation is to give up self-ego,

0.g: ਕਿ ਈਣ ਰਾਹ ਤਅੱਲਕਿ ਮੰਜ਼ਲਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਸਤ ।੩।
0.e: And, not thinking about Him would get us stuck in every other worldly attraction. (275)

0.g: ਹਰ ਦਿਲ ਕਿ ਬਰਾਹਿ ਰਾਸਤ ਜਾਨਾਣ ਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: To redeem ourselves from our egos is the real emancipation,

0.g: ਤਹਿਕੀਕ ਬਿਦਾਣ ਕਿ ਐਨਿ ਜਾਨਾਣ ਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: And, to tie up our minds with Waaheguru's devotion is also real deliverance. (276)

0.g: ਯੱਕ ਜ਼ੱਰਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਫ਼ੈਜ਼ਿ ਰਹਿਮਤਸ਼ ਖ਼ਾਲੀ ਨੀਸਤ ।
0.e: Whosoever has linked and attached his mind to the Almighty,

0.g: ਨੱਕਾਸ ਦਰੂਨਿ ਨਕਸ਼ ਪਿਨਹਾਣ ਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਅਸਤ ।੪।
0.e: Take it that he has easily leaped over a sky equipped even with nine locks. (277)

0.g: ਈਣ ਆਮਦੋ ਰਫ਼ਤ ਜੁਜ਼ ਦਮੇ ਬੇਸ਼ ਨਬੂਦ ।
0.e: The company of such God-attached devotees,

0.g: ਹਰ ਜਾ ਕਿ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕੁਨੇਮ ਜੁਜ਼ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ਨਬੂਦ ।
0.e: Take it that it is the cure-all; however, how can we be fortunate enough to obtain it? (278)

0.g: ਮਾਣ ਜਾਨਿਬਿ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਚੂੰ ਂਨਿਗਾਹ ਬਿਕੁਨੇਮ ।
0.e: Both the faith and the religion are amazed,

0.g: ਚੂੰ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਤੂ ਹੀਚ ਕਸੇ ਪਸੋ ਪੇਸ਼ ਨਬੂਦ ।੫।
0.e: And in this amazement beyond limits they are perplexed. (279)

0.g: ਹਰ ਬੰਦਾ ਕੂ ਤਾਲਿਬਿ ਮੌਲਾ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ।
0.e: Whosoever imbibes such a chaste and divine desire,

0.g: ਦਰ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਜਹਾਣ ਰੁਤਬਾ-ਅੰਸ਼ ਊਲਾ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ।
0.e: His Guru (teacher) is the master of innate and intrinsic knowledge. (280)

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਦੋ ਜਹਾਣ ਰਾ ਬ-ਜੌਏ ਬਿ-ਸਤਾਨੰਦ ।
0.e: God connected noble saints can make your connection with Him,

0.g: ਮਜਨੂੰਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੈ ਆਸ਼ਕਿ ਲੈਲਾ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ।੬।
0.e: They can also help you to obtain the eternal treasure, the Naam. (281)

0.g: ਦਰ ਦਹਿਰ ਕਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਆਮਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: This is an immortal achievement for an enlightened person,

0.g: ਬਰ ਗ਼ੁਮ-ਸ਼ੁਦਗਾਨਿ ਰਹਿਨੁਮਾ ਆਮਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: This adage is commonly well known, and everyone is well acquainted with it. (282)

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਅਗਰ ਈਂ ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਤੂ ਮੁਸ਼ਤਾਕਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: The enlightened, perfect and submerged into the love of God devotees;

0.g: ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ-ਨੁਮਾ ਆਮਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।੭।
0.e: They always have His Naam on their tongues and lips in meditation. (283)

0.g: ਦਰ ਮਜ਼ਹਬਿ ਮਾ ਗ਼ੈਰ-ਪਰਸਤੀ ਨ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।
0.e: To continually meditate on His Naam is their worship;

0.g: ਸਰ ਤਾ ਬਕਦਮ ਬਹੋਸ਼ ਓ ਮਸਤੀ ਨ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।
0.e: And, the eternal treasure blessed by Akaalpurakh directs one towards His path. (284)

0.g: ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਲਿ ਨਸ਼ਵੰਦ ਯਕ ਦਮ ਅਜ਼ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।
0.e: When the divine eternal treasure shows Its face,

0.g: ਦੀਗਰ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਬੁਲੰਦੋ ਪਸਤੀ ਨ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।੮।
0.e: You would then belong to Waaheguru and He would belong to you. (285)

0.g: ਯੱਕ ਜ਼ੱਰਾ ਅਗਰ ਸ਼ੌਕਿ ਇਲਾਹੀ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ।
0.e: If the shadow of Akaalpurakh falls on someone's heart and soul,

0.g: ਬਿਹਤਰ ਕਿ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ।
0.e: Then take it that the painful thorn of separation has been extracted out of the foot (depth) of our mind. (286)

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ-ਸਤ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮਿ ਮੁਰਸ਼ਦਿ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ।
0.e: When the thorn of separation has been removed from the feet of the heart,

0.g: ਈਣ ਖ਼ਤ ਨ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਿ ਗਵਾਹੀ ਬਾਸ਼ਦ ।੯।
0.e: Take it then that the Akaalpurakh has made the temple of our heart as His abode. (287)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਸ ਬ-ਜਹਾ ਨਸ਼ਵੋ ਨੁਮਾ ਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਦ ।
0.e: Like that drop of water that fell into a river or ocean, giving up its own identity (showing humility),
