0.e: It itself became the river and the ocean; (thus falling on the feet of Aakaalpurakh), and convergence with Him took place. (288)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਸ ਜ਼ਿ ਬਰਾਇ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ਚੀਜ਼ੇ ਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਦ ।
0.e: Once the drop merges into the ocean,

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਦ ।੧੦।
0.e: After that, it cannot be separated from the ocean. (289)

0.g: ਪੁਰ ਗਸ਼ਤਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਸਰ ਤਾ ਬ-ਕਦਮ ਨੂਰ-ਉਲ-ਨੂਰ ।
0.e: When the drop started to rush in the direction of the ocean,

0.g: ਆਈਨਾ ਕਿ ਦਰ ਵੈਨ ਬਵਦ ਹੀਚ ਕਸੂਰ ।
0.e: It, then, realized the significance of being just a drop of water. (290)

0.g: ਤਹਿਕੀਕ ਬਿਦਾਣ ਜ਼ਿ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਿਲਾਣ ਦੂਰ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: When the drop was bestowed with this eternal meeting,

0.g: ਊ ਦਰ ਦਿਲਿ ਆਰਿਫ਼ ਕਰਦਾ ਜ਼ਹੂਰ ।੧੧।
0.e: The reality dawned on it, and its long-cherished desire was fulfilled. (291)

0.g: ਈਣ ਉਮਰਿ ਗਿਰਾਣ-ਮਾਯਾ ਕਿ ਬਰਬਾਦ ਸ਼ਵਦ ।
0.e:
The droplet said, "Even though I am a small drop of water,
I have been able to measure the expanse of this huge ocean." (292)

0.g: ਈਣ ਖ਼ਾਨਾਇ ਵੀਰਾਣ ਬ-ਚਿਹ ਆਬਾਦ ਸ਼ਵਦ ।
0.e: If the ocean, out of its extreme kindness, would agree to take me in,

0.g: ਤਾ ਮੁਰਸ਼ਦਿ ਕਾਮਿਲ ਨਦਿਹਦ ਦਸਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ।
0.e: And, it agreed to merge me into itself even beyond its capacity; (293)

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਗ਼ਮਗੀਨ ਤੂ ਚੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਦ ਬਵਦ ।੧੨।
0.e: And, it rose like a tidal wave out of the span of the ocean,

0.g: ਦਿਲਿ ਜ਼ਾਲਮਿ ਬ-ਕਸਦਿ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਨਿ ਮਾ-ਸਤ ।
0.e: It became another wave, and then bowed in reverence to the ocean. (294)

0.g: ਦਿਲਿ ਮਜ਼ਲੂਮਿ ਮਨ ਬਸੂਇ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਸਤ ।
0.e: In the same manner, every such person who had a confluence with the Almighty,

0.g: ਊ ਦਰੀਣ ਫ਼ਿਕਰ ਤਾਣ ਬਮਾ ਚਿਹ ਕੁਨਦ ।
0.e: Became complete and perfect on the path of meditation. (295)

0.g: ਮਾ ਦਰੀਣ ਫ਼ਿਕਰ ਤਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਚਿਹ ਕੁਨਦ ।੧੩।
0.e: In reality, a wave and the ocean are one and the same,

0.g: ਦਰ ਹਾਸਿਲਿ ਉਮਰ ਆਣ ਚਿਹ ਮਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾ ਏਮ ।
0.e: But still there is a vast difference between them. (296)

0.g: ਦਰ ਹਰ ਦੋ-ਜਹਾਣ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾ ਏਮ ।
0.e: I am just a simple wave, while you are an enormously large ocean,

0.g: ਈਣ ਹਸਤੀਏ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ਤਨ ਬਲਾ ਬੂਦ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ।
0.e: Thus, there is a big difference between you and me like that between the earth and the sky. (297)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ਗੁਜ਼ਸ਼ਤੇਮ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾ ਏਮ ।੧੪।
0.e: I am nothing; all this (that I am) is only because of your blessings,

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਤੂ ਤੂਤੀਆ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾਏਮ ।
0.e: I am, too, one wave in Your vast manifest world. (298)

0.g: ਕਜ਼ ਦੌਲਤਿ ਆਣ ਨਸ਼ਵੋ ਨੁਮਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾਏਮ ।
0.e: You would need the association with the noble persons,

0.g: ਮਾ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਬਰ ਰੂਇ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਦੀਗਰ ਨਭਕੁਨੇਮ ।
0.e: This will be the first and the foremost thing that you will need. (299)

0.g: ਦਰ ਖ਼ਾਨਾਇ ਦਿਲ ਨਕਸ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾਏਮ ।੧੫।
0.e: That perfect and complete Creator is visible through His own creations,

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਅਜ਼ ਯਾਦਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾਏਮ ।
0.e: The Creator, in fact, abides amidst His own Nature and manifestations. (300)

0.g: ਈਣ ਜਾਮਿ ਲਬਾ-ਲਬ ਅਜ਼ ਕੁਜਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾਏਮ ।
0.e: The Creator and His creations are one and the same,

0.g: ਜੁਜ਼ ਤਾਲਿਬਿ ਹੱਕ ਨਸੀਬਿ ਹਰ ਕਸ ਨ ਬਵਦ ।
0.e: They, the noble persons, renounce all material distractions except the Provident. (301)

0.g: ਈਣ ਦੌਲਤਿ ਨਾਯਾਬ ਕਿ ਮਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾਏਮ ।੧੬।
0.e: O my dear friend! Then you should also make a judgement and conclude,

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦਰੀਣ ਸਰਾਏ ਮਾਦੂਅਮ ।
0.e: As to who is God, and who you are, and how to distinguish between the two. (302)

0.g: ਗਾਹੇ ਲਾਜ਼ਮ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਵ ਗਾਹੇ ਮਲਜ਼ੂਮ ।
0.e: If, in your pursuits, you happen to have a meeting with the Akaalpurakh.

0.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚੂ ਸਗਾਣ ਬਰ ਉਸਤਖ਼ਾਣ ਜੰਗ ਕੁਨੇਮ ।
0.e: Then you should not utter any other word except the word of worship and meditation. (303)

0.g: ਦੁਨਿਆ ਮਾਲੂਅਮ ਅਹਿਲਿ ਦੁਨਿਆ ਮਾਲੂਅਮ ।੧੭।
0.e: All this tangible and non-tangible boons are because of the meditation,

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਅਗਰ ਆਣ ਜਮਾਲ ਦੀਦਨ ਦਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Without meditation, this life of ours is only mortification and humiliation. (304)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਹਵਸ ਮੈਲਿ ਰਮੀਦਨ ਦਾਰੀ ।
0.e: The Almighty God has also said,

0.g: ਜ਼ੀਣ ਦੀਦਾ ਮਬੀਣ ਕਿ ਹਜ਼ਾਬ ਸਤ ਤੁਰਾ ।
0.e:
Anyone who transformed himself into a man of God is redeemed." (305)
Anyone who proclaimed through his own mouth that he was God,
The Islamic religious law crucified him just like Mansoor. (306)
Inebriated with God is, in fact, to be always in a state of alertness,
Even dreaming while asleep for the knowledgeable is indeed like staying awake. (307)
In reality, a disrespectful faces the consequences (reaps the fruits) of his own actions,
Because, it is the 'respect' and 'civility' that is capable of showing all the direction of the right path. (308)
If you have transformed yourself from head to toe into Akaalpurakh's form,
And, If you have merged into that unparalleled and matchless Waaheguru, (309)
Then you should adopt the path of meditation,
And, become His (favorite) person by holding on to the divine spiritual  passage  of meditation. (310)
One should assume His presence under all circumstances,
Considering Him Omnipresent and Immanent, and also take it that He is capable of seeing everything everywhere. (311)
There is no education except that of respect and civility in the path of God,
It is not prudent for His seeker-devotee to accept anything but His Order. (312)
The seekers of the Divine Spirit are always respectful,
They are also satiated with reverence while remembering Him. (313)
What does an apostate know about the tradition of those noble persons?
The efforts of an atheist to get a glimpse of Akaalpurakh will always be ineffective. (314)
A disrespectful can never find the path leading towards the Divine Spirit;
No strayed person has ever been able to find the path of God and much less to reach Him. (315)
It is reverence that is the guide to the path of Waaheguru;
And, an atheist remains blank from receiving His blessings. (316)
How can an atheist find the way to the Almighty,
Who has been condemned due to the anger of Waaheguru?(317)
If you care to seek the shelter (and agree to function in their shadow) of the noble souls of God,
You will receive teachings and instructions about respectability there. (318)
Coming to this place (of noble persons), even the apostates become capable to teach lessons of reverence,
Here, even extinguished lamps begin to spread light throughout the world. (319)
O Akaalpurakh! Kindly bestow reverence even on the irreverent,
So that they can spend their lives in Your remembrance. (320)
If you can relish the savor (sweet taste) of Waaheguru's remembrance,
Then O good man! You can become immortal. (321)
Consider this body of dirt as permanent for this reason
Because the devotion for Him have established permanently in the fortress of your heart. (322)
The love and elation for Akaalpurakh are the life-line of the soul,
There is a wealth of faith and religion in His memory. (323)
How can the euphoria and elation for Waaheguru abide in every heart,
And, how can He take refuge in the body made up of dirt. (324)
When your fondness for Akaalpurakh supported you,
Then, take it for granted that you will obtain control and have the divine eternal wealth. (325)
The dust of His path is like a collyrium for our eyes and head,
This dust is much more valuable than the crown and the thrones for the enlightened. (326)
This worldly wealth is not ever lasting,
You should accept this according to the verdict of the true devotees of God. (327)
Meditation of Waaheguru is always absolutely essential for you,
And, the discourse about Him makes you steady and immovable forever. (328)
The devotees of Akaalpurakh are intimately connected to the divine knowledge,
And, the achievement of divine knowledge is completely absorbed inside their souls. (329)
The throne of devotion for Akaalpurakh is permanent and indestructible,
Although every peak has a trough. (330)
The marvel of the zest for God's love is eternal and non-destructible,
Wish were it that we can get just one particle of His devotion. (331)
Whosoever is lucky enough to obtain such a particle, he becomes immortal,
In reality, his desire (to meet with Akaalpurakh) is fulfilled. (332)
When he reached the stage of fulfillment,
That particle of the strong desire for His devotion gets seeded into his heart. (333)
The divine nectar oozes out of his every hair,
And the whole world, with his aroma, becomes alive and rises up. (334)
Fortunate is that person who has attained the Provident;
And, who has turned himself away (detached) from every worldly items except the memory of God. (335)
Even while living in worldly guise, he is detached from every materialistic thing,
Like the Entity of God, he maintains a hidden profile. (336)
Outwardly he might be appearing to be in the grip of a fistful of dust,
Inwardly, he is always engaged in talking about the chaste Akaalpurakh and abides with Him. (337)
Outwardly, he might appear to be immersed in love for his child and wife,
In reality, he always abides (in thought and action) with his God. (338)
Outwardly, he might seem to be inclined towards 'desires and greed',
But inwardly, he remains chaste and sacred in the memory of Waaheguru. (339)
Outwardly, he might appear to be paying attention to horses and camels,
But inwardly, he remains detached from the worldly hub-hub and noises. (340)
He might appear to be involved in gold and silver outwardly,
But he is, in fact, master of land and water inwardly. (341)
His intrinsic worth gets revealed slowly and gradually,
In fact, he becomes a casket of fragrance. (342)
His internal and external selves become one and the same,
Both the worlds become followers of his command. (343)
His heart and tongue are completely immersed in Akaalpurkh's remembrance at all times and  for ever,
His tongue becomes his heart, and his heart his tongue. (344)
Those saintly  souls who have converged with God have said clearly,
That persons of God remain comfortable and happy while they are in meditation." (345)

0.g: ਬੇ-ਦੀਦਾ ਬਿਬੀਣ ਹਰ ਆਣ ਚਿਹ ਦੀਦਨ ਦਾਰੀ ।੧੮।
0.e: The mastery and splendor of our True King, the Waaheguru, is well known,

0.g: ਮੌਜੂਦ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਸਤ ਤੂ ਕਿਰਾ ਮੀ ਜੋਈ ।
0.e: I bow before the pedestrian who is walking on this path. (346)

0.g: ਮਕਸੂਦ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਸਤ ਤੂ ਕੁਜਾ ਮੀ ਪੋਈ ।
0.e: The traveler on this path arrived at his destination,

0.g: ਈਣ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਜਹਾਣ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਿ ਦੌਲਤਿ ਤੁਸਤ ।
0.e: And, his heart became familiar with the real purpose and attainment of life. (347)

0.g: ਯਾਅਨੀ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ਬਾਨਿ ਹੱਕ ਮੀ ਗੋਈ ।੧੯।
0.e: Persons of God really need only His meditation,

0.g: ਫੁਟਕਲ ਬੈਂਤ ।
ਮਬਰ ਐ ਬਾਦ ਖ਼ਾਕਮ ਅਜ਼ ਦਰਿ ਦੂਸਤ ।
0.e: And, the cup of the pleasure and elation of meditation continues to overflow for ever. (348)

0.g: ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨਮ ਸਰਜ਼ਨਸ਼ ਕੁਨਦ ਕਿ ਹਰ ਜਾਈਸਤ ।੧।
0.e: The Mastery (of all creations in this world) is befitting and looks elegant only for the true and the chaste Master, the Akaalpurakh;

0.g: ਨੀਸਤ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਅਜ਼ ਆਣ ਸਨਮ ਦਰ ਪਰਦਾਇ ਦੈਰੋ ਹਰਮ ।
0.e: And, it is Him alone who has blessed this fistful of dust the gaiety and prosperity. (349)

0.g: ਕੈ ਬਵਦ ਆਤਿਸ਼ਿ ਦੋ ਰੰਗ ਅਜ਼ ਇਖ਼ਤਲਾਫ਼ਿ ਸੰਗ ਹਾ ।੨।
0.e: The fondness to remember the Waaheguru blessed him with prominence,

0.g: ਆਸਮਾਣ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਕੁਨਦ ਪੇਸ਼ਿ ਜ਼ਮੀਣ ਕਿ ਬਰ ਊ ।
0.e: And, this tendency also blessed him with honor and eminence and made him familiar with His mysteries. (350)

0.g: ਯੱਕ ਦੋ ਨਫ਼ਸ ਅਜ਼ ਪੈਏ ਜ਼ਿਕਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਬਿਨਸ਼ੀਨੰਦ ।੩।
0.e: This fistful of dust, with the remembrance of Akaalpurakh, became bright and shiny,

0.g: ਬਜ਼ੇਰਿ ਸਾਇਆਇ ਤੂਬਾ ਮੁਰਾਦ ਹਾ ਯਾਬੀ ।
0.e: And, the fondness to remember Him began to surge like a storm in his heart. (351)

0.g: ਬਜ਼ੇਰ ਸਾਇਆ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਹੱਕ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਯਾਬੀ ।੪।
0.e: May we express our deep devotion for the Omnipotent who from just one drop of water

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ, ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs knew very well about the one Guru (Nanak) and one disciple (Guru Angad).

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: By becoming the true Sikh of the Guru, this disciple virtually merged himself into the latter.

0.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ, ਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: The true Guru and the disciple were identical (in spirit) and their Word was also one.

0.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਭੂਰ ਭਵਿਖ, ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: This is the wonder of the past and the future that they (both) loved the truth.

0.g: ਲੇਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਲਿਖੁ, ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: They were beyond all accounts and were honour of the humble ones.

0.g: ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਿਖੁ, ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: For them, the nectar and poison were the same and they had got liberated from the cycle of transmigration

0.g: ਨੀਸਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਖੁ, ਹਦ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Recorded as the model of special virtues, they are known as the extremely honourable ones.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ, ਹੋਇ ਹੈਰਾਣਿਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: The wonderful fact is that the sikh of the Guru became the Guru.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਂਡ ਚੂਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੋਤ ਘਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੈ; ਪਾਹੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਆਏ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੈ ਖੁਵਾਇ ਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as flour, sugar and oil are kept at home, and on arrival of some guests, sweet dishes are prepared, served and eaten.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੀਰ ਹਾਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਨਕ ਆਭਰਨ ਪੈ; ਬ︀ਯਾਹੁ ਕਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਤਨ ਸੁਜਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as beautiful dresses, pearl necklace and gold jewellery are in possession but are worn on special occasions like marriage and are shown to others.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਅਮੋਲ ਹੋਤ ਹਾਟ ਹੀ ਮੈਂ; ਗਾਹ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਬਿੜਤਾ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਪਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as valuable pearls and jewels are kept in the shop, but shopkeeper shows them to the customer to sell and earn profit.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਲਿਖ ਪੋਥੀ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਤ; ਮਿਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ।੫੬੨।
0.e: Similarly Gurbani is written in a book form, it is bound and preserved. But when the Sikhs of Guru assemble in a congregation, that book is read and heard and it helps one attach the mind in the holy feet of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਬਾਸੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A Guru-conscious person is able to arrest the wandering of the mind by following the teachings of the Guru. He is thus able to live in stable, peaceful and equipoise state.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਊਪ; ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਦਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Coming into the refuge of the True Guru and feeling the holy dust of the True Guru's feet, a Guru-conscious person becomes beautiful of radiance. Beholding a glimpse of the True Guru, he is enlightened with the rare quality of treating all living beings a

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ; ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the union of Guru's teachings with consciousness and achieving absorption in Naam, his ego and arrogance of self-assertion is destroyed. Hearing the sweet tune of Naam Simran, he experiences an astonishing state.

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਅਲੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਕੇ ਅਲੇਖ ਭਏ; ਪਰਦਛਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ।੨੫੯।
0.e: By imbibing the unreachable teachings of the Guru in mind, a Guru-conscious person is freed from rendering account of his life before God. By the circumambulation of the True Guru, he achieves spiritual comfort. Living in humility, he serves as servant of

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬ︀ਯਾਹਤ ਹੈ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਤਾਂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a king marries many women, but one who gives birth to a son is honoured with bestowing of kingdom.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਧ ਬੋਹਥ ਬਹਾਇ ਦੇਤ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ; ਜੋਈ ਪਾਰ ਪਹੁੰਚੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as many ships sail in all directions of the sea, but one that reaches the shore beyond proves profitable.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਨ ਖਨਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਖਨਵਾਰੋ ਖੋਜੈ; ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਆਵੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਤਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਾਜੁ ਬਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as several mine diggers dig for diamonds, but one who finds a diamond enjoys the celebrations of his find.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਵਤਨ ਅਉ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਪੈ; ਜਾਂ ਪਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਤਾਂ ਕੈ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ।੫੬੩।
0.e: Similarly, a Sikh of the Guru whether new or old devotee who gets a look of grace of the True Guru, earns honour, glory and praise.  (563)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ; ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ।
0.e: Within the teaching of the Guru, the Sikhs of the Guru serve (others).

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥਿ ਭਿਖ; ਫਕੀਰਾਂ ਪਾਵਣੀ ।
0.e: They give in charity the four riches (char padarathi) to the beggars.

0.g: ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਲਖਿ; ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ।
0.e: They sing paeans of the invisible Lord who is beyond all accounts.

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸ ਇਖ; ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਵਣੀ ।
0.e: They drink the juice of the sugarcane of loving devotion, and make others also enjoy the same.

0.g: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ; ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣੀ ।
0.e: Nothing in the past as well as the future can be equal to their love.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਵਿਖ; ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣੀ ।੧੭।
0.e: None can vie with even the one step of the way of gurmukhs.

0.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਗਇਆ ਬਗਦਾਦਿ ਨੋ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਆ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ ।
0.e: From Mecca Baba went to Baghdad and stayed outside the city.

0.g: ਇਕੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਅਕਾਲ ਰੂਪੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ।
0.e: Firstly, Baba himself was in the form of Timeless and secondly, he had his companion Mardana, the rebeck player.

0.g: ਦਿਤੀ ਬਾਂਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਹਾਨਾ ।
0.e: For namaz (in his own style), Baba gave call, listening to which the whole world went into absolute silence.

0.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਮੁੰਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਭਈ; ਦੇਖਿ ਪੀਰ ਭਇਆ ਹੈਰਾਨਾ ।
0.e: The whole city became quiet and lo! to behold it, the pir (of the town) also got wonderstruck.

0.g: ਵੇਖੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਗਾਇ ਕਰਿ; ਇਕੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਸਤਾਨਾ ।
0.e: Observing minutely he found (in the form of Baba Nanak) an exhilerated faquir.

0.g: ਪੁਛਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਸਤਗੀਰ; ਕਉਣ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਘਰਿਆਨਾ ।
0.e: Pir Dastegir asked him, which category of faquir you belong to and what is your parentage.

0.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ; ਰਬੁ ਫਕੀਰ ਇਕੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾ ।
0.e: (Mardana told) He is Nanak, who has come into kaliyug, and, he recognises God and His faquirs as one.

0.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਆਕਾਸ, ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਨਾ ।੩੫।
0.e: He is known in all the directions besides earth and sky.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮੁ; ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ਮੂੜੀ ।
0.e: As the earth is embodiment of continence, dharma and humility,

0.g: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੀਂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ; ਤਿਸ ਮਣੀ ਨ ਕੂੜੀ ।
0.e: It remains under the feet and this humility is true and not false.

0.g: ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕਰੈ; ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਰੂੜੀ ।
0.e: Somebody constructs temple of god on it and some gather rubbish heaps on it.

0.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ; ਫਲ ਅੰਬ ਲਸੂੜੀ ।
0.e: Whatever is sowed is got accordingly whether is be a mango or lasuri, a glutinous fruit.

0.g: ਜੀਵਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਜੁੜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੂੜੀ ।
0.e: While being dead in life i.e. deleting ego from the self, the gurmukhs join gurmukhs in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਲਤਾਂ ਹੇਠਿ ਲਤਾੜੀਐ; ਗਤਿ ਸਾਧਾਂ ਧੂੜੀ ।੧੯।
0.e: They become the dust of the feet of the holy men, which is trampled under the feet.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਚਾਕਰ ਅਮਲੀ ਸੋਫੀਆਂ; ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਦੀ ਚਉਕੀ ਆਏ ।
0.e: Servants, addict (of the Lord's name) as well as teetotallers devoid of Mitn came to the Lord king's presence.

0.g: ਹਾਜਰ ਹਾਜਰਾਂ ਲਿਖੀਅਨਿ; ਗੈਰ ਹਾਜਰ ਗੈਰਹਾਜਰ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Those present are marked present and those absent are declared absent.

0.g: ਲਾਇਕ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਵਿਰਲੈ ਮਜਲਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦਾਏ ।
0.e: The intelligent king (God) selected a few to be his courtiers.

0.g: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੁਸਿਆਰ ਮਸਤ; ਖੁਸ ਫਹਿਮੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਪਰਚਾਏ ।
0.e: He, a clever person, made both the clever and the indifferent happy and put them to work.

0.g: ਦੇਨਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਅਮਲੀਆਂ; ਸੋਫੀ ਸਭਿ ਪੀਆਵਣ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Now, the so called teetotallers (religious persons) were engaged to serve drinks (nam) to the addicts.

0.g: ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਅਮਲੀ ਹੋਏ; ਪੀ ਪੀ ਚੜ੍ਹੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ।
0.e: The latter became exhilerated in the name of the Lord and attained tranquility

0.g: ਸੂਫੀ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਟਕਰਾਂ; ਪੂਜ ਨਿਵਾਜੈ ਸੀਸ ਨਿਵਾਏ ।
0.e: But the so-called religious persons (teetotallers who served mans to others) remained involved in the so-called prayer and ritualistic worship.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਜਾਬ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁਦੀ ਬਹਸ ਬਹਸਾਏ ।
0.e: They under the tyranny of their religious books, the Vedas and the Katebas, kept busy in arrogant debates and discussions.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ।੮।
0.e: Any rare gurmukh attains the fruit of the delight (of quaffing the drink of Lord's name).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੯
ਆਨੰਤਾ ਕੁਕੋ ਭਲੇ; ਸੋਭ ਵਧਾਵਣ ਹਨਿ ਸਿਰਦਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Ananta and Kuko are good persons who adorn the occasions.

0.g: ਇਟਾ ਰੋੜਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਨਵਲ ਨਿਹਾਲੂ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Ita Arora, Naval and Nihalu ponder upon the Word.

0.g: ਤਖਤੂ ਧੀਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ; ਦਰਗਹੁ ਤੁਲੀ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Takhatu is serious and serne and Daragahu Tuli is always absorbed in remembering the formless Lord.

0.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤੀਰਥੁ ਉਪਲੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Manasadhar is deep and Tirath Uppal is also servant.

0.g: ਕਿਸਨਾ ਝੰਝੀ ਆਖੀਐ; ਪੰਮੂ ਪੁਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Kisana Jhanji and Pammi Puri are also dear to the Guru.

0.g: ਧਿੰਗੜੁ ਮੱਦੂ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਵਡੇ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਤਖਾਣ ਅਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Dhingar and Maddu artisans are carpenters and are very noble persons.

0.g: ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ਤੇ ਪਰਸਰਾਮ; ਬਾਲ ਵੈਦ ਹਉ ਤਿਨਿ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto Banavari and Paras Ram who are experts in paediatrics.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ, ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ।੨੯।
0.e: The supreme Lord sets right the wrongs done to the devotees.

0.g: ਪੁਛੇ ਪੀਰ ਤਕਰਾਰ ਕਰਿ; ਏਹੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਅਤਾਈ ।
0.e: The pir debated and came to know that this faquir is much more powerful.

0.g: ਏਥੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਗਦਾਦ ਦੇ; ਵਡੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ।
0.e: Here in Baghdad he has shown a great miracle.

0.g: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਲਖਿ; ਓੜਕਿ ਭਾਲੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ।
0.e: Meanwhile he (Baba Nanak) talked about myriads of netherworlds and skies.

0.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਦੁਰਾਇਨ ਦਸਤਗੀਰ; ਅਸੀ ਭਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਜੋ ਤੁਹਿ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Pir Dastegir asked (the Baba) to show him whatever he had seen.

0.g: ਨਾਲਿ ਲੀਤਾ ਬੇਟਾ ਪੀਰ ਦਾ; ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਹਵਾਈ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak Dev taking along with him the son of the pir, melted into thin air.

0.g: ਲਖ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਲਖ; ਅਖਿ ਫੁਰਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ।
0.e: And in a wink of eye visualized him the upper and lower worlds.

0.g: ਭਰਿ ਕਚਕੌਲ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਦਾ; ਧਰੋ ਪਤਾਲੋ ਲਈ ਕੜਾਹੀ ।
0.e: From the nether world he brought a bowl full of sacred food and handed it over to pir.

0.g: ਜਾਹਰ ਕਲਾ, ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਈ ।੩੬।
0.e: This manifest power (of the Guru) cannot be made to hide.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਜਿਸੁ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡੇ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ।
0.e: What could be said about the greatness of that great Lord whose one word is beyond all measures.

0.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ; ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: None can know His mystery whose base is only One Gallia. How could His long life be counted whose half a breath is unfathom­able.

0.g: ਅਧਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ; ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਈ ।
0.e: His creation cannot be evaluated; how can then that imperceptible one be beholden (understood).

0.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਕਾਦਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: His gifts such as days and nights are also invalu­able and His other boons are also infinite.

0.g: ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ; ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ।
0.e: Indescribable is the position of the Lord, the master of the masterless,

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਅਲਾਈ ।
0.e: And His unnarratable story can only be concluded by saying neti neti (this is not, this not).

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ, ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਈ ।੧੬।
0.e: Worthy of salutation is only that primeval Lord.

0.g: ਆਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਖਤ ਦੁਹਾਗਨ ਕਉ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਗਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a distressed, divorced woman cannot bear to see or tolerate the loving and happy union of another woman with her husband,

0.g: ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਮੈ ਸੰਜੋਗਨਿ ਕੋ; ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਿੰਗਾਰਿ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a woman separated from her husband and bearing the pangs of separation cannot tolerate the embellishments of another woman who is united with her husband,

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਮਾਂਝਿ ਬਾਂਝਿ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਸੋ ਸ੍ਰਮ; ਸਉਤ ਕੇ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a distressed and fatigued woman suffering from her inability to bear a child feels much distressed on seeing the son of her co-wife,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ; ਸਾਧਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਤ ਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ।੫੧੩।
0.e: Similarly I am infested with three chronic ailments-namely other's women, other's wealth and slander. And that is why praise of the devoted and loving Sikhs of the True Guru does not please me.  (513)

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ; ਤਾਹਿ ਆਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਵਈ ।
0.e: One who is blessed by Satguru with spiritual wisdom, he does not like to see any other form or attraction. Nothing else can give tranquility and peace to such a blessed person.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਮਇਆ ਕੈ ਚਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ; ਤਾਹਿ ਅਨਰਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਿਤਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: One who is blessed with spiritual pleasure by the True Guru, he does not relish any other pleasures.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ।
0.e: A devout Sikh who is blessed with the spiritual pleasure that no one can reach to, he need not run after other worldly relishments.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਵਾਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ।੨੦।
0.e: Only he who is blessed with self-realization (spiritual knowledge) can feel its pleasure and this cannot be explained. The devotee himself can only appreciate the pleasure of that state. (20)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ; ਸੁਕੈ ਜਾਵਾਹਾ ।
0.e: In the month of savan, the whole forest becomes green but javels, a prickly plant remains dry.

0.g: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਰਸਾ ਵਰਸਦੈ; ਝੂਰੇ ਜੋਲਾਹਾ ।
0.e: During rains every one feels delighted but the weaver is seen gloomy.

0.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ; ਚਕਵੀ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ ।
0.e: In the night all the pairs meet but for chakavi , that is the time of separation.

0.g: ਸੰਖੁ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ; ਰੋਵੈ ਦੇ ਧਾਹਾ ।
0.e: The conch remains empty even in the ocean and cries when blown.

0.g: ਰਾਹਹੁ ਉਝੜਿ ਜੋ ਪਵੈ; ਮੁਸੈ ਦੇ ਫਾਹਾ ।
0.e: The man gone astray will definitely be robbed by putting rope around his neck.

0.g: ਤਿਉ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ; ਨਿਤ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹਾ ।੫।
0.e: Similarly, the apostates go on sobbing in this world.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਆਨਪਨ; ਤਊ ਨ ਜਨਨੀ ਅਤੁਗਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a mother ignores many of her son's amateurish deeds and brings him up with love and care.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਗਿਆ ਰਾਖੈ; ਅਨਿਕ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a warrior abides by his woe/pledge in respect of one who comes in his refuge and despite his showing disrespect does not kill him.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ, ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਨ ਬੋਰਤ; ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a log of wood does not sink in river, since it carries a latent respect that he (river) has helped the tree grow by providing it with life-giving water.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਗਤਿ; ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਛੂ ਨਾ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।੩੭੯।
0.e: So is the great benefactor True Guru who like a philosopher stone is capable of turning the Sikhs into gold-like metal. He does not dwell on their erstwhile deeds and by blessing them with Naam Simran, make them virtuous like Himself.  (379)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The life of that Gurmukh is successful who has met the true Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮੁ, ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The Gurmukh who has surrendered before the Guru is a blest one and his fate is perfect one.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ, ਨਾਉ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The true Guru, by giving him place around his feet has made him remember the name (of the Lord).

0.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ, ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Now being detached, he remains at home and maya does not affect him.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਇ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: By putting into practice the teachings of the Guru, he has realised he invisible Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।੩।
0.e: Losing his ego, the Guru-orientated Gurmukh has become liberated though still embodied.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਗਤ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: From their conduct in the world, the Guru-oriented, gurmukhs and mind oriented manmukhs are known sadhus and wicked ones respectively.

0.g: ਦੁਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੇ; ਖਰਬੜ ਹੋਏ ਖੁਦੀ ਖੁਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Out of these two, the mongrels-apparently sadhus but internally thieves--are always in wavering state and, suffering for their ego, go astray.

0.g: ਦੁਹੀਂ ਸਰਾਈਂ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ; ਦਗੇ ਦੁਰਾਹੇ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਗਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Such double-faced thieves, backbiters and cheats remain pale-faced due to their bewilderment in both the worlds.

0.g: ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: They are neither here nor there and, burdened with the load of delusions go on drowing in between and getting suffocated.

0.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Whether Muslim or the Hindu, the manmukh among the gurmukhs is the utter darkness.

0.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ, ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ।੧।
0.e: His head is always loaded with the comings and goings through transmigration of his soul.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਮਈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਪਰਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Guru-blessed Sikh realises the universal presence of God through the total benefaction and kindness of the complete Guru who is manifestation of Supreme God.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ; ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: By absorbing the mind in the form of True Guru and contemplation of Guru's teachings, the Sikh lodges that God in his heart who is one and is present in all.

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਪੇਖਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: By keeping the vision of the eyes in the glimpse of Satguru and tuning the ears to the sound of Guru's utterances, an obedient and devoted Sikh reckons Him as the speaker, listener and watcher.

0.g: ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਠਟ; ਨਟ ਵਟ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।੯੯।
0.e: God who is the cause of the visible and invisible expanse, who is playing the game of the world both as a performer and the apparatus, the mind of a devoted Sikh of Guru gets engrossed in words and teachings of the Guru. (99)

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: A Guru-conscious person strings the word divine in the thread of his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. He acknowledges the presence of omnipresent Lord in the form of soul in every one.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ; ਬਿਹਸਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਸਮਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: He is ever engrossed in the love and faith of the Guru Lord in his mind. He treats all alike and smilingly too.

0.g: ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ; ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: The Guru-conscious person who ever lives in the presence of the True Guru is always humble and has the intellect of being the slave of slaves (of the Guru). And when he speaks, his words are sweet and full of supplication.

0.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ; ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੀਐ ।੧੩੭।
0.e: A Guru-oriented person remembers Him with every breath and stays in Lord's presence like an obedient being. Thus his soul remains absorbed in the treasure house of peace and tranquillity. (137)

0.g: ਬ-ਹਰ ਕੁਜਾ ਕਿ ਰਵੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ਼ ।
0.e: The feed of that pious bird is Akaalpurkah's remembrance,

0.g: ਬ-ਬੁਰਦਾਈ ਦਿਲਿ ਈਮਾਨਿ ਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ਼ ।੪੫।੧।
0.e: His remembrance, only His meditation, yes only His memory. (58)

0.g: ਬਿਆ ਕਿ ਬੁਲਬੁਲੋ ਗੁਲ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਇੰਤਜ਼ਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: Anyone who is (sincerely) devoted to His meditation;

0.g: ਦਮੇ ਬਜਾਨਿਬਿ ਬੁਸਤਾਨਿ ਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ਼ ।੪੫।੨।
0.e: The dust of his path is like a collyrium for our eyes. (59)

0.g: ਨਮਕ ਜ਼ਿ ਲਾਲਿ ਲਬਤ ਰੇਜ਼ ਬਰਦਿਲਿ ਰੇਸ਼ਮ ।
0.e: If you can get attuned to the meditation of Waaheguru,

0.g: ਪਸ਼ੀਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਸੀਨਾਇ ਬਿਰੀਆਨਿ ਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ਼ ।੪੫।੩।
0.e: Then O mind of mine! You should understand that all your difficulties have been solved (solutions to all the problems have been found). (60)

0.g: ਚਿ ਖ਼ੁੱਸ਼ ਬਵਦ ਕਿ ਖ਼ਰਾਮਤ ਕੱਦਤ ਚੂ ਸਰਵਿ ਬੁਲੰਦ ।
0.e: The only solution to every predicament is remembering Akaalpurakh;

0.g: ਦਮੇ ਬਸੂਇ ਗੁਲਿਸਤਾਨਿ ਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ਼ ।੪੫।੪।
0.e: In fact, a rememberer of (the Naam of) Waaheguru conforms himself into the same category as the Waaheguru Himself. (61)

0.g: ਬਿਆ ਬ-ਮਰਦਮਕਿ ਦੀਦਾ ਅਮ ਕਿ ਖ਼ਾਨਾਇ ਤੁਸਤ ।
0.e: In reality, nothing but the Lord Himself is the acceptable Entity;

0.g: ਦਰੂਨਿ ਦੀਦਾਇ ਗਿਰੀਆਨਿ ਮਨ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ ।੪੫।੫।
0.e: O my mind! Who is such a person that does not reflect the radiance of Akaalpurakh from head to toes? (62)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਕੂੜ ਅਹੀਰਾਂ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਹੈ; ਪੰਜ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਨਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: Falsehood is-the village of robbers where reside the five evil legates.

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਤ; ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: These couriers are lust, anger, disputation, greed, infatuation, treachery and ego.

0.g: ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾਣੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗੁ; ਵਰਤੈ ਪਾਪੈ ਦਾ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In this village of wicked company pulls, pushes and sinful conduct always operate.

0.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ; ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਵਡੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Attachment to the others' wealth, slander and woman always persist here

0.g: ਖਲੁਹਲੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ; ਰਾਜ ਡੰਡੁ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Confusions and commotions are ever there and people always undergo punishments of state as well as of death.

0.g: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ; ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣ ਨਰਕਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The residents of this village are always shameful in both the worlds and go on transmigrating in the hell.

0.g: ਅਗੀ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰਾ ।੧੬।
0.e: The fruits of fire are the sparks only.

0.e: The Tenth Guru, Guru Gobind Singh Ji. The Tenth Guru, Guru Gobind Singh Ji, had the capability of twisting the arms of the goddess that overpowered the world. He was sitting on the eternal throne from where he bestowed a special honor to it. He was the one to exhibit the panorama of the nine-lighted torches displaying the 'truth' and annihilating the night of darkness of lies and untruths. The master of this throne was the first and the last monarch who was divinely equipped to visualize the interior and exterior happenings. He was the one to expose the instruments of sacred miracles and to lighten the principles of service for the All-powerful Waaheguru and meditation. His brave victorious tiger-like valiant soldiers would overshadow every place in every instant. His redeeming and emancipating flag was adorned with victory at its borders. The eternal truth-depicting Farsi 'Kaaf' (Gaaf) in his name is the one to overcome and conquer the whole world; the first 'Vaayo' is to connect the positions of the earth and the world. The 'Bay' of immortal life is the one to pardon and bless the refugees; the aroma of the sacred 'Noon' in his name will honor the meditators. The 'Daal' in his name, representing his virtues and gaiety, will break the snare of death and his highly impressive 'Seen' is the asset of life. The 'Noon' in his name is the congregationalist of the Omnipotent; and the second Farsi 'Kaaf' (Gaaf) is the one to decompose the lives of those strayed in the jungles of non-obedience. The last 'Hay' is the true guide to steer to the right path in both the worlds and the big drums of his teachings and command is resounding over the nine skies. People from the three universes and six directions are at his beck and call; Thousands from the four oceans and nine cosmos and millions from the ten directions appreciate and praise his divine court; Millions of Ishars, Brahmaas, Arshes, and Kurshes are anxious to seek his patronage and protection, and millions of earths and skies are his slaves. Hundreds of thousands of suns and moons have earned the blessings of wearing the robes bestowed by him, and millions of skies and universes are captives of his Naam and are suffering from his separation. Similarly, millions of Ramas, Rajas, Kahans and Krishnas are putting the dust of his lotus feet on their foreheads and thousands of the accepted and selected ones are reciting his eclat with their thousands of tongues. Millions of Ishars and Brahmas are his adherents and millions of sacred mothers, the true powers of organizing the earths and the skies, are standing in his service and millions of powers are accepting his commands.

0.e: Reaching back home when asked, he would tell people that he had gone to the door of his king (the Supreme Lord).

0.g: ਘਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੂ ਮੰਗੀਅਨਿ; ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਝਤ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ।
0.e: When his wife asked for some household material he would avoid her and thus spend his time performing spiritual activities.

0.g: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਓਹ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ।
0.e: One day while concentrating on the Lord with single-minded devotion, a strange miracle happened.

0.g: ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਭਗਤ ਦੀ; ਰਾਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਚਲਿ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: To keep the glory of the devotee, God Himself in the form of King went to his house.

0.g: ਦੇਇ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ; ਅਣਗਣਤੀ ਖਰਚੀ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਵੈ ।
0.e: In great joy, He consoled everyone and made available profuse money for expenditure.

0.g: ਓਥਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਸਿ; ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ ।
0.e: From there He came to His devotee Beni and compassionately loved him.

0.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ।੧੪।
0.e: This way He arranges applause for His devotees.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ।
0.e: Kindling the supreme light in his mind a gurmukh remains absorbed in the state of supreme trance.

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ; ਅਨਹਦਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਈ ।
0.e: When he adopts the supreme reality (Lord) in his mind, the unstruck melody starts ringing.

0.g: ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਬੋਧ ਕਰਿ; ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਹਾਈ ।
0.e: Becoming conscious for altruism now resides in his heart the sense of God’s omnipresence.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਅਨਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Inspired by the teachings of the Guru, gurmukh attains the state of fearlessness.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈ ।
0.e: Disciplining himself in the company in the holy ones i.e. losing his ego, he remembers Lord with single-minded devotion.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ; ਇਉਂ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈ ।੫।
0.e: This way, entering from this world into the spiritual world, he finally establishes himself in his real nature.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਲਖ ਚਾਨਣੇ; ਤਿਲ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤੀ ।
0.e: The light of lacs of moons and suns cannot become equal to an iota of the wisdom of the true Guru.

0.g: ਲਖ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਕਾਸ ਲਖ; ਉਚੀ ਨੀਵੀਂ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਨ ਰਤੀ ।
0.e: Millions of nether worlds and millions of skies exist but there is not the slightest maladjustment in their alignment.

0.g: ਲਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਲਖ ਪਉਣ ਮਿਲਿ; ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਨ ਵਤੀ ।
0.e: Lacs of airs and waters join to create moving waves of different hues.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਲੁ; ਲਖ ਪਰਲਉ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਉਤਪਤੀ ।
0.e: Millions of creations and millions of dissolutions continuously alternate without the beginning, middle and end of the process.

0.g: ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਪਰਬਤ ਲਖ ਧਰਤੀ ।
0.e: Lacs of forbearing earths and mountains cannot equate the teachings of the true Guru in perseverance and righteousness.

0.g: ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖ; ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਤਿਲ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ।
0.e: Millions types of knowledges and meditations are not equal to even a particle of the knowledge of the wisdom of Guru (gunnat).

0.g: ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਿਰਣਿ, ਘਣੀ ਘੋਲ ਘਤੀ ।੧੪।
0.e: I have sacrified Lacs of rays of lights for one ray of the meditation upon the Lord.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਬਸਿ ਬਾਂਸ ਮਹਿਮਾਂ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ; ਆਨ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਦੂਰ ਭਏ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਬੋਹੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a bamboo has not known the merits of a sandalwood tree having lived near it, but other trees though far away from it still acquire its fragrance.

0.g: ਦਾਦਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਮੈਂ ਜਾਨੈ ਨ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ; ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਮਧਕਰ ਹੀ ਬਿਮੋਹੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A frog knows not the goodness of a lotus flower though it stays in the same pond, but bumble bees are crazy of the nectar that is stored in these flowers.

0.g: ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਗ ਜਾਨ︀ਯੋ ਨ ਮਰਮ ਕਛੂ; ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਤ੍ਰੀ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੇਤ ਸੋਹੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: An egret living in the waters of river Ganges does not know the importance of that water, but many people come to the river Ganges on a pilgrimage and feel honoured.

0.g: ਨਿਕਟ ਬਸਤ ਮਮ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੀਨ; ਦੂਰ ਹੀ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰ ਲੈ ਪੋਹੇ ਹੈ ।੬੩੯।
0.e: Similarly, though I live near the True Guru, I am bereft of the knowledge of His advice whereas people from far off places come to the True Guru, obtain His sermon and abides it in their heart. (639)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ; ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ।
0.e: Leaving the Guru, the Pleasure Ocean, one tosses up and down in the world-ocean of delusions and deceptions.

0.g: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਅਨਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੂਸੇ ।
0.e: The stroke of the waves of the world-ocean tosses and the fire of ego continuously burns the inner self.

0.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਜਮਦੂਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਧਕੇ ਧੂਸੇ ।
0.e: Tied and beaten at the door of death, one receives the kicks of the messengers of death.

0.g: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ; ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਨਿ ਈਸੇ ਮੂਸੇ ।
0.e: May be some one has named himself after Christ or Moses, but in this world all are to stay for a few days.

0.g: ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ; ਆਪੋ ਧਾਪੀ ਹੈਰਤ ਹੂਸੇ ।
0.e: Here none deems himself lesser one and all are engrossed in the rat race for selfish ends to find themselves shocked ultimately.

0.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ; ਕਰਨਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਖੇਚਲ ਖੂਸੇ ।
0.e: Those who are divers of the pleasure-ocean existing in the form of Guru, only they remain happy in the labour (of spiritual discipline).

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ, ਡਾਂਗ ਡੰਗੂਸੇ ।੧੩।
0.e: Without the true Guru, all are always at loggerheads.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ, ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ।
0.e: The eyes are not satisfied with beholding sights and exhibitions;

0.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ, ਰੋਵਣਿ ਤੈ ਹਾਸੇ ।
0.e: The ears are not satisfied with hearing praise or blame, mourning or rejoicing;

0.g: ਸਾਦੀਂ ਜੀਭ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ, ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ।
0.e: The tongue is not satisfied with eating what affords pleasure and delight;

0.g: ਨਕ ਨ ਰਜਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ, ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੁਵਾਸੇ ।
0.e: The nose is not contented with good or evil odour;

0.g: ਰਜਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ, ਕੂੜੇ ਭਰਵਾਸੇ ।
0.e: Nobody is satisfied with his span of life, and everyone entertains false hopes.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਸਚੀ ਰਹਰਾਸੇ ।੯।
0.e: But the Sikhs are satisfied with the Guru and theirs is the true love and delight.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
0.e: Foolish gets himself entrapped and is a liar

0.g: ਤੋਤਾ ਨਲੀ ਨ ਛਡਈ; ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀਂ ਫਾਥਾ ਚੀਕੈ ।
0.e: The parrot does not leave the rod and caught in it cries and wails.

0.g: ਬਾਂਦਰੁ ਮੁਠਿ ਨ ਛਡਈ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਚੈ ਝੀਕਣੁ ਝੀਕੈ ।
0.e: Monkey too does not leave the handful of corn (in the pitcher) and suffers dancing and gritting its teeth from door to door.

0.g: ਗਦਹੁ ਅੜੀ ਨ ਛਡਈ; ਚੀਘੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਹੀਕਣਿ ਹੀਕੈ ।
0.e: The donkey also when beaten, kicks and brays loudly but does not shed its stubbornness.

0.g: ਕੁਤੇ ਚਕੀ ਚਟਣੀ; ਪੂਛ ਨ ਸਿਧੀ ਧ੍ਰੀਕਣਿ ਧ੍ਰੀਕੈ ।
0.e: The dog does not leave licking the flour mill and its tail though pulled, never turns straight.

0.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਕੁਫਕੜ ਮੂਰਖਾਂ; ਸਪ ਗਏ ਫੜਿ ਫਾਟਨਿ ਲੀਕੈ ।
0.e: The foolish ones boast foolishly and beat the track while the snake has gone away.

0.g: ਪਗ ਲਹਾਇ, ਗਣਾਇ ਸਰੀਕੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Even when humiliated by their turbans taken off their heads, they count themselves superior to their collaterals.

0.g: ਕਊਆ ਜਉ ਮਰਾਲ ਸਭਾ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਮਾਨਸਰ; ਦੁਚਿਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਆਸ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਕੀ ।
0.e: If a crow joins the company of swans on the bank of lake Mansarover (a sacred lake in Himalayas) he will feel morose and in two minds since he cannot find any sullage there.

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਬੈਠਾਈਐ ਸੁਭਗ ਪ੍ਰਜੰਗ ਪਾਰ; ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਾਇ ਚਾਕੀ ਚਾਟੈ ਹੀਨ ਮਤ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ।
0.e: Just as a dog is made to sit on a comfortable bed, being of base wisdom and foolish he will leave it and go to lick millstone.

0.g: ਗਰਧਬ ਅੰਗ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਜਉ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੀਜੈ; ਲੋਟਤ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਕੰਧ ਕੀ ।
0.e: If a donkey is applied with paste of sandalwood, saffron and musk etc., he will still go and roll in the dust as is his character.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੀਤਿ; ਮਨਸਾ ਉਪਾਧ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਕੀ ।੩੮੬।
0.e: Similarly, those of base wisdom and turned away from the True Guru have no love or attraction for the company of saintly persons. They are ever engrossed in creating troubles and doing ill deeds.  (386)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The life of that gurmukh is fortunate whom meeting some Sikh of the Guru has come to the shelter of the Guru.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He bows before primeval Purusa (God) and becomes blessed after having the sight of such a Guru.

0.g: ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਕਰਿ; ਮਸਤਕੁ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: After circumambulation he bows on the lotus feet of Guru.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Becoming kind, the Guru recites true mantra Vaheguru for him.

0.g: ਸਚ ਰਾਸਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਦੇ; ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Sikh with his capital of devotion falls at the feet of Guru and the whole world bows at his feet.

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹਰਿ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: God (the Guru) eradicates his lust, anger and resistance and gets his greed, infatuation and ego erased.

0.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Instead, the Guru makes him practise truth, contentment, dharma, name, charity and ablution.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ, ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।੩।
0.e: Adopting the teachings of the Guru, the individual is called a Sikh of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ, ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Creation, the power of the Lord is unrpproachable and unfathomable.

0.g: ਕਾਦਰੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ, ਕਿਨ ਪਰਚਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Nobody can know its extent. That creator is without any anxiety;how could He be persuaded and amused.

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਗਾਹ, ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ।
0.e: How the majesty of His court could be described.

0.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਸੈ ਰਾਹੁ, ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ।
0.e: None is there to tell the way and means leading to Him.

0.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ, ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ।
0.e: This is also incomprehensible that how infinite are his eulogies and how should He be concentrated upon.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ, ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈਐ ।੧੯।
0.e: The dynamics of the Lord is unmanifest, deep and unfathomable; it cannot be known.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਧਰਤੀ ਉਤੈ ਰੁਖ; ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The tree on the earth has their heads down towards the bottom.

0.g: ਆਪਿ ਸਹੰਦੇ ਦੁਖ; ਜਗੁ ਵਰੁਸਾਇਆ ।
0.e: They endure suffering themselves but pour happiness on the world.

0.g: ਫਲ ਦੇ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਭੁਖ; ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Even on being stoned, they offer fruits and quench our hunger.

0.g: ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਬਹਿ ਸੁਖ; ਮਨੁ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Their shadow is so thick that the mind (and body) enjoys peace.

0.g: ਵਢਨਿ ਆਇ ਮਨੁਖ; ਆਪੁ ਤਛਾਇਆ ।
0.e: If someone cuts them, they offer to be sawed.

0.g: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੀ ਸਨਮੁਖ; ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।੮।
0.e: Rare are the persons like tree who accept the will of Lord.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰ ਧਨੁਖ ਚਲਾਈਅਤ ਬਾਨ ਤਾਨ; ਚਲ︀ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਚਲਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as an arrow is placed in a bow, the bowstring is pulled and arrow released in the direction in which it is intended to go.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਲਗਾਇ ਤਨ ਤੇਜ ਕਰਿ; ਦੋਰ︀ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਆਤੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਹਿਤ ਹੀ ਦਉਰਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as a horse is whipped to make it run faster and agitated, it keeps running in the direction it is made to run

0.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਠਾਂਢੀ ਰਹੈ; ਧਾਵੈ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਿਤ ਹੀ ਪਠਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as an obedient maid-servant keeps standing in attention in front of her mistress, and she hastes away to the direction she is sent,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਗ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਭੂਮ; ਜਤ ਜਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਤਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਖਾਈਐ ।੬੧੦।
0.e: Similarly, an individual keeps wandering on this Earth according to the deeds that he had performed (in previous birth). He goes where he is destined to sustain himself.  (610)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਠੰਢੇ ਖੂਹਹੁੰ ਨ੍ਹਾਇ ਕੈ; ਪਗ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੈ ।
0.e: Having taken bath on the well, a person forgot his turban and returned home bare headed.

0.g: ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਨਾਂ ਕਮਲੀਆਂ; ਧੁਸੀ ਲੀਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਢੰਗੈ ।
0.e: Seeing his improper conduct (of being bare headed) the silly women started weeping and wailing (Seeing turbanless master of the house they conjectured the death of some one in the family).

0.e: How much one may praise the True Guru, the embodiment of the complete God on the Earth, is still not enough. It is futile to say in words because He is infinite, limitless and fathomless.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਮਈ; ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਹੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: True Guru the embodiment of all-pervading Lord is completely manifested in all living beings. Then who should be cursed and slandered? He is worthy of salutation again and again.

0.g: ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਬਿਵਰਜਤ ਅਸੁਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: And it is for this reason that a Guru-conscious person is forbidden to praise or slander anyone. He remains engrossed in the contemplation of the indescribable True Guru of unique form.

0.g: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਭਏ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਹੈ ।੨੬੨।
0.e: A disciple of the Guru advances towards the state of living dead by leading a life of childlike innocence and discarding all external adorations. But he is ever alert and conscious of mind in a strange way. (262)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਜਿਉ ਚਰਖਾ ਅਠਖੰਭੀਆ; ਦੁਹਿ ਲਠੀ ਦੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੰਝੇਰੂ ।
0.e: The eight board spinningwheel moves between two upright posts.

0.g: ਦੁਇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਿਰ ਗਿਰਦਾਨ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਖ ਫੇਰੂ ।
0.e: Both ends of its axle are thrust in the holes in the middle of two post and on the force of its neck the wheel is turned innumerable times.

0.g: ਬਾਇੜੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੇਟੀਐ; ਮਾਲ੍ਹ ਵਟਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਟ ਘੇਰੂ ।
0.e: The two sides are secured by a fastening cord and a string belt encircles the wheel and the spindle.

0.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਚਰਮਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਤ੍ਰਕੁਲਾ; ਕਤਨਿ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ ਚਿੜੀਆਂ ਹੇਰੂ ।
0.e: Two pieces of leather hold the spindle around which the girls spin sitting in groups.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿੰਞਣਿ ਬਹਿ ਉਠ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ; ਜਿਉ ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਉਡਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ।
0.e: Sometimes they would suddenly stop spinning and leave as birds fly from the tree (the double-minded person is also like these girls or birds and changes his mind abruptly).

0.g: ਓੜਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੂ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ; ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ਗੇਰੂ ।
0.e: Ochre colour which is temporary one, does not give company up to the last i.e. it fades away after sometime.

0.g: ਘੁੰਮਿ ਘੁਮੰਦੀ, ਛਾਉ ਘਵੇਰੂ ।੫।
0.e: The double-minded person (also) is like a moving shadow which does not stick to one place

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ; ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਹੈ ਦੇ ਪੁਤੈ ।
0.e: The son of a banker served Mahadev and got a boon (of attaining wealth).

0.g: ਦਰਬੁ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਰੇਵੜੈ; ਆਏ ਵੜੇ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਤੈ ।
0.e: Wealth came to his house in the guise of sadhus of gramanic tradition.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਹਥਿਆਰੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦਰਬ ਹੋਇ ਧੜਧੁਤੈ ।
0.e: As they were beaten, heaps of money emerged there in his house.

0.g: ਬੁਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਡਿਠਿਓਨੁ; ਨਾਈ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੁਤੈ ।
0.e: A barber working in the house also saw this scene and he becoming restive lost his sleep.

0.g: ਮਾਰੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਰੇਵੜੇ; ਸੁਣਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਅਛੁਤੈ ।
0.e: Availing an opportunity he killed all the sadhus and the matter of the innocent victims came to the court of law.

0.g: ਮਥੈ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਆ; ਵਾਲ ਛਡਾਇਅਨਿ ਕਿਸ ਦੈ ਬੁਤੈ ।
0.e: Catching hold from his hair he was thrashed. Now by what power he will give rescued from that clutch.

0.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਬੀਉ, ਕੁਰੁਤੈ ।੧੭।
0.e: The foolish sows seeds out of season (and suffers loss).

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੌ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਹੂ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ; ਪਰਮ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: O my True Guru! I am seeing your beautiful face in my eyes, and if I ever attempt to see anything else with them, then bless me with your wonderful form for me to see all the times.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਨਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ।
0.e: I am listening your elixir-like words in my ears; and if I ever desire to hear anything else with these ears, then bless me with hearing of unstruck tune of Naam Simran perpetually.

0.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਮੈ ਰਟਤ ਜੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਹੂੰ ਰਸੇ ਚਾਹੈ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੁਆਇ ਕੈ ਚਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: My tongue is continuously recalling Lord's name and if my tongue desires to relish some other elixir, then please bless me with perpetual flow of elixir-like Naam (in my tenth door).

0.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਯਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ; ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ।੬੨੨।
0.e: O my Great True Guru! Be clement on me and reside in my heart for ever. Please stop my wandering mind going all over and then engross it in high spiritual state.  (622)

0.g: ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਦਾ; ਬਾਹਲੇ ਪੂਰ ਮਾਣਸ ਮੋਹਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Only one person ferries across many a man.

0.g: ਆਗੂ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਦਾ; ਲਸਕਰ ਸੰਗ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The one commander of the imperial army gets the whole task executed.

0.g: ਫਿਰੈ ਮਹਲੈ ਪਾਹਰੂ; ਹੋਇ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ਸਵਨਿ ਪਰਧਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Because of only one watchman in the locality, all the rich persons sleep free from any anxiety.

0.g: ਲਾੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਵੀਵਾਹੀਐ; ਬਾਹਲੇ ਜਾਞੀਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Guests in the marriage party remain many but the marriage is solemnised of one person.

0.g: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਲਕ ਵਿਚਿ; ਹੋਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The emperor in the country happens to be one and the rest are the public in the forms of Hindus and Muslims.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Similarly the true Guru Emperor is one and the holy congregation and the Guru word-sabad are His identification marks.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਣੈ, ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ।੨੧।੫।
0.e: I sacrifice myself unto them who seek the shelter of the true Guru.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਕੂਪ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਜਤਨ ਕੀਏ; ਸੀਚੀਅਤ ਖੇਤ ਏਕੈ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as water from a well can be drawn by different methods, such as bucket and rope, Persian wheel etc. and then it is directed to irrigate a field and it goes nowhere else.

0.g: ਪਥਿਕ ਪਪੀਹਾ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਢਿਗ ਬੈਠਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਉ ।
0.e: A traveller and a rain-bird may keep on sitting thirsty near a well but cannot quench their thirst without means to draw water from the well and therefore cannot assuage their thirst.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ; ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਏ ਦੇਤ ਫਲ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Likewise, all gods and goddesses can do something within their power. They can reward a devotee for his services only to that extent and that too of worldly desires.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਿਤਿ; ਬਰਖ ਹਰਖਿ ਦੇਤ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਉ ।੪੫੧।
0.e: But the complete and perfect God-like True Guru showers the spiritual pleasure-giving ambrosial nectar of Naam, the treasure-house of all the happiness and comforts. (The service of gods and goddesses is trivial in benefits whereas that of True Guru bless

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਗਹੇ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਪੰਥ ਮੇਟੇ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Treading the path of Guru's percepts, a Sikh is freed from the fear of death. By keeping company of the holy Sangat (congregation) even vices like lust, anger, avarice, attachment and pride are shed.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਏ; ਦਰਸ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਕੰਟਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By taking the refuge of Satguru, one destroys all effects of the past deeds. And beholding the God-like form of Satguru, the fear of death disappears.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਵੇਸ ਬਜ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੂਰਛਤ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Abiding by the sermons of the Satguru, all desires and apprehensions vanish. By engrossing the mind in the holy words of the Guru, the mammon-gripped unconscious mind becomes alert.

0.g: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਏ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਹੈ ।੫੭।
0.e: Even a subtle element of grace of the Satguru is no less than all the worldly treasures. By engrossing the mind in the word and Naam blessed by the Satguru, one achieves salvation while still alive and living life. (57)

0.g: ਬੇ ਤੂ ਆਲਮ ਜੁਮਲਾ ਹੈਰਾਨਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।
0.e: These two worlds are under the (constant) command of the true Waaheguru,

0.g: ਸੀਨਾ ਅਜ਼ ਹਿਜਰਿ ਤੂ ਬਿਰਯਾਣਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।੩੯।੧।
0.e: And, the divine messengers and prophets are willing to sacrifice themselves for Him. (26)

0.g: ਤਾਲਿਬ ਮੌਲਾ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਾ ਅਸਤ ।
0.e: Any one who become firm practitioner of meditation of (Naam of) Akaalpurakh

0.g: ਬਰ ਜ਼ਬਾਨਸ਼ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਬਹਾਨ ਅਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।੩੯।੨।
0.e: As long as the Entity exists, he, too, becomes immortal. (27)

0.g: ਖਾਲਿ ਮੁਸ਼ਕੀਨਸ਼ ਦਿਲਿ ਆਲਮ ਰਬੂਦ ।
0.e: Both these worlds are just a ray of the radiance and splendor of Waaheguru,

0.g: ਕੁਫ਼ਰਿ ਜ਼ੁਲਫ਼ਸ਼ ਦਾਮਿ ਈਮਾਨਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।੩੯।੩।
0.e: The moon and the sun, both serve Him as His torch-bearers. (28)

0.g: ਜ਼ੂਦ ਬਿਨੁਮਾ ਆਣ ਰੁਖਿ ਚੂੰ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬ ।
0.e: The achievements in this world are nothing but a constant and severe headache,

0.g: ਈਣ ਇਲਾਜਿ ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਗਿਰੀਆਨਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।੩੯।੪।
0.e: Anyone who becomes oblivious of the Trinity is either a bull or a donkey. (29)

0.g: ਦਿਲ ਨਿਸਾਰੀ ਕਾਮਤਿ ਰਾਅਨਾਈਇ ਊ ।
0.e: To be careless, negligent, sluggish and apathetic of the memory of Akaalpurakh even for a moment is equivalent to hundreds of deaths.

0.g: ਜਾਣ ਫ਼ਿਦਾਈ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਾਣ ਨਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।੩੯।੫।
0.e: For those enlightened and knowledgeable ones of Waaheguru, His meditation and remembrance is indeed the real life. (30)

0.g: ਗਰ ਬਿ-ਪੁਰਸੀ ਹਾਲਿ ਗੋਯਾ ਯੱਕ ਨਫ਼ਸ ।
0.e: Every moment that is spent in remembering Akaalpurakh,

0.g: ਈਣ ਇਲਾਜਿ ਦਰਦਿ ਹਰਮਾਨਸਤੋ ਬਸ ।੩੯।੬।
0.e: Builds permanent foundations with Him. (31)

0.g: ਬਾਯਸ ਉਡਹ ਬਲ ਜਾਉ ਬੇਗ ਮਿਲੌ ਪੀਯ; ਮਿਟੈ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਯੋਗ ਕੋ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto you 0 Crow! go and convey my message to my beloved to come and meet me soon so as to allay my sufferings, distresses and pangs of separation;

0.g: ਅਵਧ ਬਿਕਟ ਕਟੈ ਕਪਟ ਅੰਤਰ ਪਟ; ਦੇਖਉ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਕੋ ।
0.e: O my beloved! separated from you, the life has become hard to spend. I am living in ignorance. Then how will I ever get the opportunity of uniting with my husband Lord to relish His love for ever?

0.g: ਲਾਲ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਭ ਲਗਨ ਸਗਨ ਭਲੇ; ਹੋਇ ਨ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦ ਬੇਦ ਲੋਕ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Time and omen appear auspicious, yet the dear beloved is not coming. Hopefully the cause of the delay in His arrival is not my worldly attachments.

0.g: ਅਤਿਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ ਭਈ ਅਧਿਕ ਔਸੇਰ ਲਾਗੀ; ਧੀਰਜ ਨ ਧਰੌ ਖੋਜੌ ਧਾਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ।੫੭੧।
0.e: O my dear beloved! much delay has taken place in meeting with You and I am very anxious and impatient to meet You. I can hold on to my patience no more. Should I then dress up as a (female) yogi and search You?  (571)

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The female living being (jeev Istri) who has found favour with the True Guru Master the manifest form of the Lord, becomes virtuous and praiseworthy due to the blessing of spiritual beauty to her. That truly is called the beauty.

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਾਨਕ ਬਧੂ ਬਨਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਬਨਤਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: She who is loved by her beloved master, is made into a highly adorable bride by Him. One who is ever engrossed in the hue of Lord's meditation is truly a blessed married woman.

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਬੈ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੀਲ ਕੈ ਸੁਸੀਲੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The (seeker) female living being who gains the favour of her beloved master has all her desires fulfilled by Him. By virtue of her superior nature, she is well behaved and that makes her famous as beautiful lady in the true sense.

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਲੈ ਪੀਆਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਰਸਕ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਹੈ ।੨੦੯।
0.e: The seeker woman who is liked by dear True Guru, she is blessed with relishing the Nam elixir of Lord's love. One who drinks deep the divine elixir is loved one in the true sense. (209)

0.g: ਸਰਪ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੈ ਖਰਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤਹਾ ਜਉ ਸਰਪ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਹੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: If for the fear of snake, one takes shelter of Garud and yet the snake comes and bite there, how can one survive then?

0.g: ਜੰਬਕ ਸੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੈ; ਤਹਾਂ ਜਉ ਜੰਬਕ ਹਰੈ ਕਹੋ ਕਹਾਂ ਕੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: For the fear of a Jackal, if one takes refuge of a lion what can be done if jackal comes and kills there ?

0.g: ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਚਾਂਪੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਰ ਸਮੇਰ ਸਿੰਧ; ਤਹਾਂ ਜਉ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਹਿ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੀਜੀਐ ।
0.e: Distressed by poverty if someone goes and takes refuge in a gold mine, Sumer mountain or ocean-the treasure-house of diamonds; and if he is still distressed by poverty, then who should be blamed?

0.g: ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਕੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਗਹੈ; ਤਹਾਂ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਉਨ ਓਟ ਲੀਜੀਐ ।੫੪੫।
0.e: In order to liberate oneself from the wandering and effect of the deeds performed, one takes the support of True Guru. And if even then the cycle of deeds and actions do not end, then whose refuge should be sought.  (545)

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਪੈਡਾ ਜਾਇ ਚਲ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੈਡਾ ਆਗੇ ਹੋਇ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A disciple who walks one step towards Guru to take his refuge and goes to him with devotion and humility, Guru advances to receive him (devotee) by taking million steps.

0.g: ਏਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ; ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਾਰੰਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He who unites with the Lord by remembering the incantation of the Guru even once, the True Guru remembers him millions of time.

0.g: ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਕਉਡੀ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਾਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He who makes an offering of even a shell before the True Guru with loving worship and faith, the True Guru blesses him with the countless treasures of invaluable wealth that is Naam.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਹੈ ।੧੧੧।
0.e: The True Guru is a repository of compassion that is beyond description and understanding. Therefore myriad salutations to Him because there is no one else like Him. (111)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਕਪਾਹਿ; ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Accepting the will of the Lord, cotton suffers a lot.

0.g: ਵੇਲਣਿ ਵੇਲ ਵਿਲਾਇ; ਤੁੰਬਿ ਤੁੰਬਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Having been ginned through the roller, it is carded.

0.g: ਪਿੰਞਣਿ ਪਿੰਜ ਫਿਰਾਇ; ਸੂਤੁ ਕਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Having carded it, its yarn is spun.

0.g: ਨਲੀ ਜੁਲਾਹੇ ਵਾਹਿ; ਚੀਰੁ ਵੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Then the weaver with the help of his reed, eaves it into cloth.

0.g: ਖੁੰਬ ਚੜਾਇਨਿ ਬਾਹਿ; ਨੀਰਿ ਧੁਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The washerman puts that cloth into his boiling cauldron and then washes it on a stream.

0.g: ਪੈਨ੍ਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ; ਸਭਾ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: Putting on the same clothes, the rich and the kings adorn the assemblies.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਰਜਿ ਆਥਵੈ; ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਚਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Once the son sets in the evening stars twinkle in the dark night.

0.g: ਸਾਹ ਸਵਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਚੋਰ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਹਣੈਹਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Rich people sleep in their homes but the thieves move around to commit thefts.

0.g: ਜਾਗਨਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਹਰੂ; ਰੂਆਇਨਿ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ।
0.e: A few guards remain awake and go on shouting to alert others.

0.g: ਜਾਗਿ ਜਗਾਇਨਿ ਸੁਤਿਆਂ; ਸਾਹ ਫੜੰਦੇ ਚੋਰ ਚਗਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Those awakened watchmen make sleeping people awake and this way they catch hold of thiefs and vagabonds.

0.g: ਜਾਗਦਿਆਂ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ; ਸੁਤੇ ਘਰ ਮੁਸਨਿ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Those who remain awake protect their homes but the house is looted of those who go on sleeping.

0.g: ਸਾਹ ਆਏ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ।
0.e: The rich men handing over the thieves (to the authorities), happily return home but caught from their necks the thieves are beaten hollow.

0.g: ਭਲੇ ਬੁਰੇ, ਵਰਤਨਿ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ।੭।
0.e: The evil and the meritorious both are active in this world.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਅਖੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ; ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਸੈ ।
0.e: He who sees from inside the eyes, is in fact beholden outside also.

0.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਸੁਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਿਸੈ ।
0.e: He is described through words and He is illumined in the consciousness.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ; ਮਨੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਸਲਿਸੈ ।
0.e: For the fragrance of the lotus feet of the Guru, the mind, becoming the black bee, enjoys the pleasure.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ।
0.e: Whatever is attained in the holy congregation, he gets not away from it.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਹੈ; ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਸੈ ।
0.e: By putting the mind into the teachings of the Guru, the mind itself changes according to the wisdom of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: The true Guru is the form of that transcendental Brahm who is beyond all the qualities.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾਂ; ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Hinduism put up expositions of the four varnas, six philosophies, Shastras, Bedas and Puranas.

0.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ; ਦੇਵ ਸਥਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: People worship gods and goddesses and undertake pilgrimage of holy place.

0.g: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਅਪਛਰਾਂ; ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣ ਛਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Within Hinduism are defined ganas, gandharvas, fairies, Indra, Indrasan, the throne of Indra.

0.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ; ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Yetis, satis, contented men, siddhas, naths and incarnations of God are included in it.

0.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ; ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਪੁਜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Modes of worship through recitation, penances, continence, burnt offerings, fasts, dos, don’ts, and oblations are there in it.

0.g: ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕ; ਪਿਤਰ ਕਰਮ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Hairknot, sacred thread, rosary, (sandal) mark on forehead, last rites for ancestors, rituals for gods are (also) prescribed in it.

0.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ, ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।੭।
0.e: The teaching of virtuous alms – giving is repeated in it time and again.

0.g: ਖਾਧੀ ਖੁਣਸਿ ਜੋਗੀਸਰਾਂ; ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰਨਿ, ਸਭੇ ਉਠਿ ਆਈ ।
0.e: All the yogis getting irritated grouped together and came forward to have a debate.

0.g: ਪੁਛੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੰਗਰਨਾਥੁ; ਤੁਹਿ ਦੁਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਿਉ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: Yogi Bhangar Nath asked, (Why have you put vinegar in milk?)

0.g: ਫਿਟਿਆ ਚਾਟਾ ਦੁਧ ਦਾ; ਰਿੜਕਿਆ ਮਖਣੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਈ ।
0.e: The spoiled milk cannot be churned into butter.

0.g: ਭੇਖ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਦਾ; ਵਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਚਲਾਈਂ ।
0.e: How have you put off yogic garb and attired yourself in a household way.

0.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖੇ, ਭੰਗਰਿਨਾਥ; ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਉ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਆਹੀ ।
0.e: Said Nanak, (O Bhangar Nath, your mother-teacher is unmannerly)

0.g: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਤਿਓਨਿ; ਭਾਇ ਕੁਚਜੇ ਫੁਲੁ ਸੜਾਈ ।
0.e: She has not cleansed the innerself of your body-pot and your clumpsy thoughts have burnt your flower (of knowledge which was to become fruit).

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤਿ ਤਜਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਉਨਹੁ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: You, while distancing and repudiating house hold life, go again to those householders for begging.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਿਤੇ, ਕਛੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਈ ।੪੦।
0.e: Except their offerings you don’t get anything.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਬਦ ਸਤਿ; ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: True Lord (Satguru) is truth. His word is truth. His holy congregation is truth but this truth is realized only when one presents oneself before the True Lord (Satguru).

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Contemplation on His vision is truth. Union of consciousness with Guru's word is truth. Company of the Sikhs of the Guru is truth but all this reality can be accepted only by becoming an obedient Sikh.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ; ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਥਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Vision of the True Guru is like vision and meditation of Lord. The sermon of the True Guru is the divine knowledge. The congregation of the Sikhs of the True Guru is the abode of the Lord. But this truth can only be realised when love resides in the mind.

0.g: ਸਤਿਰੂਪ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ।੧੫੧।
0.e: The remembrance of the eternal and true name of the True Lord is contemplation and awareness of the True Guru. But this can only be realised after becoming bereft of all lusts and worldly desires and raising the soul to a higher realm. (151)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਗਲੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜਿਚਰੁ ਮੁਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ।
0.e: So long as a tasty object enters not the mouth, mere talking about taste cannot bring any joy.

0.g: ਮੁਹੁ ਭਰਿਐ ਕਿਉਂ ਬੋਲੀਐ; ਰਸ ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਲੀ ।
0.e: When holding the object the mouth is full of taste and tongue full of delight, how could one speak?

0.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਉਲੰਘਿ; ਨਹਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ।
0.e: Going past the stage of recitation those whose consciousness gets merged in the Word, do not see anything except the Lord.

0.g: ਪੰਥੁ ਕੁਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਅਲਮਸਤ ਖਿਆਲੀ ।
0.e: For the people drenched in love, good or bad ways have not meaning.

0.g: ਡਗਮਗ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਢਾਲ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ।
0.e: Wobbling gait of the person full of love for the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat) looks distinctly beautiful.

0.g: ਚੜਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਲੁਕਈ; ਢਕਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੁਨਾਲੀ ।੬।
0.e: Now the moon emerged in the sky of heart cannot remain hidden in spite of efforts to cover its light with flour kneading basin.

0.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਮੈ ਨ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਆਵਤ ਸਬੈ; ਕਾਹੂ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਬਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: All pilgrims on pilgrimage are not alike. But when a rare hermit of higher spiritual state enjoins them, the sins of all of them perish.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਲ ਹੋਤ; ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪਾਛੇ ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As all soldiers in a king's army are not equally valiant, but together under a brave and courageous general they become a force to reckon with.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਜਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਸੈ; ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a ship leads the other ships to the safety of the shore through tumultuous ocean, many passengers of these ship also reach the safety of the other end.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਆਰ; ਸਨਮੁਖ ਓਟ ਗਹੇ ਕੋਟ ਬਿਆਸਾਤ ਹੈ ।੩੬੨।
0.e: Similarly, there are numerous teachers and disciples at the worldly level, but one who has taken the refuge of the True Guru, an embodiment of the Lord, millions sail across the worldly ocean with his support. (362)

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: The enlightened mind of the Sikhs drinks and digests the unbearable cup of the love of the Lord.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Armed with the knowledge of the Brahm, they meditate upon the transcendental Brahm.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣ ਹੋਇ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Merging their consciousness in the Word-sabad, they recite the indescribable story of the Word-the Guru.

0.g: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖਹੁਂ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ; ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They are competent to see incomprehensible pace of the past, present and future.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲੁ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Never deluding fruit of joy, the gurmukhs get, and with grace of the God, kind to devotees, they rather delude the evil propensities.

0.g: ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ; ਇਕਸ ਪਿਛੇ ਲਖ ਤਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They work as a boat in the world-ocean and ferry across the millions who follow one gurmukh, the Guru-oriented person.

0.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ, ਮਿਲਨਿ ਹਸੰਦੇ ।੧੪।
0.e: The altruist Sikhs always come up smiling.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Those gurmukhs are acclaimed who have found the true Guru.

0.g: ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ, ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Practising the Word, they have emancipated their whole families.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs have the Will of God and they work according to the truth.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ, ਆਪ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Eschewing ego, they obtain the door of liberation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ, ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The gurmukhs have made the mind understand the principle of altruism.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The base of gurmukhs is truth and they (finally) get absorbd into truth.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਲੋਕਾਰੁ, ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs are not scared of public opinion

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।੨੦।
0.e: And this way they visualise that imperceptible Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ।
0.e: By remaining in and around the lotus feet, the gurmukh receives the light of the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ; ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਮਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Worshipping the feet and becoming the dust of the feet one becomes detached , immortal and indestructible .

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਆਚਮਾਨ; ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Drinking the ash of the feet of gurmukhs, freedom from all physical mental and spiritual ailments is attained.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Through the wisdom of the Guru they lose, their ego and do not get absorbed in maya.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Absorbing their consciousness in the word, they reside in the true abode (holy congregation) of the formless one.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ ।
0.e: The tale of the servants of the Lord is unfathomable ineffable and Manifest.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ।੧੮।
0.e: Remaining indifferent to hopes is the pleasure fruit of the Gurmukhs.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਨ ਬੋਰਤ; ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the water of streams and rivers does not sink the wood, it (water) has the shame of the fact that it has irrigated and brought the wood up;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਆਨ ਪਨ; ਤਊ ਨ ਜਨਨੀ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਉਰਧਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a son commits many mistakes but his mother who has given him birth never recounts them (she still keeps loving him).

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰੰਨ ਸੂਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਗਿਆ ਰਾਖੈ; ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a culprit who may have myriad vices is not killed by a brave warrior in whose refuge he may have come, the warrior protects him and thus fulfils his virtuous traits.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਗਤਿ; ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।੫੩੬।
0.e: Similarly the supreme benevolent True Guru does not dwell on any of the faults of His Sikhs. He is like touch of philosopher-stone (True Guru removes dross of the Sikhs in His refuge and makes them gold-like precious and pure).   (536)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗ; ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤਰੁਵਰੁ ਪਰਬਤ ਸਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Four mines of life, four speeches and four Ages included, the Lord created water, earth, trees, and mountains.

0.g: ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਅ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਣ; ਕਰਿ ਇਕੀਹ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ।
0.e: The one Lord created the three worlds, fourteen spheres and many universes.

0.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੀਪ ਸਤ; ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਜਣਿ ਵਾਜੇ ।
0.e: For Him the musical instruments are being played at in all the ten directions, seven continents and nine divisions of the universe.

0.g: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਖਾਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਇਕੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲਖ ਉਪਾਜੇ ।
0.e: From each originating source, twenty-one lacs of creatures have been produced.

0.g: ਇਕਤ ਇਕਤ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤੁ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Then in each species innumerable creatures exist.

0.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਕਰਿ; ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਗਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Incomparable forms and hues then appearnd in variegated waves (of life).

0.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ, ਘਰੁ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ।੩।
0.e: Bodies formed by the association of air and water, have nine doors each.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਸਿੰਚ ਸਿੰਚ ਕਾਸਟ ਸਮਥ ਕੀਨੇ; ਜਲ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਪੁਨ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as wood is strengthened by drenching it in water for long and then its relation with water by which a faith develops that water will not sink the wood since it has brought it, up; ships are made with it that sail across the sea.

0.g: ਪਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਸਟ ਸ੍ਰੀਖੰਡ ਹੋਤ; ਮਲਯਾਗਿਰ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁ ਮੰਡ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The fragrance of sandalwood of Malay mountain causes happiness. The woods and plants that have been touched by that fragrant breeze also acquire the fragrance of sandalwood.

0.g: ਪਾਵਕ ਪਰਸ ਭਸਮੀ ਕਰਤ ਦੇਹ ਗੇਹ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The same wood reduces houses to ashes when it unites with fire. It also consumes friends, enemies and the whole world.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਵ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ।੬੨੫।
0.e: Just as wood deals differently with water, wind and fire similarly, human soul deals with three characteristics (Rajo, Tamo, Sato) differently that determine the nature of human beings. But by meeting with God-like True Guru and practicing his blessed tea

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਉਚਾ ਲੰਮਾ ਝਾਟੁਲਾ; ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਗ ਦਿਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Tall, high and luxuriant, the silk cotton tree is seen in the garden.

0.g: ਮੋਟਾ ਮੁਢੁ ਪਤਾਲਿ ਜੜਿ; ਬਹੁ ਗਰਬ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: It is proud of its stout trunk and deep roots.

0.g: ਪਤ ਸੁਪਤਰ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਵਿਸਥਾਰੁ ਬਣੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Its beautiful green leaves enhance its spread.

0.g: ਫੁਲ ਰਤੇ ਫਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ; ਹੋਇ ਅਫਲ ਫਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: But because of its red flowers and insipid fruit it fructifies in vain.

0.g: ਸਾਵਾ ਤੋਤਾ ਚੁਹਚੁਹਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Seeing it, the chirping green parrot gets deluded

0.g: ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ; ਓਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦਾ ।੧੦।
0.e: But repents afterwards because it gets no fruit on that tree.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs having the desire of the fruits of delight with all love wash the feet of the guru.

0.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੁਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ; ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਪਿਆਲੇ ।
0.e: They make cups of the nectar of lotus feet and quaff it with complete delight.

0.g: ਕਉਲਾਲੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਮੁਖੀ; ਲਖ ਕਵਲ ਖਿੜਦੇ ਰਲੀਆਲੇ ।
0.e: Considering the feet of the Guru as sum they blossom like lotus.

0.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਖੀ ਹੁਇ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ; ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਮੀਆਲੇ ।
0.e: Again becoming water lily attracted towards moon, they enjoy nectar from the lotus feet.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ; ਲਖ ਸੂਰਜ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਭਉਰ ਕਾਲੇ ।
0.e: To have the fragrance of the lotus feet many suns become black bees.

0.g: ਲਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੂਰਜਿ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ; ਜਿਉ ਛਪਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਆਪ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Wen the sun rises, myriad stars, unable to maintain themselves, hide.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦਲਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਲਖ ਸੂਰਜਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਰਵਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Likewise with the light of petals of lotus feet, myriad suns are concealed.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ, ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ।੬।
0.e: Receiving the teaching of the Guru, the disciples have themselves become the house of all pleasures.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗਦ ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਫਲਿਆ ।
0.e: From the limb of Guru (Nanak) the tree of nector fruits in the name of Guru Angad has flourished.

0.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਈਅਨੁ; ਦੀਵੇ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲਿਆ ।
0.e: As a lamp lits another lamp, with the light (of Guru Nanak), the flame (of Guru Angad) has been lit.

0.g: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ; ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੀ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਿਆ ।
0.e: The diamond has cut (to shape) the diamond as if through magic, the undeceivable (Baba Nanak) has brought under control the simple_minded one (Guru Angad)

0.g: ਕੋਇ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ; ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਰਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Now they connot be distinguished as if water has mingled with water.

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ; ਸਚੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਹੁ ਢਲਿਆ ।
0.e: The Truth is always beautiful and in the die of truth he (Guru Angad) has moulded himself.

0.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਹੈ; ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਨ ਹਲੈ ਹਲਿਆ ।
0.e: His throne is immovable and kingdom everlasting ; they connot be moved in spite of efforts.

0.g: ਸਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਉਪਿਆ; ਸਚ ਟਕਸਾਲਹੁ ਸਿਕਾ ਚਲਿਆ ।
0.e: The ture word has been handed over ( to Guru Angad) by the Guru (Nanak) as if the coin has been issued from the mint

0.g: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਭ; ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਏ ਖਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Now siddhs naths and incarnations (of gods) etc have stood before him with folded hands

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਅਟਲੁ, ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ।੮।
0.e: And this command is true,immutable and inevitable.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜ ਤਨ ਜੰਬੁਕ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੋਤ; ਖਗ ਪਤ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਹਾਰਤ ਕਾਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a cub becomes subservient to a jackal or a Garud (Ardea argala) bows to a crow.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਹ ਕੇਤ ਬਸ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਰਿਤਰ; ਸੋਭ ਨ ਅਰਕ ਬਨ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as Sun and Moon resides in the houses of Rahu and Ketu (the two unfriendly mythological demons), or Kalapbrichh the all giving tree of heavens does not fit into the jungle of Calotropis procera.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਸੁਤ ਸੂਕਰੀ ਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ; ਐਰਾਪਤ ਸੁਤ ਗਰਧਬ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a calf of ever milk-yielding cow (Kamdhenu) sucks the teats of a she pig, or the young one of Airawat the elephant of god Inder keeps bowing before a donkey.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਤ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ; ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਬੰਸ ਮੈ ਬਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ।੪੭੭।
0.e: Similarly, if son of a Guru's Sikh starts worshipping gods and goddesses, his human birth would be a failure just as a son of two fathers would be in a respectable family.  (477)

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the Grace of the divine preceptor

0.g: ਵਾਰ ੪ ।
0.e: Vaar Four

0.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਧਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Oankar transforming into forms created air, water and fire.

0.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ; ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਦੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Then separating earth and sky He threw two flames of sun and moon in between them.

0.g: ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ; ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ।
0.e: Further creating the four mines of life He created eighty four lacs of species and their animalcules.

0.g: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ ।
0.e: In each species further are born myriads of creatures.

0.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣ ਉਧਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Among them all, the human birth is the rare one. One should, in this very Birth, liberate himself by surrendering before the Guru.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵ; ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: One must go to holy congregation; the consciousness should be merged in the word of the Guru and cultivating only a loving devotion, one should undertake to follow the path shown by the Guru.

0.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ, ਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ।੧।
0.e: The man by becoming altruist becomes beloved of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨
ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੀਪਾ ਕਾਸਰਾ; ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ।
0.e: An obedient Sikh named Dipa of Kasara caste was a lamp at the door of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਟੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਉਧਰੀ; ਢਿਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਲੰਗਾਹੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: In the town of Patti, Bhai lal and Bhai Langah of Dhillon caste are well seated.

0.g: ਅਜਬੁ ਅਜਾਇਬੁ ਸੰਙਿਆ; ਉਮਰਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Ajab, Ajaib and Umar belonging to Sangha caste are the servants (masands) of the Guru.

0.g: ਪੈੜਾ ਛਜਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਕੰਦੂ ਸੰਘਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Paira is of Chhajal caste and Kandu belongs to Sanghar caste. They greet everybody with a warming smile.

0.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਸਪੁਤੁ ਕਪੂਰਿ ਦੇਉ; ਸਿਖੈ ਮਿਲਿਆਂ ਮਨਿ ਵਿਗਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Kapur Dev along with his son gets blossomed when he meets the Sikhs.

0.g: ਸੰਮਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਹਬਾਜ ਪੁਰਿ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਾਰ ਲਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: In Shahbazpur, Saman takes care of the Sikhs.

0.g: ਜੋਧਾ ਜਲੋ ਤੁਲਸਪੁਰਿ; ਮੋਹਣ ਆਲਮੁਗੰਜਿ ਰਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Jodha and Jalan in Tulaspur and Mohan lives in Alam Ganj.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਡਿਆ, ਵਡੇ ਮਸੰਦਾ ।੨੨।
0.e: These big masands surpass one another.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦੁ ਰਸਿ; ਹੋਇ ਭਵਰੁ ਲੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੁਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Like the black bee they surrender at the lotus feet of Guru and enjoy the sap and remain happy.

0.g: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ; ਲੰਘਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: They go beyond the triveni of ira, pingala and susumna and stablize in their own self.

0.g: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਵਣ ਲਿਵ; ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸਾ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: They through the flame of breath, mind and the life force, recite and make others recite the soham and hans recitations (jap).

0.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਲਿਵ; ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਮਚਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The form of surati is wonderfully fragrant and enrapturing.

0.g: ਸੁਖਸਾਗਰ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The gurmukhs calmly absorb in the pleasure-ocean of the Guru feet.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: When they in the form of pleasure-fruit obtain the supreme joy, they go beyond the bondages of body and bodylessness and attain the highest station.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ, ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Such gurmukhs have the glimpse of that invisible Lord in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭

0.e: The vegetation in the desolate places in the forest remains unknown.

0.e: The gardeners choose and pick up some plants and plant them in the garden of the kings.

0.e: They are grown by irrigation, and the thoughtful persons take care of them.
