0.e: From the point of view of public weal this was good and this way he further extended the ,,way shown by his (spiritual)father and grandfather.

0.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Teaching the skill of merging the cousciousness in the word, he has brought people face to face with that imperceptible (Lord)

0.g: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: His glory is unapproachable, invisible and deep; its limits cannot be known.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ, ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।੧੩।
0.e: He has known his real self but even then he has never attributed any importance to himself.

0.g: ਹੋਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਆਦਿ; ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: In the primordial times the Lord ordained.

0.g: ਨਾਦੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾਦੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: The Word of the Guru met with the Sabda-brahm Word-God and the ego of creatures got erased.

0.g: ਬਿਸਮਾਦੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: This very awe-inspiring word is the collyrium of gurmukhs.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਭਰਮੁ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: Adopting Gurmat, the wisdom of the Guru, with the grace of the Guru, the delusions are eschewed.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ; ਅਕਾਲ ਅਗੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: That primordial being is beyond time and destruction.

0.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: He bestows grace upon His servants like Siva and Sanaks et al.

0.g: ਜਪੀਐ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: In all the ages only He is remembered and He alone is the object of concentration of the Sikhs.

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਸਾਦੁ; ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰੰਜਨੋ ।
0.e: Through the taste of the cup of love that Supreme Love is known.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਰੰਜਨੋ ।੧੭।
0.e: Since the primordial time He has been delighting all.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਮੇਲ ਖੇਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ; ਦੀਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੂ ਸਮਾਵਈ ।
0.e: For meeting the dear True Guru, an obedient disciple plays the game of love and merges his self into the light divine of the True Guru in a manner as is done by a moth who perishes on his beloved flame.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਬਿਖੈ; ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ।
0.e: The state of a devoted Sikh for meeting with True Guru in order to relish the spiritual ecstasy is like that of a fish in water. And one who is separated from water looks like dying with pangs of separation.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਥਕਤਿ ਚਕਤ ਹੋਇ; ਸਬਦ ਬੇਧੀ ਕੁਰੰਹਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਤਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Like a deer engrossed in the musical sound of Ghanda Herha, the mind of a true devotee enjoys the divine bliss engrossed in the word of the Guru.

0.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ; ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਨੋਹੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ।੫੫੦।
0.e: The disciple who is able to engross his mind in the divine word, and yet separates himself from True Guru, his love is false. He cannot be called a true lover.  (550)

0.g: ਮਾਨਸਰ ਹੰਸ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮਹੰਸ; ਧਰਮਧੁਜਾ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ਚਲ ਆਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as swans visit lake Mansarover, so do the righteous people with divine wisdom visit the holy congregation of Lord's loving servants/devotees.

0.g: ਉਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਹਾਰ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ; ਇਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: There, at Mansarover, the swans relish pearls as their food and nothing else; so do these devotees engross their minds in the holy Naam of the Lord and remains attached with His divine words.

0.g: ਉਤ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ; ਇਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: The swans are believed to disintegrate milk in its constituents of water and milk; while here in the holy congregation, one learns about those who are Guru-oriented and self-oriented.

0.g: ਉਤ ਬਗ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਕੈ; ਇਤ ਕਾਗ ਪਾਗਿ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ।੩੪੦।
0.e: The temperament of herons cannot be changed into those of swans but here in the holy congregation, those who are like filth-eating crows are transformed into holy and devoted persons through the hue of Naam blessed by the True Guru. (340)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਸਉ ਵਿਚ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ; ਇਕੋਤਰ ਸੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ।
0.e: If the Sikh is hundred times, the eternal true Guru is hundred and one times.

0.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦੀਵ ਦੀਵਾਣ ਜਿਸੁ; ਅਸਥਿਰ ਸਦਾ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਸੀ ।
0.e: His court is ever steadfast and he never undergoes the cycle of transmigra­tion.

0.g: ਇਕ ਮਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹੈਂ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਕਾਟੀ ਗਲਹੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ।
0.e: He who meditates upon Him with singleminded devotion, gets his noose of Yama, cut asunder.

0.g: ਇਕੋ ਇਕ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਣਾਸੀ ।
0.e: That one Lord alone pervades everywhere, and only by merging consciousness in the word that true Guru can be known.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਫਿਰੇ ਲਖ ਜੂਨਿ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Without the glimpse of the manifest Guru (the word of Guru), thefts, wanders in eightyfour lacs of species of life.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦੀ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕ ਪਵਾਸੀ ।
0.e: Without the teachings of Guru, the jivgoes on taking birth and dying and is ultimately thrown in hell.

0.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਰਗੁਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸਮਾਸੀ ।
0.e: The true Guru (Lord) is without attributes and yet possesses all the qualities.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਓਟ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ; ਸਚੀ ਓਟ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ।
0.e: A rare one absorbes himself in the word of the Guru. There is no shelter without Guru's and this true refuge never gets destroyed.

0.g: ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਹਾਸੀ ।
0.e: The true Guru (Lord), Guru of all Gurus, is the immutable Guru from beginning to end.

0.g: ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ।੨੧।
0.e: Any rare gurmukh gets merged in the equipoise.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਕਰਿ; ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਤਮੋਲ ਗੁਲਾਲੇ ।
0.e: As in betel leaf all the colours mix and become one red colour, likewise mixing all the varnas one Sikh has been created.

0.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ; ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਚਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Eight metals mixing up make one metal (alloy); similarly there is no difference among Vedas and the Katebas (the Semitic scriptures).

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸੁਪਤਿ; ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਾਲੇ ।
0.e: The sandal perfumes the whole vegetation whether it is devoid of fruit or full of fruit.

0.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Touching the philosopher’s stone, iron becoming gold, again points towards its further beauty (of making itself useful for the needy ones).

0.g: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ; ਚਰਣਾਮਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Then in gold in the form of gurmukh, the colour (of Name) and elixir (of love) enter and he becomes carefree of the world around.

0.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੁਇਨਿਅਹੁ; ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Now all the qualities of rubies, pearls, diamonds emerge in that gold-gurmukh.

0.g: ਦਿਬ ਦੇਹ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦਿਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲੇ ।
0.e: Becoming divine body and divine sight the consciousness of gurmukh concentrates on the light of the divine Word.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲੇ ।੭।
0.e: Thus, adopting the delight of devotion, the gurmukhs become full of many delights.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਵਜਿਆ; ਚਹੁ ਚਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਮਿਰੇਟਾ ।
0.e: The tanner (Ravidas) became renowned as bhagat (saint) in all the four directions.

0.g: ਪਾਣ੍ਹਾ ਗੰਢੈ ਰਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਢੋਇ ਢੋਰ ਸਮੇਟਾ ।
0.e: In accordance with his family tradition he would cobble the shoes and carry away the dead animals.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚੀਥੜੇ; ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਲੇਟਾ ।
0.e: This was his outward routine but in reality he was a gem wrapped in rags.

0.g: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ; ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹੇਟਾ ।
0.e: He would preach all the four varnas (castes). His preaching made them rapt in the meditative devotion for the Lord.

0.g: ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਬਾਨਾਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਗੰਗਾ ਥੇਟਾ ।
0.e: Once, a group of people went to Kasi (Varanasi) to have their sacred dip in the Ganges.

0.g: ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਰਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ; ਰਵਿਦਾਸੈ ਗੰਗਾ ਦੀ ਭੇਟਾ ।
0.e: Ravidas gave one dhela (half a pice) to one member and asked him to offer it to the Ganges.

0.g: ਲਗਾ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਅਭੀਚ ਦਾ; ਡਿਠਾ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਮੇਟਾ ।
0.e: A great festival of Abhijit naksatr (star) was on there where the public saw this wonderful episode.

0.g: ਲਇਆ ਕਸੀਰਾ ਹਥੁ ਕਢਿ; ਸੂਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਤਾਣਾ ਪੇਟਾ ।
0.e: Ganges, herself taking out her hand accepted that paltry amount, dhela, and proved that Ravidas was one with Ganges as warp and weft.

0.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ, ਹਰਿ ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਬੇਟਾ ।੧੭।
0.e: For bhagats (saints,) God is their mother, father and son all in one.

0.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਸਦੇਵ; ਵਵਾ ਵਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: In Satyug, Visnu in the form of Vasudev is said to have incarnated and ‘V’ Of Vahiguru reminds of Visnu.

0.g: ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰੀਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ; ਹਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The true Guru of dvapar is said to be Harikrsna and ‘H’ of Vahiguru reminds of Hari.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ; ਰਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: In the the treta was Ram and ‘R’ of Vahiguru tells that rembering Ram will produce joy and happiness.

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ; ਗਗਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: In kalijug, Gobind is in the form of Nanak and ‘G’ of Vahiguru gets Govind recited.

0.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ; ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The recitations o f all the four ages subsume in Panchayan i.e. in the soul of the common man.

0.g: ਚਾਰੋ ਅਛਰ ਇਕੁ ਕਰਿ; ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: When joining four letters Vahiguru is remembered,

0.g: ਜਹਾ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।੪੯।੧। ਇਕੁ ।
0.e: The jiv merges again in its origin.

0.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਚਾਕਰ ਕੂਕਰ ਦੇਸਿ ਦੁਹਾਈ ।
0.e: By becoming subject of a king, people as servants go around the countries to abide orders.

0.g: ਜੰਮਦਿਆ ਰੁਣਿਝੁੰਝਣਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਦਕ ਹੋਇ ਵਧਾਈ ।
0.e: On the birth of a child felicitatory songs are sung in the houses of the maternal and paternal grandfathers.

0.g: ਵੀਵਾਹਾ ਨੋ ਸਿਠਣੀਆ; ਦੁਹੀ ਵਲੀ ਦੁਇ ਤੂਰ ਵਜਾਈ ।
0.e: On marriage occasions the songs are sung by woman in scurrilous language and trumpets are played on the part of the bride and bridegroom (but not so among the gurmukhs).

0.g: ਰੋਵਣੁ ਪਿਟਣੁ ਮੁਇਆ ਨੋ; ਵੈਣੁ ਅਲਾਹਣਿ ਧੁਮ ਧੁਮਾਈ ।
0.e: Weepings and wailings are there for the dead;

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ।
0.e: But the gurmukhs (the Guru-oriented) recite the Sohila in the company of the saints on such occasions.

0.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਜੰਮਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਈ ।
0.e: The Sikh (gurmukh) goes beyond the holy books of the Hindus and Muslims i.e. the Vedas and the Katebas, and neither rejoices at a birth nor mourns at a death.

0.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ, ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਈ ।੧੪।
0.e: In the midst of desires he remains free from them.

0.g: ਰਸ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਰਖਦਾ; ਬੋਲਣ ਅਣੁਬੋਲਣ ਅਭਿਰਿਠਾ ।
0.e: Full of juice (sugarcane) is tasty and whether it speaks or not, in both the conditions, it is sweet.

0.g: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਅਣਸੁਣਿਆ ਕਰੈ; ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਡਿਠਾ ਅਣਡਿਠਾ ।
0.e: It listens not to what is said and sees not what is visible, i.e. in the sugarcane field one neither can listen to other nor a person is visible in it.

0.g: ਅਖੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਟਾਈਆ; ਅਖੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ਬਹਿਠਾ ।
0.e: When in the form of seed the nodes of sugarcane are put into the earth, they sprout up.

0.g: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਬੂਟ ਹੋਇ; ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਇਠਹੁ ਇਠਾ ।
0.e: From one sugarcane grow many a plant, each lovely from top to bottom.

0.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਖੁੰਢਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੀੜੀਐ; ਟੋਟੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਇਤੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਮਿਠਾ ।
0.e: It is crushed between two cylinderical rollers because of its sweet juice.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਪਣਿਠਾ ।
0.e: Worthy people use it on auspicious days whereas the wicked also use it (by preparing wine etc out of it) and get perished.
Those who cultivated the nature of sugarcane i.e. do not shed sweetness though in peril, are indeed steadfast persons.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ; ਸਪੁ ਦੁਮੂਹਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ।
0.e: The wicked and unhappy is the betrayer who is like two headed snake which is also undesirable.

0.g: ਸਭਦੂੰ ਮੰਦੀ ਸਪ ਜੋਨਿ; ਸਪਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਭਾਈ ।
0.e: Snake's is the worst species and out of that also the two-headed snake is a bad and wicked variety.

0.g: ਕੋੜੀ ਹੋਆ ਗੋਪਿ ਗੁਰ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਾਈ ।
0.e: Its master remains unknown and on this unprincipled creature no mantra works.

0.g: ਕੋੜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੜੈ ਜਿਸ; ਵਿਗੜ ਰੂਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਿ ਸਹਮਾਈ ।
0.e: Any one whom it bites becomes leper. His face is deformed and he dies of its fear.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ; ਲਾਤੋ ਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ।
0.e: Manmukh, the mind-oriented one does not accept the advice of gurmukhs and creates quarrel here and there.

0.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਹੁ ਵਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਾਤਿ ਮਨਿ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਣਤੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ।
0.e: His speech is poisonous and in his mind are cherished sordid plans and jealousies.

0.g: ਸਿਰ ਚਿਥੈ, ਵਿਹੁ ਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ।੮।
0.e: His poisonous habit does not go even when his head is crushed.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਦੁਧ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕੂੜ ਵਿਗਾੜੁ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਦੀ ਚੁਖੈ ।
0.e: The truth is the rennet in the milk whereas falsehood is like the spoiling vinegar.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਵਣਾ; ਇਕੁ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਦੁਖੈ ।
0.e: The truth is like eating the food through mouth but the falsehood s painful as if a grain has gone into the nose.

0.g: ਫਲਹੁ ਰੁਖ, ਰੁਖਹੁ ਸੁ ਫਲੁ; ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਖਉ ਲਾਖਹੁ ਰੁਖੈ ।
0.e: From fruit emerges tree and nom tree the fruit; but if shellac attacks the tree, the latter is destroyed (similarly falsehood decimates the individual).

0.g: ਸਉ ਵਰਿਆ ਅਗਿ ਰੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ; ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਗਿ ਬਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੁਖੈ ।
0.e: For hundreds of years, the fire remains latent in the tree, but enraged by a small spark, it destroys the ree (similarly the falsehood ever remaining in the mind, ultimately destroys the man).

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੈਦ ਵੇਦਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੈ ।
0.e: The truth is medicine whereas the falsehood is a disease which inflicts the manmukhs who are without physician in the form of Guru.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਥੋਈ ਕੂੜ ਠਗੁ; ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੈ ।
0.e: Truth is companion and the falsehood a cheat who cannot make the gurmukh suffer (because they ever abide in the pleasure of truth).

0.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਪਚੈ, ਸਚੈ ਦੀ ਭੁਖੈ ।੯।
0.e: Falsehood perishes and the truth is ever desired.

0.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਜਨ ਸਗਾਈ ਹੋਤ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Deeds of previous births bring together noble people and they join in the form of holy congregation to establish union with True Guru. Such a maid who is betrothed thus hears the messages of her True Guru master from others and remembers them.

0.g: ਬਿਧਿ ਸੈ ਬਿਵਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ; ਬਿਦਿਮਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਭੇਸ ਕੈ ।
0.e: When according to tradition, marriage is solemnised, that is to say she is consecrated by Guru and an accord gets established between them, then her mind is engrossed in the form, colour, attire and pleasure of the master True Guru.

0.g: ਰੈਨ ਸੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਸ੍ਰੁਤ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ; ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ।
0.e: At night when it is time for people to sleep, a seeker of the Lord takes refuge in the knowledge of the divine words and achieving soulful ecstasy through practicing of Naam, unites in the holy feet of the Lord.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਉਲੰਘ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੈ ।੨੧੧।
0.e: Contemplating thus she (jeev istri) crosses all the stages of knowledge and becomes one with dear beloved and influenced by His loving pleasure, she gets engrossed in wondrous and marvellous spiritual state. (211)

0.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ; ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਭੇਵ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The eternal form of the Lord whose embodiment is True Guru, is formless, who is bereft of all support, who has no desire of any food, who is free of all vices, free of entering wombs to take birth, who is imperishable, limitless and who cannot be fathomed

0.g: ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਨਿਰਬੈਰ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ; ਨਿਰਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਤਹ ਪਰ ਅਤੇਵ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He is sans attachment, animosity, free of all allurements and stigmas, fearless, uninfluenced by maya and is beyond the beyond.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਅਚੁਤ ਅਲਖ ਅਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਵ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Whose extent cannot be known, is imperceptible, beyond the senses, whose expanse is unknowable, who is ever stable, beyond perceptions, is beyond deception nor can be hurt by anyone.

0.g: ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ; ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਹੈ ।੩੪੪।
0.e: Knowing Him is most baffling, amazing and astonishing that can make anyone blissfully ecstatic. The effulgent of form the True Guru is the form of such an eternal and radiant God Lord. (344)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਜੇ ਮਾਂ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਰਨੀ; ਕਿਉ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: If the mother is adulteress why should son speak ill of her.

0.g: ਗਾਈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਗਲਿਆ; ਪੇਟੁ ਪਾੜਿ ਨ ਮਾਰੇ ।
0.e: If a gem is swallowed by a cow, nobody ripps its stomach to get it out.

0.g: ਜੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਹੰਢਣਾ; ਸਤੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਰੇ ।
0.e: If the husband enjoys (immorally) at many houses, the wife should preserve her chastity.

0.g: ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਚੰਮ ਦੇ; ਚਾਕਰ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: If the king exercises dictatorial powers, the servants are helpless before him.

0.g: ਜੇ ਮਦੁ ਪੀਤਾ ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੀ; ਲੋਇ ਲੁਝਣਿ ਸਾਰੇ ।
0.e: If a brahmin woman is drunk, all feel ashamed and donot look up in her face.

0.g: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ।੨੦।
0.e: If the Guru performs a sham, the Sikh should not give up his forebearance.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਡਾਇਣੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਣੀ; ਪੁਤੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ।
0.e: The witch is man eater but she also does not contemplate wrong for her son.

0.g: ਵਡਾ ਵਿਕਰਮੀ ਆਖੀਐ; ਧੀ ਭੈਣਹੁ ਸੰਗੈ ।
0.e: Even known as the most vicious man, he also feels ashamed before his daughter and sister.

0.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਕਮਾਂਵਦੇ; ਰੈਬਾਰ ਸੁਰੰਗੈ ।
0.e: The kings, trecherous for each other, put no harm to the amabassadors (and they live comfortably).

0.g: ਬਜਰ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਉਤਰਨਿ; ਜਾਇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਗੰਗੈ ।
0.e: The sins committed at Ganges (the religious places) are as hard as the thunderbolt and never fade out.

0.g: ਥਰਹਰ ਕੰਬੈ ਨਰਕੁ ਜਮੁ; ਸੁਣਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨੰਗੈ ।
0.e: Listening to the naked meanness of the slanderer, Yama of the hell also trembles.

0.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ; ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦ ਕੁਢੰਗੈ ।੪।
0.e: Backbiting of any one is bad but the vilification of the Guru is the worst (way of life).

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਚੋ ਪਾਰੋ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਖਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਹਕਲੰਕ ਹੁਇ ਕਲੰਕਨ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as raw mercury is very harmful to eat but when treated and processed, it becomes edible and a medicine to cure many ailments.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਟਿ; ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਕਾਰਨ ਘਟਾਵਈ ।
0.e: So should the mind be treated with the words of wisdom of the Guru. Dispelling ego and pride, then becoming benevolent it reduces other vices. It frees the evil and vice-ridden people from evil deeds.

0.g: ਸਾਧੁਸੰਗਿ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਹੁਇ ਮਿਲਤ; ਚੂਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ।
0.e: When a lowly person joins the saintly congregation, he too becomes superior just as lime when joined by a betel leaf and other ingredients yield beautiful red colour.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਵਈ ।੨੫੮।
0.e: So would a base and frolicsome mind wandering in four directions get absorbed in the blissful spiritual state by coming into the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru and the blessing of the saintly assembly. (258)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਮੁਹਿ ਵਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਰਾਤਿ ਪਈ ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: One evening while king Ambaris was fasting he was visited by sage Durvasa

0.g: ਭੀੜਾ ਓਸੁ ਉਪਾਰਣਾ; ਓਹੁ ਉਠਿ ਨ੍ਹਾਵਣਿ ਨਦੀ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The king was to break his fast while serving Durvasa but the rishi went to the riverbank to take a bath.

0.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਪੋਖਿਆ; ਓਹੁ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਦੇਣ ਨੋ ਧਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Fearing the change of date (which would deem his fast fruitless), the king broke his fast by drinking the water which he had poured on the feet of the rishi. When the rishi realised that the king had not served him first, he ran to curse the king.

0.g: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਸੁਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਾਲ ਰੂਪ; ਹੋਇ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: On this, Vishnu ordered his death like disc to move towards Durvasa and thus the ego of Durvasa was removed.

0.g: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣੁ ਭੰਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਲੈ; ਰਖਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Now Brahmin Durvasa ran for his life. Even the gods and deities could not afford him shelter.

0.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕੁ ਤਜਿ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕੁ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤਜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He was avoided in the abodes of Indra, Siva, Brahma and the heavens.

0.g: ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਸਣੁ; ਸਿਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Gods and God made him understand (that none except Ambaris could save him).

0.g: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਮਾਰੀਦਾ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਛੁਡਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Then he surrendered before Ambaris and Ambaris saved the dying sage.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ, ਜਗਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।੪।
0.e: The Lord God came to be known in the world as benevolent to devotees.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਝਟੁਲਾ; ਨੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਈ ।
0.e: The akk, a poisonous plant of sandy region and thorn- apple though with branches lowered, yet do not discard their dubiety.

0.g: ਫੁਲਿ ਫੁਲਿ ਫੁਲੇ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੇ; ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਫਲਿ ਫਲਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: The hybrid plants apparently look blossommed but they have poisonous flowers and fruits which make them ill-reputed.

0.g: ਪੀਐ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਅਕੁ ਦੁਧੁ; ਪੀਤੇ ਮਰੀਐ ਦੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: Drinking akk-milk, man dies. How could such secretion be called milk?

0.g: ਖਖੜੀਆਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਢੀਆਂ; ਫਟਿ ਫਟਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਉਡਨਿ ਓਈ ।
0.e: Out of their parts cotton-like pieces burst out and fly about.

0.g: ਚਿਤਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਅਕਤਿਡੁ; ਮਿਲੈ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਿਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਢੋਈ ।
0.e: Akkhoppers are also piebald; they too like the double-minded , are nowhere sheltered.

0.g: ਖਾਇ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਬਰਲੀਐ; ਕਖ ਚੁਣਿੰਦਾ ਵਤੈ ਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Eating thornapple man goes mad and people see him gathering straw in the world.

0.g: ਕਉੜੀ ਰਤਕ ਜੇਲ ਪਰੋਈ ।੧੮।
0.e: Ratak,small red and black seeds, also get pierced through for making garlands.

0.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਆਂ ਮਤਾਅ ਉਲ-ਵਰਾ ।
0.e: Guru Ram Das, the asset and the treasure of the entire world

0.g: ਜਹਾਂਬਾਨਿ ਇਕਲੀਮ ਸਿਦਕੋ ਸਫ਼ਾ ।੬੯।
0.e: And, is the protector/caretaker of the realm of faith and chastity. (69)

0.g: ਹਮ ਅਜ਼ ਸਲਤਨਤ ਹਮ ਅਜ਼ ਫ਼ੁਕਰਸ਼ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਂ ।
0.e: He includes (in his personality) symbols of both royalty and renunciation,

0.g: ਗਿਰਾਂ ਮਾਯਾ ਤਰ ਅਫ਼ਸਰਿ ਅਫ਼ਸਰਾਂ ।੭੦।
0.e: And, he is the king of kings. (70)

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੌਸਫ਼ਿ ਊ ਸਲਸ ਕਾਸਿਰ ਜ਼ਬਾਂ ।
0.e: The tongues of all the three worlds, the earth, the underworld, and the skies, are incapable to describe his eclat,

0.g: ਅਜ਼ੋ ਰੁਬਅ ਹਮ ਸੁੱਦਸ ਗੌਹਰ ਫ਼ਿਸ਼ਾਂ ।੭੧।
0.e: And, pearls-like messages and words  (metaphors and expressions) from the four Vedaas and six Shaastraas emerge from his utterances. (71)

0.g: ਚਿ ਹੱਕ ਬਰਗ਼ੁਜ਼ੀਦਸ਼ ਜ਼ਿ ਖ਼ਾਸਾਨ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ।
0.e: Akaalpurakh has selected him as one of His specially close favorites,

0.g: ਸਰ ਅਫ਼ਰਾਖ਼ਤਸ਼ ਹਮ ਜ਼ਿ ਪਾਕਾਨੇ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ।੭੨।
0.e: And, has elevated him to even a higher position than His personal sacred souls. (72)

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਸਾਜਿਦਸ਼ ਦਾ ਬਸਿਦਕਿ ਜ਼ਮੀਰ ।
0.e: Everyone prostrates before him with a truthful and clear conscience,

0.g: ਚਿਹ ਆਅਲਾ ਚਿਹ ਅਦਨਾ ਚਿਹ ਸ਼ਹ ਚਿਹ ਫ਼ਕੀਰ ।੭੩।
0.e: Whether he is high or low, a king or a mendicant. (73)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਅਪਤੁ ਕਰੀਰੁ ਨ ਮਉਲੀਐ; ਦੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਬਸੰਤੈ ।
0.e: The leafless wild caper Karin does not grow green but it blames the spring season.

0.g: ਸੰਢਿ ਸਪੁਤੀ ਨ ਥੀਐ; ਕਣਤਾਵੈ ਕੰਤੈ ।
0.e: The barren women does not bear the child but she blames her husband.

0.g: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਜੰਮਈ; ਘਣਹਰੁ ਵਰਸੰਤੈ ।
0.e: The rains of the clouds cannot make alkaline field grow and produce.

0.g: ਪੰਗਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਚੰਗਿਆਂ; ਅਵਗੁਣ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੈ ।
0.e: The meritorious people get evils and embarrassments in the company of vicious people.

0.g: ਸਾਇਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਘੰਘੂਟਿਆਂ; ਬਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਅਨੰਤੈ ।
0.e: In the ocean, one gets many a pearl even from the shells, i.e. the association with the good produces good results.

0.g: ਜਨਮ ਗਵਾਇ ਅਕਾਰਥਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੰਤੈ ।੭।
0.e: Slandering the Guru, the whole life elapses in vain.

0.g: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਹਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਲੋਪੁ ਹੋਇ; ਤਿਐ ਦਿਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਕਾ ।
0.e: Remaining invisible for two days, third day the moon is beholden in a small size.

0.g: ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੁਹਾਰਦਾ; ਗਗਨ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਟਿਕਾ ।
0.e: Supposed to adorn the forehead of Mahesa, people bow to it again and again.

0.g: ਸੋਲਹ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੀਐ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਇਕਾ ।
0.e: When it has attained all the sixteen phases i.e. on the full moon night it begins diminishing and again reaches the position of the first day. People now bow before it.

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ; ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਿੰਜੈ ਸਹਸਿਕਾ ।
0.e: Nectar is sprinkled by its rays and it irrigates all thirsty trees and fields.

0.g: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੇ; ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮਿਕਾ ।
0.e: Peace, contentment and cool, these invaluable jewels are bestowed by it.

0.g: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੇਰਹੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਡੋਰ ਚਕੋਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਛਿਕਾ ।
0.e: In darkness, it spreads light and provides the thread of meditation to the chakor, the redlegged partridge.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਅਮੋਲ ਮਣਿਕਾ ।੨੦।
0.e: Only by erasing its ego it becomes an invaluable jewel.

0.g: ਇਹ ਵਾਰ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਮਹਾਂ ਪੁਨੀਤੇ ।
0.e: This Epic of Bhagauti is prominently sacred,

0.g: ਜਿਸ ਉਚਰਤਿ; ਉਪਜਤਿ ਪਰਤੀਤੇ ।
0.e: Sermonising which, (sublime) perception is revealed.

0.g: ਜੋ ਇਸ ਵਾਰ ਸੋਂ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਗਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Those, who will embrace this Epic,

0.g: ਸੋਈ; ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Will get their mental desires fulfilled.

0.g: ਮਿਟਹਿਂ ਸਗਲ; ਦੁਖ ਦੁੰਦ ਕਲੇਸਾ ।
0.e: All the adversities, conflicts and bickering will be erased.

0.g: ਫੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈਂ; ਬਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ।
0.e: The sacred manifestation descends, and one gets contentment.

0.g: ਜੋ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ; ਰਟਹਿਂ ਇਹ ਵਾਰੇ ।
0.e: One who recites this Epic day and night,

0.g: ਸੋ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ; ਧੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Will realise the internal court of Har.

0.g: ਇਹ ਵਾਰ ਭਗਉਤੀ; ਸਮਾਪਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ।
0.e: Thus the Epic of Bhagauti is completed.

0.g: ਤਬ ਘਟ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੀਨੀ ।
0.e: Through its knowledge the creator is recognised,

0.g: ਇਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਭਏ ਦਿਆਲਾ ।
0.e: Only then the True Guru becomes benevolent,

0.g: ਤਬ ਛੂਟ ਗਏ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ।
0.e: And all the perplexities are ridden.

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਰਧਾਰੇ ।
0.e: O God, Almighty, do me a favour,

0.g: ਤਹਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਬਾਂਹ; ਭਉਜਲ ਸੋਂ ਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Hold my arm and enable me to swim across the temporal sea.

0.g: ਇਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Thus exclaimed Gurdas;

0.g: ਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰਾ ।੨੮।੪੧। ਇਤੀ ।
0.e: O my True Guru, you grant me redemption.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਡਾਕਨ ਹਰੈ ਕਰੇਜੌ; ਬਾਲਕ ਤਾਹੀ ਲੌ ਧਾਵੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਗੋਦਿ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a malicious woman enamors a child with her sweet and gullible talk that attracts the child to her who thinks she would bestow her love upon him.

0.g: ਰੋਵਤ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਉਖਦ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਮਾਤਾ; ਬਾਲਕੁ ਜਾਨਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a mother administer medicine to her suffering and crying son but the child feels she is serving him poison.

0.g: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ; ਬਾਲਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਜਗਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The intellect of the worldly beings is also like this child. They do not know the traits of God-like True Guru who is fully capable of destroying all the vices in them. In this regard, Bhai gurdas Ji says: "Avgun lai gun vikanai vachnai da sura". Var. 13/

0.g: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਆਪ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਹੈ ।੪੦੬।
0.e: The True Guru is perfect in all respects. He is beyond our perception. No one can fathom his vast knowledge. He alone knows His own capabilities. All that can be said is-He is Infinite, Infinite, Infinite.   (406)

0.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ; ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਬਰਖਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੈ ।
0.e: The gathering of thick and different hue of clouds in the sky causes rain that beautifies the Earth spreading happiness all around.

0.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ; ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਕੰਦ ਕੈ ।
0.e: That also causes colourful flowers to bloom. The vegetation wears a fresh and new look.

0.g: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਖਗ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਭਾਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ; ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਕੈ ।
0.e: With fragrance of the colourful flowers carried by cool breeze and fruits of different shape, size and taste, birds of various species come and sing songs merrily.

0.g: ਰਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਥਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕੈ ।੭੪।
0.e: Enjoying all these attractions of the rainy season become more fruitful and enjoyable by putting hard work on the meditation of Lord's name as is advised by Satguru. (74)

0.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਅਵਲੋਕਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ; ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the desire of a miser for money is never satiated, so are the eyes of a Sikh of the Guru who have realised that the form of True Guru is a unique treasure seeing which one never feels satisfied.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ; ਅਚਵਤਿ ਸੁਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as hunger of a pauper is never satiated, so are the ears of a Gursikh which are ever desirous of hearing the ambrosial words of the True Guru. And yet hearing those elixir-like words, the thirst of his consciousness is not quenched.

0.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਟਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਨਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਗੂੜ; ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਅਘਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The tongue of a Gursikh keeps recalling the prime traits of the True Guru and like a rain-bird who keeps shouting for more, it is never satiated.

0.g: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰਸਿ; ਰਸਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਢਾਈ ਹੈ ।੬੨੧।
0.e: The inner self of a Sikh is getting enlightened with blissful light through seeing, hearing and uttering of the wondrous form of True Guru-a treasure-house-nay the fountain-head of all the virtues. Yet the thirst and hunger of such a Gursikh never wanes.

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ; ਕੋਟਿਕ ਉਸਤਤ ਛਬਿ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The radiance of the light of the True Guru, the ocean of happiness and comfort is repository of all the happiness of the world. A glimmer of light no more than a sesame seed has generated radiance of millions of beauties and adulations in the world.

0.g: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰ; ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਧੁ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A little kind look of the True Guru has millions of goddesses of wealth and celestial trees capable of fulfilling all desires, hidden in it. Elixir immersed sweet words of the True Guru has millions of relishments of the world.

0.g: ਮੰਦ ਮੁਸਕਾਨਿ ਬਾਨਿ ਖਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਸਿ; ਸੋਭਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The habit of soft and slow smile of the True Guru is the source of praise of millions of moons. The glory of millions of nymphea flowers is sacrifice unto it.

0.g: ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ; ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਸ ਹੈ ।੨੯੪।
0.e: A devoted and loving Sikh of the Guru enamoured by the elixir-like relishment of Naam Simran practiced through the teachings of the True Guru remains absorbed in a state of equipoise and astonishing devotion of the Lord. (294)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ; ਹੋਂਦੀ ਅਖੀਂ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: He who cannot see the grandneur of gurmukhs is blind despite his eyes.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ; ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕੰਨੀਂ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: He ‘who does not understand the idea of a gurmukh is deaf despite his ears.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਈ; ਹੋਂਦੀ ਜੀਭੈ ਗੁੰਗਾ ਗੋਈ ।
0.e: He ho does not sing the hymns of Gurmukh is dumb though having a tongue.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਵਾਸ ਵਿਣੁ; ਨਕਟਾ ਹੋਂਦੇ ਨਕਿ ਅਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Devoid of the fragrance of the lotus feet of the Guru, he is supposed to be with a clipped nose (brazen-faced) despite his lovely nose.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆਂ; ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕਰੀਂ ਲੁੰਜਾ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਈ ।
0.e: A person devoid of Gurmukh's sense of service is a wailing cripple, his healthy hands notwithstanding and he goes on weeping.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਸਈ; ਸੋ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਲਹਦਾ ਢੋਈ ।
0.e: One in whose heart, the wisdom of the Guru is not sustained, is a fool who gets no shelter anywhere.

0.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਨਾਲਿ, ਨ ਕੋਇ ਸਥੋਈ ।੩।
0.e: The idiot has no companion.

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲ ਹੈ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ।
0.e: True Naam, the Word, is precious, and is grasped only by the fortunate ones,

0.g: ਸਤਿਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀਐ ।
0.e: In the True Assembly by, always, singing the praises of Har.

0.g: ਧਰਮ ਖੇਤ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਸਰੀਰ; ਬੋਈਐ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੀਐ ।
0.e: In the field of righteousness in the Kal-age, one crops what one sows.

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਇ; ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉਂ ਪੁਣੀਐ ।
0.e: The True Lord, like straining water, assesses Truth through Justice.

0.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Truth prevails in the congregation, and unique is His everlasting affinity.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੬।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; himself is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal enegy, realised through The grace of divine preceptor.

0.g: ਵਾਰ ੩ ।
0.e: Vaar Three

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ; ਆਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: I bow before the primeval Lord who has been told as the primordial cause of all.

0.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਸੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Truth incarnate that true Guru is realised through the Word.

0.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ; ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Only they have realised Him whose surati (consciousness) has merged into the truth after accepting the commands of the Word.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਸੁ; ਘਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Holy congregation is the genuine basis and authentic abode of truth.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਵੇਸ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Wherein the individual inspired by loving devotion enjoys the innate delight.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ; ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Lord, kind to the devotees and the glory of the poor, also assimilates Himself in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Even Brahma, Visnu, Mahesa could not know His mysteries.

0.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਹਿਸ ਫਣ ਸੇਸੁ; ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ।
0.e: Sesanag remembering Him with its thousand hoods could not understand Him.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ; ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਣਿਆ ।੧।
0.e: The truth is pleasing to those gurmukhs who have become dervish at the door of holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਜੰਮਿਆ; ਹੋਇ ਅਚਲੁ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ।
0.e: With feet upward and head down, the tree gets rooted and stands unmoved.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਧੁਪ ਸਹਿ; ਉਹ ਤਪਹੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ।
0.e: It bears with water, cold and sunshine but does not turn its face from self-mortification.

0.g: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ; ਫਲ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਸੁ ਫਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Such a tree is blessed one and becomes full of fruit.

0.g: ਫਲੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਐ; ਕਰਵਤਿ ਨ ਹਲਿਆ ।
0.e: On stoning, it gives fruit and does not stir even under the sawing machine.

0.g: ਬੁਰੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆਂ; ਭਲਿਆਈ ਭਲਿਆ ।
0.e: The wicked go on doing evil deeds whereas the gentle remain busy in good activities.

0.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਨਿ; ਜਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਰਲਿਆ ।
0.e: Rare are the people in world who with their saintly heart do good to the evil.

0.g: ਅਉਸਰਿ ਆਪ ਛਲਾਇਂਦੇ; ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਛਲਿਆ ।੨੧।
0.e: The commoners are duped by time i.e. they change according to the time, but the holy men succeed in deluding the time i.e. they remain free from the influence of time.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਉ ਘਾਇਲ ਕੋ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੋਤ; ਪੀਰ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਪੇਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as the wound gets cured with medicine and the pain also vanishes, but the scar of the wound is never seen to vanish.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਫਾਟੇ ਅੰਬਰੋ ਸੀਆਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਓਢੀਅਤ; ਨਾਗੋ ਤਉ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤਊ ਥੇਗਰੀ ਪਰੇਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a torn cloth stitched and worn does not bare the body but the seam of the stitch is visible and conspicuous.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਟੂਟੈ ਬਾਸਨੁ ਸਵਾਰ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਠਠੇਰੋ; ਗਿਰਤ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ਪੈ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a broken utensil is repaired by coppersmith and even the water does not leak from it, but it is repaired form stays.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਿ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਪੁਨਿ; ਸਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪੈ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਲੇਖ ਲੇਖੀਐ ।੪੧੯।
0.e: Similarly, a disciple who has turned away from the holy feet of the True Guru comes back to the Guru's refuge when he feels the pain of his actions. Although he is freed of his sins and becomes pious, yet the .blemish of his apostasy remains.  (419)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਧਾਮ ਭਾਮ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਏਕ; ਨਾਇਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭਨ ਲਡਾਵਈ ।
0.e: As a king has many queens in his palace, each of remarkable beauty, he cajoles and pampers each one of them;

0.g: ਜਨਮਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਵਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਭਾਗੁ; ਸਕਲ ਰਾਨੀ ਮੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ਸੋ ਕਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: One who bears him a son enjoys higher status in the palace and is declared as the chief among the queens;

0.g: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਸਬੈ; ਰਾਜ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਵਈ ।
0.e: Each one of them has the right and opportunities to enjoy the pleasures of the palace and share the bed of the king;

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਬੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ।੧੨੦।
0.e: So do the Guru's Sikhs assemble in the refuge of the True Guru. But he who meets with the Lord after losing his self reaches the realm of spiritual peace and comfort. (120)

0.g: ਘੋਸਲਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਡਾ ਤਜਿ ਉਡਤ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ; ਸੰਧਿਆ ਸਮੈ ਅੰਡਾ ਹੋਤਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a bird flies away in the open sky from the comfort of its nest, leaving its egg behind but returns due to its concern for the baby bird in the egg,

0.g: ਤਿਰੀਆ ਤਿਆਗ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਬਿਖੈ; ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a labour woman leaves her child home under compulsion and goes to the jungle to pick up firewood, but keeps the memory of her child in the mind and finds comfort on returning home;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਡੀਅਤ ਜਲਚਰੀ; ਜਬ ਚਾਹੇ ਤਬ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a pool of water is made and fish released in it to be caught again at one's will.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹੈ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਠਹਰਾਵਈ ।੧੮੪।
0.e: So does the frolicsome mind of a human being wanders in all the four directions. But due to the ship-like Naam blessed by the True Guru, the wandering bird-like mind comes and rests in the self. (184)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਮਾਨਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Manasarovar (lake) in the form of holy congregation contains in it many invaluable rubies, pearls and jewels.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs too belong to the family of swans of highest order who merging their consciousness in the Word remain stabilized.

0.g: ਖੀਰਹੁਂ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਕਾਲਦੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Due to their power of knowledge and meditiation, the gurmukhs sift milk from water (i.e. truth from falsehood).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਤੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Eulogising the truth, gurmukhs become incomparable and their glory cannot be measured by any one.

0.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ; ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਖਾਇ ਅਬੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Manmukh, the mind-oriented, is like a crane who silently strangulates the creatures and eats them up.

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਉ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜਾਇ; ਛਪੜਿ ਊਹੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਹਚੋਲਾ ।
0.e: Seeing it sitting at a pond, the creatures therein create an uproar and cries of distress.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਉ, ਕੂੜੁ ਗਹਿਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ।੪।
0.e: Truth is noble whereas falsehood is lowly slave.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਚੰਨਣੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਉਪਾਇ; ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਰਖਿਆ ।
0.e: God created the sandal tree and kept it in the forest.

0.g: ਪਵਣੁ ਗਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ; ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ।
0.e: The breeze moves around the sandal but does not understand the imperceptible (nature of the tree).

0.g: ਵਾਸੂ ਬਿਰਖ ਬੁਹਾਇ; ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖਿਆ ।
0.e: The truth about the sandal comes to the forefront when it perfumes everyone with its fragrance.

0.g: ਸਭੇ ਵਰਨ ਗਵਾਇ; ਭਖਿ ਅਭਖਿਆ ।
0.e: The gurmukh goes beyond all the caste and the distinctions of eating taboos.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ; ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀ ਚਖਿਆ ।
0.e: He drinks the nectar of fear and love of the Lord in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿਆ ।੧੬।
0.e: The Gurmukh comes face to face with his own intrinsic nature (sahaj subhai).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਖਾਇ; ਗਲ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Even being an ascetic, Narad merely talked (of here and there).

0.g: ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ਖਾਇ; ਚੁਗਲੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Being a backbiter, he popularised himself only as a tell-tale.

0.g: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤਾਮਸੁ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Sanak et al. got angry when they having gone to Visnu were not allowed entry by the doorkeepers.

0.g: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਰਾਇ; ਜਨਮੁ ਗਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: They forced Visnu to undergo ten incarnations and thus the peaceful life of Visnu got tormented.

0.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਕੁ ਜਣਿਆ ਮਾਇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The mother who gave birth to Sukdev was caused to suffer by him by remaining undelivered by the mother for twelve years.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਖਾਇ; ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾਇਆ ।੫।
0.e: Only gurmukhs tasting the fruit of supreme joy have endured the unendurable (name of the Lord).

0.g: ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਕੋ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਆਸਰੋ ਨਿਰਾਸਨ ਕੋ; ਨਾਥੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਾਥਨ ਕੋ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: God is support of all those who are without any support. He is refuge of those who have no one to take care of them. He is the master of all those who are orphans. He is the haven of mercy for the destitutes.

0.g: ਅਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਅਉ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਧਨ; ਟੇਕ ਅੰਧਰਨ ਕੀ ਅਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those who are unable to obtain shelter anywhere, He provides them refuge. For the poor, His name is the real treasure. For blind, He is the walking stick. He showers His kindness even on misers.

0.g: ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਤਤਿ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: To the ungrateful, he is the provider of their needs. He makes the sinners pious. He saves the sinners from hell fire and abides by His character of kind, clement, benevolent and sustainer.

0.g: ਅਵਗੁਨ ਹਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਤਗਿਆ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ; ਸੰਗੀ ਸਰਬੰਗਿ ਰਸ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਹੈ ।੩੮੭।
0.e: He destroys the vices and knows all the latent deeds of everyone. He is a companion who stands by in all thick and thin situations. Such a Lord is the treasure-house of elixir for those who relish His divine nectar.  (387)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਨ ਧਨੁਖ ਸਹਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਬਸ; ਛੂਟਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੁਨ ਜਤਨ ਸੈ ਹਾਥ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as an arrow is in full control (of the warrior) as long as it remains in the bow, but once released cannot come back howsoever one may try.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਘ ਬੰਧਸਾਲਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਧ︀ਯੋ ਰਹੈ ਪੁਨ; ਖੁਲੈ ਤੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਸ ਬਸਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਥ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a lion remains in a cage, but when released cannot be brought under control. Once out of control, it cannot be tamed.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਖੈ; ਦਾਵਾਨਲ ਭਏ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਦੁਰੈ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as the heat of a lit lamp is not felt by anybody in the house, but if it becomes the fire of the jungle (spreads in the house) then it becomes uncontrollable.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਮਧ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਸਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਖੈ; ਬੋਲੀਐ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਥ ਜੀ ।੬੩੦।
0.e: Similarly, no one can know the words on one's tongue. Like an arrow released from the bow, words spoken cannot be taken back. Therefore one should always think and reflect on what one is about to say and all conversation should be in accordance with the w

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ; ਤਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਨਾਵਈ ।
0.e: The True Guru becomes clement and enters the heart of a Sikh first. Then he asks the Sikh to meditate on Naam and showers his kindness to make him meditate.

0.g: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਫਲ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Obeying the command of the True Guru, a Guru-conscious person indulges in Naam Simran- a supreme treasure of the Lord and enjoys the spiritual comfort. He also attains the ultimate spiritual state.

0.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ।
0.e: In that spiritual realm, he achieves that high state of Naam where all desires of reward or fruit vanish. Thus he gets engrossed in a deep concentration. This state is beyond description.

0.g: ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਤ ਪਦਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ।੧੭੮।
0.e: With whatever desires and sentiments one worships the True Guru, He fulfils all his wants and desires. (178)

0.g: ਬਰਖਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਓਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ; ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: In the rainy season, both pearl and hailstones are produced. Being of the same form, a pearl is considered good doer while the hailstone causes damage.

0.g: ਓਰਾ ਬਰਖਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਧਾਨ ਪਾਸ ਕੋ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ; ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Hailstones destroy/damage crops and other vegetation, whereas a pearl is praised for its beauty and lustrous form.

0.g: ਓਰਾ ਤਉ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਤ ਬਿਲਾਇ ਜਾਇ; ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Being damaging in nature, a hailstone melts away in no time, whereas a good doer pearl remains stable.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਵਈ ।੧੬੩।
0.e: Similar is the effect of the company of vice/evil and virtuous people. The supreme wisdom acquired by the teachings of a True Guru and polluted intellect due to base wisdom cannot be hidden. (163)

0.g: ਜਨਨੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਗਵੈ ਜਠਰ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਿੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a pregnant woman takes all possible care of herself during her pregnancy and on completion of the period gives birth to a baby boy;

0.g: ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਅਖਾਦਿ ਖਾਦਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਰਹੈ; ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਪੈ ਪੀਅਤ ਅਰੋਗਪਨ ਪਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Then she observes and controls her eating habits meticulously and rigidly that helps the young child to grow healthy by consuming his mother's milk.

0.g: ਮਲਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਚਿਤ; ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਬਾਲੁ ਤਊ ਤਨ ਗਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The mother cares not about all the filth of the child and brings him up to give him a healthy body.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਅਰਭਕੁ ਰੂਪ ਸਿਖ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਧਿ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਸਨ ਗਤ ਹੈ ।੩੫੩।
0.e: So is a disciple (Sikh), like a child in this world who like the mother is blessed by the Guru with Naam Simran that ultimately emancipates him. (353)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਪੁਤੁ ਜਣੈ ਵੜਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: A son is given birth in a closed room but all the people outside come to know of it.

0.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਬੀਐ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
0.e: The wealth even buried in the earth is revealed through facial expressions of the owner.

0.g: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਖਦੇ; ਵੁਠੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Even an ordinary passerby can tell that it has already rained.

0.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਦਾ; ਚੜ੍ਹਿਐ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: All bow towards it as the new moon rises.

0.g: ਗੋਰਖ ਦੇ ਗਲਿ ਗੋਦੜੀ; ਜਗੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Gorakh has a patched blanket around his neck but the world knows him as nath, the great master.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਾਣੈ ।੨੦।
0.e: Knowledge of the Guru is called the Guru; only the truth identifies the truth.

0.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ; ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Since time immemorial, on account of the bondage of unfulfilled desires, the jiv has been suffering transmigration.

0.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਐ; ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ, ਮਰਮੁ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Time and again, the body is changed, but the mystery of this change can be understood by becoming knowledgeable.

0.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ; ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: Engrossed in duality in satyug, the jiv entered into the body in treta.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਬਾਂਧਤੇ; ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਰਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Getting caught in karma-bondage in treta

0.g: ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਅਹੰ ਕਰਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: He was born in dvapar and remained writhing and wriggling.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜੁਗਾਂ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਸਾ ਨ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Even the performance of the duties of three ages does not dispel the fear of birth and death.

0.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਧਰਿ; ਕਰਮਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਸਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The jiv reincarnates in kaliyug and gets entangled in the karmas.

0.g: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਚੁਕਾ, ਹਥ ਨ ਆਵੈ ।੧੫।
0.e: Lost opportunity comes not again.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨
ਜੇ ਮਾਉ ਪੁਤੈ ਵਿਸੁ ਦੇ; ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: If a mother administers poison to son then to whom else that son could be more dear.

0.g: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਭੰਨੈ ਪਾਹਰੂ; ਕਉਣੁ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ।
0.e: If the watchman breaks open the house, then, who else could be a protector.

0.g: ਬੇੜਾ ਡੋਬੈ ਪਾਤਣੀ; ਕਿਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ।
0.e: If the boatman makes the boat sink, how one could get across.

0.g: ਆਗੂ ਲੈ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਵੈ; ਕਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: If the leader himself makes the people go astray, who else could be called for help.

0.g: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਤੈ ਖਾਇ ਵਾੜਿ; ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ।
0.e: And if the protecting fence starts eating the crops who else will take care of the fields.

0.g: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਾਏ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਕਰਿ; ਕਿਆ ਸਿਖੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ।੨੨।
0.e: Similarly, if the Guru deludes a Sikh through a sham, what a poor Sikh could do.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਸਦਾਵਣਾ; ਕੀੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ।
0.e: Ants never make themselves noticed and are known lowest among the lowly.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ; ਇਕਤੁ ਖਡੁ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਮਾਏ ।
0.e: They follow the path of gurmukhs and due to their broad mindedness they live in thousands, in a small hole.

0.g: ਘਿਅ ਸਕਰ ਦੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ; ਜਿਥੈ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਥੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਏ ।
0.e: Only by smelling ghee and sugar, they reach the place where these things are kept (gurmukhs also search out he holy congregations).

0.g: ਡੁਲੈ ਖੰਡੁ ਜੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ; ਖੰਡੂ ਦਾਣਾ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਏ ।
0.e: They pick up the sugar bits scattered in sand similarly as a gurmukh cherishes the virtues.

0.g: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਦੇ ਭੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ; ਹੋਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ ।
0.e: Dying of the fear of worm bhringi the ant itself becomes bhringi and makes others also like itself.

0.g: ਅੰਡਾ ਕਛੂ ਕੂੰਜ ਦਾ; ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Like the eggs of heron and tortoise, it (ant) remains detached amidst hopes.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ।੮।
0.e: Similarly gurmukhs also getting educated attain the pleasure fruits.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ; ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ।
0.e: The polite language of a Sikh brings out what he thinks in his mind and heart.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਣਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ।
0.e: A Sikh beholds God everywhere with his own eyes, and that is equal to a yogi's meditation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਲਾਪੈ ।
0.e: When a Sikh listens attentively to, or himself sings, the word of God, that is equal to the five ecstatic sounds in the brain of a yogi.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ; ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ।
0.e: Earning livelihood with his hands by a Sikh is equal to the obeisance and prostration (of Hindus).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ; ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ।
0.e: When, the gurmukh, walks to behold the Guru, that is equal to an extremely holy circumambulation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੈਨਣਾ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪਛਾਪੈ ।
0.e: When the Guru oriented person eats and clothes himself, that is equal to the performance of Hindu sacrifice and offering.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਣੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ।
0.e: When gurmukh sleeps, that is equal to a yogi's trance and the gunnukh withdraws not his thoughts from the object (God the Guru) of his concentration.

0.g: ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ।
0.e: The householder is liberated in life; he is not afraid of the waves of the world's ocean and fear does not enter his heart.

0.g: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ, ਲੰਘਿ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: He goes beyond the region of blessings and curses, and does not utter them.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ; ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਰਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Brahma Visnu and Mahesra all the three are creator, sustainer and dispenser of justice respectively.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਘਰਬਾਰੀਆ; ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੇ ।
0.e: The house holders of all the four varnas depend upon caste-gotra the lineage and maya.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਾ; ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਨਿ ਦੇਵਾਜੇ ।
0.e: People perform hypocritical rituals pretending to follow the six philosophies of six shastras.

0.g: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਮ ਧਰਿ; ਜੋਗੀ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Likewise the sannyasis assuming ten names and yogis creating their twelve sects are moving around.

0.g: ਦਹਦਿਸਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਹੋਇ; ਪਰ ਘਰ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਖਾਜ ਅਖਾਜੇ ।
0.e: They are all going astray in ten directions and twelve sects go on begging edibles and non edibles.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ।
0.e: The gursikhs of all the four varnas jointly recite and listen to the unstruck melody in the holy cangregation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਉਂ ਪੰਥ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Gurmukh going beyond all varnas follows the philosophy of ncim and the path of spiritual delight made for him.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ, ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਪਾਜੇ ।੧੮।
0.e: The truth is always true and falsehood is altogether false.

0.g: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜੋ; ਭੈ ਨਾਸਨ ਭੋਗੀ ।
0.e: Remember the destroyer of anxiety, and worship the obliterator of licentiousness.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ; ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਰੋਗੀ ।
0.e: The Cherisher of His Devotees, destroys their afflictions, and makes them, the ones in meditation, for ever diseaseless.

0.g: ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮੁਕੰਦ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ।
0.e: His alluring demeanour grants emancipation and chances amalgamation (with God).

0.g: ਰਸੀਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਰਚਨਹਾਰ; ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀ ।
0.e: He, Himself is the Admirer, the Protector, and the Creator, and He proceeds the way He wishes.

0.g: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਖੇਲਾ ।
0.e: God, the liberator of the destiny, is the adversary of ego and duality, and luxuriates in multitudes of plays.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੧੨।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੁਰਸਤੀ ਜਮਨਾ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ; ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਗਿ ਸੇਤ ਕੁਰਖੇਤ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Rivers like Ganges, Saraswati, Jamuna, Godavari and places of pilgrimage like Gaya, Prayagraj, Rameshwram, Kurukshetra and Mansarover lakes are located in India.

0.g: ਕਾਸੀ ਕਾਤੀ ਦੁਆਰਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਅਜੁਧਿਆ; ਗੋਮਤੀ ਆਵੰਤਕਾ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਹਿਮਧਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: So are the holy cities of Kashi, Kanti, Dwarka, Mayapuri, Mathura, Ayodhya, Avantika and river Gomti. The temple of Kedarnath in the snow clad hills is a sacred place.

0.g: ਨਰਬਦਾ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਲ ਕਵਲਾਸ; ਨੀਲ ਮੰਦਰਾਚਲ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਗਿਰਵਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Then river like Narmada, temples of gods, tapovans, Kailash, the abode of Shiva, Neel mountains, Mandrachal and Sumer are places worth going on a pilgrimage to.

0.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਅਰਥ ਸਤ ਧਰਮ ਦਇਆ ਸੰਤੋਖ; ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਤੁਲ ਨ ਸਗਰ ਹੈ ।੪੧੬।
0.e: To seek the virtues of Truth, contentment, benevolence and righteousness, the holy places are idolized and worshipped. But all these are not equal to even the dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru. (Taking refuge of Satguru is supreme of all these place

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ; ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ।
0.e: God Almighty is the Immaculate and Supreme Being.

0.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ; ਸਰਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Knowing all, He is the saviour of fallen ones.

0.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ; ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Beholding all, He is prudent and bountiful in charity.

0.g: ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ਆਪੁ; ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ।
ਇਹ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਅਮੋਲ ਹੈ; ਮਿਲਨੇ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: In valuable human form, it is the time to join with Him.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੧੧।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਸਣ ਵਣ ਵਾੜੀ ਖੇਤੁ ਇਕੁ; ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਜਣਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Hemp and cotton grow in the same field but the use of one is benevolent while the other one is put to evil use.

0.g: ਖਲ ਕਢਾਹਿ ਵਟਾਇ ਸਣ; ਰਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਨ੍ਹਾਵੈ ।
0.e: After peeling off the hemp plant rope is made whose nooses are used to tie people in bondage.

0.g: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ; ਸੂਤੁ ਕਤਾਇ ਕਪਾਹ ਵੁਣਾਵੈ ।
0.e: On the other hand, from cotton are made coarse cloth muslin and sirisaf.

0.g: ਲਜਣੁ ਕਜਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਸਾਧੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Cotton in the form of cloth covers the modesty of others and protects the dharma of sadhus as well as wicked persons.

0.g: ਸੰਗ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ; ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਨ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The sadhus even when they associate with the evil never repudiate their saintly nature.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਗ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੁਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: When the hemp transformed into coarse cloth is brought to the holy places for spreading in the holy congregation, it also becomes blest after coming in touch with the dust of the feet of the sadhus.

0.g: ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਸਣ ਕਿਰਤਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Also, when after getting a thorough beating paper is made of it, the holy men write praises of the Lord.on it and recite the same for others.

0.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ, ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ।੧੯।
0.e: The holy congregation makes the fallen ones also holy.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰੈ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਅਰੋਗ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a would-be mother takes care of what she eats so that the child in her womb remains healthy.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚੇਤੰਨ ਰੂਪ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਚਿੰਤ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਬਸਤ ਲੋਗ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a good ruler remains alert in the enforcement of law and order so as to keep his subjects safe, fearless of any harm and happy.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਥ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਪਥਿਕ ਅਸੋਗ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a sailor is ever alert while sailing his boat in the ocean so that he takes all his passengers safely to other shore.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ; ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਸਿਖ ਨਿਜਪਦ ਜੋਗ ਜੀ ।੩੫੪।
0.e: Similarly, the God-like True Guru is ever alert to bless his loving and devoted servant with knowledge and ability to focus his mind in Lord's name. And thus a Sikh of the Guru keeps himself free of all vices and becomes eligible for higher spiritual stat

0.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The benefactor Lord listened to the cries (of humanity) and sent Guru Nanak to this world.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ, ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ; ਚਰਣਾਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਪੀਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He washed His feet, eulogised God and got his Disciples drink the ambrosia of his feet.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He preached in this darkage (kaliyug) that, saragun (Brahm) and nirgun (Parbrahm) are the same and identical.

0.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਮ ਦੇ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Dharma was now established on its four feet and all the four castes (through fraternal feeling) were converted into one caste (of humanity).

0.g: ਰਾਣਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ; ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜਗਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Equating the poor with the prince, he spread the etiquette of humbly touching the feet.

0.g: ਉਲਟਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਦਾ; ਪੈਰਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Inverse is the game of the beloved; he got the egotist high heads bowed to feet.

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਬਾਬੇ ਤਾਰਿਆ; ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Baba Nanak liberated this dark age (kaljug) and recited the mantra of satnaam for one and all.

0.g: ਕਲਿ ਤਾਰਣਿ, ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ।੨੩।
0.e: Guru Nanak came to redeem the kaliyug.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ; ਸਿਖ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: Rare is the gurmukh who concentrates upon the Guru and attains the divine sight.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਰਤਨਾ ਅਵਲੋਈ ।
0.e: He is the jeweller having the capacity of testing as well as keeping the jewels in the from of virtues.

0.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕਾ; ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੋਈ ।
0.e: His mind becomes pure like ruby and he remains absorbed in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਮਾਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਈ ।
0.e: His mind becomes pure like ruby and he remains absorbed in the holy congregation.

0.e: The defilement of worms and moth never ends then how should they spend their time!

0.e: Insects keep hovering over water surfaces in Silvan (rainy month) howsoever one might try to drive them away.

0.e: As in the month of Vaisakh migratory heron birds fly over foreign lands.

0.e: Man without the Guru is not liberated and suffers transmigration.

0.e: May I be a sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who, meeting the true Guru have lost their ego.

0.e: May I be a sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who, while living amidst maya, remain indifferent to it.

0.e: May I be a sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who, in accordance with Gurmat concentrate their mind on the feet of the Guru.

0.g: ਹਉ ਸਦਕੇ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: May I be a sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who, imparting the teachings of the Guru make another disciple meet the Guru.

0.g: ਹਉ ਸਦਕੇ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: May I be a sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who, have resisted and bounded the outgoing mind.

0.g: ਹਉ ਸਦਕੇ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: May I be a sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who, while living among hopes and desires.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾ, ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦਿੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ ।੬।
0.e: Remain indifferent to them and learn steadfastly the teaching of the true Guru.

0.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਏ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Blessed is he who accepting Guru's advice become his disciple (devotee). In the process his mind is reassured in the True Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਾਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਾਉ ਚਾਉ ਰਿਦੈ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਾਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By accepting his (Guru's) teachings with faith, love and enthusiasm develops in the heart of a devotee. He who labours on the teachings of Guru with singular mind, becomes known as a true Sikh of the Guru the world over.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਹਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The union of Guru and his Sikh by virtue of strenuous meditation on Lord's name that enables him practice Guru's teachings sincerely and adeptly, the Sikh then recognises the complete Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ; ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ।੧੪੯।
0.e: The sincerity of the Sikh in labouring on the teachings of his Guru brings both together to the extent of becoming one. Believe it! By repeated incantations of Waheguru, Waheguru (Lord) and Tuhi Tuhi (He alone, He alone), he lodges the Lord in his heart.

0.g: ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਪੁੰਸਕ ਨ ਸੰਤਤ ਹੁਇ; ਸਲਲ ਬਿਲੋਇ ਕਤ ਮਾਖਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a barren woman and an impotent man cannot produce children, and churning of water cannot yield butter.

0.g: ਫਨ ਗਹਿ ਦੁਗਧ ਪੀਆਏ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਬਿਖੁ; ਮੂਰੀ ਖਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਸੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a poison of a cobra cannot be destroyed by feeding him milk and one cannot get good smell from mouth after eating radish.

0.g: ਮਾਨਸਰ ਪਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਬਾਇਸੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ; ਅਰਗਜਾ ਲੇਪੁ ਖਰ ਭਸਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a filth-eating crow on reaching lake Mansarover, becomes sad since he cannot get filth which he is so used to eating; and a donkey will roll in dust even if it is given a bath with sweet smelling scents.

0.g: ਆਂਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ; ਕਠਨ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ।੪੪੫।
0.e: Similarly, the servant of other gods cannot realise the ecstasy of serving the True Guru, because the chronic and bad habits of the followers of god cannot perish.  (445)

0.g: ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਏਕ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੁਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The dear beloved who has not one but many obedient consorts; the dispenser of kindness on the distressed, the  beloved has been clement on me.

0.g: ਸਜਨੀ ਰਜਨੀ ਸਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅਉਸਰ ਮੈ; ਅਬਲੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਉਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: That moonlit night (the auspicious moment) when the time for me to belong to and enjoy the loving elixir of the Lord came, this humble maid slave in all the humility· made a supplication before the beloved True Guru;

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ; ਹਾਥ ਜੋਰੇ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Oh beloved! Whatever will be your command, I shall obey implicitly. I shall ever serve you obediently and with humility.

0.g: ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਾਇ ਚਾਇਕੈ ਚਈਲੋ ਭਜਉ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਆਜ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੈ ।੨੧੨।
0.e: I shall serve you with dedication and devotion of loving worship in my heart. This moment when you have so kindly blessed me with your consecration, my human birth has become purposeful since my turn to meet my beloved Lord has come. (212)

0.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ।
0.e: Sorath:

0.e: God - manifest Satguru's play is ecstatic and blissful, astonishing beyond astonishment,

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਭਏ ।੧।੮।
0.e: unimaginably wondrous, and amazing beyond perception.

0.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ।
0.e: Dohra:

0.e: (Describing the wondrous state of Guru who is immanent of the Lord), we have reached the awesome of awesome state, in the most enrapturing ecstatic state,

0.e: wonderfully strange condition of transcendence seeing the magnificence of the Lord .

0.g: ਛੰਦ ।
0.e: Channt:

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਅਗੋਚਰ ।
0.e: Primordial Lord (God) has no beginning. He is beyond and still farther. He is free of such mundane worldly pleasures like taste, desires and fragrances.

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਸ ਪਰਸ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਮਨੋਚਰ ।
0.e: He is beyond vision, touch, reach of mind, intelligence and words.

0.e: The imperceptible and unattached Lord cannot be known by study of Vedas and through other earthly knowledge.

0.g: ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ।੩।੮।
0.e: Satguru who is embodiment of Lord and inhabits His divine radiance is infinite. Thus, he is worthy of salutation and obeisance in all the three times-past, present and future. (8)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਸੋਭਾ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਤੋਲੇ ।
0.e: Holy congregation is that ocean of delight in which the waves of Lord’s praise adorn it.

0.e: Myriad rubies diamonds and pearls in the form of Guru’s teachings exist in this ocean.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਗਮ ਅਲੋਲੇ ।
0.e: Musicality here is like a jewel and merging their consciousness in the rhythm of the unstruck Word, the listeners listen to it with rapt attention.

0.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ; ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੋਇਲ ਗੋਲੇ ।
0.e: Here the miraculous powers are subservient and the four ideals of life (dharm, arth, kam and moks) are servants and being transitory does not attract the attention of the people who reached this stage.

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚੰਦ ਚਰਾਗਚੀ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਚਨਿ ਝੋਲੇ ।
0.e: Myriad means here work as lamps and myriad men getting elated quaff the nectar.

0.g: ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ; ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਨਿ ਅਡੋਲੇ ।
0.e: Myriad of wish fulfilling cows gaze delightfully in the forest of wish fulfilling trees.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲੇ ।੨੦।੧੨। ਬਾਰਾਂ ।
0.e: In fact the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is ineffable.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ; ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The moon, loving the redlegged partridge, makes its light shining.

0.g: ਕਿਰਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਫਲੁ ਫਲਿ; ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਵਰਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: It pours the nectar of peace by which the crop, trees etc. are blest.

0.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਿਹਜਾ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਬਣੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Husband meets wife and prepares her for further joy.

0.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ; ਚਕਵੀ ਚਕਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੰਦਾ ।
0.e: All meet in the night but the male and the female ruddy sheldrake go away from each other.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹਿ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ਲਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: This way, even listening to the Guru's teachings in the holy congregation the fake lover does not know the depth of love.

0.g: ਮਜਲਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਲਸਣੁ ਖਾਇ; ਗੰਦੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਚਾਏ ਗੰਦਾ ।
0.e: As the person having eaten garlic spreads malodour.

0.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ, ਮੰਦੀ ਹੂੰ ਮੰਦਾ ।੭।
0.e: The results of duality are the most bad of the worst.

0.g: ਬਿਰਖੈ ਬਇਆਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਹਿਰਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ; ਪੰਛੀ ਨ ਧੀਰਜ ਕਰਿ ਠਉਰ ਠਹਰਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the leaves and branches of a tree start trembling under the influence of fast wind and even the birds lose trust of their nests;

0.g: ਸਰਵਰ ਘਾਮ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਜ ਬਿਲਖ ਮੁਖ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅੰਤ ਹੰਤ ਜਲ ਜੰਤ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as lotus flowers whither away under the sharp heat of the Sun and aquatic life of the water feels distressed as if their lives were coming to an end;

0.g: ਸਾਰਦੂਲ ਦੇਖੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਮਾਲ ਸੁਕਚਿਤ ਬਨ; ਵਾਸ ਮੈ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the herd of deers find solace and safety in their small hiding places in the jungle when they see the lion in the vicinity;

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਂਗ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗਿ ਭਏ ਬੈ ਚਕਤਿ ਸਿਖ; ਦੁਖਤਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ।੪੦੨।
0.e: Similarly, the Sikhs of the Guru are frightened, amazed, distressed and morose seeing the body/limbs of a spurious Guru marked with artificial marks of recognition. Even the Sikhs most close to the Guru feel restless.  (402)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਵਾਉ ਵਿਚਿ; ਅਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: In His will lakhs of deep and unfathomable rivers (of life) go on flowing.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਫੇਰ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Beginning and end of those life currents cannot be understood.

0.g: ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਲਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They are infinite, inaccessible and imperceptible but still all move in the Lord, the great. They cannot know the extent of that imperceptible and boundless Lord.

0.g: ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਲਖ; ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਗਮ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Rivers having myriad's of waves meeting the ocean becomes one with it.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੁਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: In that ocean are lakhs of invaluable jewel materials, which in fact are beyond all costing.

0.g: ਸਦਕੇ, ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਸਿਰੰਦੇ ।੯।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto that Creator Lord.

0.g: ਓਲਾ ਬਰਖਨ ਕਰਖਨ ਦਾਮਨੀ ਬਯਾਰਿ; ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਬਨ ਜਰਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: If hails be falling, lightening be making thunderous sounds, storm be raging. stormy waves be rising in the ocean and forests may be burning with fire;

0.g: ਰਾਜੀ ਬਿਰਾਜੀ ਭੂਕੰਪਕਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਲ; ਬੰਦਸਾਲ ਸਾਸਨਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The subjects be without their king, earthquakes be experienced, one may have been troubled by some deep innate pain and for some offence may have been lodged in the jail;

0.g: ਆਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰਿ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਨਗਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Many tribulations may overpower him, may be distressed by false accusations, poverty may have crushed him, may be wandering for loan and caught in the slavery, may be straying aimlessly but in acute hunger;

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਜਉ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜਗ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਭਗਨ ਹੈ ।੪੦੩।
0.e: And even if more of such worldly tribulations and distresses may befall upon Guru-loving, obedient and meditating persons dear to the True Guru, they are least troubled by them and live life ever in bloom and happiness.  (403)

0.g: ਦਸਵਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸ਼ਾਹ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ; ਸਭ ਥਾਈਂ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਇ ।

0.e: Just as the water flows down towards low

0.e: Millions are physicians adept in medicine and millions are armed rich men.

0.e: Just as a lecherous person declares himself chaste and celibate like the deers of a jungle after committing adultery with some other woman, he is not let off on his statement. Instead his nose and ears are chopped off and he is expelled from the city.

0.g: ਚੋਰੀ ਬਟਵਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ; ਨਰਕ ਅਰਕ ਸੁਤ ਡੰਡ ਦੇਤ ਹਾਰੀਐ ।੫੨੪।
0.e: A thief, dacoit and a lecherous man is punished so severely for one crime they commit. But I am a sufferer of all these three ailments like tuberculosis. So punishing me for all these sins, the angels of death will get tired.  (524)

0.e: Gods and goddesses adore that Lord but their service does not take them to His mystery.

0.e: They all declare the feet of Guru as unapproachable

0.e: To crave for the material of store (for the Sikhs) is improper.

0.e: The cravings of the caving person cannot be controlled and for him the inedible becomes edible.

0.e: As the cow meat is forbidden in Hindu code of conduct;
