0.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਆਪਿ ਰੀਝਿ ਰੀਝਾਏ ।
0.e: Merging his consciousness in the Word he becomes elated and makes others also delighted.

0.g: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ; ਸੁਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Lord is the speaker as well as the listener immersed in super consciousness.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਰਬੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ।
0.e: Himself all bliss He premeates one and all.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਏ ।੨।
0.e: This mystery that the Lord is omnipresent, is only understood by a gurmukh, the Guru oriented one.

0.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਖੇਹ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਲਈ ਨਕੀਬੀ ।
0.e: Human body is like ashes but in it the tongue is admirable (for its benefits).

0.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ; ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੰਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਰਕੀਬੀ ।
0.e: The eyes behold forms and colours and the ears take care of the sounds- musical and otherwise.

0.g: ਨਕਿ, ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਬੁਰੀ ਤਰਤੀਬੀ ।
0.e: Nose is the abode of smell and thus all these five couriers (of the body) remain indulged in these pleasures (and become futile).

0.g: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੇ ਚਰਣ ਹੋਇ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨਸੀਬੁ ਨਸੀਬੀ ।
0.e: Among these all, the feet are placed at the lowest level and they repudiating ego are fortunate.

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਦਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਬੀਬੀ ।
0.e: The true Guru by giving treatment removes the malady of ego.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਰਹਿਰਾਸ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨੀਬੀ ।
0.e: The true disciples of the Guru touch the feet and bow and abide by the instructions of the Guru.

0.g: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ, ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ।੩।
0.e: He who becomes humble and dead to all desires is the true disciple.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਠਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The perfect true Guru is known in his majestic form.

0.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਘਟਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Perfect is the justice of the perfect Guru to which nothing can be added nor reduced from.

0.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰਸੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The wisdom of the perfect Guru is perfect and he makes up his mind with out asking for other's counsel .

0.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਟਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The mantra of the perfect is perfect and his command cannot be avoided.

0.g: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: All desires are fulfilled when joining the holy congregation, one meets the perfect Guru .

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ; ਪਤਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Crossing all calculations the Guru has climbed the ladder of honour to reach his own loft.

0.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।੧੬।
0.e: Becoming perfect he has merged in that perfect Lord.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ; ਨਿਧਿ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜੀ ।
0.e: In all of the four ideals of life, riddhis, siddhis and myriads of treasures;

0.g: ਲਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ; ਲਖ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Philosopher’s stones, wish fulfilling trees and many varieties of wealth are collected;

0.g: ਲਖ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ; ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਚਮੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Myriads of fabulous gems supposed to yield anything desired and wish fulfilling cows are also added to all this;

0.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਿਆ; ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਮਹੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Again invaluable jewels, pearls and diamonds are kept with all this;

0.g: ਲਖ ਕਵਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਮੇਰੁ ਲਖ; ਲਖ ਰਾਜ ਬਹੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Myriads of kailas and Sumer mountains are also gathered together;

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ; ਮੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸੁ ਥੋੜੀ ।੯।
0.e: Even then they all have no standing at all before the invaluable elixir of love of the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਸਿਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਲੋਵੈ ।
0.e: The way of gurmukhs is that way of truth treading which, the Sikh automatically stabilizes in his innate nature.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ।
0.e: The conduct of gurmukhs is true; touching of the feet and becoming of dust of the feet i.e. getting most humble is their active behaviour.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਵਣਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ।
0.e: The ablution in Sikh-life is washing away of evil propensities by adopting the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat).

0.g: ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਪੂਜਣਾ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਜ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਵੈ ।
0.e: Worship in Sikh-life is the worship (service) to the Sikhs of the Guru and getting drenched in the shower of love of the dear Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਮੰਨਣਾ; ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਵੈ ।
0.e: Wearing the words of the Guru like garland, is the accepting of the will of the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਜੀਂਵਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ।
0.e: Life of a gursikh is being dead i.e. losing one's ego while alive.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ ।੯।
0.e: In such a life the word of the Guru is churned in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਵੁਣੈ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਤੰਦੁ ਗੰਢਿ; ਇਕੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਣਾ ਵਾਣਾ ।
0.e: By tying the threads, weaver weaves huge warp and weft with a single yarn.

0.g: ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਦਾ; ਪਾਟਾ ਮੁਲ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਿਕਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Tailor tears and spoils cloth and torn cloth cannot be sold.

0.g: ਕਤਰਣਿ ਕਤਰੈ ਕਤਰਣੀ; ਹੋਇ ਦੁਮੂਹੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਸਾਣਾ ।
0.e: His double-blade honed scissors cuts the cloth.

0.g: ਸੂਈ ਸੀਵੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆਂ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਣਾ ।
0.e: On the other hand, his needle stiches and the separated pieces are thus reunited.

0.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਾਹਿ ਦੁਇ; ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: That Lord is one but different ways have been created by Hindus and Muslims.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦੀ ਹੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The path of Sikhism is superior to both because it accepts an intimate relation between the Guru and the Sikh.

0.g: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਿਆਂ, ਹੈਰਾਣਾ ।੪।
0.e: The double-minded are always perplexed and thus they suffer.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਘ ਬਰਖਤ ਹਰਖਤਿ ਹੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਿ; ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਲੋਧਾ ਲੋਨ ਗਰਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a farmer is delighted to see the rainfall but the face of a weaver becomes ashen and he feels restless and miserable.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਫੁਲਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ; ਸੁਕਤ ਜਵਾਸੋ ਆਕ ਮੂਲ ਮੁਰਝਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as all the vegetation turns green with the fall of rain but the plant of camel thorn (Alhagi maurorum) withers while akk (Calotropis procera) dries out right from its roots.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਖੇਤ ਸਰਵਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਖ ਜਲ; ਊਚ ਥਲ ਕਾਲਰ ਨ ਜਲ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as ponds and fields are filled with water when it rains, but no water can accumulate on mounds and saline land.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਿਦੈ; ਸਾਕਤ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਕੁਚਾਤ ਹੈ ।੫੧੮।
0.e: Similarly, the sermon of the True Guru permeates in the mind of a Sikh of the Guru, that always keeps him in a state of bloom and happiness. But a self-oriented person who is in the grip of the worldly attractions is ever engrossed in mammon (maya). Thus

0.g: ਐ ਰੁਖ਼ਿ ਤੂ ਰੌਨਿਕਿ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਿ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।
0.e: O human being! You are one of the rays of the Divine glow, and become engulfed in divine radiance from head to toes,

0.g: ਅਸ਼ਕਿ ਰੇਜ਼ਿ ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਗੌਹਰ-ਬਾਰਿ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।੪੬।੧।
0.e: Get rid of any worries or suspicions, and get inebriated permanently in His memory. (63)

0.g: ਮਹਰਮ ਹਰਫ਼ਾਤਿ ਊ ਰਾ ਗਸ਼ਤਾ ਅਸ਼ਤ ।
0.e: How long would you be in the never-ending captivity of anxieties?

0.g: ਅਸ਼ਕ ਮੇ ਰੇਜ਼ਦ, ਦਿਲਿ ਅਫ਼ਗਾਰਿ ਸ਼ਮਾਅ ।੪੬।੨।
0.e: Get rid of sorrows and griefs; remember the Lord and stay safe and secure for ever. (64)

0.g: ਹਰ ਕੁਜਾ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਚਰਾਗੇ ਕਰਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: What is distress and depression? It is the negligence of His meditation;

0.g: ਯੱਕ ਗੁਲੇ ਬੂਦ ਅਸਤ ਅਜ਼ ਗੁਲਜ਼ਾਰਿ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।੪੬।੩।
0.e: What is pleasure and joy? It is the remembrance of the Almighty of infinite dimensions. (65)

0.g: ਤਾ ਕਿਹ ਬਰ-ਅਫ਼ਰੋਖ਼ਤੀ ਰੁਖ਼ਸਾਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ।
0.e: Do you know the meaning of the Illimitable?

0.g: ਮੀ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਿ ਤੂ ਸਦ ਬਾਰ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।੪੬।੪।
0.e: It is the Boundless, the Akaalpurakh, who is not subjected to births and deaths. (66)

0.g: ਗਿਰਦਿ ਰੁਖ਼ਸਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਅਜ਼ ਬਹਿਰਿ ਨਿਸਾਰ ।
0.e: Every man and woman in his/her head is overwhelmed with His ardor;

0.g: ਜਾਣ ਬਰੀਜ਼ਦ ਦੀਦਾਹਾਇ ਜ਼ਾਰਿ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।੪੬।੫।
0.e: All this excitement in both the worlds is His creation. (67)

0.g: ਬਸਕਿ ਇਮਸ਼ਬ ਨਾਮਦੀ ਅਜ਼ ਇੰਤਜ਼ਾਰ ।
0.e: It is the tongue of the saints and noble souls where He has made His abode;

0.g: ਸੋਖ਼ਤ ਮਹਿਫਲ ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਆਤਿਸ਼ ਬਾਰਿ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।੪੬।੬।
0.e: Or He abides in their hearts where there is constant remembrance of Him day and night. (68)

0.g: ਸੁਬਹ ਦਮ ਗੋਯਾ ਤਮਾਸ਼ਿਾਇ ਅਜੀਬ ।
0.e: The eyes of a meditator never open up to see anyone or anything else but Him;

0.g: ਜੁਮਲਾ ਆਲਮ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਾ ਓ ਬੇਦਾਰ ਸ਼ਮਆ ।੪੬।੭।
0.e: And, his drop (of water), every breath, does not flow towards any other place except towards the vast ocean (the Akaalpurakh). (69)

0.g: ਨਾਰ ਕੈ ਭਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਹੁਇ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a wife is considered faithful who lives life in the love of her husband. So does an obedient Sikh of the Guru take refuge of one Guru-God Lord.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਅਉ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਹੁਇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਕਾਨ ਸਿਖ ਦੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a husband enjoys the subject of mode of singing musical instruments and other conversation, so does a Sikh in the service of the Guru talks and listens nothing other than the sound of the divine words of the Guru.

0.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਹੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a faithful wife admires the good looks, colour and beauty of all limbs of her husband, so does a devoted Sikh neither is the follower of any god nor proceeds to see any. Other than one True Guru, the form of True Master, he looks at no one else.

0.g: ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਗਉਨ ਕਰੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ।੪੪੯।
0.e: Just as a faithful wife lives amongst the close relatives in her house and goes nowhere else; so does the Sikh of the Guru go nowhere else other than the court of the True Guru and assembly of His devoted and loving Sikhs. Places of other gods and goddess

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੇਦੁ ਲੈ; ਮੇਲੁ ਕਪੂਰ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Mixing the sandal oil, fragrance of the musk-cat, camphor, musk etc.

0.g: ਸਭ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਲਾਇ ਕੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਗਾਂਧੀ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: The perfumer prepares the scent.

0.g: ਮਜਲਸ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਾਂ; ਗੁਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਕੰਦਾ ।
0.e: When using it, some one comes to the assembly of the experts, they all become full of fragrance.

0.g: ਗਦਹਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਖਉਲੀਐ; ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਰਕ ਭਵੰਦਾ ।
0.e: If the same fragrance is applied to an ass, it does not understand its importance and goes on wandering at dirty places.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨ ਧਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Listening to the words of the Guru, one who does not adopt loving devotion in his heart.

0.g: ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਅਖੀ ਹੋਂਦਈ; ਬੋਲਾ ਕੰਨਾਂ ਸੁਣ ਨ ਸੁਣੰਦਾ ।
0.e: They are blind and deaf though they have eyes and ears.

0.g: ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ, ਜਾਇ ਭਰੰਦਾ ।੧੪।
0.e: In fact, he goes to the holy congregation under some compulsion.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਦਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਫੜਿ ਦੇਸੁ ਪੀੜਾਏ ।
0.e: In the Satyug the whole country suffered because of the evil deeds of one wrong-doer.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਵਗਲੀਐ; ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਹਮਾਏ ।
0.e: In Tretia the whole city was surrounded and in Dvapar, the whole family was to suffer hell.

0.g: ਜੋ ਫੇੜੈ ਸੋ ਫੜੀਦਾ; ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਾਏ ।
0.e: The justice of Kaliyug is true because only he suffers who does the evil deeds.

0.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਸਤੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਜੁਗਾ; ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿੜਾਏ ।
0.e: In Satyug, the truth, in Treta- the yajti, in Dvapar ritualistic worship were accomplished.

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ; ਹੋਰ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: In Kaliyug through no action other than constant remembering the Lord's name could attain liberation.

0.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਲੁਣੀਐ ਬੀਜਿਆ; ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: In all the yugs (ages) the individual reaps what he has sown and earns sufferings and delights in accordance with his demer

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ; ਪਾਪਹੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ।
0.e: In Kaliyug, the individual desires to have the fruits of meritorious actions though he remains absorbed in the sinful deeds

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ।੧੭।
0.e: Gurmukhs attain the pleasure fruit only by losing their sense of ego

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ, ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਤੋਟਾ ।
0.e: The trader trades and he earns profits as well as loss.

0.g: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ, ਹੋਇ ਦੁਬਲਾ ਮੋਟਾ ।
0.e: The farmer cultivates and thus increases or decreases.

0.g: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ, ਰਣਿ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਚੋਟਾਂ ।
0.e: The servant serves and gets blows in the battlefield.

0.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ, ਵਣ ਖੰਡ ਗੜ ਕੋਟਾ ।
0.e: The results of ruling, living as a yogi, residing in the world, forest

0.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ਪੈ, ਪਾਏ ਫਲ ਫੋਟਾ ।
0.e: And forts are such that ultimately man is caught in the web of yama i.e. he goes on transmigrating.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਹੁਇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਤੋਟਾ ।੮।
0.e: But such is love between the Sikh and his Guru that loss is never suffered.

0.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਕਮਲ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਸਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛਰਤ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਬਿਆਪਹੀ ।
0.e: The lotus flower keeps waiting for a glimpse of the Sun during the day while Nymphea lotus (kumudini) is ever eager to behold the moon. Lotus flower feels happy to meet the Sun during the day while at night, it feels distressed. On the contrary a Nymphea

0.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਹੀ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਿਲਾਪਹੀ ।
0.e: Going beyond the attitude of the Sun and Moon where they meet or separate from their beloved, a Guru-conscious person takes the refuge of the True Guru, and remains absorbed in the tranquil and comforting holy feet of the True Guru.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸੁਬਾਸਨ ਕੈ; ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਜਾਪਹੀ ।
0.e: Just as a bumble bee is enamored by the fragrance of a flower and remains enticed in its love, so does a Guru-oriented person remains engrossed in the fragrance of elixir-like Naam in the seat of the mystical tenth door.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ; ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਅਲਾਪਹੀ ।੨੬੬।
0.e: Free from the influence of three traits of the maya (mammon), a Guru-conscious person is ever absorbed in singing the melody of the Naam in the mystical tenth door state of high spirituality. (266)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਦੀ; ਕਿਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ।
0.e: How is the dynamism of the Unmanifest known?

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਅਕਥ ਦੀ; ਕਿਉ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ।
0.e: How can the story of that ineffable Lord be told?

0.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਹੈ; ਹੈਰਾਣ ਕਰਾਏ ।
0.e: He is wonderful for the wonder itself.

0.g: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ; ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਮਾਏ ।
0.e: The absorbents in the wondrous realization get themselves elated.

0.g: ਵੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਹੁ; ਸੇਸਨਾਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: The Vedas also do not understand this mystery and even the Sesanag (mythological snake having thousand hoods) cannot know its limits.

0.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲਾਏ ।੧੩।
0.e: Vahiguru, God, is eulogised through recitation of the Word of the Guru, Gurbani.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ, ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: The gurmukh who have received well with the Guru's teachings have got their minds enlightened.

0.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ, ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: They have understood that the world is like a parental home; one has to go one day from here and hence all their doubts have been removed.

0.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ, ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਵੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: They are unattached amid hopes and remain charged with the knowledge.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ, ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਦੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: They spread message of the Word in accordance with the conduct of the holy congregation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ, ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਿਆ ।
0.e: The idea that they are servants of the servants of the Lord has got deeply rooted in the wisdom of the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਸਿਮਰਣ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ, ਦੇਸ ਵਿਦੇਸਿਆ ।੭।
0.e: Be they anywhere in the country or abroad they remember God with every inhalation and exhalation of breath.

0.g: ਸਤਿਰੂਪ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ; ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: True of form, the True Guru is the embodiment of the perfect Lord. Focusing on True Guru is truly focusing on the Lord. True Guru helps us realise the Lord of Eternal Name.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਸਤਿ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Guru-blessed unstruck word is eternal of form and this is the means of divine knowledge and His realisation. The Guru-wise path defined by the True Guru is eternal of form, but this path is beyond reach.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸਤਿ; ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The assembly of Guru's obedient and saintly disciples is the abode of the eternal Lord. Singing His praises through Gurbani with singular mind, a devoted disciple becomes one with God, the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਚਾਉ ਸਤਿ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ।੩੪੩।
0.e: The heart of a Guru-conscious disciple of the Guru is ever filled with loving devotion and enthusiasm of His worship. Salute such a cool-natured Guru-conscious disciple again and again. (343)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁਆਰ ਗਾਇਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਜਤਨ ਬਨ; ਖੇਤ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਚਰਤ ਅਘਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as cowherd grazer grazes his cows very attentively in the jungle and does not let them wander into some fields, and they graze to their satisfaction.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਰਾਜਨੀਤ ਬਿਖੈ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਸ ਪਰਜਾ ਬਸਤ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a king who is righteous and just, his subjects live in peace and prosperity.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਖੇਵਟ ਚੇਤੰਨਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਮੈ; ਲਾਗੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਬੋਹਥ ਪਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a sailor is very alert and conscious of his duties, that ship touches the yonder shore without any adverse happenings.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਖ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਕੈ ।੪੧੮।
0.e: Similarly, the True Guru who has merged with the Light divine of the Lord, like warp and weft of a cloth, alone can make a disciple living emancipated with His teachings.  (418)

0.g: ਬਿਥਾਵੰਤੇ ਬੈਦ ਰੂਪ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਗਤਿ; ਗਾਹਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Gursikhs with contemplated knowledge extend all help to the needy as an act of welfare, just as a medicine practitioner does for a patient, a donor does for a beggar, a trader for a customer and parents for their son.

0.g: ਨਾਰ ਭਿਰਤਾਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਤਾਈ ਰੂਪ; ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਖਾ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਸੂਤ ਕਉ ।
0.e: As an act of benevolence, the relishers of Lord's name reach the distressed people to render them comfort They are husband to a distressed wife or vice versa, friends to friends and other loved ones; according to the defined moral code.

0.g: ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ; ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Sikhs blessed with Guru's wisdom acquire the supreme knowledge of the Lord and meet the common mortals as one of them and as intelligent and wise in the gathering of learned men. They approach the hermits as renouncers.

0.g: ਬਿਰਲੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੇਤਿ; ਮਿਲਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਗਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਭੂਤ ਕਉ ।੧੧੪।
0.e: Such a rational and knowledgeable Sikh is very rare who for the sake of benevolence becomes humble like water and unites with the people of all denominations. (114)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਪਹਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦੇ; ਸਿਖ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: First the Guru making the disciple sit near his feet preaches to him.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ; ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Telling him about the distinction of the holy congregation and the abode of dharma, he is put into the service (of the mankind).

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਸੇਵਦੇ; ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰਾਏ ।
0.e: Serving through loving devotion, the servants of the Lord celebrate the anniversaries.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਸਚਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Attuning the consciousness with the Word, through the singing of hymns, one meets the truth.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਚ ਦਾ; ਸਚੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ।
0.e: The Gurmukh walks the path of Truth; practicing Truth he crosses the Worldly ocean.

0.g: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਨੋ; ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ।੧੭।
0.e: Thus the truthful one obtains the truth and getting it, the ego is erased.

0.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਜੁਮਲਾ ਜੂਦੋ ਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲ ।
0.e: Guru Arjan is the personification of bestowals and praises,

0.g: ਹਕੀਕਤ ਪਜ਼ੋਹਿੰਦਾਇ ਹੱਕ ਜਮਾਲ ।੭੫।
0.e: And, is the searcher of the reality of the glory of Akaalpurakh. (75)

0.g: ਵਜੂਦਸ਼ ਹਮਾ ਰਹਿਮਤਿ ਈਜ਼ਦੀ ।
0.e: His entire body is the glimpse and reflection of the kindness and benevolence of Akaalpurakh,

0.g: ਸਆਦਤ ਫਜ਼ਾਇੰਦਇ ਸਰਮਦੀ ।੭੬।
0.e: And, is the propagator of the eternal virtues. (76)

0.g: ਮੁਰੀਦਸ਼ ਦੋ ਆਲਮ ਚਿਹ ਬਲ ਸਦ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ।
0.e: What to speak of just two worlds, he had millions of followers,

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਕਰਮਹਾਇ ਊ ਜੁੱਰਾਅ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਰ ।੭੭।
0.e: All of them are drinking gulps of divine nectar of his kindness. (77)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ੋ ਨਜ਼ਮ ਕਾਲਿ ਹੱਕ ਅੰਦੇਸ਼ਾ ਰਾ ।
0.e: Verses full of divine thought comes down out of him,

0.g: ਬਦੋ ਨਸਕ ਇਲਇ ਯਕੀਂ-ਪੇਸ਼ਾ ਰਾ ।੭੮।
0.e: And, faith and trust-revealing essays, full of spiritual enlightenment, are also from him. (78)

0.g: ਜਲਾਇ ਮਕਾਲਿ ਹੱਕ ਆਮਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ।
0.e: Divine thought and conversation get the glitter and shine from him,

0.g: ਫ਼ਰੋਗ਼ਿ ਜਮਾਲਿ ਹੱਕ ਆਮਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ।੭੯।
0.e: And, the divine beauty also gets its freshness and bloom from him.(79)

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਆਸਾ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: An obedient disciple of the True Guru lodges the Guru's word in his consciousness in the holy company of God-loving people. He protects his mind from the influence of maya (mammon) and remains free from the worldly options and conceptions.

0.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ; ਬਰਤੈ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Living and dealing with the world, the Naam of the Lord which is treasure-house of indifference to the worldly attractions gets lodged in his mind. Thus the divine light effulges in his heart.

0.g: ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥਲ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Supreme Lord who manifests in perceptible and subtle ways in everything of the world becomes his support when he contemplates on Him. He reposes his confidence in that Lord alone.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੁਇ ਰੇਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ।੧੯੦।
0.e: By engrossing and attaching the mind in the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru, one destroys his egocentricity and adopts humility. He lives in the service of holy men and becomes a true servant of the Guru by accepting the teachings of the True Gur

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਲੂਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ; ਰਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਪੈ ।
0.e: True is he who is true to the salt of his master and dies fighting for him in the battelfield.

0.g: ਸਿਰ ਵਢੈ ਹਥੀਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਵਰੀਆਮਾ ਵਰਿਆਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ।
0.e: One who beheads the enemy with his weapon is known as brave among the warriors.

0.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਜੋ ਇਸਤਰੀ; ਥਪਿ ਥੇਈ ਦੇ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ ।
0.e: His bereaved woman is established as sati capable of granting boons and curses.

0.g: ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁਤ ਵਡੀਰੀਅਨਿ; ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ਪਰਾਪੈ ।
0.e: Sons and grandsons are praised and the whole family becomes exalted.

0.g: ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮਰੈ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ ।
0.e: One who dies fighting in the hour of peril and recites the Word in the ambrosial hour is known as the true warrior.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ।
0.e: Going to the holy congregation and effacing his desires, he wipes out his ego.

0.g: ਲੜਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਤੈ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਣੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਤੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ।
0.e: Dying while fighting in battle and maintaining of the controle over the senses is the grand path of the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਦਕ, ਸਚ ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਪੈ ।੧੪।
0.e: In whom you repose your full faith is known as the true Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਚੰਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੰਨਣਹੁ, ਕੋ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: None knows the mystery how in the association of sandal, other trees transform into sandal.

0.g: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲਦਾ ਦੀਵਿਅਹੁਂ, ਸਮਸਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
0.e: From lamp is illumined the lamp and looks identical.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਰਲਦਾ ਪਾਣੀਐ, ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ।
0.e: No one can identify that water which mixes into water.

0.e: Her husband fulfils all her needs of bedding, clothing, food, wealth, house and other property, and she in returns embellishes herself to enjoy oneness with her husband on the nuptial bed,

0.e: Millions of recitations, disciplines, continences, burnt oblations and fasts are performed.

0.e: Millions of holy journeys, charities are undertaken and millions of holy occasions are celebrated.

0.e: This experience that is felt in the tenth opening of the body, its radiance is astonishing and full of ecstasy. The stay of the mind in the mystical tenth door is of strange faith. (251)

0.e: They listen to, write and make others write the hymns of the Gurus.

0.e: They practice the remembrance of Lords name, charity and ablutions.

0.e: They walk in humility, speak sweetly, and eat the earning of their own hands.

0.e: O True Guru! be kind and let my head be in the feet of the True Guru, my ears be always attentive to listen to the words divine, my eyes be seeing your glimpse and thus bless me with true happiness.

0.e: O True Guru! be kind and bless me that my tongue may ever repeat and utter the ambrosial words that Guru has blessed me with, the hands may indulge in the service and salutation, the words of wisdom may remain installed in my mind and thus fix my consciou

0.e: Whoever is made noble by Satguru, he strives to make others noble too. Vices ridden, iron-slag-like person becomes pure like gold or even philosopher-stone. And a bamboo-like arrogant person becoming humble with the practicing of Lord's name acquires frag

0.e: The company of holy and True Guru is like rivers and lakes from where his disciples drink the elixir of Naam and quench their thirst. I, an unfortunate person am still thirsty because I am full of ill traits and vices. Please be clement on me and grant me

0.e: None knows the residing place of sleep and hunger in the body.

0.e: Whence idleness, yawning, hiccough, itch, gaping, sighing, snapping and clapping?

0.e: Hope, desire, happiness, sorrow, renunciation, enjoyment, suffering , pleasure, etc. are indestructible emotions.

0.e: And the same get deeply rooted in mind while one is asleep and dreaming.

0.e: Man controlled by desires, goes on intensely longing and yearning.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਚੈਨ ਹੁਇ ਚਤੁਰਕੁੰਟ; ਛਤ੍ਰ ਢਾਲਾ ਚਾਲ ਭਏ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੰਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as enforcement of law and order of the kingdom ensures peace and prosperity everywhere, but chaos prevails when enforcement is compromised.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗ; ਅੰਤਰੀਛ ਭਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਲੋਗ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ।੩੫੧।
0.e: So is the unique opportunity for the Sikhs of the Guru to meet with the saintly True Guru. Once missed, everyone repents. (351)

0.g: ਜਤ ਸਤ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ; ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The obedient Gursikh of the True Guru has truth and true morals as his throne while patience and contentment are his ministers. His flag is the eternal persevering righteousness.

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਇਆ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮਿਲੀ; ਭਾਗ ਤਉ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਕਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: That Sikh of the Guru resides in the tenth opening like capital of his body. Kindness is his prime queen. His past deeds and fortune is his treasurer while love is his royal feast and food. He is not a slave of worldly delicacies,

0.g: ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਕੈ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ; ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਛਿਮਾ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਛਬ ਛਾਬ ਹੈ ।
0.e: His policy of reigning is to establish a kingdom of humility and righteousness. Forgiveness is his canopy under which he sits. The comforting and peace giving shade of his canopy is known all around.

0.g: ਆਨਦ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ; ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਜ ਹੈ ।੨੪੬।
0.e: Peace and comfort to all are his happy subjects. By the practice of Naam Simran and his capital being in the tenth door where the divine radiance is ever effulgent, the unstruck melody is constantly playing in his capital. (246)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ, ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Rarely comes a benevolent gurmukh who serves others.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Gurmukh abandons ego and receives the fruit of delight.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਖੀ ਸਬਦਿ, ਸਿਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Only the gurmukh tells the story of the (grandeur of ) Word to the disciples (of the Guru) and never claims to tell something as his own.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Deeply pondering over the Word, a gurmukh practices truth in his life,

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਚੁ, ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He likes the truth, which resides in his heart as well as speech.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ, ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: Such a gurmukh not only spruces his own life he rather gets the whole world across.

0.g: ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਪਿਆਰ; ਮਿਥਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਪਹਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: There are several types of worldly loves but all these are false and considered a source of distress.

0.g: ਬੇਦ ਮਿਰਜਾਦਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਕਥਾ ਅਨੇਕ; ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨ ਤੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Several love episodes are found used in the Vedas in order to explain certain point but none is heard or believed to be anywhere near the love of a Sikh with his Guru and holy congregation.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਜਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਬਿਖੈ; ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Such true love cannot be found in methods and statements of knowledge, in saying of pious persons in the melodies sung in various modes with accompaniment of musical instruments from one end of world to the other.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਜੈਸੋ; ਤੈਸੋ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੇ ਅਉਰ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ।੧੮੮।
0.e: The expression of love between the Sikhs and the holy congregation of the True Guru has unique grandeur and such love cannot find its match in anyone's heart in the three worlds. (188)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ; ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਪਇਆਣਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukh goes beyond air, water, fire, earth and sky.

0.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਲੰਘਿ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਹਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Resisting lust and anger he crosses the greed, infatuation and ego.

0.g: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ; ਅਰਥੁ ਸੁ ਗਰੰਥੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He espouses truth, contentment, compassion, dharma and fortitude.

0.g: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਚਾਚਰੀ; ਉਨਮਨ ਲੰਘਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Getting above of the khechar bhuchar chachar, unman and agochar (all yogic postures) mudras he concentrates upon the One Lord.

0.g: ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ; ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਘਨਘੋਰ ਨੀਸਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He beholds God in five (select persons) and the five sounds of five words become his special marks.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਆਤਮਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਹਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Antahkaran, the basis of all five external elements is cultivated and cultured by gurmukh in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ, ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ।੫।
0.e: This way immersing in undisturbed trance he gets liberated from the cycle of transmigration.

0.g: ਲਤਾਂ ਹੇਠਿ ਲਤਾੜੀਐ; ਘਾਹੁ ਨ ਕਢੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Grass is trampled under feet yet the poor thing never complains.

0.g: ਗੋਰਸੁ ਦੇ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ; ਗਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The cow while eating grass remains altruist and gives milk to the poor.

0.g: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਜਮਾਈਐ; ਦਈਅਹੁ ਮਖਣੁ ਛਾਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: From milk is made curd and then from curd butter and delicious butter-milk etc are prepared.

0.g: ਘਿਅ ਤੇ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ; ਢੰਗ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: With that butter (ghee) homs, yajnas and other social and religious rituals are performed.

0.g: ਧਰਮ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ; ਧੀਰਜਿ ਵਹੈ ਸਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Dharma in the form of mythological bull patiently bears and burden of the earth.

0.g: ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਉ ਜਣੇਦਿਆਂ; ਚਹੁ ਚਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਗ ਹਜਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Each calf produces thousands of calves in all lands.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ, ਵਡਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ।੮।
0.e: One blade of grass has infinite extension i.e.the humility becomes base of the whole world.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਛਡਨੀ, ਹੁਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਇਕਠੇ ।
0.e: Opium-eaters eschew not opium and sit down together to eat it.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਜੂਏ ਜੂਆਰੀਆ, ਲਗਿ ਦਾਵ ਉਪਠੇ ।
0.e: Gamblers indulge in play and lose their stakes.

0.g: ਚੋਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਨ ਪਲਰਹਿ, ਦੁਖ ਸਹਨਿ ਗਰਠੇ ।
0.e: Thieves do not abandon thieving and suffer punishment when caught.

0.g: ਰਹਨਿ ਨ ਗਣਿਕਾ ਵਾੜਿਅਹੁ, ਵੇਕਰਮੀ ਲਠੇ ।
0.e: The evil-doers do not remain away from the house of the ill-repute women though they sell off even their clothes to provide for them.

0.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ, ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਨਠੇ ।
0.e: Sinners commit sin anu abscond to avoid punishment.

0.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ, ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਪਣਠੇ ।੨।
0.e: But, contrary to all these, the Sikhs of the Guru, (whose companionship is far from being injurious) love their Guru, and he absolves them of all their sins.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਚੋ ਪਾਰੋ ਖਾਤ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਗਾਤਿ; ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੈ ਪਿਰਾਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as consuming raw mercury causes such a disorder in the body that causes pain in every limb and one feels discomfort.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਲਸਨ ਖਾਏ ਮੋਨਿ ਕੈ ਸਭਾ ਮੈ ਬੈਠੇ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਰਤ ਦੁਰਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as after eating garlic one may remain silent in an assembly, even then its foul odour cannot be hidden.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਖੀ ਲੀਲੇ; ਹੋਤ ਉਕਲੇਦ ਖੇਦੁ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਹਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as a person may swallow a fly while eating sweetmeat, he vomits immediately. He bears much suffering and distress.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਪਰਚੇ ਪਿੰਡ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੀ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਖਾਏ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਜਮ ਲੋਕ ਜਾਈਐ ।੫੧੭।
0.e: Similarly an ignorant person consumes the offerings made by the devotees of the True Guru. He suffers much at the time of his death. He has to face the wrath of the angels of death.  (517)

0.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤੀ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ; ਬਨਿ ਬਨਵਾਸ ਨ ਉਦਾਸ ਡਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Without Guru's teaching and all by himself a householder engrossed in all household duties cannot reach the state of oneness with Lord nor renouncing the world and living in jungles can he attain Him

0.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ; ਸਿਧਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਦਿੜਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By becoming a scholar, reading scriptures no one can become knowledgeable of the magnificence of the Lord and describe Him. Nor by doing Yogic practices can one merge in Him.

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਥਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਨ ਨਾਥ; ਜਗਿ ਭੋਗ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੈ ਨ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Yogis, Naths could not realise Him by their strenuous yogic practices, nor can He be attained by doing yags etc.

0.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੈ ਨ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਟਾਰੀ; ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਮਝਾਇਓ ਹੈ ।੩੦।
0.e: Serving gods and goddesses one cannot get rid of one's ego. All this worship and offerings before these gods and goddesses only inflate the ego. The Lord who is beyond reach and description can only be reached with the teachings, knowledge and wisdom of t

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਰਹਰੈ; ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukh repudiates ego and he likes the will of God.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Becoming humble and falling at the feet he becomes dust and earns honour in the court of the Lord.

0.g: ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He always moves in the present i.e. never ignores the contemporary situations and side by side accepts whatever is likely to happen.

0.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਕਰਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Whatever is done by the creator of all the causes, is gratefully accepted by him.

0.g: ਰਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ; ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He remains happy in the will of the Lord and considers himself a guest in the world.

0.g: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He remains elated in the love of the Lord and goes sacrificed unto the feats of the creator.

0.g: ਲੇਪ ਅਲੇਪ, ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣਾ ।੨੧।
0.e: Living in the world he remains detached and liberated.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇਆ; ਭੁਖ ਨ ਖਾਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ।
0.e: The gurmukh having tasted the joy of love feels no desire for food and ink.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੀਂਦ ਉਘੜੀ; ਜਾਗਦਿਆਂ ਸੁਖ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Due to the merger of his consciousness in the Word, he gets no eep and by getting awake, he spends his night delightfully.

0.g: ਸਾਹੇ ਬਧੇ ਸੋਹਦੇ; ਮੈਲਾਪੜ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ।
0.e: As for a few ays before marriage, the bride and the bridegroom look beautiful even in gs, the gurmukhs also remain adorned.

0.g: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਹੋਇ; ਜਗ ਮਿਹਮਾਨ ਆਏ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Since they understand the mystery f going from the world, they live like guests in the world (who must sooner r later go).

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਖੇਪ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Being familiar with the highway of the wisdom of the Guru, Gurmukhs move on it with full load of the truthful merchandise.

0.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ।
0.e: The Sikhs ove the teachings of the Guru and their faces remain bright in this and in the world hereafter.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ, ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ।੧੨।
0.e: Always in the holy congregation, the ineffable story of the grandeur of) the Lord is told.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਕੋਇਲ ਕਾਂਉ ਰਲਾਈਅਨਿ; ਕਿਉ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਇਕੈ ।
0.e: Crows and cuckoos however mixed, cannot be one.

0.g: ਤਿਉ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਜਗ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਫਿਕੈ ।
0.e: Likewise the slanderers are distinguished in the world by their cheap and low talk.

0.g: ਬਗੁਲੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਕਨਿ ਮਿਕੈ ।
0.e: How can a crane and a swan be equated by the same measurement?

0.g: ਤਿਉ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੀਅਨਿ; ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਟਿਕੈ ।
0.e: Similarly the apostates are picked up, separated and stigmatized.

0.g: ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ਮੀਣਿਆ; ਖੋਟੁ ਸਾਲੀ ਸਿਕੈ ।
0.e: What is the hall mark of dissemblers? They are like counter-feit coins of a fake mint.

0.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਣੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਓਇ ਪੀਰ ਫਿਟਿਕੈ ।੮।
0.e: Shoe beating is given on their heads and they are cursed by the preceptor.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ; ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਨ ਚੰਚਲ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as water produces vegetation of various colours and forms, but the fragrance of Sandalwood makes all other vegetation around it smelling like itself (Just as water brings variety in vegetation, so is the association with gods and goddesses who make o

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਾਤ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ; ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a metal shines like fire when placed in it, but in reality it is no different than what it is. But with a touch of philosopher stone, the same metal becomes gold and shines like it.

0.g: ਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਖ਼ਾਸ ॥
0.e: The Khalsa is my special embodiment;

0.e: always I live within the Khalsa. 519

0.e: The Khalsa is my encouraging friend;

0.e: the Khalsa is my parents who give me joy.

0.e: The Khalsa is my virtuous delight,

0.e: ever tied together in friend-ship with me. 521

0.e: The Khalsa is my virtue and honour;

0.e: from the Khalsa I took birth.

0.e: The Khalsa is my source of supply;

0.e: The Khalsa is the breath of my body;

0.e: The Khalsa is my perfect Satguru;

0.e: as God and Guru Nanak are my witnesses. 526

0.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਜੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਪਾਂਊ ॥

0.e: Gurmukh decimates ego and conquers it.

0.e: Similarly all powerful, all knowing Guru is God Himself. He is both Guru and God. This incomprehensible state can best be understood by a Guru-conscious person. (56)

0.e: All listen to the melody and rhythm but a rare one understands the mystery of Word consciousness,

0.e: The Sikhs of the Guru are pearls who are strung in the garland in the form of congregation.

0.e: Only his consciousness remains merged in the Word whose mind diamond remains cut by the diamond of Word, the Guru.

0.e: Sarwan, the devoted son served his blind parents with love and dedication that has earned him fame and praise in the world.

0.e: What a strange play it is of the Lord that instead of serving his father, Bhagat Prahlad disobeyed his father's order that demanded of him not to meditate on the name of God (Ram). The Lord destroyed Harnakash (Prahlad's father) and protected Prahlad thus

0.g: ਦੁਆਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਦੁਖਤ ਕਰੀ; ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਤਤਖਿਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਾਹੂ ਕੋ ।
0.e: It is said that sage Sukdev kept on causing pain to his mother by remaining in her womb for 12 years, but when born he was found to be an established and perfect sage, and all those born at that time turned out to be hermit with divine powers.

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਸਮ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਛੁ; ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ।੪੩੬।

0.e: In one sheath two swords and two emperors in one country cannot be accommodated;

0.e: But twenty faquirs in one mosque under one patched blanket can remain (comfortably).

0.g: ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੀਹ ਦੁਇ; ਪੋਸਤ ਡੋਡੇ ਖਸਖਸ ਦਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Emperors are like two lions in a jungle whereas the faquirs are like the opium seeds in one pod.

0.e: These seeds play on the 'bed of thorns before they get the honour of selling in the market.

0.g: ਕੋਲੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੀੜੀਅਨਿ; ਪੋਸਤਿ ਪੀਹਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਛਾਣੈ ।
0.e: They are rushed in the press with water before they are strained into the cup .

0.g: ਲਉਬਾਲੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: In the court of the fearless Lord, the proud ones are called sinners and the humble get respects and regards.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ, ਹੋਂਦੇ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੈ ।੧੬।
0.e: That is why the gurmukhs though powerful behave as the meek ones.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਲਗ ਮਾਤ੍ਰਹੀਨ ਪੜਤ ਅਉਰ ਕਉ ਅਉਰ; ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਪੂਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a word devoid of vowel symbol would sound different, word 'pita' and 'putt' would be read alike.

0.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ; ਅਉਰ ਕਹੇ ਅਉਰ ਕਛੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੈ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a person is called demented when not in his full senses, he understands different than what is being said.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁੰਗ ਸਭਾ ਮਧਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਬਾਤ; ਬੋਲਤ ਹਸਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Just as a mute person cannot express himself in any gathering, even if he tries to utter a word, he becomes a laughing stock for all,

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਥਕਤ ਹੁਇ; ਲਗਨ ਸਗਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।੨੬੪।
0.e: No self-oriented or self-willed person can tread the path of Guru-conscious persons. How can one feel persuaded to tread the path of Guru-conscious people when one is bound by the omens-good or bad. (264)

0.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧੀਐ; ਬਰਮੇ ਕਣੀ ਅਣੀ ਹੋਇ ਹੀਰੈ ।
0.e: With diamond-bit of drill the piece of diamond is cut gradually i.e. with the diamond bit of the Word of the Guru the mind-diamond is pierced.

0.g: ਧਾਗਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੋਈਐ; ਹੀਰੈ ਮਾਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਗਹੀਰੈ ।
0.e: With the thread (of love) a beautiful string of diamonds is prepared.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੈ ।
0.e: In the holy congregation, merging consciousness in the Word and eschewing ego, the mind is tranquilized.

0.g: ਮਨ ਜਿਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਨ; ਗੁਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਰੀਰੈ ।
0.e: Conquering the mind, one should surrender it (before the Guru) and adopt the virtues of gurmukhs, the Guru oriented ones.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ; ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਣੁ ਨ ਨੀਰੈ ।
0.e: He ought to fall on the feet of saints because even the wish-granting cow (Kamadhenu) is not equal to the dust of the feet of saints.

0.g: ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ; ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਤਰਸਨ ਸੀਰੈ ।
0.e: This act is nothing but licking of the tasteless stone though myriad tastes of sweet juices one strives for.

0.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸਿਖ, ਸੁਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ।੧੬।
0.e: Rare is the Sikh who listens to (and accepts) the teachings of the Guru.

0.g: ਹਰਦੀ ਅਉ ਚੂਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਰੁਨ ਬਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ; ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਕੈ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As turmeric and lime when mixed produce red colour, but when betel leaf, lime, betelnut and catechu are all brought together, a very deep red colour is produced;

0.g: ਦੂਧ ਮੈ ਜਾਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ; ਖਾਂਡ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੂਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As a small cogulent added to the milk set it as curd but sugar, flour and clarified butter produces a very tasty dish;

0.g: ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਲ ਸੈ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਹੋਤ; ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਧੂਪ ਹੈ ।
0.e: An extract of flowers when mixed with sesame oil become scented oil, but mixing of saffron musk, sandalwood and rose make a very fragrant product called argaja;

0.g: ਦੋਇ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਹੈ; ਦਸ ਬੀਸ ਤੀਸ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਊਪ ਹੈ ।੧੨੨।
0.e: So would two Sikhs together make a holy congregation while five of them would represent the Lord. But where ten, twenty or thirty like-minded Sikhs engrossed in the love of the Guru meet, their praise is beyond description. (122)

0.g: ਬਾਛੈ ਨ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਬਾਸ ਮਾਨੈ ਨ ਨਰਕ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ; ਆਸਾ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: An obedient disciple of the True Guru neither asks for heaven nor does he fear hell. He does not keep any longing or desire in his mind. Instead he believes that whatever God does is just right.

0.g: ਸੰਪਤ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਬਿਪਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਤਾਹਿ; ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਬਿਹਸ ਨ ਰੋਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Acquisition of wealth does not make him happy. In the times of distress, he is never morose. Instead he treats distresses and comforts alike and does not lament or rejoice on them.

0.g: ਜਨਮ ਜੀਵਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਖੇਦ; ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਵਲੋਇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He is not afraid of birth and death and has no desire of salvation. He is least affected by the worldly dualities and remain in a state of equipoise. He is aware of all the three periods of life and know all the happenings of the world. Yet he always look

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਹਿ; ਬਿਰਲੋ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਹੈ ।੪੦੯।
0.e: Who ever is blessed with the collyrium of knowledge of the True Guru, recognises the mammon-free Lord God. But such a person who is able to achieve that state is rare in the world.  (409)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪

0.e: Guru Hargobind is the Lord in the form of Guru. Earlier a disciple he is now a. Guru i.e. earlier Gurus and Guru Hargobind are the same.

0.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਪਛੋਆ ।
0.e: First, the formless Lord assumed the form of the Ekarikar and later he created all the forms (i.e. universe).

0.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰਿ ਲਖ; ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਰੇਂਦੇ ਢੋਆ ।
0.e: In the form of Oatikär (Guru) lacs of streams of life take shelter.

0.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਗੜਾੜਿ ਸਮੋਆ ।
0.e: Lacs of rivers flow into seas, and all the seven seas merge in the oceans.

0.g: ਲਖ ਗੜਾੜਿ ਕੜਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਝਹਿਂ ਸੀਖ ਪਰੋਆ ।
0.e: In the cauldron of desires of fire, the creatures of lacs of oceans hooked in skewers are getting roasted.

0.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਇਕੁ; ਠੰਢੇ ਤਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਖਲੋਆ ।
0.e: All these burning creatures attain peace by the one drop of sandal-delight of the Guru.

0.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਹੋਆ ।
0.e: And lacs of such sandals have got created from the wash of the Guru's lotus feet.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਅਲੋਆ ।
0.e: By the order of the transcendent, primeaval perfect God, the canopy

0.e: And the royal umbrella are held over the head of Guru Hargobind.

0.e: In this world are myrids of wicked persons, thieves, bad characters and gamblers.

0.e: Many are highway robbers. Dupers, backbiters and devoid of thinking.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ; ਕਿਤੜੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਣਚਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Many are ungrateful, apostate and have spoiled conduct.

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੀ ਵਿਸਵਾਸਿ ਘਾਤ; ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਭਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Killers of their masters, unfaithful, not true to their salt and morons are also there.

0.g: ਬਿਖਲੀਪਤਿ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਰਵਤ; ਮਦ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Many are deeply engrossed in evil propensities, untrue to their salt, drunkards and evil-doers.

0.g: ਵਿਸਟ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਕੂੜੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ।
0.e: Many by becoming mediators raise antagonism and many are mere tellers of lies.

0.e: Without surrendering before they true Guru, all will run from pillar to post (and will get nothing).

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realised through the grace of the divine preceptor

0.g: ਵਾਰ ੨ ।
0.e: Vaar Two

0.g: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਰਸੀ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ ।
0.e: The mirror (in the form of world) is in the hand (of the Lord) and man sees of himself in it.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ; ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਭੇਖੈ ।
0.e: God visualises and makes men see the guises and philosophies of six Schools (in this mirror).

0.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਮੂਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਲਿਦਾ; ਤੇਵੇਹੈ ਲੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Man is reflected (in the mirror) in exactly the same way as is his propensity.

0.g: ਹਸਦੇ ਹਸਦਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ; ਸੋ ਰੂਪ ਸਰੇਖੈ ।
0.e: The laughing person finds a laughing form in it.

0.g: ਰੋਦੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਦਾ; ਹੋਏ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ ।
0.e: Whereas the wailing person finds himself (as well as everybody) there in the weeping posture. Same is the case of a clever person.

0.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ ।੧।
0.e: The Lord Himself is prevading this world-mirror but He is specifically preceivable in and through the holy congregation.

0.g: ਲਿਖਨੁ ਪੜਨ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਜਉ ਲਉ; ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਕੈ ।
0.e: So long the husband is away on business or work tour, the wife keeps receiving his commands and news of well being through letters. They exchange their emotions through letters.

0.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਅਉ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦੋਇ ਹੋਇ; ਭੇਟਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਬਿਰਹ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੈ ।
0.e: So long the husband and wife are not together, they indulge in looking here and there. But when they meet they become one in the wake of their separation. Similarly so long a seeker remains away from his deity Guru, he indulges in other means of spiritual

0.g: ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਖੋਜਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ; ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a deer keeps wandering and searching for the musk that he keeps smelling and is unaware of the means to find it, so would a seeker keep wandering till he meets with True Guru and learns the way of God-realisation.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਦੇਸ ਕੈ ।੧੮੬।
0.e: When a disciple meets with Guru, the all knowing Lord then comes and resides in the heart of the disciple. He then meditates, contemplates and worships the Master Lord as a slave and serves His command and will. (186)

0.g: ਕਬਿਤ ।
0.e: Kabit

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ, ਸੁਧਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਰਹੀ; ਬੁਧਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਰਹੀ, ਮਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A glimpse of (Satguru) left me bereft of all my consciousness, senses, intelligence, cleverness and all other considered wisdom of the world.

0.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ, ਅਉ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ; ਗਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਹਿਓ, ਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: I lost my awareness, attachment of mind with insignificant matters, desires to acquire base or futile ego inflating knowledge and other worldly predicaments.

0.g: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕੋ ਧੀਰਜੁ, ਗਰਬ ਕੋ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਇਓ; ਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਰਤਿ ਰਹੀ, ਪਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਮੈ ।
0.e: My patience was lost and so was my vanity. There was no life in me and I was bereft of my existence even.

0.g: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ; ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਅਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਹੈ ।੧।੯।
0.e: The glimpse of Satguru is capable of amazing one with wondrous feelings. These are astonishing and marvellous and there is no end to this amazement. (9)

0.g: ਰਚਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤਰਪਨ; ਚਿਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਚਿਤੈ ਚਿਤੈ ਚਿਤੇਰਾ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: The process and event of creation is full of wonder, marvel, colourful and picturesque. Watching and appreciating the beautiful and picturesque creation, one should lodge the Creator in the heart.

0.g: ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ; ਸੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: By the support of the words of Guru, and practicing of these words, one should see the presence of the Almighty in everything; just as listening to the tune of a musical instrument one feels the presence of the player in that melody.

0.g: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ; ਕਰੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: One should recognise the provider of peace and comfort, the treasure-house of kindness from the food, bedding, wealth and donation of all other treasures that He has blessed us with.

0.g: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਬਗਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।੨੪੪।
0.e: The utterer of all words, demonstrator of everything, the listener, the donor of all things and relisher of all pleasures. the Omnipotent complete Lord like True Guru is known in the holy congregation of saintly people only. (244)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੇਲਾ ਬਸਤ ਬਬੂਰ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟ ਤਾਂਹਿ; ਸਾਲਤ ਹੈਂ ਸੂਰੈਂ ਆਪਾ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਬਚਾਇ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as leaves of a plaintain tree are torn by the thorns of an acacia tree growing within its proximity, it can not free itself from the hold of the thorns without damaging itself.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਸੂਆ ਪੜਤ ਗਾਥਾ ਅਨੇਕ; ਦਿਨਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਖਾਇ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a parrot in a small cage learns much but he is watched by a cat who one day catches it and eats it up.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰ ਮੁਦਤ ਮਨ ਹੋਤ ਮੀਨ; ਮਾਸ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਲੇਤ ਬਨਛੀ ਲਗਾਇ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a fish feels happy living in water but an angler throws the bait tied at the end of a strong thread and the fish is enticed to eat it. When the fish bites the bait, it bites the hook as well making it convenient for the angler to pull it out.

0.g: ਬਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਤ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ; ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਜੀ ।੬੩੪।
0.e: Similarly, without meeting the God-like True Guru, and keeping company of base people, one acquires base wisdom that becomes the cause of his falling in the hands of angels of death.  (634)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਹਿੰਦੂਆਂ; ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾਂ ਮਕਾ ਕਾਬਾ ।
0.e: Hindus adore Ganges and Banaras and Muslims consider Mecca-Kaba as a holy place.But to the accompaniment of mradarig (drum) and rabad (stringed instrument) the praises (of Baba Nanak) are sung

0.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਗਾਵੀਐ; ਵਜਨਿ ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗੁ ਰਬਾਬਾ ।
0.e: Lover of the devotees, he has come to uplift the down trodden ones.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ; ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਅਜਬੁ ਅਜਾਬਾ ।
0.e: He himfelf is wonderful (because in spite of his powers he is egoless).

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਰਾਬਾ ।
0.e: By his efforts all the four varnas have become one and now the individual gets liberated in the holy congregatio

0.g: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਅਵਲਿ ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਖਰਾਬਾ ।
0.e: Like the fragrant of sandal, he without any discrimination makes every one fragrant.

0.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਿਸ ਦੀ ਕਰੈ ਜਵਾਬਾ ।
0.e: All act as ordained by him and no one has the power to say no to him.

0.g: ਜਾਹਰ ਪੀਰੁ, ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਬਾ ।੪।
0.e: Such grand Guru (Nanak) is the manifest spiritual teacher of the whole world.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ; ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ ।
0.e: As the path of fish in water is unknowable, the way of gurmukhs is also unapproachable.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਗਾਸ ਉਡੰਦਾ ।
0.e: As the path of birds flying in the sky cannot be known, the thoughtful and search-orientated way of gurmukh is also imperceptible. It cannot be understood.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਨਗਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ ।
0.e: Holy congregation is the straight path for gurmukhs and this world is full of illusions for them.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ; ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: As the four colours of betel catechu, betelnut, lime and betel lead become one (red) colour (of joy-giving love), the gurmukhs also enjoy the cup of the Lord's love.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: As the fragrance of sandal comes to reside in other plants, they merging their consciousness into Word reside in the hearts of others.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਕੂੰਜਿ ਕੂਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸ ਵਧੰਦਾ ।
0.e: By means of knowledge, meditation and remembrance, they like cranes, tortoise and swans expand their family or tradition.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅਲਖ ਲਖੰਦਾ ।੧੩।
0.e: The gurmukhs come face to face with God, the pleasure of all fruits.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਲੇਖਕ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਬਿਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਤ ਨ ਤੈਸੋ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as the mind of an accountant is ever engrossed in maintaining and writing accounts of worldly affairs, it does not focus on writing the paeans of the Lord.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ।
0.e: As the mind is engrossed in trading and business, it does not like to involve and engross itself in the meditation of Lord's name.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਨੁ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਉ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਨੇਹ ਬਿਖੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਤੈਸੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਪਲ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a man is enamoured by gold and love of woman, he does not show that type of love in his heart for a moment for the congregation of holy men.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ਧੰਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਆਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਜਾਇ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੀਨ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਈ ।੨੩੪।
0.e: Life is spent in the worldly bondages and affairs. One bereft of practicing and following the teachings of True Guru repents when one's time to depart from this world draws near. (234)

0.g: ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਮਵਾਸ ਸਾਧਿ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਆਨਿ; ਤਾ ਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਰਖ ਨਰਿੰਦ ਜੀ ।
0.e: If a brave warrior defeats a rebel landlord and brings him into the protection of the king, the king rewards him out of happiness and glory is bestowed upon him.

0.g: ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਪੈ ਜਾਇ; ਧਾਇ ਮਾਰੈ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਸਹਿਤਿ ਹੀ ਰਜਿੰਦ ਜੀ ।
0.e: But if an employee of the king absconds the king and joins the rebel landlord, the king launches a campaign against him and kills both the rebel landlord as well as the disloyal servant.

0.g: ਆਨ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ; ਸੇਵਕ ਨਰੇਸ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਤ ਨਿੰਦ ਜੀ ।
0.e: If someone's employee takes refuge of the king, he earns praise there. But if a servant of the king goes to someone, he earns slander from all around.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਅਨਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ; ਆਨ ਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ।੪੬੪।
0.e: Similarly, if a devotee of some god/goddess comes to the True Guru as a devoted disciple, the True Guru bless him with His refuge, initiates him in the meditation of His name. But no god or goddess is capable of granting refuge to any devoted Sikh of the

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤ ਹੀਨ ਪਸੂਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਹ; ਖੜ ਖਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੈ ।
0.e: One who has no perception of Guru’s words is far inferior than an animal who eats hay and grass and yields nectar like milk.

0.g: ਗੋਬਰ ਗੋਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ; ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਨਿਖਿਧ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਹੈ ।
0.e: According to Hindu mythology, cowdung and cow's urine are considered sacred but cursed is a human body that eats elixir- like food and spreads filth all around.

0.g: ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ; ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਖਲ ਬਚਨ ਦੁਰਾਉ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Those who take the support of the knowledgeable sermons of the True Guru and practice these in their life are superb saintly persons. On the contrary, those who shy away from the teachings of the True Guru are low of status, evil and foolish.

0.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਹੁਇ; ਮਾਨਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਧਰ ਬਿਖਮ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਉ ਹੈ ।੨੦੧।
0.e: By meditation on His name, such saintly persons themselves become the fountains of elixir-like Naam. Those who are bereft of the words of the Guru and are engrossed in maya are scary like poisonous snakes and full of venom. (201)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਸਬਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Gurumukh (Angad) attuning his sabad (word) to the Sabad has chiselled his clumsy mind to make it an ornament.

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲਣਾ; ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਖਹਣਾ ।
0.e: He has disciplined himself in the fear of loving devotion and losing the sense of ego has saved himself from all sorts of imbroglios.

0.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਸ ਨਸੀਨੀ ਬਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Achieving mastery over spirituality as well as temporarily, the gurmukh has resided in the loneliness.

0.g: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਹੈ; ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Even being cause of all effects and all powerfull he remains in the world full of deceptions.

0.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮ; ਅਰਥ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Dopting truth, contentment, compassion dharma, richness and scriminatory wisdom(Vichar) he has made peace his abo

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਛਡਿ; ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਹੁ ਤਹਣਾ ।
0.e: Shedding lust, anger and opposition he has repudiated greed, infatuation and ego.

0.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਸਪੁਤੁ, ਬਬਾਣੇ ਲਹਣਾ ।੭।
0.e: Such a worthy son Lahana (Angad) is born in the family of Baba (Nanak).

0.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Among the eighty-four lacs of births, the human life is the rare one.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਜਹਬਾਂ; ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: This human got divided into four varnas and dharmas as also into Hindu and Musalman.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ਅਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: How many are the males and females cannot be counted.

0.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਹੈ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: This world is fraudulent display of maya who with its there qualities has created even Brahma, Visan and Mahesa.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾਂ ਵਾਚਦੇ; ਇਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ, ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Hindus read Vedas and Muslims kaebas but the Lord is one while two ways have been devised to reach Him.

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Out of the Siva-Sakti i.e. maya, the illusions of yoga and bhoga (enjoyment) have been created.

0.g: ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ, ਸੰਗਤਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।੬।
0.e: One gets good or bad results according to the company of sadh or evildoers he keeps.

0.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ; ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Controlling her mind and with utmost determination, when a woman jumps into the pyre of her husband and self immolates herself, the whole world applauds her effort of being a loving and devoted wife.

0.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੂਝੈ; ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਹੋਤ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: As a brave warrior lays down his life fighting for his noble cause determinedly till the end, he is applauded here, there and everywhere as a martyr.

0.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਮਰੈ; ਫਾਸੀ ਕੈ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਢਾਏ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Contrary to this, as a thief determinedly makes up his mind to commit theft, if caught, he is jailed, hanged or punished, he is degraded and rebuked the world over

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ; ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਨਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਜੀ ।੭੦।
0.e: Similarly one becomes bad and wicked with base wisdom whereas accepting and abiding by Guru's wisdom makes a person noble and virtuous. A human being makes his life a success or failure according to the company he keeps or his devotion to the holy congreg

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩

0.e: Double-faced i.e. uneven minor moves hand to hand in the assembly (because nobody likes it).

0.g: ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੀ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਖਚੈ ।
0.e: Similarly a double-talker like a prostitute engrossed in other's homes moves from door to door.

0.g: ਅਗੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ; ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਚਹਮਚੈ ।
0.e: At first she looks pretty and men are pleased to see her face

0.g: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ; ਇਕੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਜਿਨਸਿ ਵਿਰਚੈ ।
0.e: But later she is found to be dreadful because her single face possesses two images.

0.g: ਖੇਹਿ ਪਾਇ ਮੁਹੁ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਚੈ ।
0.e: Even cleaned with ashes, such double-faced mirror becomes filthy again.

0.g: ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ; ਧਰਮੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਪਰਚੈ ।
0.e: Yama, the Lord of dharma is one; he accepts dharma but does not get pleased by the delusions of wickedness.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ, ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ।੩।
0.e: Truthful gurmukhs ultimately attain the truth.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੈ; ਵੇਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਵਟੈ ।
0.e: Hirrtyakyapu talked adversely about God and the result gained is clear that he eventually got killed.

0.g: ਲੰਕ ਲੁਟਾਈ ਰਾਵਣੈ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਸ ਕਟੈ ।
0.e: Ravan also for the same reason got Lanka looted and his ten heads slayed.

0.g: ਕੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਣ ਲਸਕਰੈ; ਸਭ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਟੈ ।
0.e: Kans was killed along with his full army and his all the demons perished.

0.g: ਵੰਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕੈਰਵਾਂ; ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਫਟੈ ।
0.e: The Kauravas lost their dynasty and got their myriads of army destroyed.

0.g: ਦੰਤ ਬਕਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਸਪਾਲ ਦੇ; ਦੰਦ ਹੋਏ ਖਟੈ ।
0.e: For the same reason, Dantavaktr and Siupál got crushing defeat.
