0.g: ਚੀਕਨੇ ਕਲਸ ਪਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕਤ ਬੂੰਦ; ਕਾਲਰ ਮੈਂ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਜ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨ ਖੇਤ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a drop of water does not rest on a greasy pitcher and no seed grows in a saline soil.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਿ ਪਰ ਤਰੁ ਸੇਬਲ ਅਫਲ ਅਰੁ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਤ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as silk cotton tree is bereft of fruit on this earth, and just as a poisonous tree causes much trouble to the people.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸੀਐ ਨਾ; ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਮਲ ਮੂਤਤਾ ਸਮੇਤ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as a bamboo tree acquires no fragrance despite living near a sandalwood tree, and just as the air blowing over filth acquires the same bad odour.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨ ਮੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਿਦੇ; ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨੋ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿਬੂੰਦ ਅਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਲੇਤ ਜੀ ।੬੩੮।
0.e: Similarly being like a greasy pitcher, saline land, silk cotton tree, bamboo tree and filth-polluted air, the sermon of the True Guru does not pierce my heart (it creates no ambrosial elixir). On the contrary, it feels as if a snake has just taken swati.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਏ ਪਾਈਐ; ਚਮਗਿਦੜ ਜੂਹੈ ।
0.e: If bowing only could grant liberation then the bats in the forests hang from trees upside down.

0.g: ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁਡਾਂ ਚੂਹੈ ।
0.e: If liberation were achieved in the loneliness of crematories then rats should get it in their holes.

0.g: ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ; ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਵਿਹੁ ਲੂਹੈ ।
0.e: Longevity also does not bring it because snake during its whole long life goes on smouldering in its own poison.

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਵਰਤੀਐ; ਖਰ ਸੂਰ ਭਸੂਹੇ ।
0.e: If dirt could make it attainable, asses and swines always remain dirty and muddy.

0.g: ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ; ਅਈਅੜ ਵਣੁ ਧੂਹੇ ।
0.e: If relishing over tubers and roots could provide it (liberation), then herd of animals go on hauling and eating them (they should also have attained liberation).

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਜਿਉਂ ਘਰੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਹੇ ।੧੩।
0.e: As a house (in fact) is useless without door, one cannot attain liberation without Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ; ਇਕਸ ਅਖਰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Even after reading lakhs of Vedas, Brahma did not understand syllable (paramatama)

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਲਖ; ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਭੇਖੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Siva meditates through lakhs of methods (postures) but still could not recognise the form, hue and guise (of the Lord).

0.g: ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਲੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Visnu incarnated himself through lakhs of creatures but he could not recognise even a bit of that Lord.

0.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਉਤਨ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ; ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸੇਖ ਵਿਸੇਖ ਨ ਤਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Sesanag (the mythical snake) recited and remembered many a new name of the Lord but still could not know much about Him.

0.g: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਤਾ ।
0.e: Many long-lived persons experienced life variously, but they all and many a philosopher could not understand Sabda, the Brahma.

0.g: ਦਾਤਿ ਲੁਭਾਇ, ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਦਾਤਾ ।੧੩।
0.e: All got engrossed in the gifts of that Lord and that bestower has been forgotten.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਇ; ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Being one with each other the Guru and the Sikh have made the Lord perceptible (in the form of Guru).

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੈ ਸਿਖਿ; ਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Getting initiated by the Guru the disciple has become a Sikh.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਇਕੋ ਹੋਇ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: It was the Lord’s desire that the Guru and the disciple would become one.

0.g: ਹੀਰਾ ਕਣੀ ਪਰੋਇ; ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧਾਇਆ ।
0.e: It seems as if the diamond cutting the diamond has brought the other one in one string;

0.g: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਅਵਲੋਇ; ਸਲਿਲ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Or the wave of water has merged in water, or the light of one lamp has come to reside in another lamp.

0.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ; ਦੀਪੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The wondrous deed (of the Lord) seems to have been transformed into a parable.

0.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਢੋਇ; ਚਲਤੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: It is as if the sacred ghee has been produced after churning the curd.

0.g: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਇ; ਘਿਉ ਕਢਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The One Light has scattered in all the three worlds.

0.g: ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਆਇਆ ।੧੧।
0.e: It is as if the sacred ghee has been produced after churning the curd. The

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਇਵ; ਅਖੀਂ ਹੋਂਦੀ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਹੋਆ ।
0.e: The jiv though consciousness incarnate is so much unconscious (of his aim in life) as if he is blind though having the eyes;

0.g: ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ; ਡਾਇਣੁ ਮਾਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਮੋਆ ।
0.e: Does not distinguish between a friend and a foe; and according to him the nature of a mother and a witch is identical.

0.g: ਬੋਲਾ ਕੰਨੀਂ ਹੋਂਵਦੀ; ਜਸੁ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਧੋਹੁ ਨ ਸੋਆ ।
0.e: He is deaf despite ears and does not distinguish between glory and infamy or between love and treachery.

0.g: ਗੁੰਗਾ ਜੀਭੈ ਹੁੰਦੀਐ; ਦੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਆ ।
0.e: He is dumb despite tongue and drinks poison mixed in milk.

0.g: ਵਿਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਮਸਰ ਪੀਐ; ਮਰਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਆਸ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਢੋਆ ।
0.e: Considering poison and nectar identical he drinks them

0.g: ਸਰਪੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਇ; ਕਰੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਕੜਿ ਖਲੋਆ ।
0.e: And for his ignorance about life and death, hopes and desires, he gets no refuge anywhere.

0.g: ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ, ਟਿਬਾ ਟੋਆ ।੮।
0.e: He stretches his desires towards snake and fire and catching hold of them does not distinguish between a pit and a mound.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ; ਗੁਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇਆ ।
0.e: The True Guru Nanak Dev was the Guru of Gurus.

0.g: ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਭੇਉ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮੋਇਆ ।
0.e: He installed Guru Angad Dev on the invisible abd mysterious throne of equipoise.

0.g: ਅਮਰਹੁ ਅਮਰ ਸਮੇਉ; ਅਲਖ ਅਲੋਇਆ ।
0.e: Merging Amar Das into the external Lord he made him see the invisible.

0.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਰਿਖੇਉ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੋਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Ram Das was made to quaff the delight of supreme nectar.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਉ; ਢੋੲੈ ਢੋਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Arjan Dev got the largess of service (from Guru Ram Das).

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਮੇਉ; ਅਮਿਉ ਵਿਲੋਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Hargobind also churned the sea (of Word)

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਚੇਉ; ਸਚਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ।
0.e: And due to the grace of all these truthful personalities, the truth of the Lord has come to reside in the hearts of common people, who have fully devoted their selves to the Word.

0.g: ਆਤਮ ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹੇਉ; ਸਬਦ ਪਰੋਇਆ ।
0.e: Even empty hearts of the people have been filled by sabad, the Word

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇਉ; ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: And the Gurmukhs have exterminated their fears and delusions.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਸ੍ਵਨੀ ਸੁਤਹ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰਿ ਮਧ; ਜਾਤਿ ਪੁਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a mare leaves the house with her master to help him do his work leaving her colt back home and returns home remembering its young one.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਵੰਤ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ; ਬੋਲਤ ਘਟੰਤਰ ਚੈਤੰਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੇਹ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a sleeping person visits many cities and countries in his dream, mumbles in his throat, but once out of his sleep performs his household duties attentively.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਰੇਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਤ︀ਯਾਗ ਹੁਇ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ; ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਕਰ ਗਿਰੈ ਤਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੇਹ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a he-pigeon leaves his mate and flies in the sky but seeing his mate, he comes down towards her at such a fast pace as a drop of rain falls from the sky,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਬਿਖੈ; ਦੇਖ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਸਨ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਕੈ ।੬੧੬।
0.e: Similarly a devotee of the Lord lives in this world and his family but when he sees his beloved Satsangis, he becomes ecstatic of mind, words and deeds. (He becomes absorbed in the loving state that the Lord blesses him with through Naam).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ; ਰਜ ਗੁਣੁ ਤਮ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਤ ਗੁਣੁ ਜਿਤਾ ।
0.e: Air, water, fire and the three qualities – tranquillity, activity and inertness have been conquered by the Sikh.

0.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਸੰਕਲਪ ਕਰਿ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗੋਇ ਦੁਚਿਤਾ ।
0.e: With the concentration of mind, speech, action and meditating upon the One, he has lost the sense of duality.

0.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਾ ।
0.e: Absorption in the knowledge of the Guru is his conduct in the world. In his innerself he is One (with the Lord) while he performs diverse duties in the world.

0.g: ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਜਿਣਿ; ਸੁਰਗ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਥਿਤਾ ।
0.e: Conquering the earth and the nether world he establishes himself in heavens.

0.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਣੁ; ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ।
0.e: By speaking sweetly, behaving humbly and bestowing charities with one's own hands, even the fallen ones have become pure.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ।
0.e: Thus, the gurmukh attains incomparable and invalauable fruits of delight.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ, ਪੀੜਿ ਨਪਿਤਾ ।੪।
0.e: Associating with the holy congregation he squeezes out the ego (from the mind).

0.g: ਮਾਨਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਹੰਸੁ; ਖਾਇ ਜਲ ਜੰਤ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸਹਿ ਲਜਾਵਈ ।
0.e: If a swan leaves lake Mansarover and resides in a pond, starts eating living beings from the pond like a heron, he will shame the species of swans.

0.g: ਸਲਿਲ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਭਏ ਜੀਅਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਉ ਮੀਨ; ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: If a fish survives outside water, then its love for water will be considered false and it would not be called as beloved of water.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਉ ਅਨਤ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਕਰੈ; ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਛਨੁ ਲਗਾਵਈ ।
0.e: If a rain-bird satiates its thirst with a drop of water other than the swati drop, he would stigmatise his family.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਲਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੋਖ ਹੁਇ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ।੪੬੩।
0.e: A devoted disciple of the True Guru preaches the teachings of the True Guru and achieves emancipation. But a disciple who gives up his love for the True Guru and bows before other gods, self.-made saints and sages and worships them; his love with Guru is

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜਾਸੁ; ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Sikh in whose heart resides the percept of Guru, and by focusing his mind in the holy feet of the Lord through Simran, the omnipresent Lord dwells in him;

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He who lodges the holy word of the True Guru, contemplates on spiritual knowledge and in the process realises that One Supreme Lord exists in all, thus treats all as equals;

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਭਏ; ਮਨ ਓੁਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He who sheds his ego and becomes an ascetic by virtue of Simran, yet live a detached worldly life; reaches the inaccessible Lord,

0.g: ਸੂਖਮ ਅਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ।੨੨।
0.e: He who recognises one Lord manifested in all things subtle and absolute; that Guru-conscious person is emancipated even when living a worldly life. (22)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਸਿਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is holy congregation and controlled by this holy congregation, the Lord comes here as lover of the devotees.

0.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: All the causes are under control of the creator but in the holy congregation He does everything in accordance with the wishes of the devotees and the saints.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The transcendetal Brahm is the perfect Brahm and He likes the will of the holy congregation.

0.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In his every trichome are absorbed crores of universes.

0.g: ਬੀਅਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ਵੜੁ; ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬੀਉ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From one seed comes out banyan tree and in its fruits again the seeds reside.

0.g: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਜਰ ਜਰਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Who quaffing the nectar have devotedly adopted the unbearable in their mind, the eschewing their ego have never made themselves noticed.

0.g: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ, ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।੧੫।
0.e: Such true persons while being amidst maya have attained that immaculate Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕੀਨੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਮ ਨਿਰੁਦਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A disciple coming face to face of the Guru frees himself from all desires and wants by receiving the unique and comforting words of the True. Guru. Thus he frees himself from the worldly encumbrances with the strength of his meditation and consecration.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਏ; ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Treading the path of Guru, he destroys all his duality and doubts. The refuge of the True Guru makes his mind stable.

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਤ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਿਤ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the glimpse of the True Guru, all his desires and sensualities get tired and become ineffective. Remembering the Lord with every breath, he becomes totally aware of the Lord, the master of our lives.

0.g: ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਪਨ; ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਚਿਤੇਰ੍ਰਾ ਕੋ ਬਸੇਰਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ।੨੮੨।
0.e: The multiform creations of the Lord are wondrous and astonishing. The Guru-oriented disciple realises the presence of the Lord in this whole picture as true and eternal. (282)

0.g: ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਪੁੰਸਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ; ਬਾਂਝ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਤਤ ਸਨੇਹ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as an impotent person does not know what pleasure it is to share a union with a woman, and a barren woman cannot know the love and attachment of children.

0.g: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਕੋ ਬਖਾਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੋਤਚਾਰ; ਨਾਹ ਉਪਚਾਰ ਕਛੁ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਕੀ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as the lineage of the children of a prostitute cannot be defined, and a leper cannot be cured anyway.

0.g: ਆਂਧਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਦਸਨ ਛਬਿ; ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਬਹਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਅਸਪ੍ਰੇਹ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as a blind person cannot know the beauty of the face and teeth of a woman and a deaf person cannot feel anyone's anger or happiness since he cannot hear.

0.g: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ; ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਵਾਸੋ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਮੇਹ ਕਉ ।੪੪੩।
0.e: Similarly, a devotee and follower of other gods and goddesses, cannot know the celestial bliss of service of true and perfect Guru. Just as camel-thorn (Alhagi maurorum) resents rain.  (443)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਕਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਆਪਨੀ ਆਪਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ; ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਤਮਾਲ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as all trees grow and spread according to the nature of their species and they cannot impose their influence on others but a sandalwood tree can make all other trees smell like itself.

0.g: ਤਾਂਬਾ ਹੀ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਡਾਰੈ; ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਕਲ ਉਜਾਲ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as addition of some special chemical in copper. can convert it into gold, but all metals can become gold by the touch of a philosopher-stone.

0.g: ਸਰਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਗਤਿ; ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮ ਜਨਮ ਸੁਢਾਲ ਕਉ ।
0.e: Just as the flow of many rivers is different in many ways, but their water becomes pure and sacred once they mingle with water of river Ganges.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਸਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਉ ।੪੫੯।
0.e: Similarly, none of the gods and goddesses change their basic character. (They can reward someone according to their nature). But like sandalwood, philosopher-stone and river Ganges, the True Guru takes all under his refuge and blessing them with Naam Amri

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਤਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਨਵਨ ਮਨ; ਤਾ ਮੈ ਨ ਉਤਪਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਤ ਸਭ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Just as Earth is most humble out of the five elements. That is why it produces so much and all that goes back to it.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਆਂਗੁਰੀ ਮੈ ਸੂਖਮ ਕਨੁੰਗ੍ਰੀਆ ਹੈ; ਕੰਚਨ ਖਚਤ ਨਗ ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੀ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Just as the little finger of the hand is smallest and frail looking, yet a diamond ring is worn in it.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਚ ਜੋਨ ਗਨੀਅਤ ਅਤਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ; ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਮਧੁ ਉਪਜਤ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Just as fly and other insects are counted among the low species, yet some of them produce such valuable things like silk, pearls, honey etc;

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਦਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਏ; ਹੀਨ ਜਾਤ ਊਚ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੀ ਮੈ ।੬੩੨।
0.e: Similarly, saints like Bhagat Kabir, Namdev Ji, Bidar and Ravi Das Ji being low born have attained a much higher spiritual level who have blessed humanity with their precept that have made their life peaceful and comfortable.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ ਸਾਇਰਹੁਂ; ਭੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਖਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Jewels have come out of sea but still its water is brackish.

0.g: ਸੁਝਹੁ ਸੁਝਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ; ਅਉਲੰਗੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In the light of moon, the three worlds are seen, yet the stigma on moon persists.

0.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The earth produces the corn but still alkaline earth is also there.

0.g: ਈਸਰੁ ਤੁਸੈ ਹੋਰਨਾ; ਘਰਿ ਖਪਰੁ ਛਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Siva, getting happy, grants boons to others but in his own home only ashes and begging bowl are found.

0.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਹਣਵੰਤਿ ਕਛੋਟੜਾ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The powerful Hanuman can do a lot for others but has only a loincloth to wear.

0.g: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਕਉਣੁ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ।੧੦।
0.e: Who can efface the words of destiny of the apostate.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਸਾਗਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ; ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਹਾਣਾ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ।
0.e: The vessel is in the ocean and there is a benevolent sailor in it.

0.g: ਭਾਰ ਅਥਰਬਣ ਲਦੀਐ; ਲੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ।
0.e: The vessel is amply loaded and the traders get boarded thereon.

0.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਲਹਰ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ; ਅਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਪਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Waves of impassable ocean put no impact upon any one.

0.g: ਬਹਲੇ ਪੂਰ ਲੰਘਾਇਦਾ; ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ।
0.e: That boatman takes the passengers across safe, dale and hearty. Those traders earn profits two or four times and gain in many ways.

0.g: ਦੂਣੇ ਚਉਣੇ ਦੰਮ ਹੋਨ; ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs in the form of boatmen make people board the ship of holy congregation and take them across the impassable world-ocean.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Any liberated one alone can understand the mystery of the technique of the formless Lord.

0.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ।੫।
0.e: Plant of sandal be becoming tree lives in the deep forests.

0.g: ਸਲਿਲ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਦੇਖੈ ਬੋਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ; ਲਾਹ ਗਹੈ ਕਹੈ ਅਪਨੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Look at water, the nature of it never drowns wood in it. It regards the wood as his own having brought it up by irrigating it and thus keeps the shame of this relationship.

0.g: ਜੁਗਵਤ ਕਾਸਟ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਹਿ; ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੈ ਕਾਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Wood keeps fire in it latently but taking the wood in itself the fire burns it (wood) to ashes.

0.g: ਅਗਰਹਿ ਜਲ ਬੋਰਿ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਡੈ ਮੋਲ ਤਾ ਕੋ; ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਗਧ ਕੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਉਟਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The wood of Gularia Agalocha (Agar) resurfaces in water after sinking for sometime. This sinking increases the value of the wood. For burning it well in fire, it is boiled in water.

0.g: ਤਊ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਰੁਧਰੁ ਚੁਇ ਚੋਆ ਹੋਇ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲ; ਅਉਗਨਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ।੪੨੫।
0.e: Then its essence mixes well in water that becomes sweet smelling. For extracting the essence of the wood, the water has to bear the heat of the fire. But for its calm and tolerant nature, water changes its demerits into merits and thus fulfils its duties

0.g: ਕੋਟਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖ; ਆਨੰਦ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਤੁਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions of comforts and millions of ecstasies cannot reach anywhere near the comforts and ecstasies that are experienced with His acquisition.

0.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਸਹਜ ਸਰ; ਮੰਗਲ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਮ ਮੰਗਲ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions of equipoise states cannot reach the state of His stability, nor can millions of happy songs of praise can touch the bliss of the happiness blessed by Him.

0.g: ਕੋਟਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਪਰਤਾਪ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਸਰ; ਕੋਟਨ ਕੋਟਾਨ ਛਬਿ ਛਬਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions of splendours cannot match His splendour nor can millions of adornments reach His form.

0.g: ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਹੀ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਿ; ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਨਾਹ ਸਿਹਜ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੀ ।੬੫੧।
0.e: Millions of four desirable elements (dharam, arth, kaam and mokh) cannot reach him who has been blessed with His Naam and who gets an opportunity of the auspicious invitation of the Master calling the seeker on the nuptial bed of His heart.  (651)

0.g: ਬੀਸ ਕੇ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਂਸੁ; ਹੇਮ ਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the common folk wisdom, knowledge of religious books and the dealings of the worldly people, a bamboo cannot acquire fragrance nor can the iron waste become gold. It is the undeniable truth of Guru's intellect that a bamboo-like arrogant person cannot

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਕੀਸ ਕੋ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ; ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਾਸੈ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The path of Sikhism is a path of One God. The sandalwood like True Guru blesses a bamboo-like arrogant person with humility and Naam making him full of virtuous qualities. His dedication to Naam Simran instills fragrance into other similar persons.

0.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਮਨੂਰ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਭੇਟਿ; ਪਾਰਸ ਮਨੂਰ ਕਰੈ ਅਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Vice laden iron waste-like person becomes philosopher-stone by touching Paaras (philosopher stone) like True Guru. The True Guru converts the wasted person into gold like virtuous. He earns respect everywhere.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਾਨਿ ਹੈ ।੮੪।
0.e: The congregation of holy and true disciples of a True Guru is capable of making the sinners into pious persons. One who joins the congregation of true Sikhs of Satguru is also known as Guru's disciple. (84)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ।
0.e: The Lord has subsumed crores of universes in His each trichome.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ।
0.e: The true Guru form of that primal perfect and transcendental Brahm is bestower of delights.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ।
0.e: All the four vamas come to the shelter of the true Guru in the form of holy congregation

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ।
0.e: And the gurmukhs there merge their consciousness in the Word through learning, meditation and, prayer.

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੇ ਵਸਾਈ ।
0.e: Fear of the Lord, loving devotion and the delight of love, for them, is the idol of the true Guru whom they cherish in their heart.

0.g: ਏਵਡੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਂਦੇ; ਸਾਧ ਚਰਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ।
0.e: The feet of the true Guru in the form of sadhu bear so much load (mental as well as spiritual) of their disciples that,

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ।੧੪।
0.e: 0 my brothers you, ought to worship them. The value of the pleasure fruit of the gunnukhs cannot be estimated.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਸਚੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜਹੁ ਘੁਘੂ ਕੁਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ।
0.e: The truth is sun-light and falsehood is owl which cannot see anything.

0.g: ਸਚ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਬੋਹੀਐ; ਕੂੜਹੁ ਵਾਸ ਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਬੁਝੈ ।
0.e: The fragrance of truth diffuses in the whole vegetation but falsehood in the form of bamboo does not identify sandal.

0.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਸਫਲ ਤਰੋਵਰਾ; ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਫਲੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਲੁਝੈ ।
0.e: Truth makes a fruitful tree where as the proud silk cotton tree being fruitless is ever anguished.

0.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ; ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾਂ ਰੁਝੈ ।
0.e: In the month of silvan all the forests go green but akk, the wild plant of sandy region, and javds, the camel-thorn, remain dry.

0.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ; ਸੰਖਿ ਨਿਸਖਣ ਹਸਤਨ ਦੁਝੈ ।
0.e: Rubies and pearls are there in the Manasarovar but the conch being empty within is pressed by hands.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਗੰਗੋਦਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਕੂੜਿ ਰਲੈ ਮਦ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਝੈ ।
0.e: Truth is pure like the water of the Ganges but the wine of falsehood, even if hidden, makes its foul smell manifest.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ, ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਖੁਜੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Truth is truthful and falsehood remains false.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਵਧੈ ਚੀਲ ਉਜਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ; ਉਚੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਉਚੀ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: Pine tree grows in a forest and goes high and higher.

0.g: ਗੰਢੀ ਜਲਨਿ ਮੁਸਾਹਰੇ; ਪੱਤ ਅਪੱਤ ਨ ਛੁਹੁਦਾ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: Its nodes burn in torches and none touches its scorned leaves.

0.g: ਛਾਉਂ ਨ ਬਹਨਿ ਪੰਧਾਣੂਆਂ; ਪਵੈ ਪਛਾਵਾਂ ਟਿਬੀਂ ਟੋਈ ।
0.e: No passerby sits under its shade because its long shadow falls over rough ground.

0.g: ਫਿੰਡ ਜਿਵੈ ਫਲੁ ਫਾਟੀਅਨਿ; ਘੁੰਘਰਿਆਲੇ ਰੁਲਨਿ ਪਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Its fruit also bursts forth in curly pieces like that of a ball made of rags and moves around.

0.g: ਕਾਠੁ ਕੁਕਾਠੁ ਨ ਸਹਿ ਸਕੈ; ਪਾਣੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਧੁਪ ਨ ਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Its wood is also not a good one, because it cannot bear water, air, sunshine and heat.

0.g: ਲਗੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ; ਜਲਦੀ ਹਉਮੈਂ ਅਗਿ ਖੜੋਈ ।
0.e: If fire breaks out in pine forest it does not extinguish soon and it further goes on burning itself in the fire of ego.

0.g: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਿ, ਦਈ ਵਿਗੋਈ ।੧੯।
0.e: Giving it big size, God has made it useless and liable to destruction.

0.g: ਐ ਕਮਾਲਿ ਤੋ ਕਮਾਲਸਤੋ ਕਮਾਲਸਤੋ ਕਮਾਲ ।
0.e: Will have his deserted house, with the achievement of the Truth, rehabilitated and revived again. (204)

0.g: ਐ ਜਮਾਲਿ ਤੋ ਅਸ ਜਮਾਲਸਤੋ ਜਮਾਲਸਤੋ ਜਮਾਲ ।੫੨।੧।
0.e: Meditation of God is one great treasure;

0.g: ਐਾ ਕਿ: ਨਜ਼ਦੀਕੀ ਤੋ ਅਜ਼ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਰੱਗ ਵ ਆਲਮ ਹੈਰਾਂ ।
0.e: How can one obtain such a magnificent treasure from the worldly riches like wealth and silver? (205)

0.g: ਯਾਰਿ ਮਾ ਈਂ ਚਿਆਂ ਖ਼ਿਆਲਸਤੋ ਖ਼ਿਆਲਸਤੋ ਖ਼ਿਆਲ ।੫੨।੨।
0.e: Whosoever developed a desire for (meeting with) the Lord, the Lord liked him;

0.g: ਮਨ ਨਦਾਨਮ ਕਿ ਕੁਦਾਮਮ ਕਿ ਕੁਦਾਮਮ ਕਿ ਕੁਦਾਮਮ ।
0.e: The love and devotion for Akaalpurakh is the best cure-all panacea. (206)

0.g: ਬੰਦਾਇ-ਊ ਏਮ ਵਾਊ ਹਾਫ਼ਿਜ਼ਿ ਮਨ ਦਰ ਰਮਾ ਹਾਲ ।੫੨।੩।
0.e: The deed of the main purpose of this body is only to remember Waaheguru;

0.g: ਦਿਲਿ ਮਨ ਫ਼ਾਰਗ਼, ਵ ਦਰ ਕੂਏ ਤੋ, ਪਰਵਾਜ਼ ਕੁਨਦ, ।
0.e: However, He always abides and manifests on the tongues of the noble souls. (207)

0.g: ਗਰ ਜ਼ਿ ਰਾਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼, ਬ-ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀ ਪਰੋ ਬਾਲ ।੫੨।੪।
0.e: That saintliness is really worthwhile if it is to seek the Truth;

0.g: ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਹਾਲ ਬਜੁਜ਼ ਹਰਫ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਦਮ ਨ-ਜ਼ਨਦ ।
0.e: What is the worth of that kingdom that is useless if it is not aiming towards God. (208)

0.g: ਗ਼ੈਰਿ ਜ਼ਿਕਰਸ਼ ਹਮਾ ਆਵਾਜ਼ ਬਵਦ ਕੀਲੋ ਮਕਾਲ ।੫੨।੫।
0.e: Both the drunk and the holy person are desirous of Him;

0.g: ਮੁਰਸ਼ਦਿ ਕਾਮਿਲਿ ਮਾ ਬੰਦਗੀਅਤ ਫ਼ਰਮਾਇਦਾ ।
0.e: Let us see! Whom does He, the transcendent Akaalpurakh likes?  (209)

0.g: ਐ ਜ਼ਹੇ ਕਾਲ ਮੁਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਿ ਕੁਨਦ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਹਾਲ ।੫੨।੬।
0.e: A human being deserves to be called a human being only if he directs himself towards meditation;

0.g: ਹਰ ਕਿ: ਗੋਇਦ ਤੌ ਚਿ: ਬਾਸ਼ੀ, ਵ ਚਿ: ਗੋਇਦ ਜੁਜ਼ਿ ਤੋ, ।
0.e: Without a description/word of Waaheguru, it is all humiliation. (210)

0.g: ਗਸ਼ਤ ਹੈਰਾਂ ਹਮਾ ਆਲਮ ਹਮਾ ਦਰ ਐਨਿ ਜਮਾਲ ।੫੨।੭।
0.e: However, it is apparent that only that person is on the right path,

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Discipleship of the Guru is such a difficult task that only a rare one can understand it.

0.g: ਪੀਰਾ ਪੀਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: He, who knows it, becomes guide of spiritual guides and chief Guru of Gurus.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ; ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ।
0.e: In this stage the wonderful feat of becoming Guru by the disciple and vice-versa is enacted.

0.g: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ, ਸੋਈ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Externally the Sikh and Guru remain as they were, but internally, the light of the one permeates the other.

0.g: ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Becoming the Sikh of the One Guru, the disciple understands the word of the Guru.

0.g: ਮਿਹਰ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ; ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸੁ ਭਾਣੈ ।੧।
0.e: Grace of the Guru and love of the disciple meeting together in the divine order join each other in the form of the love of the Guru and fear in the mind of the disciple to create a balanced and handsome personality.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਮਉਲੇ ਅੰਬ ਬਸੰਤ ਰੁਤਿ; ਅਉੜੀ ਅਕੁ ਸੁ ਫੁਲੀ ਭਰਿਆ ।
0.e: In spring season, the mangoes blossom and akk the bitter wild plant of sandy region also becomes full of flowers.

0.g: ਅੰਬਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਖਖੜੀ; ਅਕਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਅੰਬੁ ਅਫਰਿਆ ।
0.e: The pod of akk cannot produce mango and fruitless akk cannot grow on mango tree.

0.g: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਅੰਬ ਵਣਿ; ਅਕਿਤਿਡੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਿਤਾਲਾ ਹਰਿਆ ।
0.e: Nightingale sitting on mango tree is black and the grosshopper of akk is speckled one or green.

0.g: ਮਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਬਿਰਖ ਭੇਦੁ; ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਧਰਿਆ ।
0.e: Mind is a bird and due to difference of the results of different company, it gets the fruit of the tree it chooses to sit upon.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਡਰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਨ ਡਰਿਆ ।
0.e: Mind is scared of holy congregation and the wisdom of the Guru but is not afraid of evil company and evil intellect i.e. it does not want to go in good company and takes interest in the evil company.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭੀ ਆਖੀਐ; ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਿਆ ।
0.e: God is said to be loving towards saints and liberator of the fallen ones.

0.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ, ਸੋਈ ਤਰਿਆ ।੮।
0.e: He has salvaged many fallen pepole and only he gets across who is accepted by Him.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪੁਤੈ ਦੀ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: Parents are happy that the betrothel ceremony of their son has been solemnized.

0.g: ਰਹਸੀ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ; ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: Mother becomes overjoyed and sings songs of happiness.

0.g: ਵਿਗਸੀ ਪੁਤ ਵਿਆਹਿਐ; ਘੋੜੀ ਲਾਵਾਂ ਗਾਵ ਭਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Singing eulogies of bridegroom, and praying for the welfare of the couple she feels very happy that her son got married.

0.g: ਸੁਖਾਂ ਸੁਖੈ ਮਾਵੜੀ; ਪੁਤੁ ਨੂੰਹ ਦਾ ਮੇਲ ਅਲੋਈ ।
0.e: For the well-being and harmony of bride and bridegroom the mother makes vows of offerings (before the deities).

0.g: ਨੁਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਕੰਤ ਕੁਮੰਤੁ ਦੇਇ; ਵਿਹਰੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਸੁ ਵਿਗੋਈ ।
0.e: Now, the bride starts ill-advising the son, goading him to get separate from the parents, and consequently the mother-in-law becomes sorrowful.

0.g: ਲਖ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਪੁਤ ਕੁਪੁਤਿ ਚਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਝੋਈ ।
0.e: Forgetting lacs of benefactions (of mother) the son becomes disloyal and sets himself at logger-heads with his parents.

0.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰਵਣ, ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ।੧੧।
0.e: Rare is any obdient son like Sravan of mythology who was most obedient to his blind parents.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਧਰਤਿ ਵੜੈ ਵੜਿ ਬੀਉ ਹੋਇ; ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ।
0.e: The seed enters the earth and settles in the form of root.

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਬਰੂਟਾ ਚੁਹਚੁਹਾ; ਮੂਲ ਡਾਲ ਧਰੰਮੈ ।
0.e: Then in the form of verdant plant it becomes stem and branches.

0.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਬਹੁ ਜਟਾ ਪਲੰਮੈ ।
0.e: Becoming tree it extends further and tangled branches hang from it.

0.g: ਜਟਾ ਲਟਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਹੋਇ ਮੂਲ ਅਗੰਮੈ ।
0.e: These flourishing branches ultimately entering the earth again attain the form of roots.

0.g: ਛਾਂਵ ਘਣੀ ਪਤ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਫਲ ਲੱਖ ਲਖੰਮੈ ।
0.e: Now its shade becomes think and leaves appear beautiful and millions of fruits grow on it.

0.g: ਫਲ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੀਅ ਬਹੁ; ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਰੰਮੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: In each fruit remain many seeds (and this process goes on). The mystery of the Sikhs of the Guru is the same; they also like banyan tree go on spreading the name of the Lord.

0.g: ਸਫਲ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਮਾਰੇ; ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਸਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a tree laden with fruit drops fruit to the person who throws stone at it, then it bears the pain of a saw on its head and in the form of a raft or boat takes the iron saw across the river;

0.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੋਰੀਅਤ ਸੀਪ ਕੇ ਜਿਉ; ਦੇਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as an oyster is taken out of the sea, is broken and it yields a pearl to the one who breaks it open and feels not the insult that it faces;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਨਤ ਹਨਤ ਘਨ; ਮਾਨਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a labourer strives the ore in a mine with his shovel and pick-axe and the mine rewards him with precious stones and diamonds;

0.g: ਊਖ ਮੈ ਪਿਊਖ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੋਤ ਕੋਲੂ ਪਚੈ; ਅਵਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ।੩੨੬।
0.e: Just as sweet nectar-like juice is extracted out by putting it through a crusher, so are the evil-doers treated with sympathy and welfare by the true and saintly persons when they come to them. (326)

0.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੁਖ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਹਸਤ ਪਗ; ਚਿਹਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨ ਮੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As the mind is associated with eyes, ears, mouth, nose, hand, feet etc., and other limbs of the body; it is the driving force behind them:

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੁਸਟ ਤੁਸਟਮਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ; ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਅਰਪਤ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As tasty and wholesome food is eaten by the mouth that makes every limb of the body strong, and blooming;

0.g: ਮੂਲ ਏਕ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਰਮਾਖਾ ਜਲ ਜਿਉ ਅਨੇਕ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਜਾਵਦੇਕਿ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As watering the trunk of a tree conveys water to its many big or small branches. So far as the question of the universe arises, one should bring to mind the thought of one Lord who is all-pervading.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਪਨ ਦੇਖੀਆਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ; ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨੀਐ ।੨੪੫।
0.e: As one sees self in the mirror, so does an obedient disciple of the Guru focuses his mind in his self (a miniscule part of the Lord-soul) and recognises the all-pervading Lord. (245)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੫
ਖੇਤੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਸੁ ਢਿੰਗਰੀ ਕਿਕਰ ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਗੈ ।
0.e: Around the agricultural field the bushes are kept as fence and around the garden acacia. trees (for its safety) are planted.

0.g: ਸਪ ਪਲੇਟੇ ਚੰਨਣੈ; ਬੂਹੇ ਜੰਦਾ ਕੁਤਾ ਜਾਗੈ ।
0.e: The sandalwood tree is entwined by snakes and for the safety of treasure the lock is used and the dog also remains awake.

0.g: ਕਵਲੈ ਕੰਡੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਸਿਆਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਾਗੈ ।
0.e: Thorns are known to live near flowers and during the ho/frevelty among the turbulent crowd one or two wise men also remain persent.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਥਰਾਂ; ਮਣਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲੈ ਨਾਗੈ ।
0.e: As the jewel remains in the head of black cobra the philosopher's stone remains surrounded by stones.

0.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਗਲਿ ਪੋਤ ਵਿਚਿ; ਮੈਗਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਚੈ ਧਾਗੈ ।
0.e: In the garland of jewels on both the side of a jewel glass is kept to protect it and the elephant remains tied with the thread cf love.

0.g: ਭਾਵ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ਘਰਿ; ਬਿਦਰੁ ਖਵਾਲੈ ਪਿੰਨੀ ਸਾਗੈ ।
0.e: Lord Krsna for his love for the devotees goes to Vidur's home when hungry and the latter offers him beans of sag, a green leafy vegetable.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਭਉਰ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਹਲੰਗੁ ਸਭਾਗੈ ।
0.e: The Sikh of the Guru becoming black bee of the lotus feet of the Guru, ought to attain good fortune in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ, ਦੁਤਰੁ ਝਾਗੈ ।੨੫।
0.e: He should further know that cup of the love of the Lord is got after very hard

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਿਲੇ; ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A Sikh ever in attendance of Satguru merges in the ocean-like True Guru through the Ganges-like holy congregation. He remains engrossed in the fountain-head of Cyan (knowledge) and contemplation.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ; ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਚਕੋਰ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A True Sikh remains absorbed and immersed in the holy dust of the True Guru like a bumble bee and longs for a glimpse of his Guru just as a moon bird experiences pangs of separation of his beloved moon.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਹਾਰ ਹੰਸ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Like a swan whose diet is pearls, a true Sikh relishes the pearl-like Naam as his life support. Like a fish, he swims in the cool, clean and comforting waters of spirituality.

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਅਮਰਾਪਦ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ; ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰ ਕਾਮਧੇਨਾਧੀਨ ਹੈ ।੯੭।
0.e: By the element and nectar-like glimpse of grace of the True Guru, a true Sikh attains immortality. And then all mythical donors like Kamdhen cow or Kalap brichh and even Lakshmi (Goddess of wealth) serve him diligently. (97)

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਉ ਕਰੈ; ਹਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When the True Guru, an embodiment of complete and the only Lord becomes clement, he destroys the melody of ego, instilling humility in the heart.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the kindness of the True Guru, one gets attached with Word Guru (Shabad Guru) in the company of saintly persons. The sentiment of loving worship destroys the duality from the mind.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ; ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਵਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the magnificence of the True Guru, the relishing of loving elixir-like Naam, one feels satiated. Becoming wondrous and devoted, one indulges in the meditation on the name of fearless Lord.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ।੧੮੯।
0.e: With the kindness of True Guru renouncing fear and worry one gets into a state of ecstasy and by adopting consecration of True Guru one becomes a slave of the Guru. (189)

0.g: ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ; ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When the vision rests on the congregation of holy people, one's consciousness attaches with the Lord. The same vision turns into vices in the company of self-willed people.

0.g: ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ; ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: In the holy company, one realises the Lord through the union of the True Guru's words and the consciousness. But the same consciousness becomes a cause of arrogance and discord in the company of ill reputed persons.

0.g: ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦ; ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਕਮ ਅਹਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By virtue of the company of Guru-conscious persons simplicity in life and eating becomes supreme blessing. But eating (of meat etc.) in the company of ill-famed and self-willed people become painful and distressing.

0.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ।੧੭੫।
0.e: Due to base wisdom, the company of the self-willed people become a cause of birth and death repeatedly. On the contrary, adopting Guru's wisdom and keeping company of holy persons become a cause of emancipation. (175)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਜਾਣੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ; ਆਪੁ ਪੀਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Madder (Rubia munjista) knowing very well gets itself grinded.

0.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛਡੈ ਸੰਗੁ; ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Its character is such that it never deserts the clothes.

0.g: ਕਟਿ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ; ਆਪੁ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Likewise, the sugarcane also care freely gets itself crushed.

0.g: ਕਰੈ ਨ ਮਨ ਰਸ ਭੰਗੁ; ਅਮਿਓ ਚੁਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Without leaving away its sweetness offers the taste of nectar.

0.g: ਗੁੜੁ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡ ਅਚੰਗੁ; ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਾਇਆ ।
0.e: It produces jaggery, sugar, treacle molasses many relishable items.

0.g: ਸਾਧ ਨ ਮੋੜਨ ਅੰਗੁ; ਜਗੁ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ।੧੩।
0.e: Similarly, the saints also do not abstain from the service of mankind, and give happiness to all.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਜਿਉ ਘੁਣ ਖਾਧੀ ਲਕੜੀ; ਵਿਣੁ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੀ ।
0.e: He (the apostate) becomes feeble and powerless as the weevil-eaten wood.

0.g: ਜਾਣੁ ਡਰਾਵਾ ਖੇਤ ਵਿਚਿ; ਨਿਰਜੀਤੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ।
0.e: He is similar to the life-less scarecrow put up in the field to frighten (the birds).

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਧੂਅਰੁ ਝੜੁਵਾਲ ਦੀ; ਕਿਉ ਵਰਸੈ ਪਾਣੀ ।
0.e: How out of clouds of smoke rain could take place.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਥਣ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਕਰੀ; ਦੁਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਨ ਆਣੀ ।
0.e: As the teat of a goat in the neck cannot give milk, likewise the grabber of religious earning of a religious place roams hither and thither in the craving of the same.

0.g: ਝਾਕੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਝਾਕਵਾਲੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ।
0.e: What is the exact mark of such a man.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਮੁ ਚਟੈ ਗਾਇ ਮਹਿ; ਉਹ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ।੧੬।
0.e: Such a man remains deluded like that cow who considering its dead offspiring alive goes on licking it

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਅਸਚਰਜਮੈ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Millions of astonishments are feeling astonished at the grandeur of a Guru-conscious person who has been able to achieve union of mind and Guru's words in the holy gathering. Millions of trances are feeling surprised and astonished.

0.g: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਹੁਇ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ; ਗਦਗਦ ਹੋਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Millions of strangeness’s are feeling astonished. Millions of tunes are feeling pleasure and ecstasy listening to the unstruck melody of the word in the consciousness.

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਗਨੀ ਜਾਤ ਨਹੀ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲਾਦਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Millions of states of knowledge become redundant before the ecstasy of the engrossment of the united state of the word and consciousness.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਅੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਹੈ ।੨੫੦।
0.e: A Guru-oriented person practices union of Guru's blessed words in his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. He focuses his mind on the Lord who is infinite and sans beginning. (250)

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਅਦਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ; ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A vision of the Lord is beyond the knowledge of the six philosophies (of Hinduism). That vision is astonishing and wondrous. One is amazed at its sight. But that marvellous sight is beyond the capabilities of these eyes that can only see outwardly.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਬਦ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The form of divine word of the Lord is beyond speech and language. It is extremely wonderful. Even a description made and heard with ears is capable of sending one into a trance.

0.g: ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਅਪੀਅ ਪਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ; ਰਸਨਾ ਥਕਤ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: For His vision, relishing the elixir of Naam with love is beyond the worldly tastes. It is indeed unique. The tongue feels tired of making salutations to Him repeatedly and saying-Thou art infinite! Thou art infinite.

0.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਨ ਗਹਨ ਗਤਿ; ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ।੧੫੩।
0.e: No one can reach the latent and patent characteristics of the Transcendental and Immanent God who is complete in both forms: The complete and absolute God is the source of all the visible and invisible cosmos. (153)

0.g: ਸੋਰਠਾ ।
0.e: Sorath:

0.e: The light eternal of Guru Nanak Dev melded into the light of Guru Angad Dev who acquired effulgence like the former.

0.g: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਤਹਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਤਤਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ।੧।੩।
0.e: With the light of Guru Nanak merging with that of Guru Angad Dev Ji, the latter became wondrous in form and beyond words of praise.

0.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ।
0.e: Dohra:

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ।
0.e: Light supreme (Guru Nanak Dev Ji) merged in Guru Angad Dev's light who himself became light divine.

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਤਤਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਤ ਹੀ ਅਨੂਪ ।੨।੩।
0.e: Truth of Guru Nanak merged with the essence of Guru Angad transforming him into astonishing form.

0.g: ਛੰਦ ।
0.e: Channt:

0.g: ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਸ ।
0.e: Guru Angad coming in contact with Guru Nanak the philosopher-stone, became a philosopher-stone himself. His form too became wondrous.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗ ਉਧਾਰਸ ।
0.e: Becoming inseparable from Guru Nanak, Lehna Ji became Guru Angad and then whosoever came in touch with him (Guru Angad) was liberated.

0.g: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ।
0.e: Guru Angad Ji integrated himself like warp and weft with Guru Nanak, the possessor of Divine power of the Lord.

0.g: ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ।੩।੩।
0.e: Light merged with light so much that whosoever came in contact with light embodiment (Guru Angad) , became resplendent too. (3)

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੁਗੰਤਰ ਬਸੈ ਪਾਖਾਨ; ਭਿਦੈ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਕਠੋਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਜ੍ਰ ਭਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a stone stays in water for ages, yet it never softens since it is hard-hearted. Because of its density and solid mass, it sinks;

0.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਕਰੈ ਤੋਬਰੀ ਤਉ; ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਕਰਵਾਈ ਭੋਏ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as colocynth (Tumma) does not lose its bitterness even it is washed both from inside and outside at sixty-eight places of pilgrimage

0.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ਰਹੈ ਚੰਦਨਹਿ; ਤਜਤ ਨ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਊ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Just as a snake keeps entangled with the trunk of a Sandalwood tree all his life but because of the pride of long age, it does not shed its venom;

0.g: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕੈ ।੩੨੯।
0.e: Similarly, he who is debased and spurious at heart, has deceitful and suspicious love. His life in the world is useless and futile. He is a slanderer of saintly and Guru-oriented persons and is caught in the mesh of vices and sins account of his 'mine' an

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਂਝ ਬੈਠੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਰੈ; ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਾਤ ਨ ਕਨਿਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as without embarking a ship, ocean cannot be crossed and without the touch of philosopher-stone, iron, copper or other metals cannot be turned into gold.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਆਨ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾਰ ਨ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਤਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as no water is considered sacred other than the water of .river Ganges, and no child can be born without conjugal union of husband and wife.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਏ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨ ਧਾਨ ਧਾਰਾ; ਸੀਪ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਨ ਮਾਨਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as without sowing seeds, no crop can grow and no pearl can be formed in an oyster unless the swati drop of rain falls on it.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨ ਨ ਜਨ ਕਹੈ ।੫੩੮।
0.e: Similarly without taking refuge and consecration of True Guru, there is no other method or force that can end the repeated cycle of birth and death. One who is without the divine word of the Guru cannot be called a human being.  (538)

0.g: ਮੇਲਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਵਰਾਤਿ ਦਾ; ਬਾਬਾ ਅਚਲ ਵਟਾਲੇ ਆਈ ।
0.e: Hearing about the Sivratri fair, Baba (Nanak) came to Achal Batala.

0.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਕਾਰਨੇ; ਸਗਲੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ।
0.e: To have his glimpse the whole humanity swarmed the place.

0.g: ਲਗੀ ਬਰਸਣਿ ਲਛਮੀ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਵਾਈ ।
0.e: More than riddhis and siddhis, the money started pouring in like rain.

0.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਤ੍ਰ ਨੋ; ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਿਸਕਿ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਖਾਈ ।
0.e: Seeing this miracle, the yogis’ anger was aroused.

0.g: ਭਗਤੀਆ ਪਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਣਿ; ਲੋਟਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਲਇਆ ਛਪਾਈ ।
0.e: When some of the devotees paid obeisance (before Guru Nanak), the yogis’ ire deepened and they hid their metal pot.

0.g: ਭਗਤੀਆ ਗਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੁਲਿ; ਲੋਟੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ।
0.e: The devotees having lost their pot forgot their devotion because their attention now was in the pot.

0.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀ ਜਾਣ ਪੁਰਖ; ਕਢਿਆ ਲੋਟਾ ਜਹਾ ਲੁਕਾਈ ।
0.e: The omniscient Baba discovered (and handed over) the pot (to devotees).

0.g: ਵੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਤ੍ਰਿ, ਜੋਗੀ ਖੁਣਿਸਾਈ ।੩੯।
0.e: Witnessing this the yogis were further enraged

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਰੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਖਾਨਿ ਪਾਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a healthy person eats many types of dishes and eatables but a sick man does not like eating any of them.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਖੀ ਸਹਨਸੀਲ ਕੈ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੁਜਾ; ਅਜਿਆ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਕਲੇਜੋ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a buffalo, because of its tolerance is known to have great patience but a goat on the other hand does not have even a fraction of that patience.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਉਹਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਹੈ ਵੇਚੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਾਨਕਾਦਿ; ਰੰਕ ਪੈ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਗ ਨ ਜੁਗਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Just as a jeweller trades in diamonds and precious stones but no valuable diamond can be kept with a pauper since he does not have the ability to keep such expensive item.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਪਰਚ ਅਪਰਚੇ ਦੁਸਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ।੫੦੫।
0.e: Similarly, a devotee who remains engaged in the service and remembrance of the Lord, eating the offerings and consecrated food for him is justified. But he who is far removed from obeying the command of the Guru cannot consume the worship offerings. Consu

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭੁਤ ਉਦਮਾਦ ਠਟ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Lust, anger etc., the five vices are shadows of maya (mammon). These have created turbulence in human beings like demons. Many oceans of vices and evils are in rage in me mind of a human being as a result of these.

0.g: ਅਉਧ ਪਲ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਆਸਾ; ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Human life is very brief but his expectations and desires are of eons. There are waves of vices in the ocean-like mind whose cravings are unimaginable.

0.g: ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਧਾਵਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ; ਛਿਨਕ ਮੈ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Under the influence of all these cravings and desires, the mind roams about in all four directions and reaches regions beyond in split second time.

0.g: ਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਮਨ; ਸਾਧਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਹੈ ।੨੩੩।
0.e: Despite its engrossment in worries, physical ailments and many types of other maladies, it cannot be stopped from wandering. The refuge of the True Guru is the only means of controlling it. (233)

0.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੇ ਉਠਿ ਕੈ; ਜਾਇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ੍ਹਵੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Getting up at the ambrosial hour of morning the Sikhs bathe in the river.

0.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੰਦੇ ।
0.e: By putting their mind in the unfathomable God through deep concentration, they remember Guru, the God by reciting Japu (Ji).

0.g: ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Getting fully activated then they go to join the holy congregation of the saints.

0.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Becoming absorbed in remembering and loving the sabad they sing and hear the Guru's hymns.

0.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਵਰਤਿਮਾਨਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They love to spend their time in meditation, service and fear of God and they serve the Gum by observing his anniversaries.

0.g: ਸੰਝੈ ਸੋਦਰੁ ਗਾਵਣਾ; ਮਨ ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They sing the Sodar in the evening and heartily associate with one another.

0.g: ਰਾਤੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ; ਕਰਿ ਆਰਤੀ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਵੰਡੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Having recited the Sohila and made supplication at night they distribute sacred food (prasad).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖੰਦੇ ।੩।
0.e: Thus gurmukhs gladly taste the fruit of happiness.

0.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਥਾਪਿਆ; ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਾਈ ।
0.e: Kalijug became prevalent as the fourth age in which the low instincts gripped the whole world.

0.g: ਕਰਮ ਸੁ ਰਿਗਿ ਜੁਜਰ ਸਿਆਮ ਕੇ; ਕਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਰਿਦਿ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਕਚਾਈ ।
0.e: People became resultant in performing of the duties enjoined in the Rig, Yajur and Samaveda.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ; ਕਲਿ ਕਲਿਵਾਲੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ।
0.e: The entire earth got enticed by mammon and the antics of the Kalijug put everyone into delusion.

0.g: ਉਠੀ ਗਿਲਾਨਿ ਜਗਤ੍ਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਲੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ ।
0.e: Hatred and degeneracy engrossed the people and ego burnt oneand all.

0.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਪੂਜਦਾ; ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭਿ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Nobody now worships anyone and the sense of respect for the younger and elder has vanished into thin air.

0.g: ਭਏ ਬਿਅਦਲੀ ਪਾਤਸਾਹ; ਕਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਉਮਰਾਇ ਕਸਾਈ ।
0.e: In this cutter age the emporers are tyrants and their satraps butchers.

0.g: ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ; ਚਉਥੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: The justice of three ageshas become extinct and now whosoever gives something (as bribe) gets (justice?).

0.g: ਕਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ, ਸਭਿ ਭਈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ।੭।
0.e: The mankind has become wanting in dexterity of action.

0.g: ਪੁਛਨਿ ਗਲ ਈਮਾਨ ਦੀ; ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: Qazi and maulvis got together and began discussing religion.

0.g: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਂਗ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ; ਲਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: A great fantasy has been created and no one could understood its mystery.

0.g: ਪੁਛਨਿ ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਨੋ; ਹਿੰਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਕਿ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੋਈ ।
0.e: They asked Baba Nanak to open and search in his book whether Hindu is great or the Muslim.

0.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਖੇ ਹਾਜੀਆ; ਸੁਭਿ ਅਮਲਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ, ਦੋਨੋ ਰੋਈ ।
0.e: Baba replied to the pilgrim hajis, that, without good deeds both will have to weep and wail.

0.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਦੁਇ; ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ।
0.e: Only by being a Hindu or a Muslim one can not get accepted in the court of the Lord.

0.g: ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੁਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ; ਪਾਣੀ ਧੋਤੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੋਈ ।
0.e: As the colour of safflower is impermanent and is washed away in water, likewise the colours of religiosity are also temporary.

0.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਖਲੋਈ ।
0.e: (Followers of both the religions) In their expositions, denounce Ram and Rahim.

0.g: ਰਾਹਿ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ, ਦੁਨੀਆ ਗੋਈ ।੩੩।
0.e: The whole of the world is following the ways of Satan.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਹੁਇ, ਪਤੰਗ ਸੰਗਮ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ; ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: In order to become one with my dear beloved, I, a deceitful lover, not possessed by his love, did not learn from a mot how to die in separation from him, nor did I learn from fish how to die in the separation of beloved.

0.g: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਹੁਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ; ਚਰਨ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਹੋਇ, ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਠਹਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: And here I am who is not making any effort to merge in my Lord by keeping his refulgence in my heart; and yet with all this recalcitrance, I am alive.

0.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨ ਬਿਰਹ ਜਾਨੀ; ਮੀਨ ਅਉ ਪਤੰਗ, ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਖਤ ਲਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: I have not understood the intensity of love and consequence of death as is in the case of a moth and flame or fish and water, and therefore both moth and fish feel ashamed of my; fraudulent love.

0.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ, ਧੰਨਿ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ; ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।੧੪।
0.e: Being a deceitful friend, my human life is damnable, whereas the reptilian species are worth appreciation for their love of their beloveds like the moth and fish. Because of my fraudulent love I will not even get a place in hell. (14)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਵੇਦਾਂ ਸਣੈ; ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Brahmas alongwith the Vedas have declared Him this is not, this is not (neti neti) and these all could not known His mystery.

0.g: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਵਧੂਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: By becoming avadhut (a kind of superior yogi), Madadev also recited his name but his meditation could not attain him.

0.g: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Ten incarnations also flourished but none could perceive ekhankar, the supreme Lord.

0.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਥ ਨਉ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Nine naths, the treasures of miraculous powers, also bowed before that Lord.

0.g: ਸਹਸ ਨਾਂਵ ਲੈ ਸਹਸ ਮੁਖ; ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੰਖ ਨ ਨਾਉਂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Sesang (mythical snake) with its thousand mouths remembered Him by thousands of names, but its recitation could not be accomplished.

0.g: ਲੋਮਸ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਸਾਧਿ ਨ ਸਾਧੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Sage Lomas rigorously undertook ascetic discipline but could not overcome his ego and could not be called a true ascetic.

0.g: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨ ਚਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Ever-living Markandey spent a long life but could not taste the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ, ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ।੧੪।
0.e: All mentioned above remained deluded while living on earth.

0.g: ਕੂਆ ਕੋ ਮੇਢਕੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਹਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ; ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਸੰਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਈ ।
0.e: Just as a frog living in well cannot know the greatness and extent of the ocean, and the hollow conch shell cannot appreciate the importance of the ambrosial drop of rain water that turns into a pearl when it falls on an oyster.

0.g: ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਹਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਲੂ; ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸੈ ਕਹਾ ਖਾਇ ਸੂਹਾ ਹਿਤ ਠਾਨਈ ।
0.e: Just as an owl cannot know the light of the Sun or a parrot cannot eat the insipid fruits of a silk cotton tree nor can he love them.

0.g: ਬਾਇਸ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੋ; ਮਰਕਟ ਮਾਨਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਈ ।
0.e: Just as a crow cannot know the importance of the company of swans nor can a monkey appreciate the value of gems and diamonds.

0.g: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ; ਗੂੰਗੇ ਬਹਰੇ ਨ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਈ ।੪੭੦।
0.e: Similarly, a worshipper of other gods cannot understand the significance of serving True Guru. He is like a deaf and dumb person 'whose mind is not at all receptive to the sermons of the True Guru and therefore cannot act upon them.  (470)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੫
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak is perfect and transcendental Brahm.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ; ਸਚ ਸਬਦ ਸਮੇਉ ।
0.e: Guru Angad attained merger in Word by being in the company of the Guru.

0.g: ਅਮਰਾਪਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦਹੁ; ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ।
0.e: After Guru Angad, the imperceptible and without duality, Guru Amas Das, the bestower of immortality has flourished.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ ।
0.e: After Guru Amar Das, the forbearing and storehouse of infinite virtues, Guru Ram Das made manifest his existence.

0.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਕ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ; ਅਬਿਚਲ ਅਰਖੇਉ ।
0.e: From Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan Dev, who absorbed one in Ram-Nam, beyond all blemishes and immovable one, was born.

0.g: ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ; ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣੇਉ ।੨੫।੧੩। ਤੇਰਾਂ ।
0.e: Then came Guru Hargobind who is the cause of all the causes i.e. who is Gobind, the Lord himself.

0.g: ਗਿਰਤ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ਪਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਪਰ ਜਉ; ਗਹੈ ਆਸਰੋ ਪਵਨ ਕਵਨਹਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a person falling from the sky try to take support of the air, and that support is futile.

0.g: ਜਰਤ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਜਉ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਧੂਮ ਗਹੈ; ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਲ ਬੁਧ ਉਪਰਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a person ablaze in the fire tries to escape from its wrath by catching smoke, he cannot escape from the fire. On the contrary it only shows his foolishness.

0.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬੂਡਤ ਜਉ ਫੇਨ ਗਹੈ; ਅਨਿਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਜੈਬੇ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਾਜ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a person drowning in the rapid waves of the sea try to save himself catching the surf of the water, such a thought is totally foolish since the surf is not a means of crossing the sea.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ਦੁਖਤ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਨ ਮੋਖ ਪਦੁ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ।੪੭੩।
0.e: Similarly, the cycle of birth and death cannot end by worshipping or serving any god or goddess. Without taking the refuge of the perfect True Guru, no one can achieve salvation.  (473)

0.g: ਗਰ ਦਸਤਿ ਮਨ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਪੈਇ ਕਾਰ ਮੀਰਵਦ ।
0.e: So that you may begin to savor the taste of romantic tale. (50) (1)

0.g: ਮਨ ਚੂੰ ਕੁਨਮ ਕਿ ਦਿਲ ਬਸੂਇ ਯਾਰ ਮੀ ਰਵਦ ।੨੮।੧।
0.e: Even if the deep love for the Almighty ruins someone's worldly life,

0.g: ਆਵਾਜ਼ਿ ਲਨਤਰਾਨੀ ਹਰ ਦਮ ਬੋਗ਼ਸ਼ਿ ਦਿਲ ।
0.e: He still considers this divine pleasure far superior than anything else. (50) (2)

0.g: ਮੂਸਾ ਮਗ਼ਰ ਬਦੀਦਨਿ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਮੀ-ਰਵਦ ।੨੮।੨।
0.e: That moment and breath is blessed that is spent in His remembrance.

0.g: ਈਣ ਦੀਦਾ ਨੀਸਤ ਆਣ ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਅਸ਼ਕ ਮੀ-ਚਕਦ ।
0.e: And only that head is fortunate that dedicates and sacrifices itself to the path of devotion. (50) (3)

0.g: ਜਾਮਿ ਮੁਹੱਬਤ ਅਸਤ ਕਿ ਸਰਸ਼ਾਰ ਮੀ-ਰਵਦ ।੨੮।੩।
0.e: Thousands of devotees, having risked their lives, are standing and

0.g: ਦਿਲਦਾਰ ਵਾ ਦਿਲ ਜ਼ਿ ਬਸਕਿ ਯਕੇ ਅੰਦ ਦਰ ਵਜੂਦ ।
0.e: Reclining against the wall of the passage to His abode. (50) (4)

0.g: ਜਾਣ ਦਿਲ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਜਾਨਬਿ ਦਿਲਦਾਰ ਮੀ-ਰਵਦ ।੨੮।੪।
0.e: Anyone who has been sacrilegious in the Divine path,

0.g: ਦਰ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਕੌਨ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਊ ਸਰ-ਬੁਲੰਦ ਸ਼ੁਦ ।
0.e: Like Manssor, the crucifix (of love) is the befitting punishment for him. (50) (5)

0.g: ਮਨਸੂਰ ਵਾਰ ਹਰ ਕਿ ਸੂਇ ਦਾਰ ਮੀ-ਰਵਦ ।੨੮।੫।
0.e: Blessed is the heart that is imbued with its love for Akaalpurakh;

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਯਾਦਿ ਦੂਸਤ ਹਕੀਕੀ ਹੱਯਾਤ ਯਾਫ਼ਤ ।
0.e: In fact, it is the (heavy) weight of intense devotion that has bent the back of the heavenly sky. (50) (6)

0.g: ਦੀਗ਼ਰ ਚਿਰਾ ਬਕੂਚਾਇ ਖ਼ੁਮਾਰ ਮੀ-ਰਵਦ ।੨੮।੬।
0.e: O kind-hearted person and a person of resolve! If you could listen intently to just one note of the musical instrument (harp) of love and devotion,

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਲਖ ਹਕੀਮ, ਚਲਤ ਬਣਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Physicians prepare myriads of prescriptions.

0.g: ਆਕਲ ਹੋਇ ਫਹੀਮ, ਮਤੇ ਮਤਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Millions of people full of wisdom adopt many a resolution.

0.g: ਗਾਫਲ ਹੋਇ ਗਨੀਮ, ਵਾਦ ਵਧਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: Many enemies unwittingly go on increasing their enmity.

0.g: ਲੜਿ ਲੜਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਮੁਹੀਮ, ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: They march for fightings and thus show their ego

0.g: ਹੋਇ ਜਦੀਦ ਕਦੀਮ, ਨ ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੀ ।
0.e: From youth, though, they step in old age yet their egotism is not effaced.

0.g: ਸਾਬਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਲੀਮ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੀ ।੧੨।
0.e: Only the contented and the humble lose their sense of egocentricity.

0.g: ਭਈ ਗਿਲਾਨਿ ਜਗਤ੍ਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ, ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਉਪਾਏ ।
0.e: In view of the prevaling lassitude in the world, four varnas and four Ashrams were established.

0.e: The Eighth Guru, Guru Har Kishen Ji. The eighth Guru, Guru Har Kishen Ji, was the crown of the 'accepted' and  the 'chaste' believers of Waaheguru and the honorific master of those who have merged into Him. His extraordinary miracle is world-famous and  the radiance of his personality lights up the 'truth'. The special and near-ones are willing to sacrifice themselves for him and the chaste constantly bow at his door. His numerous followers and those who have an appreciation of real virtues are the elite of the three worlds and the six directions, and there are countless persons who pick up bits and scraps from the refectory and pool of Guru's qualities. The jewel-studded 'Hay' in his name is capable to defeat and bring down even the world-conquering and strong giants. The truth-telling 'Ray' deserves to be seated respectfully with the status of a president on the eternal throne. The Arabic 'Kaaf' in his name can open the doors of generosity and benevolence, and the glorious 'Sheen' with its pomp and show can tame and overpower even the tiger-like strong monsters. The last 'Noon' in his name brings and enhances freshness and aroma in life and is the closest friend of the God-given boons.
