0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੋ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਨ ਬੈਦ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ; ਬਿਨ ਉਪਚਾਰ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਾਧ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as the ailment of a patient if not told to a physician becomes beyond treatment with every passing moment.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਉਦਮ ਅਦਿਆਉ ਬਿਨ; ਮੂਲ ਔ ਬਿਆਜ ਬਢੈ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਆਧ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as the interest on the borrowed money increases every day if the principle amount is not returned leading to greater problem.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਸਨਾ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਬਿਨ; ਪਲ ਪਲ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਹੁਇ ਕਰਤ ਉਪਾਧ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Just as the enemy though warned, if not sorted out in time, makes him powerful with every passing day, can raise rebellion one day.

0.g: ਜ︀ਯੌਂ ਜ︀ਯੌਂ ਭੀਜੈ ਕਾਮਰੀ ਤ︀ਯੌਂ ਤ︀ਯੌਂ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ; ਬਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਰ ਬਸੈ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਜੀ ।੬੩੩।
0.e: Similarly, without obtaining true precept from the True Guru, sin resides in the mind of a mammon-effected human being. This sin increases further if not controlled.  (633)

0.g: ਨਿਸ ਦੁਰਿਮਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੇਤੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A base wisdom is full of ignorance. It encourages sin and evil deeds. The wisdom given by the True Guru is like the brightness of the day that pronounces righteous deeds.

0.g: ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੇ ਉਦੋਤ ਸਭ ਕਿਛ ਸੂਝੈ; ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਭੂਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭਰਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: With the emergence of Sun-like teachings of the True Guru, all that would stand in good stead becomes conspicuous. But consider any idol worship as dark night where one keeps wandering in doubts and suspicions by going wayward from the True path.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the virtues of Naam obtained from the True Guru an obedient Sikh becomes capable of seeing all that is not visible openly or conspicuously. Whereas the followers of gods and goddesses remain manifested with evil or sinning vision.

0.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੌਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਮਰਮੁ ਹੈ ।੪੮੮।
0.e: The worldly people's association with gods and goddesses for acquiring worldly pleasures from them, is just like a blind person is holding on to the shoulder of a blind person in search of the right path. But those Sikhs who are united with the True Guru

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor.

0.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਦਸਵੀਂ ਕੀ ।
0.e: Raag Ramkali, Vaar In praise of Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Sword) and the Tenth Master

0.g: ਬੋਲਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਕਾ ।
ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਖਤ ਰਚਾਇਆ; ਸਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾ ।
0.e: God established the true congregation as his celestial throne.

0.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ; ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਧਾਂ ਖੇਲਾ ।
0.e: (Guru) Nanak illuminated the Sidhas with the true form of the Fearless and Formless One.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰ ਮਨਾਈ ਕਾਲਕਾ; ਖੰਡੇ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ।
0.e: The Guru (in his Tenth Form) entreated the Shakti, the Integrity, by bequeathing the nectar through the Double-Edged Sword.

0.g: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਪਾਹੁਲ ਖੰਡੇਧਾਰ; ਹੋਇ ਜਨਮ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Quaffing the nectar of Double-Edged Sword, accomplish the worth of your birth.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਖ਼ਾਲਸਾ; ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: While the egocentric remains in duality, the Khalsa, the pure ones, enjoy the association of the Guru;

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੧।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and Disciple too.

0.g: ਮਾ ਕਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਹਰ ਬੰਦਾਇ ਹੱਕ ਰਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਫ਼ਹਿਮੀਦਾ ਏਮ ।
0.e: What use is that life that is spent needlessly and in vain. (216)

0.g: ਖ਼ੋਸ਼ੀਤਨ ਰਾ ਬੰਦਾਇ ਈਣ ਬੰਦਾਹਾ ਫ਼ਹਿਮੀਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੪।੧।
0.e: A person is born (only) to be engaged in meditation;

0.g: ਮਰਦੁਮਾਨਿ ਚਸ਼ਮਿ ਮਾ ਰਾ ਏਹਤਿਆਜਿ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਨੀਸਤ ।
0.e: In fact, religious devotion (and prayers) is a good cure to put this life in the proper perspective. (217)

0.g: ਬਸਕਿ ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਰਾਹਿ ਮਰਦੁਮ ਤੂਤੀਆ ਫ਼ਹਿਮੀਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੪।੨।
0.e: How fortunate is that eye that has got a glimpse of the face of the Beloved!

0.g: ਹਰ ਨਫ਼ਸ ਸਰ ਬਰ ਜ਼ਮੀਣ ਦਾਰੇਮ ਅਜ਼ ਬਹਿਰੇ ਸਜੂਦ ।
0.e: Eyes of the people of both the worlds are fixed towards it. (218)

0.g: ਜ਼ਾਣ ਕਿ ਰੂਇ ਯਾਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਨੂਰਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਫ਼ਹਿਮੀਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੪।੩।
0.e: This and the other world are satiated with the Truth;

0.g: ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹਾਣ ਰਾ ਫ਼ਕੀਰਾਣ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਦਾਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: But devoted men of God are rare in this world. (219)

0.g: ਜ਼ਾਣ ਗਦਾਇ ਕੂਇ ਊ ਰਾ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ ਫ਼ਹਿਮੀਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੪।੪।
0.e: If some one became indistinguishable with Akaalpurakh,

0.g: ਮਾ ਨਮੀ ਖ਼ਾਹੇਮ ਮੁਲਕੋ ਮਾਲ ਰਾ ਗੋਯਾ ਅਜ਼ਾਣ ।
0.e: Then his glory spreads in countries like Rome and Africa. (220)

0.g: ਸਾਇਆਇ ਜ਼ੁਲਫ਼ਿ ਤੁਰਾ ਬਾਲਿ ਹੁਮਾ ਫ਼ਹਿਮੀਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੪।੫।
0.e: To get assimilated in the Entity of God is, in fact, real love for Him;

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The importance of assembling in the company of obedient disciples of the True Guru is very significant. Because of love with the True Guru, this place is wonderful.

0.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹਰੀ; ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਤ ਸੁਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The disciple of the Guru looks for a glimpse of the True Guru. Because of a sight of the True Guru, his attention from other interests wane away. By His glimpse, he becomes unaware of all that is around him.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦ ਹਰੇ; ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: In the company of Guru's disciples, one hears the melody of Guru's words and that dispels listening of other melodies cram the mind. In the listening and uttering of Guru's words, one does not like to listen to or hear any other knowledge.

0.g: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਬਿਸਮਰਨ ਹੁਇ; ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਉਨਮਤ ਮਧੁ ਪਾਨ ਹੈ ।੨੬੩।
0.e: In this divine state, a Guru's Sikh forgets all his physical needs of eating, wearing, sleeping etc. He becomes free from physical adorations and relishes the Naam Amrit, ever living an ecstatic state. (263)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦਿਹੁਂ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਧਾਏ ।
0.e: Conquering Siva and S'akti (the rajas and tamas qualities), the gurmukhs have disciplined the moon-sun (ira, pingala) and also the time known by days and nights.

0.g: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਧੇ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ; ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਲੰਘਾਏ ।
0.e: Subjugating pleasure and pain, joy and suffering, they have gone beyond hell and heaven, sin and virtue.

0.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਏ ।
0.e: They have humbled life, death, liberation in life, right and wrong, enemy and friend.

0.g: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਾਧਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਰਹਾਏ ।
0.e: Being victors of raj and yoga (temporality and spirituality), they have disciplined alliance as well as separation.

0.g: ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਨੀਂਦ ਭੂਖ; ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ।
0.e: Conquering sleep, hunger, hope and desire, they have made their abode in their own true nature.

0.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਸਬਾਏ ।
0.e: Going beyond praise and slander, they have become beloved of the Hindus as well as Muslims.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ, ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਸਦਾਏ ।੨।
0.e: They bow before all and consider themselves as dust.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸਮਾਲ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ।
0.e: The words of gurmukh should always be cherished in one’s heart.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ; ਨੇਹ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ।
0.e: By the benevolent glance of the gurmukh one becomes blest and happy.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲਿ; ਵਿਰਲੇ ਘਾਲੀਐ ।
0.e: Rare are those who attain the sense of discipline and service.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ; ਹੇਤੁ ਹਿਲਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs being full of love are kind to the poor.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੇ ਨਾਲਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪਾਲੀਐ ।
0.e: Gurmukh is ever steadfast and always adheres to the teachings of the Guru.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਾਲ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਲੀਐ ।
0.e: One should seek jewels and rubies from the gurmukhs.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਲ ਅਕਾਲ; ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀਐ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs are devoid of deception; they, without becoming victim of Time, go on enjoying the delight of devotion.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੰਸਾ ਢਾਲਿ; ਰਸਕ ਰਸਾਲੀਐ ।੧੪।
0.e: Gurmukhs have discriminatory wisdom of swans (who can separate milk from water), and they with their mind and body love their Lord.

0.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਖੇਲ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Nanak, the embodiment of God Himself, permeated this (godly) operation.

0.g: ਅੰਗਦ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: And invoked sacred writ on (Guru) Angad.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਮਹਲ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਓ ।
0.e: In the first manifestation, he expounded the Naam (the Creator in His Creator).

0.g: ਦੁਤੀਏ ਅੰਗਦ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਓ ।
0.e: And the second, (Guru) Angad sang the benevolence of Har.

0.g: ਤੀਸਰ ਮਹਲ; ਅਮਰ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ।
0.e: In the Third revelation, (Guru) Amar Das captured the mind with the Eternal Word,

0.g: ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਖੇ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ।
0.e: By which he had envisaged the Lord God in his heart.

0.g: ਜਲ ਭਰਿਓ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕੇ ਦੁਆਰੇ ।
0.e: He served his True Guru by fetching water to his (Guru's) abode,

0.g: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਪਾਇਓ; ਮਹਲ ਅਪਾਰੇ ।
0.e: And, thus, obtained the divine throne.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ; ਚਉਥੇ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ।
0.e: In the fourth personification, appeared Guru Ram Dass,

0.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਟੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸਾ ।
0.e: Who recapitulated the faultless Immortal-being,

0.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ; ਪੰਚਮ ਠਹਿਰਾਇਓ ।
0.e: And confirmed fifth pontification upon Guru Arjan,

0.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਧਾਰ; ਗਰੰਥ ਬਣਾਇਓ ।
0.e: Who with the treasure of nectarous Word, compiled the Granth (the book of Holy Scriptures).

0.g: ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਬਣਾਇ; ਉਚਾਰ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ ।
0.e: Creating the Granth, he pronounced:

0.g: ਤਬ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ; ਪਾਠ ਰਚਾਇਓ ।
0.e: The whole world to reiterate the Sermons,

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਪਾਠ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ; ਜਗਤ ਸਭ ਤਰਿਓ ।
0.e: And with the Sermons from the Granth, the world emancipated.

0.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਰਿਓ ।
0.e: But the emancipated were those who, day and night, recollected the Naam.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਖਸਟਮ ਅਵਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Then was embodied Guru Hargobind, the sixth master,

0.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਤੇਗ; ਬਹੁ ਦੁਸਟ ਪਛਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Who, with sword held high, prostrated the enemies.

0.g: ਇਉਂ ਸਭ ਮੁਗਲਨ ਕਾ; ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ।
0.e: He made the minds of Muslim rulers demented,

0.g: ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੋਂ; ਦੁੰਦ ਰਚਾਨਾ ।
0.e: And for the sake of his devotees he rose and initiated (upon them) the war of attrition.

0.g: ਇਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ।
0.e: And thus exclaimed Gurdas;

0.g: ਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰਾ ।੨੧।
0.e: O my True Guru, You grant me redemption.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਮੈ ਘੂਘਟ ਪਟ; ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਮੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨ ਪੀਅ ਸੈ ।
0.e: Just as a daughter-in-law covers herself with veil in front of the elders of the house, but keeps no distance from her husband at the time of sharing his bed;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਣਿ ਅਛਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਹੀ ਸਹਿਤ ਅਹਿ; ਬੰਕ ਤਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਬਿਲ ਪੈਸਤ ਹੁਇ ਜੀਅ ਸੈ ।
0.e: Just as a snake remains crooked when with female snake and his family, but becomes straight when it enters in the burrow;

0.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਛਤ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੈ; ਪਾਛੇ ਕੈ ਦੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਤ ਤੀਅ ਸੈ ।
0.e: Just as a son avoids talking to his wife in front of his parents, but when alone showers all his love upon her,

0.g: ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀਅ ਸੈ ।੪੧।
0.e: Similarly a devoted Sikh appears worldly among others but having attached his mind with Guru's word, he rises spiritually and realises the Lord. Quintessence: One may maintain oneself as a worldly person outwardly but inwardly one keeps oneself attached w

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਫਲ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਫਲੁ ਮੀਠੋ ਖਗ ਤਾਪੋ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a fruit orchard has many types of fruit trees, but birds fly only to the one which has sweet fruit.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਬਹੁ; ਜਾ ਮੈ ਤੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਲਲਚਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Numerous types of stones are available in the mountains but one in search of diamond longs to see the stone that can yield one a diamond.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਲਧਿ ਮਧਿ ਬਸਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਜੰਤ; ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਾਮੈ ਹੰਸ ਖੋਜ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a lake is inhabited by many forms of marine life, but a swan visits only that lake which has pearls in its oyster.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਸਿਖ; ਜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਲੋਕ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ।੩੬੬।
0.e: Similarly-numerous Sikhs reside in the refuge of the True Guru. But he who has the knowledge of Guru residing in his heart, people feel attracted and enamoured to him. (366)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਧ; ਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਜੀਂ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ।
0.e: One is a Sikh, two the congregation and in five resides God.

0.g: ਨਉ ਅੰਗ ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਸੁੰਨ; ਅਵਤਾਰ ਮਹੇਸਰੁ ।
0.e: As cyphers added to one make the infinite number, likewise getting attached with Sunya (God), the creatures also transform into great men and kings of the earth.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੰਖ; ਮੁਕਤੈ ਮੁਕਤੇਸਰੁ ।
0.e: In this way innumerable small and big persons also become liberated and liberators.

0.g: ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਿਖ; ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਲਖੇਸਰੁ ।
0.e: In town after town and country after country are myriads of Sikhs.

0.g: ਇਕ ਦੂੰ ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਲਖ ਫਲ; ਫਲ ਬੀਅ ਲੋਮੇਸਰੁ ।
0.e: As millions of fruits are obtained from a tree and in those fruits remain millions of seeds (In fact the Sikhs are the fruits of the Guru-tree and in those fruits the Guru resides in the form of seeds).

0.g: ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਰਾਜੇਸੁਰਾ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੇਸਰੁ ।੧੯।
0.e: These disciples of the Guru being enjoyers of delights are the emperors of the kings and being knower of the technique of yoga are kings of yogis.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From one resonance the Oankar-Braham created the whole universe.

0.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰ ਲਖ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The very Oankar assumed the form of millions of universes.

0.g: ਪੰਜਿ ਤਤੁ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਲਖ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਅ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Five elements were created, myriads of productions were made and all the three worlds were adorned.

0.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਫਲ; ਦਰੀਆਵ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He created water, earth, mountains, trees and made the holy rivers flow.

0.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਲ ਤੁਲ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He created great oceans that subsume in them myriads of rivers.

0.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਇਕ ਅਤੋਲਵੀ; ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: A fraction of their grandeur cannot be explained. Only nature is infinite whose expanse cannot be counted.

0.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ।੧੧।
0.e: When nature is unknowable how could its creator be known?

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਕਰੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Millions of rituals of recitation, penances, continence, burnt offerings and crores of oblations are there.

0.g: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਘਣੇ; ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਤੰਦੁ ਮਰੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Fasts, rules, controls, activities are many but they all are like a weak thread.

0.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ; ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਓੜੀ ।
0.e: Many are pilgrimage centres, anniversaries, and millions of virtuous acts, charities and altruism's.

0.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ; ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਲਖ ਜੋੜ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Millions kinds of worship of gods and goddesses, combinations, detractions, boons, curses are there.

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਲਖ; ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Many philosophies, varnas, non-varnas and many are the persons who do not bother about the (unnecessary) brands of lakhs of worships and oblations.

0.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਖ; ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਝਾੜਿ ਪਛੋੜੀ ।
0.e: Many are the means of public behaviour, virtues, renunciation, indulgence and other covering devices;

0.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਹੁ; ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸੱਭਾ ਥੋੜੀ ।
0.e: But all these are craftsmanship's remain away from the truth; they cannot touch it.

0.g: ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ, ਅਚਾਰੁ ਚਮੋੜੀ ।੧੯।
0.e: Higher than truth is truthful living.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ; ਨਾਭਿ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Calling himself great, Brahma entered into the naval lotus (Of Visnu to know its end).

0.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੁਗ; ਓੜਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਆ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ ।
0.e: For many ages he wandered in the cycle of transmigration and ultimately become dumbfounded.

0.g: ਓੜਕੁ ਕੀਤੁਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਆਪ ਗਣਾਇਐ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He left no stone unturned but remained misguided in his own so-called greatness.

0.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਦਾ; ਚਤੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ।
0.e: He becoming four-headed and wise would recite the four Vedas.

0.g: ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੋ ਸਮਝਾਇਦਾ; ਵੇਖਿ ਸੁਰਸਤੀ ਰੂਪ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He would make people understand many things but seeing the beauty of his own daughter, Sarasvati, became enamoured.

0.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ; ਗਰਬੁ ਗਰੂਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ।
0.e: He made his knowledge of the four Vedas futile. Proud as he became, he had to repent eventually.

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ, ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਵਖਾਣਾ ।੭।
0.e: In fact the Lord is ineffable; in Vedas also He is also described as neti neti, (not this, not this).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਭਭੀਖਣੋ; ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Dhru, Prahlad, Vibhisan, Ambris, Bali, Janak are well known personalities.

0.g: ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਜਸੀ; ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੀ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ।
0.e: They all were princes, and hence the rajas game of hope and desire was always on them.

0.g: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਮਤਰੇਈ ਚੰਡਿਆ; ਪੀਉ ਫੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਰਞਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Dhru was beaten up by his stepmother and Prahlad was caused to suffer by his father.

0.g: ਭੇਦੁ ਭਭੀਖਣੁ ਲੰਕ ਲੈ; ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਲੈ ਚਕ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Vibhisan got Lanka by divulging the secrets of home and Ambris became happy seeing the Sudarsan chakr, as his protector (to save Ambris from the curse of Durvasa, Visnu had sent his chakr).

0.g: ਪੈਰ ਕੜਾਹੈ ਜਨਕ ਦਾ; ਕਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਧਿਙਤਾਣਾ ।
0.e: Janak by keeping one leg into the soft bedding and another into the boiling cauldron showed his power of hathayoga and let down the real dharma.

0.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ।
0.e: The man who has eschewed his ego and has subsumed in the Lord is respected in the court of Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ।੧੪।
0.e: Only Gurmukhs have attained the fruits of delight and only they are accepted (here and hereafter).

0.g: ਮਾ ਬਾ-ਯਾਦਿ ਹੱਕ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਾ-ਏਮ ।
0.e: Every Tom, Dick or Harry does not have the wherewithal to reach there (them). (232)

0.g: ਦਾਇਮ ਅਜ਼ ਇਹਸਾਨਿ ਊ ਸ਼ਰਮਿੰਦਾ-ਏਮ ।੫੭।੧।
0.e: In appearance, they look just like an embodiment of the specie of Akaalpurakh,

0.g: ਖ਼ੁਦ-ਨਮਾ ਰਾ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਨੀਸਤ ।
0.e: In reality, they are the refuge for everyone in both the worlds. (233)

0.g: ਊ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾਣ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਮਾ ਬੰਦਾ-ਏਮ ।੫੭।੨।
0.e: While engaged in their professions or trades, they are still unattached and unduly engrossed in them;

0.g: ਦਰ ਵਜੂਦਿ ਖ਼ਾਕੀਆਣ ਪਾਕੀ ਅਜ਼ੋਸਤ ।
0.e: They spend their lives in remembering the Provident (day and night). (234)

0.g: ਮਾ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਇ ਪਾਕ ਰਾ ਬੀਨਿੰਦਾ-ਏਮ ।੫੭।੩।
0.e: They, the noble souls, consider themselves (out of humility) just like an ant,

0.g: ਮਾ ਬਪਾਇ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਸਰ ਅਫ਼ਗੰਦਾ-ਏਮ ।
0.e: Even though they, in fact, might be more powerful than a ferocious and dangerous elephant. (235)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ ਦੋ ਆਲਮ ਦਸਤ ਰਾ ਅਫ਼ਸ਼ਾਣਦਾ-ਏਮ ।੫੭।੪।
0.e: Whatever you are seeing in this world is simply astonished and confounded about them;

0.g: ਨੀਸਤ ਦਰ ਹਰ ਚਸ਼ਮ ਗ਼ੈਰ ਅਜ਼ ਨੂਰਿ ਊ ।
0.e: Their splendor and aura is far superior than even that of the examinations. (236)

0.g: ਸੁਹਬਤਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਿ ਹੱਕ ਜੋਇੰਦਾ-ਏਮ ।੫੭।੫।
0.e: The company of the true devotees of Waaheguru is a great boon;

0.g: ਮਾ ਚੂ ਜ਼ੱਰਾਇ ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਪਾਇ ਊ ਸ਼ੁਦੇਮ ।
0.e: Such a wealth and virtuosity does not suffer from any anxiety or grief. (237)

0.g: ਤਾ ਬਦਾਮਨ ਦਸਤਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਅਫ਼ਗੰਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੭।੬।
0.e: They, themselves, are elevated, mature and blessed; anyone who happens to  be bestowed with their company;

0.g: ਕੀਸਤ ਗੋਯਾ ਜ਼ਾਕਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ।
0.e: He, too, becomes elevated, mature and blessed, and receives laurels everywhere. (238)

0.g: ਹਮਚੂ ਖ਼ੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਜਹਾਣ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ੰਦਾ ਏਮ ।੫੭।੭।
0.e: Anyone who has recognized his own reality;

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਛਤ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Accepting the initiation sermon of the True Guru turns the outward vision of a person into divine vision. But the base wisdom makes a person blind despite the presence of eyes. Such a person is bereft of knowledge.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਠਿਨ ਕਪਾਟ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਹੈ ।
0.e: With the sermon of the True Guru, the tight shut doors of the consciousness become ajar whereas this does not happen in the case of a person of base wisdom and self will.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By adopting the counsel of the True Guru, one relishes the elixir of God's love perpetually. But base wisdom emanates foul smell from the mouth as a result of ill and bad words spoken.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਹੈ ।੧੭੬।
0.e: Adopting the wisdom of True Guru produces true love and peace. He is never touched by happiness or sorrow in this state. However, base wisdom remains a cause of discord, quarrels and distress. (176)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵੇਦ ਲਖ; ਮਹਾਂ ਭਾਰਥ ਰਾਮਾਇਣ ਮੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Even if Shastras, Smritis, Lakhs of Vedas, Mahabharat, Ramayan etc. are joined together;

0.g: ਸਾਰ ਗੀਤਾ ਲਖ ਭਾਗਵਤ; ਜੋਤਕ ਵੈਦ ਚਲੰਤੀ ਖੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Thousands of gists of the Gita, Bhagvats, books of astronomy and acrobats of physicians are joined;

0.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਸਾਅੰਗੀਤ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ਭੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Fourteen branches of education, musicology and Brahma, Visnu, Mahesa are put together;

0.g: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਲਖ ਨਾਰਦਾ; ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ ਲਖ ਸੇਖ ਨਵੇਲੇ ।
0.e: If Lakhs of ses, serpent, Sukr, Vyas, Narad, Sanal et al. are all collected there;

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਘਣੇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Myriad's of knowledge's, meditations, recitations, philosophies, varnas and guru-disciples are there; they all are nothing.

0.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰੁ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ।
0.e: The perfect Guru (Lord) is the Guru of the gurus and the holy discourse of the Guru is the basis of all the mantras.

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ; ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕੇਲੇ ।
0.e: The tale of the Word of the Guru is ineffable; it is neti neti (not this not this). One should always bow before him.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੇ ।੨੦।
0.e: This pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is attained in the early ambrosial hours.

0.g: ਸਰਵਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਦਾਦਰ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ; ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਮਦ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A frog living in a pool is unaware of the presence of a lotus flower growing in the same pool. Even a deer is unaware of the musk pod that he is carrying within his body.

0.g: ਮਨਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਹਿ ਬਿਖ੍ਰ ਬਿਖਮ ਕੈ; ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਸੰਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੀਨ ਬਕ ਬਾਨੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a poisonous snake because of its poison is not aware of the invaluable pearl that he carries in his hood and a conch shell keeps wailing although it lives in the ocean but unaware of the wealth stored therein.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਕੰਧ; ਉਲੂਐ ਅਲਖ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As a bamboo plant remains bereft of fragrance despite living in the close proximity of a Sandalwood tree, and as an owl keeps his eyes shut during the day behaving ignorantly of the Sun,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਮਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਭੇਟ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਜਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ।੨੩੬।
0.e: Similarly, because of my ego and pride, I like an infertile woman remained fruitless despite acquiring the touch of True Guru. I am no better than the tall fruitless tree like silk Cotton. (236)

0.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਮਾਸ ਸਨਿ; ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧ ਕਛੁ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: First of all, when no breath and body was there nothing was visible in the pitch darkness.

0.g: ਰਕਤਿ ਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਰਚਿ; ਪੰਚਿ ਤਤ ਕੀ ਜੜਿਤ ਜੜਾਈ ।
0.e: The body was created through the blood(of mother) and semen (of father) and the five elements were joined judiciously.

0.e: His command is obeyed in all the six directions,

0.g: ਮੁਨੱਵਰ ਅਜ਼ੇ ਦਾਇਮਾ ਸਲਤਨਤ ।੩੧।
0.e: And, the entire kingdom is illuminated because of him. (31)

0.g: ਬ-ਹਰ ਦੋ ਜਹਾਂ ਕੌਸਿ ਸਾਹੀਇ ਊ ।
0.e: The beat of His kettle-drum resonates in both the worlds,

0.g: ਜ਼ਹੇ ਫ਼ਲਰਿ-ਗੀਹਾਂ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਈਇ ਊ ।੩੨।
0.e: And, His godliness is the glory of the world. (32)

0.g: ਬੁਲੰਦ ਅਖ਼ਤਰਸ਼ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਆਲਮ ਫ਼ਰੋਜ਼ ।
0.e: His elevated prominence illuminates both the worlds,

0.g: ਕਜ਼ੋ ਆਮਦਾ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨਾਨਸ਼ ਬਸੋਜ਼ ।੩੩।
0.e: And, it burns down the enemies. (33)

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਮਾਹੀ ਜ਼ਮੀਂ ਤਾ ਸਰਿ ਲਾ-ਮਕਾਂ ।
0.e: From the fish in the netherworld to the highest eternal limits,

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਫ਼ਿਦਵੀਇ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਾਕਿਸ਼ ਬਜਾਂ ।੩੪।
0.e: The whole world follows his sacred Naam with their heart and soul. (34)

0.g: ਮਲੂਕਿ ਮਲਿਕ ਤਾਅਤ ਅੰਦੇਸ਼ਿ ।
0.e: Kings and gods remember and worship Him in their meditation,

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਹਰ ਕੇਸ਼ ਫ਼ਰਖ਼ੰਦਾ-ਤਰ ਕੇਸ਼ਿ ਊ ।੩੫।
0.e: And, His belief and faith are much more fortunate and sublime than every other religion. (35)

0.g: ਚਿ ਕੈਸਰ ਚਿ ਖ਼ਾਕਾਂ ਹਜਾਰਾਂ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ।
0.e: How about millions of Kaisers, emperors of Germany and millions of Mongolian kings

0.g: ਚਿ ਕਿਸਰਾ ਚਿ ਕਾਊਸ ਬੇਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ ਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ।੩੬।
0.e: How about innumerable Nausheervaans and countless emperors of Iran (36)

0.g: ਚਿ ਫ਼ੈਰੋ ਚਿ ਫ਼ਗਫ਼ੂਰਿ ਵਾਲਾ-ਗਾਹ ।
0.e: Whether we talk abouit Egyptian kings or Chinese rulers of high rank,

0.g: ਬਪਾਇਸ਼ ਹਮਾ ਬੰਦਾ-ਇ ਖ਼ਾਕ-ਰਾਹ ।੩੭।
0.e: They all are the dust of his lotus feet (dust of the path on which he treads) (37)

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਫ਼ਿਦਵੀ ਓ ਬੰਦਾ-ਇ ਪਾਇ ਊ ।
0.e: All these people adore his feet and are his servitors and sleves,

0.g: ਪਜ਼ੀਰਿੰਦਾਇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਲਾਇ ਊ ।੩੮।
0.e: And, all of them are the followers of his divine commands. (38)

0.g: ਚਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਿ ਈਰਾਂ ਚਿ ਖ਼ਾਨਿ ਖ਼ੁਤਨ ।
0.e: Whether it be the Sultaan of Iran, or Khan of Khutan

0.g: ਚਿ ਦਾਰਾਇ ਤੂਰਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਯਮਨ ।੩੯।
0.e: Whether it be the Daaraa of Tooraan, or the king of Yemen (39)

0.g: ਚਿ ਕੁੰਤਾਲਿ ਰੂਸੋ ਚਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਿ ਹਿੰਦ ।
0.e: Whether it be the Tsar of Russia, or the ruler of India

0.g: ਚਿ ਹੁੱਕਾਮਿ ਦੱਕਨ ਚਿ ਰਾਇ ਖ਼ਜ਼ੰਦ ।੪੦।
0.e: Whether it be the officials of the South or those fortunate Raos (40)

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਮਸ਼ਰਿਕ ਬ-ਮਗ਼ਰਿਬ ਹਮਾ ਸਰਵਰਾਂ ।
0.e: All the chiefs and the kings from the east to the west

0.g: ਪਜ਼ੀਰਾਇ ਫ਼ਰਮਾਨਿ ਕੁਦਸਸ਼ ਬਜਾਂ ।੪੧।
0.e: Are obeying his sacred command even at the cost of their lives. (41)

0.g: ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਕਿਊਮਰਸੋ ਜਮਸ਼ੇਦੋ ਜ਼ਾਰ ।
0.e: Thousands of emperors of olden Iran and tzars of Russsia

0.g: ਕਮਰ ਬਸਤਾ ਦਰ ਖ਼ਿਦਮਤਸ਼ ਬੰਦਾ ਵਾਰ ।੪੨।
0.e: Are standing by, with their folded hands like slaves, ready to serve him. (42)

0.g: ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਚੂੰ ਰੁਸਤਮ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਚੂੰ ਸਾਮ ।
0.e: Thousands like Rustam and Saam, father of Rustam

0.g: ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਚੂੰ ਅਸਫ਼ੰਦ ਯਾਰਸ਼ ਗ਼ੁਲਾਮ ।੪੩।
0.e: And thousands of Asfand Yaars, the son of Gustapus who was blinded by Rustam with his arrow and then killed, are his slaves. (43)

0.g: ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਚੂੰ ਜਮਨਾ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਚੂੰ ਗੰਗ ।
0.e: Thousands of rivers like Jamnaa and Gangaa

0.g: ਬਪਾ ਅੰਦਰਸ਼ ਸਰ ਨਿਹਾਦਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਨੰਗ ।੪੪।
0.e: Bow their heads respectfully on his lotus feet. (44)

0.g: ਚਿਹ ਇੰਦਰ-ਆਦਿਕਾਨੋ ਚਿਹ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ-ਆਦਿਕਾਂ ।
0.e: Whether (we talk of) gods like Indar or Brahmaa

0.g: ਚਿਹ ਰਾਮ-ਆਦਿਕਾਨੋ ਚਿਹ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨ-ਆਦਕਾਂ ।੪੫।
0.e: Whether (we talk about) gods like Raam or Krishen (45)

0.g: ਜ਼ਬਾਨਿ ਹਮਾ ਕਾਸਿਰ ਅਜ਼ ਵਸਫ਼ਿ ਊ ।
0.e: All of them are unable and inadequate to describe his eclats,

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਖ਼ਾਸਤਗਾਰਿੰਦਾਇ ਲੁਤਫ਼ਿ ਊ ।੪੬।
0.e: And, All of them are the seekers of his blessings and bestowals. (46)

0.g: ਬ-ਹਰ ਦੀਪੋ ਹਰ ਸੂਇ ਕੌਸ਼ਸ਼ ਬੁਲੰਦ ।
0.e: His fame is being celebrated on the beat of a drum in all islands and directions,

0.g: ਬ-ਹਰ ਮਮਿਲਕਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਊ ਅਰਜ਼ਮੰਦ ।੪੭।
0.e: And, his name is being honored in every country and region. (47)

0.g: ਬ-ਹਰ ਖ਼ੰਦੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਿਮੰਡ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਦਾਸਤਾਂ ।
0.e: His tales are talked about and discussed in every universe and cosmic region,

0.g: ਪਜ਼ੀਰਾਇ ਹੁਕਮਸ਼ ਹਮਾਂ ਰਾਸਤਾਂ ।੪੮।
0.e: And, all the connoisseurs of truth delightfully accept and follow his command. (48)

0.g: ਸੁਰਾ ਤਾ ਸਮਾ ਜੁਮਲਾ ਫ਼ਰਮਾਂ-ਬਰਸ਼ ।
0.e: Everyone from the nethgerworld to the seventh sky are the followers of his orders,

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਮਹਿਤਾਬੋ ਮਾਹੀ ਹਮਾ ਚਾਕਰਸ਼ ।੪੯।
0.e: And, everyone from the moon to the fish deep below the earth are his servitors and slaves. (49)

0.g: ਕਰਮਹਾ ਵ ਅਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲਿ ਊ ਬੇ ਹਸਾ ।
0.e: His blessings and bestowals are infinite,

0.g: ਕਰਾਮਾਤੋ ਇਹਜਾਜ਼ਿ ਊ ਕਿਬਰੀਆ ।੫੦।
0.e: And, His miracles and antics are divine and celestial. (50)

0.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾਂ-ਹਾ ਬ-ਤੌਸੀਫ਼ਿ ਊ ਗੁੰਗੋ ਲਾਲ ।
0.e: All the tongues are dumbstruck in praising him,

0.g: ਸਖ਼ੁਨ ਰਾ ਬ-ਵਸਫ਼ਸ਼ ਚਿ ਹੱਦੋ ਮਜਾਲ ।੫੧।
0.e: Neither any one can describe his eclat to any limits nor has enough courage to do so. (51)

0.g: ਕਰੀਮੁਲ-ਸਜਾਇਆ ਜ਼ਮੀਲੁਲ ਖ਼ਸਾਲ ।
0.e: By nature, he is generous, and comeliness is in his character,

0.g: ਅਮੂਮੁਲ-ਅਤਾਇਆ ਸ਼ਮੂਮਲ ਨਵਾਲ ।੫੨।
0.e: He is known for his generosities, and is remembered for his unlimited gifts. (52)

0.g: ਸਫ਼ੀਉਲ-ਵਰਾਇਆ ਜ਼ਮਾਨੁਲ-ਵੁਰਾ ।
0.e: He is desirous of condoning the sins of the populace,

0.g: ਮਹੀਤੁਲ-ਸਖ਼ਾਇਆ ਜ਼ਕਾ-ਉਲ-ਹੁਦਾ ।੫੩।
0.e: and he is the guarantor of the entire creations. (53)

0.g: ਨਜਾਤੁਲ-ਅਵਾਮੋ ਅਮਾਨੁਲ-ਅਨਾਮ ।
0.e: He is the redeemer of the people and he is the deposit in trust for all of them;

0.g: ਜਲਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾ ਜ਼ੂ ਗ਼ਮਾਮਿ ਜ਼ਲਾਮ ।੫੪।
0.e: Even the darkest clouds become shining with his touch. (54)

0.g: ਵਫ਼ੂਰੁਲ ਅਤਾ ਓ ਅਮੀਮੁਲ ਨਅਮ ।
0.e: He is the treasure of bestowals and a great collection of blessings,

0.g: ਕਸੀਰੁਲ ਫ਼ਯੂਜ਼ੋ ਕਫ਼ੀਉਲ ਕਰਮ ।੫੫।
0.e: He is the abundance of beneficence and ultimate in generosity. (55)

0.g: ਫ਼ਰਾਜ਼ਿੰਦਾਇ ਰਾਇਤਿ ਅਦਲੋ ਦਾਦ ।
0.e: He unfurls and waves the flag of wisdom and justice,

0.g: ਫ਼ਰਾਜ਼ਿੰਦਾਇ ਦੀਦਾਇ ਇਅਤਕਾਦ ।੫੬।
0.e: He further glistens the eyes of trust. (56)

0.g: ਅਜ਼ੀਮੁਲ-ਮਨਾਜ਼ਿਲ ਰਫ਼ੀ-ਉਲ-ਮਕਾਂ ।
0.e: He is the one with lofty palaces and tall mansions,

0.g: ਕਰੀਮੁਲ-ਸ਼ਮਾਇਲ ਮਨੀਅ-ਉਲ-ਨਿਸ਼ਾਂ ।੫੭।
0.e: He is generous in his character and habits, and gentle and suave in his facial features. (57)

0.g: ਮੁਕੱਦਸ ਜਨਾਬੋ ਮੁਅੱਲਾ ਖ਼ਿਤਾਬ ।
0.e: Sacred is His court, and higher is His title,

0.g: ਗਦਾਇਸ਼ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਮਹਿ ਓ ਆਫਤਾਬ ।੫੮।
0.e: Thousands of moons and suns are begging at His door. (58)

0.g: ਮੁਆਲੀ ਮਦਾਰਿਜ ਅਵਾਲੀ ਪਨਾਹ ।
0.e: His ranks are higher and He is a great refuge,

0.g: ਅਲੀਮਿ ਰਮੁਜ਼ਿ ਸਫ਼ੇਦੋ ਸਿਆਹ ।੫੯।
0.e: He is the Knower of all the good and the bad secrets. (59)

0.g: ਮਕੱਦੁਸ ਮਦਾਰਿਜ ਫ਼ਖ਼ੀਮੁਲ ਨਵਾਲ ।
0.e: He sanctifies different regions and is the donor of benedictions,

0.g: ਤਆਲਾ ਮਰਾਤਬ ਅਮੀਮੁਲ-ਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਲ ।੬੦।
0.e: He elevates the status and is the embodiment of compassion. (60)

0.g: ਮੁਅੱਜ਼ਮ ਸ਼ਰਾਫ਼ਿ ਸਤੂਦਾ ਖ਼ਸਾਲ ।
0.e: He is great in His nobility and is most appreciated for His characteristics,

0.g: ਮੁਕੱਰਮ ਖ਼ਸਾਇਲ ਮੁਨੱਵਰ ਜਮਾਲ ।੬੧।
0.e: He is respected for His customs and habits, and is praiseworthy for His form and shape. (61)

0.g: ਜਮਾਲਿਸ਼ ਹਮਾ ਕੂਰਾ-ਇ ਜ਼ੁਲਜਲਾਲ ।
0.e: His elegance and radiance is the circumference of the Divine grandeur,

0.g: ਸ਼ਕੋਹਸ਼ ਹਮਾ ਅਜ਼ਮਤਿ ਲਾ-ਜ਼ਵਾਲ ।੬੨।
0.e: His glory and pomp is eternal and his eclat indestructible. (62)

0.g: ਜਮੀਮੁਲ ਸਫ਼ਾਤੋ ਜਜ਼ੀਲੁਲ ਸਨਾ ।
0.e: He is beautiful because of his noble qualities, and is perfect in his virtues,

0.g: ਕਫ਼ੀਲੁਲ ਜਰਾਇਮ ਵਕੀਲੁਲ ਵਰਾ ।੬੩।
0.e: He is condoner of the sins and is the supporter of and advocates the cause of the world. (63)

0.g: ਕਰੀਮੁਲ ਮਨਿਸ਼ ਮਾਲਕਿ ਫ਼ੈਜ਼ੋ ਜੂਦ ।
0.e: He is generous by nature and is the master of blessings and generosity,

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਕੁਦਸੀਆਂ ਪੇਸ਼ਿ ਊ ਦਰ ਸਜੂਦ ।੬੪।
0.e: All angels prostrate before him. (64)

0.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦਿ ਅਰਜ਼ੋ ਸਮਾਵਾਤੋ ਅਰਸ਼ ।
0.e: He is the All-powerful master of the earth, the skies and the cosmos,

0.g: ਮੁਨੱਵਰ-ਕੁਨਿ ਜ਼ੁਲਮਤ ਆਬਾਦ ਫ਼ਰਸ਼ ।੬੫।
0.e: He provides illumination in the darkest porches of the world. (65)

0.g: ਜ਼ੂਏ ਮਜਦੋ ਤਖ਼ਸੀਸੋ ਤਫ਼ਖ਼ੀਰ ਹਾ।
0.e: He is, in fact, is the light of maturity and courtesy,

0.g: ਖ਼ੁਦਾਵੰਦਿ ਤਮਜ਼ੀਦੋ ਤੌਕੀਰ ਹਾ ।੬੬।
0.e: He is the master of status and praises. (66)

0.g: ਵਲੀ-ਉਲ-ਤਫ਼ਾਜ਼ੀਲੋ ਤਕਰੀਮ ਹਾ ।
0.e: He is the prophet of virtues and blessings,

0.g: ਅਮੀਮੁਲ ਤਕਰੀਮੋ ਤਨਈਮ ਹਾ ।੬੭।
0.e: He is the embodiment of boons and bestowals. (67)

0.g: ਵਫ਼ੂਰੁਲ ਤਜ਼ਾਜ਼ੀਲੋ ਇਜਲਾਲ ਹਾ ।
0.e: He is the 'abundance' of generosities and wisdom,

0.g: ਕਸੀਰੁਲ ਤਕਾਮੀਲੋ ਇਕਮਾਲ ਹਾ ।੬੮।
0.e: He is the 'collection' of accomplished and perfect persons. (68)

0.g: ਅਮੀਮੁਲ ਅਤੀਆਤ ਕਾਮਿਲ ਅਯਾਰ ।
0.e: He is the manifestation and perfect jeweler of the offers and gifts.

0.g: ਪਜ਼ੀਰਿੰਦਾਇ ਇਜਜ਼ਿ ਹਰ ਖ਼ਾਕਸਾਰ ।੬੯।
0.e: He recognizes and accedes to the helplessness of the lowly and meek.(69)

0.g: ਮੁਫ਼ਖ਼ੱਰੁਲ ਨਬਾਇਲ ਜਜ਼ੀਲੁਲ ਜਮੀਲ ।
0.e: He is the pride of the elderly and kings and chief of the amiable and the suave.

0.g: ਕਸੀਰੁਲ ਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਇਲ ਜਲੀਲੁਲ ਨਬੀਲ ।੭੦।
0.e: He is the abundance of blessings and representative of the competent, dexterous and the intelligent. (70)

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਨੁਰਸ਼ ਜਹਾਂ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਾ ਜ਼ੇਬੋ ਫ਼ਰ ।
0.e: The world has gained beauty, splendor and glory from his radiance,

0.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਫ਼ੈਜ਼ਸ਼ ਮਕੀਨੋ ਮਕਾਂ ਬਹਿਰਾਵਰ ।੭੧।
0.e: The world and its people have profited a great deal from his blessings. (71)

0.g: ਬ-ਦਸਤਸ਼ ਫ਼ਰੋਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੋ ਗੌਹਰ ਚੂੰ ਮਿਹਰ ।
0.e: He has two diamonds in his hand that are brilliant like the Sun,

0.g: ਯਕੇ ਜਾਇ ਫ਼ਜਲੋ ਦਿਗਰ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਿਰ ।੭੨।
0.e: One of them represents beneficence and the other disaster and wrath. (72)

0.g: ਬ-ਅੱਵਲ ਜਹਾਂ ਰਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਹੱਕ ਨੁਮਾ ।
0.e: Due to the first (diamond), this world becomes a demonstration of truth,

0.g: ਬ-ਸਾਨੀ ਹਮਾ ਜ਼ੁਲਮੋ ਜ਼ੁਲਮਤ ਜ਼ਦਾ ।੭੩।
0.e: And, second is capable to dispel all darkness and tyranny. (73)

0.g: ਹਮਾ ਜ਼ੁਲਮਤੋ ਜ਼ੁਲਮ ਰਾ ਸਾਖ਼ਤ ਦੂਰ ।
0.e: He has dispelled all the darkness and cruelty from this world,

0.g: ਜਹਾਂ ਦਰ ਜਹਾਂ ਜ਼ੇ ਰਯਾਹੋ ਸਰੂਰ ।੭੪।
0.e: And, it is because of him that the whole world is filled with aroma and ecstacy. (74)

0.g: ਲਕਾਇਸ਼ ਮੁਨੱਵਰ ਜ਼ਿ ਨੂਰਿ ਅਜ਼ਲ ।
0.e: His face is lit with the Devine eclat,

0.g: ਵਜੂਦਸ਼ ਵ-ਅਨਵਾਰਿ ਹੱਕ ਲਮ ਯਜ਼ਲ ।੭੫।
0.e: And his body is eternal due to the refulgence of Akaalpurakh. (75)

0.g: ਚਿਹ ਆਅਲਾ ਚਿਹ ਅਦਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਰ ਦਰਸ਼ ।
0.e: Whether big or small, high or low, all, on his doorsteps,

0.g: ਸਰ ਅਫ਼ਗੰਦਾ ਵ ਬੰਦਾ ਓ ਚਾਕਰਸ਼ ।੭੬।
0.e: Are standing as slaves and servitors with their heads bowed. (76)

0.g: ਚਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਂ ਚਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਬਹਿਰਾਮੰਦ ।
0.e: Whether kings or whether beggars, all profit from his kindness,

0.g: ਚਿ ਉਲਵੀ ਚਿ ਸਿਫ਼ਲੀ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਸਰਬੁਲੰਦ ।੭੭।
0.e: Whether heavenly or whether earthly people, all become respectable because of him. (77)

0.g: ਚਿਹ ਪੀਰੋ ਚਿਹ ਬਰਨਾ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਕਾਮਯਾਬ ।
0.e: Whether older folks or the youngsters, all have their wishes fulfilled from him,

0.g: ਚਿਹ ਦਾਨਾ ਚਿਹ ਨਾਦਾਂ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਪੁਰ ਸਵਾਬ ।੭੮।
0.e: Whether the wise or the naive, all are able to do good, virtuous and charitable deeds because of him. (78)

0.e: He is more reverential than anyone could describe. (172)

0.e: All the worlds are saturated with the graciousness of his personality, and

0.e: His feats cannot be confined within any limits. (173)

0.g: ਚੂ ਤੌਸੀਫ਼ਸ਼ ਆਮਦ ਫ਼ਜ਼ੂੰ ਅਜ਼ ਹਿਸਾਬ ।
0.e: When his praises and glory are beyond any accountability,

0.e: How could, then, they be confined to the screens (pages) of any book. (174)

0.e: With Waaheguru's grace, I pray that the head of Nand Lal be sacrificed for his naam, and that

0.g: ਅਜ਼ੋ ਬਾਦ ਜਾਨੋ ਦਿਲਸ਼ ਰਾ ਨਵਾ ।੧੭੫।
0.e: With Akaalpurakh's kindness, the soul and heart of Nand Lal be offered before Him. (175)

0.e: The catechu is of brown colour and light and a pinch of it is used.

0.e: The lime is white and is burnt and thrashed.

0.e: When losing their ego (they meet) they uniformally become of red colour.

0.e: Likewise are the saints, who adopting the qualifies of the four varnas, live in mutual love like gmmukhs, the Guru oriented.

0.g: ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ; ਤਾਰਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as dream events cannot be seen while awake, just as stars are not visible after sunrise;

0.g: ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘ ਚਪਲ ਬਲ; ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਥਿਰ ਨ ਰਹਾਈਐ ।
0.e: Just as the shadow of a tree keeps changing in size with the falling rays of the sun; and the pilgrimage to the holy places does not last for ever.

0.e: With the meeting of Guru and Sikh, and engrossment of the latter in the divine word, he is able to counter the deceit of five vices-kam, krodh, lobh, moh and ahankar. The five virtues of Truth, Contentment, Compassion, Devotion and Patience become paramou

0.g: ਭਾਗੈ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭੇਦ ਕਾਲ ਅਉ ਕਰਮ ਖੇਦ; ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਉਦੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: All his doubts, fear and discriminatory feelings are destroyed. He is not hunted by the worldly discomforts those accrue from worldly activities.

0.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰਿ; ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਨਝੁਨ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: With his conscious awareness firmly lodged in the mystical tenth opening, the worldly attractions and Lord appears alike to him. He sees the image of the Lord in every creature of the world. And in such a state, he remains engrossed in the celestial music

0.g: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ; ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।੨੯।
0.e: In such a high spiritual state, he enjoys heavenly bliss and the divine light shines in him. He is ever relishing the divine elixir of Naam. (29)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮
ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ; ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ।
0.e: Gurmukhs moving in the holy congregation and having controlled the seven seas remain detached in this world ocean.

0.g: ਸਤੇ ਦੀਪ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦ ਉਜਾਲਾ ।
0.e: All the seven continents are in darkness; gurmukh enlightener them by lamp of Word.

0.g: ਸਤੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸੋਧੀਆ; ਸਹਜ ਪੁਰੀ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ।
0.e: The gurmukh has reformed all the seven purls (abodes of gods), and has found that only the state of equipoise is the real abode of truth.

0.g: ਸਤੇ ਰੋਹਣਿ ਸਤ ਵਾਰ; ਸਾਧੇ ਫੜਿ ਫੜਿ ਮਥੇ ਵਾਲਾ ।
0.e: All the major nakstrs such as Sva-ti etc, and the seven days, he has controlled by holding them from their heads i.e. he has gone beyond their deceptions.

0.e: Twenty-one cities and their ostentations he has crossed and he lives happily (in his self).

0.g: ਸਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਤੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਲਾ ।
0.e: He has known the comprehensiveness of the seven melodies (of music) and he has crossed the seven streams of the mountains.

0.e: This could be possible because he has sustained and accomplished the Word of the Guru in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ; ਸਫਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਅਲੋਈਐ ।
0.e: Human life is successful if spent in the refuge of the True Guru remembering the Supreme Being. Vision of the eyes is purposeful if it has the desire to see Him.

0.e: Their hearing power is fruitful who hear that creative sound of the True Guru all the time. That tongue is blessed if it keeps on uttering the virtues of the Lord.

0.e: For the Sikhs of the Guru, focusing of mind on True Guru is like seeing the Transcendental Lord who is beyond time. There belief of enjoying the magnificence sight of the True Guru is like performing worship with flowers and fruits.

0.e: A true servant of Guru realises the supreme state of the Absolute Lord through perpetual meditation and engrossment of his mind in the divine word.

0.e: Millions of virtuous knowledge and millions of fortunes are sacrifice unto the knowledge and fortune of that woman;

0.e: Who is looked at with even a small look of grace by the Lord for her living a life commensurate with her feminine religion and duties.  (650)

0.e: When will I hear the sweet ambrosial-like and elixir-giving words of my True Guru with my own ears? When will I be able to make a humble supplication of my distress with my own tongue before him?

0.g: ਕਬ ਕਰ ਕਰਉ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਬੰਦਨਾ; ਪਗਨ ਪਰਿਕ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਨ ਰੇਖਉ ।

0.e: True Guru who is the manifest of the Lord, provided of knowledge, contemplation, granter of salvation and sustainer of life when will I be able to realise Him clearly through my loving worship? (Bhai Gurdas Ii is expressing his pangs of separation from hi

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ; ਅਲਖੁ ਅਭੇਉ ਹੈ ।

0.e: Guru (Nanak) and disciple (Angad) both are blest (because both have merged into each other).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ; ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮੇਉ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Their abode is the wisdom of Guru and they both are rapt in the praises of the Lord.

0.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ; ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Enlightened with the Word their consciousness has become infinite and immutable.

0.e: Transcending all hopes they have assimilated subtle wisdom in their person.

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ; ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮੇਉ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Conquering the lust and anger they have absorbed themselves in the praises (of God).

0.e: Beyond the abodes of Siva and Sakti they have reached the abode of truth, contentment and bliss.

0.e: Being indifferent to household (pleasures) they are truth-oriented.

0.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਭਿਆਸ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ।੨।
0.e: The Guru and disciple have now attain the ratio of twenty and twenty One, i.e.the disciple has gone ahead of the Guru.

0.g: ਪੰਜਾਂ ਤਖ਼ਤਾਂ, ਸਰਬੱਤ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰ ਕੇ ਬੋਲੋ ਜੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ।
0.e: Thinking of the five thrones (seats of religious authority) and all gurdwaras, say, "Waheguru", O Khalsa.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩
ਸਾਵਣ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ; ਵੁਠੇ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾ ।
0.e: In the month of Sayan forests go green but akk, a wild plant of sandy region, and /avail, the camel thorn, wither.

0.e: In the month of Chaitr, the vegetation blooms but leafless kart (a wild caper) remains totally uninspired.

0.g: ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੰਦੇ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਭ; ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਫਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਿਸਾਹਾ ।
0.e: All the trees become full of fruits but the silk cotton tree remains devoid of fruit.

0.g: ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਵਾਂਸ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ਨ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹਾ ।

ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮੁ, ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: For earning livelihood, the Gurmukhs keep in mind, the dharma and always remember the truth.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ, ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: They know that the creator himself has created (and diffused) the truth.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ, ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: That true Guru, the supreme one, compassionately has descended on earth.

0.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ, ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Personifying the formless into the form of Word He has recited it for one and all.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡ, ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Guru has founded the high mound of the holy congregation known also as the abode of truth.

0.g: ਸਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਬਣਾਇ, ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।੯।
0.e: There only establishing the true throne he has made all to bow and salute.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਹਉ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ; ਹਉ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਮੰਦਾ ।
0.e: I am a criminal, a sinner, evil and apostate.

0.g: ਚੋਰੁ ਯਾਰੁ ਜੂਆਰਿ ਹਉ; ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜੋਹੰਦਾ ।
0.e: I am a thief, adulterer; gambler who always keeps his eye upon other's household.

0.g: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ; ਠਗੁ ਦੇਸ ਠਗੰਦਾ ।
0.e: I am a slanderer, knave, venal and a swindler who goes on cheating the whole world.

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
0.e: I feel proud of my sexual urges, anger, greed, infatuations and other intoxications.

0.g: ਬਿਸਵਾਸਘਾਤੀ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ; ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਰਖੰਦਾ ।
0.e: I am treacherous and ungrateful; none likes to keep me with him. Remember,

0.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਢਾਢੀਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਖਸੰਦਾ ।੨੧।੩੬। ਛੱਤੀ ।
0.e: 0 singing disciple! that the true Guru, alone is competent to grant pardon (for your sins).

0.g: ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਕੋ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਲੋਗੁ; ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: The union with friends, family members and other acquaintances in this world is like voyagers in a boat that lasts for a short period of time. Therefore whatever is donated for good deeds in. this world will be received in the world beyond.

0.g: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਸੰਗ ਨ ਚਲਤ ਚਲੇ; ਅਰਪੇ ਦੀਜੈ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ਪਹੁਚਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Food, clothing and wealth does not go with one in the next world. Whatever has been assigned to the Guru in the true company is what one's wealth or earnings are for life beyond.

0.g: ਆਠੋ ਜਾਮ ਸਾਠੋ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ; ਸਫਲ ਪਲਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Spending all the time in the love of maya and its actions are futile but enjoying the company of saintly persons even for a few seconds is a big achievement and useful.

0.g: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਤ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ।੩੩੪।
0.e: By uniting the words/teachings of the Guru with mind, and by the grace of holy company, this filth-filled and vice-ridden human being becomes an obedient disciple of the Guru. (334)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: I love him deeply who cultivates humility through Gurmat, the wisdom of Guru.

0.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ; ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ।
0.e: I love him deeply who does not go near another’s wife.

0.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ; ਪਰ ਦਰਬੈ ਨੋ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: I love him deeply who touches not the other’s wealth.

0.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ; ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਹਟਾਵੈ ।
0.e: I love him deeply who becoming indifferent to the backbiting of others detatches himself.

0.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ।
0.e: I love him deeply who listening to the teaching of the true Guru practices it in actual life.

0.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ; ਥੋੜਾ ਸਵੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਹੀ ਖਾਵੈ ।
0.e: I love him deeply who sleeps little and eats little.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ।੪।
0.e: Such a gurmukh absorbs himself in the equipoise.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਸਹਸ ਬਾਹੁ ਜਮਦਗਨਿ ਘਰਿ; ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਚਾਰੀ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: A king named Sahasrbahu came to Jamadagni rishi as a guest.

0.g: ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ ਲੋਭਾਇ ਕੈ; ਜਮਦਗਨੈ ਦਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਵਢਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Seeing wish-ful-filling cow with the rishi he became greedy and killed Jamdagni.

0.g: ਪਿਟਦੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ; ਪਰਸਰਾਮ ਧਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Hearing the wails of Renuka, his mother, Parana Ram came running to her.

0.g: ਇਕੀਹ ਵਾਰ ਕਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ; ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਖਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Becoming full of anger he cleared this earth of the kshatriyas twenty-one time i.e. he killed all the kashatriyas.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਫੜਿ ਉਬਰੇ; ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਉਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Only those who fell at the feet of Parasu Rim were saved; none else could raise arms against him.

0.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਆ; ਚਿਰੰਜੀਵ ਹੁਇ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He also could not obliterate his ego and though he became chiraiijiv i.e. ever living person,

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ, ਮਕਰੰਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।੭।
0.e: He always made show of his ego and could never receive the pollen of the lotus feet (of Lord).

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰ ਤਾਕਉ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਤ ਨਾਤ; ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਲੋਗਚਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as living in her house, bathing, eating and sleeping etc. and discharging her worldly duties according to the social customs and traditions are all sacred for a faithful and loyal wife.

0.g: ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਸੁਤ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਖਾ; ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: It is her natural duty to embellish herself with ornaments for the happiness of her husband beside serving and respecting parents, brothers, sisters, sons, other elders in the family, friends and other social contacts.

0.g: ਕਿਰਤ ਬਿਰਤ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ; ਸਕਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਈ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਅਚਾਰ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Attending to the household chores, bearing children, bringing them up, keeping them clean and neat is all sacred for a faithful and loyal wife.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮੈ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ।੪੮੩।
0.e: Similarly, the disciples of the Guru are never blemished while leading a householder's life. Like loyal and faithful wife, they consider indulgence of worship of any other god over the True Guru as a condemnable act in the world.  (483)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The order of the Lord is true, His writ is true and from the true cause He has created the creation as His sport.

0.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਵਿਰਲੈ ਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: All the causes are under the control of the creator but He accepts the deeds of any rare devotee.

0.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਈ; ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The devotee who has loved the will of the Lord, does not beg anything from any one else.

0.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Now the Lord also loves to accept the prayer of the devotee because protection of the devotee is His nature.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਵ; ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The devotees who keep their consciousness absorbed in the Word in the holy congregation, know well that the creator Lord is the perennial cause of all causes.

0.g: ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਤੀਤ ਜਗਿ; ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਦਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The devotee like the innocent child remains detached from the world and keeps himself free from delusions of boons and curses.

0.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ, ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।੧੦।
0.e: He receives the fruit in accordance with his desert.'

0.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ; ਕਚਾ ਪਕਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Why madder is the fast colour and safflower temporary.

0.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਖਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ; ਮੂਲ ਮਜੀਠ ਜੜੀ ਜੜਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: The roots of madder spread in earth, it is first brought out and put into the pit and is pounded with wooden pestles.

0.g: ਉਖਲ ਮੁਹਲੇ ਕੁਟੀਐ; ਪੀਹਣਿ ਪੀਸੈ ਚਕੀ ਭਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Then it is crushed into a heavy mill.

0.g: ਸਹੈ ਅਵੱਟਣੁ ਅੱਗਿ ਦਾ; ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: It further suffers the pain of getting boiled and decorated in water and then only it adorns (with fast colour) the clothes of the beloved.

0.g: ਪੋਹਲੀਅਹੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਕੈ; ਫੁਲੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਚਲੁੰਭ ਖਿਲਾਰੇ ।
0.e: The safflower comes up from the upper portion of the thorny weed Carthamus tinctoria and yields its deep colour.

0.g: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਦੇ ਰੰਗੀਐ; ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਹ ਚਾਰੇ ।
0.e: Adding tart in it, the clothes are dyed and they remain dyed only for a few days.

0.g: ਨੀਵਾ ਜਿਣੈ, ਉਚੇਰਾ ਹਾਰੇ ।੬।
0.e: The lowly born utimately wins and the so-called high up gets defeated.

0.g: ਹੱਯਦਾ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਬ-ਸੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।
0.e: O Guru! Your beautiful smile bestows and instills life to the world,

0.g: ਹਰਦਮ ਤਵਾਫ਼ਿ ਕਾਅਬਾ ਕੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੧।
0.e: And, this gives tranquility and stability to the mystical eyes of the saints and Pirs.” (36) (2)

0.g: ਹਰ ਜਾ ਕਿ ਬਿਨਿਗਰੇਦ ਜਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਬਿਨਿਗਰੇਦ ।
0.e: There is no ever-lasting love or devotion other than the love of Waaheguru,

0.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਿਲਾਣ ਨਜ਼ਾਰਾਇ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੨।
0.e: And, one should deem everyone other than the devotees of Waaheguru as destructible. (36) (3)

0.g: ਜਾਣ ਰਾ ਨਿਸਾਰਿ ਕਾਮਤਿ ਰਾਅਨਾਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: In whichever direction you look, you bestow and instil new life and spirit,

0.g: ਦਿਲ-ਹਾਇ ਮੁਰਦਾ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੩।
0.e: It is your vision only that blesses showers of new life everywhere. (36) (4)

0.g: ਆਈਨਾਇ ਖ਼ੁਦਾਇ-ਨੁਮਾ ਹਸਤ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ।
0.e: Akaalpurakh is omnipresent at every place under all circumstances and with everyone all the times,

0.g: ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਹੱਕ ਜ਼ਿ-ਆਈਨਾਇ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੪।
0.e: However, where is such an eye that is capable of visualizing His presence in every nook and corner? (36) (5)

0.g: ਤੀਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਣ ਕਿ ਚਸ਼ਮ ਨਦਾਰੰਦ ਮੁਤਲਿਕ ਅੰਦ ।
0.e: No one other than those dedicated to the love of God has ever been redeemed.

0.g: ਖ਼ੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਰਾ ਮੁਕਾਬਲਿ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੫।
0.e: The 'death' has captured both the 'earth' and the 'time' with its sharp beak. (36) (6)

0.g: ਮਸਤਾਨਿ ਸ਼ੌਕ ਗ਼ੁਲਗ਼ਲਾ ਦਾਰੰਦ ਦਰ ਜਹਾਣ ।
0.e:
Goyaa says, "A devotee of Akaalpurakh becomes immortal,
Because, without his meditation, no one else will ever leave a sign behind in this world." (36) (7)

0.g: ਸਦ ਜਾਣ ਫ਼ਿਦਾਇ ਯੱਕ ਸਰ ਮੋਈ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੬।
0.e: I became old from young in the lap of the 'age',

0.g: ਦਰ ਪਰਦਾਇ ਜਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਰੋਸ਼ਨ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਜਹਾਣ ।
0.e: How beautiful was my life that I spent in Your company! I owe the happiness of this journey to your grace!” (37) (1)

0.g: ਦਰ ਹਰ ਤਰਫ਼ ਕਿ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਜ਼ਰਦੀ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀ ਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੭।
0.e: Consider the remaining breaths of your life as blessed,

0.g: ਆਸ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਗਾਨਿ ਸ਼ੌਕਿ ਤੂ ਗੋਯਾ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਮਦਾਮ ।
0.e: Because, it will be the autumn (old age) that will bring the spring (season of youth) of your life one day. (37) (2)

0.g: ਆਵਾਜ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼-ਕਲਾਮ ਜ਼ਿ ਬੂਇ ਤੂ ਮੀਕੁਨੰਦ ।੨੨।੮।
0.e: Yes, consider that moment as blessed that is spent in remembering God,

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਗਾਂਈ ਵੰਸ ਘਾਤ; ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਰੇ ।
0.e: (It is said that) The killing of brahmin, cow and the man of one's own family is a deadly sin.

0.g: ਮਦੁ ਪੀ ਜੂਏ ਖੇਲਦੇ; ਜੋਹਨਿ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੇ ।
0.e: The drunkards gamble and look at the wives of others.

0.g: ਮੁਹਨਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਲਖਿਮੀ; ਠਗ ਚੋਰ ਚਗਾਰੇ ।
0.e: The thieves and decoits loot other's wealth.

0.g: ਵਿਸਾਸ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੀ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ; ਪਾਪੀ ਹਤਿਆਰੇ ।
0.e: These all are treacherous, ungrateful, sinners and killers.

0.g: ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਜੋੜੀਅਨਿ; ਅਣਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ ।
0.e: If such persons are gathered in infinite number;

0.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਲੂਇ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੇ ।੧੬।
0.e: Even they all are not equal to the single hair of the apostate.

0.g: ਦਿਲ ਅਗ਼ਰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬਵਦ ਅੰਦਰ ਕਿਨਾਰਸ਼ ਯਾਰ ਹਸਤ ।
0.e: Anyone who has understood his own self is no longer stranger to the Akaalpurakh. (10) (2)

0.g: ਚਸ਼ਮ ਗਰ ਬੀਨਾ ਬਵਦ ਦਰ ਹਰ ਤਰਫ਼ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਹਸਤ ।੬।੧।
0.e: Anyone who has a longing to meet the Creator is the master of his own self.

0.e: O my True Guru, You grant me redemption.

0.e: The Sewak, the devoted adherent, who meditates on the Naam (of the Creator) is sanctified.

0.e: With deliberation, penance and austerity, the devotee achieves godliness,

0.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਫੁਨ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਚੁਕਾਏ ।
0.e: And abandons sensuality, wrath, greed arrogance and infatuation.

0.g: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੇਧ ਕਰਿ; ਪਵਣਾ ਠਹਿਰਾਏ ।
0.e: He reforms with capable strategy, and domineers the mind wavering wind,

0.g: ਤਬ ਖਟ ਚਕਰਾ ਸਹਿਜੇ ਘੁਰੇ; ਗਗਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਛਾਏ ।
0.e: Six spheres (of bodily self-control) overpowered, he eventually, overwhelms the divine heights.

0.e: Then he proceeds, with honour, towards the heavenly abode with a virtuous appearance.

0.g: ਤਬ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉਂ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਏ ।
0.e: One who narrates the glory of (Guru) Nanak, is the bravest of all.

0.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਰਦਾਨ ਮਰਦ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ।
0.e: And the one who recounts this Epic of Bhagauti, attains the Eternal status.

0.g: ਯਹ ਵਾਰ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੋ ਪੜ੍ਹੈ; ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: Neither he faces the distress nor repentance; rather he prevails in bliss.

0.g: ਤਿਹ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਲਗੈ; ਆਨੰਦ ਵਰਤਾਏ ।
0.e: Whatever he desires, he achieves and, through his heart, invokes the invisible.

0.e: For that, he, day and night, recounts this Epic from his mouth,

0.e: To earn freedom from the urge for material things, attains salvation and flies to rapturous heights.

0.g: ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦ; ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਗਗਨ ਸਮਾਏ ।
0.e: There remains no challenge of Yamas,

0.e: and Righteousness eliminates all the transgressions.

0.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਡੰਡ ਦੁਖ; ਨਹਿਂ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: No punishment of the Yamas remains effective, and the adversities become not troublesome.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ।੨੦।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਰਖ ਪਨਾਰੇ ਬਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਲੁ; ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਉਮਗਿ ਬਹੈ ਬੀਥੀ ਬੀਥੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Every drop of rain joins the other and together they flow from the roof-tops into the streets and then in the storm water drains; And overflowing its banks, the water flows through many rivulets and join the main stream or rivers;

0.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨੋਰਾ ਨੋਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਚਲਤ ਚਤਰ ਕੁੰਟ; ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ।
0.e: And all the water of the rivers flow to achieve union with sea and once it falls in it, become one with it. It loses its individuality. The truth is, whatever are the traits of a person, he is praised and recognised accordingly (Some may behave mean, frol

0.e: Just as a diamond held in hand seems very small but when evaluated and sold, fills the coffers. Just as a cheque/draft carried on person has no weight but when cashed at the other end yields much money

0.e: Just as seed of a banyan tree is very small but when sown grows into big tree and spreads all over. Similar is the significance of the lodging of true Guru's teachings in the hearts of obedient Sikhs of the Guru. This is reckoned only on reaching the divi

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਲੇ ਜਾਤ ਸੁਖ; ਗਹੇ ਕਰ ਦੁਚਿਤੁ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਭਟਕਾ ਸੇ ਭੇਟ ਹੈ ।

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਅਗੈ ਆਰਸੀ; ਨਾਈ ਧਰਿ ਨ ਵਧਾਈ ਪਾਵੈ ।
0.e: A barber showing mirror to a blind person never gets the reward.

0.e: If the dumb is consulted on any issue, the issue will go worse and he will not be able to answer.

0.g: ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀ ਵੜਿ ਗੁਣਗੁਣਾ; ਮਾਲੀ ਨੋ ਨ ਇਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ।
0.e: If a person devoid of the sense of smell goes to a garden, he cannot recommend the gardener for award.

0.g: ਲੂਲੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਆਹੀਐ; ਕਿਵ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: How could a woman married to a cripple embrace him.

0.e: Since the inexperienced physician does not know the problem of the patient as well as the medicine for the same.

0.e: If a mature physician is found, he prescribes the right medicine, which removes the malady.

0.e: Now, if the patient does not follow the prescribed discipline and goes on to eat everything sweet and sour, the physician is not to be blamed.

0.e: For want of temperance the malady of the patient goes on increasing day and night.

0.e: If a cheat even comes to the holy congregation and sits there.

0.e: He being controlled by wickedness gets perished in his duality.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੀ ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ; ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਚਮਕਨ ਤਾਰੇ ।
0.e: In the dark night myriad stars shine.

0.e: The householders shut the doors of their homes and shops before they go to sleep.

0.e: The sun with its light dispels the darkness of night.

0.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ।

0.e: Such beneficent persons are dear to the Guru.

ਲੋਹੇ ਤਛਿ ਤਛਾਇ, ਲੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: With the help of iron the tree is cut and pruned and iron nails are stuck into it.

0.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਚੜਾਇ, ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।

0.g: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਾਲਿ, ਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The water also considering it its adopted son does not make it sink.

0.g: ਅਗਰੈ ਡੋਬੈ ਜਾਣਿ, ਡੋਬਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: But the sandalwood is sunk intentionally to make it costlier.

0.g: ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਇ, ਜਗੁ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ।
0.e: The quality of goodness produces goodness and the whole world also remains happy.

0.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਹਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੈ, ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto him who does good in return of evil.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ, ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Having the sight of the true Guru, the Sikh of the Guru concentrates upon Him.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ, ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Pondering upon the word of true Guru he cultivates knowledge.

0.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ, ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He keeps to his heart the mantra and the lotus feet of Guru.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇ, ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He serves the true Guru and consequently makes the whole world serve him.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਚਾਇ, ਜਗ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Guru loves disciple and disciple makes the whole world happy.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਛਾਇਆ ।੧੪।
0.e: This way, that disciple creates a religion of the Gurmukhs and situates in his own self.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬

0.e: Adopting the discipline in the holy congregation, the unbearable cup of love is drunk and endured.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਣਾ ।
0.e: Then the individual falling at the feet and eschewing ego dies in relation to all the worldly concerns.

0.e: Liberated in life is he who dies of maya and lives up in the love of God.

0.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਤੈ ਅਉਚਰ ਚਰਣਾ ।
0.e: Merging his consciousness in Word and quaffing the nectar he eats up his ego.

0.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣਾ ।
0.e: Inspired by the unstruck melody he always goes on pouring the word-nectar.

0.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ; ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ।
0.e: Now he is already cause of all the causes but still does nothing harmful to others.

0.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ, ਅਸਰਣ ਸਰਣਾ ।੧੬।
0.e: Such a person salvages the sinners and provides shelter to the shelterless.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਘਰਿ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ ਦੈਤ ਦੇ; ਕਲਰਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ।
0.e: Prahlad, the saint, was born in the house of demon (king) Haranakhas like a lotus is born in the alkaline (barren) land.

0.g: ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਚਾਟਸਾਲ; ਪਾਂਧੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੋਆ ਅਹਿਲਾਦੁ ।
0.e: When he was sent to seminary, the brahmin purohit became elated (because the king’s son was now his disciple).

0.g: ਸਿਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਨਾਦੁ ।
0.e: Prahlad would remember the name of Ram in his heart and outwardly also he would eulogise the Lord.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਭ ਚਾਟੜੈ; ਪਾਂਧੇ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ।
0.e: Now all the disciples became devotees of Lord, which was an awful and embarrassing situation for all the teachers.

0.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਰੂਆਇਆ; ਦੋਖੀ ਦੈਤਿ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਵਾਦੁ ।
0.e: The priest (teacher) reported or complained to the king (that O king your son has become devotee of God).

0.g: ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਤਿਆ; ਜਲੈ ਨ ਡੁਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ।
0.e: The malevolent demon picked up the quarrel. Prahlad was thrown into fire and water but with the grace of Guru (the Lord) neither he was burnt nor drowned.

0.g: ਕਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛਿਆ; ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ।
0.e: Angered as he was, Hiranyaksyapu took out his double-edged sword and asked Prahlad who his Guru (Lord) was.

0.g: ਥੰਮ੍ਹੁ ਪਾੜਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ; ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਨਾਦਿ ।
0.e: At the same moment Lord God in the form of man-lion came out of pillar. His form was grand and majestic.

0.g: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ; ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ।
0.e: That wicked demon was thrown down and killed and thus it was proved that the Lord is kind to devotees since the time immemorial.

0.g: ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਕਰਨਿ, ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ।੨।
0.e: Seeing this Brahma and other gods started eulogising the Lord.

0.g: ਧਰੀ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਕਉਸਿ ਦੀ; ਮਕੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Wooden sandal (of Baba Nanak ) was kept as a memory and he was woshipped in Mecca.

0.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਜਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਬਾਬੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: Go anywhere in the world, you would not find a place bereft of the name of Baba Nanak.

0.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ; ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਗੁਆਈ ।
0.e: Without discrimination of Hindu or Muslim, in every house, the Baba is revered.

0.g: ਛਪੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਆ; ਚੜਿਆ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਸਨਾਈ ।
0.e: When the sun rises it cannot be covered and it lightens the whole world.

0.g: ਬੁਕਿਆ ਸਿੰਘ ਉਜਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਭਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲਿ ਭੰਨੀ ਜਾਈ ।
0.e: When the lion roared in the jungle the flocks of deer ran away.

0.g: ਚੜਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਲੁਕਈ; ਕਢਿ ਕੁਨਾਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਛਪਾਈ ।
0.e: If someone wants to conceal moon by putting before it a platter, it cannot be hide.

0.g: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੇ ਆਥਵਨੋ; ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਸਭ ਝੁਕਾਈ ।
0.e: From rising to setting directions i.e from east to west, all the nine divisions of earth bowed before Baba Nanak.

0.g: ਜਗਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ, ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਰਤਾਈ ।੩੪।
0.e: He diffused his power in whole of the world.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਤ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸੁਤ ਗੋਦ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Just as a mother has many sons but one in her lap is the dearest to her;

0.g: ਸਿਆਨੇ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ; ਗੋਦ ਮੈ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨ ਸਹੋਦ ਕੋ ।
0.e: The elder sons remain engrossed in their commercial activities but one in lap is ignorant of all allurements of wealth, commodities and love of brothers and sisters;

0.g: ਪਲਨਾ ਸੁਵਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਇ; ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਤ ਰੁਦਨ ਪੈ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਮਨ ਮੋਦ ਕੋ ।
0.e: Leaving the innocent baby in a cradle, the mother keeps attending other domestic chores but listening to the baby's cry, she comes running and feeds the child.

0.g: ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਜੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ; ਰਹੇ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋ ।੩੯੨।
0.e: Like the innocent child, he who loses his self and takes the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru, is blessed with the consecration of Naam-Simran-Mantar that saves him from the worldly vices; and relishing the bliss of Naam Simran he achieves salvati

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਨੋ; ਸਾਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Perfect Guru, embodiment of complete Lord becoming kind lodges true sermon in the heart of a disciple of the Guru. That makes him stable of intelligence and saves him from wanderings.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਭਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਮਈ ਪੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Engrossed in the word, his condition becomes like that of a fish enjoying the bliss of his surroundings. He then realises the presence of God in everyone just as fat, that is present in all milks.

0.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ; ਸਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: God, the true Master resides in the heart of a Sikh who is ever engrossed in the word of the Guru. He sees the presence of the Lord everywhere. He hears Him with his ears, enjoys the sweet smell of His presence with his nostrils, and relishes the name of

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰੁਮੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫੂਲ ਫਲ; ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ।੨੭੬।
0.e: True Guru who is eternal of form has dispensed this knowledge that just as the seed resides in the trees, plants, branches, flowers etc, one God who is perfect and all-knowing pervades in all. (276)

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੀ ।
0.e: One becomes true disciple only by getting the divine word of Guru absorbed in the mind and becoming a humble slave of the Guru. For virtually a possessor of the child-like wisdom, he is free of deceit and infatuations.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਮ ਤੁਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ; ਲੋਚਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਉ ਲੋਹ ਕੀ ।
0.e: Since his consciousness is engrossed in the name of the Lord; he is least affected by praise or rejection.

0.g: ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਬਿਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨ ਬੋਹ ਕੀ ।
0.e: Fragrance and foul smell, poison or elixir are the same for him, because his (devotee's) conscious is absorbed in Him.

0.g: ਕਰ ਚਰ ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਅਪਥ ਪਥ; ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਸਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੀ ।੧੦੭।
0.e: He remains stable and uniform even if he uses his hands in good or indifferent deeds; or treads path not worthy of appreciation. Such a devotee never harbours any feeling of deceit, falsehood or ill deeds. (107)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ, ਨ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਤੋਲੀਐ ।
0.e: Gurmukh is perfect; he cannot be weighed on any scale.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲੁ, ਨ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ ।
0.e: Every word by gurmukh comes to be true and perfect and nothing can be said about him.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲ, ਨ ਡੋਲਣਿ ਡੋਲੀਐ ।
0.e: The wisdom of gurmukhs is stable one and does not get destabilised even if done so.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ, ਨ ਮੋਲਣਿ ਮੋਲੀਐ ।
0.e: The love of gurmukhs is invaluable and it cannot be purchased at any cost.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ, ਨ ਰੋਲਣਿ ਰੋਲੀਐ ।
0.e: The way of gurmukh is clear and distinct; it cannot be subsumed and dissipated by any one.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲੋਲੁ, ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਝੋਲੀਐ ।੨੦।
0.e: The words of gurmukhs are steadfast; along with them one quaffs nectar by deleting passions and carnal desires.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩੦
ਜਿਉ ਲਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਦੇ; ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੇ ।
0.e: Despite millions of stars shine in the sky in the darkness of night yet things are not visible even if they are kept near by.

0.g: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਬਦਲ ਛਾਇਆ; ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਿਹਸੈ ਫੇਰੇ ।
0.e: On the other hand even coming of the sun under the clouds, their shadow cann't change day into night.

0.g: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੇਰੇ ।
0.e: Even if the Guru enacts any sham, the doubts are not created in the mind of the Sikhs.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਝੁ ਹੈ; ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਹੇਰੇ ।
0.e: In all the six seasons, the same sun remains in the sky but the owl cannot see it .

0.g: ਚੰਦਰਮੁਖੀ ਸੂਰਜਮੁਖੀ; ਕਵਲੈ ਭਵਰ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਚਉਫੇਰੇ ।
0.e: But lotus blossoms in the sunlight as well as in the moonlit night and the black bee starts hovering around it (because they love lotus and not the sun or the, moon ).

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਸਵੇਰੇ ।
0.e: Despite the illusive phenomena created by maya (i.e. Siva and Sakti) the Sikhs of the Guru, come to join the holy congregation in the ambrosial hours.

0.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪਵਣਾ, ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ ।੩੦।
0.e: Reaching there they touch the feet of one and all good and the better one.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ; ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: When a Guru-conscious person achieves harmony with his mind, words and actions, and by the blessings of the refuge of True Guru, he acquires knowledge of times and the three worlds.

0.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਜਤਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By practicing on Naam, a Guru-conscious person lives in a state of equipoise. Any description of that state is beyond our comprehension. It is indescribable. By dint of that state, he becomes aware of all that is happening in every nook and corner of the

0.g: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By the union of Guru and Sikh, the seeker feels the presence of the Lord of Cosmos in his body and his life-giving support; and when he achieves oneness with God, he remains engrossed in the memory of Lord.

0.g: ਦਰਪਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਉ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ; ਓਤ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਏਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ।੪੭।
0.e: As the mirror and image in it, music and the musical instrument, waft and woof of a cloth are all part of each other and inseparable, so does the Guru-conscious person becomes one with God and is freed of all doubts of duality. (47)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਕੈਹਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਜਲਾ; ਮਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਿਤੈ ।
0.e: The bronze appears bright but inside it remains blackness .

0.g: ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ; ਫਲੁ ਕੰਮ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ।
0.e: Baal: weed plant in a field of sesame may be lush green but it. fruit is worthless.

0.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਕਲੀ ਕਨੇਰ ਦੀ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਹੁ ਭਿਤੈ ।
0.e: The oleander bud has two aspects; externally it is beautiful but internally it is poisonous.

0.g: ਪੇਂਝੂ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ; ਮਰੀਐ ਅਗਲਿਤੈ ।
0.e: Pelijha, the ripe fruit of wild caper looks colourful but over eating it man dies instantly.

0.g: ਖਰੀ ਸੁਆਲਿਓ ਵੇਸੁਆ; ਜੀਅ ਬਝਾ ਇਤੈ ।
0.e: Prostitute looks very beautiful but she ensnares the mind (and ultimately man stands finished).

0.g: ਖੋਟੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਣਿਆ; ਦੁਖ ਦੇਂਦੀ ਮਿਤੈ ।੫।
0.e: Similarly, dissembler's company causes suffering for their friends

0.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮੇਲ ਪਿੰਡ ਲੋਕ ਬੇਦ ਕਹੈਂ ਪਾਂਚੋ; ਤਤ ਕਹੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਰਚਤ ਭੇ ਆਦਿ ਹੀ ।
0.e: Common knowledge, Vedas and other religious scriptures say that body is made of five elements. But tell me, how have these five elements come into existence?

0.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਸੇ ਧਰਨ ਧਾਰੀ ਧੀਰਜ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਿਥਾਰੀ; ਕਾਹੇ ਸਯੋ ਗੜਯੋ ਅਕਾਸ ਠਾਢੋ ਬਿਨ ਪਾਦ ਹੀ ।
0.e: How is Earth supported and how is patience spread in it? How is sky secured and how is it existing without any support?

0.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਸੌਂ ਸਲਲ ਸਾਜੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਪਵਨ ਬਾਜੇ; ਅਗਨ ਤਪਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੀ ।
0.e: How is water made? How does breeze blow? How is fire hot? All this is very wondrous.

0.g: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨਾਥ; ਉਨ ਕੀ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ, ਬਕਨੋ ਹੈ ਬਾਦ ਜੀ ।੬੨੪।
0.e: The effulgent Lord is beyond comprehension. No one can know His secret. He is the cause of all happenings. He alone knows the secret of all these things. So it is futile for us to make any statement in connection with creation of Universe.  (624)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭
ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Rare are those people who like a moth rush toward the flame of the glimpse (of the Lord).

0.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਗ ਮਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: They are also rare in the world who merging their consciousness in the Word die like a deer.

0.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਹੁਇ ਭਵਰ ਵਸੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Rare are they in this world who like black bee adore lotus feet of the Guru.

0.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪਿਰਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਮੀਨ ਤਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Rare are (the Sikhs) in the world who becoming full of love swim like fish.

0.g: ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Such Sikhs of the Guru are also rare who serve other Sikhs of the Guru.

0.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਨਿ, ਭੈ ਰਹਨਿ; ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜੀਵੰਦੇ ।
0.e: Taking birth and sustaining in His order (fear), the Sikhs of the Guru who die while alive (are also rare).

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ, ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖੰਦੇ ।੧੭।
0.e: Thus becoming gurmukhs they taste the fruit of joy.

0.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ; ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A Guru-conscious Sikh feels fully satiated drinking the loving elixir of the nectar-like Naam. He experiences strange and astonishing waves of spiritual ecstasy within.

0.g: ਇਤ ਤੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਸਰਜਤ; ਉਤ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Relishing the loving elixir, a Guru-conscious person turns his senses away from the worldly engrossments and attaches them with the faculties that help him enjoy the divine pleasures. As a result he experiences strange and astonishing sensations within.

0.g: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ, ਸੁਨੈ ਸੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ; ਚਾਖੇ ਸੋ ਬਤਾਵੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਗ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਹੈ ।
0.e: All that he experiences, he cannot make others experience. How can he make others hear the unstruck music that he himself hears? The taste of Naam nectar that he enjoys himself, how can he describe it to others? All these he alone can enjoy.

0.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਥਕਤ ਹੁਇ; ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਹੈ ।੯੬।
0.e: It is impossible to narrate the state of spiritual delight of such a person. Every part of his body becomes stable in the happiness of this state and one feels flabbergasted. Staying in the holy feet of Satguru, such a person merges in the ocean-like God

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਉਲੂ ਆਦਿਤ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਉ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Just as an owl cannot know the greatness of sunlight, similarly a worshipper of other deities cannot have perception of True Guru's advice and company of the holy men.

0.g: ਮਰਕਟ ਮਨ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Just as a monkey does not know the value of pearls and diamonds, so can a follower of other deities not assess the importance of Guru's sermon.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਫਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੈ ਪਾਠ ਮਹਾਤਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ; ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਹਾਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ।
0.e: Just as a cobra cannot appreciate nectar-like milk, similarly a follower of other gods cannot understand significance of the blessings of the Guru's word and his consecrated gift of Karhah Parsad.

0.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਬਗ ਠਗ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਟਿਕ; ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੈ ।੪੫੩।
0.e: Just as an egret cannot fit in the flock of swans and has no knowledge of comforting waves of lake Mansarover. Similarly a worshipper (follower) of other gods cannot stay in the society of devout Sikhs blessed by the True Guru, nor can he understand the d

0.g: ਜਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਾਸ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਪਟੰਬਰਿ ਮੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਲਫ ਤਜਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A fish removed from water, though kept in silk cloth yet dies having been separated from her beloved water.

0.g: ਬਨ ਸੈ ਪਕਰ ਪੰਛੀ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਤਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬਨ ਮਨ ਓਨਮਨੋ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a bird is caught from the jungle and put in a beautiful cage with very delicious food, his mind is seen to be restless without the freedom of the jungle.

0.g: ਭਾਮਨੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਅਤਿ ਛੀਨ ਦੀਨ; ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਭਵਨ ਭਇਆਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as a pretty woman becomes weak and grieved on separation from her husband. Her face looks perplexed and confused and she feels scared of her own home.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਬਿਛੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੈ; ਜੀਵਨ ਜਤਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਹੈ ।੫੧੪।
0.e: Similarly separated from the saintly congregation of the True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru wails, tosses and turns, feels miserable and perplexed. Without the company of saintly souls of the True Guru, he has no other aim in life.  (514)

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਬਾਹਮਣ ਸਾਰਸੁਤ; ਵਿਰਤੀਸਰ ਲਾਗਾਇਤ ਲੋਏ ।
0.e: Many brahmins of sarasuat gotra, priests and lagait (a sount Indian sect) have existed.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਗਉੜ ਕਨਉਜੀਏ; ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਢੋਏ ।
0.e: Many are gaur, kanaujie brahmins who reside in pilgrimage centres.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਲਖ ਸਨਉਢੀਏ; ਪਾਂਧੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵੈਦ ਖਲੋਏ ।
0.e: Lacs of people are called sanaudhie, pandhe, pandit and vaid.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਜੋਤਕੀ; ਵੇਦ ਵੇਦੁਏ ਲੱਖ ਪਲੋਏ ।
0.e: Many lacs are astrologers and many people will-versed in Vedas and the Veduc lore have been.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਲਖ ਕਵੀਸਰਾਂ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਾਟ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਉ ਬਖੋਏ ।
0.e: Lacs of people are known by the names of brahmins, bhats (eulogists) and poets.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਅਭਿਆਗਤਾਂ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਲੈ ਕਨਸੋਏ ।
0.e: Becoming mendicants many people undertaking spying work go on begging and eating.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਸਉਣ, ਸਵਾਣੀ ਹੋਏ ।੯।
0.e: Many are there who forecast about the good and bad omens and thus earn their livelihood.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ; ਮਨ ਪਾਟੈ ਖਰਬਾੜੂ ਖੀਰਾ ।
0.e: Mind of the dual-faced is like useless sour milk.

0.g: ਅਗਹੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਪਿਛਹੁ ਕਉੜਾ ਦੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ।
0.e: On drinking it at first it tastes sweet but then its taste is bitter and it makes body diseased.

0.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤਾ ਕਵਲ ਫੁਲੁ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਅਹੀਰਾ ।
0.e: The double talker is that black bee which is friend of flowers but like fools supposes those flowers to be its permanent home.

0.g: ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ; ਕਲੀ ਕਨੇਰ ਦੁਰੰਗ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ।
0.e: Green but internally hallo sesame seed and the oleander bud have neither true beauty and colour nor any sensible person considers them of any use.

0.g: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਹਥਾ ਨੜੁ ਵਧੈ; ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਵਾਜੁ ਨਫੀਰਾ ।
0.e: If reed grows up to the lenght of hundred hands even then it remains hollow internally producing noisy sound.

0.g: ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਸ ਨ ਬੋਹੀਅਨਿ; ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਵਾਂਸ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੇਪੀਰਾ ।
0.e: Despite their juxtaposition with sandal wood tree bamboos donot become fragrant, and destroy themselves by their mutual friction.

0.g: ਜਮ ਦਰ ਚੋਟਾ, ਸਹਾ ਵਹੀਰਾ ।੧੫।
0.e: Such person at the door of Yama, the god of death, bear many a stroke of his rod.

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ, ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: God himself created the true Guru Nanak.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਬਬਾਣੇ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Becoming Sikh of the Guru, Guru Angad joined this family.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Liked by the true Guru, Guru Amar Das became Sikh of the Guru.

0.g: ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Then Ram Das, the Sikh of the Guru came to be known as the Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ, ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Thereafter came Guru Arjan as the disciple of the Guru (and got established as the Guru).

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ, ਨ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ।੧।
0.e: Hargobind, the Sikh of the Guru cannot remain concealed even if somebody wishes to (and this further means that all the Gurus had the same light).

0.g: ਪੀਉ ਦੇ ਨਾਂਹ ਪਿਆਰ ਤੁਲਿ; ਨਾ ਫੁਫੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਤੀਏ ਤਾਏ ।
0.e: The love of father's sister or cousins are not equal to the father's love.

0.g: ਮਾਊ ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਹੇਤੁ ਨ ਮਾਮੇ ਮਾਸੀ ਜਾਏ ।
0.e: Love of mother cannot be equalled by the love of the children of maternal uncle and mother's sister.

0.g: ਅੰਬਾਂ ਸਧਰ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਆਣਿ ਅੰਬਾਕੜੀਆਂ ਜੇ ਖਾਏ ।
0.e: By eating mango blossms the desire for eating mangoes is not fulfilled.

0.g: ਮੂਲੀ ਪਾਨ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ; ਵਾਸੁ ਡਿਕਾਰੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ।
0.e: The smells of radish leaves and betel are differ­ent and are identified through smell and eructation.

0.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ; ਦੀਵੇ ਲਖ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਾਏ ।
0.e: Lacs of lighted lamps and stars cannot compete with the sun and the moon.

0.g: ਰੰਗ ਮਜੀਠ ਕੁਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸਥੋਈ ਵੇਸੁ ਵਟਾਏ ।
0.e: The colour of madder is steadfast and the colour of safflower changes very soon.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਾਏ ।
0.e: Neither mother and father nor all the gods can be as gracious as the true Guru.

0.g: ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭੇ, ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਏ ।੨੦।
0.e: All these relations have been thoroughly tested.

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਛਬਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Despite presence of millions of beauties, forms, complexions, treasure-houses of splendour and glory, presence of lights effulgent;

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਭਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਦੋਤ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Appearing of kingdoms, rules, grandeurs and glory, comforts and peace;

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦਿ ਬਾਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਨ; ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਓਤ ਪੋਤਿ ਕੈ ।
0.e: Despite presence of millions of tunes and melodies of music, classical knowledge, pleasures and relishments integrated like weft and woof,

0.g: ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਤਿਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਕੈ ।੨੬੫।
0.e: All these glories are paltry. The glory of merging once consciousness in the words of Guru, a glimpse of and a graceful look of the True Guru is beyond expression. Salutations to Him again and again. (265)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਗਲੀਂ ਜੇ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤੋਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਫਾਸੈ ।
0.e: If mere chatter could help meet the beloved, why should a parrot remain encaged?

0.g: ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪੈ; ਕਾਉ ਗੂੰਹੁ ਗਿਰਾਸੈ ।
0.e: He is not attained by over-cleverness and the clever crow ultimately eats faeces.

0.g: ਜੋਰਾਵਰੀ ਨ ਜਿਪਈ ਸੀਹ; ਸਹਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੈ ।
0.e: The power also does not win (the intellect wins) because an hare caused a lion killed (by showing its reflection and making it jump into the well).

0.g: ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ; ਭਟ ਭੇਖ ਉਦਾਸੈ ।
0.e: The beloved is not lured by lyrics and poems, otherwise why should minstrels adopt the garb of sannyasis.

0.g: ਜੋਬਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ; ਰੰਗੁ ਕੁਸੁੰਭ ਦੁਰਾਸੈ ।
0.e: He is not attracted by youth and beauty because the colour of safflower is not permanent.

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਹਾਸੈ ।੧੨।
0.e: Without service (to the Lord and His creation) this soul is deserted woman and the beloved is not attained merely by laughing (foolishly). He is attained through service.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਸਟਾ ਸੁਖੰਬਰ ਲੈ; ਅਨਕਿ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ।
0.e: By the grace of True Guru, a Guru-conscious person appreciates no other apparel than the comfort giving dress of respect and honour acquired by virtue of perpetual engrossment of the mind in the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ; ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਲਾਲਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ।
0.e: He also feels no more desire for other foods after relishing the soul comforting sweet elixir like food of Naam Simran (Meditation on Lord's name).

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਕੈ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ।
0.e: Having attained access to the love filled treasure of the Lord, a Guru-obedient person desires for no other treasures.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਛ; ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ।੧੪੮।
0.e: By a miniscule grace of God-like True Guru for practicing meditation on Lord's name, all expectations of a Guru-oriented person are defeated. Except for indulgence in Naam Simran, they wander nowhere else. (148)

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨੇਮਹ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ।
0.e: Salutation to the True Guru the wondrous form of the (root of all) Lord, in whom God Himself has lodged His light effulgent.

0.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ; ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਖੀ ।
0.e: In the congregation assembled before God-like True Guru, praises of the Lord are sung and recited. All four varnas (caste based sections of the society) then integrate into one caste society.

0.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਜ ਧਾਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ; ਧੁਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਾਖੀ ।
0.e: A Sikh of the Guru whose base is Lord's name, listens to the melodious paeans of the Lord's praise. He then realises his self that helps him perceive the imperceptible.

0.e: The True Guru showers his benediction in very small measure on such a person who gets engrossed in it and relishes the loving elixir of Lord's love. (144)

ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਬਾਰੀਕ ਹੈ; ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਗਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਭੀੜੀ ।
0.e: The discipleship of the Guru is very subtle like a sword edge and narrow alley.

0.e: Mosquito’s and ants cannot stand there.

0.e: Like licking of the salt-less stone they pick up the rubies and jewels to eat.

0.e: Climbing the steps of non-duality they adopt the Word of the formless Guru.

0.e: Calling him simple minded makes him feel good but he would not talk to one who tells him that he is a silly person.

0.e: He smiles at being called a carrier of the burden (of all) but feels angry when told that he is just an ox.
