0.e: With the mind engrossing into the teachings of Satguru and divine word residing for ever in the memory, astonishing loving devotion is generated.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ; ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੰਚਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: In the company of devoted, slave Sikhs, noble and pious persons, one gets dyed in the hue of colour as beetle leaf, beetle nut, lime, cardamom and catechu mix together to become red beside giving pleasant smell. As other metals become gold when touched wi

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਤਾਸ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ ।੮੫।
0.e: As the fragrance of sandalwood makes other trees equally fragrant, so does the touch of the holy feet, a glimpse of the True Guru, and with' the union of the divine word and the conscious mind; the company of pious and noble persons, fragrance blossoms. T

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ; ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The True Guru is the true and complete form of the Radiance supreme-the Lord. The blessings of Naam to the Sikhs is the complete knowledge of the True Guru.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The slave Sikh of the True Guru imbibes the teachings of the Guru in his heart according to the manner taught and holds it as total truth. He practices it in the holy congregation very devotedly;

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਦਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਨ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਹੈ ।
0.e: In the worship of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, the beetle-like mind is satiated with the love elixir of Lord-like Guru and feels free from all other desires and wants.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ।੧੩੯।
0.e: The storehouse of all treasures are the form of complete form of True Guru. By virtue of the meditation on Naam (obtained from the True Guru) the heart that feels the light effulgence of the Lord, that heart is wondrous and astonishing. (139)

0.g: ਭਾਂਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਊ ਦੀਪਕੈ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਰਾਖੈ; ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਅਛਤ ਹੀ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ।
0.e: If a beacon is lit but kept under cover, no one can see anything in that room despite the presence of an oil lamp there.

0.g: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਖਵਈਆ ਪੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਰੈ; ਹਰੈ ਤਮ ਤਿਮਰ ਉਦੋਤ ਜੋਤ ਠਾਨਈ ।
0.e: But he who has hidden the lamp removes its cover and light up the room, the darkness of room is dispelled.

0.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਤਛਿ ਰੂਪ; ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਪਈਆ ਤਤਖਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਈ ।
0.e: Then one is able to see everything and even he who has lit the lamp can be recognised.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਟ ਗੁਪਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ; ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਉਨਮਾਨਈ ।੩੬੩।
0.e: Similarly, God resides latently in the tenth door of this sacred and invaluable body. By the incantation blessed by the True Guru and perpetual practicing on it, one realises Him and feels His presence there. (363)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਦੁਇ ਜਣੇ; ਦੁਹੁ ਜਣਿਆਂ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ।
0.e: Consequent to the confluence of male and female both (Hindu and Muslim) were born; but both initiated separate ways (sects).

0.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਆਖਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮੁ; ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਏ ।
0.e: Hindus remember Ram-Ram and the Muslims named Him Khuda.

0.g: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਸਉਹਿਆਂ; ਪਛਮਿ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਏ ।
0.e: Hindus perform their worship facing East and Muslims bow towards the West.

0.g: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਹਿੰਦੂਆਂ; ਮਕਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਮਨਾਏ ।
0.e: Hindus adore Ganges and Banaras, whereas Muslims celebrate Mecca.

0.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ; ਚਾਰ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਜਹਬ ਚਲਾਏ ।
0.e: They have four scriptures each--four Vedas and four Katebas. Hindus created four varnas (castes) and Muslims the four sects (Hanifis, Safis, Malikis, and Hambalis).

0.g: ਪੰਜ ਤਤ ਦੋਵੈ ਜਣੇ; ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਛਾਏ ।
0.e: But in fact, the same air, water and fire exist in them all.

0.g: ਇਕ ਥਾਉਂ, ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉਂ ਧਰਾਏ ।੨।
0.e: The ultimate shelter for both is the same one; only they have given different names to it.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਮਣਿ ਨਿਮਿ, ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Under the natural law (fear of lord), the jiva (creature) is conceived (by mother) and in the fear (law) he is born.

0.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥਿ, ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: In fear he comes in the shelter of the way (panth) of Guru.

0.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ, ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In fear while in the holy congregation he earns the merit of the True Word

0.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In fear (natural laws) he gets liberated in life and accepts the will of God happily.

0.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In fear he leaves away this life and merges in equipoise.

0.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ, ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ।੨੦।
0.e: In fear he settles in his self and attains the supreme Perfect Being.

0.g: ਨੈਹਰ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਲਾਡਿਲੀ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਅਤਿ; ਬਿਆਹੇ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਨਨੁ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: An unmarried daughter is loved by everyone in parental house and enjoys respect in the in-laws house because of her virtues.

0.g: ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਲਗਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਕਹੀਏ ਸਪੂਤ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤ ਕੈ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As one goes to other cities to trade and earn living, but one is known as an obedient son only when one makes profit;

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸਮੈ ਪਰ ਦਲ ਮੈ ਅਕੇਲੋ ਜਾਇ; ਜੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੂਰੋ ਸੁਭਟੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As a warrior ingresses into enemy ranks and comes out victorious is known as a brave man.

0.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।੧੧੮।
0.e: Similarly he who enjoins the holy gatherings, acquire the refuge of the True Guru is accepted in the court of the Lord. (118)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ, ਲਖ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ।
0.e: Millions of Brahmas, Visnus and Mahegas adore the Lord.

0.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਸੇਸ, ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਦੇ ।
0.e: Narad, Saran and Sesanag eulogise Him.

0.g: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਗਣੇਸ, ਨਾਦ ਵਜਾਇਦੇ ।
0.e: The gams, gandharvas and Gana et al. play instruments (for Him).

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ, ਸਾਂਗ ਬਣਾਇਦੇ ।
0.e: The six philosophies also propound different garbs (for reaching Him).

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ, ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦੇ ।
0.e: The gurus sermonize the disciples and the disciples act accordingly.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ, ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਦੇ ।੨।
0.e: Salute to the primeval Lord who is unfathomable.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧
ਖਾਧੇ ਲੂਣ ਗੁਲਾਮ ਹੋਇ; ਪੀਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵੈ ।
0.e: Having eaten the salt (of a person), man becoming servant fetches water and grinds the corn.

0.g: ਲੂਣ ਖਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਰਣਿ ਟੁਕ ਟੁਕ ਹੋਵੈ ।
0.e: Such a faithful, in the battlefield gets killed piece to piece for the master.

0.g: ਲੂਣ ਖਾਇ ਧੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਭ ਲਜਾ ਧੋਵੈ ।
0.e: The faithful sons and daughters wash all the shames of the family.

0.g: ਲੂਣੁ ਵਣੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ; ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਖੜੋਵੈ ।
0.e: The salt eater servant always stands with folded hands.

0.g: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ; ਗੁਣੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ।
0.e: The passerby eulogizes the person whose salt be has eaten.

0.g: ਲੂਣਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ ।੧੧।
0.e: But the ungrateful person commits sins and he loses his life in vain and dies.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪
ਸਭ ਸਰੀਰ ਅਕਾਰਥੇ; ਅਤਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ।
0.e: All the bodies are useful but the human body is the most useless and defiled one.

0.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ; ਹੁਇ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਇਵੇਹੀ ।
0.e: In its company many a delicious food, sweet etc change into urine and faeces.

0.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਵਿਗੜਦੇ; ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਕੁਸੰਗ ਸਨੇਹੀ ।
0.e: In its evil company silken robes, betel, comphor etc. also get spoiled.

0.g: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਅਰਗਜਾ; ਹੁਇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੁਰੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Sandal scent, and joss sticks etc also get converted into fowl smell.

0.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਂਵਦੇ; ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਖਹਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ।
0.e: Kings rule gheir kingdoms and die of their fights with one another.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਿਣੁ; ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹ ਇਵੇਹੀ ।
0.e: Withoug going to the holy congregation and to the shelter of Guru, this human body is also fruitless.

0.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣਿ, ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ਜੇਹੀ ।੧੪।
0.e: Only that body is meaningful which has come to the Guru's fold in humility

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੰਜ ਤਤ ਉਪਜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The supreme Reality assuming the form of Oankar created the three qualities (of matter) and the five elements.

0.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਸਾਜਿ; ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਚਲਿਤ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Creating Brahma, Visnu and Mahes'a he performed the sports of ten incarnations.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ; ਸਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Producing six seasons, twelve months and seven days he created the whole world.

0.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੇ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਿ; ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Scribing the writs of birth and death, He recited the Vedas, Shastras and the Puranas.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੁ; ਥਿਤ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: About the beginning and end of the holy congregation He did not prescribe any date, day or month.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Holy congregation is the abode of truth wherein resides the formless One in the form of Word.

0.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁਂ ਫਲੁ ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Creating fruit from tree and tree from fruit i.e. making disciple of the Guru and then from disciple the Guru, the Lord has laid down the mystery of His perfect imperceptible form.

0.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The Gurus themselves bowed before the primeval Lord and made others also bow before Him.

0.g: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਤਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਓਤਪੋਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The true Guru is the primordial Lord who is pervading this creation as does a thread in the rosary.

0.g: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ, ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।੧੩।
0.e: Guru Himself is the wonder who is one with the supreme wonder.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ; ਅਰਥ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Crores of properties such as truth, contentment, pity, dharma, lucre are there but none could know the extremity of that (pleasure-fruit).

0.g: ਚਾਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਹੋਇ ਲਖੂਣਿ ਨ ਪਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Four ideals are said to be and may be they are multiplied by lakhs, even then they do not equal the one moment of pleasure fruit.

0.g: ਰਿਧੀ ਸਿਧੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ; ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਖ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Riddhis, Siddhis and lakhs of treasures do not equal its one small fraction.

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਖ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Seeing the intimacy of Word and the consciousness, many combinations of philosophies and meditations are surprised.

0.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਅਸੰਖ; ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਲਖ ਨੇਤ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Many methods of knowledge, meditation and remembrance are put forth;

0.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ।
0.e: But reaching the tranquil stage, the pleasure-fruit of the cup of love of the Lord attained by gurmukhs is wondrous.

0.g: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ, ਲਖ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਣੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: At this stage, intellect, wisdom and millions of purities get combined.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦
ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਈ ।
0.e: The forests are replete with vegetation but without sandalwood, the fragrance of sandal does not occur in it.

0.g: ਪਰਬਤਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ; ਪਾਰਸ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ ।
0.e: Minerals are there on all the mountain but without the philosopher's stone they do not transform into gold.

0.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਣਿ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: None among the four varnas and the scholars of the six philosophies can become (true) sadhu without the company of saints.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਈ ।
0.e: Charged by the teachings of the Guru, gurmukhs understand the importance of the company of the saints.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਿਓਈ ।
0.e: Then, they getting the consciousness attuned to the Word, quaff the cup of nectar of loving devotion.

0.g: ਮਨਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਬਲੇ; ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਥੋਈ ।
0.e: The mind now reaching the highest stage of spiritual realisation (turiya) and becoming subtle stabilises in the love of the Lord.

0.e: Gurmukhs beholding the invisible Lord receive the fruits of that pleasure.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ।
0.e: The true Guru is that pilgrimages centre in whose shelter are the sixty-eight pilgrimage centres of the Hindus.

0.e: Being beyond dualities, the true a Guru is the supreme God and other gods get across the world ocean only by serving Him.

0.e: The true Guru is that philosopher's stone the dust of whose feet adorns millions of philosopher's stones.

0.e: The true Guru is that perfect wish-fulfilling tree who is meditated upon by the millions of wish-fulfilling trees.

0.e: The true Guru being ocean of delights distributes pearls in the form of different sermons.

0.e: The feet of the true Guru are that desire fulfilling fabulous gem (chintamani) which makes myriads of gems free of anxieties.

0.e: Except the true Guru (God) all other is duality (which makes one go the cycle of transmigration).

0.e: The door of the True Guru is perpetual source of knowledge, a place where His slaves are ever involved in His loving worship and His loving maids are praying for salvation.

0.g: ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸ੍ਵਪਨ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨ ਉਠ ਬੈਠ ਚਲਿ; ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: That human being is ever accepted at the door of the True Guru who utters and listens to His divine name awake, sleeping, sitting, standing or walking. This for him is the supreme task for him.

0.g: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਮਾਨੋ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: All those who come to the door of the True Guru with devotion and love are accepted by the True Guru. He acquires the invaluable treasure of Name. It seems the proclamation of Him being the lover of the worshippers is being sounded on His door in the form

0.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗਵਤ; ਅਦਭੁਤ ਛਬਿ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਹੈ ।੬੧੯।
0.e: All those human beings who take refuge on the door of the king of kings, they enjoy the wondrous comforts of the treasure of Name and becomes liberated while alive. Such wondrous beauty of the court of the True Guru is becoming well adorned.  (619)

0.e: The only difference in human and animal body is that a human is aware of the union of consciousness and the holy word of the Guru but animal has no such knowledge nor any ability.

0.e: If an animal is asked to stay away from green fields, or pasture land, it ignores it but a human being lodges the teachings of the True Guru in his heart and adheres to it.

0.g: ਪਸੂਆ ਸਬਦ ਹੀਨ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਕੈ; ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Devoid of words, an animal cannot speak with its tongue but a human can speak several words.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ; ਨਾਤੁਰ ਅਚੇਤ ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਹੂ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਹੈ ।੨੦੦।
0.e: If a man listens, understands and speaks the words of Guru, he is a wise and intelligent person. Otherwise he too is one among the ignorant animal and a fool. (200)

0.g: ਤਾ ਲਾਲਿ ਜਾਣ ਫ਼ਜ਼ਾਇ ਤੂ ਗੋਯਾ ਨਮੀ ਸ਼ਵਦ ।
0.e: Because, he meditates and has only Naam of the Omnipotent on his tongue. (39) (2)

0.e: The fragrant black speckle, the mole, of your cheek, has enamored the entire world,

0.g: ਲਬਿ ਤਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਰਾ ਬਾ-ਆਬਿ ਲਬਤ ਹਸਤ ਆਰਜ਼ੂ ।
0.e: And, your locks of hair are just like a snare for the faith and the religion and nothing else.(39) (3)

0.e: O Guru! Kindly show me your sun-like face as soon as possible,

0.g: ਦਾਰੇਮ ਦਰਦਿ ਦਿਲ ਕਿ ਮਰ ਊ ਰਾ ਇਲਾਜ ਨੀਸਤ ।
0.e:
Because, this is the only cure for my tearful eyes and nothing else." (39) (4)

0.e: Alas! I wish you had asked Goyaa even for a moment, How are you?

0.g: ਗੁਫ਼ਤਮ ਕਿ ਜਾਣ-ਦਿਹੇਮ ਇਵਜ਼ਿ ਯੱਕ ਨਿਗਾਹਿ ਤੂ ।
0.e:
Because, this is the only remedy for my painfully tortured heart." (39) (6)

You should not cast your eyes just even to look towards any one else; this will be an act of blindness;

0.e: I am not asking anyone to go to the temple or the Muslin shrine.

0.e: In fact, rid yourself of all purpose and pursuits.(This way, one can attain the real goal) (40) (6)

0.e: Hearts of everyone in deep love are scorched and charred,

0.e: Both the worlds are amazed and even desperately restless for his glimpse. (41) (1)

0.e: The dust of your street is like a collyrium for the eyes of those with divine sight,

0.e: And for the tearful eyes, there is no other better cure than this. (41) (2)

0.e: The imperceptible and blemishless Lord is said to be beyond all the forms and writs.

0.e: The nature of that unmanifest Lord is also deeply unmanifest, and in spite of continuous recitations by Sesanffg His mystery could not be understood.

0.e: How can His ineffable story be known because none is there to tell it.

0.e: Thinking about Him, the wonder also feels itself full of wonder and the awe also becomes awe struck.

0.e: Becoming the Sikh of the Guru the people of all the four varnas leading the household life,

0.e: Have undertaken to perform various types of business and trade.

0.e: One who has fixed his attention on the vision of the True Guru. is not reassured by the six schools of philosophy nor towards other religious sects. He sees all philosophies in the vision of one True Guru.

0.e: One who has received Guru's consecration hears melodies of five types of musical instruments deep in his soul because the unstruck music that has appeared in his being due to perpetual meditation on Lord's name has all the melodies in it.

0.e: By practicing meditation on the Lord, He comes and resides he in the heart. In this state an initiated disciple sees the all-pervading Lord everywhere.

0.e: The Sikh who is blessed with knowledge, contemplation and Simran by the True Guru and who relishes the loving elixir, learns the truth of one Lord who pervades in all despite being one. (214)

0.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ; ਤਾਮੈ ਤਿਲ ਛਬਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਛਕਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The divine radiance of True Guru's light is astonishing. Even a miniscule part of that light is beautiful, marvellous and quaint.

0.e: Eyes have no power to see, ears have no power to hear and tongue has no power to describe the beauty of that light divine. Nor are there words in the world to describe it.

0.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ; ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਓਟਿ ਲੈ ਛਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Numerous praises, lights of glittering lamp hide behind curtains before this supernatural light.

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੇਖ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਭਈ; ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਅਤਿ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਅਤਿ ਹੈ ।੧੪੦।
0.e: A very momentary glimpse of that divine effulgence ends all the notions and options of the mind. The praise of such glimpse is infinite, most wondrous and marvellous. Thus He should be saluted again and again. (140)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਜਿਉ; ਸਚੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਸਿਲਹ ਸੰਜੋਆ ।
0.e: Falsehood is a fake weapon whereas the truth is protector like an iron-armour.

0.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਦਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸੁਮਿਤੁ ਹਿਮਾਇਤਿ ਹੋਆ ।
0.e: Like enemy, falsehood always lies in ambush but the truth, like a friend is ever ready to help and support.

0.g: ਸੂਰਵੀਰੁ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਸਚੁ; ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁੜਾਵਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਢੋਆ ।
0.e: The truth is truly a brave warrior who meets the truthful ones whereas the Her meets Hers alone.

0.g: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ਹੈ; ਲਰਜੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਖੜੋਆ ।
0.e: At good places, the truth stands firmly but being in the wrong places, falsehood always shakes and trembles.

0.e: The four directions and the three worlds are witness (to the fact) that the truth catching hold of falsehood has thrashed it.

0.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਦਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੀ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਰੋਆ ।
0.e: Deceptive falsehood is ever diseased and the truth is always hale and hearty.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ, ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਖੋਆ ।੧੦।
0.e: The adopter of truth is ever known as truthful and the follower of falsehood is ever considered a Tier.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ; ਗਿਆਨ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਹ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਸਿ ਆਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Contemplating on the vision of the True Guru and practicing His impressed divine word are the weapons for fighting the five evils like lust, anger, avarice etc.

0.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਧੇਨ; ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਕਟਿ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The refuge of True Guru and by living in the dust of His feet, the ill effects and doubts of all past performed deeds are vanquished. One acquires a state of fearlessness.

0.e: By imbibing the divine words of Satguru (True Guru), and by developing an attitude of a true slave, one realises the imperceptible, indeceivable and indescribable Lord.

0.e: In the company of holy men of the True Guru, singing Gurbani (Guru's utterances in praise of the Lord) with humility and love, one gets absorbed in the spiritual peace. (135)

0.e: The snakes are said to be coiled around the sandal tree (but the tree is not influenced by their poison).

0.e: The philosopher's stone exists among stones but does not turn out to be an ordinary stone.

0.e: The jewel-holding snake also roams about among the ordinary snakes.

0.g: ਲਹਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੰਸੁਲੇ; ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਿ ਚੁਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ।
0.e: From the waves of the pond, the swans pick up only pearls and gems to eat.

0.g: ਜਿਉਂ ਜਲਿ ਕਵਲ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ; ਘਰਿਬਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਿ ਤਿਵਾਹੀ ।
0.e: As the lotus remains unsmeared in water, the same is the position of the householder Sikh.

0.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਵਾਹੀ ।
0.e: He residing among all the hopes and cravings around, adopts the skill of liberation in life and lives (happily).

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ।੧੫।
0.e: How could one eulogise the holy congregation.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੪
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The true Guru has been created in the form of perfect Brahm by the transcendent Brahm. Guru is God and God is the Guru; two names are of the same supreme reality.

0.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ; ਜੋਤਿ ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵ ਧਰਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The son for the father and the father for the son created wonder by receiving the wondrous Word .

0.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਪਿਅਹੁ, ਪਿਉ ਪੁਤ ਤੇ; ਵਿਸਮਾਦਹੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: A wonderful beauty has been created in the action of tree becoming fruit and fruit the tree.

0.g: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ, ਫਲ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਖੁ; ਆਚਰਜਹੁ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From the two banks of a river its true extent cannot be understood simply by saying that the one is far and the other near bank.

0.g: ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੇ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਪੁਛੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Guru Arjan Dev and Guru Hargobind are in fact one and the same.

0.g: ਹੋਰਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ; ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: None else can perceive the imperceptible Lord but the disciple (Hargobind) having met the Guru (Arjan Dev) has visualised the imperceptible Lord.

0.g: ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ, ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਇਆ ।੨੪।
0.e: Guru Hargobind is dear to the Lord who is the Guru of the Gurus.

0.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ; ਪਾਂਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਦਰਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: By perpetual meditation on Lord's name, a Guru-conscious person distances himself from duality and caste discrimination. He frees himself from the grip of five vices (lust, anger, greed, ego and attachment) nor does he entangle himself in the rationales o

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਭਏ; ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਆਪਾ ਅਪਰਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as an iron piece when touched with a philosopher-stone becomes gold, similarly a devotee meeting Guru becomes a pious and a clean man.

0.g: ਨਵ ਦੁਆਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰਿਬ੍ਰਮਾਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਮੈ; ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਨਿ ਰੁਚਤ ਨ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Overcoming the pleasures of the nine doors of the body, he rests his faculties in the tenth door, where the divine elixir flows perpetually that turn him away from all other pleasures.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ਈਸ; ਅਨਹਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਅਭਰ ਭਰਸ ਹੈ ।੩੨।
0.e: Be assured that the meeting of Guru and a disciple, makes a disciple realise Lord and virtually becomes like Him. His  heart then remains immersed in the celestial music. (32)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ।
0.e: The true Guru is a perfect banker and the three worlds are his travelling salesmen.

0.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਖ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He has the treasure of infinite jewels in the form of loving devotion.

0.g: ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ ਲਖ ਬਾਗ ਵਿਚਿ; ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ ਦੇ ਵਗ ਹਜਾਰਾ ।
0.e: In his garden, he keeps millions of wishfulfilling trees and thousands of herds of wishfulfilling cows.

0.g: ਲਖਮੀਆਂ ਲਖ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ; ਪਾਰਸ ਦੇ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ।
0.e: He has millions of Laksamts as servants and many mountains of philosopher's stones.

0.g: ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਲਖ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੈ; ਹੁਇ ਸਕੈ ਛਿੜਕਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Millions of Indrs having millions types of nectars sprinkle in his court.

0.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਚਰਾਗ ਲਖ; ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਅੰਬਾਰਾ ।
0.e: Millions of lamps like suns and moons are there and the heaps of miraculous powers are also with him.

0.g: ਸਭੇ ਵੰਡ ਵੰਡਿ ਦਿਤੀਓਨੁ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ।
0.e: The true Guru has distributed all these stores among those who love the truth and are absorbed in loving devotion.

0.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ।੨੨।
0.e: The true Guru, who himself is the Lord, loves his devotees (deeply).

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: The disciple who obeys the commands of the Guru is called gurmukh.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ; ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: The actions of the gurmukh are awe-inspiring and their glory is indescribable.

0.g: ਕੁਦਰਤ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣ; ਕਾਦਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: Considering creation as the form of the Creator he feels to be a sacrifice unto it.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ; ਜਗੁ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: In the world he feels himself as a guest and the world a guest house.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣੁ; ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: Truth is his real Guru whom he speaks and listens to.

0.g: ਦਰਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਵਾਣੁ; ਚਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: Like a bard, at the doors of the holy congregation, he recites the hymns of the Guru (gurbani).

0.g: ਅੰਤਰਿਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ; ਹੇਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: For him the holy congregation is the basis of his acquaintance with the omniscient Lord.

0.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਐ ।
0.e: His consciousness remains absorbed in the graceful true Word.

0.g: ਇਕੋ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ।੩।
0.e: True court of justice for him is the holy congregation and through Word the true identity of it he establishes in his heart.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਥਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਲੁਕਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ।
0.e: Philosopher's stone remains hidden and does not publicise itself.

0.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ਸਿਞਾਣਦਾ; ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: Any rare one identifies it and only a prospector gets it.

0.g: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ।
0.e: Touching that stone, the lowly metals transform into one metal, gold.

0.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਵੰਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਵਿਕਾਏ ।
0.e: Becoming pure gold those metals are sold as invaluable ones.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ ।
0.e: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation where merging consciousness into Word, the clumsy mind is chiselled into beautiful shape.

0.g: ਚਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸੈਂਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਭਾਏ ।
0.e: Even a worldly person here, concentrating upon the feet of Guru, becomes dear to God, the formless One.

0.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ, ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਏ ।੯।
0.e: Becoming householder, man resides in his innate nature (atman).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਅੰਬਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਂਵਦਾ; ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: The sky is seen but none knows its extent.

0.g: ਉਚਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਰੂਪ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: How much high it is in the form of vaccum is not known to anybody.

0.g: ਲੈਨਿ ਉਡਾਰੀ ਪੰਖਣੂ; ਅਨਲ ਮਨਲ ਉਡਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ ।
0.e: Birds fly in it and even the anal bird which always remains flying does not know the mystery of sky.

0.g: ਓੜਿਕੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਭਈ; ਸਭੇ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Mystery of its origin is not known to any body and all are wonder-struck.

0.g: ਲਖ ਅਗਾਸ ਨ ਅਪੜਨਿ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto His Nature; even millions of skies cannot express His grandeur.

0.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੈ ।
0.e: That true Lord resides in the holy congregation.

0.g: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ।੧੮।
0.e: Only a devotee who becomes dead from the point of view of ego, can identify him.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: By contemplating and absorbing oneself in the name obtained by the blessings of a True Guru, and shedding the feelings of mine and his, one becomes a servant of the Guru. Such a servant acknowledges the presence of one Lord everywhere.

0.g: ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗੋਰਸ ਗੋਬੰਸ; ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੋ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪਹਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As the same fire exists in all the woods, different beads are arranged in the same thread; as all shades and species of cows yield milk of the same colour; similarly the slave of True Guru achieves the wisdom and knowledge of the presence of one Lord in a

0.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੁਖ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ; ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਮੈਕ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ।
0.e: As all that is seen by the eyes, heard by the ears and said by the tongue reaches the mind, similarly the slave of the Guru sees one Lord residing in all beings and lodges Him in his mind.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਹੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।੧੦੮।
0.e: The union of a Sikh with his Guru makes him utter Lord's name repeatedly and enjoins in Him like warp and weft. When his light merges with light eternal, he too acquires the form of light divine. (108)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ; ਬਧਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The double-talker salutes bound by his compulsions, yet his posture is disliked.

0.g: ਢੀਂਗ ਜੁਹਾਰੀ ਢੀਂਗੁਲੀ; ਗਲਿ ਬਧੇ ਓਹੁ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Dhitighalt, a contraption to draw water from a pit or well comprising a wooden pole, bows only when a stone (as a counterweight) is tied to it.

0.g: ਗਲਿ ਬਧੈ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਕਲੈ; ਖੂਹਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ ।
0.e: On the other hand leather bag when tied only, brings out water from the well.

0.g: ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੈ; ਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Working under some complusion is neither a merit nor a benevolence.

0.g: ਨਿਵੈ ਕਮਾਣ ਦੁਬਾਜਰੀ; ਜਿਹ ਫੜਿਦੇ ਇਕ ਸੀਸ ਸਹਾਵੈ ।
0.e: The two ended bow with an arrow on it, bends when pulled, but immediately on release, the arrow discharged strikes the head of someone.

0.g: ਨਿਵੈ ਅਹੇੜੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਕਰੈ ਵਿਸਾਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਸਰੁ ਲਾਵੈ ।
0.e: Similarly, the hunter also bows on the sight of a deer and treacherously kills it with his arrow.

0.g: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ, ਅਪਰਾਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ।੧੬।
0.e: The criminal, thus, goes on committing crimes.

0.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਾਈਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ।
0.e: The Celestial Word is for them, whose divine writ is blessed.

0.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਗ ।
0.e: The egocentric is like a derelict woman but the fortunate is the Gurmukh one.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੈ ਕਾਗ ।
0.e: The Gurmukh is the epitome of a (white) swan whereas the (black) crow represents an egocentric.

0.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਊਂਧੇ ਕਵਲੁ ਹੈਂ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਗ ।
0.e: The egocentric resembles the withered lotus but the Gurmukh is full bloom.

0.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Whereas the dissenter remains in transmigration, the Gurmukh is assimilated in Har.

0.g: ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿੰਘ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ।੪।
0.e: Hail, hail (Guru) Gobind Singh; He, Himself, is the Master and the Disciple too.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਨੀ; ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Not serving the Lord (God) of Lords, many lords (naths) becoming gurus initiate people as their disciples.

0.g: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ; ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਪਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇਲੇ ।
0.e: They getting the ears split and applying ashes on their bodies carry begging bowls and staff.

0.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਟੁਕਰ ਮੰਗਦੇ; ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਾਜਾਇਨਿ ਭੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Going from door to door, they beg food and blow their singi, a special instrument made of horn.

0.g: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਵੰਡੀਐ; ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਵਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Getting together on the Sivaratri fair they share with one another the food and the cup of drinks.

0.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਚਲਾਇਦੇ; ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟੀ ਖਰੇ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ।
0.e: They follow one of the twelve sects (of yogis) and go on moving on these twelve ways i.e. they go on transmigrating.

0.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਿਝਨੀ; ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੇ ।
0.e: Without the word of the Guru, none gets liberated and all of them run here and there like acrobats.

0.g: ਅੰਨ੍ਹੈ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ, ਖੂਹੀ ਠੇਲੇ ।੫।
0.e: This way the blind one goes on pushing the blind into the well.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯
ਕਿਸਨ ਲੈਆ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਜਗਿ; ਮਹਮਾ ਦਸਮ ਸਕੰਧੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ।
0.e: The tenth chapter of the Bhagavat defines the glory of incarnation of Krsna in the world.

0.g: ਲੀਲਾ ਚਲਤ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਰਿ; ਜੋਗੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਰਸ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: He performed many wonderful acts of bhog (merriment) and yoga (renunciation).

0.g: ਮਹਾਭਾਰਥੁ ਕਰਵਾਇਓਨੁ; ਕੈਰੋ ਪਾਡੋ ਕਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Making Kauravs (sons of Dhrttrastr) and Pandays to fight against each other he further made them wonder struck.

0.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕਾ; ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਿਤਿ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Indr and Brahma et al. donot know the limits of his grandeur.

0.g: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਟਹਲਾ ਵੰਡਿ ਕੈ; ਜਗਿ ਰਾਜਸੂ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੈ ।
0.e: When Raisfiy was arranged by Yudhisthar, all were alloted their duties.

0.g: ਮੰਗ ਲਈ ਹਰਿ ਟਹਲ ਏਹ; ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਮਾਣੈ ।
0.e: Krsna himself tookover the duty of washing of the feet of all so that through this service

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ।੯।
0.e: He could realise the importance of the service of the holy congregation and the Word of the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩
ਪੰਜ ਤਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ; ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ।
0.e: As a result of the rational combination of five elements this lovely abode of dharma in the form of earth has been created.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਰਿ; ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਪਾਣੀ ।
0.e: The earth is placed in water and again in earth, water is placed.

0.g: ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਏ ਰੁਖ ਹੋਇ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਬਿਬਾਣੀ ।
0.e: Having their heads downward i.e. the trees rooted in earth grow on it and reside in the deep lone forests.

0.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਿ; ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਵਰਸਾਣੀ ।
0.e: These trees are also altruists which when stoned rain fruits for the creatures on earth.

0.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ; ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਹਿਕਾਣੀ ।
0.e: The fragrance of sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant.

0.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ।
0.e: In the holy company of Gurmukhs the consciousness is merged into Word and man attains the fruits of delight through the ambrosial speech.

0.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ, ਅਤਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ।੧੩।
0.e: Ineffable is the story of the unmanifest Lord; His dynamism is unknowable.

0.g: ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਨਕ ਬਨੇ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ; ਪਾਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਆਜ ਮੇਰੋ ਆਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Himself holy and capable of making other pious-the friendly True Guru has come into my dream beautifully attired and adored. It is indeed a wonderful marvel for me.

0.g: ਪਰਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਮੁਖ; ਬਚਨ ਰਸਾਲ ਮਧੁ ਮਧੁਰ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Beloved Lord is sweet of words, big eyed and clement of form. Believe me! It is like He blessing us with honeyed elixir.

0.g: ਸੋਭਿਤ ਸਿਜਾਸਨ ਬਿਲਾਸਨ ਦੈ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੁਇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ।
0.e: He looked pleased and honoured me by occupying my bedlike heart. I was lost in the love filled trance of Nam Amrit that merged me into a state of equipoise.

0.g: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਖੀਆ ਉਘਰਿ ਗਈ; ਭਈ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਰਹ ਜਗਾਏ ਹੈ ।੨੦੫।
0.e: Enjoying the bliss of divine dream, I was woken up by the voice of rain-bird and that broke my celestial dream. The awe and marvel of love-filled state disappeared reawakening the pangs of separation. I was restless like a fish out of water. (205)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਕੈ; ਚੇਲੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ, ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਚੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Absorbing consciousness in the Word, the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.

0.g: ਵਾਣਾ ਤਾਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ; ਸੂਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਕਪੜੁ ਮੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Ward and weft are separate names but in the form of yam they are one and are known as the one, cloth.

0.g: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਦਹੀਅਹੁ ਮਖਣੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: The same milk becomes curd and from curd is made butter to be used variously.

0.g: ਮਿਸਰੀ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ; ਜਾਣੁ ਕਮਾਦਹੁ ਰੇਲਾ ਪੇਲਾ ।
0.e: From the sugar cane juice are prepared the lump sugar and other forms of sugar.

0.g: ਖੀਰਿ ਖੰਡੁ ਘਿਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ; ਅਤਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Mixing the milk, sugar, ghee etc. many dainty dishes are prepared.

0.g: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਚੂਨੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ।
0.e: Likewise when betal, betel nut, catechu and lime are mixed, they produce a beautiful colour.

0.g: ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੀਕੁ, ਨਵੇਲਾ ।੧੦।
0.e: In the same way the grandson Guru Amar Das has been authentically established.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਕਾਰੂੰਜੜੇ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਬਗਰ ਕਾਸਾਈ ।
0.e: Many are green grocers, many are makers of kuppas, large vessels made from raw hide usually for holding and carrying oil, and may more are butchers.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਮੁਨਿਆਰ ਲਖ; ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਅਰਾਈ ।
0.e: Many are toy and bangle sellers and many are leather workers and vegetable growers-cum-sellers.

0.g: ਭੰਗਹੇਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਬਗਨੀਗਰਾਂ ਕਲਾਲ ਹਵਾਈ ।
0.e: Many are toy and bangle sellers and many are leather workers and vegetable growers-cum-sellers.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਭੰਗੀ ਪੋਸਤੀ; ਅਮਲੀ ਸੋਫੀ ਘਣੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ ।
0.e: Millions drink hemp and many are brewers of wine from rice and barley, and confectioners are also many there.

0.g: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਕਹਾਰ ਲਖ; ਗੁਜਰ ਲਖ ਅਹੀਰ ਗਣਾਈ ।
0.e: Millions of cattle breeders, palanquin bearers and milk-men may be presently counted.

0.g: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਹੀ ਲਖ ਚੂਹੜੇ; ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ ਅਲਾਈ ।
0.e: Millions of scavengers and outcaste pariahs (chandal) are there.

0.g: ਨਾਵ ਥਾਵ ਲਖ, ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ।੨੩।
0.e: Thus myriads are names and places which cannot be counted.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬
ਪਥਰੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ; ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸੈ ।
0.e: Even after remaining in water for a hundred years the stone would not get wet at all.

0.g: ਪਥਰ ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਜੰਮਈ; ਚਾਰਿ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਇੰਦਰੁ ਵਰਸੈ ।
0.e: It may rain for four months continuously, but a stone would not sprout in the field.

0.g: ਪਥਰਿ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਰਗੜੀਏ; ਚੰਨਣ ਵਾਂਗਿ ਨ ਪਥਰੁ ਘਸੈ ।
0.e: A stone grinding sandal, never gets worn off like sandal.

0.g: ਸਿਲ ਵਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਪੀਸਦੇ; ਰਸ ਕਸ ਜਾਣੇ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਰਸੈ ।
0.e: Grinding stones always grind the material but never know about the taste and virtues of the things ground.

0.g: ਚਕੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਹੰਸ ਵਾਰ; ਖਾਇ ਨ ਪੀਐ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਤਸੈ ।
0.e: The grinding stone moves around thousands of times but it never feels hunger or thirst.

0.g: ਪਥਰ ਘੜੈ ਵਰਤਣਾ; ਹੇਠਿ ਉਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਘੜਾ ਵਿਣਸੈ ।
0.e: The relationship between the stone and the pitcher is such that pitcher has to perish whether the stone strikes the pitcher or vice versa.

0.g: ਮੂਰਖ, ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਸ ਅਪਜਸੈ ।੬।
0.e: The stupid does not understand the difference between fame and infamy.

0.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Satguru's sermon (in the form of blessing of Naam) is complete contemplation of the Master Lord, His knowledge and is total worship.

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As water mixes with several colours and acquires the same hue, similarly a disciple following Guru's advice becomes one with God.

0.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ; ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਅਵੇਸ ਹੈ ।
0.e: As many metals when touched with philosopher stone become gold, bushes and plants grown in the vicinity of sandalwood attain its fragrance, similarly a devotee following Guru's advice becomes pure and one who spreads the fragrance of goodness all around.

0.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ; ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਅਦੇਸ ਹੈ ।੧੩੩।
0.e: Making prayers and supplications to the Almighty Lord, a wise and rationalist person enjoins the divine radiance of the Omnipresent Lord like warp and weft of a fabric through complete faith and devotion instilled in him by the Guru. (133)

0.g: ਹਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਝਗਰੋ ਮਿਟਤ, ਰੋਸ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਹੁਇ; ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰੇ ਲਾਗਤ ਨ ਡੰਡੁ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Accepting defeat ends all discords. Shedding anger gives much peace. If we discard the results/income of all our deeds/business, we are never taxed. This fact is known to the whole world.

0.g: ਹਉਮੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਲੁ; ਨਿਮਤ ਨਵਨ ਥਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: The heart where ego and pride dwells is like a high ground where no water can accumulate. Lord cannot stay either.

0.g: ਅੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਤਰਹਰ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਚਰਨ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਤ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ।
0.e: Feet are located at the lowest end of the body. That is why the dust of the feet and the foot wash are regarded sacred and thus respected.

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿੰਮਰੀਭੂਤ; ਜਗ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ ।੨੮੮।
0.e: So is the devotee and worshipper of God who is sans pride and full of humility. The whole world falls at his feet and consider their forehead blessed. (288)

0.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
0.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace if divine preceptor

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਜਾਇ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਡਿਠਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who go to have the glimpse of the Guru.

0.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਭਾ ਬਹਿਠਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who touching the feet sit in the assembly of the Guru.

0.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੋਲ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਮਿਠਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who speak sweet.

0.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਇਠਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who prefer their fellow disciples to their sons and friends.

0.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਅਭਿਰਿਠਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who love the service to the Guru.

0.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ; ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ਸਰਿਠਾ ।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto those Gursikhs who get across and make other creatures also swim across.

0.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਲਿਆ, ਪਾਪ ਪਣਿਠਾ ।੧।
0.e: Meeting such Gursikhs, all the sins are removed.

0.g: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਡੁਲੀ; ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਖਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ।
0.e: In her mother's home the girl is fondled and dearly loved by parents.

0.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਭਿਰਾਵਾਂ ਭੈਨੜੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਦਕ ਸਪਰਵਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Among the brothers she is a sister and lives joyfully in the full fledged families of the maternal and the paternal grand fathers.

0.g: ਲਖਾਂ ਖਰਚ ਵਿਆਹੀਐ; ਗਹਣੇ ਦਾਜੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Then offering ornaments and dowry etc. and by spending lacs of rupees she is married.

0.g: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਨੀਐ; ਸਣਖਤੀ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰੀ ।
0.e: In her father-in-law's house she is accepted as title married wife.

0.g: ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਜੜੀ; ਛਤੀਹ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ।
0.e: She enjoys with her husband, eats variety of foods and always remains bedecked.

0.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ; ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੀ ।
0.e: From a temporal and spiritual point of view, women is half man's body and assists to the door of deliverance.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ, ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਾਰੀ ।੧੬।
0.e: She assuredly brings happiness to the virtuous.

0.g: ਆਂਧਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ ਚਰ ਟੇਕ; ਬਹਰੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A blind person has support of the words, ability to hear, hands and feet. A deaf has much reliance on his hands feet, vision of the eyes and the words that he speaks.

0.g: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਟੇਕ ਚਰ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ; ਲੂਲੇ ਟੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਪਦ ਹੈ ।
0.e: A dumb has support of ears for listening, feet, hands vision of the eyes. A handless person relies much on eyes speech, hearing and feet.

0.g: ਪਾਗੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ; ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਅਛਦ ਹੈ ।
0.e: One who is lame or without legs rely on sight of his eyes speech, ability to hear, and use of his hands. Despite capacitated of one limb or faculty, the dependence on others remain hidden.

0.g: ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਸੁੰਨ ਪੰਗ ਲੁੰਜ ਦੁਖ ਪੁੰਜ ਮਮ; ਅੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪਰਬੀਨ ਸਦ ਹੈ ।੩੧੪।
0.e: But I am blind, dumb, deaf, maimed of hand and feet a mass of suffering. 0 my True Lord! You are the wisest and completely informed of all my innate pains. 0 My Lord, please be merciful and remove all my pains. (314)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯
ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ, ਛਡਿ ਮਣੀ ਮਨੂਰੀ ।
0.e: The Sikh of the Guru, falling at the feet (of Guru) forswears his ego and desires of mind.

0.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਹਣਾ, ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਮਜੂਰੀ ।
0.e: He fetches water, fans the congregation, grinds flour (for latigar) and does all manual jobs.

0.e: By worshipping the life granting and bestower of all treasures of the world, he becomes like a philosopher-stone. Whosoever comes in his contact, he does good turn to him. (261)

0.e: Repudiating the parents, meditation in the forest is similar to the wanderings at deserted places.

0.e: The service and worship to the gods and goddesses are useless if one has renounced his parents.

0.e: Without service to the parents, bath at the sixty-eight pilgrimage centres is nothing but gyrating in a whirlpool.

0.e: The person who having deserted his parents performs charities, is corrupt and ignorant.

0.e: He who repudiating the parents undertakes fasts, goes on to wander in the cycle of births and deaths.

0.e: That man (in fact) has not understood the essence of Guru and God.

0.g: ਕਤ ਪੁਨ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਕਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ।

0.e: When will I get a chance to write the name of the Lord on the paper-like mind with the conscious-like ink? Therefore I should write the True Guru blessed word on the paper-like heart and reach the self-realisation (through constant meditation).  (500)

0.e: From convention and the knowledge given by the Guru also the same (conclusion) emerges that the dust of the (feet of) sadh

0.e: The fallen ones are made meritorious and the meritorious ones are further transformed into sacred ones.

0.g: ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਮਿਤ; ਸੇਖ ਸਹਸ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The glory of the wash nectar of the feet of sadhus is limitless; even Stesanag (thouosand hooded mythological snake) while

0.e: Eulogizing the Lord by its many a mouth could not know it. The dust of sadhu's feet has erased all debts and because of that feet-wash nectar, the mind has also come under control.

0.e: Gurmukh first himself bowed at the feet and then he made the whole world fall at his feet.

0.e: In Lahore from the family of Sodhis the elderly uncle Sahari Mal is the close Sikh of the Guru.

0.e: Sain Ditta of Jhanjhi caste and Saido, the Jatt, are thinkers of the Word of the Guru.

0.e: From among the Patolis, Bhai Lakhu and Bhai Ladha are the altruists.

0.g: ਕਾਲੂ ਨਾਨੋ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਇ; ਹਾੜੀ ਕੋਹਲੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Bhai kalu and Bhai Nano, both masons, and from among the Kohlis, Bhai Hari is a grand Sikh.

0.g: ਸੂਦੁ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਸੂਰਮਾ; ਭਾਨੂ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ।
0.e: Kalyana Sud is the brave one and Bhanu, the devotee is a thinker of the Guru’s Word.

ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸਨਾ ਮੁਹਜੰਗੀਆ; ਸੇਠ ਮੰਗੀਣੇ ਨੋ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ।
0.e: A devotee from Mujang is known by the name of Kisana and I am sacrifice unto Mangina, the wealthy person.

0.g: ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਨਿਆਰਾ ਭਲਾ; ਨਾਉ ਨਿਹਾਲੂ ਸਪਰਵਾਰੀ ।
0.e: A goldsmith named Nihalu along with his family remains present before the Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ, ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ।੨੫।
0.e: These all have performed delight giving perfect devotion bestowed by the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ, ਜਗਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Blest is the birth of a gurmukh and his coming to this world.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ, ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ।
0.e: In accordance with the wisdom of the Guru he deletes his ego and accomplishes the (virtuous) actions.

0.e: He works controlled by his love for work and loving devotion, and receives the pleasure fruit (of life).

0.e: The inaccessible teachings of the Guru he adopts in his heart.

0.e: Keeping of the flag of forbearance and dharma high, becomes his innate nature.

0.e: He bows before the will of the Lord and never suffers any fear or sorrow.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬

0.e: Having listened to the teachings of the Guru the disciple and the Guru become one (in form and spirit).

0.e: He with single mind adores the one Lord and keeps his straying mind under control.

0.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ; ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ।
0.e: He becomes obedient servant of the lord and loves His will and command.

0.e: Any rare Sikh becoming disciple be a dead person enters the guru-grave.

0.e: Falling on the feet and becoming dust of the feet, he reposes his head on the feet of the Guru.

0.e: Becoming one with Him he loses his ego and now the sense of duality is nowhere visible with him.

0.e: Such an accomplishment is had only by Sikh of the Guru.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਫਲ ਚਾਖਤ ਭਈ ਉਲਟੀ; ਤਨ ਸਨਾਤਨ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Enjoying the taste of the pleasure-giving True Guru blessed Naam elixir, practicing the command of the Guru diligently, the inclinations of such Sikhs of the Guru turn away from the worldly attractions.

0.e: The base intellect is shed and the wisdom of Guru comes and resides in them. They are then known not as unworthy of trust but persons of divine traits.

0.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਲਟਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਭਏ; ਬਗ ਬੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Freeing themselves from the affairs of the world, the mammon entangled people become the devotees of the formless God. By the True Guru blessed knowledge, they become praise worthy like a swan from that of a heron like inclination.

0.e: By obeying the command of Guru of doing Naam Simran, those who were under the influence of worldly affairs now become their masters. They become aware of the Lord's indefinable traits who is the creator, the sustainer and destroyer of all things in the Un

0.e: Just as sweetmeats are hidden carefully and yet ants reach it with impunity and cling to them,

0.e: Just as a lit lamp is carefully hidden in the house, yet a moth is able to find it and merges in its flame,

0.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਇਕਾਂਤ ਬਸੈ; ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਧੁ ਅਚਵਨ ਤਹ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ।
0.e: Just as the lotus flower of fresh and clean water blooms in solitary place, but the black bee always reaches it to enjoy its elixir,

0.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ; ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਿਹਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ।੪੧੦।
0.e: So does a devoted disciple of the True Guru whose heart is kindled with the Love of the Lord, the whole world beseeches and whines at his door.  (410)

0.e: The gurmukh never carries on his back the nine treasures and eight miraculous powers.

0.e: Wish fulfilling cow and millions of Laksamis, 'With their fine gestures cannot reach a gursikh — Sikh of the Guru.

0.e: The Sikh of the Guru never touches the philosopher's stone or transitory fruits millions of wishfulfilling trees.

0.e: Millions of tantrists knowing mantras and tantras are mere naked acrobats for a Sikh of the Guru.

0.e: The Sikh of the Guru is ever shy of the sense of duality.

0.e: Amidst the four vamas and six philosophies the way of the gurmukh is the way of adoption of truth.

0.g: ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਘਨ ਗਰਜਤ ਅਤਿ; ਚੰਚਲ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Their thunder produces a very strong sound and sprightly lightning flashes.

0.g: ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਤਾ ਤੇ; ਅਉਖਧੀ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜੀ ।
0.e: Then sweet, cold, nectar-like raindrops from where a swati drop falls on oyster to produce a pearl, camphor when it falls on a plantain beside producing many useful herbs.

0.g: ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਜਗ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਉ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਜੀ ।੩੨੫।
0.e: Like good-doer cloud, the body of Guru-conscious disciple is divine. He is free from the cycle of birth and death. He comes to this world to do good. He helps others reach and realise Lord. (325)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੩
ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਗਦ ਲੂਣ ਜਿਉ; ਘਿਅ ਚੋਪੜਿ ਪਾਏ ।
0.e: Applying butter to the paper and salt they can be put into water (they will take longer time to dissolve).

0.g: ਦੀਵੇ ਵਟੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੇ; ਸਭ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਲਾਏ ।
0.e: With the help of oil, the wick of the lamp goes on burning the whole night.

0.g: ਵਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਰ ਫੜਿ; ਗੁਡੀ ਓਡਾਏ ।
0.e: Catching hold of the string, the kite could be made to fly in the sky.

0.g: ਮੁਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਰੜ ਦੁਗਾਰੁ ਪਾਇ; ਜਿਉ ਸਪੁ ਲੜਾਏ ।
0.e: By keeping an herb in the mouth, one could get bitten by serpent.

0.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਿਟਾਏ ।
0.e: If the king goes out in the guise of a faquire, he could listen to the sufferings of people and remove them.

0.g: ਸਾਂਗੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਬਤਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਹਾਏ ।੨੩।੩੫। ਪੈਂਤੀਹ ।
0.e: In such a feat only he passes the test who is helped by the Guru.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਹੁ; ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਮਰ ਅਮਰਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: From the true Guru (Angad Dev) becoming the truthful Guru, Amar

0.g: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ, ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ; ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Has enacted a wondrous feat. The same light, the same seat and the same will of Lord is being spread by him.

0.g: ਖੋਲਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: He has opened up the storehouse of word and has made the truth manifest through the holy congregation.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ; ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਲੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Making the disciple authentic, the Guru has put all the four varnas at his feet.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Now all becoming gurmukhs adore the one Lord and evil wisdom and duality have been wiped out of them.

0.g: ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਭ; ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Now the duty of the family and the teaching of the Guru is that one should be detacthed while living amidst maya

0.g: ਪੂਰੇ, ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ।੧੨।
0.e: The perfect Guru has created the perfect grandeur.

0.g: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਬਿਮੋਹਤ ਮਗਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Lord whose one transverse glance can infatuate millions of people of the regions and realms in maya, that God, enamoured by the love of the assembly of true God-loving meditating people remains absorbed in them.

0.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ; ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਸੋ ਲਗਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Lord whose expanse and forms are indescribable, He remains involved in the pious people through the singing of His hymns of praise.

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੇ; ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਗੁਨਨੁ ਅਗਨ ਹੈ ।
0.e: The Lord who has the services of all the three deities and the four sons of Brahma at His beck and call and obedience, that Lord of countless traits remains obedient in the company of the holy and saintly persons who are ever engrossed in Him.

0.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਾਧ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ; ਅਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਅਭਗਨ ਹੈ ।੩੦੨।
0.e: Praise of congregation immersed in His loving remembrance is beyond comprehension. A Guru-conscious devotee remains in love with Him like a fish in water. (302)

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮
ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ, ਥਾਪ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ।
0.e: With one word (sound) the Lord creates the universe and destroyes it.

0.g: ਤਿਦੂ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ, ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ।
0.e: From that very Lord myriads of life streams have emerged and there is no end to them.

0.g: ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਸਮਾਉ, ਨ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ ।
0.e: Millions of universes subsume in Him but He is uninfluenced by any of them.

0.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਉ, ਲਖ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ।
0.e: He sees His own activities with great enthusiasm and makes many a man glorious

0.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਅਰਥਾਉ, ਵਰ ਨ ਸਰਾਪ ਦਾ ।
0.e: Who can decode the mystery and meaning of the principle of His boons and curses?

0.g: ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ, ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਦਾ ।੧੮।
0.e: He accepts not only the (mental) repentance of sins and virtues (and accepts the good deeds).

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਾਣਿ, ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ।
0.e: Those who, accepting Guru as God have sought shelter in the Lord.

0.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ, ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Those who have put their heart at the feet of Lord, never become perishable.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ, ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: They, getting deeply rooted in the wisdom of Guru, attain themselves.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ, ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ।
0.e: They adopt the daily routine of the Gurmukhs, and Gods Will becomes dear to them.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ, ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: As Gurmukhs, losing their ego, they merge in the truth.

0.g: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ, ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ।੨੧।੨੦। ਵੀਹ ।
0.e: Their birth in the world is meaningful and they across the whole world also.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫
ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜਿਐ ਲੁਕ ਜਾਨਿ; ਉਲੂ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਜਗਿ ਮਾਹੀ ।
0.e: On sun-rise, the owls blind like wall hide themselves in the world.

0.g: ਬੁਕੇ ਸਿੰਘ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ; ਜੰਬੁਕ ਮਿਰਗ ਨ ਖੋਜੇ ਪਾਹੀ ।
0.e: When the lion roars in the jungle, the jackals, deer etc. are not found around.

0.g: ਚੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਚੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ; ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਨਾਲੀ ਲੁਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ।
0.e: Moon in the sky cannot be concealed behind a small plate.

0.g: ਪੰਖੀ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ; ਡਿਠੇ ਬਾਜ ਨ ਠਉਰਿ ਰਹਾਹੀ ।
0.e: Seeing a hawk all the birds in the forest leave their places and become restive (and flutter for their safety).

0.g: ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ; ਦਿਹੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ।
0.e: Thieves, adulterers and corrupt ones are not seen around after day break.

0.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੋਇ; ਲਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ।
0.e: Those, who have knowledge in their heart improve the intellect of lacs of ignorants.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨੈ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਿ; ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸ ਬਿਨਾਹੀ ।
0.e: The glimpse of the holy congregation decimates all the tensions suffered in the kaliyug, the dark age.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ, ਵਿਟਹੁਂ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਹੀ ।੫।
0.e: I am sacrifice unto the holy congrega­tion.

0.g: ਤਾਰੇ ਲਖ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰ ਵਿਚਿ, ਚੜ੍ਹਿਐ ਸੁਝਿ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਕੋਈ ।
0.e: Myraid stars exist in the darkness but with the rise of the sun no one remains visible.

0.g: ਸੀਹਿ ਬੁਕੇ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲੀ; ਭੰਨੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਆਇ ਖੜੋਈ ।
0.e: Before the roar of the lion, flocks of deers take to their heels.

0.g: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਗਰੜੈ ਡਿਠਿਆ; ਖੁਡੀ ਵੜਿਦੇ ਲਖ ਪਲੋਈ ।
0.e: Seeing the large vulture (garur) the snakes crawl into their holes.

0.g: ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਸਾਹਬਾਜ ਦੇਖਿ; ਢੁਕਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਨਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ ।
0.e: Seeing a hawk, the birds fly helter skelter and do not find place to hide.

0.g: ਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ।
0.e: In this world of conduct and thought, in the holy congregation one gives up evil-mindedness.

0.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਵਾਸਾ ਗੋਈ ।
0.e: The true Guru is the true king who obliterates dilemma, and, evil propensities hide or vanish.

0.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਣੋਈ ।੧੨।
0.e: The Gurmukhs diffuse their knowledge among others (and they are not selfish people).

0.g: ਇਮ ਸ਼ਬ ਬ-ਤਮਾਸ਼ਾਇ ਰੁਖ਼ਿ ਯਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫ਼ਤ ।
0.e:
Goyaa says, "I keep entangling myself on the curls of the lock of your hair, O Guru!    
Because, my mind that keeps yearning with intense desire to see you is able to attain peace and stability.” (19) (7)
What can a doctor prescribe as a medication for a patient suffering from a keen love?
How can a pilot, the Guru, help to show the right path when we, ourselves have a crippled condition with lame legs? (20) (1)
All his (Guru's) glow and grace are visible without a camouflage,
When we are under the garb of ego, what can even a moon-like serene face do for us? (20) (2)
One who does not have any momentary direction or stability in his mind,
What can a placid spot or a quiet nook of a mansion do for him?" (20) (3)

0.g: ਸੂਇ ਬੁਤਿ ਆਸ਼ਕ-ਕੁਸ਼ ਅੱਯਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫ਼ਤ ।੧੨।੧।
0.e: How can you reach the court of the Beloved without a preceptor of love?

0.g: ਦਰ ਕੂਚਾਇ ਇਸ਼ਕ ਅਰ ਚਿ ਮੁਹਾਲ ਅਸਤ ਰਸੀਦਨ ।
0.e: What can a guide do to help if you lack the desire and the emotion?” (20) (4)

0.g: ਮਨਸੂਰ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਬਾ-ਕਦਿਮ ਦਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫ਼ਤ ।੧੨।੨।
0.e:
O Goyaa ! "As long as you are able to use the sacred dust of the feet of the Guru as a collyrium for your eyes,
You would be able to see the grace and refulgence of the Creator. What other use is the collyrium for you?" (20) (5)

0.g: ਐ ਦਿਲ ਬਸੂਇ ਮਦਰਿਸਾ ਗਰ ਮੈਲ ਨ ਦਾਰੀ ।
0.e: When the easterly breeze combs through the curls of his tresses,

0.g: ਬਾਰੇ ਬ-ਸੂਇ ਖ਼ਾਨਾਇ ਖ਼ੁਮਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫ਼ਤ ।੧੨।੩।
0.e: It is as if it is making a strange chain link for my insane mind. (21) (1)

0.g: ਚੂੰ ਖ਼ਾਤ੍ਰਿਮ ਅਜ਼ ਇਸ਼ਕਿ ਤੂ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਰਸ਼ਕਿ ਗੁਲਿਸਤਾਣ ।
0.e: We have not understood the significance of the human body since the dawn of creation, beginning of the time,

0.g: ਬੇ-ਹੁਦਾ ਚਿਰਾ ਜਾਨਬਿ ਗੁਲਜ਼ਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫ਼ਤ ।੧੨।੪।
0.e: That, the Lord created this body for His own abode. (21) (2)

0.g: ਐ ਦਿਲ ਚੂ ਸ਼ੁਦੀ ਵਾਕਿਫ਼ਿ ਅਸਰਾਰਿ ਇਲਾਹੀ ।
0.e: The heart of a lover becomes that of the beloved's in a short time;

0.g: ਦਰ ਸੀਨਾ-ਅੱਮ ਐ ਮਖਜ਼ਨਿ ਅਸਰਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫਤ ।੧੨।੫।
0.e: Anyone who is on good terms with the beloved becomes the heart and soul from feet to the head (all over his body). (21) (3)

0.g: ਸਦ ਰੌਜ਼ਾਇ ਰਿਜ਼ਵਾਨਸਤ ਚੂ ਦਰ ਖਾਨਾ ਸ਼ਿਗੁਫ਼ਤਾ ।
0.e: Why are you running after (every) mean person for a morsel of bread?

0.g: ਗੋਯਾ ਬ-ਚਿਹ ਸੂਇ ਦਰੋ ਦੀਵਾਰ ਤਵਾਣ ਰਫ਼ਤ ।੧੨।੬।
0.e: You know well that the greed for just one grain makes one a prisoner. (21) (4)

0.g: ਹਵਾਇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਆਵੁਰਦ ਦਰ ਵਜੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।
0.e: The attraction of meditation and religious devotion brought me into this world,

0.g: ਵਗਰਨਾ ਜ਼ੋਕਿ ਚੁਨੀਂ ਨ ਬੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।੧।
0.e: Otherwise, I had no urge to come. (1) (1)

0.g: ਖੁਸ਼ ਅਸਤ ਉਮਰ ਕਿਹ ਦਰ ਯਾਦ ਬਿਗੁਜ਼ਰਦ ਵਰਨਾ ।
0.e: Only that part of my life is useful and happy that is spent in remembering the Akaalpurakh

0.g: ਚਿ ਹਾਸਲ ਅਸਤ ਅਜ਼ੀਣ ਗੁੰਬਦਿ ਕਬੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।੨।
0.e: Otherwise what is the benefit to me from this blue sky or the world. (1) (2)

0.g: ਦਰਾਂ ਜ਼ਮਾਂ ਕਿ ਨਿਆਈ ਬ-ਯਾਦ ਮੀ-ਮਰਮ ।
0.e: For any moment that you are out of my remembrance, I feel that I am dying,

0.g: ਬਗ਼ੈਰ ਯਾਦਿ ਤੂ ਜ਼ੀਂ ਜ਼ੀਸਤਨ ਚਿਹ ਸੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।੩।
0.e: What is the purpose of my life (it became worthless) without your reminiscence.(1) (3)

0.g: ਫ਼ਿਦਾਸਤ ਜਾਨੋ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਨ ਬ-ਖ਼ਾਕਿ ਮਰਦਮਿ ਪਾਕ ।
0.e: I can sacrifice my heart and soul uninhibitedly for (the dust of the feet of) this holy person

0.g: ਹਰ ਆਂ ਕਸੇ ਕਿਹ ਬੂ-ਸੂਇ ਤੂ ਰਹਿ ਨਮੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।੪।
0.e: Who has shown me the way to You, the Akaalpurakh. (1) (4)

0.g: ਨਬੂਦ ਹੀਚ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਹਾ ਜ਼ਿ-ਆਸਮਾਨੋ ਜ਼ਮੀਂ ।
0.e: There was no sign-posts on the Pilgrim's way through earth or sky at that time,

0.g: ਕਿ ਸ਼ੌਕਿ ਰੂਇ ਤੂ ਆਵੁਰਦ ਦਰ ਸਜੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।੫।
0.e: When my longing for Your glimpse made me prostrate in Your honor. (1) (5)

0.g: ਬਗ਼ੈਰ ਯਾਦਿ ਤੂ ਗੋਯਾ ਨਮੀ ਤਵਾਨਮ ਜ਼ੀਸਤ ।
0.e:
O Goya! "I cannot live without Your remembrance, If pining for you ceases, then an end to life is the only thing coveted;
I will be free then to move in the direction of my Beloved." (1) (6)

0.g: ਬਸੂਇ ਦੋਸਤ ਰਹਾਈ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਜ਼ੂਦ ਮਰਾ ।੬।੧।
0.e: Both the religion and the actions of the world are in the grip of my beloved, handsome and fairy-faced friend.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨
ਨੀਲਾਰੀ ਦੇ ਮਟ ਵਿਚਿ; ਪੈ ਗਿਦੜੁ ਰਤਾ ।
0.e: Once a jackal fell into a dyer's vat and got dyed.

0.e: Thus, the dissembler out of his own hypocrisis is beaten hollow in the court of the Lord.

0.e: A Master looks graceful and befitting only among the Masters,

0.e: The character of Masters is to be master-like,

0.e: And, the meditation of a human being is permanent. (248)

0.e: For this, you have turned your head away from Him, you have strayed;

0.e: It has no deep roots and fast winds uproot it.

0.e: Just as a black bee is never satiated enjoying the fragrance of the flowers, a bird's desire to fly in sky never decreases.

0.e: So is the love of a Guru-conscious saint, the seeker of ambrosial nectar for his dear True Guru. The longing of love for his Guru that has permeated in every limb of his body and is flowing rapidly never decreases.  (424)

ਸਤਜੁਗ ਦਾ ਅਨਿਆਉ ਵੇਖਿ; ਧਉਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਉਡੀਣਾ ।

0.e: Even the king of gods, Indr, and other kings with vast empires, engrossed egoism, devoid of power and wisdom could not sust

0.e: In Treta- its one foot slipped and now religious people started feeling satisfied by mere performance of the ceremonies of

0.g: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮ ਦੇ; ਪੂਜਾ ਚਾਰ ਪਖੰਡੁ ਅਲੀਣਾ ।

0.e: True Guru, the power of the powerless, has made it (dharma) manifest by and through creating the holy Icongretgations.

0.e: The gurmukhs have brought to perfection the dharma earlier reduced to dust.

0.e: The word of the Guru is the glimpse of the Guru and getting settled in one's own self, the discipline of loving devotion is observed.

0.e: This discipline consists in sweet speech, humble conduct, honest labour, hospitality and in remaining detached among hopes and disappointments.

0.e: Living in equi­poise and indifference is true renunciation in the Kaliyug, the dark age.

0.e: Just as a black bee keep searching and smelling elixir from various lotus flowers, but one day it is caught in the boxlike flower.

0.e: (Although water is cold and fire is hot) falling in water drowns while jumping into fire burns a person to death. Similarly it is foolish to believe on the kindness or anger of another woman. (It is utter foolishness to lay faith on any other god/goddess

0.e: Siddhs spoke, Listen O Nanak! You have shown miracles to the world.

0.e: Why are you late in showing some to us.

0.e: Baba replied, O respected Nath! I have nothing worth showing to you.

0.e: I have no support except of the Guru (God), holy congregation, and the Word (bani).

0.g: ਸਿਵ ਰੂਪੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਚਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਚਲਾਈ ।
0.e: That Paramatman who is all full of benedictions (sivam) for all is stable and the earth (and material over it) is transitory.

0.g: ਸਿਧਿ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ; ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਕਲਾ ਛਪਾਈ ।
0.e: The siddhs exhausted themselves with the tantra-mantras but the world of Lord did not allow their powers to come up.

0.g: ਦਦੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਕਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ।
0.e: The Guru is the giver and no one can gauge his bounties.

0.g: ਸੋ ਦੀਨ ਨਾਨਕ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ।੪੨।
0.e: Utimately, the humbled yogis submitted before the true Guru Nanak.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭
ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਰਸਨਿ ਘਣੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Followers of six (Indian. philosophies) crave intensely but only gurmukh gets the glimpse of the Lord.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The six Shastras make one understand in a round about manner but gurmukhs make the teachings of the Guru firmly lodged in the heart.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ।
0.e: All the musical measures and melodies are wonder-struck to feel that

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ; ਸੂਰਜੁ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ।
0.e: The true Guru is such as the one sun remains stabilized in all the six seasons.

0.g: ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਚਖਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Such a pleasure-fruit has been attained by Gurmukhs, the taste of which could not be known by six pleasures.

0.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਣੇ; ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ।
0.e: Anchorites, followers of truth, long lived ones and universally acclaimed ones are all engrossed in delusions.

0.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ, ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ।੭।
0.e: Only joining the holy congregation, one could be absorbed in one's innate nature.

0.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪
ਕਾਲਾ ਧਉਲਾ ਰਤੜਾ; ਨੀਲਾ ਪੀਲਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Black, white, red, blue, yellow and green colours are adorning (the creation).

0.g: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦੁ; ਜੀਭਹੁੰ ਜਾਪ ਨ ਖਾਜ ਅਖਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Wondrous tastes of edible and inedible objects have been made which are known through the tongue.

0.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਟੁ ਤੁਰਸੁ; ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਸਲੂਣਾ ਛਾਜੇ ।
0.e: These tastes are sweet, bitter, sour, salty and insipid.

0.g: ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ; ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਕੇਸਰੁ ਕਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Mixing many fragrances, the camphor, sandal and saffron have been created.

0.g: ਮੇਦੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਪਾਨ ਫੁਲੁ; ਅੰਬਰੁ ਚੂਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਅੰਦਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Others such as musk cat, musk, betel, flowers, incense, camphors etc are also held to be similar.

0.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਬਹੁ; ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਗਾਜੇ ।
0.e: Many are the musical measures, vibrations and dialogues, and through fourteen skills the unstruck melody rings.

0.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ, ਕਰੋੜ ਜਹਾਜੇ ।੪।
0.e: Lacs of rivers are there on which crores of ships ply.

1.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.

1.g: ਜਾਪੁ ॥
1.e: Name of the Bani : Japu Sahib

1.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖਵਾਕ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
1.e: The sacred utterance of The Tenth Sovereign:

1.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1.e: CHHAPAI STANZA. BY THY GRACE

1.g: ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਅਰੁ ਬਰਨ; ਜਾਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਤਿ ਨਹਿਨ ਜਿਹ ॥
1.e: He who is without mark or sign, He who is without caste or line.

1.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਰੇਖ ਭੇਖ; ਕੋਊ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਕਿਹ ॥
1.e: He who is without colour or form, and without any distinctive norm.

1.g: ਅਚਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਅਮਿਤੋਜਿ ਕਹਿੱਜੈ ॥
1.e: He who is without limit and motion, All effulgence, non-descript Ocean.

1.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਣ; ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾਣਿ ਗਣਿਜੈ ॥
1.e: The Lord of millions of Indras and kings, the Master of all worlds and beings.

1.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹੀਪ, ਸੁਰ, ਨਰ, ਅਸੁਰ; ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ ਬਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕਹਤ ॥
1.e: Each twig of the foliage proclaims: “Not this Thou art.”

1.g: ਤਵ ਸਰਬ ਨਾਮ ਕਥੈ ਕਵਨ, ਕਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਰਨਤ ਸੁਮਤਿ ॥੧॥
1.e: All Thy Names cannot be told. One doth impart Thy Action-Name with benign heart.1.

1.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ; ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1.e: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

1.g: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
1.e: Chant And Meditate:

1.g: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ; ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
1.e: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

1.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
1.e: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

1.g: ਸੋਚੈ. ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
1.e: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times.

1.g: ਚੁਪੈ. ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
1.e: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

1.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ; ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
1.e: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

1.g: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ. ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ; ਤ ਇਕ. ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1.e: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

1.g: ਕਿਵ. ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ; ਕਿਵ. ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
1.e: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?

1.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
1.e: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

1.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਓ ਸਤ ।
1.e: Waaheguru is the Truth,

1.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਓ ਹਾਜ਼ਰ ਨਾਜ਼ਰ ਹੈ ।
1.e: Waaheguru is Omnipresent

1.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
1.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

1.g: ਨਮਸਤ੍ਵੰ ਅਕਾਲੇ ॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Timeless Lord

1.g: ਨਮਸਤ੍ਵੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੇ ॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Beneficent Lord!

1.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਅਰੂਪੇ ॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Formless Lord!

1.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਅਨੂਪੇ ॥੨॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Wonderful Lord! 2.

1.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਅਭੇਖੇ ॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Garbless Lord!

1.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਅਲੇਖੇ ॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Accountless Lord!

1.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਅਕਾਏ ॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Bodyless Lord!

1.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
1.e: Salutation to Thee O Unborn Lord!3.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ. ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ; ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
1.e: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ. ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ; ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1.e: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ, ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ, ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
1.e: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

1.g: ਇਕਨਾ. ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ; ਇਕਿ, ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
1.e: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1.e: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

1.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ; ਤ ਹਉਮੈ. ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
1.e: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

1.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਓ ਹਾਜ਼ਰ ਨਾਜ਼ਰ ਹੈ ।
1.e: Waaheguru is Omnipresent

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ; ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
1.e: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ; ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
1.e: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
1.e: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1.e: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
1.e: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
1.e: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ; ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
1.e: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

2.g: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ; ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
2.e: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

2.g: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ, ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
2.e: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

2.g: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ; ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ, ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
2.e: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

2.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ. ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
2.e: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

2.g: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ; ਦੋਸੀ. ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
2.e: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ, ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
2.e: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

2.g: ਤੇਹਾ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਜਿ. ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
2.e: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||
Waaheguru is the Truth,
Waaheguru is Omnipresent

2.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ; ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
2.e: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

2.g: ਆਖਹਿ. ਮੰਗਹਿ, ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ; ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
2.e: People beg and pray, "Give to us, give to us", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.

2.g: ਫੇਰਿ. ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ; ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
2.e: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?

2.g: ਮੁਹੌ. ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
2.e: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?

2.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ; ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
2.e: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.

2.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
2.e: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
2.e: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||

2.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ, ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ. ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
2.e: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

2.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ. ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
2.e: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?

2.g: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ, ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ; ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
2.e: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.
The Guru has given me this one understanding:

2.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ. ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸੋ. ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
2.e: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||
