18.g: ਜਲ ਕਹਾ, ਥਲ ਕਹਾ, ਗਗਨ ਕੇ ਗਉਨ ਕਹਾ; ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਬਨਾਇ, ਸਬੈ ਕਾਲ ਹੀ ਚਬਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥
18.e: Not only to speak of the residents of water, earth and wanders of the sky, all those created by god of death will ultimately be devoured ( destroyed) by him.

18.g: ਤੇਜ ਜਿਉ ਅਤੇਜ ਮੈ, ਅਤੇਜ ਜੈਸੇ ਤੇਜ ਲੀਨ; ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਪਜ, ਸਬੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਹਿਂਗੇ ॥੧੮॥੮੮॥
18.e: Just as the light merged in darkness and the darkness in the light all the created beings generated by the Lord will ultimately merge in Him. 18.88.

18.g: ਕੂਕਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਕੇਤੇ, ਰੋਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਕੇਤੇ; ਜਲ ਮੈਂ ਡੁਬਤ ਕੇਤੇ, ਆਗ ਮੈਂ ਜਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
18.e: Many cry out while wandering, many weep and many die many are drowned in water and many are burnt in fire.

18.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਗੰਗ ਬਾਸੀ, ਕੇਤੇ ਮਦੀਨਾ ਮਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਕੇਤਕ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕੇ, ਭ੍ਰਮਾਏ ਈ ਫਿਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
18.e: Many live on the banks of Ganges and many reside in Mecca and Medina, many becoming hermits, indulge in wanderings.

18.g: ਕਰਵਤ ਸਹਤ ਕੇਤੇ, ਭੂਮਿ ਮੈ ਗਡਤ ਕੇਤੇ; ਸੂਆ ਪੈ ਚੜ੍ਹਤ ਕੇਤੇ, ਦੂਖ ਕਉ ਭਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥
18.e: Many endure the agony of sawing, many get buried in the earth, many are hanged on the gallows and many undergo great angulish.

18.g: ਗੈਨ ਮੈਂ ਉਡਤ ਕੇਤੇ, ਜਲ ਮੈਂ ਰਹਤ ਕੇਤੇ; ਗਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਹੀਨ, ਜਕ ਜਾਰੇ ਈ ਮਰਤ ਹੈਂ ॥੧੯॥੮੯॥
18.e: Many fly in the sky, many lives in water and many without knowledge. In their waywardness burn themselves to death. 19.89.

18.g: ਸੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਦੇਵਤਾ, ਬਿਰੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਦਾਨੋ ਬਡੇ; ਬੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਬੋਧਕ, ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਹਾਰੇ ਜਾਪਸੀ ॥
18.e: The gods got weary of making offerings of fragrances, the antagonistic demons have got weary, he knowledgeable sages have got weary and worshippers of good understanding have also got weary.

18.g: ਘਸ ਹਾਰੇ ਚੰਦਨ, ਲਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਚੋਆ ਚਾਰੁ; ਪੂਜ ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ, ਚਢਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਲਾਪਸੀ ॥
18.e: Those who rub sandalwood have got tired, the appliers of fine scent (otto) have got tired, the image-worshippers have got tired and those making offerings of sweet curry, have also got tired.

18.g: ਗਾਹ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੋਰਨ, ਮਨਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੜ੍ਹੀ ਮਟ; ਲੀਪ ਹਾਰੇ ਭੀਤਨ, ਲਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਛਾਪਸੀ ॥
18.e: The visitors of graveyards have got tired, the worshippers of hermitages and monuments have got tired those who besmear the walls images have got tired and those who print with embossing seal have also got tired.

18.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ; ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
18.e: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

18.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ; ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
18.e: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

18.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ; ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
18.e: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

18.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
18.e: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

18.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ; ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
18.e: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

18.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
18.e: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

18.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
18.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

18.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
18.e: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

18.g: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ. ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
18.e: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

18.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ; ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
18.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

18.g: ਮੁੰਧੇ. ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
18.e: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

18.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
18.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

18.g: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ. ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
18.e: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

18.g: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
18.e: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

18.g: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ; ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
18.e: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

18.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
18.e: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

18.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ. ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
18.e: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

18.g: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ; ਆਖਣਿ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
18.e: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

18.g: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ; ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
18.e: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

18.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ; ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
18.e: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

18.g: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
18.e: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

18.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ; ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
18.e: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

18.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ. ਸੋ ਥੀਐ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
18.e: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ. ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
18.e: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

18.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
18.e: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

18.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
18.e: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

19.g: ਗਾਇ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ, ਬਜਾਏ ਹਾਰੇ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਸਭ; ਪਚ ਹਾਰੇ ਪੰਡਤ, ਤਪੰਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਤਾਪਸੀ ॥੨੦॥੯੦॥
19.e: Gandharvas, the musicians of goods have got tired, Kinnars, the players of musical instruments have got tired, the Pundits have got highly weary and the ascetics observing austerities have also got tired. None of the above-mentioned people have been able

19.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
19.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

19.g: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ. ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
19.e: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

19.g: ਅਉਗਣ. ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ; ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
19.e: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

19.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਭਰਮਾਈਐ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
19.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

19.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
19.e: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

19.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
19.e: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

19.g: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
19.e: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

19.g: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
19.e: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

19.g: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
19.e: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

19.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ. ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ; ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
19.e: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

19.g: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
19.e: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

19.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
19.e: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

19.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ; ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
19.e: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.

19.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
19.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

19.g: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ; ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
19.e: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

19.g: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ. ਵਿਝਵੀ; ਧੂਉ. ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
19.e: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

19.g: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
19.e: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

19.g: ਮੂੜੇ; ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
19.e: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

19.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ; ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
19.e: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

19.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
19.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

19.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ. ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
19.e: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

19.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
19.e: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

19.g: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ, ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ; ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
19.e: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

19.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ, ਹਉ ਮੁਈ; ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
19.e: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

19.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
19.e: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

19.g: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
19.e: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

19.g: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ. ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ; ਨਾ ਆਵੈ. ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
19.e: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

19.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ; ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
19.e: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

19.g: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ; ਦਰਗਹ. ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
19.e: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

19.g: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਭੁਲਈ; ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
19.e: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

19.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
19.e: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

19.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ; ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
19.e: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

19.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ. ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
19.e: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

19.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
19.e: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

19.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਚੁਕਈ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ. ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
19.e: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

19.g: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ; ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
19.e: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

19.g: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ; ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
19.e: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

19.g: ਜੇ ਧਨ. ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
19.e: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

19.g: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ; ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
19.e: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

19.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ. ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ; ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
19.e: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

19.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
19.e: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

19.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
19.e: BY THY GRACE. BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

19.g: ਨ ਰਾਗੰ ਨ ਰੰਗੰ, ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
19.e: The Lord is without an affection, without colour, without form and without line.

19.g: ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਹੰ, ਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੰ ਨ ਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ॥
19.e: He without attachment, without anger, without deceit and without malice.

19.g: ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ, ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ॥
19.e: He is actionless, illusionless, birthless and casteless.

19.g: ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ, ਨ ਪਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ ॥੧॥੯੧॥
19.e: He is sans friend, sans enemy, sans father and sans mother.1.91.

19.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ, ਨ ਕਾਮੰ ਨ ਧਾਮੰ ॥
19.e: He is without love, without home, without just and without home.

19.g: ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ, ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਭਾਮੰ ॥
19.e: He is without son, without friend, without enemy and without wife.

20.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
20.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

20.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
20.e: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

20.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
20.e: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

20.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
20.e: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

20.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ. ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
20.e: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
20.e: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

20.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ; ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
20.e: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

20.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
20.e: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

20.g: ਓਹੁ. ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
20.e: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

20.g: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ; ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
20.e: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

20.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ. ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
20.e: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

20.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
20.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

20.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ; ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
20.e: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

20.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
20.e: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

20.g: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
20.e: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

20.g: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ. ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ; ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
20.e: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

20.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ; ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
20.e: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

20.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
20.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

20.g: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ; ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
20.e: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

20.g: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ; ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
20.e: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

20.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
20.e: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

20.g: ਜੀਅਰੇ; ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
20.e: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

20.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ; ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
20.e: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

20.g: ਅਲੇਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ, ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
20.e: He is accountless, guiseless, and Unborn entity.

20.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਧ ਦਾ, ਬੁਧਿ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਰੂਪੰ ॥੨॥੯੨॥
20.e: He is ever the Giver of Power and Intellect, He is most Beautiful. 2.92.

20.g: ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਨ ਜਾਈ, ਕਛੂ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
20.e: Nothing can be known about His Form and Mark.

20.g: ਕਹਾ ਬਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ, ਫਿਰੈ ਕਉਨ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
20.e: Where doth He live? In what Garb He moves?

20.g: ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ, ਕਹਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
20.e: What is His Name? Of what Place He is told?

20.g: ਕਹਾ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੋ, ਕਹੇ ਮੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥੯੩॥
20.e: How should He be described? Nothing can be said. 3.93.

20.g: ਨ ਰੋਗੰ ਨ ਸੋਗੰ, ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ ॥
20.e: He is without ailment, without sorrow, without attachment and without mother.

20.g: ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ, ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ॥
20.e: He is without work, without illusion, without birth and without caste.

20.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
20.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

20.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ; ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
20.e: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

20.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ. ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ; ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
20.e: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

20.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ. ਬੂਡੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
20.e: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

20.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
20.e: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

20.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ; ਮੈ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
20.e: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

20.g: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ. ਡਉ ਜਲੈ; ਪਾਛੈ. ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
20.e: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

20.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ. ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
20.e: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

20.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ; ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
20.e: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

20.g: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
20.e: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

20.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
20.e: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

20.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂ ਧਣੀ; ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
20.e: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

20.g: ਜਿਨਿ. ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
20.e: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
20.e: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

20.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ; ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
20.e: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
20.e: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

20.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ; ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
20.e: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

20.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
20.e: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

21.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
21.e: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

21.g: ਮੁਇਆ. ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
21.e: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

21.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
21.e: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

21.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
21.e: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

21.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
21.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

21.g: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ; ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
21.e: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

21.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ. ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
21.e: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

21.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ; ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ. ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
21.e: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

21.g: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
21.e: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

21.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
21.e: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

21.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ. ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
21.e: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

21.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ; ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
21.e: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

21.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
21.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

21.g: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ; ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

21.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ. ਸਾਕਤਾ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

21.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
21.e: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

21.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

21.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
21.e: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

21.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

21.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ; ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
21.e: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

21.g: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
21.e: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

21.g: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ. ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

21.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ. ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ; ਜਮੁ. ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

21.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
21.e: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

21.g: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ; ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

21.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
21.e: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

21.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
21.e: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

21.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ, ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
21.e: He is without malice, without guise, and Unborn Entity.

21.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ, ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੪॥੯੪॥
21.e: Salutation to Him of One Form, Salutation to Him of One Form. 4.94.

21.g: ਪਰੇਅੰ ਪਰਾ, ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ॥
21.e: Yonder and Yonder is He, the Supreme Lord, He is the Illuminator of Intellect.

21.g: ਅਛੇਦੰ ਅਛੈ, ਆਦਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
21.e: He is Invincible, Indestructible, the Primal, Non-dual and Eternal.

21.g: ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਪਾਤੰ, ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
21.e: He is without caste, without line, without form and without colour.

21.g: ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਅਭੰਗੇ, ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਅਭੰਗੇ ॥੫॥੯੫॥
21.e: Salutation to Him, Who is Primal and Immortal Salutation to Him who is Primal and Immortal.5.95.

21.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਟ, ਕੋਟੈ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
21.e: He hath Created millions of Krishnas like worms.

21.g: ਉਸਾਰੇ ਗੜ੍ਹੇ, ਫੇਰ ਮੇਟੇ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
21.e: He Created them, annihilated them, again destroyed them, still again Created them.

21.g: ਅਗਾਧੇ ਅਭੈ, ਆਦਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
21.e: He is Unfathomable, Fearless, Primal, Non-dual and Indestructible.

21.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
21.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

21.g: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
21.e: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

21.g: ਕਿਉ. ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
21.e: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

21.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
21.e: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

21.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
21.e: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

21.g: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
21.e: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

21.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ; ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
21.e: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

21.g: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
21.e: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

21.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
21.e: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

21.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ; ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
21.e: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

21.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ; ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
21.e: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

21.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
21.e: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||

22.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
22.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

22.g: ਭਰਮੇ. ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ; ਜੇ ਭਵੈ. ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
22.e: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

22.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
22.e: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

22.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ. ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਬਿਨੁ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
22.e: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

22.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
22.e: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
22.e: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

22.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
22.e: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

22.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
22.e: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

22.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
22.e: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

22.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ; ਸੁ. ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
22.e: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

22.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
22.e: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

22.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
22.e: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

22.g: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
22.e: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
22.e: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

22.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
22.e: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

22.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
22.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

22.g: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ; ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
22.e: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.

22.g: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ; ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
22.e: Buy that object which will go along with you.

22.g: ਅਗੈ. ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
22.e: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||

22.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
22.e: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.

22.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ; ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
22.e: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||

22.g: ਪਰੇਅੰ ਪਰਾ, ਪਰਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ॥੬॥੯੬॥
22.e: Yonder and Yonder is He, the supreme Lord, He is the Perfect Illuminator. 6.96.

22.g: ਨ ਆਧੰ ਨ ਬਿਆਧੰ, ਅਗਾਧੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
22.e: He, the Unfathomable Entity is without the ailments of the mind and body.

22.g: ਅਖੰਡਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ, ਆਦਿ ਅਛੈ ਬਿਭੂਤੇ ॥
22.e: He the Lord of Indivisible Glory and Master of eternal wealth from the very beginging.

22.g: ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਮਰਨੰ, ਨ ਬਰਨੰ ਨ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥
22.e: He is without birth, without death, without colour and without ailment.

22.g: ਅਖੰਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੇ, ਅਦੰਡੇ ਅਸਾਧੇ ॥੭॥੯੭॥
22.e: He is Partless, Mighty, Unpunishable and Incorrigible.7.97.

22.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ, ਸਨੇਹੰ ਸਨਾਥੇ ॥
22.e: He is without love, without home, without affection and without company.

22.g: ਉਦੰਡੇ ਅਮੰਡੇ, ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ ॥
22.e: Unpunishable, non-thrustable, mighty and Omnipotent.

22.g: ਨ ਜਾਤੇ ਨ ਪਾਤੇ, ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੇ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੇ ॥
22.e: He is without caste, without line, without enemy and without friend.

22.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
22.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

22.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
22.e: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.

22.g: ਮਨੁ. ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ; ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
22.e: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.

22.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
22.e: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

22.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ. ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
22.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.

22.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
22.e: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

22.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
22.e: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.

22.g: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ. ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ; ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ. ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
22.e: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.

22.g: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਇਉ. ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ. ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
22.e: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||

22.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
22.e: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.

22.g: ਸਾਕਤ. ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
22.e: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.

22.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
22.e: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||

22.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ. ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
22.e: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.

22.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
22.e: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.

22.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
22.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||

22.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
22.e: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.

22.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
22.e: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.

22.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
22.e: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||

23.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
23.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ. ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ; ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
23.e: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ; ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
23.e: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

23.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
23.e: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ; ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
23.e: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ; ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
23.e: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ; ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
23.e: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

23.g: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
23.e: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

23.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ. ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
23.e: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

23.g: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ. ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
23.e: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

23.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
23.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

23.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ. ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ; ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
23.e: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

23.g: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ. ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ; ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ. ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
23.e: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

23.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ॥
23.e: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

23.g: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ; ਤੇਰੇ. ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
23.e: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

23.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ. ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ; ਇਨ ਤਜਿ. ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
23.e: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

23.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ. ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ; ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ. ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
23.e: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

23.g: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ. ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ. ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
23.e: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

23.g: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ. ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ; ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
23.e: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||

23.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
23.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

23.g: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ; ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
23.e: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

23.g: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ. ਪਤ ਜਿਉ; ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
23.e: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

23.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
23.e: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

23.g: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ; ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
23.e: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

23.g: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ; ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
23.e: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

23.g: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ; ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
23.e: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

23.g: ਕੀ. ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ; ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
23.e: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

23.g: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ; ਨਿਤ. ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
23.e: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

23.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ; ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
23.e: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

23.g: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ; ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
23.e: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

23.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਕਿਉ. ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
23.e: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

23.g: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
23.e: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

23.g: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ; ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
23.e: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

23.g: ਖੋਟੇ. ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ, ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
23.e: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

23.g: ਖੋਟੇ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ; ਖੋਟਿ. ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
23.e: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

23.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
23.e: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

23.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
23.e: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

23.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ; ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ. ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
23.e: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

23.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
23.e: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

23.g: ਸੁ ਭੂਤੇ ਭਵਿਖੇ, ਭਵਾਨੇ ਅਚਿਤ੍ਰੇ ॥੮॥੯੮॥
23.e: That Imageless Lord was in the past, is in the present and will be in the future. 8.98.

23.g: ਨ ਰਾਯੰ ਨ ਰੰਕੰ, ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥
23.e: He is neither the king, nor the poor, without form and without mark.

23.g: ਨ ਲੋਭੰ ਨ ਚੋਭੰ, ਅਭੂਤੰ ਅਭੇਖੰ ॥
23.e: He is without greed, without jealousy, without body and without guise.

23.g: ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ, ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ ॥
23.e: He is without enemy, without friend, without love and without home.

23.g: ਸਦੈਵੰ ਸਦਾ, ਸਰਬ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਸਨੇਹੰ ॥੯॥੯੯॥
23.e: He always has love for all at all times. 9.99.

23.g: ਨ ਕਾਮੰ ਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੰ, ਨ ਲੋਭੰ ਨ ਮੋਹੰ ॥
23.e: He is without lust, without anger, without greed and without attachment.

23.g: ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਛੈ, ਆਦਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਜੋਹੰ ॥
23.e: He is Unborn, Invincible, the Primal, Non-dual and Imperceptible.

23.g: ਨ ਜਨਮੰ ਨ ਮਰਨੰ, ਨ ਬਰਨੰ ਨ ਬਿਆਧੰ ॥
23.e: He is without birth, without death, without colour and without ailment.

24.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

24.g: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ. ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ. ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
24.e: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

24.g: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ. ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ; ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ. ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
24.e: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||
Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

24.g: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ. ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
24.e: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

24.g: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ; ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ, ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
24.e: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

24.g: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ. ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ; ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ. ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
24.e: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

24.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ. ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
24.e: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

24.g: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ. ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
24.e: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

24.g: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ, ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ; ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ. ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
24.e: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

24.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ. ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ; ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ. ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
24.e: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
There is one awareness among all created beings.
None have been created without this awareness.
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
The dogs of greed are with me.
In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.
Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

24.g: ਮੈ. ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
24.e: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.
I am deformed and horribly disfigured.
Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

24.g: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ; ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
24.e: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||
With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!
Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||
I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.
I am a robber-I rob the world.
I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||
I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

24.g: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ; ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
24.e: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.
Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

24.g: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ. ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
24.e: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

24.g: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ; ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
24.e: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||
Death, O Mullah-death will come,
so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

24.g: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ, ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ; ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
24.e: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

24.g: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ. ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ. ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
24.e: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

24.g: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ. ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ; ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
24.e: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

24.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ. ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
24.e: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

24.g: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ; ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
24.e: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

24.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ. ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ; ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
24.e: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||

24.g: ਨ ਰੋਗੰ ਨ ਸੋਗੰ, ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਖਾਧੰ ॥੧੦॥੧੦੦॥
24.e: He is without malady, without sorrow, without Fear and without hatred.10.100.
He Invincible, Indiscriminate, Actionless and Timeles.
He is Indivisible, Indefamable, Mighty and Patronless.

24.g: ਨ ਤਾਤੰ ਨ ਮਾਤੰ, ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਭਾਇਅੰ ॥
24.e: He is without father, without mother, without birth and without body.

24.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ, ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਕਾਇਅੰ ॥੧੧॥੧੦੧॥
24.e: He is without love, without home, without illusion and without affection. 11.101.

24.g: ਨ ਰੂਪੰ ਨ ਭੂਪੰ, ਨ ਕਾਯੰ ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
24.e: He is without form, without hunger, without body and without action.

24.g: ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੰ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਸੰ, ਨ ਭੇਦੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ ॥
24.e: He is without suffering, without strife, without discrimination and without illusion.
He is Eternal, He is the Perfect and Oldest Entity.

25.e: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:

25.g: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ. ਨਹ ਛਲੈ; ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
25.e: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.

25.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ. ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ; ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ, ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
25.e: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||

25.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ; ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.e: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||
Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil,
And let the Fear of God be the wick for the lamp of this body.
Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||
Use this oil to light this lamp.

25.g: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.e: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;
you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).
As is their awareness, so is their way.
According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?

25.g: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ; ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.e: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||
All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,
how can You become angry with them?
Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,
still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||
We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.
You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.
When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.
Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||
Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?
They are self-realized; they understand God.
By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;
such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

25.g: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ; ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ. ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
25.e: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?

25.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ, ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ. ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
25.e: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||

25.g: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ; ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
25.e: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.

25.g: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.e: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||
You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.

25.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ; ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
25.e: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.
You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.
I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||
Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.

25.g: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
25.e: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?
Nanak offers this one prayer:
this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

25.g: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ, ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ; ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
25.e: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.

25.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ. ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
25.e: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.

25.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
25.e: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||

25.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ, ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੧੨॥੧੦੨॥
25.e: Salutation to the Lord of One Form, Salutation to the Lord of One Form. 12.102.
His Glory is inexpressible, His Excellence from the very beginning cannot be described.
Non-aligned, Unassailable and from the very beginning Unmanifested and Unestablished.
He is the Enjoyer in diverse guises, invincible from the very beginning and an Unassailable Entity.

25.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ, ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੧੩॥੧੦੩॥
25.e: Salutation to the Lord of One Form Salutation to the Lord of One Form.13.103.

25.g: ਨ ਨੇਹੰ ਨ ਗੇਹੰ, ਨ ਸੋਕੰ ਨ ਸਾਕੰ ॥
25.e: He is without love, without home, without sorrow and without relations.
He is in the Yond, He is Holy and Immaculate and He is Independent.

25.g: ਨ ਜਾਤੰ ਨ ਪਾਤੰ, ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੇ ॥
25.e: He is without caste, without line, without friend and without adviser.

25.g: ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੇ, ਨਮੋ ਏਕ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧੦੪॥
25.e: Salutation to the One Lord in wrap and woof Salutation to the One Lord in wrap and woof. 14.104.
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?
The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.
As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.
What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||
He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.
The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||
The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden
according to their nature, He gives them all their names.
The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.
As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||
The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.
The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.
O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.
Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||

26.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
26.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

26.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
26.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

26.g: ਹਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ. ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
26.e: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
26.e: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

26.g: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ; ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
26.e: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

26.g: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
26.e: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

26.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ, ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ; ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
26.e: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

26.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
26.e: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

26.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
26.e: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

26.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
26.e: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

26.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
26.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

26.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
26.e: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
26.e: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

26.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
26.e: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

26.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
26.e: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

26.g: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ. ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ; ਜਿਨਾ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
26.e: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

26.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
26.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
26.e: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

26.g: ਜਿਨਾ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ; ਹਉ. ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
26.e: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

26.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
26.e: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

26.g: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ; ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
26.e: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

26.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ; ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
26.e: In the midst of this world, do seva,

26.g: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ; ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
26.e: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

26.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
26.e: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

26.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
26.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

26.g: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ. ਭਰਮਾਈਐ; ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
26.e: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਈ; ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
26.e: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

26.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ. ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
26.e: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

26.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
26.e: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

26.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ; ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
26.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
26.e: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

26.g: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ; ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
26.e: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

26.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
26.e: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ. ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
26.e: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

26.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ; ਓਨਾ. ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
26.e: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

26.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
26.e: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

26.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ; ਹਰਿ. ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
26.e: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||

26.g: ਨ ਧਰਮੰ ਨ ਭਰਮੰ, ਨ ਸਰਮੰ ਨ ਸਾਕੇ ॥
26.e: He is without religion, without illusion, without shyness and without relations.

26.g: ਨ ਬਰਮੰ ਨ ਚਰਮੰ, ਨ ਕਰਮੰ ਨ ਬਾਕੇ ॥
26.e: He is without coat of mail, without shield, without steps and without speech.

26.g: ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੰ, ਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
26.e: He is without enemy, without friend and without countenance of a son.

26.g: ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪੇ, ਨਮੋ ਆਦਿ ਰੂਪੇ ॥੧੫॥੧੦੫॥
26.e: Salutation to that Primal entity Salutation to that Primal Entity.15.105.

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕੰਜ ਕੇ ਮੰਜ, ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ਭੂਲੇ ॥
26.e: Somewhere as a black bee Thou art engaged in the delusion of fragrance of the lotus!

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰੰਕ ਕੇ ਰਾਜ, ਕੇ ਧਰਮ ਅਲੂਲੇ ॥
26.e: Somewhere Thou art describing the characteristics of a king and the poor!

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ, ਕੇ ਧਰਮ ਧਾਮੇ ॥
26.e: Somewhere Thou art the abode of virtues of various guises of the county!

26.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਸਾਜ, ਕੇ ਬਾਜ ਤਾਮੇ ॥੧੬॥੧੦੬॥
26.e: Somewhere Thou art manifesting the mode of Tamas in a kingly mood!  16. 106

27.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
27.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

27.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
27.e: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.

27.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
27.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

27.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
27.e: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.

27.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
27.e: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||

27.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
27.e: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.

27.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
27.e: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

27.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ. ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
27.e: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.

27.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
27.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.

27.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
27.e: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.

27.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ. ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
27.e: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||

27.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
27.e: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.

27.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
27.e: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.

27.g: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
27.e: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.

27.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
27.e: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||

27.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
27.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

27.g: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
27.e: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.

27.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
27.e: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.

27.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
27.e: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.

27.g: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ. ਸੇ, ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ; ਤਿਨ. ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
27.e: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||

27.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ; ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
27.e: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.

27.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
27.e: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

27.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
27.e: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.

27.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ. ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
27.e: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.

27.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
27.e: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.

27.g: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
27.e: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

27.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ; ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
27.e: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.

27.g: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ. ਨ ਬੁਝਈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
27.e: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

27.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ; ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
27.e: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.

27.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
27.e: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||

27.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ; ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
27.e: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.

27.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
27.e: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.

27.g: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
27.e: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.

27.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
27.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||

27.g: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ. ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ; ਮਤ ਤੂ. ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
27.e: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.

27.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ; ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
27.e: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.

27.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
27.e: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.

27.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ; ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
27.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਛ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਪਛ੍ਰ, ਕੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou art practicing for the realisation of powers through the medium of learning and science!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸਿਧ ਕੇ ਬੁਧਿ, ਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou art searching the secrets of Powers and Intellect!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅੰਗ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ, ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੇ ॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou art seen in profound love of woman!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੰਗ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ, ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਪੇਖੇ ॥੧੭॥੧੦੭॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou art seen in excitement of warfare!  17. 107

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ, ਕੇ ਹਰਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou art considered as the abode of the acts of piety!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ, ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou acceptest the ritualistic discipline as illusion!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਚਾਰ ਚੇਸਟਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou makest grand efforts and somewhere Thou lookest like a picture!

27.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਯਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ॥੧੮॥੧੦੮॥
27.e: Somewhere Thou art embodiment of fime intellect and somewhere Thou art the Sovereign of all!  18. 108

28.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
28.e: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.

28.g: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ. ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ; ਆਗੈ. ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
28.e: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.

28.g: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ. ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
28.e: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

28.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
28.e: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

28.g: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
28.e: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

28.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ; ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥
28.e: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
28.e: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.

28.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
28.e: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||

28.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
28.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ. ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
28.e: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
28.e: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.

28.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
28.e: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||

28.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
28.e: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.

28.g: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
28.e: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ; ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
28.e: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.

28.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ. ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
28.e: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.

28.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
28.e: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||

28.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
28.e: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.

28.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ. ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
28.e: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.

28.g: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
28.e: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

28.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ. ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
28.e: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

28.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
28.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

28.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
28.e: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru

28.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ; ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
28.e: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

28.g: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
28.e: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||

28.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
28.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ. ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
28.e: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||

28.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
28.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.

28.g: ਸਬਦੈ. ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
28.e: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.

28.g: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ. ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ; ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
28.e: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||

28.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ; ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
28.e: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

28.g: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
28.e: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
28.e: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

28.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
28.e: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

28.g: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
28.e: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.

28.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ; ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
28.e: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਹ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art an eclipse of love and somewhere Thou art physical ailment!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਔਖਧੀ, ਰੋਗ ਕੇ ਸੋਕ ਸੋਖੰ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the medicine, drying up the grief of malady!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੈਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of gods and somewhere Thou art the speech of demons!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜਛ ਗੰਧਰਬ, ਕਿੰਨਰ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੧੯॥੧੦੯॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the episode of Yaksha, Gandharva and Kinnar!  19. 109

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜਸੀ, ਸਾਤਕੀ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art Rajsic (full of activity), Sattvic (rhythmic) and Tamsic (full of morbidity)!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਾ ਧਰੇ ਤਾਪਸੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art an ascetic, practicing the learning of yoga!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰੋਗ ਰਹਿਤਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤੰ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the Remover of malady and somewhere Thou art cohesive with Yoga!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭੂਮਿ ਕੀ ਭੁਗਤ ਮੈ, ਭਰਮ ਭੁਗਤੰ ॥੨੦॥੧੧੦॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art cohesive with Yoga , Somewhere Thou art deluded in enjoying the earthly rictuals!  20. 110

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਦਾਨਵੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art a daughter of gods and somewhere a daughter of demons!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜਛ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਾ, ਧਰੇ ਮਾਨਵੀ ਹੋ ॥
28.e: Somewhere a daughter of Yakshas, Vidyadhars and men!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਹੋ, ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਕੰਨਿਆ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the queen and somewhere Thou art the princess!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਕੀ, ਰਿਸਟ ਪੰਨਿਆ ॥੨੧॥੧੧੧॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the superb daughter of the Nagas of netherworld!  21. 111

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਬਿਓਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of Vedas and somewhere the voice of heaven!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਕੋਕ ਕੀ, ਕਾਬਿ ਕਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thu art the discourse and story of general poets!

28.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਅਦ੍ਰ ਸਾਰੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਭਦ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
28.e: Somewhere Thou art iron and somewhere Thou art splendid gold!

29.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
29.e: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

29.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਦਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
29.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

29.g: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
29.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

29.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
29.e: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

29.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ. ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ. ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
29.e: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

29.g: ਹਉਮੈ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
29.e: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

29.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
29.e: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

29.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ, ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
29.e: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
29.e: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

29.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
29.e: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

29.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
29.e: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

29.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
29.e: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

29.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
29.e: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

29.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
29.e: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

29.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
29.e: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

29.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
29.e: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

29.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ. ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
29.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮਦ੍ਰ ਬਾਨੀ, ਕਹੂੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥੨੨॥੧੧੨॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art sweet speech and somewhere Thou art sweet speech and somewhere Thou art critical and fault finding!  22. 112

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਕਾਬ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of the Vedas and somewhere Thou art literature!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਚੇਸਟਾ ਚਾਰਿ, ਚਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou makest superb effort and somewhere Thou lookest like a picture!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ, ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou comprehendest the tenets of holy Puranas!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ, ਬੈਠ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨੩॥੧੧੩॥
29.e: And somewhere Thou singest the songs of sacred Quran! !  23. 113

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਸੁਧ ਸੇਖੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਰਮੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art a True Muslim and somewhere the adherent of the religion of Brahmins!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਅਵਸਥਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਬਾਲ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art in old age and somewhere actest as a child!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੁਆ ਸਰੂਪੰ, ਜਰਾ ਰਹਤ ਦੇਹੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art a youth sans an old body!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨੇਹ ਦੇਹੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਤਿਆਗ ਗ੍ਰੇਹੰ ॥੨੪॥੧੧੪॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou lovest the body and somewhere Thou forsakest Thy home!  24. 114

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਰੋਗ ਰਾਗੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art engrossed in Yoga and enjoyment and somewhere Thou art experiencing ailment and attachment!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰੋਗ ਰਹਿਤਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਭੋਗ ਤਿਆਗੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the Remover of ailment and somewhere Thou Forsakest enjoyment!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਰੀਤੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art in pomp of royalty and somewhere Thou art without kingship!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਪਰਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੰ ॥੨੫॥੧੧੫॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art perfect intellectual and somewhere Thou art embodiment of Supreme Love!  25. 115

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ, ਆਰਬੀ ਤੋਰਕੀ ਪਾਰਸੀ ਹੋ ॥
29.e: Somewhere thou art Arabic, Somewhere Turkish, Somewhere Persian!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ, ਪਹਿਲਵੀ ਪਸਤਵੀ ਸੰਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਹੋ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art Pathlavi, somewhere Pushto, somewhere Sankrit!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਸ ਭਾਖ︀ਯਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art Arabic, somewhere Turkish, somewhere Persian

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਦਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀ ॥੨੬॥੧੧੬॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the State-learning and somewhere Thou art the State Capital!!  26. 116

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the instruction of mantras (spells) and somewhere Thou art the essence of Tantras!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਰੀਤੰ, ਕਹੂੰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the instruction of the method of Yantras and somewhere Thou art the wielder of arms!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਹੋਮ ਪੂਜਾ, ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਵ ਅਰਚਾ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of Homa (fire) worship, Thou art the instruction about offerings to gods!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ, ਚਾਰਣੀ ਗੀਤ ਚਰਚਾ ॥੨੭॥੧੧੭॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the instruction about Prosody, somewhere Thou art the instruction about the discussion regarding the songs of minstrels!  27. 117

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੀਨ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਾਨ ਗੀਤੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning about lyre, somewhere about singing song!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਮਲੇਛ ਭਾਖਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤੰ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the language of malechhas (barbarians), somewhere about the Vedic rituals!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਦਿਆ, ਕਹੂੰ ਨਾਗ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning of dancing, somewhere Thou art the language of Nagas (serpents)!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਗਾਰੜੂ, ਗੂੜ੍ਹ ਕਥੈਂ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੨੮॥੧੧੮॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art Gararoo Mantra (that mantra, which effaces the snake poison) and somewhere Thou tallest the mysterious story (through astrology)!  28. 118

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ, ਅਛਰਾ ਪਛਰਾ ਮਛਰਾ ਹੋ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the belle of this world, somewhere the apsara (nymph of heaven) and somewhere the beautiful maid of nether-world!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ, ਅਭੂਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਹੋ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the learning about the art of warfare and somewhere Thou art the non-elemental beauty!

29.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਛੈਲ ਛਾਲਾ, ਧਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ॥
29.e: Somewhere Thou art the gallant youth, somewhere the ascetic on the deer-skin!
Somewhere a king under the canopy, somewhere Thou art the ruling sovereign authority!  29. 119

29.g: ਨਮੋ ਨਾਥ ਪੂਰੇ, ਸਦਾ ਸਿਧ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
29.e: I bow before Thee, O Perfect Lord! The Donor ever of miraculous powers!

29.g: ਅਛੇਦੀ ਅਛੈ, ਆਦਿ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
29.e: Invincible, Unassailable, the Primal, Non-dual Providence!

29.g: ਨ ਤ੍ਰਸਤੰ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਤੰ, ਸਮਸਤੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ ॥
29.e: Thou art Fearless, free from any bondage and Thou manifestest in all beings!

29.g: ਨਮਸਤੰ ਨਮਸਤੰ, ਤੁਅਸਤੰ ਅਭੂਤੇ ॥੩੦॥੧੨੦॥
29.e: I bow before Thee, I bow before Thee, O Wonderful Non-Elemental Lord!  30. 120

29.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
29.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

29.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
29.e: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

29.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
29.e: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

29.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ; ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
29.e: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

29.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
29.e: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.

29.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥ ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
29.e: BY THY GRACE PAADGARI STANZA!

29.g: ਅਬ︀ਯਕਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਨਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ॥
29.e: O Lord! Thou art Unmanifested Glory and Light of Knowledge!

29.g: ਅਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ, ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਨਾਸ ॥
29.e: Thou art Unassailable Entity Non-dual and Indestructible!

29.g: ਅਨਤੁਟ ਤੇਜ, ਅਨਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
29.e: Thou art indivisible Glory and an Inexhaustible Store!

29.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਰੰਤ, ਸਰਬੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
29.e: Thou art the Infinite Donor of all kinds! 1. 121

29.g: ਅਨਭੂਤ ਤੇਜ, ਅਨਛਿਜ ਗਾਤ ॥
29.e: Thine is the Wonderful Glory and Indestructible Body!

29.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਦੀਵ, ਹਰਤਾ ਸਨਾਤ ॥
29.e: Thou art ever the Creator and Remover of Meanness!

29.g: ਆਸਨ ਅਡੋਲ, ਅਨਭੂਤ ਕਰਮ ॥
29.e: Thy Seat is Stable and Thy actions are non-elemental!

29.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲ, ਅਨਭੂਤ ਧਰਮ ॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
29.e: Thou art the Beneficent Donor and Thy religious discipline is Beyond the working of elements! 2. 122

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ, ਨਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਾਤ ॥
29.e: Thou art that Ultimate Reality which is without enemy friend birth and caste !

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ, ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤ ॥
29.e: Which is without son brother friend and mother!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ, ਨਹੀਂ ਧਰਮ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
29.e: Which is action less Illusion less and without any consideration of religious disciplines !

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਨੇਹ ਗੇਹ, ਨਹੀਂ ਬਿਓਤ ਬਾਨ ॥੩॥੧੨੩॥
29.e: Which is without love home and beyond any thought-system! 3. 123

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਤਿ, ਨਹੀਂ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ॥
29.e: Which is without caste line enemy and friend!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਨੇਹ ਗੇਹ, ਨਹੀਂ ਚਿਹਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ॥
29.e: Which is without love home mark and picture!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ, ਨਹੀਂ ਰਾਗ ਰੇਖ ॥
29.e: Which is without caste line enemy and friend!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਨਮ ਜਾਤ, ਨਹੀਂ ਭਰਮ ਭੇਖ ॥੪॥੧੨੪॥
29.e: Which is without is without birth caste illusion and guise! 4. 124

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ, ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ॥
29.e: Which is without action delusion caste and lineage!

29.g: ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹ ਗੇਹ, ਨਹੀ ਪਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤ ॥
29.e: Which is without love home father and mother!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਾਮ ਥਾਮ, ਨਹੀ ਬਰਗ ਬਿਆਧ ॥
29.e: Which is without name place and also without species of maladies!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ, ਨਹੀ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ॥੫॥੧੨੫॥
29.e: Which is without ailment sorrow enemy and a saintly friend! 5. 125

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਵਾਸ, ਨਹੀ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਸ ॥
29.e: Which never remains in fear and whose body is Indestructible!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ, ਨਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਸ ॥
29.e: Which has no beginning no end no form and no outlay!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ, ਨਹੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
29.e: Which has no ailment sorrow and no device of Yoga!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਆਸ, ਨਹੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥੬॥੧੨੬॥
29.e: Which has no fear no hope and no earthly enjoyment! 6. 126

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ, ਕਟਿਓ ਨ ਅੰਗ ॥
29.e: Thou art That whose bodily limb hath never been stung by the serpent of death!

29.g: ਅਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ, ਅਖੈ ਅਭੰਗ ॥
29.e: Who is Unassailable Entity and Who is Indestructible and Imperishable!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਨੇਤ ਨੇਤ, ਉਚਰੰਤ ਬੇਦ ॥
29.e: Whom the Vedas call ‘Neti Neti’ (Not this not this) and infinite!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਅਲਖ ਰੂਪ, ਕਥਤ ਕਤੇਬ ॥੭॥੧੨੭॥
29.e: Whom the Semitic Scriptures call Incompre-hensible! 7. 127

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਅਲਖ ਰੂਪ, ਆਸਨ ਅਡੋਲ ॥
29.e: Whose Form is Unknowable and Whose Seat is stable!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ, ਅਛੈ ਅਤੋਲ ॥
29.e: Whose light is unlimited and who is Invincible and Unweighable!

29.g: ਜਿਹ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾਜ, ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
29.e: For Whose meditation and sight infinite sages !

29.g: ਕਈ ਕਲਪ, ਜੋਗ ਸਾਧਤ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥੮॥੧੨੮॥
29.e: Perform hard Yoga Practices for many kalpas (ages)! 8. 128

29.g: ਤਨ ਸੀਤ ਘਾਮ, ਬਰਖਾ ਸਹੰਤ ॥
29.e: For Thy realization they endure cold heat and rain on their body!

29.g: ਕਈ ਕਲਪ, ਏਕ ਆਸਨ ਬਿਤੰਤ ॥
29.e: For many ages they remain in the same posture!

29.g: ਕਈ ਜਤਨ, ਜੋਗ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
29.e: They make many efforts and ruminate over the learning of Yoga!

29.g: ਸਾਧੰਤ ਤਦਪਿ, ਪਾਵਤ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥੯॥੧੨੯॥
29.e: They practice Yoga but still they cannot know Thy end! 9. 129

29.g: ਕਈ ਉਰਧ ਬਾਹ, ਦੇਸਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ॥
29.e: Many wander in several countries with raised arms!

29.g: ਕਈ ਉਰਧ ਮਧ, ਪਾਵਕ ਝੁਲੰਤ ॥
29.e: Many burn their bodies upside down!

29.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
29.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

29.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
